items.description: Flies become harmless or less dangerous depending on the type.
items.effects:
* This item causes many Fly enemies to alter their behavior toward Isaac.
** The following flies transform into a neutral normal Fly: Attack Fly, Dart Fly, Ring Fly, Army Fly, and Swarm.
** The following flies no longer shoot at Isaac: Pooter, Super Pooter, and Tainted Pooter.
*** These don't deal contact damage, even without Skatole.
** The following flies move slower and no longer deal contact damage: Level 2 Fly and Bulb.
*** Bulbs will not drain active item charges if touched.
** The following flies no longer deal contact damage, but retain their speed: Eternal Fly, Moter, Hush Fly, Ultra Famine Fly, Ultra Pestilence Fly, and Ultra Pestilence Fly Ball.
*** Moters will not split into Attack Flies, and Eternal Flies will not turn into Attack Flies.
** The following flies move slower and no longer deal contact damage, but can still damage Isaac through other means: Full Fly, Boom Fly, Red Boom Fly, Drowned Boom Fly, Dragon Fly, Dragon Fly X, Bone Fly, Sick Boom Fly, Bloodfly, and Tainted Boom Fly.
*** Bone Flies will still throw bones at Isaac.
** The following flies no longer deal contact damage, but retain their speed and can still damage Isaac through other means: Sucker, Soul Sucker, Spit, Ink, Level 2 Willo, and Mama Fly.
** The following flies move slower, but will still deal contact damage: Boom Fly, Red Boom Fly, Drowned Boom Fly, and Fly Bomb.
** The following flies are completely unaffected, retaining their normal attacks and speed: Swarm, Hush Fly, Sucker, Soul Sucker, Spit, Willo, Eternal Fly Bomb, and Tainted Sucker.
*** Willos and Tainted Suckers don't deal contact damage, even without Skatole.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* This item can only be naturally obtained from the Shell Game.
** ⟨24⟩ Skatole exists in an otherwise unused shellGame item pool. This means it can also be acquired with ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ and ⟦i:402¦Chaos⟧, and bosses in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ can drop it.
* 's effect overrides Skatole.
* ⟨7⟩ Flies spawned by ⟦e:the-husk¦The Husk⟧ will not become passive.
* ⟨24⟩ Due to being quality 0, Skatole cannot be obtained from Shell Games after ⟦i:691¦Sacred Orb⟧ has been picked up.
* This item makes ⟦e:the-duke-of-flies¦The Duke of Flies⟧ a lot easier, as most of his attacks, which spawn flies, will instantly be converted. Staying out of his way while having Skatole can even make it so he ends up killing himself.

items.description: Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, he will respawn in the previous room with full health, after which 1up! will disappear.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, he will respawn in the previous room with full health, after which 1up! will disappear.
** If Isaac has no Red Heart Containers, he'll respawn with a Half Soul Heart instead.
* The 1up! mushroom begins following Isaac like a familiar upon pickup, but doesn't do anything. It disappears when its life is used up.
items.notes:
* Resurrection items activate in a set order. 1up! is 1st in this order.
* ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧ (⟨24⟩ ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧) will each respawn with 3 Soul Hearts.
* ⟨28⟩ ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ will respawn with 3 filled Bone Hearts and ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧ with whatever Soul and Black Hearts he had on death.
** Dying as The Soul respawns him with a Half Soul Heart and The Forgotten with whatever Bone Hearts he had on death.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧ will respawn with 2 Black Hearts.
* ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧ will respawn in his ghost form if he had been turned into his ghost form before dying.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with 1up! having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

items.description: Isaac poisons enemies on contact. ⟨7⟩ -0.1 speed. ⟨24⟩ +0.2 speed. ⟨6⟩ Poisoned enemies have a chance to drop a black heart when killed.
items.effects:
* Inflicts poison on enemies who make contact with Isaac.
** ⟨1⟩ The poison deals 2 damage per tick (3 damage per second) and lasts for 2-3 ticks.
** ⟨2⟩ The poison deals Isaac's damage per tick (1.5x Isaac's damage per second) and lasts for 2-3 ticks.
** ⟨4⟩ The poison deals Isaac's damage per tick (1.5x Isaac's damage per second) and lasts for 6 ticks for normal enemies and 3 ticks for bosses.
** ⟨24⟩ The poison lasts for 6-7 ticks and deals damage equal to (0.2*HeartContainers^2) + 2, where HeartContainers is the total number of heart containers and Bone Hearts Isaac has.
*** The poison can be continuously applied to bosses, which normally are immune to status effects for a brief time after being inflicted with one.
* ⟨24⟩ Lets Isaac deal 12 contact damage per tick on top of applying poison (24 damage per second).
* ⟨6⟩ Enemies who are killed after they have been inflicted with this type of poison have a 20% chance to drop Black Hearts.
* ⟨7⟩ -0.1 speed down.
** ⟨1⟩ This is not applied until the next time Isaac's speed stat is updated.
* ⟨24⟩ +0.2 speed up.
items.notes:
* This item can drop from killing ⟦e:lust¦Lust⟧. ⟨7⟩ Lust can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.
* Taking another copy of ⟦i:13¦The Virus⟧:
** ⟨1⟩ results in a speed down with no benefit.
** ⟨30⟩ does not affect Isaac.
** ⟨24⟩ counts as two items towards the Spun transformation.
* ⟨6⟩ The black heart is only dropped if the poison was caused by The Virus. The item's effect doesn't extend to poison tears.
* ⟨6⟩ If an enemy doesn't do contact damage, The Virus can safely be applied to it for more chances at black hearts. Flies, Mulligans, and Hosts are the most common enemies this can be applied to.
** ⟨6⟩ With ⟦i:9¦Skatole⟧, Hives and Swarmers will constantly spawn normal Flies, meaning they can be endless sources of Black Hearts.
** ⟨3⟩ Although Stonies and Shopkeepers can't be visibly poisoned, they still can drop Black Hearts if destroyed after being touched.
* Enemies won't start taking poison damage if they are pushing up against Isaac; The Virus will be constantly trying to apply poison and refreshing the ticks where poison damage would occur.
** ⟨6⟩ ⟦i:210¦Gnawed Leaf⟧ and The Virus can still work if Isaac has a short-range orbital such as ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧ or ⟦i:207¦Ball of Bandages⟧, as it will kill enemies pushing against Isaac that are not taking poison damage while still dropping Black Hearts.

*** ⟨24⟩ Losing ⟦i:691¦Sacred Orb⟧ after exhausting an item pool while holding it will allow low quality items to appear again.

items.notes:

With moderate luck, a poop pile spawned by this item may drop the trinket itself, and with a method of generating unlimited battery charge, it becomes a matter of time. With the trinket, The Poop can easily become a better source of Hearts and money than other items that require more charges, such as ⟦i:78¦Book of Revelations⟧ or ⟦i:97¦The Book of Sin⟧.

items.description: Creates an explosion around Isaac, damaging him and nearby enemies as well as destroying obstacles.

items.notes:

** Kamikaze! does not bypass invincibility, which means items such as ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ or ⟦i:663¦Tooth and Nail⟧ work normally.
** ⟨7⟩ Devil Room/Angel Room chance is lowered if red heart damage is taken.
** ⟨24⟩ Devil Room/Angel Room chance will not be lowered if red heart damage is taken.
* Kamikaze!'s cool down length is as long as the invincibility frames Isaac normally gets from being hit. This means that Isaac cannot activate Kamikaze!, and then activate Kamikaze! again before the invincibility frames end.
* Synergizes with many bomb-enhancing items such as ⟦i:140¦Bob's Curse⟧, with exceptions listed in Interactions.

items.description: +1 luck. Improves Isaac's chances at various random events (independent from the luck stat). ⟨24⟩ Converts all bad pills into good pills, without identifying them.
items.effects:
* +1 luck.
* Increases chances of winning at Shell Game, Hell Game, Slot Machine, Fortune Telling Machine, and Confessional.
* Increases chances of getting a room-clearing drop (independent from the luck stat).
* Increases the chance of a reward from a Beggars or Devil Beggar after each of their first payouts.
** On Hard mode, reduces the minimum number of donations for each reward to 2 (from 3).
** Does not apply to Key Master, Bomb Bum, Battery Bum, or Rotten Beggar.
* ⟨24⟩ Converts all "bad" pills into their "good" counterparts but doesn't affect neutral ones, like ⟦i:75¦PHD⟧. Pills remain unidentified.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧ starts with this item by default.
* For Room Clear Awards, the Lucky Foot works by first applying a decimal multiplier to the room-clearing drop RNG, and then by raising its minimum value. All of this happens before the luck stat modifies the RNG's maximum value by adding another random number.
** With zero luck, your chance to get nothing from a room clear is 22%; with Lucky Foot's modifiers (other than luck), it's reduced to around 13.33%. The effect on its own is similar to having 6.5 extra points of luck, though with a much lower likelihood of getting Chests.
** Lucky Foot also slightly increases the likelihood of running into Chests, though this effect is most noticeable if your luck isn't very high.

items.description: Creates a crosshair on the ground that can be aimed with tear controls. A missile strikes the spot after 2 seconds, creating a heavy damage explosion.

items.notes:
* The red marker works different from Epic Fetus' marker when controlled with the mouse: While pressing mouse left button, it keeps going away from Isaac, not following the mouse.
* Activating the item again while the crosshair is on the ground will cancel the animation of Isaac holding up the remote and allow him to shoot tears sooner.
** Activating the item again while having full charge (e.g. with ⟦i:63¦The Battery⟧) will also deplete the charge, wasting it.
** ⟨7⟩ Taking damage also cancels the animation.
** ⟨7⟩ The missile will still drop on the crosshair, which can no longer be controlled.
** ⟨24⟩ This will cancel the missile drop and remove the crosshair.

items.description: Tears are replaced by Bombs that benefit from bomb-enhancing effects and slide for a fixed time after being fired.
items.effects:
* Tears are replaced with Bombs that explode approximately one second after being fired.
** ⟨1⟩ Each bomb deals 3 times the character's normal tear damage.
** ⟨6⟩ Each bomb deals 5 times the character's normal tear damage plus a flat 30 damage. The flat 30 is not affected by damage multipliers.
** ⟨24⟩ Dr. Fetus has two formulas for calculating the damage it does. At first, each bomb deals 10 times the character's normal tear damage. If the previous formula would lead to the bombs doing more than 60 damage, the bombs instead deal 5 times the character's normal tear damage plus a 30 flat damage. The flat 30 is not affected by damage multipliers.
** Tears down: ⟨7⟩ Tear Delay × 2.5 / ⟨24⟩Fire Rate ÷ 2.5.
** ⟨7⟩ The range and shot speed stats both affect the velocity at which the bombs are fired out. Delay before the explosion is not affected by either.
*** ⟨24⟩ Bomb velocity formula has not been updated to account for the new range stat so it uses tear height for calculation (and not the actual range stat), resulting in the range stat effectively not working for Dr. Fetus with exceptions being ⟦i:6¦Number One⟧, ⟦i:440¦Kidney Stone⟧, ⟦i:598¦Pluto⟧, and ⟦i:688¦Inner Child⟧'s revive, which make velocity absurdly low. Shot speed still increases bomb velocity.
** ⟨24⟩ Bombs grow larger or smaller with tear size modifiers and deal no knockback to each other.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Dr. Fetus is a special item.
* Dr. Fetus overrides multiple tear effect items, but benefit some/⟨30⟩all bomb-enhancing effects like ⟦i:106¦Mr. Mega⟧.
* Dr. Fetus bombs deal half a heart of damage to Isaac. Other explosion damage is not affected.
** Self-damage is increased to a full heart if the bomb would deal 85 damage or more. This includes effects from bomb modifiers, not just raw base damage.

items.description: Pulls pickups towards Isaac.
items.effects:
* Pickups (e.g. hearts, coins, keys, bombs, etc.) are attracted to Isaac.
** The attraction enables the item to pass/fly over pits or rocks, but not through Key Blocks.
** Hearts are only attracted if Isaac could pick them up with his existing Red Heart containers.
** Batteries act similarly to hearts in that they will only be attracted to Isaac if his active item isn't fully charged.
** Chests roughly 2 or fewer tiles away from Isaac open automatically. Spiked Chests are opened without damaging Isaac. Locked Chests and Bomb Chests are not opened and still require a key/bomb, though Locked chests will be opened from a distance if Isaac possesses the ⟦t:19¦Paper Clip⟧.
items.notes:
* Magneto can attract Scared Hearts, but they still run away from Isaac.
* Grab Bags are not attracted by Magneto.
** ⟨24⟩ They are also not opened by Magneto.
* ⟨24⟩ If Magneto opens the chests in Challenge Rooms, the waves won't start spawning unless you touch the empty chests, nor will the way out be closed.

items.quote: Eye in the back of your head
items.description: Gives Isaac a chance to fire tears from the back of his head.
items.effects: * Gives Isaac a chance to shoot a tear out of an eye on the back of his head.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ The chance to shoot an extra tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 2 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5 \right \rfloor}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 50%, maxing out at 100% at 2 luck.
* ⟨24⟩ The chance to shoot an extra tear depends on the luck stat and is based on this formula: 50\% + (10\% * \mathit{Luck})
** This means that the chance starts at 50% at 0 luck, minimizes at 0% at -5 luck, and maximizes at 100% at 5 luck.

items.description: Reduces all Shop prices by 50%, rounded down to 7 coins for an item, rounded up to 2-3 coins for a pickup.
items.effects:
* Halves the price of all purchasable items and pickups.
** Items on sale for an odd amount will have their price rounded down (ie; 15 cost items will cost 7).
** Most Pickups have their price reduced to 3. ⟨24⟩ This includes Grab Bags, which are normally sold for 7.
** Red Hearts have their price reduced to 2.
* ⟨24⟩ Prevents shops from having natural discounts.
items.notes:
* This item can drop from killing ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧, as well as a 1% chance to drop from destroying Shopkeepers.
** It can also drop from killing ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧, if ⟦i:74¦A Quarter⟧ is not yet unlocked.
* ⟨7⟩ Multiple Steam Sales can be obtained via each of the normal drop methods.
* ⟨1⟩ Multiple Steam Sales have no effect.
* ⟨6⟩ After obtaining 2 Steam Sales, all shop prices are set to 0 coins.
* ⟨24⟩ Multiple Steam Sales only further reduce prices, with each additional copy lowering prices less.
** The price is lowered to \frac{price}{n+1}, where n is the number of Steam Sales. For example, an item with 3 Steam Sales would cost 15 \over 4 pennies, which is rounded up to 4.
* ⟨2⟩ Steam Sale will cause the Deals with the Devil not to convert the type of required heart automatically.
* ⟨24⟩ Steam Sale's quality is treated as 3 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

** These tears appear red, but have no special effects.
items.notes:

* ⟨24⟩ Sister Maggy deals more damage than ⟦i:8¦Brother Bobby⟧, while Brother Bobby has a higher tear rate.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Sister Maggy having 5th priority.

items.description: Replaces tears with a piercing laser with unlimited range.
items.effects: * Replaces tears with a laser beam with unlimited range and piercing. The laser is fired from Isaac's left eye.
items.notes:
* Laser rate of fire is determined by the tears stat. This differentiates the item from ⟦i:152¦Technology 2⟧ which fires a continuous beam, and ⟦i:244¦Tech.5⟧ which has a random fire rate.
* ⟨24⟩ Laser size scales with tear size.
** ⟨24⟩ The sound emitted by the laser will also change depending on its size. This is purely aesthetic.
* ⟨24⟩ Lasers are affected by momentum, allowing them to be shot diagonally if fired while Isaac is moving.
* ⟨24⟩ When directly adjacent to a wall or obstacle and firing in the wrong direction the obstacle may block the laser, preventing it from damaging enemies. This can happen on all sides of a given room with the exception of the bottom wall.

items.description: Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.
items.effects:
* Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.
** Tear damage scales from approximately 10% damage at a minimum charge to 400% damage at full charge.
*** The minimum charge damage increases as Isaac's fire rate increases.
* ⟨7⟩ Tear delay: ×2.5.
items.notes:
* Repeatedly pressing a key to fire allows Isaac to fire as quickly as the key is pressed, up to the equivalent of a maxed tears stat. This is not generally recommended, as overall damage per second is greatly reduced.
** Rapid-fire can be useful for dealing with low-health enemies or for quickly destroying obstacles like poops or fireplaces, for whom DPS is less relevant, or chance-based tear effects.
* Having multiple instances of Chocolate Milk has no effect.
* ⟨24⟩ At 30.00 fire rate or above, charging is no longer needed. Higher fire rate results in higher tear damage. At 120.00 fire rate, tears deal 4× Isaac's damage.

items.description: Grants 3 Soul Hearts. ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧ has a chance to appear in any item pool. ⟨24⟩ +0.5 tears.
items.effects:
* Grants 3 Soul Hearts.
* Items in all pools have a \frac{1}{\mathit{SumOfPoolItemsWeight chance to be replaced by ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧.
** The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.
* ⟨24⟩ +0.5 tears.
items.notes:
* If The Bible has been picked up before collecting the Rosary, it will not replace other items.
* The Bible can be encountered multiple times even in the same pool if it is not picked up; however, once picked up, it cannot appear again anywhere.
* ⟨24⟩ Collecting more than one Rosary will further increase the chance of finding The Bible. The above limitations still apply, and it can be collected only once no matter the number of Rosaries.
* This item stacks with ⟦t:7¦Rosary Bead⟧, further increasing the chance to find The Bible in the Library and Shop.
* ⟨1⟩ The approximate chances of finding ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧ in each item pool are:
** Treasure Room: 2.26%
** Shop: 12.82%
** Boss: 11.36%
** Devil Room: 12.82%
** Angel Room: 20.83%
** Secret Room: 20.83%
** Library: 45.45%
** Golden Chest: 55.56%
** Red Chest: 71.43%
** Beggar: 27.78%
** Devil Beggar: 45.45%
** Curse Room: 38.46%
** Key Master: 71.43%
*** The probabilities after Rebirth have not been computed, though the chances are pretty similar to the ones shown above. This is because the smaller the item pool, the more likely the Bible is to appear, and this effect is far more pronounced than the Bible simply being added to each pool. So, for example, the Bible is much more likely to appear from a Red Chest compared to the Treasure Room.

items.description: Creates an orbital familiar. Collecting additional copies gives it the ability to shoot tears, then chase enemies to deal contact damage, then deal even more contact damage.
items.effects:
* Spawns an orbital familiar around Isaac which blocks shots and deals 105 contact damage per second.
* Each subsequent Cube of Meat obtained is combined with the first one (increasing its 'level'), changing its characteristics:
** Level 2: Gives the orbital the ability to shoot tears that deal 3.5 damage once every second.
** Level 3: Changes it from an orbital to a Meat Boy that chases nearby enemies dealing 8.75 contact damage per second.
** Level 4: Increases the size of the Meat Boy and increases its damage to 13.75 contact damage per second.
** The fifth Cube of Meat will create a new Level 1 cube, and start the cycle again.
items.notes:
* Multiple Cubes of Meat can be collected in a single run.
* ⟨24⟩ The orbital orbits Isaac significantly faster.
* ⟦e:famine¦Famine⟧, ⟦e:pestilence¦Pestilence⟧, ⟦e:war¦War⟧, and ⟦e:death¦Death⟧ will always drop either a ⟦i:207¦Ball of Bandages⟧ or Cube of Meat. After the first one drops, further Harbingers will only drop that same one and never the other for the duration of the run.
* The ticking rate for Meat Boys' contact damage causes them to often deal damage twice once they touch an enemy, making their first second of DPS up to 1.5x higher than normal.
* The following types of flies are instantly killed when they come in contact with the familiar, at any level:
** Army Fly
** Attack Fly
** Dart Fly
** Fly
** Hush Fly
** Moter
** Pooter
** Ring Fly
** Super Pooter
** Swarm

items.description: Converts all bad pills into good pills, spawns one pill pickup, and identifies all pills. Restores two Red Hearts and increases the payout of Blood Donation Machines.
items.effects:
* Identifies all pills upon pickup.
* Spawns a pill.
* Replenishes 2 Red Hearts.
* Increases the payout of Blood Donation Machines to 2-3 coins on Normal mode and 2 on Hard mode.
* ⟨7⟩ Increases the payout of ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ to 2-3 coins.
* ⟨24⟩ Increases the payout of ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ to 2-3 coins on Normal mode and 2 on Hard mode.
* Converts some "bad" pills into their "good" counterparts or removes their bad effects:
items.notes:
* Bad pills already obtained/dropped will be converted to their "good" counterparts.
* If PHD is lost in any way, such as rerolling by the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ or a Dice Room, or dropping it as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧, pills will remain fully identified, but negative pills will not be converted.
** Rerolling an owned passive item into PHD through effects such as ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ will not identify pills, but will convert negative pills into positive ones.
* ⟨28⟩ Performing a RERUN with a character that held PHD will still prevent negative pills from spawning, but will no longer identify pills until used.
* As bad pills will turn into good pills, it is possible for two different colored pills to have the same effect.
* Multiple copies of PHD will not yield more coins when using a Blood Donation Machine or IV Bag.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with eight pills.

items.effects:
* Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.
** ⟨7⟩ Isaac deals 40 contact damage to enemies, once per second.
** ⟨24⟩ Isaac deals 20 contact damage to enemies, twice per second.
*** If an enemy is at 40 HP or less, the contact damage is increased to 40 for that enemy.
items.notes:
* The invulnerability effect negates all forms of damage, including health loss from Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.
* Ending the current run via opening the end chest while My Little Unicorn is active will cause the credits and main menu music to be sped up. The effect ends upon restarting the game or starting a new run.
* ⟦p:vii-the-chariot¦VII - The Chariot⟧ card provides the same effect of this item when used.

items.description: Increases the chance of a Devil Room / Angel Room appearing while held. Upon use, gives one Soul Heart, and replaces the boss of the current floor with a Harbinger if possible.
items.effects:
* Upon use, gives one Soul Heart.
* Increases chance for a Devil Room or Angel Room door to open if held while killing the final boss of the floor.
** ⟨1⟩ The chance is increased by 35%.
** ⟨30⟩ The chance is increased by 17.5%.
* If the Book of Revelations is used at least once on a floor, a Harbinger will replace the current floor's boss if possible.
** ⟨25⟩ This will always happen as long as the floor's respective Harbinger has not been encountered, the boss has not been fought yet, and a Harbinger can appear on the floor normally.
** ⟨6⟩ This has a high chance to happen but is not guaranteed.
items.notes:
The Harbingers capable of appearing, and the floors they appear on, are as follows:
# ⟦e:famine¦Famine⟧ in Chapter 1
# ⟦e:pestilence¦Pestilence⟧ in Chapter 2
# ⟦e:war¦War⟧ in Chapter 3, floor 1
# ⟦e:death¦Death⟧ or ⟦e:conquest¦Conquest⟧ (if unlocked) in Chapter 4, floor 1
# ⟦e:headless-horseman¦Headless Horseman⟧ on any floor in Chapters 1-4
* Set bosses (⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, ⟦e:isaac¦Isaac⟧, ⟦e:the-lamb¦The Lamb⟧, etc.) are unaffected by Book of Revelations.
* Only the first boss of a floor affected by is affected.
* Book of Revelations won't replace the boss on double-sized Boss Rooms, like Double Trouble rooms or if the boss is ⟦e:mr-fred¦Mr. Fred⟧.
** Furthermore, if the Book of Revelations is used on the first floor of a Chapter with a Double Trouble room no Harbinger will spawn on the second floor, even if Book of Revelations is used again. If finding a Harbinger is desired, Isaac should wait until seeing the shape of the Boss Room before using it.
* Keeping Book of Revelations until Chapter 4 is one of the methods to unlock achievements related to Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl, explained in detail here.
* ⟨3⟩ This item can replace the Boss even after Isaac initiates a battle with a normal boss and then teleports out before the fight is completed.
* ⟨28⟩ This item can replace ⟦e:the-bloat¦The Bloat⟧ with a Harbinger in .
* ⟨24⟩ Bosses in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ / ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ and their variants cannot be replaced with Harbingers.

items.description: Sets Isaac's Red Heart Containers to 1, but grants 9 extra lives. After dying, Isaac respawns with 1 Red Heart Container in the previous room.
items.effects:
* Sets Isaac's Red Heart containers to 1 when being picked up.
** Does not remove Soul Hearts or Black Hearts unless picked up as ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧, ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧, or ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧.
** ⟨28⟩ Does not remove Bone Hearts unless picked up as ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧.
*** Can be picked up as The Soul half of The Forgotten to remove all but 1 Soul heart and keep all Bone Hearts.
* Grants 9 extra lives.
** Upon death, Isaac respawns with 1 Red Heart container, typically in the previous room.
* The head of Guppy begins following Isaac like a familiar upon pickup but doesn't do anything.
** When Isaac has lost all of the lives provided by this item, the Guppy familiar will disappear.
items.notes:
* This item can drop from killing ⟦e:super-pride¦Super Pride⟧. ⟨7⟩ Super Pride can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.
* Resurrection items activate in a set order. Dead Cat is ⟨7⟩ 2nd / ⟨24⟩ 4th in this order after ⟦p:soul-of-lazarus¦Soul of Lazarus⟧, ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧, and ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧' inherent extra life.
* ⟨1⟩ Picking this item up as ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ does not show the number of lives remaining, but still functions normally.
* ⟨28⟩ If picked up as ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, his Bone Hearts are reduced to 1 but ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧'s Soul Hearts remain unaffected; It is also true the other way.
* The lives are added after the "picking up an item" animation has ended, so characters that die while the animation is playing will not be revived by this item.
* ⟨7⟩ The effects of the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:283¦D100⟧, ⟦i:258¦Missing No.⟧, or a 1- or 6-pip Dice Room will not remove the lives granted by this item.
* Additional Dead Cats can be picked up during a run, increasing lives well past 9. ⟨7⟩ Only the first dead cat counts toward becoming Guppy.
* ⟨4⟩ This item counts as 9 items, so if Isaac is trying for an early portal to ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ after beating ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, this will significantly boost the progress closer to 20 items.
* ⟨24⟩ If ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ take the item, only the brother who takes it will be set to one Red Heart Container on pickup. But if they die, both are resurrected with one Red Heart Container.
** If both brothers take the item (via ⟦i:347¦Diplopia⟧ or ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧), resurrections will be subtracted from Jacob before Esau, regardless of which brother actually died.
* ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧'s health will still be reduced to 1 Red Heart Container if he takes this item after being touched by ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧ or if he dies in his Lost form.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Dead Cat having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* If Isaac somehow obtains Dead Cat in the starting room of Chapter 1 and dies before ever leaving it, he will respawn in that same room.
** ⟨24⟩ Similarly, during the fight against ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, Isaac will respawn in the same room on the spot and can continue the battle.
* ⟨24⟩ Despite the life counter being shown during the ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ chase, the item is inactive like all other items and will not provide extra lives.
* ⟨24⟩ If all 9 lives are used, Dead Cat disappears from Isaac's inventory. If Isaac only has three Guppy items prior to losing Dead Cat, then its disappearance will cause the Guppy transformation to be lost.
* ⟨16⟩ Dead Cat's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

items.description: Re-rolls all items in the current room into other items, depending on the current room's item pool.
items.effects: * Upon use, replaces every item in the current room (not pickups or trinkets) with other random items corresponding to the current room's item pool.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ The D6 is a special item.
* ⟦c:isaac¦Isaac⟧ starts with this item once it is unlocked.
* Since it re-rolls every item in the room, it can be more efficient to use it in rooms where multiple items are in the same room. For instance:
** In the Shop, when multiple items are available for purchase.
** In the Devil Room, when there are multiple deals offered.
** In the Boss Room after the ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ fight, where both ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ and ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ can be rerolled, at the cost of the opportunity to go to the ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧/⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧. Once one item is picked up the other will disappear.
** In the Angel Room, when there is a choice between multiple items.
** In the Boss Rush Room, where all items can be rerolled at once.
** When ⟦i:249¦There's Options⟧ or ⟦i:414¦More Options⟧ spawn two items.
* Items from Chests can be rerolled.
** When an item from a chest is rerolled, the item is rolled from the current room's item pool, and not the chest's
* When an item pool is exhausted, the pool will start to use the ⟦pool:Treasure Room¦Treasure Room Pool⟧.
** When the ⟦pool:Treasure Room¦Treasure Room Pool⟧ is exhausted, every item in it will be rerolled to ⟦i:25¦Breakfast⟧.
** With ⟦i:402¦Chaos⟧, every fully depleted item pool will only contain ⟦i:25¦Breakfast⟧.
* ⟨1⟩ If Isaac runs out of red hearts in the Devil Room, then rerolls, the prices of the items switch over to soul hearts.
* ⟨7⟩ Using the D6 on an active item yields different rerolls depending on whether you picked up the active item first.
* Using the D6 to reroll items duplicated with ⟦i:347¦Diplopia⟧ will reroll all the items into different items. The copied item will not be rerolled into the same one as the original item.
* Be careful when rerolling, as it will replace the item with another item from the current room's item pool, even if the item came from a different pool, or is a set drop. This can be used as an advantage in various ways; for example, after defeating ⟦e:the-fallen¦The Fallen⟧, the item will be drawn from the ⟦pool:Devil Room¦Devil Room item pool⟧, so Isaac can safely roll the item into another from that pool. This behavior can also be an advantage in Angel Rooms since ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ can be rerolled to get a free Angel Room item.
** Normal rooms use the ⟦pool:Treasure Room¦Treasure Room Pool⟧.

items.description: Separates Isaac's head from his body for the current room, granting flight and turning the body into a familiar that chases enemies.
items.effects:
* Separates Isaac's head and body for the current room. Isaac's head, which now has flight, will be under the player's control, while his body will seek out enemies to attack by contact damage.
** The body's movement speed is dependent on Isaac's speed.
** ⟨7⟩ The body deals 5.5 damage per tick, or up to 82.5 damage per second.
** ⟨24⟩ The body deals 5.5 damage per tick, or up to 23.6 damage per second.
items.notes:
* The damage of the body familiar is independent of Isaac's stats. ⟨7⟩ Its damage per second is the highest of all chasing familiars.
* ⟨24⟩ If Isaac's body is not visible (for example, through the effects of ⟦i:20¦Transcendence⟧ or previous uses of the Pinking Shears), the familiar will gain Flight and take upon a ghost-like body, similar to the Lost's body type.
* If used multiple times in the same room (via battery pickups, for example), more instances of the body familiar can be spawned.
* ⟨7⟩ If Isaac switches active items while The Pinking Shears is in effect, the body will immediately despawn for the rest of the room.
* The body familiar will avoid creep, and will consequently rarely damage enemies like Brains and ⟦e:blighted-ovum¦Blighted Ovum⟧ that leave creep trails as they walk, instead opting to stand right next to them.
* Using The Pinking Shears just above an obstacle results in the body becoming stuck in the terrain, making it useless until the obstacle is destroyed.

items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Demon Baby having 5th priority.

items.description: Isaac's tears are replaced by a knife that pierces enemies, can travel through obstacles, and can hurt enemies while Isaac is holding it. Holding down the fire button before firing increases its range and power.
items.effects:
* Isaac's tears are replaced by a knife that pierces enemies and can travel through obstacles. Holding down the fire button increases its range and power.
* The knife deals damage 20 times per second upon contact with enemies while Isaac is holding it.
* ⟨7⟩ The knife deals 2× Isaac's damage while held and 6× damage at the furthest possible point of its throw distance, regardless of the actual maximum range stat.
* ⟨24⟩ Damage dealt by the knife depends on its charge state. The knife deals 2× Isaac's damage when held and 6× damage at about 1/3 of full charge. The knife damage quickly drops to 2× Isaac's damage when returning regardless of charge state. Further charging only increases its maximum range.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Mom's Knife is a special item.
* ⟨7⟩ The knife can be held and fired diagonally with frame perfect input. This can be done easily with a controller's analog stick or with ⟦i:465¦Analog Stick⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ The knife can be held and fired diagonally as if Isaac was holding ⟦i:465¦Analog Stick⟧.
** The knife can be fired in any direction if using mouse controls (enabled in options.ini).
* The knife will not work in challenges with the blindfolded effect.

items.description: Reduces the charge of any activated item by 1. Any 1 charge items instead have timed recharges.
items.effects:
* Fully charges the currently held active item upon 9 Volt's first pickup.
* If the current active item has a recharge time of more than 1 bar, then it will grant 1 bar of charge whenever the item is activated.
* If the current active item has a recharge time of 1 bar, then it will change the item to have a timed recharge of 15 seconds. The recharging of the item only triggers so long as there are enemies present in the room in any fashion. Empty rooms do not cause recharging to start.
* ⟨28⟩ If the current activated item already has a timed recharge, 9 Volt makes it start at half charge when used, effectively halving the time to recharge and allowing quicker reuse.
items.notes: * Enemies generated through a Slot Machine, Shell Game, Hell Game, Rotten Beggar or breaking Urns/Skulls will restart the charging process, even though a cleared room still counts as cleared if enemies are spawned in it.

items.effects:
* Taking damage summons a bird familiar that chases enemies for the remainder of the current room, dealing 2 damage per tick (~4.3 damage per second).
** ⟨16⟩ As long as Isaac's HP is at one half heart ( no matter the type of heart), Dead Bird will remain active between rooms. Upon entering a new floor, Dead Bird will be inactive, and a hit must be taken to activate it again.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧ starts with this item by default.
** ⟨16⟩ Additionally, Dead Bird will remain active between rooms at a total HP of one heart or less.
* The following types of flies are instantly killed when they come in contact with the familiar:
** Army Fly
** Attack Fly
** Dart Fly
** Fly
** Hush Fly
** Moter
** Pooter
** Ring Fly
** Super Pooter
** Swarm

items.description: Tears are replaced with a blood laser beam that pierces through all enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period.
items.effects:
* Isaac's tears are replaced with a charged blood laser beam. The beam is piercing and spectral, dealing damage to all enemies and ignoring all obstacles in its path.
** The laser deals damage equal to Isaac's damage and deals damage each tick.
*** These ticks occur every 1/15th of a second (once every 4 frames). However, after the first damage tick, there is an additional pause for ~0.12 seconds (7 frames). Damage ticks work normally after that.
*** ⟨7⟩Brimstone ticks 13 times over the course of 0.9 seconds (54 frames).
*** ⟨24⟩Brimstone ticks 9 times over the course of ~0.63 seconds (38 frames).
** \text{Charge Time (s)} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay)}) \approx \frac{1}{\text{Fire Rate
** ⟨24⟩Starting from 15.00 fire rate, the beam can last indefinitely as long as the fire key is held, and higher fire rate results in higher damage and larger scale.
*** \text{Damage per Tick} = \frac{6 \times \text{Damage{\text{Tear Delay} + 1} = \frac{\text{Damage} \times \text{Fire Rate{5}
* Tears down: ⟨7⟩ Tear Delay × 3 / ⟨24⟩ Fire Rate ÷ 3.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Brimstone is a special item.
* ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧ starts the game with a short-ranged, slower-charging version of Brimstone. Without the long-range version, his mini-brimstone won't have enough length to use any homing items.
** ⟨30⟩His Brimstone's shorter range can be increased with range-increasing items or pills.
* Multi-shot effects like ⟦i:245¦20/20⟧ will increase the number of beams accordingly, with exceptions listed below.
** Although extremely unlikely, Isaac can shoot a total of 16 blood beams at a time via multi-shot items. If the number of blood beams would exceed this number, the beams' span will instead widen.
* ⟨24⟩⟦c:tainted-azazel¦Tainted Azazel⟧ has a full-range, but thinner beam whose damage is halved unless enemies are cursed by his inherent ⟦i:726¦Hemoptysis⟧ sneeze.
* The beam will apply Tear effects and does so frequently thanks to its high tick rate.
* Any item that grants homing tears: will cause the beam to make sharp turns and even loops to hit enemies, which is extremely powerful. ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧'s mini-brimstone does not home unless he has a high range stat.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with eight Black Hearts.

items.description:
⟨15⟩+1.7 tears, +0.3 speed, slightly reduces damage.
⟨16⟩ +1.7 fire rate, +0.3 speed, slightly reduces damage.
items.effects:
* ⟨15⟩ +1.7 tears.
** Additional copies only grant +0.7 tears.
* ⟨16⟩ +1.7 fire rate.
** Additional copies only grant +0.7 fire rate.
* +0.3 speed.
* -0.4 damage.
* x0.9 total damage up multiplier.
** This penalty is not a total damage multiplier and applies only to certain "standard" damage ups, the specific details are available in the damage order list.
* Decreases Isaac's size.
items.notes:
* There are two collectible items in the game named Odd Mushroom; they can be told apart from the sprites.
* This item's damage multiplier works differently than other items in the game: instead of directly multiplying the damage stat, it multiplies the total added damage from other items. As a result, flat damage upgrades aren't affected by Odd Mushroom.
** Multiple copies of the item will grant a speed and fire rate boost with no additional decrease in damage.
* Despite only the head part gets smaller visually, Isaac's size also gets smaller. Isaac can walk between some gaps while only the body stays the same size if enough copies of the item are taken.
* ⟨16⟩ Since the damage penalty doesn't apply to everything and the item grants a straight fire rate bonus instead of tears, it is often an upgrade to total damage output. Some combinations of high tears/fire rate with few or no damage ups will result in DPS down.

items.description: Grants +1.5 Damage and +0.3 Speed whenever Isaac has a Half Red Heart or less.
items.effects: * Grants +1.5 Damage and +0.3 Speed whenever Isaac has a Half Red Heart or less.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧ starts with this item by default, and has the following extra effects:
** The item is activated at one full Red Heart or less.
** Her damage multiplier increases from 0.75 to 1.0 when active.
* The effect is removed after leaving a room with more than half a heart (more than one full heart for ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧).
* The effect may not be immediately applied if Isaac has lost red hearts without taking damage; the effect will activate upon entering a new room.
* The effect is always active for characters without Red Heart containers, such as ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧ and ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, though other characters can also lose their heart containers through Devil deals or items like ⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧ or ⟦i:230¦Abaddon⟧.
* ⟦p:iii-the-empress¦III - The Empress⟧ grants a similar effect to Whore of Babylon for the current room which does stack with Whore of Babylon.
** Stacking The Empress on Whore of Babylon either via multiple cards or multiple activations of ⟦i:286¦Blank Card⟧ increases damage by the number of uses squared, e.g. +1.5 * 2 * 2 total damage bonus for using the card on top of activated Whore of Babylon.

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Spawns a familiar from a specific selection for the current room.
⟨24⟩ Spawns a familiar from a specific selection for the current floor.
items.effects:
When used, a random familiar will be spawned from the following:
* ⟨7⟩ Familiars spawned by Monster Manual last for the current room.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars spawned by Monster Manual last for the rest of the floor.
* Familiars generated by Monster Manual do not contribute toward transformations.
items.notes:
* It can spawn familiars not yet unlocked.
* If ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧ or ⟦i:207¦Ball of Bandages⟧ are spawned and Isaac already has either of those items, the level of these items will increase while the effect is active.
* Using Monster Manual is a good method to unlock achievements related to Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl.
** Using Monster Manual and enough Lil' Batteries, Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl can both be achieved in the same run.
** If Isaac does not already have the Cube of Meat or Ball of Bandages, Monster Manual can spawn a level 2 Cube of Meat or Ball of Bandages in one use.
* ⟦i:322¦Mongo Baby⟧ will not copy familiars spawned by Monster Manual.
* Familiars spawned by Monster Manual cannot be rerolled into other items by ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ or ⟦i:283¦D100⟧.
* ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧ will not duplicate familiars spawned by Monster Manual.
* ⟦i:645¦Tinytoma⟧ orbitals will persist between floors until they are all destroyed. They will not respawn outside of the floor they were generated in.
* ⟨24⟩ The familiars summoned by Monster Manual are items with a monstermanual item tag.
* ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧: If dead Tainted Lazarus has used Monster Manual, but living Tainted Lazarus progresses to the next floor (or vice versa), familiars from the previous floor are not removed. Upon exiting the game, or moving to the next floor as either character, any familiars retained this way are lost, meaning familiars cant be kept at most 1 extra floor.

items.description: Triggers the effect of a random activated item from a list of possible options (not every activated item is included).
items.effects: When used, a random activated item effect will be activated from the following:
items.notes:
* When ⟦i:42¦Bob's Rotten Head⟧ or ⟦i:49¦Shoop da Whoop!⟧ is chosen, Dead Sea Scrolls will not lose its charge until said item is thrown or released.
** This allows Isaac to press Spacebar again if need be to skip over said items in the rotation while keeping full charge, allowing it to be used again for a different effect.
*** This doesn't work if Bethany has Soul Charges and ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧.
* It may be helpful to use Dead Sea Scrolls upon entering an enemy room, as many of its effects such as ⟦i:93¦The Gamekid⟧ and ⟦i:38¦Tammy's Head⟧ are helpful in combat.
* As many of Dead Sea Scrolls effects involve explosions, using it near Tinted Rocks or potential Secret Room entrances can potentially be helpful when low on bombs.
** While ⟦i:65¦Anarchist Cookbook⟧ and ⟦i:40¦Kamikaze!⟧ can hurt the player, effects such as ⟦i:78¦Book of Revelations⟧, ⟦i:83¦The Nail⟧, ⟦i:158¦Crystal Ball⟧ and ⟦i:146¦Prayer Card⟧ will pay out with more health than is lost long-term.
* ⟨24⟩ Since ⟦i:84¦We Need To Go Deeper!⟧ guarantees a crawlspace if used on special tiles, it may be helpful to use Dead Sea Scrolls on such tiles whenever possible.

items.description: Damages Isaac for one heart and grants +1.2 damage for the current room. ⟨24⟩ Subsequent uses in the same room only take half a heart.
items.effects:
* On use, damages Isaac for a full heart of health and grants +1.2 damage for the current room.
** Razor Blade takes Red Hearts before other heart types.
** ⟨24⟩ When used more than once in the same room, damage taken is lowered to half a heart.
items.notes:
* ⟨30⟩ ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧ starts with this item after unlocking it and donating 439 coins to the Greed Donation Machine.
** ⟨7⟩ Both conditions must be met for Eve to hold it; donating 439 coins before defeating ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧ with Eve will wrongly state on Eve's profile on the Character Selection Screen that she has it equipped.
** ⟨24⟩ Eve starts with the Razor Blade if unlocked from the Greed Machine, even if ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧ has not been defeated with Eve.
* ⟨7⟩ If Isaac has half a red heart left, Razor Blade will damage other heart types.
* It is possible to die using Razor Blade if Isaac does not have enough hearts.
* The effect stacks with itself and ⟦t:40¦Red Patch⟧, which provides a similar benefit.
* Using this item does not affect Devil Room/Angel Room chances.
* Using the Razor Blade grants immunity frames; this allows access to Curse Rooms without losing soul hearts.
* ⟨30⟩ Using this item in the ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧ boss room will remove 2-4 coins and drop 1-3 pennies on the floor, as if Isaac was hit by an enemy attack.
* Using this item as ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ will kill The Lost, even if the protective effect from ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ is still active.
** ⟨24⟩ This interaction will kill Isaac while temporarily transformed into The Lost by a White Fire Place, even when he would otherwise have enough hearts to survive.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Restarts the current floor with a new layout. Any items and pickups from the original floor are kept.
items.effects:
* On use, the current floor will be completely re-generated and Forget Me Now will be removed from Isaac's inventory.
** Isaac will restart the level as if he had entered a new floor.
** This will be a brand new floor, with different rooms and mapping generation.
items.notes:
* The re-generated floor will count as the same floor number as the one Isaac used Forget Me Now in.
** If a Devil Room / Angel Room is not encountered after defeating the boss of the re-generated floor, the multiplier tied to the number of floors since the last Devil/Angel Room affecting the spawn chance will not change.
*** ⟨24⟩ If the first possible Devil Room is encountered, the 100% chance for the next deal to be an angel chance is preserved upon regenerating the floor.
** If a Devil/Angel Room is encountered before regenerating the floor, the multiplier will become x0.25 upon regenerating the floor.
* Any items earned before using the re-generation effect will remain in Isaac's inventory.
* ⟨15⟩ There is an extremely brief time window after using Forget Me Now where Isaac can pick up another active item before the floor regenerates.
* If used on the ⟦s:depths¦Depths⟧ / ⟦s:necropolis¦Necropolis⟧ / ⟦s:dank-depths¦Dank Depths⟧ II after beating ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, both ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ and ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ can be obtained in one run. Additionally, two Boss Rushes can be entered as long as the total playtime of the run stays under 20 minutes.
** ⟨24⟩ This also allows opening the door to ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II in the starting room.
* ⟨24⟩ If used on ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II after collecting ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧, a second ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ will spawn in the mirrored world's Treasure Room, which can be rerolled into a random item from the Treasure Room (Item Pool).
* ⟨24⟩ If used on ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ / ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ II after collecting ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, a second ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ will spawn in the chase sequence, which if picked up results in a ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ familiar following Isaac if he doesn't have a second ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧.
* ⟨15⟩ If used on ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ or ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ when the door to ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ has been opened, the golden key will not re-open the door and you will be unable to fight him.
** ⟨16⟩ The door to ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ will now stay open after restarting the floor.
* If used on an XL floor, the merged chapter can be re-generated as two separate floors instead.
* If used on ⟦s:womb¦Womb⟧ II/⟦s:utero¦Utero⟧ II/⟦s:scarred-womb¦Scarred Womb⟧ II after defeating ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧, and Mom's Heart is again defeated on the regenerated floor, it will count as having defeated Mom's Heart 2 separate times, therefore unlocking 2 consequent endings.
* Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms will have the same rewards and enemy waves as the Challenge Room in the previous iteration of the floor.
* ⟨24⟩ If left in a Treasure or Boss Room and then returned to during the Ascent, the Forget Me Now item will return to the room it was left each time it is used, allowing the floor to be repeated indefinitely.
** This can be useful in conjunction with ⟦i:586¦The Stairway⟧, as it allows for unlimited Angel Shops to be visited.
** Upon reentry, items, pickups, and trinkets left in the treasure and boss room after using Forget Me Now will be removed and not converted into cracked keys.
* ⟨24⟩ If used on ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, each room is re-generated and players can obtain an additional item from the chest in Mom's room.
* If used in Floor 1, the chance of Devil/Angel room is still 0%.
* ⟨24⟩ If a Treasure Room hasn't been visited, the Planetarium chance persists unchanged.
* ⟨24⟩ If used on Mausoleum or Gehenna II after the special version of ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ is defeated, the newly generated floor will be dimly lit as though Mom's Heart was already defeated. Additionally, no items will naturally generate in rooms where they would have. After the player defeats ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ again, there will be no flesh door, and the trapdoor to ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ will appear.
* This item is significantly useful for both score and time-related daily runs. For score, it gives you a significant boost of exploration while for time, using it on the final floor locks in the finish time at which it was consumed. Meaning — you don't have to do the final floor and save up a lot of time.

items.description: Passively grants flight and increases speed to 1.5. Upon use, Isaac charges in the direction the pony is facing, giving invulnerability during the charge and dealing damage to enemies hit.
items.effects:
* Passively gives flight whether it has charges or not.
* If Isaac's speed is less than 1.5, passively increases his speed to 1.5.
* Upon use, Isaac charges in the direction the pony is facing, giving invincibility during the charge and dealing contact damage to enemies.
** ⟨7⟩ The dash deals 40 flat contact damage to enemies.
** Invincibility granted by dashing will not prevent Isaac from being damaged by Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, and similar self-damage active items (when holding ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧).
** ⟨24⟩ The dash deals 4 times Isaac's damage, plus a flat 28 damage.
** ⟨24⟩ Isaac can dash through doors, which means that damage from Curse Room doors can be avoided.
*** The dash persists through rooms, and lasts up to the length of 2 normal rooms unless Isaac collides with a closed door/wall.
**** This allows Isaac to enter and exit curse rooms for free, provided the dash is activated to give invincibility before charging through the exit.
**** Caution should be taken when dashing into rooms that have not been explored, as some room layouts have Blood Donation Machines or Devil Beggars, which Isaac may dash into and get damaged.
***** This is more important to ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, as ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ or ⟦p:holy-card¦Holy Card⟧ can not prevent damage from them.
items.notes:
* A Pony is only obtainable as a boss drop from ⟦e:headless-horseman¦Headless Horseman⟧, as a starting item for ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧, by using ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ on ⟦i:131¦Bomb Bag⟧, or by using ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧.
* The flight and potential speed added by A Pony will be removed if a new activated item is collected.
* ⟨28⟩ If ⟦i:477¦Void⟧ is used, Isaac will not be granted permanent flight.

items.effects: * Grants a 1/3 chance of replacing Room Clear Awards with a Chest or a Locked Chest, but also a 2/9 chance to replace it with nothing at all.
items.notes:
* The drawback to this item is that Keys become much more scarce, while increasing the amount of Locked Chests. This makes taking Guppy's Tail a potential liability early on.
* Due to any found Chests containing items while in ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ or ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧, Guppy's Tail can be a good way to quickly stack up more upgrades before facing the final boss.
* ⟨30⟩ The effect does not apply to Pennies dropped in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, meaning that this item has no effect in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ other than counting towards the Guppy Transformation.

items.description: Damages Isaac and spawns a random amount of coins, similar to a Blood Donation Machine.
items.effects:
* Upon use, causes Isaac to lose half a heart of health (or a full heart in Chapter 4 onward) while spawning coins.
** ⟨7⟩ Each use pays out with 1-2 coins.
** ⟨24⟩ Each use pays out with 1-2 coins on Normal mode or 1 coin on Hard mode.
** IV Bag takes Red Hearts before other heart types.
items.notes:
* This item can be found when causing a Blood Donation Machine to explode by donating Hearts to it.
* This effect is counted as inflicted damage for items that spawn pickups upon said inflicted damage, such as ⟦i:225¦Gimpy⟧ or ⟦i:204¦Fanny Pack⟧, but does not decrease the chance of encountering the Devil Room / Angel Room.
* Can be used before taking damage (getting hit, walking over spikes, going through a Curse Room, etc.) to grant coins without inflicting extra damage.
** ⟨7⟩ Also allows Isaac to avoid damage taken by using a Blood Donation Machine or Devil Beggar.
* Using this item as ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ or while in the Lost form after touching the White Fire Place kills Isaac.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a decoy Isaac that explodes after 5 seconds. Enemies will always target the decoy and ignore Isaac.
items.effects:
* Spawns a decoy vaguely resembling Isaac in his crying animation, which explodes after 5 seconds with the blast radius of a Mega Troll Bomb.
** ⟨7⟩ The explosion deals 110 damage.
** ⟨24⟩ The explosion deals 185 damage.
* The decoy bomb distracts enemies, as they will target the decoy instead of Isaac regardless of distance.
items.notes:
* All Bomb modifier items will affect Best Friend, with the exception of ⟦i:125¦Bobby-Bomb⟧, ⟦i:353¦Bomber Boy⟧, ⟦i:517¦Fast Bombs⟧, ⟦i:106¦Mr. Mega⟧, and ⟦i:583¦Rocket in a Jar⟧.
** ⟦i:366¦Scatter Bombs⟧ will create mini decoys.
** ⟦i:367¦Sticky Bombs⟧. When sticking to a flying enemy that can fly off-screen, Best Friend will fly off with them but will not deal explosion damage.
* Bosses such as ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧ or ⟦e:carrion-queen¦Carrion Queen⟧ can swallow the decoy bomb just like a regular bomb.
* Isaac can push the decoy bomb by walking into it or shooting it with his tears just like regular bombs.
* If Isaac leaves and re-enters a room after placing the decoy bomb, its explosion timer will be set to that of a regular bomb (1.5 seconds).

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Bombs placed by Isaac only explode when Remote Detonator is used. Gives 5 bombs.
items.effects:
* Activating the Remote Detonator will cause all Bombs placed by Isaac to explode.
* Bombs will no longer explode without the usage of the detonator.
* Gives 5 bombs when picked up. If the same instance of the item is picked up a second time in the same run, this effect will not be applied.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if ⟦e:hornfel¦Hornfel⟧ is killed in his second phase.
* Remote Detonator gives Isaac five bombs for the price of three (using the bombs on the Donation Machine to trade for coins) when bought at a Shop, making its purchase a good value if the player is low on bombs.
** ⟨24⟩ The Donation Machine explodes once bombed and while it drops many coins, it is destroyed for the rest of the run
* Remote Detonator does not control the explosions of Troll Bombs and Mega Troll Bombs.
* It does control throwable bombs spat out by Bomb Grimaces, once picked up. The bombs can be carried throughout rooms without ever exploding until Remote Detonator is used, making a Bomb Grimace essentially equivalent to a Golden Bomb with this item.
* If ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧ or ⟦e:carrion-queen¦Carrion Queen⟧ swallow a remote bomb, the bomb will be released from them after the animation unless it is detonated manually.

items.description: Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half heart, he is granted one Soul Heart.
items.effects:
* Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half heart (either red, soul, or black), the aura around his head temporarily vanishes and he is granted one Soul Heart.
** After re-entering a room, the ability can be triggered again.
** With Bone Hearts, the effect triggers on both half-filled and empty ones.
items.notes:
* If the Scapular is active and Isaac is already at his last half heart, the effect won't trigger even on fatal damage.
** ⟦c:tainted-samson¦Tainted Samson⟧ / ⟦i:704¦Berserk!⟧: If fatal damage activates Tainted Samson's Berserk, or if it occurs during Berserk!'s effect, it will trigger and grant the soul heart.
* ⟨30⟩ Scapular does not charge between waves in Greed mode, though it can still be recharged by moving between rooms.
* Does not work with ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ or ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧, as they cannot reach the required heart value.
* Reaching only half a heart remaining may be more difficult in Chapter 4 onwards, since all half-heart hits are upgraded to a full heart.
* ⟨24⟩ Damage sources that count as "health donation" no longer activate Scapular. This includes Blood Donation Machine, Devil Beggar, Hell Game, Confessional, ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧, ⟦i:126¦Razor Blade⟧, ⟦i:186¦Blood Rights⟧, ⟦i:486¦Dull Razor⟧, ⟦i:205¦Sharp Plug⟧, ⟦i:448¦Shard of Glass⟧, ⟦i:614¦Blood Bombs⟧, and ⟦i:569¦Blood Oath⟧. However, Sacrifice Rooms and Curse Room spikes still activate Scapular.
** Scapular can still be exploited by alternating between donating half a heart and taking half a heart of damage from elsewhere.
*Rotten Hearts cannot activate Scapular as the whole heart will be depleted by any damage source.

* ⟨30⟩ Bum Friend can pick up Lucky Pennies, but it will simply count as a regular Penny and will not grant luck.
* ⟨6⟩ From a scoring perspective, Pennies that Bum Friend picks up count towards your Schwag bonus on daily runs.
* Bum Friend does not join the line of familiars that follow behind Isaac.
* Not recommended for ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ as it will make it harder to regain health due to the Keeper healing via coins.

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Isaac destroys obstacles and opens Secret Rooms by walking into them, but cannot shoot or pick up items until it's cancelled.
⟨24⟩ Toggles between tears and the pickaxe, which can be swung to attack and break obstacles. Using it depletes the charge, and it can't be used until next floor once the charge runs out.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Isaac holds the Notched Axe above his head as long as he is in that room, and can break any obstacles he touches, as well as being able to break through walls that lead into Secret Rooms.
* ⟨24⟩ Isaac stops shooting tears and holds the Notched Axe like ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s club, and can break obstacles, blow open doors, and hit enemies for 3x damage by swinging it. The Notched Axe has 64 charges. Hitting rocks or opening doors depletes 1 charge for each obstacle destroyed. Hitting enemies depletes 2 charges. Isaac can toggle back and forth between tears and using the Notched Axe by pressing the Active Item button. Once the Notched Axe runs out of charges, it cannot be used for the rest of the floor.
* ⟨24⟩ The charges on Notched Axe cannot be refilled by means other than going to a new floor or picking up ⟦i:201¦Iron Bar⟧. This includes Batteries, Battery Bums, ⟦i:647¦4.5 Volt⟧, ⟦i:520¦Jumper Cables⟧, etc.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ If Isaac takes damage while using the Notched Axe, his current use of the Axe will end.
* ⟨7⟩ Isaac cannot attack or pick up other items while using the Notched Axe.
* ⟨7⟩ Activating the item while it is already being used will end the effect. This does not require any charge.
* ⟨7⟩ Obstacles destroyed by the Notched Axe will never fill pits.
* ⟨24⟩ The Notched Axe may be used to get access to the ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧. The door will break open with one swing.
* ⟨24⟩ Notched Axe shares its synergies with ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s bone club. See that page for details.
* ⟨24⟩ Notched Axe, like ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s bone club, may be used to pick up items that are just out of reach over a pit or spikes. This does not require any charge.
* ⟨24⟩ Notched Axe can open secret rooms, and so it can be used on walls to test for secret rooms without using charge.
* ⟨24⟩ Notched Axe cannot free Sticky Nickels.
* ⟨24⟩ Notched Axe can provoke an Angel Statue in Angel Rooms, triggering the boss fight.
* ⟨24⟩ Notched Axe can be used to destroy the ⟦e:tuff-twins¦Tuff Twins⟧ and ⟦e:the-shell¦The Shell⟧ bosses instead of using bombs.

items.description: Replaces tears with explosive and poisoning projectiles fired in an arc from the mouth.
items.effects:
* Replaces tears with explosive and poisoning projectiles fired in an arc.
* ⟨7⟩ Tears down − (Delay × 2) + 10
* ⟨24⟩ 1/3 Fire Rate
* ⟨7⟩ Tear Falling Speed is set to 13.
* ⟨24⟩ 0.8× range multiplier.
* ⟨24⟩ 0.8× shot speed multiplier.
* +40 flat damage (See Effective Damage)
* Tear size multiplier: 0.4×
items.notes:
* Enemies within the blast radius of an Ipecac explosion will also be poisoned.
* The damage boost mitigates the very small tear size multiplier.
* Ipecac's damage bonus does not apply to Burn or Poison fully; only ⟨7⟩ +4/⟨24⟩ +2 is applied to their damage per tick.
* Character damage multipliers do not apply to Ipecac's flat bonus.
* Since explosions that deal less than 85 damage hurt Isaac for half a heart, Ipecac shots usually hurt Isaac for half a heart.
** Self-damage is increased to a full heart with 85 or higher damage stat.
* If Isaac's damage is above ⟨7⟩ 100 / ⟨24⟩ 166, Ipecac's explosions will shake the screen. This is just a visual effect.
** ⟨24⟩ A big enough tear size (~827 damage with no other tear size modifiers) will cause the explosion sound to change to the one used by ⟦i:483¦Mama Mega!⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ The height of the shots scales with range. At base stats, Ipecac shots won't be able to fly over obstacles, but the more range ups Isaac gets, the higher shots will be launched.
* ⟨24⟩ It is possible that with low shot speed and high range/tear height, Isaac won't be able to hit obstacles up close with Ipecac shots.
* ⟨7⟩ The range of the explosion is a circle roughly 3 blocks in diameter, regardless of damage.
** As Ipecac's explosion range does not scale with tear size, with enough tear size increasing items (e.g. ⟦i:237¦Death's Touch⟧), it can become nearly impossible to hit enemies with Ipecac's explosions.
* ⟨24⟩ Ipecac's explosion range increases with tear size.

items.description: Adds a chance to shoot a tooth instead of a tear, which deals x3.2 Isaac's damage.
items.effects: * Adds a chance to shoot a tooth instead of a tear, which deals x3.2 Isaac's damage.
items.notes:
* The chance to fire a tooth depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 9 luck.

items.description: Tears have a 16.67% chance of spawning allied Blue Flies when they hit an enemy.

items.notes:

** ⟨24⟩ The 66.67% chance of spawning a fly granted by Guppy will not stack with The Mulligan's 16.67% chance.
* ⟨24⟩ Blue flies will only spawn if Isaac has less than 30 blue flies.
* ⟨7⟩ This item does not work for ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ since the ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ tears do not count for her tears.
* Items and trinkets that increase tear firing rate synergize well with the Mulligan.
* This item is not affected by luck.

items.description: Replaces the tears fired from Isaac's right eye with a rapid-firing low damage piercing laser. ⟨7⟩ Damage down.
items.effects:
* Replaces Isaac's right eye tears with an unlimited range piercing laser which fires continuously, dealing damage 15 times per second.
* ⟨7⟩ x0.65 Damage multiplier.
* ⟨7⟩ The laser deals 20% of Isaac's damage per tick.
** This compounds with the damage down for a total of 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
* ⟨24⟩ Only the laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.
* ⟨24⟩ Tears fired per second * (2/3).
* ⟨24⟩ Laser is able to knock back enemies.
items.notes:
* Tear delay is effectively doubled, as Isaac will do a bit of the animation to fire a right eye tear, but no tear will come out.
** ⟨24⟩ This applies to items that replace Isaac's tears, such as ⟦i:114¦Mom's Knife⟧ and ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧.
* Charged shots are not affected by the effective tear delay down, as they don't use the alternative left eye/right eye fire scheme.
* ⟨7⟩ As ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧ can only fire tears from his right eye, Technology 2 will replace his tears altogether unless he has ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧ or a charged attack.
** ⟨24⟩ When used by Cain, or a character that is forced to fire from one eye due to the effects of ⟦i:708¦Stapler⟧ or ⟦i:444¦Lead Pencil⟧, they will fire ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧ lasers out of their right eye instead of their normal tears, as long as they have no other items that replace their tears (⟦i:597¦Neptunus⟧ or ⟦i:6¦Number One⟧ lets them fire tears normally). These lasers cannot be angled with momentum.
* ⟨7⟩ Because ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ is blindfolded and relies on her ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧, the only effect gained from Technology 2 is the damage down.
** ⟨24⟩ Incubus can fire laser and tears as normal; stat effects apply.
* ⟨24⟩ The blood clots spawned by ⟦c:tainted-eve¦Tainted Eve⟧ will all also fire their own individual lasers.
* The laser can apply status effects very efficiently due to its high tick rate.
