** Bomb: 1+1 Bombs, Troll Bomb, Golden Bomb
** Heart: Double Heart, Half-Heart, Soul, Half-Soul, Black, Eternal, Gold, Bone, Rotten
** Key: Golden, Charged Key
** Card: Reversed Cards
** Rune: Soul Stones
** Pill: Horse or Golden pills
** Trinket: Golden Trinket
* ⟨24⟩ Box's quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds 2 keys. Chests will drop additional pickups.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac two Keys.
* If a non-Red Chest spawns hearts, coins, Bombs and/or Keys, causes the chest to spawn a second group of said pickups, effectively doubling the average pickup yield.
items.notes:
* Mom's Key cannot change the contents of a chest; it will only cause it to spawn extra pickups.
* All other chest rewards (such as pills, cards, items, etc.) will not cause the chest to spawn additional pickups.
* ⟨24⟩ Does not affect Old Chests.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears have a chance to charm enemies.
items.effects: * Gives a chance to shoot charming tears.
items.notes:
* ⟨28⟩ This item has a 1% chance to spawn when bombing Mom's Dressing Table. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.
* The chance for a tear to be charming depends on the Luck stat. The activation rate is almost equal to 1/(10 - (Luck / 3)). With 0 Luck, the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 26.95 Luck.
** Due to how this formula works, increases in activation rate are only seen with about every 3 points of Luck, as this formula rounds down after dividing Isaac's Luck by 3.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.3 damage. Adds a chance to shoot concussive tears, causing enemies to walk around randomly.
items.effects:
* +0.3 damage.
* Adds a chance to shoot concussive tears, causing enemies to walk around randomly.
items.notes: * Concussive tear effect depends on the luck stat, and goes up to 100% at 27 Luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Enemies that touch Isaac are temporarily petrified and turn to gold. Any enemy killed while in this state will drop Pennies.
items.effects:
* Petrifies and turns enemies into gold upon contact with Isaac.
** Enemies killed while in this state will drop 1-3 Pennies.
** When held by ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, enemies will drop 0-1 pennies instead.
* Enemies that make contact with Isaac take damage equal to the number of coins he has.
** ⟨24⟩ The damage is 3.5+0.2 * the number of Isaac's coins. The damage caps at 23.30 with 99 coins and 203.3 with 999 coins.
** Damage is dealt up to twice per second per enemy.
items.notes:
* With Midas' Touch, some effects that create Poop may instead create Golden Poop (see Synergies for details).
* If an enemy doesn't deal contact damage, Midas' Touch can safely be used on it to create extra Pennies. Flies, Bulb, Mulligan, and Host are the most common enemies this can be applied to.
** If Isaac has 13 coins or more when using Midas' Touch on Mulligans, they will die and release flies, hurting Isaac.
** With ⟦i:9¦Skatole⟧, Hives and Swarmers will constantly spawn black flies, meaning they can create endless amounts of coins.
** ⟨7⟩ As ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧'s foot and ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧'s feet don't deal contact damage, Midas' Touch can be used against them to great effect.
* Spawning Multiplayer Babies while the player has Midas' Touch will give the Midas' Touch effects (freeze on touch + damage) to the baby itself. This can be abused, considering the baby's invincibility frames upon spawning:
** Spawn the baby using the Enter key. It is invincible for a short period.
** During this period, stay in contact with enemies to freeze them and damage them.
* This can be used to gather 99 coins very quickly, and in turn, deal massive damage with Midas' Touch damage component.
* ⟨24⟩ Petrified enemies that are frozen will not drop any coins on death.
* ⟨24⟩ Midas' Touch can be a great item with ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, as you can run into enemies and get even more coins. Just be careful to not kill yourself.
* ⟨24⟩ Both Midas' Touch and ⟦i:236¦E. Coli⟧ affect ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧'s body, causing enemies that touch the body to freeze and turn into poop respectively.
* ⟨16⟩ If a violet champion monster is killed while it is gold-petrified, the trinket it drops is guaranteed to be a golden one. Rainbow champions still drop normal trinkets.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Transforms Bombs, Keys, Pennies, and Red Hearts into their respective Double versions. ⟨24⟩ This will occur 50% of the time.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Transforms all Bombs, Keys, Pennies, and Red Hearts into their respective Double versions.
* ⟨24⟩ All Bombs, Keys, Pennies, and Red Hearts have a 50% chance to be replaced by their respective Double versions.
items.notes:
* Only works specifically on Bombs, Keys, Pennies, and Red Hearts; other variants, like Nickels or Soul Hearts, etc., are not doubled.
* ⟨7⟩ By bombing Donation Machines, Isaac can earn more money than is taken from the machine, giving an endless supply of coins until the machine breaks or he runs out of bombs.
* ⟨7⟩ When used while fighting ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧, Hangers, or ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧s, every coin knocked out of Isaac will be worth two coins, allowing Isaac to net a profit.
* ⟨24⟩ Coins dropped when taking damage from enemies such as ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧, Hangers, or ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧s have a chance to be doubled, allowing Isaac to potentially recover all lost money or even net a profit.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Has a chance to drop a random pickup when Isaac takes damage.
items.effects:
* Grants a 50% chance to drop a random Coin, Bomb, Key, or Heart whenever Isaac takes damage.
** The chances of the drops between each category are roughly equal.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Damages Isaac in exchange for fully recharging Isaac's current activated item.
items.effects:
* Damages Isaac in exchange for fully recharging Isaac's current activated item.
** ⟨7⟩ Sharp Plug costs two hearts of health to use.
*** ⟨24⟩ Sharp Plug's heart cost is one half-heart per charge slot filled. The health cost is not increased in later stages where half-heart damage is upgraded to full heart.
** If the item has no charges, the Sharp Plug will not activate.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ If Isaac has less than two Black or Soul Hearts, it will remove them but will not remove any Red Hearts.
* ⟨24⟩ Sharp Plug attempts to draw from Red Hearts first.
* ⟨24⟩ Sharp Plug cannot deal fatal damage. If used at half a heart, it will not work.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: DMG + tears up. An out-of-body experience!
items.description: Isaac's head becomes an orbital familiar that blocks shots and deals contact damage. Tears are still fired from the rotating head. ⟨7⟩ +1 damage, -1 tear delay. ⟨24⟩ +1 damage, +0.5 fire rate.
items.effects:
* Isaac's head becomes an orbital familiar that blocks shots and deals contact damage. Tears are still fired from the rotating head.
* +1 damage.
* ⟨7⟩
* ⟨24⟩ +0.5 fire rate.
* The head orbital deals 7 damage per tick or 105 damage per second.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ Isaac's body will spew a fountain of blood like a Gusher. This is purely cosmetic.
* While Isaac's actual hitbox (his body) does not change, the position of the head can obscure the body's exact position, making things such as dodging or collecting pickups more difficult.
* Items that apply contact damage and effects (⟦i:13¦The Virus⟧, ⟦i:300¦Aries⟧, etc.) do not apply to the head.
* The head orbital ignores the normal three orbital cap used by items such as ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧ and ⟦i:172¦Sacrificial Dagger⟧.
* The orbital is larger than most other orbitals, making it easier to use both offensively and defensively.
** Despite changing size with Isaac, the orbital's hitbox does not change, which can be deceptive.
* Standing near a wall may cause the head to go inside the wall while rotating, blocking tears.
* ⟨16⟩ Guillotine's quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Creates an orbital familiar. Collecting additional copies gives it the ability to shoot Charm tears, then chase enemies to deal contact damage, then deal even more contact damage.
items.effects:
* Spawns an orbital familiar that deals 105 contact damage per second.
* ⟨1⟩ Unlike the ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧, it does not block enemy shots.
* ⟨30⟩ Ball of Bandages blocks enemy shots.
* Each subsequent Ball of Bandages obtained are combined with the first one (increasing its 'level'), changing its characteristics:
** Level 2: Gives the orbital the ability to shoot Charm tears once every second, with each tear dealing 3.5 damage.
** Level 3: Changes it from an orbital to a Bandage Girl that that chases nearby enemies dealing 52.5 contact damage per second and fires Charm tears in the direction Isaac shoots. The tears it fires are the same as the ones fired by the Level 2 form.
** Level 4: Increases the size of the Bandage Girl and increases its contact damage to 82.5 per second. Enemies killed by a level 4 Bandage Girl's tears have a chance to drop full Red Hearts.
** The fifth Ball of Bandages will create a new Level 1 ball, and start the cycle again.
items.notes:
* Multiple Balls of Bandages can be collected in a single run.
* ⟨24⟩ The orbital orbits Isaac significantly faster, making it more effective at blocking shots but less effective for dealing damage.
* ⟦e:famine¦Famine⟧, ⟦e:pestilence¦Pestilence⟧, ⟦e:war¦War⟧, and ⟦e:death¦Death⟧ will always drop either a Ball of Bandages or ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧. After the first one drops, further Harbingers will only drop that same one and never the other for the duration of the run.
* The ticking rate for Bandage Girls' contact damage causes them to often deal damage twice once they touch an enemy, making their first second of DPS up to 1.5x higher than normal.
* Level 3 and 4 Bandage Girls' tears inherit Isaac's momentum.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +1 damage. Increases the chance of champion enemies appearing by 15%.
items.effects:
* +1 damage.
* Increases the chance for champion enemies to appear by 15%.
** Without any other champion enemy appearance modifiers the chance increases from 5% to 20% (⟨7⟩ 20% to 35% in hard mode).
items.notes:
* While more champions likely mean a tougher run, players will also profit from a higher amount of pickups available to them, thanks to many champions dropping items upon death.
** Champion enemies don't drop consumables while playing Greedier mode, making Champion Belt significantly worse in that mode.
* The belt does not affect the appearance rate of champion bosses.
* This is one of the only raw DMG up's in the shop item pool.
* ⟨28⟩ The chance for champions to appear does not increase in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧. It has a fixed 75% chance.
* ⟨16⟩ Champion Belt's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs now cloud up the screen, briefly damaging and confusing all enemies.
items.effects:
* Gives the player 5 Bombs.
* Bombs now cloud up the screen on detonation, briefly confusing and dealing 10 damage to all enemies in the room.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ This item can be spawned by ⟦e:bumbino¦Bumbino⟧ if he picks up 12 cents.
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:colostomia¦Colostomia⟧.
* ⟨30⟩ Butt Bombs heal ⟦e:turdlings¦Turdlings⟧, ⟦e:dingle¦Dingle⟧, ⟦e:dangle¦Dangle⟧, ⟦e:brownie¦Brownie⟧ and ⟦e:clog¦Clog⟧ by 25% of their maximum HP.
** ⟨28⟩ The Butt Bomb effect on ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧ or ⟦i:168¦Epic Fetus⟧ does not cause healing, but normal bombs still do.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: After standing still and not shooting for a short time, Isaac turns invincible until he moves or shoots.
items.effects:
* After standing still and not pressing the move or attack buttons for one second, Isaac will turn into an invulnerable statue.
** Using bombs and active items will remove the invincibility state.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:great-gideon¦Great Gideon⟧.
* ⟨30⟩ While invulnerable, ⟦e:little-horn¦Little Horn⟧’s pitfall still affects Isaac and will teleport him throughout the room; however, the damage is not dealt.
* With items like ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧, Isaac can easily, but slowly, kill most enemies and bosses without taking any damage.
* Bombs can be placed while stationary and safely be stood on until they blow up if no other inputs are done after placing the bomb, as the invincibility state will be activated before the bomb explodes.
** This cannot be done if Isaac is holding the item ⟦i:137¦Remote Detonator⟧ as the bombs will not explode until Isaac uses his active item, damaging him, unless he has an item that gives him explosion immunity (Ex: ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧)

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns ⟨7⟩ 1-2 / ⟨24⟩ 3-5 Blue Spiders when Isaac takes damage.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Spawns 1-2 friendly Blue Spider(s) upon taking damage.
** This has a 1500 ms cooldown.
* ⟨24⟩ Spawns 2-5 friendly Blue Spiders upon taking damage.
items.notes: * ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:widow¦Widow⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants a permanent 50% chance to respawn with 1/2 of a Red Heart after death.
items.effects:
* Grants a permanent 50% chance to resurrect on death.
** Resurrection leaves Isaac at half of a Red Heart, or half a Soul Heart if he had no Red Heart Containers.
items.notes:
* Resurrection items activate in a set order. Guppy's Collar is 4th in this order after ⟦p:soul-of-lazarus¦Soul of Lazarus⟧, ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧, ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧, ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧' inherent extra life, and ⟦i:688¦Inner Child⟧.
* It is possible to obtain two collars by finding one in a Red Chest, without picking it up, and then finding another collar in a different Red Chest. ⟨7⟩ However, this does not have any additional effects and does not count towards transforming into Guppy.
** ⟨24⟩ Obtaining multiple copies of Guppy's Collar now grants extra lives, depending on how many copies are obtained (obtaining a second collar displays the lives count as '2?', and so on). The chance for Guppy's Collar to activate is defined with separate rolls, but increases the odds for one of the collars to revive Isaac. Additional collars also count towards the Guppy transformation.
* Resurrecting in a Curse Room may trap Isaac if he has no way of recovering health or exiting them without losing health.
* ⟨28⟩ Resurrecting via Guppy's Collar during a Daily Challenge will count as a death, even if the run is eventually completed.
* ⟨24⟩ While escaping ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧, the HUD states the revive chance is 100% (the question mark is removed). However, since all Isaac's items are removed in the area, the revive will not happen.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac's tears can hit and destroy enemy projectiles. -0.15 shot speed.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac's tears a shield surrounding them, allowing the player to block enemy shots.
** Isaac's shots are destroyed upon contact with an enemy's shot.
** ⟨2⟩ Affects familiar's tears.
* -0.15 shot speed.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: After Isaac is damaged, a trail of red creep will be left behind him until he leaves the current room. ⟨7⟩ +5 range. ⟨24⟩ +1.5 range.
items.effects:
* Upon taking damage, Isaac leaves a trail of red creep that damages enemies until he leaves the room.
** The creep deals 2 damage per tick (6 damage per second) to enemies that walk over it.
* +5 range.
items.notes:
* The effects of this item do not stack if multiple copies of the item or its effects are acquired; Isaac only gets the range bonus once.
* ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧, or anyone holding ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, is resurrected with this item upon his first death.
** ⟨28⟩ After is beaten, Lazarus will start with Anemic, and Lazarus Risen will have its increased range and creep trail effect permanently active, regardless of whether he possesses the item.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: A Devil Room / Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.
items.effects: * Sets the Devil Room chance to 100% regardless of all other modifiers, guaranteeing a Devil Room or Angel Room Door will spawn whenever possible and remain open.
items.notes:
* Even if taken after a boss is killed, Goat Head will force a Devil / Angel Room door to spawn on that floor.
* Taking a deal with the Devil will prevent Angel Rooms from appearing, meaning Goat Head must be acquired from another source for an Angel Room to spawn.
* ⟨6⟩ Goat Head will not force a Devil / Angel Room door to open if the boss fight was in a narrow room.
* ⟨30⟩ Goat Head has no effect in Greed mode and is not normally available.
** It can still be a starting item for ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧, a bonus item from ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧, and is obtainable with ⟦i:297¦Pandora's Box⟧ and ⟦i:536¦Sacrificial Altar⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ By touching the white fire in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II and ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II, Isaac will temporarily become ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧. After defeating the boss, Goat Head will always keep the devil deal door open, allowing the Lost to take one Devil Deal item for free.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants 3 Black Hearts and +1 damage.
items.effects:
* Grants 3 Black Hearts.
* +1 damage.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-heretic¦The Heretic⟧.
* When purchased at a Devil Room by ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧ (or another character who has lost all Red Heart containers), this item effectively converts 3 Soul Hearts into 3 Black Hearts, increasing damage at no downside.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to spawn Blue Spiders when firing tears. Restores 1 Red Heart.
items.effects:
* Isaac now spawns friendly Blue Spiders when firing tears.
* Heals Isaac for 1 Red Heart upon pickup.
items.notes:
* ⟨28⟩ This item has a 1% chance to spawn when bombing Mom's Dressing Table. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.
* The blue spider spawning chance depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac{1}{20 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 2 \right \rfloor}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 5%, maxing out at 100% at 9.5 luck.
* The spiders are spawned when Isaac is shooting, and up to 5 spiders can be spawned at the same time. More spiders can be spawned if the previous ones died.
* ⟨7⟩ This item does not work for Lilith since ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ tears do not count as her tears.
* Spiders can still be spawned in rooms without enemies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container, and a chance to regenerate a Half Red Heart of health every minute of gameplay.
items.effects:
* Grants one full Red Heart container when picked up.
* Isaac has a 50% chance to regenerate a Half Red Heart every time the in-game timer hits a new minute (00:01:00, 00:02:00, etc).
* ⟨24⟩ Heals 1 additional Red Heart when picked up.
items.notes:
* This item can rarely drop from destroying polyps (outside of ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧).
* The regeneration can happen multiple times in the same room, so there is no need to move between rooms to continue regeneration.
** ⟨7⟩ However, regeneration does not occur when standing in a Crawl Space.
* Regeneration will only occur when Isaac has Red Heart containers or something equivalent:
** ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧'s and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧'s coin hearts will regenerate, one coin at a time.
** Bone Hearts regenerate like red hearts.
** Consequently, characters with no applicable health -- ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧,⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧, and ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧—do not benefit from the effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants an empty Red Heart container. Adds a chance of dropping a Red Heart after taking damage.
items.effects:
* Grants an empty Red Heart container.
** If the character cannot hold red heart containers they will simply be given a normal HP up.
* Adds a chance of dropping a Red Heart after taking damage.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ The chance for Old Bandage to spawn a Red Heart depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.3 \right \rfloor},50\%)
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 50% at 26.67 luck.
* ⟨24⟩ The chance for Old Bandage to spawn a Red Heart depends on the luck stat and is based on this formula: 20\% + (\mathit{Luck}\ * 1\%)
** This means that the chance starts at 20% at 0 luck, minimizes at 0% at -20 luck, and maximizes at 100% at 80 luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +5 Bombs. Upon exploding, bombs shoot 10 tears around them, affected by tear modifiers.
items.effects:
* Upon exploding, Bombs shoot 10 tears off in every direction, similar to ⟦i:38¦Tammy's Head⟧. The tears deal a flat 25 damage plus Isaac's damage and are affected by any tear modifiers Isaac has on his tears.
* Grants five bombs.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if ⟦e:hornfel¦Hornfel⟧ is killed in his second phase.
* The tears generated by the bombs can push other bombs. Dropping multiple Sad Bombs is not advised since they could be pushed near you.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears bounce off walls, enemies, and environmental objects.
items.effects:
* Makes tears bounce off walls, enemies and environmental objects.
** Tears that bounce off of enemies bounce in random directions, whereas tears that bounce off of walls and other objects bounce directly back.
** When tears bounce from enemies, they become able to hit the same enemy again should they bounce off of another enemy or obstacle.
** ⟨28⟩ Tears bounce off bombs and are unable to push them, making Troll Bombs more difficult to deal with.
items.notes: * Tears will bounce off of walls while fighting ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, despite the lack of visible walls.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears float in position until firing ceases, after which they will fly off in the direction they were shot in. ⟨7⟩ -2 Tear Delay. ⟨24⟩ +1 Fire Rate.
items.effects:
* Holding the fire buttons causes tears to hover in midair. When released, the tears will all shoot in the direction they were originally fired.
** If the fire buttons are not released, the tears will fire on their own after 3 seconds.
* ⟨7⟩
* ⟨24⟩ +1.0 fire rate.
items.notes:
* Gravitational effects, such as ⟦e:mega-fatty¦Mega Fatty⟧'s inhalation or a Gaping Maw will pull floating tears toward them.
* The range attribute only affects the lifespan of the tears after they have been released.
* Hovering tears can damage monsters like Knights or ⟦e:mask-of-infamy¦Mask of Infamy⟧ from the front, even if they don't have the piercing effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +5 bombs. Grants immunity to explosion damage and causes explosions to heal Isaac. ⟨24⟩ Also grants immunity to fire.
items.effects:
* +5 Bombs.
* All explosions heal Isaac instead of damaging him. If Isaac has no Red Heart containers or full health, no damage is taken.
** ⟨7⟩ Explosions heal one full Red Heart.
** ⟨24⟩ Explosions heal one half Red Heart.
* ⟨24⟩ Grants immunity to damage from Fire Places or enemy fires, but does not heal Isaac.
** It does not protect the player from taking damage from fire projectiles or the White Fire Place in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Pyromaniac is a Special Item.
* ⟨7⟩ Makes the player immune to ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧'s, ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧'s, and other enemies' stomp attacks, making those fights substantially less difficult.
** Due to the immunity to Mom's stomping attack, ⟦t:16¦Mom's Toenail⟧ has improved usefulness.
* ⟨7⟩ Makes the player immune to ⟦e:the-cage¦The Cage⟧'s, ⟦e:the-adversary¦The Adversary⟧'s, ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s, and ⟦e:ultra-greedier¦Ultra Greedier⟧'s rock wave attack.
* ⟨7⟩ Makes the player immune to fires left behind by enemies and their hot bombs, as well as projectiles from Red Fire Places and Purple Fire Places, but not the fireplaces themselves.
* The item is unable to produce Soul Hearts, Black Hearts, or Eternal Hearts, making Pyromaniac a little less effective if used with ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧, or ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧. However, these characters still gain immunity to explosions, with ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧ benefiting the most out of all.
* ⟦e:ultra-greedier¦Ultra Greedier⟧ uses explosive attacks almost exclusively. As a result, Pyromaniac makes characters nearly invulnerable against him ⟨24⟩except for his rock waves.
* Makes Isaac immune to the lake of fire in the fight against ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, but not to her fire inhalation attack.
* One of only two items that grant full immunity to explosive damage, the other being ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: When tears hit an object or deplete their range, they spawn 4 smaller tears, whose range and damage scale with Isaac's. ⟨7⟩ Grants -1 tear delay and reduces range. ⟨24⟩ Grants +0.5 fire rate and reduces range.
items.effects:
* When Isaac's normal tears disappear (either from hitting the ground or hitting something else), they spawn 4 smaller tears.
** Each smaller tear deals half of Isaac's normal damage.
** Split tears are scaled down by 0.6x from the main ones, ignoring damage-based size reduction.
* ⟨7⟩ Tear size multiplier: 1.2x.
* ⟨24⟩ +0.1 tear size.
* ⟨7⟩
* ⟨24⟩ +0.5 fire rate.
* ⟨7⟩ -10 range.
* ⟨24⟩ 0.8x range multiplier.
items.notes:
* Split tears will inherit the main tear's status effect, if any.
* If Isaac has less than ⟨7⟩10 range/⟨24⟩10 tear height, the split tears appear but cannot cause damage before hitting the floor.
** ⟨7⟩ ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧, ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧, and ⟦c:samson¦Samson⟧ have lower starting range and are particularly susceptible.
** Tear falling speed ups can't mitigate this downside.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives chance of spawning a Soul Heart when taking damage. Enemies have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart after being killed.
items.effects:
* When Isaac takes damage, there is a chance that a Soul Heart may spawn.
* Monsters have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart after being killed. Chance depends on killed monster's base health.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:sisters-vis¦Sisters Vis⟧.
* ⟨7⟩ The chance for Gimpy to spawn a Soul Heart depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.4 \right \rfloor},50\%)
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 50% at 20 luck.
* ⟨24⟩ The chance for Gimpy to spawn a Soul Heart depends on the luck stat and is based on this formula: 8\% + (2\% * \mathit{Luck})
** This means that the chance starts at 8% at 0 luck, minimizes at 0% at -4 luck, and maximizes at 100% at 46 luck.
* Monsters that have less than 10 HP have a 1% chance to drop a Half Red Heart.
* Monsters that have 10 to 29 HP have a 5% chance to drop a Half Red Heart.
* Monsters that have more than 30 HP have a 10% chance to drop a Half Red Heart.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants one Red Heart Container, one Soul Heart, and one Black Heart.
items.effects:
* Grants a full Red Heart Container, one Soul Heart, and one Black Heart.
* ⟨24⟩ Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives 3 Pennies on pick-up. Every time Isaac is damaged, he will drop one or two additional pennies.
items.effects:
* Adds 3 Pennies on pickup.
* When Isaac takes damage, spawns 1 or 2 Pennies near him.
items.notes:
* The coins that are dropped from Piggy Bank are not subtracted from Isaac's total.
* Other types of coins cannot be spawned by Piggy Bank, only normal Pennies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to shoot fear tears. ⟨7⟩ Decreases tear delay by 1. ⟨24⟩ +0.5 fire rate.
items.effects:
* Adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
* ⟨7⟩
* ⟨24⟩ +0.5 fire rate.
items.notes:
* ⟨28⟩ This item has a 1% chance to spawn when bombing Mom's Dressing Table. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.
* Fear tear effect depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac{15}{100 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 15%, maxing out at 100% at 85 luck.
** ⟦i:259¦Dark Matter⟧ is significantly better at inflicting fear than Mom's Perfume.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Replaces normal tears with a charged shot that fires 14 tears in the same fashion as ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧.
items.effects:
* Grants a charged shot that fires 14 tears in the same fashion as ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧.
** The attack can be released only when fully charged.
** Each tear deals 100% Isaac's damage.
** Each tear has a random size multiplier between 0.9x to 1.33x, but there is no effect on damage.
* Tears down: ⟨7⟩Tear Delay × 4.3 / ⟨24⟩ Fire Rate ÷ 4.3 (roughly 0.23x).
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:monstro-ii¦Monstro II⟧.
* Charge time can be found with the following equation:
: \text{time} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay)}) \approx \frac{1}{\text{Fire Rate
* Each tear has independant chance to have Tear Effects.
* Tear falling speed ups will slightly reduce the effective range of Monstro's Lung.
** ⟨8⟩ Since range ups always add to tear falling speed, every range up reduces effective range.
* ⟨24⟩ Multi-shot effects such as ⟦i:245¦20/20⟧ or ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ adds 2.4 tears to the barrage per tear they normally grant. The resulting amount is rounded, and is capped at 50.
* ⟨24⟩ Reaching above 30 fire rate will release the charge automatically when full. Since this is nearly instant, it results in a constant spray of tears.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ +1.5 damage, +0.2 speed. Removes all Red Heart containers, grants six Black Hearts, and adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
⟨24⟩ +1.5 damage, +0.2 speed. Grants two Black Hearts, converts all Red Heart Containers into Black Hearts, and adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
items.effects:
* +1.5 damage.
* +0.2 speed
** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
* ⟨7⟩ Removes all current Red Heart containers and grants 6 Black Hearts.
* ⟨24⟩ Converts all current Red Heart containers into Black Hearts, and adds 2 additional Black Hearts.
* ⟨28⟩ Empties all Bone Hearts without removing them.
* Adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
items.notes:
* Fear tear effect depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac{15}{100 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}
** At base Luck (0), the chance is 15%, maxing out at 100% at 85 Luck.
** ⟦i:259¦Dark Matter⟧ is significantly better at inflicting fear than Abaddon.
* Does not remove Soul Hearts or Eternal Hearts.
* ⟨7⟩ As it removes all Red Heart Containers, other Deals with the Devil can be taken for "free" as long as Abaddon is taken last while still having at least 1 Container.
* Can always be taken as a deal. Even if Isaac only has one or two Soul Hearts, the Black Hearts will be granted after taking the item.
* ⟨24⟩ Emptied Bone Hearts will not be converted to Black Hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears. Isaac leaves a trail of slowing creep behind as he moves, impeding enemies' speed.
items.effects:
* Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears, reducing the speed of enemy movement and any projectiles they fire.
* Isaac leaves a trail of slowing Black creep.
items.notes:
* The chance to fire slowing tears depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5 \right \rfloor}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: Let's slow this down a bit...
items.description:
⟨1⟩+0.3 speed. Automatically inflicts slow to all enemies in every room.
⟨6⟩+0.3 speed. Upon taking damage, inflicts slow to all enemies for the current room.
⟨24⟩+0.3 speed. Slows all enemies in every room to 80% speed.
items.effects:
* ⟨1⟩ Automatically inflicts slow to all enemies in every room, which slows them down to approximately 51.3% of their original movement and attacking speeds.
* ⟨6⟩ Inflicts slow to all enemies in the current room after the player is hit.
* ⟨24⟩ Slows all enemies to 80% of their original movement speed and attacking speeds. This is separate from the slow status, and fully stacks with it. Isaac's tears and enemy shots are also slowed.
* +0.3 speed.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ The background music is slowed down to 70% of the original speed of the music during the item's effect.
* ⟨24⟩ The background music is slowed down to about 90% of the original speed. The slowdown makes the music approximately 2 semitones lower.
** If acquired through ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧, the starting track will be affected as well.
* ⟨7⟩ Because of the slow effect, champion versions of enemies will be tinted the same color as all other enemies. This makes it much harder to distinguish certain champion types, such as those that explode upon death.
* Pokies, Slides, minecarts and Mega Troll Bombs are not affected and will move in their regular speed.
* ⟨1⟩ Stop Watch is a special item.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Massively increases Range and grants spectral tears. Tears orbit around Isaac at a fixed distance until they hit the ground.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ +7 tear falling speed.
* ⟨24⟩ +6.5 range.
* Grants spectral tears.
* Tears now revolve around Isaac at a fixed distance until they hit the ground.
* ⟨24⟩ The tears orbit close to Isaac, offset slightly in the direction fired. Changing the firing direction will redirect all previously fired tears.
items.notes:
* Tears will not hit directly in front of Isaac; aiming directly away from enemies is often effective.
* ⟨24⟩ It is possible to control the direction of Tiny Planet with the mouse. On Windows, go to C:/Users/[username]/Documents/My Games/The Binding Of Isaac [Rebirth/Afterbirth/Afterbirth+]/ and in the options.ini file, change the line that says MouseControl0 to MouseControl1. Unlike normal controls, the mouse allows diagonal direction.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns allied Blue Spiders from killed enemies.
items.effects:
* Spawns an allied Blue Spider from each enemy that is killed.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* Enemies do not spawn Blue Spiders when killed by anything not controlled by Isaac (environmental hazards, charmed enemies, death upon clearing room, etc).
* Enemies do not spawn Blue Spiders when killed by Blue Spiders.
* Blue Flies can also spawn Blue Spiders.
* Enemies killed by familiars will spawn Blue Spiders.
* ⟨7⟩ Destroyed Shopkeepers will spawn Blue Spiders.
* Destroying normally invulnerable enemies such as Poky will spawn Blue Spiders.
* ⟨7⟩ Killing ⟦e:pin¦Pin⟧ will give one Blue Spider for each of his segments.
* Dark Balls spawned by ⟦e:little-horn¦Little Horn⟧ can also drop Blue Spiders upon death.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Enemies that touch Isaac are transformed into Poop.
items.effects:
* Enemies that touch Isaac are transformed into Poop.
* All brown Poops, including those created by E.Coli, now have a 6.25% chance to drop a heart if it normally wouldn't drop anything.
items.notes:
* Bosses cannot be turned into poop.
* Enemies that are turned into poop do not count towards on kill effects such as health regeneration from ⟦i:62¦Charm of the Vampire⟧ or the damage increase from ⟦i:411¦Lusty Blood⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ This is especially detrimental for ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-magdalene¦Tainted Magdalene⟧ which depend on pickups generated on enemy kills.
* Poops created by this item are not tiles, but entities. As such, they are not grid-aligned, and behave differently:
** The poops vanish if the room is left and then returned to.
** Things that automatically target enemies, such as ⟦i:86¦Monstro's Tooth⟧ and ⟦p:ii-the-high-priestess¦II - The High Priestess⟧, will also target the poops.
** The poops can be slowly moved by pushing them.
** The poops cannot create a bridge if they are bombed near a pit.
** ⟨3⟩ The poops will flash red when hit, similar to damaging monsters.
** ⟨28⟩ The poops will crumble when hit, identically to regular poops.
* Touching the middle section of a Grub with E. Coli will split it and create a second head (rather than destroying the Grub and spawning Maggots).
* ⟨7⟩Mullibooms can be turned into poop without taking damage.
* Turning Champion versions of a monster into poop will forfeit the chance to get the champion's drop.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +1.5 damage, -0.3 tears. Tears are replaced with large piercing scythes.
items.effects:

* -0.3 tears
* Grants piercing tears.

* Tears are replaced by ⟦e:death¦Death⟧'s scythes.

items.description: Combined with ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, unlocks the golden gate in the starting room of ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ and ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ to fight ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧.
items.effects:
* Combined with ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, unlocks the golden gate in the starting room of ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ and ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ to fight ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧.
* Increases the chance of finding an Angel Room.
* Grants a 2.5% chance of converting Red Heart pickups into Eternal Hearts.
** This effect stacks with ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧.
items.notes:

items.quote: Some stats up, some stats down
items.description:
⟨3⟩ Randomly increases and decreases some of Isaac's stats.
⟨28⟩ Increases four random stats and decreases the other two.
items.effects:
* ⟨3⟩ Randomly increases at least 1 and decreases 1-3 of Isaac's stats. The same stats can be increased/decreased multiple times.
* ⟨28⟩ Randomly increases 4 and decreases 2 of Isaac's stats.
* Each increase or decrease for a stat will change it by a fixed value:
** ±1 health.
** ±1 flat damage.
** ⟨7⟩ ±0.5 tears.
** ⟨24⟩ ±0.5 fire rate.
** ⟨7⟩ ±0.5 range.
** ⟨24⟩ ±2.5 range.
** ±0.2 shot speed.
** ±0.2 speed.
*** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
** ±1 luck.

items.notes:
The stat changes are permanent and will not go away if the item is removed.
* ⟨24⟩ This makes the item especially useful for ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧, since he gets to keep the stats while having the option to switch Experimental Treatment for another item and the transformation progress isn't lost in the process.
⟨24⟩ The tears up from this item is allowed to go past the normal tear cap of 5.0. However if it decreases tears, the normal tear cap will also be decreased.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Doubles the number of most room clear awards, but reduces the overall chance of getting one by 1/3.
items.effects: * Spawns N + 1 Room Clear Awards, but has a (0.666N / 2) chance to set the number of spawned pickups to 0, where N is the number of copies of this item held.
items.notes:
* In practice, the effect means the overall number of pickups is increased by 1/3 over the rest of the run, on average.
* Neither effect applies to trinkets.
* Doubled Chests will not necessarily be of the same kind.
* ⟨30⟩ Neither effect applies to Pennies dropped in Greed mode.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a 50% chance to block projectiles coming from any direction.
items.effects:
* Enemy shots that hit Isaac have a 50% chance to be blocked.
** After effectively blocking a projectile, Isaac will briefly flash blue. Isaac in this state can still take damage from another projectile.
** Can block:
*** Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), but their lines of fire harm Isaac.
*** Fire projectiles (e.g. from ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧).
*** Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti.
** Does not block:
*** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle).
*** Lasers or beams.
*** Lines of fire from fireballs.
*** Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:mask-of-infamy¦Mask of Infamy⟧.
* Although the mask is seen only on Isaac's face, projectiles still have a 50% chance to be blocked from any direction.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac gains a shield that protects him from enemy shots. It aims in the direction Isaac fires from.
items.effects:
* Isaac uses a shield to block shots.
* The shield stays in the same direction until Isaac fires in another direction.
items.notes:
* The shield can block diagonally by holding down 2 arrow keys at once.
** Tears will be fired vertically while the shield is at an angle.
* The shield can't block beams or explosions.
* The shield can be held in any direction if you're using a joystick.
* Many items that change the color of Isaac's tears will also change the color of the shield; this effect is purely cosmetic.
* When using Tainted Forgotten, the shield goes on the bone pile and not the soul.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac occasionally fires an unlimited range piercing laser alongside his normal tears. The laser can glitch, mimicking the effects of certain items and trinkets.
items.effects:
* Grants an unlimited range piercing laser with random rate of fire that does not replace tears.
* The laser has a 1/6 chance to fire every ~0.07 seconds (4 frames), firing at an average rate of 2.5 times per second.
* ⟨7⟩ The laser occasionally fires with the effect of the listed items or trinkets, randomly:
** ⟦t:26¦Hook Worm⟧
** ⟦i:3¦Spoon Bender⟧
** ⟦i:233¦Tiny Planet⟧
** ⟨30⟩ ⟦i:317¦Mysterious Liquid⟧
** ⟨30⟩ ⟦i:221¦Rubber Cement⟧
* ⟨16⟩ The laser has a 5% chance of firing with a ⟦i:418¦Fruit Cake⟧ effect.
items.notes:
* The damage of the laser scales directly with Isaac's damage.
* Unlike ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧ or ⟦i:152¦Technology 2⟧, Isaac can still fire tears from both eyes in addition to firing the laser.
* The laser can be fired independently from tears by slightly tilting the right analog stick, just like shooting familiars.
* ⟨24⟩ Unlike ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧, Tech.5 Lasers do not have momentum, and fire exclusively in the cardinal directions unless Isaac has an item like ⟦i:465¦Analog Stick⟧, ⟦i:572¦Eye of the Occult⟧ or ⟦i:394¦Marked⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac fires two tears at once, one from each eye. ⟨24⟩ 0.8× damage multiplier.
items.effects:
* Isaac fires two tears at once, one from each eye.
* ⟨24⟩ 0.8× damage multiplier.
items.notes:
* Unlike other multiple shot items like ⟦i:153¦Mutant Spider⟧ or ⟦i:2¦The Inner Eye⟧, 20/20 does not reduce the rate of fire.
* The maximum amount of tears per volley that can be reached by combining and/or duplicating 20/20, ⟦i:2¦The Inner Eye⟧, ⟦i:153¦Mutant Spider⟧, and ⟦i:358¦The Wiz⟧ is 16.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Reveals the locations of Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms on the map.
items.effects: * Reveals the locations of Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms on the map.
items.notes:
* When combined with ⟦i:21¦The Compass⟧ and ⟦i:54¦Treasure Map⟧, the entire floor is revealed, identical to the effect of ⟦i:333¦The Mind⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ Blue Map does not display Ultra Secret Rooms.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Increases the size and effectiveness of most familiars.
items.effects:
* Visually increases the size of all familiars by 25%, and improves the effectiveness of most of them.
** Doubles the damage of Familiars that deal damage through tears and contact damage.
*** Has no effect on Creep generated by familiars.
** For pickup-generating familiars, increases the frequency that they drop pickups.
*** Familiars that require clearing a certain number of rooms will require one less room.
*** Familiars that have a random chance to drop items have a higher chance.
*** Familiars that pick up consumables require less, except ⟦i:278¦Dark Bum⟧ which is unaffected.
** Some familiars have unique synergies.
items.notes:
* The size change is only cosmetic: familiars' hitbox for blocking damage or attacking is not affected.
* Familiars summoned by a trinket or by ⟦i:123¦Monster Manual⟧ are also affected by BFFS!.
** ⟨24⟩Wisps are also affected by BFFS!.
* Blue Flies and Blue Spiders are not affected, they instead benefit from ⟦i:248¦Hive Mind⟧.
* Does not increase the frequency or effectiveness of status effects applied by familiars.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Increases the size of Blue Spiders and Blue Flies and doubles the amount of damage they deal. ⟨24⟩ Also increases the effectiveness of fly and spider familiars.
items.effects:
* Increases the size and doubles the damage of Blue Spiders, Blue Flies and ⟨28⟩ Locusts.
* ⟨24⟩ Fly and spider familiars become stronger, exactly like ⟦i:247¦BFFS!⟧.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* The size change is only cosmetic, the flies' hitboxes remain the same.
* ⟨7⟩ This item does not affect Fly familiars or orbitals.

** Fire from a Hot Bomb doesn't damage Isaac.
** ⟨7⟩ Bombs deal 1 point of contact damage to enemies.
** ⟨24⟩ Bombs deal 16 contact damage to enemies.
* ⟨24⟩ Isaac can no longer take contact damage from static fires such as Fire Places or enemy fires. Fire projectiles still damage Isaac.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if ⟦e:hornfel¦Hornfel⟧ is killed in his second phase.
** ⟨16⟩ It also has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:hornfel¦Hornfel⟧.
* If a Hopper touches a Hot Bomb, it will become a Flaming Hopper.
* The contact damage does not scale with Isaac's damage and is completely removed if Isaac acquires another bomb item that overrides the flaming bomb graphic such as ⟦i:106¦Mr. Mega⟧ or ⟦i:432¦Glitter Bombs⟧.
* ⟦e:big-horn¦Big Horn⟧ will throw Hot Bombs at Isaac that deal contact damage.
* If eaten by a boss such as ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧, a Hot Bomb will continously deal damage to the boss until it explodes.
* ⟨24⟩ Negates the damage from the floor of lava in ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧'s chamber, but not from its fire inhalation attack.

items.description: Grants flaming tears that deal burning damage over time. Tears have a chance to explode on impact with an enemy, which creates a fire at the location of the explosion.
items.effects:
* Tears inflict burn to enemies.
* Tears have a chance to explode on impact with an enemy, leaving behind a fire.
** Explosions do Isaac's current tear damage, in addition to the tear's hit.
** ⟨7⟩ The fires deal 22 damage per tick.
** ⟨24⟩ Each fire deals up to 4 ticks of damage: 1st tick deals 23 damage, 2nd tick 17.3 damage, and 3rd and 4th tick 11.5 damage.
*** ⟨24⟩ Fires can block projectiles, up to 4 times, each time getting smaller.
**** Isaac cannot take damage from the flame, but can still take damage from the explosion.
* ⟨30⟩ Isaac gives a wide glow lighting up dark areas, such as those under the effects of the or the ⟦e:dark-one¦Dark One⟧'s attacks.
items.notes:
* The explosion effect chance depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.7 \right \rfloor}
** At base Luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 12.86 Luck.
* ⟨7⟩ An exploding tear does not set either the hit enemy or anything in the blast range on fire.
** ⟨24⟩ All enemies hit by the explosion will be set on fire.
* Explosive and burning damage is equal to Isaac's current damage stat.
* The flame will transform certain enemies into their fire-related versions (e. g. Hoppers into Flaming Hoppers).
* Tears can explode upon hitting Bombs of any kind.

items.description: Randomizes all passive items and stats upon pickup and at the start of each succeeding floor.
items.effects:
* Randomizes passive items and attributes on pickup and at the start of every floor.
** Regarding stats, this randomness is not dependent on the run's seed.
** Stats gain a random modifier. These modifiers do not stack between levels and are instead rerolled every time.
*** Speed -0.2, 0 or +0.2.
**** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed, may never exceed 2.0.
*** ⟨7⟩ Range -0.5, 0 or +0.5.
*** ⟨24⟩ Range -2.5, 0 or +2.5.
*** ⟨7⟩ Tears -0.5, 0 or +0.5.
*** ⟨24⟩ Fire rate -0.5, 0 or +0.5.
*** Shot speed -0.2, 0 or +0.2.
*** Damage flat -1, 0 or +1.
*** Luck -1, 0 or +1.
** Does not affect trinkets, cards, pills, Pretty Flies, ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ / ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧, ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ / ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ / ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, or active items.
items.notes:
* See ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ for more details of the rerolling process.
* Due to losing all items every level, it is beneficial to try to gain permanent stat boosts if possible. These include using pills when equipped with ⟦i:75¦PHD⟧ or ⟦i:303¦Virgo⟧, ⟨28⟩ sacrificing health with ⟦i:487¦Potato Peeler⟧ to gain damage or ⟦i:549¦Brittle Bones⟧ to gain tears, or using up ⟦i:311¦Judas' Shadow⟧.
* Like other full-reroll effects, Missing No. has a small chance to not reroll every item.
* Can cause transformations.
* Missing No. cannot be rerolled or removed by most means after being picked up, including:
** Rerolling passive items with ⟦i:284¦D4⟧.
*** A D4-type reroll will cause the stat modifiers from Missing No. to be rerolled.
** ⟨28⟩ Using ⟦i:482¦Clicker⟧ to remove the last item collected.
** ⟨24⟩ Using ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧ to remove the last item collected.
** ⟨24⟩ Taking damage as ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧ to reroll passive items.
* ⟨7⟩ This item can be used to gain more health if desperately needed, as the randomization does often include items that grant you various types of hearts.
* ⟨7⟩ If the player has already obtained a large number of items (such as during a run where they have gained infinite money in greed mode), it is highly recommended to avoid this item, as it will almost always end up rerolling all the items the player has thus far collected into ⟦i:25¦Breakfast⟧.

* If it hits an enemy, it deals 3.5 damage and explodes, further damaging and poisoning monsters.
** ⟨7⟩ The explosion deals 60 damage. The poison deals double Isaac's Damage over time.
** ⟨24⟩ The explosion deals 100 damage. The poison damage is dealt 4 times, inflicting Isaac's Damage per tick.
** ⟨24⟩ The explosion ignores armor.
* The explosion can hurt Isaac, dealing a full heart of damage.
** This can make picking up the item a risky choice, as Bob's Brain will always fire, regardless of whether or not Isaac will be caught in the explosion.
* Once it explodes, it takes a few seconds to re-appear.
items.notes:
* Bob's Brain is affected by most bomb modifiers.
* Bob's Brain only explodes when hitting an enemy, and does not explode upon hitting a fire, poop, or wall. It can destroy poops and fires like normal shots, however.
* Bob's Brain never launches immediately upon entering a room unless a tear-firing key is released and pressed again, or until several seconds have passed.
* If Isaac has multiple copies of Bob's Brain, only one familiar will be active at a given time, with another one firing immediately after the first has exploded or starts to return from a miss.
** ⟨1⟩ Multiple copies of Bob's Brain will float in the same spot in the familiar line.
** ⟨30⟩ Each copy takes up their spot on the familiar line, but only the first one launches out. Respawning brains may end up stacking on top of each other.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Bob's Brain having ⟨15⟩ 5th / ⟨16⟩ 7th priority.

items.effects:
* Upon taking damage, spawns a white attack fly for the duration of the current room. The fly orbits Isaac at medium range, similar to ⟦i:128¦Forever alone⟧, but with much higher speed.
** ⟨7⟩ The fly deals 5 damage per tick (75 contact damage per second).
** ⟨24⟩ The fly deals 10 damage per tick (150 contact damage per second).

items.description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires a thin ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ beam that charges while holding the fire button and shoots when released.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires a thin ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ beam that deals 3.5 damage per tick and can strike an enemy up to 9 times, for a total of 31.5 damage. It needs to be charged up and will only fire when the fire button is released.
** ⟨7⟩ Unlike Brimstone, Lil Brimstone can start charging up a beam while still firing the previous one.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* ⟨1⟩ Lil Brimstone is a Special Item.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Brimstone having 3rd.

items.description: Isaac himself is now immune to all damage, and a heart familiar follows him. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt. ⟨24⟩ The heart charges up as Isaac shoots, firing 8 blood shots, knocking back enemies, and leaving a puddle of creep when released.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Isaac's body becomes immune to all damage.
* ⟨7⟩ Most enemies now target the heart instead of Isaac. Eyes and other similar enemies, however, will still target Isaac.
* ⟨24⟩ Isaac's body becomes immune to all damage from enemies and the environment. This does not include interactable objects such as Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.
* A heart familiar appears and closely follows Isaac. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt.
* ⟨24⟩ The heart tries to position itself in the opposite direction of where Isaac is shooting.
* ⟨24⟩ The heart charges up as Isaac fires. At full charge, upon releasing the fire button, it knocks back nearby enemies and tears, creates a small puddle of red creep on the ground, and releases blood shots in 8 directions that deal 8 damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles by the knockback blast take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Enemies that come in contact with Isaac take 2x Isaac's current damage per tick or 4x Isaac's damage per second.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars can be used for free.
** During , Devil Beggars and Blood Donation Machines deal damage to Isaac.
* Spikes, Curse Room doors and Spiked Chests do no damage. Sacrifice Room spikes still work, though the heart has to go on the spikes instead of Isaac. ⟨24⟩ The door to ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ is not affected.
* Picking up a non-orbital familiar will cause either Isaac's Heart or the other familiar to be layered over the other's sprite. This is due to the heart not taking up the spot that the other familiar follows in.
* Co-op babies gain the immunity effect without spawning additional hearts.
* ⟨1⟩ Enemy Brimstone shots (such as from ⟦e:the-bloat¦The Bloat⟧) will not do any damage to the heart.
** ⟨24⟩ Enemy Brimstone shots will now be blocked by the body. This visually resembles the blocking effect of ⟦i:568¦Divine Intervention⟧.
* The tracking lasers from ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ and light pillars from ⟦e:isaac¦Isaac⟧ do not damage the heart.
* Isaac will turn into ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ form if either he or the heart touches a White Fire Place.

items.description: Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 4 damage per second and inflicting fear.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 2 damage per tick (4 damage per second) and inflicting fear.
* ⟨24⟩ The familiar has an exceptionally higher detection range than most other familiars that chase down enemies.
items.notes: * ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧.

items.quote: He wants to take your life
items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every 1½ Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will give a reward.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every one-and-a-half Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will generate one of the following:
** ⟨7⟩ A single Soul Heart.
** ⟨24⟩ A single Black Heart.
** A hostile Spider.
** A friendly Blue Spider.
** ⟨24⟩ A random pill, card, or rune.
items.notes:
* If Dark Bum enters one of a set of Super Secret Rooms which allow only certain types of hearts to generate in them, he will drop that type of heart instead of what he normally would.
** The one which only allows Red Hearts will cause Dark Bum to consume the Red Hearts on the floor only to generate yet more Red Hearts. Leading Dark Bum around the room to consume the Red Hearts and then leaving the room before he's able to generate anything will avoid this.
* ⟨30⟩ Dark Bum will only pick up regular Red Hearts (Half Red Hearts, Red Hearts, Double Hearts, Scared Hearts).
* ⟨24⟩ Temporary hearts (such as from ⟦c:tainted-magdalene¦Tainted Magdalene⟧, ⟦c:tainted-eve¦Tainted Eve⟧ with ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧, etc.) can be collected by Dark Bum, which situationally may prove useful or dangerous.
* This item is very beneficial for characters that can't have Red Heart containers (⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧) since they have no use for Red Hearts.
** Alternatively, characters that can't obtain Soul Hearts or Black Hearts for health may gain very little to no advantage from Dark Bum or may even be harmed if they're unable to pick up the Red Hearts before the Bum consumes them.
* ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ generally have no use for the Dark Bum since all hearts are converted to Blue Flies.
** This is averted if Keeper is in a co-op party with other characters that can utilize hearts.
** Dark Bum may also be picked up by Keeper for the potential transformation.
* ⟨28⟩ Scared Hearts will run away from Dark Bum. Pinching them between Dark Bum and Isaac or walls/corners will make them easier for the Bum to collect.
* ⟨6⟩ From a scoring perspective, hearts that Dark Bum picks up count towards your Schwag bonus on daily runs.
* Dark Bum does not join the line of familiars that follow behind Isaac.

items.notes:

* ⟨24⟩ Pretty Fly Horse Pills spawn a Big Fan without granting it as an item. These Big Fans spin at normal pace and don't affect rotation speed of other orbitals.
** Unlike regular Pretty Fly, there is no limit to how many familiars can be spawned this way.

* ⟨24⟩

items.description: Spawns a Mulligan familiar that wanders randomly. Enemies will attack the Mulligan if it's closer.
items.effects:
* Spawns a Mulligan familiar that walks around the room and acts as a decoy for monsters.
* If the monsters are closer to the decoy than Isaac, they will attack the decoy.
* ⟨24⟩ Homing shots from enemies will always be attracted to the decoy if they are closer to it than Isaac.
* ⟨17⟩ Punching Bag will also block enemy shots.
* ⟨2⟩ Punching Bag will die after taking too much damage and eventually respawn after a long time. Exiting and continuing the run will cause it to reappear right away.
** ⟨2⟩ Punching Bag will reappear instantly each time a familiar or orbital item is picked up.
items.notes:
* The Punching Bag will be targeted by enemies if it is closer to them than Isaac, for up to 6 seconds. Then they will target Isaac for 6 seconds regardless of distance, before acknowledging the Punching Bag again.
* ⟨2⟩ The Punching Bag will die instantly by enemies' beam-type attacks, such as ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ or by ⟦e:uriel¦Uriel⟧'s and ⟦e:gabriel¦Gabriel⟧'s beam. This also includes enemies' ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧ lasers such as Eye and Camillo Jr.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving, allowing travel over obstacles and enemies.
items.effects:
* Upon use, Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving. The distance of the jump depends on how fast Isaac was moving and for how long he was holding the button when the item was activated. Jumping allows Isaac to travel over obstacles such as rocks and pits.
* While mid-jump, enemies, projectiles, Bombs, and spikes cannot damage Isaac. Isaac cannot interact with pickups or Chest mid-jump.
items.notes:
* Standing still while jumping only grants invincibility for the first jump. Isaac has to move to regain invincibility while jumping.
* If Isaac has flight, Isaac dashes instead of jumping. This is functionally the same as jumping, but without the animation playing. Isaac will have invincibility during the dash, and the dash will only stop on terrain that can be walked on.
** While flying above a pit, the dash distance will be very short.
* This item can also be used to pass through otherwise impassible Crawl Space walls.
* Isaac can't jump through doors, which means damage from Curse Room doors cannot be avoided.
* If Isaac has a Stompy trait (from items such as ⟦i:302¦Leo⟧ and ⟦i:314¦Thunder Thighs⟧), rocks won't be destroyed mid-jump.
* When jumping in an uncleared room, it is easy to land on top of an enemy, especially one that follows Isaac's position when attacking. The damage can be avoided by immediately triggering another jump, however.
** This can be repeated indefinitely, and it may be a good idea to keep jumping until you find a safe spot to land.
* ⟨24⟩ How to Jump can be used to jump over pillars and spiked rocks safely.
* Isaac can jump over key blocks. However, if he has a key, it will be spent to open the key block.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Activates the combined effects of ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧, and ⟦i:166¦D20⟧.
⟨24⟩ Activates the combined effects of ⟦i:476¦D1⟧, ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧, ⟦i:437¦D7⟧, ⟦i:406¦D8⟧, ⟦i:285¦D10⟧, ⟦i:386¦D12⟧, and ⟦i:166¦D20⟧.
items.effects:
Upon use, it:
* Rerolls all passive items on Isaac (like the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧).
* Rerolls all pedestal items in the room (like ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧).
* Rerolls all pickups in the room (like the ⟦i:166¦D20⟧).
* ⟨24⟩ Restarts the room and respawns all enemies (like the ⟦i:437¦D7⟧).
* ⟨24⟩ Rerolls Isaac's damage, tears, range and speed (like the ⟦i:406¦D8⟧).
* ⟨24⟩ Rerolls all enemies in the room into weaker ones (like the ⟦i:285¦D10⟧).
** Doesn't go into effect in rooms the ⟦i:437¦D7⟧ works in.
* ⟨24⟩ Rerolls all rocks in the room (like the ⟦i:386¦D12⟧).
* ⟨24⟩ Duplicates 1 random pickup in the current room (like the ⟦i:476¦D1⟧).
** The pickup is rerolled by the ⟦i:166¦D20⟧ before being duplicated, essentially just granting a random extra pickup.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ D100 is a special item.
* ⟨7⟩ See the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧, and the ⟦i:166¦D20⟧ to learn more about the respective individual effects.
* ⟨24⟩ See the ⟦i:476¦D1⟧, ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧, ⟦i:437¦D7⟧, ⟦i:406¦D8⟧, ⟦i:285¦D10⟧, ⟦i:386¦D12⟧, and the ⟦i:166¦D20⟧ to learn more about the respective individual effects.
* If Missing No. is given to the player, it will activate and remove the D100, preventing further rerolls.
** Note that ⟦i:258¦Missing No.⟧ can be rerolled into, but can't be rerolled out of.
* ⟨16⟩ D100's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Rerolls all of Isaac's passive items.
items.effects:
* Upon use, rerolls each of Isaac's passive items into new ones.
** ⟨3⟩ The new items will be drawn from the Treasure Room item pool.
** ⟨28⟩ The new items will be drawn from the item pool where the original item was acquired.
** ⟨24⟩ If health upgrade items are removed by a reroll, the health they granted is subtracted.
items.notes:
* The D4 does not reroll ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧, ⟦i:10¦Halo of Flies⟧, ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:258¦Missing No.⟧, ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧, ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧, or ⟦t:97¦Tonsil⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ The D4 can reroll Dead Cat and Halo of Flies, but will not reroll ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧, ⟦i:577¦Damocles⟧, ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, and glitched items, in addition to the above.
** Note that ⟦i:258¦Missing No.⟧ can be rerolled into, but not rerolled out of.
* The D4 does not remove traits or abilities inherent to a character, such as ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧'s Brimstone-like attack, ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧'s Incubus, or ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s bone attack.
** Starting items from Challenges will also not be rerolled.
** ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧'s ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ is included.
** ⟨16⟩ Characters' starting passive items (except ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧'s and ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧'s) are now inherent to them and will also not be rerolled.
* Items that grant pickups (like ⟦i:190¦Pyro⟧ or ⟦i:18¦A Dollar⟧) do not remove their bonuses when rerolled.
** These same items also do not grant pickups when another item is rerolled into them.
* The D4 can grant items that have not yet been unlocked.
* The items gained by the D4 count towards the collection page.
* Multiple copies of the same item (as generated by ⟦i:347¦Diplopia⟧, the Debug Console, or gathering them from multiple item pools (e.g. ⟦i:64¦Steam Sale⟧ from both the Shop and ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧) will each be rerolled into a different item, ⟨7⟩ even though the duplicates are not present on the pause screen.
* There is a small chance that D4 will not reroll every item: the game makes a number of attempts to reroll each item, but if they all fail to produce a new item that is available and applicable, the original remains unchanged.
* Smelted/Swallowed trinkets (via ⟦i:538¦Marbles⟧, ⟦i:479¦Smelter⟧ or Gulp!) will not be rerolled.
* Will reroll ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧'s starting item(s).
* ⟨7⟩ Items rerolled away don't return to circulation and can't be encountered again.
** ⟨24⟩ Items rerolled away return to circulation and can be encountered again.
* ⟨7⟩ D4 doesn't remove transformation progress, meaning that he will keep a transformation or gain one if he gets a transformation item while having two points of this transformation before rerolling.
* ⟨24⟩ D4 removes transformation progress.
* ⟨7⟩ If it is unlocked, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ starts with this item along with spectral tears and flight. Using it will reroll ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ The D4 does not give hearts that would be otherwise gained from item pickups, but will remove previously collected health upgrade items.
* ⟨24⟩ If used while playing as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, it will only reroll the items on the character that used it.
* ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ can avoid having their health subtracted form rerolling health up items by dropping health items for full inventory before rerolling.
* ⟨16⟩ D4's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Rerolls all monsters in the room.
⟨24⟩ Replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Upon use, rerolls all monsters in the room.
* ⟨24⟩ Upon use, replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters. Each monster type has a specific weaker monster it will transform into. If the monster is already at its weakest level, it usually transforms it into a background critter or kills it outright.
** Some enemies can be transformed into obstacles or pickups instead.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Rerolling a monster will replace it with an entirely new one from any floor, making it dangerous to use early on in the game (as Isaac could get monsters from ⟦s:depths¦Depths⟧ or later).
* ⟨7⟩ The D10 will not reroll Bosses but can reroll monsters spawned by bosses.
* ⟨24⟩ Transforming an enemy with the D10 does not always make it objectively easier to kill, as enemies can become capable of ranged attacks when they previously weren't (e.g. Globins turning into Clotties, or Evis turning into Double Vis).
* ⟨24⟩ The D10 will not reroll friendly enemies.
* Using this item can cause some rooms to become impossible to clear. Jumping or flying monsters may become trapped behind rocks after being rerolled, and therefore become unbeatable.
** Sealed doors open after 2 minutes, though there are situations that can prevent this failsafe from triggering.
* ⟨6⟩ Flying monsters will only be rerolled into other flying monsters, and ground monsters can only be rerolled into ground monsters. (Horfs are classified as ground monsters by the D10).
* ⟨24⟩ Some invincible enemies will be rerolled, while others (including most Grimace variants) are completely unaffected.
* Using this item in a room with Mom's Hand can be very dangerous, as unless they have already landed, they will be directly on top of Isaac, resulting in the new monsters spawning directly on top of Isaac, instantly dealing contact damage.
* Using this item, then exiting the room, such as by teleporting or a bombed door, will cause the enemies to be in their original forms upon Isaac's return.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Copies the effect of the card or rune currently held by Isaac.
⟨24⟩ Copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the card.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Upon use, copies the effect of the card or rune currently held by Isaac.
* ⟨24⟩ Upon use, copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. Blank Card's recharge time changes upon use, depending on the card Isaac was holding when he used it.
items.notes:
* ⟨6⟩ Blank card also mimics ⟦p:dice-shard¦Dice Shard⟧ and ⟦p:emergency-contact¦Emergency Contact⟧.
* Using Blank Card does not expend the consumable.
* Using the Blank Card with a consumable that isn't compatible, or no consumable at all, spends the charge with no effect.
* If holding more than one consumable (e.g. ⟦i:251¦Starter Deck⟧, Tainted Characters...), only the consumable that is selected will be used. If one of them isn't a card, they must ensure the card is the one selected when activating Blank Card, otherwise the effect won't be triggered.
Blank Card's recharge time changes upon use, depending on the card Isaac was holding when he used it (except in the case of using the item with no held card). This is a list of the following recharge times the card can have:
1 room
2 rooms
3 rooms
4 rooms
6 rooms
12 rooms
Single use
* ⟦p:card¦? Card⟧
** ? Card has a unique interaction with Blank Card, noted in the synergies section.

items.description: Gives the effect of ⟦i:54¦Treasure Map⟧, ⟦i:21¦The Compass⟧, or ⟦i:246¦Blue Map⟧ for the duration of the current floor. ⟨24⟩ If all effects are active, ⟦i:76¦X-Ray Vision⟧ is provided for the floor instead. Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.
items.effects:
* Randomly grants the effect of ⟦i:54¦Treasure Map⟧, ⟦i:21¦The Compass⟧, or ⟦i:246¦Blue Map⟧ for the duration of the current floor.
** ⟨24⟩ If all effects are active, ⟦i:76¦X-Ray Vision⟧ is provided for the floor instead.
* Repeated activations will continue to add the other items' effects.
** ⟨7⟩ The chosen effect on activation may be one that Isaac already has—effectively doing nothing.
** ⟨24⟩ Book of Secrets cannot give mapping effects that Isaac already has (whether from a previous activation or through possessing the equivalent item). After all effects have been given, further activations do nothing.
* ⟨24⟩ Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Book of Secrets has no effect on floors affected by or an Amnesia pill.

items.description: Spawns ⟨7⟩1-4 / ⟨24⟩ 4-8 Blue Spiders where Isaac is standing.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Spawns 1-4 Blue Spiders.
* ⟨24⟩ Spawns 4-8 Blue Spiders.
items.notes: * ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:rag-man¦Rag Man⟧.

items.description: Throws out a flame that damages everything in its path, diminishing in size as it hits enemies or blocks shots.
items.effects:
* On use, Isaac raises the candle above his head. On pressing a fire button, a red flame, similar to a Red Fire Place, will fire in the chosen direction. It can pass over pits, but can not travel through obstacles.
** ⟨7⟩ The flame deals 23 damage per tick, and can hit up to 5 times for a maximum of 115 damage per flame.
** ⟨24⟩ The flame can hit up to 4 times, and the damage decreases as the flame shrinks. The first hit deals 23 damage, the second hit deals 17.5 damage, and the last two ticks deal 11.5 damage, for a maximum of 63.25 damage per flame.
** The flame also destroys enemy shots it comes into contact with, which decreases its size each time being hit until the flame is entirely extinguished by this process.
** ⟨7⟩ The flame projectile is persistent and will remain active in the room until it deals a set amount of damage.
** ⟨24⟩ Flames will disappear automatically after 10 seconds.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ While Isaac holds the candle above his head, his movement speed is reduced.
* ⟨7⟩ There is no limit to the number of fires that can be active. This is useful in situations where mob spawning can be controlled: for example, beating Boss Rush or ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ as ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧. This is time-consuming but can be viable if other sources of damage are weak or unreliable.
* ⟨7⟩ It will block Isaac's tears but won't burn him. Isaac's tears can also shrink the size of the flame.
* ⟨24⟩ Flames do not block Isaac's shots, nor are they put out by them.
* Flames will destroy Shopkeepers.
* ⟨24⟩ Flames will turn certain enemies (such as Hoppers and Clotties) into their flaming variants, making them stronger. The flame is unable to damage these monsters.

items.description: When at full health, up to 4 extra Red Hearts can be stored in The Jar. Activating drops the stored hearts on the ground.

Despite the jar indicating that it picked up a whole red heart in this fashion, it will only drop half a red heart on use. When picking up a double red heart, the jar will also store the remainder not healed in the same way.

items.description: Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop. ⟨30⟩ Instantly kills poop-themed bosses. Floods the current room.
items.effects:
* Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop.

* ⟨30⟩ Instantly kills most poop-themed bosses (⟦e:dingle¦Dingle⟧, ⟦e:dangle¦Dangle⟧, ⟦e:brownie¦Brownie⟧, ⟦e:clog¦Clog⟧, and ⟦e:turdlings¦Turdlings⟧).

* Poops created by this item are not tiles, but entities. As such, they are not grid-aligned, and behave differently:
** The poops vanish if the room is left and then returned to.

*** ⟨1⟩ The first Lil' Haunt can be flushed, but this softlocks the game.
** Mom's Hand.
** Enemies in an intangible state, such as invisible Wizoobs.
** ⟨14⟩⟦e:turdlings¦Turdlings⟧, ⟦e:colostomia¦Colostomia⟧, and ⟦e:turdlet¦Turdlet⟧, despite them being poop-themed.

items.notes:
* If taking a Deal leaves Isaac with no health remaining, he can still survive by taking the Deal and then activating Satanic Bible, which will leave him at 1 black heart. This will only work if the Deal is a passive item, as trading Satanic Bible with an active item will make you unable to use it. This does not work while picking up Satanic Bible as the devil deal.
* ⟨24⟩ Bosses with set drops aside from ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ will still drop their normal item, but at the cost of one Heart Container.
* ⟨24⟩ On XL floors, both items will become Devil Deals, even if Satanic Bible was only used once.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, and ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧ in his ghost form can safely take any Boss Room item pedestals and it has no effect on subsequent devil deals.
** This also applies to the Lost form granted by the white fire on ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II. Taking a deal in this form will not remove hearts, making the player able to get at least 2 Devil Room items for free on that floor.
** This does not affect the items dropped on ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ Using the Satanic Bible changes the Boss Room's item pool to the ⟦pool:Devil Room¦Devil Room item pool⟧ for purposes other than direct boss rewards as well. This works even if the boss does not normally drop items, such as ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧, or ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧.
** Rerolls such as ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧, ⟦p:perthro¦Perthro⟧, or ⟦p:soul-of-isaac¦Soul of Isaac⟧ will generate Devil Room items.
** Using Satanic Bible after the Boss Room item has spawned, followed by any reroll, causes the new item to be drawn from the Devil Room item pool, but it will have no heart cost. Taking this item will not prevent Angel Rooms from spawning.
** In the ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, the initial item spawn from a non-⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ boss room will be from a random pool as expected, but rerolls will be drawn from the ⟦pool:Devil Room¦Devil Room pool⟧ without any heart cost.
* ⟨24⟩ In True Co-op, the pedestal's additional items will also be Devil deals, but be drawn from the Boss item pool. If the Devil Deal is an active item, there will be no additional items.
** ⟨16⟩ If the Devil Deal is an active item, the next item will spawn on a pedestal instead of being a Devil Deal.
* ⟨24⟩ Using Satanic Bible on ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II will affect the Mirrored World Boss drop.

items.description: -0.3 Speed. Isaac builds speed while in a room with enemies. At max speed, he gains the ⟦i:77¦My Little Unicorn⟧ effect for 5 seconds.
items.effects:
* -0.3 speed.
