* When in a room with enemies, Isaac gradually gains speed at a rate of +0.065 per tick.

items.notes:
* Isaac slowly gains a red tint that becomes more intense as he gains speed.
* The speed boost and invulnerability effect activate only once per room.
* The higher Isaac's base speed, the quicker the effect activates. It can activate immediately upon entering a room if his base speed is already 2.0.
** If Isaac's base speed is 2.0, the effect will activate upon entering any room (including rooms with no enemies such as Sacrifice Rooms) for the first time.
* If Isaac's speed is decreased during the ⟦i:77¦My Little Unicorn⟧ effect (e. g. by using a Speed Down pill), Isaac will continue to gain speed while the effect is active.
* The item doesn't trigger when enemies are spawned, even if the room did not have enemies when first entered. This includes Challenge Rooms, Sacrifice Rooms when spawning ⟦e:uriel¦Uriel⟧ or ⟦e:gabriel¦Gabriel⟧, and the Boss Rush room.
** ⟨24⟩ Taurus will trigger each time the button is pressed to start a new Greed or Greedier wave. Since the invincibility allows pressing the button to stop waves for free, it can be used repeatedly without leaving the arena.
* The item doesn't trigger in trap rooms which only contain Poky enemies.
* If Isaac gets teleported out of the room by any source, the ⟦i:77¦My Little Unicorn⟧ effect won't trigger if the room is re-entered.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives 6 Coins, 6 Bombs, and 6 Keys and balances out all attributes.
items.effects:
* Continually balances Isaac's primary attributes - damage, range, tears, and speed (has no effect on luck, shot speed, ⟨7⟩ or tear falling speed).
** This effect is NOT one time only - Libra will rebalance Isaac's attributes whenever they are changed by an item, effect, etc. including temporary effects such as the ⟦i:34¦The Book of Belial⟧.
* Grants 6 Coins, 6 Bombs, and 6 Keys.
items.notes:
* The balancing is based on ⟦c:isaac¦Isaac⟧ as the character himself; he gains no bonuses or penalties to any stats from simply having Libra on its own.
* The game calculates Isaac's speed, range, tear delay, and damage before using them in Libra's balancing formula. This has the following notable effects:
** ⟨7⟩ If Isaac's Speed or Tear delay are already at their internal soft caps (2.00 and 5 respectively), items that increase them specifically will give no stats.
*** The only exception would be items that decrease tear delay, and then only if Isaac's tear delay isn't at the hard cap of 1.
** ⟨24⟩ If Isaac's tears stat has reached the soft cap corresponding to 5 fire rate, basic tears ups no longer add bonuses, only direct tear delay upgrades will. Likewise, direct fire rate increases have no effect if the absolute maximum of 120 has been reached.
*** Speed adjustments, despite the stat being bounded between 0.1 and 2.0, always have an effect.
** ⟨24⟩ Speed and range will positively scale as they increase; the higher these stats already are upon receiving a boost to either one, the bigger the boost to the rest of Isaac's stats. Range scales especially quickly, making large range upgrades like ⟦i:5¦My Reflection⟧ and ⟦i:233¦Tiny Planet⟧ very powerful with Libra.
** Items that apply multipliers to Isaac's tear delay (⟦i:153¦Mutant Spider⟧, ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧, ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧, etc.) can be fired more rapidly with less damage.
** Damage upgrades become less effective. In return, speed and range upgrades now increase damage and tears.
** Items that affect the stats of Isaac's tears after they're fired (⟦i:132¦A Lump of Coal⟧, ⟦i:254¦Blood Clot⟧, ⟦i:261¦Proptosis⟧, etc.) do not go through the balancing formula and work as normal.
* ⟨7⟩ Libra's balancing formula values tear delay higher than the other stats and damage less than the other stats. This makes standard tears ups give more stats than a standard range or speed up, and standard damage ups give less stats than a standard range or speed up.
* ⟨24⟩ Generally speaking, if an item increases Isaac's damage per second, Isaac will receive a stat bonus. If the item lowers fire rate and increases damage, or vice versa, in a way that results in loss of DPS, Isaac's stats will go down.
* ⟨7⟩ Since tear falling speed is not involved in the calculations, items such as ⟦i:71¦Mini Mush⟧ or ⟦i:440¦Kidney Stone⟧ that increase tear falling speed but lower range are mostly detrimental.
* Stat upgrade pills have more utility, providing bonuses long after their stat could be usefully increased.
** In order of effectiveness, the pills are: Range, Tears, then Speed Up.
** ⟦i:348¦Placebo⟧ with stat upgrade pills provides a constant source of stat increases.
* Damage from poison and burning status effects is based on Isaac's damage before the balancing. The same is true for temporary familiars (such as blue flies.)

** ⟨24⟩ Judas' Shadow is 10th in this order after ⟦p:soul-of-lazarus¦Soul of Lazarus⟧, ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧, ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧' inherent extra life, ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧, ⟦i:688¦Inner Child⟧, ⟦i:212¦Guppy's Collar⟧, ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧, and ⟦t:28¦Broken Ankh⟧.
* Beating bosses as ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧ will give Completion Marks for ⟦c:judas¦Judas⟧ and will unlock the associated items and achievements.

items.description: Gives one Red Heart Container and doubles the healing provided by Red Hearts. ⟨24⟩ Also heals 1 Red Heart when obtained.
items.effects:
* Adds one Red Heart Container.
* ⟨24⟩ Heals 1 additional Red Heart
* Red Hearts heal double their value. A Half Red Heart replenishes one Red Heart, a Red Heart or Scared Heart replenishes two Red Hearts, and a Double Heart replenishes four Red Hearts. Blended Hearts either replenish two Red Hearts or replenish one Red Heart and add one Soul Heart, depending on how many empty Red Heart Containers Isaac has.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ Has no effect on Rotten Hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants a shield that negates the first instance of damage taken from a hostile source once per room.
items.effects: * Grants a shield that negates the first instance of damage taken from a hostile source in each room.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ When the shield is broken, Isaac gets invincibility frames like he does when he would normally take damage, based on the damage it negated; 1 second for half a heart of damage, 2 seconds for a full heart, and 4 seconds for 2 full hearts.
** ⟨24⟩ Holy Mantle breaking grants one second of invincibility frames, regardless of the damage source.
* ⟨7⟩ Holy Mantle won't be active when initially appearing in the starting room of a floor if it was lost in the room where Isaac left the previous floor.
** ⟨24⟩ If Holy Mantle's shield is broken prior to using ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧, the shield won't be active in the new starting room initially.
* As the shield gets restored whenever another room is entered, Holy Mantle allows Curse Rooms to be entered and exited without taking damage.
* Holy Mantle does not prevent damage from Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, and ⟦i:186¦Blood Rights⟧.
** ⟨7⟩ However, Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars can be played practically for free during the invincibility frames granted when losing the shield, by taking damage from touching a Fire Place, etc.
* Damage from Sacrifice Room spikes can be blocked by Holy Mantle, but no payout is rewarded.
* The blocked hit does not count as damage taken for related achievements and will not trigger items that activate upon taking damage, like ⟦i:117¦Dead Bird⟧.
* ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ starts with this item after donating 879 coins to the Greed Donation Machine.
* ⟨24⟩ When Holy Mantle's shield is broken, a white cross symbol will briefly appear overlaid on top of Isaac and a smashing sound will play.
* ⟨24⟩ While Holy Mantle is in effect, a blue cross icon appears in the HUD next to Isaac's health.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: HP up + speed down + you feel stompy
items.description: Destroys rocks upon contact with Isaac. Adds one Red Heart container and lowers Speed.
items.effects:
* +1 Red Heart container.
* ⟨24⟩ Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
* -0.4 speed down.
** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed.
* Isaac gains the ability to destroy obstacles by walking into them.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:mega-fatty¦Mega Fatty⟧.
* Holes in the ground can be filled if Isaac walks into adjacent rocks from the right direction, similar to bombs.
* Avoid walking over Mushrooms and Bomb Rocks, as they can damage Isaac upon destruction.
* With this item, Isaac can walk over and destroy Red Poop and Spiked Rocks without taking damage. He will still be damaged if he's above the destroyed Red Poop when it reforms.
* Walking over an ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧ Statue in the Angel Room will trigger the boss fight, and the Angel will spawn on top of Isaac. It is possible to avoid taking contact damage by walking away from the statue immediately after touching it.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Pickups, trinkets, and monsters are magnetically attracted to Isaac's tears.
items.effects:
* Monsters, pickups, and trinkets are magnetically attracted to the player character's tears.
** ⟨30⟩ This also applies to Isaac's bombs.
** ⟨24⟩ Tears increase in magnetization as they travel, pulling enemies and items with less force at first but becoming stronger when they land.
** The effect may not affect certain immobile enemies; Round Worms will start to vibrate in the presence of multiple magnetic tears, but will not change their position, Hosts will only be attracted when readying to launch an attack.
items.notes: * Extra caution must be taken when using this item, as the attraction effect will pull small, lightweight monsters like Boom Flies towards the character very fast and in an unpredictable manner, with the consequent risk of taking damage.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants charged tears that can be fired in a tight burst. Getting hit while charging will teleport Isaac to another room.
items.effects:
* Grants charged tears which fires a tight burst of tears. Firing mid-charge will shoot fewer tears depending on the charge time.
** ⟨7⟩ The full burst size is four tears.
** ⟨24⟩ The full burst size is five tears.
** ⟨7⟩ Quickly tapping the fire key will result in no tears being fired.
** Charging while a burst is currently firing will prevent the rest of the shots from being fired.
* Taking damage while mid-charge (holding fire, but not fully charged) will teleport Isaac into another room.
items.notes:
*In most cases effects that override cursed eye will remove the teleporting effect.
**⟦c:tainted-samson¦Tainted Samson⟧/⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧/⟦i:704¦Berserk!⟧: While in their melee form, getting hit while charging a shot will cause the teleport effect regardless of items that normally override the effect.
*The damage per second increase is dependent on Isaac's current tears stat, with lower tears showing a larger increase. Ranging from a ~90% increase at a tear stat of 0.96 to becoming a damage loss at tear stat of ~23 or above.
*Having a high Tears stat around 10 or above without forms of auto firing such as ⟦i:330¦Soy Milk⟧ or ⟦i:394¦Marked⟧ can make it difficult to properly time charge shots, potentially leading to a damage loss.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears leave a small, short lasting pool of creep on impact or when their range is depleted.
items.effects:
* Tears leave a small, short-lasting pool of creep upon hitting an enemy or when their range is depleted.
** The creep deals 1 damage per tick or 30 damage per second.
** ⟨24⟩ The creep can deal up to 25 damage.
** Multiple creep pools can inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a conjoined familiar which chases enemies close to Isaac, dealing ~6.43 damage per second.
items.effects: * Spawns a conjoined familiar, much like ⟦e:gemini¦Gemini⟧'s small twin, Suture. It chases enemies close to Isaac, dealing 3 damage per tick (~6.43 damage per second).
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:gemini¦Gemini⟧.
* Despite its appearance and description, Gemini does not count towards the transformation.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Spawns a familiar that slowly floats around the room on a zig-zag pattern and shoots normal tears in the same direction as Isaac.
⟨24⟩ Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and fires tears in random cardinal directions that copy Isaac's tears and tear effects and scale with damage.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Spawns a familiar that floats slowly around the room in a zig-zag pattern similar to ⟦i:155¦The Peeper⟧ and shoots normal tears in the same direction as Isaac.
** ⟨1⟩ Each tear deals 3.5 damage.
** ⟨6⟩ Each tear deals Isaac's damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and copies all of his tear modifiers/stats (like ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧), with a 25% damage reduction. It fires randomly in the cardinal directions.
items.notes:
* Unlike ⟦i:155¦The Peeper⟧, Cain's Other Eye does no contact damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Cain's Other Eye having ⟨15⟩ 5th / ⟨16⟩ 7th priority.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a controllable familiar that deals ⟨7⟩ 37.5 / ⟨24⟩ 15 damage per second on touch. It can be moved using the shooting directional keys
items.effects:
* Spawns a controllable familiar that damages enemies on touch. It can be moved using the shooting directional keys, similarly to ⟦i:329¦The Ludovico Technique⟧ and ⟦i:267¦Robo-Baby 2.0⟧.
** ???'s Only Friend deals 2.5 damage per tick, and ticks 15 times a second, dealing a total of 37.5 damage per second.
items.notes:
* Unlike The Ludovico Technique, it cannot be controlled with the mouse, even with mouse control enabled.
* Holding two opposite fire keys (both left and right or both up and down) at the same time will keep the familiar in place, while making Isaac fire in the direction of whichever fire key was pressed second.
** This can help during combats with bosses who do not move a lot, as the familiar can continuously damage the boss when kept stationary.
** On some keyboards, holding opposite fire keys may cause other keys to become unresponsive.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Attaches a ball and chain to Isaac that pulls behind him that damages enemies, blocks shots, and destroys most Obstacles.
items.effects:
* Attaches a ball and chain to Isaac's ankle that blocks projectiles and deals 5 damage per tick (~10.7 damage per second).
* If the ball is moving fast enough, it will destroy any destructible Obstacles it comes into contact with.
items.notes:
* Despite its appearance, the item does not slow Isaac's movement.
* Can be charmed by ⟦e:the-siren¦The Siren⟧, chaining itself to her until damaged enough to return to Isaac.
* Is ignored by ⟦i:536¦Sacrificial Altar⟧.
* Cannot be used to open Secret Rooms or Super Secret Rooms.
* Can be used to initiate the Uriel/Gabriel fight inside Angel Rooms.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and cycles between the tears of Isaac's other familiars.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and cycles between the tears of Isaac's other familiars.
** If no familiars are present, Mongo Baby will fire normal tears that each do 3.5 damage.
** ⟨7⟩ Mongo Baby shoots once every half second.
** ⟨24⟩ Mongo Baby shoots at the same rate as Isaac at base tears, 2.73 tears per second.
items.notes:
* Mongo Baby can only copy the familiars listed below:
** ⟦i:8¦Brother Bobby⟧
** ⟦i:113¦Demon Baby⟧
** ⟦i:608¦Freezer Baby⟧
** ⟦i:163¦Ghost Baby⟧
** ⟦i:167¦Harlequin Baby⟧
** ⟦i:99¦Little Gish⟧
** ⟦i:100¦Little Steven⟧
** ⟦i:174¦Rainbow Baby⟧
** ⟦i:95¦Robo-Baby⟧
** ⟦i:268¦Rotten Baby⟧
** ⟦i:67¦Sister Maggy⟧
* Mongo Baby will not copy familiars spawned by ⟦i:412¦Cambion Conception⟧ or ⟦i:123¦Monster Manual⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Mongo Baby having 4th priority.
* Despite bearing similarity to previously mentioned familiars, Mongo Baby will not copy the effects of:
** ⟦i:390¦Seraphim⟧
** ⟦i:518¦Buddy in a Box⟧

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Fires 8 tears around Isaac, which use his damage, range, shot speed, and tear effects. Shooting charges this item. ⟨24⟩ Tears from this item have a +5 flat damage.
items.effects:
* Each tear shot by Isaac increases item charge by one.
* Upon use, fires 8 tears around Isaac, which retain the damage, range, shot speed, and most special tear effects of his tears.
** ⟨24⟩ Tears from this item have a +5 flat damage bonus.
items.notes:
* The effect of ⟦i:38¦Tammy's Head⟧ is similar to Isaac's Tears, but Isaac's Tears will not benefit from tear-replacing items like ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧.
* ⟨3⟩ It takes 1.3 seconds to use, during which time Isaac cannot shoot tears normally. Because of this it is only worth it to use Isaac's tears DPS-wise if 4 or more tears successfully land.
** ⟨28⟩ It takes 0.4 seconds to use, during which time Isaac cannot shoot tears normally.
** ⟨24⟩ It takes 0.1 seconds to use, short enough that it usually will not interrupt shooting tears normally.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Teleports Isaac to the Secret Room, Super Secret Room, Treasure Room, or I AM ERROR.
items.effects:
* Teleports Isaac to the Treasure Room, the Secret Room, the Super Secret Room or I AM ERROR. There is also a 1% chance of teleporting into a Black Market.
** The chances for each main destination are equal.
items.notes:
* The choice is made between individual rooms, not by room type, so having multiples of a given room makes the total chance of landing in one of them higher.
** Treasure Rooms under .
** ⟨28⟩Secret Rooms with ⟦t:102¦Fragmented Card⟧.
** ⟨24⟩Secret and Super Secret Rooms with ⟦i:589¦Luna⟧.
** ⟨24⟩Red Rooms of valid types created by ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Turns Isaac's head into a stationary familiar for the current room which fires tears automatically. ⟨24⟩ Isaac's body also shoots a controllable fountain of blood shots for the room.
items.effects:
* Detaches Isaac's head from his body and turns the head into a stationary familiar that fires tears for the current room.
** The player still controls Isaac's headless body, which also shoots tears.
*** ⟨24⟩ The body constantly spews a controllable fountain of blood shots, dealing about 0.66x-1.01x damage.
**** The blood fountain can be aimed in any direction like ⟦i:465¦Analog Stick⟧.
** ⟨7⟩ The tears fired by the head do not scale with Isaac's damage and always do 3.5 damage.
*** ⟨24⟩ The head's tears are affected by Isaac's stats and attack modifiers.
items.notes:
* Can spawn multiple heads if used in the same room more than once.
** ⟨24⟩ Only the most recent head is able to fire.
* ⟨7⟩ ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ and ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧ are not fired from the stationary head.
* If Isaac has an invisible body due to the cosmetic effect of ⟦i:20¦Transcendence⟧, only a shadow will be seen after using the Scissors.
* ⟨7⟩ If Isaac is Blindfolded, the floating head can still fire tears.
* ⟨24⟩ The floating head does nothing as ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lilith¦Tainted Lilith⟧, and ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧.
** As ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, the floating head will only fire tears when the Soul is active.
** The floating head will not fire tears as ⟦c:tainted-samson¦Tainted Samson⟧ while he is enraged.
* ⟨6⟩ Each wave of Boss Rush fully recharges the item, allowing many heads to be spawned.
* Only deaths which end runs (i.e. Isaac is not revived by a revival item such as ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧) count towards unlocking the Scissors.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants a brief moment of invincibility when the charge bar hits zero. Isaac begins taking damage if the item is held any longer. ⟨24⟩ Isaac creates beams of light when touching enemies while invulnerable, and creates a powerful 4-way beam if blocking damage exactly as the invincibility starts.
items.effects:
* Holding the active item button will deplete the charge bar. As the charge gets closer to zero, Isaac turns bluer over time.
* Once the charge bar hits zero, Isaac will become invincible to all outside sources of damage. If the button is held for an additional second after hitting zero, Isaac will take damage for every second the button is held down.
** Isaac loses invincibility once the active item button is released.
** ⟨24⟩ If the button is released before the charge bar hits zero, a negative sound effect will play and the item will lose all of its charge.
** ⟨24⟩ While Isaac is invincible, he deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies and beams of light will strike down enemies touching Isaac, dealing 15 damage.
** ⟨24⟩ Blocking damage at the exact moment the invincibility activates will create a 4-way cardinal beam of light that deals 12 damage per tick for a total of 180 damage per beam.
*** If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 720 damage.
* The item will recharge on its own, but cannot be used again until it is fully charged (even if the charge bar wasn't fully depleted).
items.notes:
* While not time-based, invincibility from Breath of Life is otherwise identical to damage immunity granted by the shield effect.
* Breath of Life will prevent damage from Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, Hell Games, and Confessionals, allowing them to be played infinitely for free.
* ⟨28⟩ Once the invincibility takes effect, Isaac starts flashing rapidly.
** ⟨7⟩ Isaac will continue flashing for about a second even when invincibility has ended after releasing the active item button.
* ⟨24⟩ Cannot be used to prevent damage from the door to the ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ Taking damage from holding the active item button for too long is considered self-damage for the purposes of Angel/Devil Deal chances and items such as ⟦i:567¦Paschal Candle⟧.

items.description: If Isaac has half a red heart or no red hearts after taking damage, he gains a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 5 seconds. Allows entrance into ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧. ⟨24⟩ Also allows access to ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
items.effects:
* If the character has half a red heart or no red hearts after taking damage, it triggers the ⟦i:58¦Book of Shadows⟧ effect, creating a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 5 seconds.
* Allows entrance into ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ after beating ⟦e:isaac¦Isaac⟧ in the ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧ by touching the chest.
* ⟨24⟩ Opens ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧ in ⟦s:depths¦Depths⟧ II and its variants that leads to ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II.
** Unlike with the Chest entrance, The Polaroid gets consumed by the door and vanishes from Isaac's inventory.
items.notes:
* This item is a guaranteed drop from ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, if unlocked. Will drop alongside ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧, provided they are both unlocked. However, they are mutually exclusive: Once one of them is picked up, the other one will disappear.
** With the use of either a teleportation item and 5 pip Dice Room, a ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧, a ⟦i:347¦Diplopia⟧, a ⟦i:485¦Crooked Penny⟧, or ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧, both the Polaroid and the Negative or multiple copies of the Polaroid or Negative can be obtained.
** With ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, proper alignment of both characters can enable picking up both The Polaroid and The Negative.
** With frame-perfect timing and a bomb, it is possible to pick up both The Polaroid and the Negative.
* The Polaroid always triggers when taking damage as characters who lack Red Heart containers, such as ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧, ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ or any other character who has chosen to trade away their heart containers in devil deals, Black Markets, ⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧ or the ⟦i:487¦Potato Peeler⟧.
* The shield effect provided by The Polaroid can be stacked if the character takes damage multiple times. For example, using ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ 2 times provides 10 seconds of shield.
* Although ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ don’t have health, The Polaroid can trigger if they take non-fatal damage (e. g. take damage while ⟦i:704¦Berserk!⟧ is active or imitate damage via ⟦i:486¦Dull Razor⟧).
* The Polaroid will be the leftmost item after defeating Mom, in case is active.
* ⟨7⟩ It is possible to obtain two Polaroids by obtaining one as an ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ starting item.
* Obtaining multiple copies of The Polaroid does not cause its effect to stack.
* As with all items crucial to story progress (⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧, and ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧), this item has protection from full-run rerolls. It does not, however, share the immunity ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧ has to D6-type rerolls and ⟦i:477¦Void⟧.
* If Isaac took fatal damage and is revived in the same room, The Polaroid will trigger upon revival.

items.description: Instead of firing tears, Isaac controls one floating tear that hover over obstacles. This tear deals constant damage when held in place over an enemy.
items.effects:
* Instead of firing tears, Isaac controls one floating tear that hovers over obstacles. This tear deals constant damage when held in place over an enemy.
* ⟨16⟩ +0.2 shot speed.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ The Ludovico Technique is a special item.
* Ludovico tear is piercing and spectral by default.
* Ludovico tear movement speed is determined by the shot speed stat.
* Ludovico tear hits per second are determined by the tears stat, maxed out at 30 ticks per second.
* ⟨7⟩ When ⟦e:death¦Death⟧ uses his ⟦i:66¦The Hourglass⟧ attack, the tear is slow to respond, but then moves so quickly that it is nearly impossible to use effectively.

items.description: Slows all enemies in every fourth newly-discovered room, with a ~13% chance to speed them up instead.
items.effects:

** The effect is lost upon leaving the room, and not gained again if re-entering it.
items.notes:
* The effect is lost upon exiting and continuing the run. This can be used when the speed up chance is hit when fighting a Boss.
* ⟨7⟩ Because of the slow effect, champion versions of enemies will be tinted the same color as all other enemies. This makes it much harder to distinguish certain champion types, such as those that explode upon death.
* The player can abuse the Broken Watch to have the Broken Stopwatch trigger during any difficult boss fight by making sure that the fight is the fourth room since the last time the effect activated.
** For example, if the third undiscovered room was the Mom boss fight, Boss Rush will be the fourth undiscovered room, resulting in it being slowed down. This necessitates skipping the Devil Room or Angel Room, however.
** To trigger the effects of Broken Watch during the ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight and do not have either the ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧ or a ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧, you have to clear 1 room after the effect has activated, then explore every room in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧. Otherwise, after the effect has activated in a room, immediately go to ⟦s:home¦Home⟧ and explore every room.
** There is also the 13% risk of the room being sped up, so this strategy can rarely backfire.
* If the slow effect triggers when entering The Boss Rush or ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ boss area, it will be active for the entire Boss Rush/all four Horsemen and the Beast. This is also true of the speed effect.

* ⟨24⟩ The Boomerang's range scales with Isaac's tear height.
* The Boomerang can hit and stun ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧ or Lil' Haunts even when they are invincible.

items.description: Duplicates all pickups and item pedestals in the current room.
items.effects: * Instantly spawns a copy of all pickups and pedestal items on the floor in the current room, then disappears.
items.notes:
* If used in a room with anything that has a cost to obtain, including a Shop, Devil Room or the Black Market, the duplicated items and pickups will spawn without a cost attached and can be taken for free.
** The original items will remain unchanged, and Deal with the Devil precedent will not be set by collecting the free copies.
* If an item pedestal that is duplicated is visible as "?" (for example with the ), duplicate will be visible as "?" until taken, just like the original item pedestal.
* Diplopia cannot be copied with another copy of Diplopia or any duplication that mimics the effect. Other forms of item duplication, such as ⟦i:485¦Crooked Penny⟧ work as normal.
* ⟨7⟩ Using Diplopia on a trinket will spawn another random trinket instead of duplicating the trinket.
** ⟨24⟩ Using Diplopia on a trinket does nothing.
* ⟨24⟩ Does not duplicate ⟦p:jera¦Jera⟧.
* ⟨3⟩ Using Diplopia on an empty item pedestal will spawn another random item.
* ⟨7⟩ Picking up multiple copies of items that can cause Isaac to transform will not count towards transformation progress.
** ⟨24⟩ Multiple copies of the same item do count towards transformations.
* ⟨7⟩ If Diplopia is used in a room that offers a choice between multiple items, all of the duplicated items can be taken. The original items will still behave as normal: once an item is chosen, the others will disappear, but the duplicates will remain. This also includes Boss Rush (though taking any duplicate will still start the Boss Rush)
** ⟨24⟩ Only one duplicate can be taken. This affects Treasure Room on the alternate path, Angel Room that has multiple item pedestals, the ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ and ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ after defeating ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, the item ⟦i:414¦More Options⟧, Boss Rush, etc.

This is a list of the following recharge times the item can have, depending on the consumable it mimicked last:
1 room
2 rooms
3 rooms

12 rooms
Golden Pills use the recharge time of the pill they mimicked. Recharge time is unaffected by whether or not it was a normal pill or Horse Pill.

* Enemies that spawn with some form of invulnerability such as Hosts, Wizoobs, or Needles are not affected by this item.

items.description:

items.effects:
* Fires a single high-damage piercing tear which can travel over obstacles.
** The damage dealt by this tear is ten times Isaac's damage, plus a flat 10 damage.
** The shot has an additional 1.5x size multiplier on top of damage-increased size.
* ⟨7⟩ Sets Isaac's health to half a heart with each use (half a Soul Heart if these are present but there are no Red Heart containers). This also removes any other Soul Hearts or Black Hearts, but not Eternal Hearts.
** ⟨4⟩ If Isaac has no Red Hearts and at least one Bone Heart, only an empty Bone Heart remains.
* ⟨24⟩ Upon taking damage, this item turns into ⟦i:474¦Broken Glass Cannon⟧, and Isaac will lose an additional 2 hearts of health on top of the damage he already took. Isaac gains 1.5 range and leaves a trail of red creep behind him for the rest of the current room, identical to the effects of ⟦i:214¦Anemic⟧.
** If the damage from breaking Glass Cannon would result in death, Isaac will remain at half a heart, gaining half a soul heart if necessary. This does not apply if the damage Isaac took would be lethal before the extra damage is taken.

items.description: Grants spectral tears. Tears simultaneously fire out of both eyes diagonally, similar to the effect of the R U a Wizard? pill.
items.effects:
* Isaac fires tears from both eyes at the same time.
* Isaac's tears are fired diagonally outwards, similar to the effect of the R U a Wizard? pill.
* Isaac's tears become spectral.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:reap-creep¦Reap Creep⟧.
* The maximum amount of tears per volley that can be reached by combining and/or duplicating ⟦i:245¦20/20⟧, ⟦i:2¦The Inner Eye⟧, ⟦i:153¦Mutant Spider⟧ and The Wiz is 16.
* ⟨24⟩ The Wiz's quality is considered 1 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +1.5 damage. Replaces Isaac's tears with nails, which have increased knockback.
items.effects:
* +1.5 damage.
* Isaac's tears are replaced with nails, which have increased knockback.
items.notes:
* Does not grant penetrative shots, despite the appearance of Isaac's tears.
* Any item that normally colors Isaac's tears red will cause the nails to become bloody.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires copies of Isaac's tears with reduced size (or width for some special attacks).
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires copies of Isaac's tears with reduced size (or width for some special attacks).
** ⟨7⟩ Incubus' tears ignore Isaac's range and shot speed.
** ⟨24⟩ Incubus' damage is reduced by 25% when playing as characters other than ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lilith¦Tainted Lilith⟧.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* Lilith's starting Incubus is technically not a collected item but an intrinsic part of the character, and is removed if an item such as ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧ or ⟦i:482¦Clicker⟧ are used to become a different character. As such, playing as Lilith will not add Incubus to the collection page, nor does her personal Incubus count towards the transformation.
* Incubus is one of the familiars that can be spawned by ⟦i:412¦Cambion Conception⟧. However, receiving one in this way does not count towards Conjoined.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Incubus having 2nd priority.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: A blue head familiar that will follow Isaac and fire tears copying his tear effects and damage.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that fires tears with the same damage and tear effects as Isaac's tears.
* Fires at half the normal fire rate of a familiar.
** Since the normal fire rate of familiars (such as ⟦i:100¦Little Steven⟧, ⟦i:95¦Robo-Baby⟧ or ⟦i:390¦Seraphim⟧) is ⟨7⟩ once per second / ⟨24⟩ 1.36 times a second, Fate's Reward shoots ⟨7⟩ once every 2 seconds / ⟨24⟩ 0.68 times a second.
* The familiar is not affected by ⟨7⟩ range/⟨24⟩ tear height; only tear falling speed.
** ⟨24⟩ Since increasing tear height and shot speed lowers tear falling speed in order to adjust Isaac's range, increases to either stat will decrease the familiar's range, and decreases to either stat will increase the familiar's range.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Fate's Reward having ⟨15⟩ 5th / ⟨16⟩ 7th priority.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a chest familiar that spawns a random pickup (25% chance) or trinket (10% chance) upon clearing a room.
items.effects:
* Spawns a chest familiar that has a 25% chance to spawn a pickup and a 10% chance to spawn a trinket after clearing a room. The possible rewards are:
** Hearts
** Coins
** Bombs
** Keys
** Pills
** Cards
** Runes
** Batteries
** Trinkets
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Chest having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns an orbital familiar which does ⟨7⟩ 105 / ⟨24⟩ 53 damage per second and attracts and blocks enemy shots. Upon blocking 10 shots in a room, it drops an Eternal Heart.
items.effects:
* Spawns an orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 7 damage per tick or ⟨7⟩ 105 / ⟨24⟩ 52.5 damage per second on contact.
** It also attracts enemy shots to itself, making them more likely to be blocked. A shot actively being attracted can no longer damage Isaac and is essentially nullified, but if it slips outside the Protector's range, it can again deal damage.
* Sworn Protector has a chance to drop an Eternal Heart upon blocking 10 shots in one room.
** This can only happen once per room, but leaving and re-entering a room will allow another eternal heart to be dropped.
* ⟨7⟩
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes: * Sworn Protector can be exploited with the help of a Constant Stone Shooter to spawn unlimited eternal hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a white attack fly that orbits somewhere between ⟦i:57¦Distant Admiration⟧ and ⟦i:128¦Forever alone⟧, dealing 45 damage per second.
items.effects: * Spawns a white fly familiar that slowly orbits Isaac and deals 3 damage per tick or 45 damage per second on contact.
items.notes: * This familiar orbits Isaac at a middle-length distance somewhere between ⟦i:57¦Distant Admiration⟧ and ⟦i:128¦Forever alone⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a fly familiar that moves in a straight line and circles around the first wall or obstacle it hits. ⟨7⟩ It deals 105 damage per second on contact. ⟨24⟩ It deals 56 damage per second and forces nearby enemies to attack it.
items.effects:
* Spawns a fly familiar that moves in a straight line and attaches itself to the first wall or obstacle it comes into contact within each room.
** The Lost Fly will then move around the room functionally similar to the Guts.
* ⟨7⟩ If any enemies walk into its path, it will deal 7 contact damage per tick or 105 damage per second.
* ⟨24⟩ Lost Fly deals 7 contact damage every 7 ticks, or 30 damage per second. Enemies near Lost Fly will target it instead of Isaac.
** Some enemies that do not normally give chase to Isaac, such as Mulligans, will chase after the Lost Fly if nearby it.
* If the obstacle it is attached to is destroyed, then it will continue rolling in the direction it was previously traveling until it meets another wall or obstacle.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: We put bombs in your bombs!
items.description: +5 Bombs. Isaac's bombs explode into 2-4 tiny bombs.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.
* ⟨7⟩ Isaac's bombs split into 2-4 tiny bombs after exploding.
* ⟨24⟩ Isaac's bombs split into 4-5 tiny bombs after exploding.
* Tiny bombs deal half damage and have decreased blast radius.
** Tiny bombs retain most of Isaac's bomb synergies.
** ⟨24⟩ Tiny bombs explode immediately upon landing.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs stick to enemies and spawn 2-5 Blue Spiders on kill. ⟨24⟩ Bombs leave a long-lasting puddle of slowing creep. ⟨16⟩ Spawns 1-2 Blue Spiders or Blue Flies when bombs damage enemies.
items.effects:
* +5 Bombs.
* Bombs stick to enemies.
* Spawns 2-5 Blue Spiders when one of Isaac's bombs kills an enemy.
* ⟨16⟩ Spawns 1-2 Blue Spiders or Blue Flies when it damages an enemy.
* ⟨24⟩ Bombs leave a puddle of slowing white creep on the ground when they explode.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* Sticky Bombs spawn the same amount of spiders even if multiple enemies are killed with a single bomb.
* Sticky Bombs can stick to friendly enemies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Shooting in one direction increases Isaac's rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as Isaac changes direction or stops shooting, rate of fire is reset to its normal amount.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Tear delay gradually decreases by intervals as the player shoots in one direction. Accuracy also decreases as the fire rate increases.
** At max "charge", it will reduce tear delay by half, rounding down.
* ⟨24⟩ Fire rate gradually increases by intervals as the player shoots in one direction. Accuracy also decreases as the fire rate increases.
** ⟨16⟩ Fire rate increases smoothly instead of intervals.
** At max "charge", it will increase fire rate by double.
* The time required to reach max charge is ⟨15⟩ 9 / ⟨16⟩ 6 seconds.
* Rate of fire returns to its original value if Isaac stops firing, changes firing directions, uses an active item, or is hit.
** ⟨28⟩ Being hit, changing rooms, and using items no longer reset the Epiphora bonus.
** ⟨8⟩ Entering an unexplored boss room will reset the Epiphora bonus.
*** During the delay when transitioning between rooms, picking up an item, or using an active item, it's possible to change the firing direction without resetting the bonus.
items.notes: * Epiphora technically works with items that require a charge (such as ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧), but requires releasing the key or button, causing players to lose the effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants spectral tears and increases range. Tears travel through walls and appear at the opposite side of the room.
items.effects:
* Grants spectral tears.
* When tears travel off-screen, they loop back around through the opposite wall.
* ⟨7⟩ +2.25 range.
* ⟨24⟩ +3 range.
* ⟨7⟩ +1.5 tear falling speed.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:mega-maw¦Mega Maw⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ When fighting ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ tears will not loop downward identical to a Crawl Space.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ +0.7 tears, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed, Spawns a combination of 3 Red Hearts, Soul Hearts or Black Hearts on the floor when picked up.
⟨24⟩ +0.7 tears, +2.5 range, spawns 3 random types of Hearts on the floor when picked up.
items.effects:
* +0.7 tears.
* ⟨7⟩ +5.25 range.
* ⟨24⟩ +2.5 range.
* ⟨7⟩ +0.5 tear falling speed.
* Spawns a combination of 3 Red Hearts, Soul Hearts or Black Hearts on the floor when picked up.
** These hearts are not subject to the Red/Soul/Black Heart chances; each type has an equal chance to spawn.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Upon taking damage, spawns six Troll Bombs around the room, similar to the effect of ⟦p:xvi-the-tower¦XVI - The Tower⟧.
items.effects: * Upon taking damage, spawns six Troll Bombs around the room, similar to the effect of ⟦p:xvi-the-tower¦XVI - The Tower⟧.
items.notes:
* Despite appearing as Troll Bombs, the bombs are mechanically identical to player-placed bombs and will benefit from Isaac's bomb-enhancing items.
* These bombs hurt the player as well as enemies.
* Taking damage from the Troll Bombs spawned by Curse of the Tower or any other type of bomb, including Isaac's bombs, will not re-activate the effect.
* ⟨7⟩ Picking up this item will make all health transactions more difficult. Devil Beggars and Blood Donation Machines will be almost impossible to use because they will very likely be destroyed by bombs.
** ⟨24⟩ Taking damage from Devil Beggars and Blood Donation Machines does not trigger the effect. ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧, however, does trigger the effect.
* The bombs prefer to spawn near the center of the room.
* The 6 Troll Bombs are difficult to dodge in small rooms.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that occasionally drops a Lil' Battery, gives an active item charge, or petrifies all enemies in the room.
items.effects:
* Spawns a battery familiar that, while Isaac is in an uncleared room, every 30 seconds, starting from the moment it has been picked up, does one of the following:
** Spawns a Lil' Battery. It does this a maximum of 2 times per room.
*** ⟨24⟩ Can also spawn a Micro Battery or Mega Battery instead.
** Adds a charge to Isaac's activated item. It does this a maximum of 2 times per room.
** Petrifies all enemies for 1.3 seconds.
** Nothing.
items.notes:
* Charged Baby becomes very powerful as ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ in Greed mode, as the duplicates will continue to spawn Lil' Batteries, leading to a huge chain of familiars.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Charged Baby having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* In an uncleared room, if Charged Baby familiar has reached the maximum of spawned batteries and/or added activated item charges, Isaac may re-enter the room (e.g. by bombing a closed door, having ⟦t:124¦Door Stop⟧ or ⟦i:590¦Mercurius⟧) to reset Charged Baby's effect limits.
** This effectively allows farming for batteries and activated item charges, given the player's patience, ability to avoid enemies present in the room, and a way to re-enter the room indefinitely.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac's damage increases each time an enemy is hit. Damage is reset upon missing a shot.
items.effects:
* Isaac's damage increases for each successive tear hit on enemies.
** The multiplier increases by 0.25x for each hit, going up to a maximum of 2x after 4 successive hits.
** If a tear misses and hits nothing (wall/floor), there is a chance for the multiplier to be reset back to 1.
*** The chance is 20% for the first miss, 33% for the second miss, and 50% for the third miss and beyond.
** As the multiplier increases, Isaac's tears glow red and increase in size.
items.notes:
* The effect is triggered by many entities aside from enemies. Shooting ⟨7⟩ Fire Places, Poop, Wall Huggers, and Stone Grimaces will count towards the multiplier. This can be used to preemptively increase damage before entering a new room.
** ⟨7⟩ Because blue fires do not deteriorate when shot at with tears, maximum damage can always be achieved as long as the fire is not destroyed by an explosion.
** Shooting Hosts will increase the damage multiplier even if their skull is lowered down.
* If Dead Eye is removed by re-rolling it with ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:283¦D100⟧, or a 1 or 6 pip Dice Room, the damage multiplier will be removed, but the tears will continue to glow red.
* Tears do not have to be landed on only one enemy to build the multiplier; as long as they do not miss, Isaac gains damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Because there are no walls or floors for tears to collide with in the fight with ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, the damage boost will not fade away.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to fire holy tears, which will create a damaging light beam in the area if they hit an enemy.
items.effects:
* Isaac has a chance to fire a glowing blue tear that, after colliding with an enemy, spawns a damaging beam of light (similar to ⟦i:160¦Crack the Sky⟧).
** ⟨7⟩Each beam of light deals quadruple (4×) Isaac's tear damage.
** ⟨24⟩Each beam of light deals triple (3×) Isaac's tear damage.
** The beam of light will damage all enemies in a small radius around it.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* The chance to fire a holy tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \times 0.9 \right \rfloor},50\%)
** At base Luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 50% at 8.89 Luck.
* Its damage is multiplied from the tear's damage, not directly from Isaac's Damage.
** This means that, if the tears' damage has been multiplied from effects such as ⟦i:261¦Proptosis⟧ or ⟦i:150¦Tough Love⟧, the beam's damage is also multiplied.
* Light beams can destroy Shopkeepers if a holy tear hits an enemy nearby.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: A host familiar that sits on Isaac's head and has a 20% chance to block enemy shots and retaliate with 3 tears. Grants immunity to explosions.
items.effects:
* Enemy shots that hit Isaac have a 20% chance to be blocked. When a shot is effectively blocked, Host Hat fires 3 projectiles similar to the Host's.
** Projectiles fired from Host Hat use Isaac's Damage and Range, and copy Isaac's Tear effects.
*** The bullets do not use Isaac's Shot Speed.
** Can block:
*** Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), but their lines of fire harm Isaac.
*** Fire projectiles (e.g. from ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧).
*** Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti.
** Does not block:
*** Lasers or beams.
*** Lines of fire from fireballs.
*** Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.
* Grants immunity to explosions.
* ⟨24⟩ Grants immunity to bullets falling from above.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-gate¦The Gate⟧.
* Does not protect against exploding mushrooms.
* Does not protect against ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧'s vertical beams in the final phase.
* ⟨7⟩ Isaac becomes immune to ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ and ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧'s stomp attacks, as they are considered explosions. This makes the item very valuable if trying to unlock ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, as it will protect Isaac from the effects of the ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧.
* ⟨28⟩ This item is invaluable in Greedier Mode as nearly all of ⟦e:ultra-greedier¦Ultra Greedier⟧'s attacks are considered explosions.
* One of only two items that grant full immunity to explosive damage, the other being ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧.
* Although Host Hat has firing animation that expose itself after it blocks a tear, it can still block tears in this state, firing bullets as it blocks.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Causes Shops to instantly restock their items when they are bought. ⟨24⟩ Outside of ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.
items.effects:
* Upon purchasing an item from the Shop, a new purchasable item is added to the store's inventory.
** Collectibles created correspond to the shop's item pool.
* ⟨7⟩ Drops 3 random pickups around Isaac.
* ⟨24⟩ Outside of ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.
** For items, the price increase is 2 coins times the number of purchases. For example, an item starting at 15 cents would next be +2 to 17, then +4 to 21, +6 to 27, etc. The cost follows the formula 15+n(n+1) with n being the number of times restock has triggered.
** For everything else, the price increase is 1 coin times the number of purchases. For example, a heart starting at 3 cents would be +1 to 4, +2 to 6, +3 to 9 etc. This follows the formula (original price)+(n(n+1))/2
** The increase is not affected by discounts occurring naturally or through ⟦i:64¦Steam Sale⟧: costs will increase at the same rate, though the base price is still discounted. Once the item's cost goes over what it would naturally be, the price is no longer highlighted red.
** The maximum price is 99 cents.
* A small restock icon appears under the map, just like ⟦i:54¦Treasure Map⟧, ⟦i:246¦Blue Map⟧, ⟦i:21¦The Compass⟧ ⟨24⟩ and any active curses.
items.notes:
* All characters start with a permanent copy of this item in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧. It cannot be removed or rerolled by any means.
* ⟨7⟩ If used with ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧/Blood Donation Machine and an item which can spawn additional coins (⟦t:52¦Counterfeit Penny⟧, ⟦t:1¦Swallowed Penny⟧, ⟦i:203¦Humbleing Bundle⟧, etc.), infinite money can be produced by buying hearts for 3 coins and getting more than 3 coins back after donating health.
* When purchasing Restock from a Shop, the slot that Restock was purchased from will not be restocked.
* Restock does not affect Black Markets, purchasable items generated via ⟦i:586¦The Stairway⟧ and purchasable items generated by ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧ that cost coins.
* ⟨28⟩ Purchasing an item that is on sale will replace it with another that is on sale.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac.
items.effects:
* Certain spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac, nor actively spawn other enemies. Spiders that are spawned from enemies that are not affected by Bursting Sack will also remain neutral.
** Affected spider enemies that deal no damage to Isaac whatsoever include: Baby Long Legs, Big Spider, Crazy Long Legs, Level 2 Spider, Small Baby Long Legs, Small Crazy Long Legs and Spider.
*** ⟨24⟩ Also: Rock Spider, Strider, Swarm Spider, Tinted Rock Spider and Trite.
**** Swarm Spiders don't blink yellow when Isaac has the item.
**** Trites will still uselessly try to target Isaac.
*** ⟨28⟩ Spiders and Big Spiders don't blink red when Isaac has the item.
** ⟨7⟩ Unaffected spider enemies include: Blind Creep, ⟦t:77¦Blister⟧, Rage Creep, Ragling, Rag Man's Ragling, The Thing, Trite and Wall Creep.
** ⟨24⟩ Affected enemies that deal no contact damage but can still damage Isaac through other methods include: Blind Creep, ⟦t:77¦Blister⟧, Migraine, Rage Creep, Ragling, Rag Man's Ragling, Soy Creep, Tainted Soy Creep, The Thing, Ticking Spider, and Wall Creep.
*** Except for Ticking Spiders, Migraines, and Blind Creeps, all other spiders will still uselessly try to target Isaac for contact damage.
** ⟨24⟩ Coal Spiders aren't aggressive to Isaac, but will still deal contact damage.
** ⟨24⟩ Twitchies are not counted as "spider" enemies and are unaffected by this item.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ If either one of ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ holds Bursting Sack, both gain the benefits.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Continuously firing tears for 2.35 seconds causes Isaac to drop a ⟦i:209¦Butt Bombs⟧ bomb, which damages and confuses all enemies in the room when it explodes.
items.effects:
* Holding any fire button/direction for 2.35 seconds causes Isaac to drop a free ⟦i:209¦Butt Bombs⟧ bomb. This includes charging or directly controlled attacks. Only 1 Butt Bomb can be dropped per charging cycle, so it is required to stop firing and then charge again to drop another Butt Bomb. Taking damage will interrupt the cycle.
** ⟨24⟩ There is a visual fart effect whenever a Butt Bomb is placed.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:turdlings¦Turdlings⟧.
* Essentially grants unlimited bombs, as the charge time can be repeatedly reset by pressing and releasing the fire button. This allows Isaac to bomb an unlimited amounts of tinted rocks, get into every Secret Room and Super Secret Room, etc.
* Increases difficulty of poop-themed bosses such as ⟦e:dingle¦Dingle⟧, as Butt Bombs restore 25% of maximum HP to the bosses when they explode.
* The spawned butt bombs will be affected by bomb modifiers, excluding ⟦i:106¦Mr. Mega⟧.
* This item can be great for clearing the early floors of Greed mode, due to the butt bombs dealing room-wide damage every few seconds.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac spectral tears and gives his tears a wide arc shape, increasing their size.
items.effects:
* Grants spectral tears.
* ⟨7⟩ Tear size multiplier: 2x.
* ⟨24⟩ +0.6 tear size.
items.notes: * Despite their crescent shape, the tears still have a circular hitbox.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ +5 Coins. Most doors require one Penny to open instead of a Key.
⟨24⟩ +5 Coins. All locked doors, Locked Chests, and Key Blocks must be opened with one Penny instead of Keys.
items.effects:
* +5 coins.
* ⟨7⟩ Shops, Treasure Rooms, and Libraries must be opened with a Penny instead of a Key. These doors appear identical to Arcade doors.
* ⟨24⟩ All locked doors, Locked Chests, and Key Blocks must be opened with a Penny instead of Keys, including those that require 2 keys to open.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ Locked doors, chests, and key blocks gain a unique visual where their key slot is replaced with a vertical coin slot.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: Tears up + your future shines brighter
items.description: +0.7 tears up. Grants a random item at the start of the next run.
items.effects:
* +0.7 tears up.
* Grants a random item at the start of the next run.
items.notes:
* Quest items, such as ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧, ⟦i:551¦Broken Shovel 2⟧, ⟦i:552¦Mom's Shovel⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, and ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧ cannot be granted.
* The effect still occurs whether the run was successful or not, even if the run was restarted.
* The effect does not work if Eden's Blessing was obtained on a seeded run, during a Victory Lap, a RERUN, or during a challenge.
** Likewise, Eden's Blessing will not grant a free item at the start of a challenge or RERUN, instead granting the free item on the next valid run started.
*** Interestingly, seeded runs will still gain the benefit of banked Eden's Blessings, without depleting them. This means that it is possible to play an infinite amount of seeded runs, and they all start with a free item until a normal run is started.
* Even if Eden's Blessing is re-rolled, such as with the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ or ⟦i:283¦D100⟧, a random item will still be granted at the start of the next run.
** If Eden's Blessing is obtained via a re-roll, it will not grant an extra item in the next run.
** Picking up Eden's Blessing and then using ⟦i:422¦Glowing Hourglass⟧ to pick it up again will not reward more than one extra item on the next run.
** ⟨28⟩ Absorbing Eden's Blessing with ⟦i:477¦Void⟧ will not grant an extra item in the next run.
** ⟨24⟩ Removing Eden's Blessing as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ or with ⟦i:622¦Genesis⟧ will still grant an extra item in the next run.
** ⟨24⟩ Obtaining Eden's Blessing temporarily by using ⟦p:soul-of-jacob-and-esau¦Soul of Jacob and Esau⟧ will grant an extra item in the next run.
* Eden's Blessing can choose itself as the free item you gain, but will not give you an item on your next run.
* If more than one Eden's Blessing is acquired in a single run, that quantity of random items will be granted at the start of the next run, ⟨28⟩ although it's capped at ⟨15⟩ ten ⟨16⟩ two items.
** It is possible to obtain multiple copies of an item at once this way.
* ⟨28⟩ If Eden's Blessing effect is obtained through ⟦i:488¦Metronome⟧, no extra item will be given.
* ⟨24⟩ If gained from ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧, it will not grant an item next run.
* ⟨24⟩ Taking Eden's Blessing and then starting a run as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ will only give item(s) to Jacob.
* ⟨24⟩ As ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, the item will be given to his alive form.
** If ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ somehow acquires the item before flipping for the first time of the run, Eden's Blessing will be consumed upon flip and a random item will be granted to ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ If ⟦i:667¦Strawman⟧ picks up Eden's Blessing, the item will be granted on the next run whether Strawman Keeper survives or not.
* ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧ can't remove the item(s) given by Eden's Blessing and using it will consume the first item(s) acquired after them or do nothing if there are no other items.
* ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧ can remove Eden's Blessing and the item will be granted in the next game.
* Eden's Blessing will never attempt to give more than one activated item. Even if there are multiple Blessings and one of them gives Isaac a ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧, only one activated item can be generated.
* From the bugs listed below, one can potentially "soft-lock" the game by overflowing the number of items one gets. This repeats and crashes until it fully loads, which may take several attempts to load. Anywhere over 1000 Eden's Blessings will have an increased chance to permanently soft-lock the game; therefore, these bugs are highly unadvised to abuse.
** ⟨28⟩ Up to 10 Eden's Blessing items will be given per run. Any remaining Blessings will continue to be given each run until you have no more left.
** ⟨24⟩ Free items gained from Eden's Blessing do not carry over to subsequent runs and are capped at 10 free items for only the next run.
** ⟨16⟩ The cap has been reduced to 2 free items for the next run.

items.description: Throwing the ball at a monster instantly kills and captures it. The captured enemy can later be released and will be friendly, fighting for Isaac and persisting between rooms.
items.effects:
* Once thrown, the Friendly Ball will instantly capture any non-boss enemy it hits, removing them from the room.
* ⟨24⟩ Walking over a Friendly Ball after it captures an enemy will instantly recharge the item.
* The next time the Friendly Ball is thrown, it will release the previously captured enemy as a friendly enemy.
** Released enemies persist between rooms and floors and will follow Isaac until they die.
** Friendly enemies cannot harm Isaac and do not need to be defeated to clear a room.
** If Isaac leaves the room before the monster is released, the monster will stay in the ball until it is thrown again.
* If the Friendly Ball does not capture an enemy, it will simply disappear after a couple seconds being on the ground. The next throw will work the same.
items.notes:
* All enemies that aren't invincible and are not designated as a boss or mini-boss can be captured by the Friendly Ball. This includes enemies summoned from bosses such as ⟦e:brownie¦Brownie⟧'s spawned Dips or ⟦e:the-cage¦The Cage⟧'s unique Vises.
** ⟨4⟩ One exception to this is if you capture a Portal, as it can spawn enemies such as Death's Head.
* It is generally wasteful to use this item on Mulligans and their variants as they will immediately rush towards enemies and try to kill themselves, leaving behind friendly debris.
* If the captured enemy is a Globin variant (besides Black Globins for their lack of regenerative abilities) or a Dark Red Champion, the enemy will regenerate after dying, granting a much longer lifespan.
* Wall Creeps and their variants stick to walls, backing far away from any potential danger they might encounter.
* Stationary enemies that move underground (such as Round Worms or Lumps) work surprisingly well as an ally as they shoot foes from far away and rarely ever get hurt.
* Mom's Hand and Mom's Dead Hand will both one-shot almost all normal enemies and greatly damage most bosses with an incredibly small window for the hands to be hit, making them ideal for capturing.
* Brimstone-capable enemies are very potent as their lasers can cause an obscene amount of damage to both enemies and most bosses.
* If the captured enemy is one that spawns enemies, those enemies will be friendly as well.
* If the ally is immune to damage (such as a Mobile Host while its head is lowered), it will not take contact damage.
* If the captured enemy is a Solid White Champion, it will be completely invincible, as it cannot be killed until the room counts as being cleared, at which point it can be killed by spikes or a Wall Hugger.
* ⟨28⟩ If the captured enemy is a Pulsing Red Champion, it will regenerate the health of other monsters in the room, including friendly ones.
* ⟨3⟩ If an enemy that leaves behind a trail of damaging creep is caught, the creep created by the friendly mob will still damage Isaac when he walks over it.
** ⟨28⟩ All creep created by a friendly enemy will only hurt grounded enemies and not the player.
* The ball will only capture one segment of a Grub, one Buttlicker, or one Swarm Fly. However, when releasing a Swarm Fly, a new swarm is generated for it.
* If a Mask + Heart's Heart is caught and then released, a Mask can use the friendly heart to live even if its original heart is destroyed. The room will not be cleared unless the Mask is killed.
** The mask will ignore the friendly heart yet can still damage it. Bait the mask to charge towards the heart to destroy both.
* Friendly enemies that produce explosions do not damage Isaac. This includes enemies that explode on death (such as Boom Flies), as well as enemies that create Ipecac explosions (such as Gurgles).
** On top of that, lit bombs from friendly Mulligoons, Fly Bombs, and even Bombgaggers cannot hurt Isaac.
* The head of ⟦e:rag-man¦Rag Man⟧ can be captured by the ball while detached. It will not become a Ragling after being released, and only chases enemies by rolling.
* ⟨24⟩ Captured Bishops will protect Isaac with their shield generation ability, as well as all other friendly enemies. Isaac cannot take any damage while the Bishop is alive, as it will protect him with the shield. Protecting the Bishop can be a powerful defensive tool, especially when playing as ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧.
** The Bishop will die after protecting Isaac 6 times.
** The shield does not protect against instant death effects such as ⟦p:suicide-king¦Suicide King⟧ or ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ Captured Cultists will revive killed enemies as friendlies, allowing one to slowly amass an army of friendlies by protecting the Cultist.
** Bosses and degraded bosses can be revived by a friendly Cultist, but will not persist between rooms.
* Enemies that are spawned by a captured enemy (such as Dips spawned by a Dinga) will persist between rooms as well.

items.description: Splits all of Isaac's tears that are currently in the air into 6 tears that fire in all directions, which retain their damage and shot speed.

items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that can be launched in the direction that Isaac is firing after a short charge-up period.

items.description: Spawns a beggar familiar which picks up any nearby coins, leveling up after collecting several coins. At level 2, Bumbo gains a body. At level 3, it begins to fire tears. At level 4, Bumbo follows enemies and gains contact damage.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar which follows Isaac and picks up any nearby coins. Bumbo changes level based on the amount of coins it's collected.
:: Level 1 (0-5 coins): Bumbo just collects coins to level up.
:: Level 2 (6-11 coins): Bumbo occasionally drops a pickup, trinket, chest or pedestal item after a room clear.
:: Level 3 (12-23 coins): Bumbo now fires tears that deal 3.5 damage in the same direction Isaac does. Bumbo's tears have a chance to drop a coin if they hit an enemy.
:: Level 4 (24+ coins): Bumbo no longer fires tears and instead chases enemies slowly and deals contact damage (2.5 per tick, or ⟨7⟩37.5 per second/⟨24⟩10.7 per second). Bumbo will occasionally drop Bombs while chasing enemies or coins.
* After reaching level 4, Bumbo will continue to collect coins, and can drop a pickup, trinket, or chest for each coin it collects, similar to ⟦i:144¦Bum Friend⟧.
** Bumbo can also drop items from the current room's Item Pool.
items.notes:
* Level 1-3 Bumbo can fly over pits and obstacles, despite having limbs at level 2 and 3 that serve him as legs.
* If Bumbo consumes an absurd amount of coins while level four, Bumbo can become level one again (Unsure if bug, likely a buffer overflow)
* If Level 4 Bumbo targets ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s head, Bumbo will attempt to "chase" him the entire fight by standing in the middle of the room.
* Level 4 Bumbo's bombs are unaffected by Isaac's bomb synergies.
* Bumbo cannot pick up Sticky Nickels and will hover over them. Level 4 Bumbo can eventually bomb the Sticky Nickel to free it.
* Bumbo will pick up Lucky Pennies, without additional benefit to evolution or drops.
* If Bumbo drops a pedestal item, it will be pulled from the current room's item pool.
* In a RERUN, Bumbo's level is reset.
* Level 4 Bumbo can target charmed enemies and will try to follow them around to no effect. This prevents him from picking up coins until the target is changed.
* ⟨24⟩ There is a boss that resembles Bumbo level 4 named ⟦e:bumbino¦Bumbino⟧.
* ⟨6⟩ From a scoring perspective, Coins that Bumbo picks up count towards your Schwag bonus on daily runs.

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Re-rolls all Rocks and Metal Blocks in the current room into other random obstacles.
⟨24⟩ Re-rolls most types of obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.
items.effects:
* Re-rolls obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.
** ⟨7⟩ Poops, TNT, Fire Places and Key Blocks cannot be re-rolled.
* Obstacles can reroll into: Rocks, Tinted rocks, Cobwebs, Chapter-specific obstacles (Urns, Mushrooms, Skulls, and Polyps), Metal Blocks, Trap doors, Crawl Spaces, TNT, White Poop, ⟨24⟩ Fool's Gold Rocks, Reward Plates and Kill Plates.
* ⟨24⟩ Rerolled obstacles will only reroll into another one in this group: Poops, Retractable Spikes, Normal and Red Fire Places, both types of TNT, and Cobwebs.
** Rerolled obstacles can also reroll into Reward Plates and Kill Plates, but will not reroll any further. They can not roll into Trap doors or Crawl Spaces.
items.notes:
* Destroyed obstacles will not be rerolled.
* Rainbow Poop, Golden Poop, Tinted Rocks, Trap Doors, Crawl Spaces, ⟨24⟩ Fool's Gold and Kill Plates are much less likely to be created by the D12 than all other obstacles.
* ⟨24⟩ It is possible to reroll the spikes in a Sacrifice Room and render the room unusable.
** Newly created spikes (but not retractable spikes) in Sacrifice Rooms use separate reward counters, allowing you to get more rewards in one room.
* Each re-roll is seeded and will produce the same result for each room that the D12 is used in.

items.description: Spawns a familiar which creates a circular aura that slows down enemies and enemy shots inside.

items.notes:

items.effects:

** ⟨28⟩ It won't trigger if there are less than 2 enemies in the room.
* ⟨24⟩ Enemies are able to damage each other with projectiles. If an enemy is damaged by another enemy, they will attack that enemy instead of Isaac.

items.description: Tears have a chance to apply a poison effect to enemies. Isaac poisons enemies on contact. Poisoned enemies have a chance to drop a Black Heart when killed.
items.effects:
* Grants a 15% chance to fire poison tears, each tick dealing damage equal to Isaac's.
** Poison from the shots will tick 2 times.
* Inflicts poison on enemies who make contact with Isaac.
** Contact poison will tick 6 times.
* ⟨7⟩ Enemies who are killed after they have been inflicted with this type of poison have a 20% chance to drop Black Hearts. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.
** ⟨24⟩ Enemies that make contact with Isaac have a 20% chance to drop a Black Heart. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.
items.notes:
* Not affected by luck.
* Enemies and bosses with multiple segments, such as Chub and Larry Jr., have a chance to drop multiple Black Hearts.
* If a boss would have been poisoned, but negates it with status immunity, they can still drop a black heart.
* Contact poisoning enemies that don't deal contact damage can be an easy way to generate black hearts (e.g. all variants of Pooter, Host, Boil, Cod Worm, and any of ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧'s non-blank coins).
* ⟨7⟩ Although Stonies and Shopkeepers can't be visibly poisoned, they still can drop Black Hearts if destroyed after being touched.

items.description: Isaac will automatically fire tears directed at a red target on the ground. The target can be moved with tear controls. +0.7 tears, increases range.
items.effects:
* Creates a controllable crosshair. Isaac automatically and continuously fires towards the crosshair.
** ⟨24⟩ The crosshair will not appear in each room until Isaac fires. Pressing the "drop" key or button (Keyboard default: left Control key; Controller default: right trigger) will make the crosshair disappear and stop Isaac from firing tears until a firing key is pressed again.
** ⟨24⟩ Shooting familiars and throwable familiars now fire towards or launch themselves in the direction of the crosshair automatically.
* +0.7 tears.
* ⟨24⟩ +3.0 range.
* ⟨7⟩ +3.15 range.
* ⟨7⟩ +0.3 tear falling speed.
items.notes:
* On PC, it is possible to control Marked with the mouse. On Windows, go to C:/Users/[username]/Documents/My Games/The Binding Of Isaac [Rebirth/Afterbirth/Afterbirth+/Repentance/Repentance+]/ and in the options.ini file, change the line that says MouseControl0 to MouseControl1.
* ⟨16⟩ Marked's quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

items.description: Tears are replaced with laser rings that pierce through enemies and deal damage to enemies within them. Can be charged to increase the effectiveness of the ring.
items.effects:
* Isaac's tears are replaced with ring-shaped lasers.
** Shots can be charged to increase the size of the rings.
** The rings deal damage 15 times per second. Only the outer circumference of the rings will deal damage.
** Rings pass through obstacles and enemies. Rings have infinite range and will travel until they hit a wall.
** ⟨24⟩ Damage dealt is based on the amount charged, starting at around 25% Isaac's damage and approaches 100% at maximum charge.
*** \text{Charge Time} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) \approx \frac{3}{\text{Fire Rate
*** \text{Max Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) - 10)
*** \text{Min Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay}) + 1) - 10)
*** At 30.00 fire rate or above (0 tear delay or lower), charging is no longer needed and fires 30 rings per second. Higher fire rate results in higher laser damage.
**** \text{Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} - 10)
**** Damage per Tick is capped at 100% Isaac's Damage, at 90.00 fire rate.
items.notes:
* Like normal tears, walking forward makes the rings move faster, and walking backwards makes the rings move slower. Because the ring deals damage for as long as the enemy is inside of it, walking backwards actually increases Tech X's DPS, while walking forward lowers it.
* The rings are similar in appearance to the combination of ⟦i:329¦The Ludovico Technique⟧ and ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧.
* The laser rings will linger for a brief moment upon touching a wall, allowing more damage to be dealt to enemies closer to walls.
* The "R U A WIZARD?" pill effect does not work with Tech X.
* Acquiring an extra copy of Tech X will shoot an extra laser ring.
* ⟨7⟩ Charging only increases size, not damage. It is useful for hard-to-hit enemies or hitting a wide area at once, but spamming small, uncharged shots will lead to much higher damage output.
** ⟨4⟩ With the charge bars option enabled, the rings can be released immediately as the charge bar appears for easier gauging of maximum damage output.
* ⟨24⟩ The maximum ring size is slightly smaller in Repentance.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Creates up to two portals that remain even if Isaac leaves the room. Upon entering a portal, Isaac is teleported to the other portal.
items.effects:
* When used for the first time, Isaac creates a blue portal under where he is standing. The next time he uses the item, he creates an orange portal. Isaac can then walk over either of the portals to teleport instantly to the location of the other one.
** Activating the item more than twice will replace the older of the two portals.
* Upon entering a new floor, the previously placed portals will disappear.
items.notes:
* The portals can be placed in any room. However, if a portal leads to a room with a negative grid index (i.e. Devil Room, Angel Room, I AM ERROR room, Crawl Space, Boss Rush, Black Market, ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ room, or ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ portal room), Isaac will not be able to enter the portal.
* ⟨7⟩ Upon teleportation, Isaac is granted with a short invulnerability period which can be abused to trigger the Blood Donation Machine and Devil Beggar without losing health by placing a portal just next to it, teleporting, and touching the Donation Machine or Beggar in the same move. This trick is particularly useful for ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧. The teleportation trick can also be used to enter a Curse Room without taking damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Upon teleportation, Isaac is granted with a short invulnerability period which can be used to enter a Curse Room without taking damage. However, it cannot be used to play Blood Donation Machines or similar machines for free. Isaac is also unable to open chests during the animation, meaning Spiked Chests cannot be opened for free.
** When teleporting between different rooms, Isaac will briefly stay invisible at the door before moving to the portals, and can interact with chests near the door. However, opening Spiked Chests this way will still deal damage to Isaac.
* Portals will stay even if the item is dropped or changed.
* It is possible to stack the two portals on top of each other. Entering one will make you hop infinitely as long as you stay on the portals. It creates invincibility at the cost of mobility and almost, but not all tears.
* If is active, using portals placed between different rooms may result in a random destination. Two portals in the same room work reliably.
** If room contents are randomized by the curse, it's possible for the portals to end up completely surrounded or even inside rocks or pits. If Isaac can't move to safety, the run can be quit and resumed to be placed at a door.
* ⟨24⟩ On ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II, Ventricle Razor cannot be used to teleport between the normal and mirror world.
* ⟨24⟩ This item can be useful to exit Mom's boss room to start the Ascent, as long as you use it at least once before entering the boss room.
* ⟨24⟩ The item only costs 10 cents when found in a Shop.
* This item can be used to steal the rewards from a Challenge Room, a Boss Challenge Room or Boss Rush. This can be done by placing a portal in another room, then taking the rewards from the challenge room. Then, instead of fighting the enemies, use Ventricle Razor to immediately teleport out and keep the rewards.
* When fighting bosses that can drop pickups accompanied by other enemies, Isaac can kill only the boss for the pickups while keeping the other enemies alive, then use Ventricle Razor to teleport out and reset the room. This can be repeated to farm their loots infinitely.

items.description: Isaac's tears are bound to a beam emitting in the direction he's firing. ⟨7⟩ +0.5 Tears, +5.25 Range, +0.16 Shot Speed. ⟨24⟩ +1 Fire Rate, +2.5 Range, +0.16 Shot Speed.
items.effects:
* Isaac emits a beam in the direction that his head is facing. Isaac's tears travel in the path of the beam. When Isaac moves or turns his head, tears that are mid-flight will remain within the beam.
* ⟨7⟩ +0.5 Tears.
* ⟨24⟩ +1.0 Fire Rate.
* ⟨7⟩ +5.25 Range.
* ⟨24⟩ +2.5 Range.
* +0.5 Tear Falling Speed.
* +0.16 Shot Speed.
