* This item prevents tears from being fired at angles using momentum.
* Isaac does not automatically aim downwards after he stops firing with this item.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears have a chance to shrink enemies, making them run away from Isaac. Shrunk enemies can be crushed and killed by walking over them.
items.effects:
* Tears now have a ⟨15⟩ 10% / ⟨16⟩ 20% chance to apply a shrinking effect, causing enemies to shrink in size and also run away from Isaac.
** Shrunk enemies can be crushed and killed by walking over them.
** ⟨24⟩ Enemies that spawn from the death of a shrunken enemy will also be shrunken upon spawning. ⟨16⟩ Enemies that release projectiles, explosions or other effects such as Soul Suckers no longer perform their effect when killed while shrunken.
* The shrinking effect lasts 5 seconds ⟨16⟩ and enemies will flash white when the effect is about to end.
items.notes:
* The shrinking effect does not affect bosses or mini-bosses.
* ⟨15⟩ Champions and enemies that explode upon death will damage Isaac if crushed.
* Shrinking the heart of a Mask + Heart will cause its corresponding Mask to shrink as well. The Mask can be crushed and killed separately.
* The chance to fire a shrinking tear does not scale with Luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: While firing, Isaac can charge and unleash a black ring that rapidly deals damage around him. ⟨7⟩ The ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts. +1 damage.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ +1.0 damage.
* After firing tears for 2.35 seconds, if Isaac stops shooting, he unleashes a black ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ ring around Isaac that expands and contracts, dealing damage at a rapid rate to all enemies touching it.
** The black ring deals damage equal to Isaac's current damage per tick, and ticks a total of 30 times. It lasts ~1.97 seconds (118 frames).
** ⟨7⟩ Enemies killed by the black ring have a 5% chance to drop Black Hearts.
items.notes:
* The charge is completed when a red upside-down cross appears on Isaac's forehead.
** ⟨28⟩ With charge bars enabled, there is also an indicator that displays the charge.
* ⟨7⟩ This item does not work while playing a blindfolded character, as it requires tears to charge.
** This restriction can, however, be bypassed by picking up ⟦i:329¦The Ludovico Technique⟧.
** This item's effect will not fully activate if picked up by ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧; its stat ups will still apply to her ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ familiar, but the ring will not appear unless she also has the Ludovico Technique.
* ⟨24⟩ This item will still work while playing as a blindfolded character.
* The ring will apply any tear status effects such as poison if Isaac has them.
* This item can begin to be recharged again immediately after activating it, effectively cutting its charge time in half in situations where it may be needed again quickly.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: In addition to tears, Isaac holds a spear in front of him which deals contact damage equal to 2× his tear damage, and occasionally inflicts fear.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a spear familiar that he holds in the direction he most recently shot.
** The spear does twice Isaac's damage per 7 frames.
*** In Challenge 30: The Guardian, the spear does one times Isaac's damage per 2 frames and damage range increased by 7/13.
** Instantly inflicts the fear effect on any boss it comes into contact with. This is subject to the boss's resistance.
items.notes:
* Spear Of Destiny does not replace tears.
* The item is similar to ⟦i:114¦Mom's Knife⟧, although it cannot be fired.
* ⟨7⟩ Despite its size, the spear's hitbox is only located on the silver part and the handle, making it only effective at very close range.
* ⟨7⟩ The spear can kill permanently charmed enemies.
* ⟨3⟩ Spear Of Destiny does not work while Blindfolded, except in .

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.
items.effects: * Isaac's tears have a 25% chance to stick to enemies and explode a few seconds afterward, dealing 60 damage plus Isaac's tear damage.
items.notes:
* Explosivo does damage to Isaac if he is hit by the explosion.
* ⟨7⟩ Tears that stick to enemies do not deal any damage until they explode.
* ⟨24⟩ Explosivo shots deal regular tear damage upon sticking to an enemy.
* If an enemy dies or teleports with an Explosivo tear attached, the tear detaches and drops to the ground. If the detached tears touch an enemy, they will stick to that enemy and explode.
** However, when an Explosivo tear is attached to ⟦e:loki¦Loki⟧ or ⟦e:lokii¦Lokii⟧, the tear teleports with the respective boss when the boss teleports.
* Since Explosivo causes large tears to grow even larger, they can completely obscure enemies and their surroundings.
* The special tears can stick to the various spiked blocks (Wall Hugger, Slide, and Poky) as well as the variants of Stone Grimace, even when they are inactive. They will not destroy them, however. This can be used to destroy rocks or other obstacles around the tile.
* Explosivo is not affected by luck.
* Explosivo shots can go through any type of Fire Place and ⟨24⟩ coal from Coal Spider and Coal Boy.
* Tears that are attached to enemies can destroy Poops and hit other enemies if they are close enough.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Drops 1-6 random pickups on the floor. Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.
items.effects:
* Drops 1-6 random pickups around Isaac.
* Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.
** Fixed item drops that ignore the current room's item pool will not be replaced. Examples include ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧ after defeating one of The Harbingers as a floor boss, or ⟦i:90¦The Small Rock⟧ after breaking a Tinted Rock.
items.notes:
* When playing Greed mode, items that are available only in the normal game will still not appear despite Chaos; the modes' different item pools stay separate.
* As the item does not mix or combine item pools, it is possible to deplete smaller item pools and end up with ⟦i:25¦Breakfast⟧ before all items in the game have been taken.
** Thus, if Chaos tries to pull from an item pool that is already depleted, it will not pull from a different pool and instead give Isaac Breakfast.
*** As many Greed mode item pools are small, Chaos tends to result in Breakfast more often during Greed mode.
* ⟨7⟩ Chaos will draw items even from item pools that are not used in the game, but defined in the game's files. The unused pools are bossrush containing nearly all bomb related items, challenge with a smaller selection of bomb items and dungeon containing several Mom related items and food items.
* ⟨7⟩ Since all item pools have the same probability of being selected, bomb-related items are much more common due to the Bomb Bum, bossrush and challenge item pools.
* ⟨24⟩ Each pool has a weight based on the number of items in the pool. Items from large pools such as Treasure Room, Shop, and Boss are very likely, while items from small pools like Bomb Bum and Planetarium are more rare.
* If an item outside of the Devil Room pool appears as a Devil Deal, it will always cost 1 Red Heart Container (or 3 Soul Hearts should Isaac have no Red Hearts).
** ⟨24⟩ If an item from the Angel Room pool appears as a Devil deal, it will cost 2 Red Hearts if it would cost 30 cents in the Angel Shop generated by ⟦i:586¦The Stairway⟧, and 1 Red Heart if it would cost 15 cents in the Angel Shop.
*** Similarly, if an item from the Devil Room pool appears in an Angel Shop generated by ⟦i:586¦The Stairway⟧, it will cost 30 cents if it would cost 2 Red Hearts as a Devil Deal, and 15 cents if it would cost 1 Red Heart as a Devil Deal.
* If an item that grants an Eternal Heart is taken in a devil deal, the eternal heart will not keep Isaac alive if he has no other hearts.
* ⟨28⟩ Bosses defeated in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ drop items as if Chaos was active. Rerolling the items uses the Boss Room pool as normal.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Displays Isaac's tear damage and enemy health bars. Spawns a familiar that wanders around and inflicts random status effects on enemies it touches. Can spawn a Lil' Battery (⟨24⟩Micro Battery) / Blue spider upon clearing a room.
items.effects:
* Spawns a grey spider familiar that wanders around and allows Isaac to see tear damage and the health bars of all enemies.
** The spider will inflict a random status effect on any enemies it comes into contact with.
** The spider has a 10% chance to spawn a Blue Spider (2/3 chance) or drop a Lil' Battery (Micro Battery) (1/3 chance) when a room is completed.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ For the sake of simplicity, all damage values shown are multiplied by 10 and rounded up to the nearest number.
** ⟨24⟩ Damage values are no longer multiplied or rounded.
* ⟨24⟩ If a hit would deal 10000 or more damage, it will be displayed as 9999.
* All status effect damage dealt by Spider Mod is based on Isaac's damage stat.
* Spider Mod reveals ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s health bar and is the only way to see his health.
** ⟨24⟩ In Repentance, doesn't reveal ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s life bar during his second phase anymore.
** ⟨24⟩ Spider Mod also reveals the health bar for ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧, the Ultra Harbingers, and ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧.
* ⟨7⟩ Spider Mod shows the health of invincible enemies, holes created by ⟦e:little-horn¦Little Horn⟧, and the golden statue of ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧.
* Spider Mod doesn't show if a segmented enemy has individual segment health like ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧ or a health pool like ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧. Against enemies with invulnerable segments such as ⟦e:carrion-queen¦Carrion Queen⟧ and ⟦e:scolex¦Scolex⟧, its indicators will show under their head and not under the vulnerable segments.
* Spider Mod's damage doesn't account for damage scaling, ⟨7⟩ enemy damage reduction, or invulnerability, which means that the damage indicators for some bosses, Mushrooms, Stone Grimaces, and similar enemies will be inaccurate.
* ⟨28⟩ If Isaac transforms into , it spawns a spider familiar who works similarly to Spider Mod.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots. If a shot hits Farting Baby, it has a chance to fart, which charms, poisons, or knocks back nearby enemies.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a 25% chance of farting. Farting has a cooldown of 210 frames. There are three possible fart effects:
** Charms all nearby enemies.
** Poisons all nearby enemies.
** Knocks back nearby enemies ⟨24⟩and hostile tears.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* Farting Baby does no contact damage.
* The knockback fart deals no damage.
** ⟨24⟩ The reflected tears deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
* The charm fart deals 5 damage.
* The poison fart initially deals 5 damage and the poison deals 3.5.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Farting Baby having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Spawns a familiar that bounces diagonally around the room, applying a random status effect to enemies it hits and has a chance to re-roll pickups it passes over.
⟨24⟩ Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster or pickup it hits.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Spawns a familiar that bounces diagonally around the room, deals 8 damage per tick or 120 damage per second and applies a random status effect to enemies it comes in contact with. The familiar also has a chance to re-roll pickups that it passes over into other pickups, Chests, or items, in an uncleared room only (with at least one enemy alive).
* ⟨24⟩ Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster, trinket, or pickup it hits. It respawns after clearing a room.
** If it cannot reroll an enemy (e.g. a boss), it will deal 8 damage instead.
** Items and opened chests cannot be rerolled.
** Pickups have a 10% chance of becoming chests (see the algorithm).
*** If a chest is rerolled, it has a 28% chance of staying as some kind of a chest.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ GB Bug can block projectiles.
* ⟨7⟩ GB Bug does more damage per second than ⟦i:155¦The Peeper⟧, with the added random status chance.
* ⟨24⟩ GB Bug is able to reroll Throwable Bombs into normal consumables. After doing so, the corresponding Bomb Grimace will generate another Throwable Bomb, making it able to generate a potentially large amount of free consumables.
* ⟨24⟩ Rerolled champion enemies will retain their color, unless they reroll into a monster that cannot naturally spawn as a champion.
* ⟨24⟩ Caution is advised as GB Bug can also reroll certain entities such as the hot rock left by a dead Coal Spider adding another enemy to the room.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with GB Bug having ⟨15⟩ 5th / ⟨16⟩ 7th priority.
* ⟨24⟩ While playing ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧, GB bug can be dropped and picked back up to respawn it, allowing for infinite rerolls.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.
items.effects:
* Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.
** Each stat is given a multiplier, ranging from 0.5x to 2.0x, which applies after all other adjustments.
items.notes:
* Luck, Shot Speed, and ⟨7⟩ Tear Falling Speed are unaffected.
* The Tears multiplier can cause Isaac's tear delay to decrease beyond the normal cap of 5.
* The Speed multiplier cannot cause Isaac's speed to decrease or increase past the normal range of 0.1 to 2.0.
** The multiplier overrides the Speed Up effect of ⟦i:130¦A Pony⟧ or ⟦i:181¦White Pony⟧, which normally raise Isaac's Speed to 1.5 if it is below that value.
** ⟨7⟩ The hidden maximum Speed value also gets the same multiplier, which may further cap Isaac's Speed.
* The multipliers are chosen in a way that keeps their total product roughly the same; the item will most often increase two and decrease two of Isaac's stats, although it can increase three and decrease one or increase one and decrease three. Larger increases are balanced by larger decreases.
* In the area where you claim ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, the multipliers granted by d8 will remain, when activated using ⟦i:477¦Void⟧ (possible bug). This can be detrimental if there are negative multipliers to fire rate or speed.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Boosts one of Isaac's stats depending on the color of the aura around him. The aura disappears upon taking damage and reappears with a random color upon entering a new room. Red boosts damage, blue boosts tears, yellow boosts speed, and orange boosts range.
items.effects:
* Grants a random aura around Isaac that grants a boost depending on the aura's color:
** Red: +4 damage.
** ⟨7⟩ Blue: -4 tear delay.
** ⟨24⟩ Blue: +2.0 fire rate.
** Yellow: +0.5 speed.
*** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
** ⟨7⟩ Orange: +7.5 range, +1.0 tear falling speed.
** ⟨24⟩ Orange: +3.0 range.
* Taking damage causes the aura to disappear. When the next room is entered, the aura will reappear with a random color.
items.notes:
* The tear delay boost can allow the player's tears to go over the normal maximum rate of fire.
* ⟨24⟩ If ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ swaps Purity for another item and picks it back up again, it will have a different aura.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ When Isaac takes damage, a damaging black ring briefly appears around him. This ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts.
⟨24⟩ After Isaac kills an enemy, adds a luck-based chance to spawn a damaging black ring around them.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ When Isaac takes damage, a black ring briefly appears around him, dealing tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it.
** When an enemy is killed with the black ring, there is a 15% chance for it to drop a Black Heart.
** Black Hearts will drop as soon as the enemy is killed. (In other words, the heart will drop at the beginning of the death animation rather than at the end of the death animation.)
* ⟨24⟩ When Isaac kills an enemy, gives a chance for a black ring to appear around where it once was, dealing Isaac's tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it. The chance scales with Isaac's luck. The base chance is 25%, with an additional 2.5% chance per point of luck, capping out at 100% at 30 luck.
items.notes:
* The ring created by Athame is identical to the ring created by ⟦i:399¦Maw Of The Void⟧.
* Athame is especially effective against bosses that summon many monsters, such as ⟦e:envy¦Envy⟧, ⟦e:super-envy¦Super Envy⟧, and ⟦e:brownie¦Brownie⟧.
** ⟨7⟩ Each piece of Envy/Brownie Corn grants a 15% chance for a Black Heart.
* ⟨24⟩ Black rings can also be generated by destroyed Shopkeepers.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants two Black Hearts. While Isaac has no red hearts, grants flight and periodically grants an invincibility shield for a few seconds.
items.effects:
* When Isaac has no Red Hearts:
** Grants flight.
** Every 40 seconds since activation or pickup, when the seconds on the timer hit 00, 20, or 40, while in a room with enemies, a shield triggers, nullifying all types of damage for 10 seconds.
* Grants 2 Black Hearts on pickup.
items.notes:
* Does not affect ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧/⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧.
* ⟨7⟩This item is difficult to use for anyone with red health, as it is impossible to have no red hearts without removing all heart containers (such as through Devil deals). It is best used by characters that cannot gain red health at all, such as ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧.
* ⟨24⟩Characters can now deplete their red health fully through sources like Blood Donation Machines while having other hearts like Soul Hearts. As a result, this item is usable for a wider amount of characters, and has synergies with characters who prefer to have no red health (such as ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧).
* Rotten Hearts also prevent Empty Vessel's effects.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to fire a slow-moving eye that fires tears in the same direction as Isaac. The eye is destroyed when it hits an enemy or obstacle.
items.effects:
* Isaac will occasionally fire a slow-moving eye with an infinite range that fires tears identical to Isaac's tears.
* The eyes fire in the same direction as Isaac.
items.notes:
* The chance to fire an eye tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 {30 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},10\%)
** At base Luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 10% at 20 Luck.
* The eye has the same rate of fire and damage as Isaac. Its travel speed is also affected by Isaac's shot speed.
* If the eyes are spawned from ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s melee attack, the eyes will pick up items off the floor in the same way The Forgotten's melee attack does.
* The eyes are not treated as familiars and therefore will not synergize with items like ⟦i:247¦BFFS!⟧.
* Eyes disappear when hitting walls, enemies, and obstacles, even if Isaac has piercing or spectral tears.
** Familiars like ⟦i:265¦Dry Baby⟧, ⟦i:511¦Angry Fly⟧ and even ⟦i:467¦Finger!⟧ also destroy the eye on collision.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac's damage increases for the current room each time he kills an enemy.
items.effects:
* Each time an enemy is killed, Isaac gains a damage boost for the current room.
** Each kill increases damage by 0.5, up to a maximum of 5 damage after 10 kills.
items.notes:
* Some summoned enemies like Rag Man's Raglings do not trigger the effect when killed.
* Mr. Maw does not trigger the effects of Lusty Blood, even after splitting.
* Blowing up a Shopkeeper will grant Isaac a damage bonus as well.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: After taking damage a certain amount of times, a permanent demonic familiar spawns.
items.effects:
* Upon taking damage a certain number of times, Isaac gains a permanent demonic familiar. Possible familiars include:
** ⟦i:278¦Dark Bum⟧
** ⟦i:113¦Demon Baby⟧
** ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧
** ⟦i:270¦Leech⟧
** ⟦i:275¦Lil Brimstone⟧
** ⟦i:417¦Succubus⟧
** ⟦i:679¦Lil Abaddon⟧
** ⟦i:698¦Twisted Pair⟧
* The first and second familiars will each spawn after taking damage 15 times. The third and fourth familiars will each spawn after taking damage 30 more times. No further familiars will spawn. As a result, after taking damage 90 times, four out of eight possible familiars will have spawned.
items.notes:
* Isaac will look progressively more pregnant as he takes damage.
* Familiars spawned this way do not count towards transformations nor the collection page.
* ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ starts with this item by default, even if it hasn't been unlocked. Lilith can get a second ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ through this.
* Only one of each familiar can be spawned.
* Familiars that have yet to be unlocked can spawn, ⟨24⟩ with the exception of ⟦i:679¦Lil Abaddon⟧ and ⟦i:698¦Twisted Pair⟧, which must be unlocked before they can spawn through Cambion Conception.
* Only actually getting damage counts towards the payout. For example, negating damage with the ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ will not count. Using the Blood Donation Machine or Devil Beggar counts as damage taken.
* Familiars spawned by the item do not affect item pools, so multiple copies of one familiar can be obtained. For example, a second Incubus can be purchased after Cambion Conception spawns one.
* If a familiar obtained is a copy of another one already obtained, using ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧ will only clone one of that familiar.
* If this item is removed in any way (such as with a ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧), the familiars from Cambion Conception will be removed upon updating familiars, including picking up items that don't add familiars but update its cache, such as ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧.
** If the item is re-obtained after being removed (e.g. by dropping the item as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧), the damage counter and familiar limit will be reset, allowing Isaac to obtain all eight familiars with only one Cambion Conception. If the familiars were removed, all will return once familiars are updated.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Upon picking up a certain amount of health, spawn a permanent angelic familiar.
items.effects:
* Upon picking up 15 heart pickups, Isaac gains a permanent angelic familiar and generates a Soul Heart drop. Possible familiars include:
** ⟦i:178¦Holy Water⟧
** ⟦i:112¦Guardian Angel⟧
** ⟦i:363¦Sworn Protector⟧
** ⟦i:98¦The Relic⟧
** ⟦i:390¦Seraphim⟧
* All five familiars will spawn in a random order.
* Isaac will look progressively more pregnant as he collects heart pickups.
* The familiars spawned by Immaculate Conception will not contribute to transformations, such as , nor do they count towards the collection page.
items.notes:
* After all five familiars have been spawned, a Soul Heart will still drop every 15 hearts collected.
* All types of hearts except Gold Hearts and Blended Hearts count.
* Items that directly add health such as ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧, ⟦i:78¦Book of Revelations⟧, ⟦i:292¦Satanic Bible⟧, and ⟦i:83¦The Nail⟧ do not count towards spawning a familiar.
* ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ can pick up Soul Hearts and Black Hearts despite having no health and thus can activate Immaculate Conception.
* ⟨15⟩ ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ cannot encounter hearts, thus the item is useless for them.
** ⟨16⟩ Healing ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ with coins counts for Immaculate conception.
* As the short-lived Half Red Hearts dropped by ⟦c:tainted-magdalene¦Tainted Magdalene⟧ also count, it is an excellent choice for her since she will constantly be picking up hearts and gain all five familiars quickly.
* Familiars spawned by the item do not affect item pools, so multiple copies of one familiar can be obtained. For example, a second Seraphim can be purchased after Immaculate Conception spawns one.
* As with ⟦i:412¦Cambion Conception⟧, if this item is removed in any way (such as with a ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧), the familiars from Cambion Conception will be removed upon updating familiars, including picking up items that don't add familiars but update its cache, such as ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧.
** If the item is re-obtained after being removed (e.g. by dropping the item as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧), any familiars that were removed will return once familiars are updated.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Two item pedestals are presented in every Treasure Room. Only one can be taken; the other will disappear.
items.effects: * Two item pedestals are presented in every Treasure Room. Only one can be taken; the other will disappear.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Small Treasure Rooms only present one item, nullifying this item's effect.
* Having multiple copies of More Options will not have any extra effect.
* If the Treasure Room has already been entered and the item was not taken, then picking up More Options later on the same floor will not retroactively add a second item to the room.
** If the Treasure Room has not been entered on the same floor More Options was picked up, then it will contain two items.
* The very rare Treasure Rooms that have either no item or two items that can both be picked up will be replaced with a one-out-of-two choice room, like other Treasure Rooms. In the latter case, this is a downgrade.
* ⟨24⟩ In the alternative path, Treasure Rooms will have two known items and one unknown item, instead of the usual one known and one unknown.
* ⟨24⟩ In ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II, The Mirrored world's treasure room will not contain a second item.
* More Options will work for Treasure Rooms during the Ascent as long as those rooms were never originally entered.
* Neither of the items in the modified Treasure Room are guaranteed to be the same as the original item, effectively rerolling the original item while also offering a second choice.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +2 Soul Hearts. While Isaac has no empty red hearts, grants 2x damage, -0.3 shot speed, ⟨7⟩ and increased range. Regardless of health, the crown deactivates for the current room when Isaac takes damage.
items.effects:
* Grants 2 Soul Hearts.
* Replaces normal tears with blue diamond tears while all of Isaac's Red Heart containers and Bone Hearts (if any) are full.
** This includes whenever Isaac has zero Red Heart containers.
** Containers can be filled with Rotten Hearts and still activate the effect.
** The coin health containers of ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ count as red heart containers for the purposes of this item.
* While the effect is active, grants the following stats:
** 2x damage.
** ⟨7⟩ +5.25 range.
** ⟨7⟩+0.5 tear falling speed.
** -0.30 shot speed.
* The crown will glow blue while active; if inactive, it will appear grey.
* The effect will deactivate for the rest of the current room when damage is taken, regardless of Isaac's health.
** Fighting waves in Greed mode won't reactivate the crown.
items.notes:
* Because the effect occurs if Isaac has no Red Heart containers at all, this is an extremely beneficial item for ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧.
* Due to the fact that they will be at full health a larger portion of the time than most characters, this item is also very powerful for ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧.
* If the damage is lost with ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧, he can pick up another item in the same room and then swap it back to refresh the effect. Holding onto pedestal generation like ⟦i:515¦Mystery Gift⟧ will allow him to place an item inside a difficult boss room and regain the bonus damage after being hit.
* Using ⟦p:xi-strength¦XI - Strength⟧ when already at a maximum 12 hearts, but having taken damage (hence visually having full maximum health) will not reactivate the item.
* Additional copies of the item will grant 2 Soul Hearts upon pickup, but no change in stats.

⟨24⟩ Increases the coin cap to 999. If a room would otherwise yield no reward, 1-3 coins will spawn.

items.description: Spawns a flying familiar that bounces around the room with a black aura, dealing rapid damage to any enemies inside it. While standing in the aura, Isaac gains a 1.5× tear damage multiplier.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that bounces around the room and has a dark aura around it.
** Enemies within the radius of the aura take damage.
*** ⟨7⟩ The aura deals 30% of Isaac's damage per tick or about 129% of Isaac's damage per second.
*** ⟨24⟩ The aura deals 2.5 damage per tick or about 7.5-10 damage per second.
** If Isaac is within the aura, his tears gain a 1.5× damage multiplier.
items.notes: * The damage boost stacks with other Succubi, as well as other damage multipliers (e.g. ⟦i:4¦Cricket's Head⟧, ⟦i:182¦Sacred Heart⟧, etc.).

items.description: Isaac's tears gain a random effect that changes every shot.
items.effects:
Each tear that Isaac fires gains a random effect. The possible effects are:
The following tear effects when generated by Fruit Cake work differently than that of the base item:
* ⟦i:450¦Eye of Greed⟧: Isaac will not lose coins from this effect occurring.
* ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧: There is no associated damage up/poison effect/arcing.
* ⟦i:5¦My Reflection⟧: There is no associated shot speed up.
* ⟦i:169¦Polyphemus⟧: Only the ability to pierce enemies on overkill damage is applied; there is no associated damage bonus with the tear.
* ⟦i:261¦Proptosis⟧ : There is no associated damage multiplier, effectively decreasing damage dealt.
* ⟦i:233¦Tiny Planet⟧: There is no associated range up.
⟨24⟩ The unique tear effects available to some wisps made by ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ can also be used by Fruit Cake. This can include:
* Drop hearts/coins/cards/runes on kill. The tear must deal the final hit; earlier hits do not flag enemies to drop the consumable on death.
* Teleport enemies to a random location in the room. This cannot affect Bosses.
* Transform enemies into Poop (similarly to ⟦i:236¦E. Coli⟧).
* Transform enemies into random wisps.
Tear effects used in the pool of Fruit Cake do not need their base items unlocked in order to be used. This means that Fruit Cake can occasionally give previews of synergies that are locked.
items.notes:
*Fruit Cake has the potential to break rocks and open secret rooms with the effects of ⟦i:463¦Sulfuric Acid⟧, ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧, or ⟦i:592¦Terra⟧. However this can be time consuming dependent on Isaac's tear rate and number of tears fired.
*Avoid shooting walls, obstacles and enemies close to Isaac as a ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ tear may explode and damage Isaac. ⟦i:257¦Fire Mind⟧ & ⟦i:401¦Explosivo⟧ tears can hurt Isaac as well when hitting an enemy.
**⟦i:440¦Kidney Stone⟧ & ⟦i:699¦Azazel's Rage⟧ cause periods of uncontrolled continuous fire that will trigger many effects, potentially damaging Isaac.
**⟦i:55¦Mom's Eye⟧, ⟦i:558¦Eye Sore⟧, ⟦i:87¦Loki's Horns⟧, ⟦i:319¦Cain's Other Eye⟧: Fire additional tears around Isaac, increasing the risk of self damage.
**⟦i:595¦Saturnus⟧, ⟦i:399¦Maw Of The Void⟧, ⟦i:573¦Immaculate Heart⟧, ⟦i:233¦Tiny Planet⟧, ⟦i:5¦My Reflection⟧: Can potentially cause explosions nearby Isaac.
*Fruit Cake has multiple effects that may spawn coins upon hitting an enemy, this can be beneficial to ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ & ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ to regain health in longer boss fights.

items.description: Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been explored yet. Normal rooms are prioritized over special rooms, and common special rooms take priority over rarer ones.
items.effects: * Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been explored yet. Normal rooms are prioritized over special rooms, and common special rooms take priority over rarer ones.
items.notes:
* The room that Isaac is teleported into will be touching an explored room, if possible.
* When used in a room with enemies in it, Isaac is teleported back into the same room, resetting it.
* The order of types of rooms is predetermined, first available on this list chosen:
*# ⟨28⟩ Grave Room / Mirror Room / Mine Cart Room
*# Normal rooms
*# Red Rooms (opened but unexplored)
*# Boss Room
*# Super Secret Room
*# Shop
*# Treasure Room
*# Planetarium
*# Sacrifice Room / Dice Room
*# Library
*# Curse Room
*# Mini-Boss Room
*# Challenge Room / Boss Challenge Room
*# Arcade / Vault
*# Clean Bedroom / Dirty Bedroom
*# Secret Room
*# Ultra Secret Room (Mirrored World only, even if it wasn't located)
*# Devil Room / Angel Room
*# I AM ERROR room.
* In ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧ or ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧, using the I AM ERROR room exit will bring Isaac to The Chest or Dark Room respectively.
** This works even if Isaac has the wrong corresponding item (⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ / ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧) for that floor.
* In ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧, ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧, ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧ floor, and ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ II, Teleport 2.0 will teleport Isaac to the Devil/Angel room instead of the I AM ERROR room. The same is true when using it on the final floor of a Daily Challenge.
* ⟨4⟩ In ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, using Teleport 2.0 in the I AM ERROR room will teleport Isaac to The Void again, allowing the floor to be restarted. The floor regenerates with new rooms and enemies. This can be done multiple times.
* A floor's Boss must be defeated in order to access rooms prioritized after the Boss Room with this item.
** ⟨24⟩ The exception to this is ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ II, where simply entering the boss room will count the room as cleared. The hole to the ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ fight does not need to be entered. This allows the player to use this item to access rooms prioritized after the Boss Room without needing to fight Mother.
* ⟨24⟩ Using Teleport 2.0 in the Ascent sequence will teleport Isaac to the Angel/Devil Room if all other rooms have been explored. After returning from the Angel/Devil Room, using the Teleport 2.0 again will teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room. If it's instead used without exploring any rooms, Isaac will be teleported to the 'starting' room of the floor containing the beam of light up to the next floor.
** This strategy also works in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, taking Isaac to an Angel/Devil Room if all rooms have been explored. Isaac cannot use this to reach the hidden closet room containing Tainted characters, however. Using it after visiting the Angel/Devil Room will not teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room, and will instead merely teleport to the same Angel/Devil Room again.
* ⟨24⟩ Using Teleport 2.0 during the ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight will teleport Isaac to a random spot on the screen without interrupting the fight.
* ⟨24⟩ In the Mirrored World, Isaac will teleport to the Ultra Secret Room before the I AM ERROR room. Although it's empty like any other special room inside the Mirror, this can be useful to find the room in the normal world with ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧.
** If used again in the Mirrored World, Isaac will teleport to the Red Room which leads Isaac back to the main floor; if used once again, Isaac will teleport to the I AM ERROR room of the normal, non-mirrored floor.
* ⟨24⟩ After killing ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ in ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II, Teleport 2.0 will teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room with hole leading to ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧, even if there are unexplored rooms on the floor.
* After exhausting all possible rooms, using the item will not teleport Isaac anymore.

items.description: Isaac leaves a trail of black powder on the floor. Walking in a circle will spawn a pentagram symbol on the floor, which deals 10 damage per tick to any enemies inside it. ⟨16⟩ Grants larger explosions and fireplaces will explode when extinguished.
items.effects:
* Isaac constantly leaves a trail of black powder on the floor. Drawing a circle with it spawns a pentagram symbol on the floor, which deals 10 damage per tick to enemies within it.
** ⟨7⟩ This does not affect flying enemies.
* ⟨16⟩ Grants larger explosions and deal 185 damage instead of 100 similar to ⟦i:106¦Mr. Mega⟧.
** It doesn't stack with Mr. Mega itself though.
* ⟨16⟩ Destroying Fire Places causes them to explode.
** Explosions from destroyed fire places do not hurt Isaac.
items.notes:
* The trail of black powder left on the floor will quickly disappear, meaning that there is an effective limit to the size of the pentagram that can be created, though bigger pentagrams can be created if the player has higher movement speed.
* The traced pattern does not have to be perfectly circular; closed shapes such as squares or very narrow crescents will work.

items.description: Rewinds time, putting Isaac back in the previous room and undoing anything that happened in the current room. ⟨24⟩ Can only be used three times per floor, after which it functions like ⟦i:66¦The Hourglass⟧ until the next floor.
items.effects:
* On use, Isaac will be returned to the previous room and everything that happened in the current room will be undone.
** Health, bombs, coins, keys, cards / runes / pills, items, and trinkets, gained or lost, will be restored to their state before having entered the room.
** Time spent and score gained or lost within the room are reverted.
*** ⟨7⟩ About one second will be spent during the animation after use.
** Most permanent unlocks will be reverted (see below).
* ⟨24⟩ Can only be used 3 times on each floor, after which it functions like ⟦i:66¦The Hourglass⟧ until a new floor is entered.
items.notes:
* The Glowing Hourglass is very useful for finding out hidden information. For example:
** Every pill on the floor can be accumulated and used in the same room, the pills' effects can be noted and reverted if unwanted.
** Isaac can bomb walls with potential secret rooms, then go back in time if he fails to find one.
** If Isaac has , Glowing Hourglass can be used to pick up or purchase an unknown item to see what it is, then decide whether or not to undo picking it up.
** It can be even be used in extremely creative ways, such as using ⟦p:xxi-the-world¦XXI - The World⟧ and screenshotting the map, then going back in time to get the card back.
* Does not affect the chance for a Devil Room, Angel Room, or a portal to ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ to spawn (it will not spawn if it didn’t initially).
* If used in a Devil Room or Angel Room, the door to it has its normal chance to close.
** If used on the Boss Rush after the time limit expires, the door will not remain open when sent back to the boss room.
* If Isaac goes into a Devil / Angel room, sees undesirable items, activates the Glowing Hourglass, and the Devil / Angel door doesn't stay open, then the game will think that Isaac missed the Devil / Angel deal on the floor, and will thus increase the chance of getting one on the next floor.
** However, if it's the first Devil Deal, and the door doesn't stay open, then you'll still get an Angel deal on the next floor.
*** By combining these two bugged interactions, Isaac can get a Devil Deal on Basement 2, bomb himself to reduce your deal chance to 1%, then go into the Devil Deal, and use the Glowing Hourglass. You then have a 100% Angel Deal chance on Caves 1.
* Finding the Glowing Hourglass in a room and using it to undo picking up Glowing Hourglass will preserve its charges, allowing for infinite resets for that room.
** This effect can also be achieved by replacing the Glowing Hourglass with a different active item, exiting the room, then re-entering and using the Glowing Hourglass.
** ⟨7⟩ Doing this will remove the charges of the returned active item.
** ⟨7⟩ If there is a Lil' Battery in a Shop, the Glowing Hourglass can be used infinitely, by entering the Shop without a charge and using the Lil' Battery to recharge and exit the shop. This is useful for duplicating temporary familiars or filling up the Donation Machine, among other uses.
* The delayed effect of the I'm Excited pill will still occur after rewinding.
* ⟨7⟩ The Retro Vision Pill will continue to affect the game even after using the Glowing Hourglass.
* ⟨3⟩ Does not turn a character back into another should they have been revived by ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧, ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, or ⟦i:311¦Judas' Shadow⟧.
** ⟨28⟩ Character changes are reverted by Glowing Hourglass.
* ⟨7⟩ Does not return keys or health used to enter special rooms.
** If a bomb is used to enter a Secret Room, the Secret Room is entered, and the Glowing Hourglass is used, the Secret Room door will stay open and the bomb will not be refunded.
* ⟨7⟩ Does not return extra lives.
* ⟨7⟩ Using any teleportation card and then the Glowing Hourglass to return to the previous room does not refund the used card.
** ⟨24⟩ Teleport cards like ⟦p:joker¦Joker⟧ can be refunded. However, if used on the first room on the floor, the Glowing Hourglass will be uncharged when returning.
* ⟨24⟩ Using the Glowing Hourglass after entering a new floor will teleport Isaac back to the room in which the trapdoor was entered on the previous floor.
** Going back to the previous floor will transform Glowing Hourglass into ⟦i:66¦The Hourglass⟧ for the rest of that previous floor. Going back to the new floor recharges the Glowing Hourglass, which allows for infinite usage of Glowing Hourglass on the starting room of a new floor.
*** If the Glowing Hourglass is held in the secondary slot of ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧ when entering the room with the trapdoor, the Glowing Hourglass will not be transformed into The Hourglass after returning to the previous floor.
** After returning to the previous floor, most changes in the room with the trapdoor will be undone. However, enemies / bosses will not be revived.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧'s soul heart counter does not get reset upon activating this item.
* ⟨24⟩ If ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧ is hit by Esau, using the Glowing Hourglass will return him to normal form in the previous room.
* ⟨24⟩ The guaranteed angel room chance can be preserved if the item is used after entering the first devil room.
* ⟨24⟩ When Isaac enters ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight, Glowing Hourglass will transform into a fully charged ⟦i:66¦The Hourglass⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ May be helpful for finding Planetariums, as it lets the player effectively skip item rooms while also seeing if what's inside them is worth taking.
* ⟨24⟩ If Isaac enters a Planetarium for the first time and then uses Glowing Hourglass to leave, the chance of a Planetarium generating on future floors can be preserved, effectively allowing Isaac to reroll his Planetarium until a desired item is found. The likelihood of this being useful is rather low, however, due to Planetariums being rather rare.
* ⟨24⟩ The Boss Challenge Room re-rolls bosses on using the Glowing Hourglass.
* ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧ is still able to drop if the Glowing Hourglass is used to reset damage, and will be brought back by the Glowing Hourglass if used to reset a damage taken while holding it.
* ⟨24⟩ If used in the starting room of ⟦s:basement¦Basement⟧ I without having entered any other rooms, Isaac is taken to the first room of ⟦s:home¦Home⟧. If used again in this room without having entered any other rooms, the room will be rewound to when it was first entered. In a normal game, this is only possible by getting the item as a starting item from ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧, or from ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧. Having ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧ and obtaining ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧ and resetting the run also makes this possible.
** ⟨16⟩ Doing the same in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ will teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room.
* The Glowing Hourglass affects permanent unlocks, event counters, boss kills, etc. differently depending on what is being reset:
** Completion marks earned in the room will be removed.
** ⟨3⟩ Donations to the Donation Machine or Greed Donation Machine are not reverted, and they can be reset into a working state once jammed.
*** ⟨28⟩ Event counters will get restored (including Donation Machines, Greed Donation Machines, and ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧).
*** Other counters not tied to the specific run, such as Slot Machines or Tinted Rocks destroyed, continue to accumulate, allowing easy unlocking of secrets such as the ⟦t:52¦Counterfeit Penny⟧, the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, and ⟦e:conquest¦Conquest⟧ if one has have access to infinite uses of the Glowing Hourglass (see the Synergies section).
** Does not remove collection page entries if it undoes collecting an item for the first time.
** No Damage Achievements are still available if the Glowing Hourglass is used to reset damage.
*** If a hit is taken, then reversed, Samson can still be unlocked.
** ⟨7⟩ Can be used to unlock multiple achievements tied to the killing of certain bosses such as ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ / ⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧.
** ⟨7⟩ Using the Glowing Hourglass right after beating ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ / ⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧ / ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧ allows additional Eden tokens to be obtained.

items.description: Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo that occasionally deals Isaac's tear damage to enemies inside it, and can convert enemy shots into friendly homing tears.
items.effects:
* Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo.
** Once per second, the halo deals Isaac's Damage to all enemies currently inside it.
** Each enemy shot has a 30% chance to be reflected by the halo.
*** The chance is predetermined, and not affected by how long it is exposed by the halo.
*** The reflectable tears are reflected once they touch the middle line of the halo, and is converted into friendly purple homing tears that have Isaac's Damage and no other tear modifiers.
*** ⟨24⟩ Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. Shady) do not create the projectiles once reflected.
*** Can reflect:
**** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle), which do not explode once reflected.
**** ⟨24⟩ Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), which do not create lines of fire once reflected.
**** Fire projectiles (e.g. from ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧).
**** ⟨24⟩ Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti.
*** Does not reflect:
**** Lasers or beams.
**** ⟨24⟩ Lines of fire from fireballs.
**** ⟨24⟩ Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.

items.description: Spawns a Grab Bag on pickup. Coins, Bombs, Keys, cards, runes and batteries have a chance to become Grab Bags.
items.effects:
* Coins have a 10% chance to be replaced with Grab Bags. Bombs, Keys, Cards, Runes, and Lil' Batteries have a 20% chance.
** This includes pickups spawned by most sources: room rewards, chests, slot machines, special shopkeepers, ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ waves, etc.
** ⟨24⟩ Coins bombed out of a Donation Machine can become sacks.
** The exception to this are pickups spawned by Isaac himself directly, e.g. with the likes of ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ or ⟦i:204¦Fanny Pack⟧, and contents of other sacks.
* Spawns a sack upon pickup.
items.notes:
* The item does not replace hearts, pills and chests.
* The item can also replace Troll Bombs and Mega Troll Bombs that are not used as attacks, i.e. generated as room rewards, chest contents and such.
* The pickup replacement is applied retroactively when the item is collected: any appropriate pickup already existing on the current level may be replaced by a sack.
* ⟨3⟩ Sacks on each floor tend to have the same contents, which can be taken advantage of if cards are involved.
* ⟨24⟩ Picking up a Golden Penny may spawn a sack instead of another Golden Penny.
* ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧ in the Ascent can be replaced by a sack, thus it is not recommended to take the item if you're going to unlock a tainted character.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: A cone of light shines in the direction Isaac is moving that slows enemies and enemy shots.
items.effects:
* A cone of light shines from Isaac's chest that slows all enemies and enemy shots.
** The light will face the direction Isaac is moving.
** The light doesn't affect bosses, but it will slow their shots.
** The slow effect will disappear from enemies when the light stops shining on them, but shots will remain slow.
* Removes for the current floor.
** Doesn't provide immunity on later floors, but lessens the visual effect significantly, effectively removing the curse.
items.notes:
* The light only needs to touch a shot once to slow it permanently.
** Doing a quick circular motion is effective to slow surrounding enemy shots, especially while fighting ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧.
** Overuse of this effect can cause unavoidable patterns, as the slowed shots will often still travel most of their original distance.
* ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧'s light will always face right.
* ⟨24⟩ This item is not recommended against ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, as the fires spawned by her will be slowed down significantly and pile up quickly, leading to no room to dodge.
* ⟨24⟩ Doesn't remove Curse of Darkness afflicted by ⟦p:xix-the-sun-reversed¦XIX - The Sun?⟧, no matter if Night Light was picked up before or after using the card. However, the visual effect is still lessened by the beam of light.

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a delay and deals 30 contact damage per second to enemies.

** ⟨24⟩ The fly follows Isaac on a 0.66 second delay instead.
items.notes: * If other familiars that move with a similar pattern such as ⟦i:431¦Multidimensional Baby⟧ have been collected before the Obsessed Fan, it will follow them instead with further delay.

** ⟨24⟩ The remote detonation can be used while the item is uncharged.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ The Movable TNT has a unique cubic appearance, but it functionally identical to a regular Movable TNT.
