items.description: Isaac's tears become coins. Hitting an enemy has a 5% chance to drop a Penny.
items.effects:
* Isaac's tears become coins. Hitting an enemy with tears has a 5% chance to drop a Penny at the point of impact.
** The chance is not affected by Luck.
items.notes:
* Head of the Keeper has a 1% chance to drop from destroying normal Shopkeepers.
* ⟨24⟩ The only way of finding Head of the Keeper is from Shopkeepers, using ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ on ⟦i:430¦Papa Fly⟧, as a starting item with ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧, or by using ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧.
* Does not produce coins other than Pennies.
* Hitting the front side of enemies such as the Knight will still produce Pennies, even though the enemy does not take damage. This can be exploited to produce an infinite amount of Pennies from a single enemy. This however doesn't work with lowered Hosts.
** Enemies that spawn other enemies, Globins, or enemies that regain health can also be farmed for infinite money.
* ⟨7⟩ Head of the Keeper does not work with ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ but will work with ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧.
* When used against ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧, the coins are spawned directly in front of him and will heal him very often.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 3 second delay, firing tears at nearby enemies.
items.effects:
* Spawns a blue fly familiar that will follow Isaac's movement with a 1-second delay and fires tears at nearby enemies.
** ⟨24⟩ Papa fly follows Isaac on a 0.66 second delay instead.
* Papa Fly's tears deal Isaac's damage, and are fired once per second.
items.notes: * Since Papa Fly's damage scales off of Isaac's own damage, any item that provides a massive damage increase (such as ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ or ⟦i:169¦Polyphemus⟧) will prove benefitial.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that will follow Isaac's movements on a 2.5-second delay. Tears that pass through the baby will be doubled and increase in speed.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac's path with a 2-second delay.
** ⟨24⟩ The delay is 0.66 seconds instead.
* When a friendly tear passes through Multidimensional Baby, the tear splits into two parallel tears that gain a 1.33x shot speed boost, ⟨7⟩ x1.5 range /⟨24⟩ x1.5 tear height (which also increases effective range), and also a visual black and white flashing effect.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* It is possible to crash the game when combining this item with rapid-fire or multi-shot laser tears.
* Duplicated tears will deal the same damage as Isaac's tears.
* If other familiars that move with a similar pattern such as ⟦i:468¦Shade⟧ have been collected before the Baby, it will follow them instead with further delay.
* Standing perfectly still with the Multidimensional Baby inside of Isaac will activate its effect, as the tears will pass through it as they spawn.
** This does not work with attacks such as Brimstone, as it is fired in front of Isaac.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs have a chance to drop random pickups or charm enemies when they explode.
items.effects:
* Grants 5 Bombs.
* Isaac's bombs have a 25% chance to spawn a pickup or trinket when they explode including other bombs.
** ⟨24⟩ Isaac's bombs have a 63% chance to spawn a pickup or trinket when they explode, but the chance for either to generate decreases by 1% for each spawn until Isaac enters a new floor. This is to prevent items such as ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧ or a Golden Bomb from providing unlimited resources. This means that the maximum spawns per floor is 63, although the final generation of a pickup or trinket will have a 1% chance to occur.
* Isaac's bombs have a 15% chance to charm random enemies in the room when they explode.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Picking up a Golden Bomb, ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧, ⟦i:168¦Epic Fetus⟧, or ⟦i:378¦No. 2⟧ with Glitter Bombs allows infinite pickup generation.
** ⟨7⟩ In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, Glitter Bombs cannot generate coins. Infinite pickup generation that isn't coins is still possible, however, so this can be worked around if Isaac has the ⟦t:1¦Swallowed Penny⟧ or ⟦i:227¦Piggy Bank⟧, since it does still produce health.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Inflicts fear on all enemies in the room upon taking damage and spawns black friendly Chargers that attack enemies.
⟨24⟩Spawns a shadow familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It spawns a black friendly Charger whenever an enemy touches it.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Upon taking damage, inflicts fear on all enemies in the room.
* ⟨7⟩ Upon taking damage, spawns a dark friendly ⟦i:433¦Charger⟧ which deal 5 damage per hit to enemies.
* ⟨24⟩ Spawns a shadow familiar that mimics Isaac's movements on a very brief delay. It spawns a friendly ⟦i:433¦Charger⟧ whenever an enemy comes into contact with it.
** The Chargers deal 8.7 damage per hit to enemies, have 20 health, and only last for the current room. Isaac can have up to 16 Chargers at once.
items.notes:
* ⟨2⟩ If this item is triggered in the ⟦s:flooded-caves¦Flooded Caves⟧, there is a chance that the black charger will be replaced by a Drowned Charger. The summoned Drowned Charger will behave like normal black chargers, and upon death will explode into 4 blood shots that do not damage the player.
* ⟨7⟩ Shadows of incoming attacks from above will be harder to see, as they're covered by the item's shadow initially.
* ⟨7⟩ This item can only spawn a maximum of 5 chargers.
* ⟨24⟩ My Shadow's hitbox is slightly larger than Isaac's, which spawns a Charger before an enemy hits him if Isaac is standing still.
* ⟨16⟩ My Shadow's hitbox depends on the size of the character.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Killing an enemy adds a fly to the jar, up to a maximum of 20. On use, releases Blue Flies equal to the number of flies in the jar.
items.effects:
* Killing an enemy adds a fly to the jar, up to a maximum of 20.
* Upon use, releases Blue Flies equal to the number of flies in the jar.
items.notes:
* Kills by blue flies and locusts (including flies from the jar) and certain familiars do not add flies to the jar.
* Friendly enemies such as from the ⟦i:382¦Friendly Ball⟧ add flies to the jar, but not those spawned from other enemies.
* Batteries do not affect the number of flies in the jar.
* Enemies must be actually killed to add a fly; transformations (such as Gapers turning into Pacers) or knockouts (such as incapacitating a Globin) do not count as kills.
* Destroying a Shopkeeper will count as a kill.
* With items that kill normally unkillable enemies, killing things like Stone Grimaces will add flies to the jar.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a Loki familiar that follows Isaac and fires 4 tears in a cross pattern.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that looks like ⟦e:loki¦Loki⟧ and follows Isaac, firing tears in all four cardinal directions that deal 3.5 damage.
** ⟨7⟩ Lil Loki shoots once per second.
** ⟨24⟩ Lil Loki shoots once every 3/4ths of a second.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:lokii¦Lokii⟧.
* If an enemy is standing inside of Lil Loki, all four shots will hit it for a total of 14 damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Loki having ⟨15⟩ 5th / ⟨16⟩ 7th priority.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨15⟩ Spawns a glass familiar that follows Isaac. After Isaac takes damage, the milk spills, and he gains -2 tear delay (⟨24⟩ +1.0 fire rate) until leaving the room
⟨16⟩ Spawns a glass familiar that follows Isaac. The milk will block projectiles, and upon blocking 10, the milk spills, giving Isaac +1.0 fire rate for the rest of the floor.
items.effects:
* Spawns a glass familiar that follows Isaac.
** ⟨15⟩ The milk spills on the floor upon taking damage. After which, Isaac gains -2 tear delay (⟨24⟩ +1.0 fire rate) until leaving the room. The familiar will reappear in the next room.
** ⟨16⟩ The milk will block projectiles and take damage up to 10 times, after which the familiar shatters granting Isaac +1.0 fire rate for the rest of the floor. The familiar will reappear upon entering a new floor.
*** The familiar can also take damage from contact with enemies, fire places, enemy lasers and all explosions, although they are not blocked or pushed back.
** Direct tear delay reduction can break the normal soft fire rate cap.
items.notes:
* The milk puddle is purely visual, and will stay on the ground for a few seconds before disappearing.
* ⟨8⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Milk! having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
** ⟨16⟩ Milk! has the third-highest priority; just behind ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Restarts the current room and respawns all monsters, allowing more rewards to be acquired by completing the room.
items.effects: * Upon use, it restarts the room and respawns all monsters. Normal room clear awards are generated.
items.notes:
* No effect in:
** Rooms with no naturally placed enemies. This includes "trap rooms" with Poky-type enemies, though deactivated pokies will spawn in their original location.
*** Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms.
*** ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ main arena room.
*** Enemies spawned by pressing buttons, destroying Shopkeepers, obstacles or ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel statues⟧ do not count as naturally placed.
** ⟨24⟩ Boss Rooms.
** The ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ fight.
** ⟨24⟩ The ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ fight.
** ⟨24⟩ ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight.
* ⟨7⟩ Teleports Isaac in the starting room if used in Boss Rooms, Angel Rooms or Devil Rooms.
* ⟨7⟩ Converts Secret Rooms and Shops that had a ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧ or ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧ fight into regular Secret Rooms and Shops.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧ can be fought again in the Devil Room, like other Mini-bosses.
* ⟨7⟩ Respawned Mini-Bosses will always have the same drop.
* When used in a room with a Champion enemy, the enemy will not respawn as a Champion.
* Enemies respawn exactly where they first spawned, even if that's where Isaac is standing, in which case Isaac will take damage immediately upon use of the D7. Right next to doors is usually a safe place to use it.
* ⟨24⟩ If used in the Mirrored World of ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ or ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II, the rooms will not only have their enemies respawn, but all the normal non-mirrored contents such as pickups are restored. Using it in the Shop causes it to be stocked normally, and additional uses will restock the Shop's contents, unlike normal Shops. Using it in the mirrored treasure room that does not have the knife piece in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ XL / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ XL will spawn an item. Using it in the mirrored Curse Room has a chance to spawn an item from its pool.
* ⟨24⟩ In ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ or ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧, the D7 cannot regenerate minecarts. Any monsters that were riding a minecart on room entry will respawn on foot.
* ⟨24⟩ As ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, enemies respawned by the D7 will drop the same type of coins as they had before using the D7. This can be used to quickly generate money from enemies that dropped high-value coins or greatly increase Luck if an enemy dropped a Lucky Penny.
* ⟨24⟩ Enemies respawned by the D7 don't drop loot when killed if they were champions and don't grant score in daily runs.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants one Soul Heart, +0.75 tears and decreases Isaac's size.
items.effects:
* Grants one Soul Heart.
* +0.75 tears.
* Decreases Isaac's size.
* Increases the pitch of Isaac's voice.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Increases luck by 1 and doubles the effects of trinkets while held. When used, drops a random trinket on the ground.
items.effects:
* Increases luck by 1 and doubles the effects of certain trinkets while held. When used, drops a random trinket on the ground.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Most trinkets ⟦i:439¦are not affected⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ Of the 188 trinkets in Repentance, only 72 have a doubled effect.
* ⟨16⟩ All trinkets have some added effect, either simply a doubled effect or a specifically enhanced one.
* ⟨24⟩ This effect stacks additively with ⟦a:617¦Golden Trinket⟧s; holding one with Mom's Box will cause applicable trinkets to have triple the regular effect.
* Holding a second Mom's Box by using ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧ only increases luck, the effects of trinkets are not affected further.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac is occasionally forced to stop firing and charge an attack that launches a massive piercing, spectral kidney stone and a barrage of tears. ⟨7⟩ -0.2 speed, decreases range.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ -0.2 speed and maximum speed.
* ⟨3⟩ -15 range.
* ⟨4⟩ -17 range.
* ⟨7⟩ +2.0 tear falling speed.
** ⟨3⟩ The increased tear falling speed and decreased range results in slightly increased firing distance.
** ⟨4⟩ The increased tear falling speed and decreased range results in nearly identical firing distance.
* Occasionally, Isaac will become unable to fire tears. He must charge an attack, indicated by his head turning red, that launches a piercing, spectral kidney stone when released, followed by a rapid, inaccurate spray of tears.
** This effect occurs approximately every 25 seconds.
** ⟨7⟩ The kidney stone does 5x Isaac's damage and has approximately twice the range of normal tears.
** ⟨24⟩ The kidney stone does 10x Isaac's damage and has approximately twice the range of normal tears.
** The barrage grants a decaying 6x fire rate multiplier that can exceed the normal cap and forces Isaac to fire for the duration.
** The barrage will continue for its full length between rooms, as will the state of charging the attack.
items.notes:
* Tints tears red. This is only a cosmetic change.
* The kidney stone can still be fired by blindfolded characters, but not the tear barrage. This includes ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac fires a giant blood laser for approximately 15 seconds. This laser deals massive damage, pushes Isaac backwards, and persists between rooms and floors.
items.effects:
* Upon use, Isaac fires a giant, incredibly powerful ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser from his mouth, similar to the one used by ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧, for 15 seconds.
** The laser deals Isaac's current damage multiplied by 5 per tick.
** The laser has enough power to push Isaac backward while being fired and will last between rooms, and across multiple floors.
** The laser is not locked to the cardinal directions; it can be aimed freely.
** While Mega Blast is being fired, Isaac cannot:
*** Open Chests.
*** Pick up a Lil' Battery, collectibles, pills, trinkets, or cards or runes.
*** Pick up the trophy or enter the chest that spawns after defeating a final boss.
*** Sleep in a bed.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ Picking up a Lil' Battery with this item will add 3 to its charge, meaning that 4 batteries are required to fully recharge the item.
** ⟨4⟩ A Charged Key will only add 3 charges.
*** Lil' Battery and Charged Key add 6 charges instead of 3.
** ⟨24⟩ Picking up a Mega Battery will fully charge it twice.
* Using a 48 Hour Energy pill with this item will fully charge it.
* Mega Blast has an 80% decreased item pool weight, making it less likely to appear than other collectibles.
* ⟨24⟩ It is not recommended to use Mega Blast in fight with ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, because its laser forces you into obstacles on the level.
** This can be mitigated to a degree with ⟦i:722¦Anima Sola⟧, especially with a ⟦i:356¦Car Battery⟧ which doubles the Anima Sola's length. The Beast won't be able to spawn obstacles while chained.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ When at exactly one Red Heart, +0.75 tears, +1.5 range, and +0.2 shot speed.
⟨24⟩ When at exactly one Red Heart, +2 fire rate, +1.5 range, and +0.2 shot speed.
items.effects:
* When at exactly 1 Red Heart, some of Isaac's stats are increased.
** ⟨7⟩ +0.75 tears.
** ⟨24⟩ +2.0 fire rate. The bonus can break the soft tears cap.
** +1.5 range.
** ⟨7⟩ +1 tear falling speed.
** +0.2 shot speed.
* The effect is lost any time Isaac gains or loses Red Hearts.
** The crown will glow red while active; if inactive, it will appear black.
items.notes:
* Full Bone Heart containers are counted towards the maximum.
* Rotten Hearts count as Red Hearts.
* This item pairs well with ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧, since she starts with ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧, and is the only character that can gain Whore of Babylon's effect at 1 heart.
* This item does not affect ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧, ⟨24⟩⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Soul⟧, or ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ since they cannot gain Red Hearts.
* This item only affects ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ when he has only one Coin Heart.
* This item only affects ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ when he has one full Bone Heart.
* The effect does not stack with multiple Dark Prince's Crowns.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.3 tears. Adds a chance to fire a razor blade that deals 4× Isaac's damage.
items.effects:
* Adds a chance to fire razor blades that deal quadruple Isaac's tear damage.
* +0.3 tears.
items.notes:
* The chance to fire a razor blade depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 15 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 6.66%, maxing out at 100% at 14 luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: After every 15 tears fired, Isaac will fire a high-damage cluster of tears.
items.effects:
* After every 15 tears fired, Isaac will fire a low range burst of 12 tears at once, in a similar fashion to ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧.
** Tears in the barrage inherit the majority of Isaac's tear effects.
** ⟨7⟩ Tears in the barrage deal double damage.
* Tears will fire only from Isaac's right eye.
* ⟨24⟩ Fired tears have a 50% chance to be colored red.
items.notes:
* Lead Pencil gives characters other than ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧ the same special properties that he has when it comes to one-eye items like ⟦i:254¦Blood Clot⟧.
* ⟨7⟩ Tears fired from items that cause multiple tears to be fired at once e.g. ⟦i:245¦20/20⟧, ⟦i:153¦Mutant Spider⟧, etc. are counted.
** ⟨24⟩ Each tear fired from ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧ still count towards triggering the barrage, but only if Isaac does not have any tear modifying items, such as ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.3 damage, +0.1 speed. Plays a howl or bark sound when entering a room with undiscovered Secret Rooms or Crawl Spaces.
items.effects:
* +0.3 damage.
* +0.1 speed.
** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).
* When entering a room connected to an undiscovered Secret Room or Super Secret Room, a howl sound effect will play.
* A barking sound will play if there is an undiscovered Crawl Space in the room.
items.notes:
* A sound won't play in the first room of a new floor until you re-enter the room.
* An extra Crawl Space added by ⟦t:74¦Stud Finder⟧ will not trigger the sound.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: While firing, Isaac gains a green aura that poisons nearby enemies.
items.effects:
* While firing, creates an aura around Isaac that poisons any nearby enemies for 2 ticks.
** The poison may stack up to 6 ticks at a time.
** The aura range is approximately two tiles.
* Poison damage is equal to Isaac's damage stat.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ This item can be spawned by ⟦e:bumbino¦Bumbino⟧ if he picks up 12 cents.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Constantly shooting causes Isaac to release gas clouds that can be pushed by his tears and damage nearby enemies. ⟨16⟩ The cloud will gradually increase in size, while the damage it does gradually decreases.
items.effects:
* Firing without a pause for ⟨15⟩ 7.5 seconds / ⟨16⟩ 4 seconds creates a small brown cloud that damages enemies who walk through it.
** ⟨15⟩ The damage is equal to Isaac's base tear damage, dealt roughly 5 times per second.
*** The clouds last for 15 seconds, meaning a maximum of two can be active at any given time.
** ⟨16⟩ The damage starts equal to Isaac's tear damage, dealt roughly 5 times per second. The damage will gradually decrease, while the cloud gradually increases in area size.
*** Each cloud lasts for 10 seconds; the damage decreases to around 43% for the duration of the cloud.
** The clouds can be moved by shooting them.
** Changing firing direction is allowed, but any pause in holding a fire button or taking damage resets the timer.
items.notes: * ⟨16⟩ The visual size of the cloud is not accurate, as the actual hitbox is much bigger than how it appears.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Upon taking damage, Isaac has a chance to drop a full red heart, gain 5 range, and leave a trail of damaging red creep for the current room.
⟨24⟩ Taking damage causes Isaac to bleed, spraying a volley of blood in the direction he fires. Bleeding will eventually damage him, but it can be stopped by picking up a Red Heart.
items.effects:
Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:
* 25% chance to drop a full Red Heart.
* ⟨7⟩ 10% chance to gain the ⟦i:214¦Anemic⟧ effect (+5 range, red creep trail) for the current room upon taking damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Causes Isaac to bleed, spewing blood tears around him constantly.
** The sprayed tears vary in damage, roughly in range of 67% to 101% of Isaac's base damage.
** Holding a direction of fire focuses the bleeding tears to that direction, with slightly increased range.
*** The bleeding tears can be aimed at any direction just like having ⟦i:465¦Analog Stick⟧.
** After bleeding for 20 seconds, Isaac's Red Hearts or Rotten Hearts will take damage (bypassing other Hearts); this is indicated by Isaac slowly turning red after and eventually blinking. This damage also has a 25% chance to drop a full Red Heart. The damaging effect will continue to occur every 20 seconds until the bleeding effect ends.
*** The damage amount is always half a Red Heart, a Coin Heart, or a Rotten Heart, even in later chapters where most damage is now a full Heart or two Rotten Hearts.
** The bleeding effect ends when Isaac receives any form of Red Heart or Rotten Heart healing, if he has no more Red or Rotten Hearts, if he fills an Eternal Heart, or if the next hit would kill him.
** If Isaac has no Red or Rotten Hearts, the bleeding effect of Shard of Glass will not activate.
items.notes:
* Red Hearts spawned by this item may become different hearts in certain Super Secret Rooms.
* ⟨24⟩ Regarding the bleeding effect:
** Taking bleed damage does not affect Devil Room or Angel Room chances.
** Bleeding blood tears will not keep any tear effects or special tears that Isaac has.
** The bleeding effect persists between floor transitions.
** If Shard of Glass is re-rolled or lost while Isaac is bleeding, the bleeding will continue, but Red Hearts will no longer spawn when Isaac takes damage.
** ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ can end the bleeding by switching to ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧.
** The bleeding effect works with ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ ⟨24⟩(and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧). They will bleed and lose a coin heart until only one coin is left. Receiving coins will stop the bleeding effect. Due to Tainted Keeper only having two coin hearts in most circumstances, bleeding will rarely apply to him.
** Rotten Hearts will take bleeding damage only when Isaac has no red hearts remaining. Picking up Rotten Hearts will also end the bleeding.
** Using a bed or a Full Health pill to heal Isaac's red hearts will not stop the bleeding.
** Turning into The Lost via the White Fire Place or ⟦p:soul-of-the-lost¦Soul of the Lost⟧ will stop bleeding effect.
** Using the ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧ will stop the bleeding effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants one Soul Heart. Enemy shots have a chance to be reflected at the shooter as confusing tears.
items.effects:
* Grants one Soul Heart.
* Enemy shots that hit Isaac have a 25% chance to be reflected.
** Isaac does not take damage from the reflected tears, but gets pushed a bit.
** The reflected tears are homing and concussive, and use Isaac's Damage and Tear effects.
*** Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. Shady) can harm Isaac and be reflected.
** Can reflect:
*** ⟨24⟩ Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), but their lines of fire harm Isaac.
*** Fire projectiles (e.g. from ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧).
*** ⟨24⟩ Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti.
** Does not reflect:
*** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle).
*** Lasers or beams.
*** ⟨24⟩Lines of fire from fireballs.
*** ⟨24⟩ Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Every 20 tears, Isaac loses 1 Penny and shoots an additional gold tear that petrifies enemies and turns them into gold. Any enemy killed while in this state will drop coins.
items.effects:
* Adds a golden tear every 20 tears fired, which causes enemies to turn gold and petrifies them for a few seconds (similar to ⟦i:202¦Midas' Touch⟧) at the cost of one Penny. Golden tears can still be fired if Isaac has no money.
** Unlike other tear effects, golden tears are fired alongside regular tears rather than replacing a regular tear.
** With multi-shot abilities, whichever tear is the 20th since previous will produce the additional golden tear.
** ⟨7⟩ The golden tear does 2x normal damage.
** ⟨24⟩ If Isaac has no money, the golden tear does normal tear damage. If Isaac does have money, the golden tear deals 1.5x normal damage +10.
** ⟨7⟩ Enemies killed while golden will drop 1-4 coins.
** ⟨24⟩ Enemies killed while golden will drop 1-3 coins.
** ⟨24⟩ If Isaac has money, golden tears that hit enemies will drop a Penny, effectively returning the cost.
items.notes:
* Tears fired from items that cause multiple tears to be fired at once, e.g. ⟦i:245¦20/20⟧, ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧, etc., are counted separately.
** The gold tear is not duplicated by said items.
* ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ has separate tear counters for The Forgotten and Soul.
* ⟨24⟩ Using this item is an easy way of unlocking ⟦i:555¦Golden Razor⟧ after obtaining 99 coins, since it drains them by just shooting and with enough patience it will reduce their count to 0.
* ⟨24⟩Hitting Armored⟦e:tuff-twins¦Tuff Twins⟧ or ⟦e:the-shell¦The Shell⟧ will turn them into gold, and all armored segments will drop 1-3 coins.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Drops a random tarot card. ⟨7⟩ Doubles the effects of most cards and runes. ⟨24⟩ Doubles the effects of tarot cards.
items.effects:
* Drops a random tarot card on pickup.
* ⟨7⟩ Adds an extra effect to a card, rune, or other card-like pickup.
** ⟨24⟩ Adds an extra effect to certain tarot cards.
Items not listed do not benefit from Tarot Cloth.
* ⟨24⟩⟦p:i-the-magician¦I - The Magician⟧: Gives ⟦i:34¦The Book of Belial⟧ effect on top of homing.
* ⟨24⟩⟦p:ii-the-high-priestess¦II - The High Priestess⟧: Another foot strikes down shortly after the first.
* ⟦p:iii-the-empress¦III - The Empress⟧: Doubles the speed increase and quadruples the damage increase.
* ⟨24⟩⟦p:iv-the-emperor¦IV - The Emperor⟧: If the boss has not yet been defeated, grants a Soul Heart on top of teleporting Isaac.
* ⟦p:v-the-hierophant¦V - The Hierophant⟧: Spawns ⟨7⟩four or ⟨24⟩three Soul Hearts.
* ⟦p:vi-the-lovers¦VI - The Lovers⟧: Spawns ⟨7⟩four or ⟨24⟩three Red Hearts.
* ⟦p:vii-the-chariot¦VII - The Chariot⟧: Doubles the duration of the invulnerability.
* ⟦p:viii-justice¦VIII - Justice⟧: Spawns twice as many pickups.
* ⟨24⟩⟦p:ix-the-hermit¦IX - The Hermit⟧: Prevents ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧/⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧ from spawning in the shop. If the shop was already entered and Greed/Super Greed was fought, using the card turns it into a normal shop. (Does not create a working shop in the Mirrored World.)
* ⟦p:x-wheel-of-fortune¦X - Wheel of Fortune⟧: Spawns two Slot Machines.
* ⟦p:xi-strength¦XI - Strength⟧: Doubles the stat increases, but the damage multiplier applies only once.
* ⟦p:xiii-death¦XIII - Death⟧: Deals 80 damage to all enemies in the room.
* ⟦p:xiv-temperance¦XIV - Temperance⟧: Spawns two Blood Donation Machines.
* ⟨24⟩⟦p:xv-the-devil¦XV - The Devil⟧: Damage increase is doubled.
* ⟦p:xvi-the-tower¦XVI - The Tower⟧: Spawns 13 Troll Bombs.
* ⟨24⟩⟦p:xvii-the-stars¦XVII - The Stars⟧: If the treasure room was not entered before, it will have two items to choose from, as if ⟦i:414¦More Options⟧ was active. This will not work if the card teleports you to a Planetarium.
* ⟦p:xix-the-sun¦XIX - The Sun⟧: Deals ⟨7⟩200 damage or ⟨24⟩400 damage to all enemies in the room.
* ⟦p:xx-judgement¦XX - Judgement⟧: Spawns two Beggars.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:2-of-clubs¦2 of Clubs⟧: Quadruples Isaac's Bombs.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:2-of-diamonds¦2 of Diamonds⟧: Quadruples Isaac's Coins.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:2-of-spades¦2 of Spades⟧: Quadruples Isaac's Keys.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:2-of-hearts¦2 of Hearts⟧: Quadruples Isaac's Red Hearts.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:suicide-king¦Suicide King⟧: Spawns twice as many pickups/items/Chests.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:card¦? Card⟧: Activates the effect of Isaac's active item twice.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:ancient-recall¦Ancient Recall⟧: Spawns 6 cards.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:algiz¦Algiz⟧: Doubles the duration of the shield, making it last a full minute.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:berkano¦Berkano⟧: Spawns 6 Blue Flies and 6 Blue Spiders.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:dagaz¦Dagaz⟧: Removes any curses from the current floor and grants two Soul Hearts.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:jera¦Jera⟧: Quadruples all pickups and chests in the room.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:perthro¦Perthro⟧: Instantly re-rolls items twice, essentially removing an extra item from the item pool.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:blank-rune¦Blank Rune⟧: Activates two random rune effects. Attempts to spawn additional Blank Rune twice.
* ⟨7⟩⟦p:black-rune¦Black Rune⟧: Deals 80 damage to all enemies in the room. Other effects are unchanged.
* ⟦p:0-the-fool-reversed¦0 - The Fool?⟧: Drops Isaac's 6 most recently collected items on the floor, alongside pickups. Does not affect quest items (e.g. ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧) or ⟦i:258¦Missing No.⟧.
* ⟦p:iii-the-empress-reversed¦III - The Empress?⟧: Adds a total of three temporary heart containers.
* ⟦p:v-the-hierophant-reversed¦V - The Hierophant?⟧: Spawns 3 Bone Hearts.
* ⟦p:vi-the-lovers-reversed¦VI - The Lovers?⟧: Removes 2 heart containers or 4 Soul Hearts, adds 2 broken hearts and spawns 2 items.
* ⟦p:viii-justice-reversed¦VIII - Justice?⟧: Spawns 4-14 Locked Chests.
* ⟦p:ix-the-hermit-reversed¦IX - The Hermit?⟧: Spawns 1 additional Penny.
* ⟦p:x-wheel-of-fortune-reversed¦X - Wheel of Fortune?⟧: Invokes an additional Dice Room effect.
* ⟦p:xii-the-hanged-man-reversed¦XII - The Hanged Man?⟧: Doubles the effect's duration.
* ⟦p:xiv-temperance-reversed¦XIV - Temperance?⟧: Forces Isaac to eat 10 pills.
* ⟦p:xvi-the-tower-reversed¦XVI - The Tower?⟧: Spawns 14 rock clusters.
* ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧: Removes 2 items and spawns 4.
* ⟦p:xx-judgement-reversed¦XX - Judgement?⟧: Spawns two Shop Restock Machines.
items.notes:
* Tarot Cloth's effect also applies to card effects used through ⟦i:286¦Blank Card⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ Only certain cards gain the Tarot Cloth effect with Blank Card, which include: ⟦p:i-the-magician¦I - The Magician⟧, ⟦p:ii-the-high-priestess¦II - The High Priestess⟧, ⟦p:iii-the-empress¦III - The Empress⟧, ⟦p:iv-the-emperor¦IV - The Emperor⟧, ⟦p:v-the-hierophant¦V - The Hierophant⟧, ⟦p:vi-the-lovers¦VI - The Lovers⟧, ⟦p:vii-the-chariot¦VII - The Chariot⟧, ⟦p:viii-justice¦VIII - Justice⟧, ⟦p:ix-the-hermit¦IX - The Hermit⟧, ⟦p:xvii-the-stars¦XVII - The Stars⟧, ⟦p:xix-the-sun¦XIX - The Sun⟧, ⟦p:0-the-fool-reversed¦0 - The Fool?⟧, ⟦p:iii-the-empress-reversed¦III - The Empress?⟧, ⟦p:v-the-hierophant-reversed¦V - The Hierophant?⟧, ⟦p:vi-the-lovers-reversed¦VI - The Lovers?⟧, ⟦p:viii-justice-reversed¦VIII - Justice?⟧, and ⟦p:xiv-temperance-reversed¦XIV - Temperance?⟧
*** Three of these cards will have diminished Tarot Cloth effects:
**** ⟦p:xix-the-sun¦XIX - The Sun⟧: Only 200 damage is dealt.
**** ⟦p:0-the-fool-reversed¦0 - The Fool?⟧: Only 3 items drop instead of 6; this also applies with ⟦i:356¦Car Battery⟧.
**** ⟦p:viii-justice-reversed¦VIII - Justice?⟧: Only 2-7 chests spawn.
** As a result, using the Blank Card in conjunction with the ⟦i:356¦Car Battery⟧ will cause the effect of the active card to quadruple, instead of double.
*** ⟨24⟩ Only certain effects will be doubled again, which include: ⟦p:i-the-magician¦I - The Magician⟧ (only the damage up), ⟦p:iii-the-empress¦III - The Empress⟧, ⟦p:iv-the-emperor¦IV - The Emperor⟧ (only the soul hearts), ⟦p:v-the-hierophant¦V - The Hierophant⟧, ⟦p:vi-the-lovers¦VI - The Lovers⟧, ⟦p:vii-the-chariot¦VII - The Chariot⟧, ⟦p:viii-justice¦VIII - Justice⟧, ⟦p:v-the-hierophant-reversed¦V - The Hierophant?⟧, ⟦p:vi-the-lovers-reversed¦VI - The Lovers?⟧, and ⟦p:xiv-temperance-reversed¦XIV - Temperance?⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ The enhanced effect of The Fool? can't drop starting items in challenges on the ground.
* ⟨24⟩ With a ⟦p:ix-the-hermit¦IX - The Hermit⟧ card, it is usually best to walk into the shop first. If Greed is there, he can be fought for money, and then the card can be used to restock the shop.

items.description: Taking damage releases a ring of 10 high damage tears.
items.effects:
* When Isaac gets hit, 10 tears are fired in a circle around him (similar to ⟦i:38¦Tammy's Head⟧).
** Tears spawned on hit have a +25 damage bonus.
* When Isaac gets hit, has a chance to activate the ⟦i:214¦Anemic⟧ effect for 2 seconds.
** The effect doesn't seem affected by luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Increases Range. Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 bone shards upon hitting an enemy or obstacle.
items.effects:
* Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 shards upon hitting an obstacle or enemy, which each deal 50% of Isaac's Damage.
** Unlike ⟦i:104¦The Parasite⟧, there is no damage minimum on splitting, but the tears can also split only once.
** The shards have a fixed size, about the same as a 3.5 damage tear, regardless of their Damage.
* +1.5 Range.
* ⟨7⟩ +1.0 Tear Falling Speed.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ This item can be spawned by ⟦e:bumbino¦Bumbino⟧ if he picks up 12 cents.
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-pile¦The Pile⟧.
* Unlike ⟦i:104¦The Parasite⟧ and ⟦i:224¦Cricket's Body⟧, Compound Fracture is overriden by most tear replacing items instead of having a synergy, making the item less versatile than those.

items.description: Allows Isaac to carry two cards, pills, or any combination of both. Spawns one random card, rune, or pill.
items.effects:
* Allows Isaac to carry two cards, pills, or any combination of both.
* Spawns one random card, rune, or pill.

* ⟨24⟩ +2.5 range.

* Drops a Lucky Penny.

items.description: Grants a Soul Heart. Gives Isaac a chance to ignore any damage taken.
items.effects:
* Grants a Soul Heart.
* Any damage dealt to Isaac has a 20% chance to be ignored.
** This includes damage through tears, contact, explosions, Curse Room, Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, and Bad Trip pills.
*** Contact damage with enemies is difficult to avoid, as the damage negation does not provide invincibility frames.
** Isaac flashes briefly blue when damage is negated. The flash can occur even while invincible from taking a hit or using an invincibility effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Drops a random trinket. Grants a second trinket slot.
items.effects:
* Drops a random trinket.
* Grants a second trinket slot.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to fire a booger that sticks to enemies and deals damage over time.
items.effects:
* Adds a 20% chance to fire a booger tear that stick to the first enemy that they come in contact with and deals damage over time.
** Each booger deals damage equal to Isaac's tear damage every second.
** ⟨7⟩ The booger lasts for 60 seconds or until the enemy dies.
** ⟨24⟩ The booger lasts 10 seconds.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ This item can be spawned by ⟦e:bumbino¦Bumbino⟧ if he picks up 12 cents.
* The booger tear chance is not affected by Luck.
* Boogers tears cannot pierce through enemies.
* Multiple boogers can stick to one enemy to deal extra damage.
* Booger tears pass through fireplaces and bombs even without piercing shots.
* Boogers cannot inflict status effects, even if the booger's appearance changes.
* The booger falls off the enemy after they die. If it hits another enemy before it touches the ground, it will stick to them and deal damage.
* Sinus Infection is extremely effective against bosses. If each booger tear lasts for the full 10 seconds, this item effectively triples Isaac's DPS against bosses.
* Jumping enemies or bosses like ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧ and Leapers and burrowing enemies like Round Worms and Lumps can get rid of the booger when they leap or burrow.
** Bosses like The Harbingers or ⟦e:dark-one¦Dark One⟧, or enemies like Oob that have dash attacks do not lose the booger when they go off-screen.
* The tear-sticking effect is similar to ⟦i:401¦Explosivo⟧ and ⟦i:553¦Mucormycosis⟧'s.
* The ⟦t:98¦Nose Goblin⟧ trinket's effect is almost identical to Sinus Infection, with an added homing bonus but half the activation chance.
** When Isaac is holding both Nose Goblin and Sinus Infection each booger tear created by the item has a 50% chance to also have homing.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to shoot tears that confuse enemies for an extremely long time.
items.effects:
* Adds a 5% chance to shoot concussive tears, causing enemies to walk around randomly.
** The confusion caused by Glaucoma tears is effectively permanent for normal enemies, and a very long duration compared to most status effects for bosses.
* Makes the screen darker.
items.notes: * Not affected by Luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to fire an egg sack which creates slowing creep and spawns 1-2 Blue Flies or Blue Spiders upon hitting an enemy.
items.effects:
* Adds a chance to fire an egg sack which spawns slowing creep. If an egg sack hits an enemy, 1-2 Blue Flies or Blue Spiders are spawned.
* Egg sack tears have ⟨7⟩ x2 range/⟨24⟩ x2 tear height (which also increases effective range).
* ⟨24⟩
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* The chance to shoot egg sacs depends on the luck stat and is based on this formula: min(\frac1 { 7 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}, 50\%)
** At base luck (0), the chance is 14.29%, maxing out at 50% at 5 luck.
* Egg sacks will also spawn blue flies or spiders if they hit Fire Places or invincible enemies like Death's Head and Stoney.
* It is possible to create a large number of Spiders and Flies by repeatedly shooting a closed Host.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants piercing tears. After piercing one enemy, tears start homing and deal double damage.
items.effects:
* +1.5 range.
* ⟨7⟩ +1.0 tear falling speed.
* Grants piercing tears.
* After piercing one enemy, tears will gain double damage, homing, and a 1.3x size multiplier.
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩The piercing effect makes placed Bombs, Troll Bombs, and Mega Troll Bombs unable to be pushed around by Isaac's tears.
* Tears will also gain homing and double damage when they pierce bombs and entities the game considers enemies, like Stone Grimaces and Fire Places.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.3 damage. Adds a chance to fire acidic tears which can destroy obstacles and open doors.
items.effects:
* +0.3 damage.
* Adds a 25% chance to fire acidic tears that destroy obstacles and open doors (including Secret Room entrances) upon contact.
items.notes:
* Tears open only closed doors, not locked doors.
* The chance to fire an acid tear does not increase with luck.
* The acidic tears affect static objects like Bombs, but with some differences:
** They do not open Bomb Chests.
** ⟨7⟩ They cannot bridge gaps with obstacles.
*** ⟨24⟩ Gaps are now bridged.
** ⟨7⟩ Poop is not destroyed in one hit.
** ⟨24⟩ The mirror leading to the Mirrored World cannot be destroyed.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants 2 Soul Hearts and modifies drops from Champion monsters based on certain conditions. ⟨24⟩ Also modifies room clear drops.
items.effects:
* Grants 2 Soul Hearts.
* Modifies drops from Champion enemies depending on certain conditions.
* ⟨24⟩ Also modifies room clear drops.
* ⟨24⟩ Every room is guaranteed to drop a reward.
* The priorities of the drops, in order, are as follows:
** Soul Hearts: When Isaac has no Red Heart containers and less than 2 Soul Hearts.
** Red Hearts: While at 0.5 Red Hearts.
** Keys: When Isaac has no keys.
** Bombs: When Isaac has no bombs.
** Red Hearts: When Isaac has at least half a Red Heart container empty.
*** ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ will always get this drop until she reaches 12 "blood charges".
** Pennies: While Isaac has less than 15 pennies.
** Keys: When Isaac has less than 5 keys.
** Bombs: When Isaac has less than 5 bombs.
** Trinkets: If Isaac has no trinkets and there are no trinkets on the ground in the room.
** Soul Hearts: When Isaac has less than 6 total Heart containers of any kind.
*** ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧ will only get this drop until she reaches 12 "soul charges".
*** ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ changes blue heart drop to red heart drop until she reaches 12 "blood charges", thus she is unable to receive any blue hearts.
** If none of the above conditions are true, items dropped will be rolled as normal.
** ⟨24⟩ Chest drops override the Glyph of Balance.
items.notes:
* When the conditions for specific drop is met, you can intentionally not pick up the drop to guarantee that same drop (or a chest) every room.
* ⟨24⟩ Staying at low luck is recommended to take full advantage of Glyph of Balance, as higher luck will make chest drops more common and override the effect of the Glyph.
* The Glyph has no effect in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ or Greedier Mode aside from the Soul Hearts granted upon pickup; champions still never drop anything.
* ⟨7⟩ Because of how the item works in the priorities listed above, this item is not recommended for ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ (except in combination with ⟦i:413¦Immaculate Conception⟧) as he is always considered to be at half a Soul Heart, and all drops from champions are replaced with Soul Hearts.
** ⟨24⟩⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ ignore both rules for Soul Heart generation. This prevents the item from generating mostly useless Soul Hearts.
* When playing as ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, the priority of the drops is based on the active form's health: for example, if The Forgotten has half a red heart or less, but The Soul was active right before the pickup drop and it had more than 2 soul hearts, the Glyph will skip over the full red heart drops to the next condition. Also if The Forgotten is full on pickups and health, has a trinket but has less than 6 bone hearts, the Glyph will always drop soul hearts unless The Soul is active at the moment of the drop.
* ⟨24⟩ When playing as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, the priority of the drops is based on the health of the character that has the Glyph.
* ⟨24⟩ When playing as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, the room drop will be modified when the character switches to the character that has the item on room clear.
* ⟨24⟩ When playing as characters incapable of having red heart containers such as ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, the Glyph will skip soul heart and red heart generation.
* While empty room drops are replaced by Glyph of Balance drops, if you get a heart drop in Hard mode, there is a separate chance of it being replaced with an empty drop.
** It is still possible to get hearts if none of the other conditions are true.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.35 tears up. Allows Isaac to fire tears diagonally.
items.effects:
* +0.35 tears up.
* Allows tears to be fired diagonally.
** With a keyboard or using buttons to fire with a controller, tears can be shot at 45-degree angles by holding two buttons. This is known as eight-directional firing. For example, holding the up button and right button will shoot diagonally towards the upper right-hand corner.
** Using a controller with a physical analog stick, its input is accepted, allowing for tears to be shot in any direction, as it shoots wherever the analog stick is pointing without being limited to 45-degree angles.
items.notes: * Enables full directional firing for keyboard and mouse users with the accessibility option EnableMouseControl enabled.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: The first enemy killed in a room releases a gas cloud that poisons nearby enemies. Affected enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect.
items.effects:
* In each room, the first enemy killed will release a gas explosion and poison nearby enemies.
** Poisoned enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect.
*** Poisoned enemies do not need to die while the poison is still active to spread the effect.
** The initial gas explosion deals 5 damage, and the poison deals Isaac's tear damage per tick, for 6 ticks.
items.notes:
* The effect will also activate if a Shopkeeper is destroyed before killing any enemies.
** Re-entering a room and destroying another Shopkeeper inside it will trigger the effect for a second time.
* The gas explosion and poison can damage friendly enemies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a finger familiar that faces in the same direction as Isaac, rapidly damaging enemies it points at for 10% of Isaac's damage.
items.effects:
* Spawns a floating finger familiar that can be aimed with the fire buttons in all directions.
** The finger fires invisible spectral lasers, doing 10% of Isaac's Damage. The lasers fire 10 times per second and are not affected by Isaac's tear rate.
** The lasers have thickness based on Isaac's Damage, making it easier to inflict damage on higher Damage.
** While not being aimed with the fire buttons, the finger points in the direction of movement or downwards if standing still.
* ⟨7⟩ The Finger!'s lasers can apply Isaac's Tear effects, which makes status effects trigger very often.
items.notes:
* Finger! will fire in the exact direction it's pointed, meaning it can be fired diagonally, or at any angle, if using a controller - the same effect as ⟦i:465¦Analog Stick⟧.
* The beam can be used to destroy TNT (among other destructible obstacles).
* The Finger! does not do contact damage.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 1 second delay and deals contact damage to enemies. After dealing enough damage, it is absorbed by Isaac and spawns friendly ⟦i:433¦Charger⟧s.
items.effects:
* Grants a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a ⟨7⟩ 1-second/⟨24⟩ 0.66-second delay and deals ⟨7⟩ 2/⟨24⟩ 5 contact damage per tick, or ⟨7⟩ 30/⟨24⟩ 75 damage per second, to enemies.
* Shade is absorbed by Isaac after dealing ⟨7⟩ over 600 damage ⟨24⟩ over 666 damage.
** The familiar disappears and turns into friendly dark ⟦i:433¦Charger⟧s, identical to those spawned by ⟦i:433¦My Shadow⟧.
** Isaac will now do equal contact damage at the same rate as the Shade used to.
items.notes:
* If other familiars that move with a similar pattern such as ⟦i:431¦Multidimensional Baby⟧ have been collected before the Shade, it will follow them instead with further delay.

items.description: Spawns a familiar that leaves a trail of creep that damages enemies at 6 damage per second. Has a chance to spawn damaging beams of light onto enemies that touch the cloud.

* Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and leaves a trail of blue creep that damages enemies.
** The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.
* If the cloud touches an enemy, it has a 1% chance to spawn a damaging ⟦i:374¦Holy Light⟧ beam onto the enemy.
** The light beams deal 20 + Isaac's tear damage per tick and may strike an enemy up to 8 times.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-rainmaker¦The Rainmaker⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Depression having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

items.effects:
* Spawns a ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ familiar that floats and travels diagonally around the room, bouncing on walls, and deals contact damage to enemies. While firing tears, Hushy stops moving. In this state, it will:
** Block enemy projectiles.
** ⟨16⟩ Fire out rings of 8 blue projectiles that deal 6 damage each, once every 1.033 seconds.
* Hushy deals 2 contact damage per tick or 30 damage per second.
items.notes:
* Hushy can be pushed by explosions, both while stationary and during movement (in this case, the explosion may cause the familiar to change the direction it is moving in).
* ⟨16⟩ Although Hushy can float over obstacles, its projectiles are not spectral, meaning its shots will be blocked if it's positioned directly over a rock.

** It fires between 12 and 14 tears that do 3.5 damage each.
*** It can do a minimum of 3.5 damage to 49 damage, depending on how many shots are fired and how many hit.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Monstro having ⟨15⟩ 3rd / ⟨16⟩ 5th priority.

* While firing tears, King Baby stops moving and glows white.
* When Isaac stops firing tears, King Baby moves rapidly back towards Isaac.
* While King Baby is stationary, other familiars remain stationary as well. ⟨24⟩ This affects every familiar that has priority in how closely it follows behind Isaac.
** ⟨7⟩ Shooting familiars will fire tears in the direction Isaac is firing, while Throwable familiars ignore King Baby.
** ⟨24⟩ Shooting familiars fire at nearby enemies automatically and throwable familiars launch themselves at nearby enemies automatically.
*** Familiars that have charged attacks will operate on similar rules to ⟦i:394¦Marked⟧: they will immediately fire at full charge, and variable-charged attacks will be released earlier the closer that King Baby is to the target.
* ⟨24⟩

* ⟦i:519¦Lil Delirium⟧'s behavior depends on which familiar form it takes.

items.notes:

* Big Chubby takes 6 seconds to travel the other end of normal-sized rooms.

* Big Chubby will continue to travel forward between rooms.

items.notes:
* ⟨15⟩ ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ can start with this item.
* Charging this item does not count as using it. Items and trinkets that activate on active item use (such as ⟦t:4¦Broken Remote⟧) do not activate when charging this item.
* If the player manages to obtain a usable fully charged Broken Glass Cannon, it will turn into Glass Cannon on use. This use counts as a use for items and trinkets that activate on active item use.
** Clearing a room with this fully charged Broken Glass Cannon will also turn it into Glass Cannon. This does not count as a use.

items.description: Kills all enemies in the room, then kills Isaac three seconds later.
items.effects:
* Upon use, deals 9,999,999 damage to every enemy in the room, then kills Isaac 3 seconds later.
* ⟨16⟩ Kills Isaac 10 seconds later in ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧'s room and 11.5 seconds later in ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧'s room.
items.notes:
* Plan C does not kill both or all phases of bosses like ⟦e:the-lamb¦The Lamb⟧, ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧, ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧, ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧, ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧, and ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧.
* Some bosses have special interactions with this item:
** ⟨15⟩ Attempting to use this item to kill ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ or ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ will not work. Their death animation is much longer than the time between using Plan C and Isaac's Last Will appearing, meaning Isaac will die first and it will not count as a kill. Having extra lives that revive Isaac outside the room will not help, either; they must be fought again.
*** However, items that revive Isaac in the same room he died in, namely ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧ (or being ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧), ⟦i:688¦Inner Child⟧, ⟦p:soul-of-lazarus¦Soul of Lazarus⟧, and ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧'s ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧, will allow Isaac to bypass this and kill them with this item. In the case of Lazarus' Rags, though, the completion mark will go toward Lazarus and not the character originally selected.
**** Similarly, if playing as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, using Plan C and then using ⟦i:711¦Flip⟧ to switch to the other form pauses the death counter until the player switches back to the form that originally used the item.
*** It is possible to kill Delirium by carefully timing pauses after each screen static. Each screen static plays a cutscene that continues to play even while paused, so by pausing and unpausing at the right timings, Delirium's death animation can be shortened to just under 3 seconds allowing for his completion mark to be awarded.
*** Using the effect of Plan C while Isaac is already under the timer of Plan C (such as through the use of another Plan C, ⟦p:card¦? Card⟧, ⟦p:wild-card¦Wild Card⟧, etc.) will reset the timer each use, allowing to stall bosses with long death animations.
** ⟨24⟩ Killing ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧'s second phase with Plan C will kill Isaac just at the end of her death animation. No completion mark is awarded.
*** However, if Isaac is revived outside the boss room, the boss will be considered dead and the mark will be awarded. This does not work for ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ (when playing as The Soul), and ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ since ghost characters have a slightly shorter death animation.
** Killing ⟦e:ultra-greedier¦Ultra Greedier⟧ with Plan C will give a completion mark, with the exception of ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ (when playing as The Soul), and ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧. This is because ghost characters have a slightly shorter death animation, resulting in Isaac's Last Will appearing more quickly.
** ⟨24⟩ If used in ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ battle, Plan C will only kill the harbinger that Isaac is fighting on screen. It won't have any effect on the other harbingers nor The Beast itself (The Beast can still be killed if Isaac is fighting it when Plan C is used, and there is enough time to earn the completion mark).
* It is recommended not to use this item in Challenges, as even if the goal is within the bosses that dies before Isaac does, the player will likely die before the end of the rising trophy animation.
* For the game's sake, a run is not truly over until Isaac's Last Will appears. This means that some bosses that might seem to finish their death animations after Isaac dies, such as Ultra Greed, will still be technically killed and will still give their completion marks, even if Isaac does not enter the Final Boss Chest.
* Invulnerable enemies and closed Hosts will not be killed by Plan C.
* Isaac's last will shows his last damage source as the cause of death, not Plan C. If Isaac has not taken damage or lost health from any source, Isaac's face is shown.
* Invincibility or the ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ shield will not save Isaac from being killed.
* Some items that activate when Isaac reaches zero hearts, such as ⟦i:694¦Heartbreak⟧ and ⟦i:674¦Spirit Shackles⟧, will not activate, killing Isaac.
* Even if Isaac enters a trapdoor immediately after using Plan C, he will still die after arriving at the next floor.
** Isaac will also die after accepting a Victory Lap or performing a RERUN.
* Plan C has an 80% decreased item pool weight, making it less likely to appear than other collectibles.
** ⟨24⟩ It has a 90% decreased weight in the Red Chest pool, and normal weight in the Ultra Secret Room pool.
* ⟨7⟩ Plan C is found in 6 item pools, the second highest count amongst all items, behind ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧. Its lowered weight, however, offsets its presence.
** ⟨24⟩ Plan C is found in 8 item pools, the highest count amongst all items. Its lowered weight, however, offsets its presence.

items.description: Duplicates a random pickup in the room. ⟨24⟩ The new pickup may be different than the original (i.e. a different card, etc).
items.effects:
* Upon use, duplicates one random pickup in the current room, including Cards, Runes, Chests, and trinkets.
* ⟨24⟩ Duplicated pickups may not be identical to the original; for example, a duplicated card may be a different one than the original.
items.notes:
* It is possible to duplicate Shop pickups that have not been purchased yet.
* ⟨7⟩ ⟦p:jera¦Jera⟧ can not be duplicated.
* ⟨7⟩ Mimic Chests will not be duplicated until their spikes are exposed.
* ⟨7⟩ Opened chests will be duplicated into an unopened copy.
* ⟨7⟩ A normal Chest may be duplicated into a Red Chest or a Mimic Chest.
* ⟨7⟩ A duplicated trinket is mostly useless, as you cannot pick up two of the same trinket even with ⟦i:139¦Mom's Purse⟧, ⟦i:458¦Belly Button⟧, or ⟦i:479¦Smelter⟧.
** However, with "consumable" trinkets such as ⟦t:13¦Store Credit⟧ or ⟦t:105¦Bag Lunch⟧, it can be extremely powerful.
* ⟨7⟩ In combination with a 48 Hour Energy pill and ⟦t:19¦Paper Clip⟧, the initial Locked Chests on ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ can be infinitely duplicated and opened.
* ⟨7⟩ In Greed mode, if a Lil' Battery appears in the Shop and a ⟦p:2-of-diamonds¦2 of Diamonds⟧ is acquired, infinite money can be gained by duplicating the Two of Diamonds.
* ⟨7⟩ By dropping a card, rune, or pill in a room with no other pickups, then using D1, this item can function similarly to ⟦i:286¦Blank Card⟧ and ⟦i:348¦Placebo⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ By dropping a card, pill, or trinket in a room with no other pickups, then using D1, this item can function similarly to ⟦i:85¦Deck of Cards⟧, ⟦i:102¦Mom's Bottle of Pills⟧, or ⟦i:439¦Mom's Box⟧ (But without the luck up or doubled trinket effects).
* ⟨24⟩ A duplicated card has a very rare chance to turn into a ⟦p:dice-shard¦Dice Shard⟧, ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧, or ⟦p:emergency-contact¦Emergency Contact⟧; however, these will always duplicate as themselves instead of duplicating as a card.
* ⟨24⟩ A duplicated Golden Pill will turn into a random Pill chosen from the Pill Pool.
* When duplicating any type of chest, the contents of the original chest will be invisibly rerolled.

items.description: Consumes all pedestal items in the room. Activated items will have their effects added to Void, and passive items will grant random stat upgrades.
items.effects:
* Upon use, destroys all pedestal items in the room. Items that require payment cannot be absorbed unless they are bought first.
** If Void destroys an activated item, it gains the activated ability of that item; whenever Void is used, it will simultaneously use all previous active items that were absorbed in the same order they were absorbed. Passive effects of absorbed active items will not apply (e.g., the passive effect of ⟦i:439¦Mom's Box⟧). The active item effects happen after the initial destruction of current pedestal items, and in the order that the active items were absorbed.
** If Void destroys a passive item, Isaac gains 2 random stat boosts. Possible stat changes include:
*** +1 flat Damage
*** ⟨7⟩ +0.5 Tears
*** ⟨24⟩ +0.5 Fire Rate
*** +0.2 Speed
**** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0)
*** +0.2 Shot Speed
*** +1 Luck
*** ⟨7⟩ +0.5 Range
*** ⟨24⟩ +2.5 Range
items.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ If speed or tears are at their maximum and are chosen, there will be no visible increase.
* ⟨24⟩ If speed is at its maximum and is chosen, there will be no visible increase.
* ⟨24⟩ Void can exceed the normal maximum tears limit.
* Using Void to absorb items in Boss Rush or Challenge Rooms counts as taking the items and will cause waves of bosses or enemies to start spawning.
* ⟨7⟩ The ability of the newly absorbed active item(s) will activate even if the item has no charge. Using any multiple-use item before absorbing it with Void will effectively allow Isaac to use the item twice.
* ⟨24⟩ If Void is used while Isaac is holding an item above his head, it can still consume the item, allowing to immediately absorb passive items bought from Devil Rooms, Black Markets, or Shops. This also can be used to give Isaac a chance to see what an unknown item is before deciding if he wants to consume it, in the case of an active or a Treasure Room in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧, etc.
** This mechanic can be used to absorb familiars granted by ⟦p:soul-of-lilith¦Soul of Lilith⟧.
** Active items can also be absorbed this way if Isaac has ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧ and is not carrying a second active item.
* ⟨24⟩ The newly absorbed active item(s) won't be used right away, but with the next usage of Void.
* ⟨24⟩ If Isaac absorbs items from a room with choice pedestals, it will only absorb one item, and the other item vanishes as if Isaac took it.
* If Isaac finds another Void, such as during a Victory Lap where it is left behind in the previous lap, it will have the same active effects stored in it as the other Void.
** Consuming a second Void will create no effect.
* If multiple copies of an active item are absorbed, using Void will activate that effect equally many times.
* Stat boosts upon destroying passive items are determined by the seed and are tied to the number of items destroyed, not the items themselves. If Isaac runs the same seed and chooses to consume different passive items, the same stat boosts will be gained.
** ⟨24⟩ Void's random number generation is advanced once after each usage, so using Void will change what stat boosts are gained.
* Stat boosts are permanent and are retained if Void is dropped (except when the player's build is rerolled, e.g. with ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ or ⟦i:283¦D100⟧).
* Using Void to absorb ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ will not permanently remove them from the run. They will continue to spawn after defeating ⟦e:uriel¦Uriel⟧ or ⟦e:gabriel¦Gabriel⟧ no matter how many times Isaac uses Void on them, as long as he does not pick them up normally.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Freezes all enemies until a fire button is pressed.
items.effects:
* Stops all enemies including bosses until a fire button is pressed.
** This does not affect troll bombs.
** Touching frozen enemies will still damage Isaac.
** Co-op babies can fire without ending the effect.
** Stops Red Fire Places/Purple Fire Places from shooting projectiles.
** Bosses will resume their actions after 30 seconds have passed, while non-boss enemies (except Lil' Haunt) are still paused.
*** ⟨24⟩ All enemies resume actions after 30 seconds
items.notes:
* New enemies generated during Pause being active will not be frozen and act normally. This applies for spawn-upon-death effects such as Attack Flies created by a Moter, or a Boss that stopped becoming frozen and began summoning enemies.
* Damage against paused multi-segmented bosses works unpredictably, most notably allowing you to damage ⟦e:scolex¦Scolex⟧ on normally invulnerable parts.
** The health bars of multi-segmented bosses may not be updated properly, making it seem as if they died without running out of health.
* Reducing a boss to zero health whilst they are paused will initiate their death animation but they will not die until a fire button is pressed or the 30 second timer has lapsed.
* ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s Soul will be able to extend far past the normal limits of the chain when activated while ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧ is out.
* ⟨24⟩ Pausing in the room before entering the minecart in the ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ causes the minecart to freeze, trapping the player inside of it until they exit to the main menu.
* Using ⟦i:705¦Dark Arts⟧ will not stop the effect.
* Pausing in Boss Rush just as bosses spawn will cause the bosses to not deal contact damage to Isaac for the full duration. This allows for contact damage items, such as ⟦i:30¦Mom's Heels⟧, to be extremely viable in completing Boss Rush.
* If you freeze Haunted Chest at a time when Polty has not yet picked it up, the chest will be impossible to open in any way until Polty unfreezes or dies. If you try to push Haunted Chest away from Polty, the ghost will appear immediately at the current chest after unfreezing.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Consumes Isaac's currently held trinket and applies its effects permanently.
items.effects:
* Upon use, any trinkets that Isaac is holding are destroyed, and their effects are permanently applied to him.
** ⟨24⟩ Trinkets that are absorbed show up on the HUD's item tracker.
* Increases the chance for a trinket to drop after clearing a room. (Has a 2% chance to turn the pickup variant into a trinket.)
items.notes:
* While held, ⟦i:439¦Mom's Box⟧ will double the effect of all absorbed trinkets (if their effects can be doubled).
* Absorbing the ⟦t:53¦Tick⟧ will allow Isaac to pick up other trinkets again.
* Trinkets whose effects only activate once, such as ⟦t:13¦Store Credit⟧, ⟦t:23¦Missing Poster⟧, and ⟦t:108¦Walnut⟧, will still only activate once after being absorbed.
* ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧ is still removed if Isaac takes damage from regular sources.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦t:69¦Faded Polaroid⟧ cannot be used to open ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧ if smelted.
* It is possible to find previously smelted trinkets during a Victory Lap, or if the trinket Item Pool is exhausted.
* ⟨7⟩ Picking up a copy of a trinket which was already absorbed will not duplicate that trinket's effect.
* ⟨7⟩ The trinket will not be absorbed if Smelter is activated during the pickup animation.

items.description: Doubles Isaac's Blue Flies and Blue Spiders, or spawns one if Isaac has none. Converts pickups in the current room into Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.
items.effects:
* Upon use, converts pickups within the current room to Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.
* Doubles Isaac's current amount of Blue Flies and Spiders.
** If Isaac has no Blue Flies or Spiders, spawns one Blue Fly or Spider.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ The item will cost 10 cents if found in a Shop
* Does not work on Troll Bombs or Mega Troll Bombs.
* One character using it does not seem to double the spiders/flies for other characters. It only seems to double the ones following the character using the item.
* ⟨24⟩ Locusts will not be doubled by Compost.

items.description: Displaces enemy sprites for the current room and randomly increases one of Isaac's stats while decreasing another. ⟨16⟩ Turns all items in the room into glitched items with random effects.
items.effects:
* Upon use, rotates every enemy and pickup 90 degrees and moves its sprite up and left for the current room.
** Enemy hitboxes remain the same.
* Increases one of Isaac's stats and decreases another. Possible stat changes include:
** ± 1 flat damage
** ±0.5 tears
** ±0.2 speed
*** ⟨7⟩ Also affects maximum speed, if some other item has reduced it below 2.0 (but still cannot increase it above the hard cap of 2.0)
** ±0.2 shot speed
** ±1 luck
** ±0.5 range
* Adds random tear effects for the current room.
* Distorts the music for the current room.
* ⟨16⟩ Rerolls any item in the room to a glitched ⟦i:721¦TMTRAINER⟧ item.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ If the tears stat reaches a negative number, there will be a wrap-around into the maximum fire rate of 120; if the tears stat is boosted back into a positive number, fire rate will again become low.
** If Rock Bottom is obtained while the tears stat is negative, fire rate will stay at 120 even if boosts are obtained.
* The minimum values for each stat are as follows:
** Damage: 0.5
** Speed: 0.1
** Shot Speed: 0.6
** Range: 1.0
* Further changes to Isaac's stats are still calculated normally behind the scenes, but their effective values cannot go below the minimum. For example, 0.5 Shot Speed will behave as though it were 0.6, but a 0.2 Shot Speed increase would apply to the true stat value of 0.5, meaning the new stat value would be 0.7.
* ⟨24⟩ Using Dataminer during the fight against ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ is not recommended, as it will distort the stalagmites and stalactites, causing them to be incredibly difficult to dodge.

items.description: Transforms Isaac into another random character and has ⟨15⟩ 100% / ⟨24⟩ 50% chance to remove the last item collected.
items.effects:
* Upon use, transforms Isaac into a random character and ⟨15⟩ removes the last item collected (not including Clicker) or gulped trinket.
** ⟨16⟩ Now has a 50% chance to remove the last item collected or gulped trinket.
** All stat changes of the new character are applied.
* ⟨24⟩ Non-tainted characters can only transform into other non-tainted characters, and tainted characters can only transform into other tainted characters.
items.notes:
* Clicker can only transform Isaac into characters that have already been unlocked, along with ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧ and ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus Risen⟧, who are counted as separate from ⟦c:judas¦Judas⟧ and ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧ respectively. ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ and ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧, ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧, ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Soul⟧ are all counted as inherently linked dual-characters.
* ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧, ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, ⟦t:23¦Missing Poster⟧, or ⟦i:311¦Judas' Shadow⟧ can allow a tainted character to become ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, or ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧ (besides their respective tainted forms) allowing the Clicker to transform them into other non-tainted characters. There is no way for a non-tainted character to become a tainted character.
* ⟨7⟩ It is possible for the Clicker to choose the same character as the one that is already being played as, making it seem like the item created no effect at all.
* Transforming into a new character does not grant Isaac the starting items of the new character unless they are inherent to the character. For example, transforming into ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧ does not grant ⟦i:46¦Lucky Foot⟧.
* Changing characters can adversely affect health.
** All Red Heart containers will be lost, and all Bone Heart containers will be emptied when changing into ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, or ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧. They will gain a Half Soul Heart if they would otherwise have no health.
** All health will be lost when changing into ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧. Changing from The Lost to any other character will leave them with a Half Soul Heart.
** ⟨7⟩ ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ will always start with 2 Coin Heart containers. Bone and Half Soul/Black Hearts will be rounded up to 1 or 2 filled coins. Red Hearts are not rounded, which allows him to have half Coin Hearts. Changing from Keeper to any other character will turn his Coin Hearts into Red Hearts.
*** ⟨24⟩ All Red Heart containers are converted to Coin Heart containers when transforming into Keeper, with a minimum of 2 and up to a maximum of 3. Only red hearts will determine if the coin heart containers are filled or not, and Soul/Black hearts will be converted into blue flies. One coin heart container will be filled if he would otherwise have no health. Changing from Keeper to any other character will turn his Coin Hearts into Red Hearts.
** Changing into ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ will not affect ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧'s health. Red Hearts are converted into Bone Hearts. Soul/Black Hearts will be lost. He will gain an empty Bone Heart if he would otherwise have no health.
** ⟨24⟩ All soul hearts will be converted to soul charges when changing into ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧. She will gain one full Red Heart container if she would otherwise have no health. Changing from Bethany to any other character will convert her soul charges into soul hearts.
** ⟨24⟩ Heart Containers will be divided evenly and split up when changing into ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧. Changing from Jacob and Esau to any other character will leave them with Jacob and Esau's combined health.
* Activating Clicker typically only consumes passive items, but with ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧, it can consume the item in the other activated item slot if that item was the most recently collected.
* Similarly to items such as ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧, ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, or ⟦i:311¦Judas' Shadow⟧ any completion marks obtained will correspond with the character the Clicker turns you into.
** ⟦c:tainted-cain¦Tainted Cain⟧ can craft the Clicker and other useful items and then use Clicker to change characters. In this way, runs started as Tainted Cain can be useful to complete other characters' completion marks, even when Tainted Cain's own completion marks are finished. Although Clicker will only turn tainted characters into other tainted characters, Tainted Cain can also craft ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧, ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, or ⟦i:311¦Judas' Shadow⟧ and die to become a non-tainted character then use the Clicker to change into other non-tainted characters.
* ⟨7⟩ Removed items still count towards transformations.
* Changing into ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧ will not use tokens. Additionally, both Eden's base stats will be the same as Isaac's if he wasn't the character selected at the start of the run.
* Changing from ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧ will leave the Luck stat decimal. If the character the Clicker turns you into has base luck stat different from 0, Luck will change by a whole number (e. g. turning into ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ will decrease your base luck by 2 instead of setting it to -2.00).
* Changing into ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ will randomly distribute items between the two. Changing from Jacob and Esau to any other character will leave them with Jacob and Esau's combined items. Changing into Jacob and Esau will drop the currently held consumables like pills, cards etc. on the floor, but will keep trinkets. Esau's consumables and trinkets will always be dropped on the ground when changing to a different character. Jacob's consumables and trinkets will be transferred to the new character.
* Changing into ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ will remove every passive item except the 8 oldest items Isaac holds.
* Changing into ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ will give every passive item to only one of the forms.
** Changing into ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧ will remove the auto-swap affect.
** Changing from ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ into another character will only keep the items of the form that used Clicker.
* ⟨7⟩ If ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧ was the last item to be picked up, Clicker will remove individual lives instead of the entire item.
* ⟨7⟩ If ⟦i:10¦Halo of Flies⟧ was the last item to be picked up, Clicker will only remove one fly at a time (including Pretty Flies obtained from pills and Slot Machines) instead of the entire item.
* In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, changing character using Clicker will update the Jam Chance of the Greed Donation Machine to the corresponding character chosen by Clicker.
** This can be useful for maxing out the coin counter of the machine, and obtaining unlocks while using a single character (like ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ or ⟦c:judas¦Judas⟧) to make the process easier and faster, and only changing characters at the end of the run.
