items.description: Deals immense damage to all enemies, opens all bombable doors, and destroys all obstacles in the room. The effect occurs every time a new room is entered for the rest of the floor.
items.effects:
* Upon use, destroys all obstacles in the current room and deals 200 damage to every enemy (including bosses). This effect also applies to every room for the remainder of the floor.
** ⟨24⟩ Also destroys all Machines, Beggars, Shopkeepers, and Fire Places.
** ⟨24⟩ Also destroys all obstacles in rooms that have already been cleared.
** ⟨24⟩ Will destroy Donation Machines as well, reducing donated coin count and removing them for the rest of the run.
* Opens all Secret Room and Super Secret Room doors on the current floor.
* Mama Mega! opens the paths to Boss Rush and the ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ even after the time limits expire.
items.notes:
* While Mama Mega! opens the paths to Boss Rush and the ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ after the time limits expire, there are still some things to be aware of:
** The Boss does not need to be defeated before entering these doors.
** It will also open the Boss Rush / ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ entrance room door if it is activated after ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ or ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ / ⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧ has already been defeated.
** Leaving the Boss Room (via teleport or entering a Devil Room/Angel Room) will close the doors.
** Leaving the Boss Rush room or ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ entrance room will also close the doors.
** Does not open the Boss Rush door from the inside.
** ⟨24⟩ Does not open a path to ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ if used in the room on the other side of the flesh door in ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II.
* Entering a room with an angel statue while the effect is active automatically initiates a fight with an ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧.
* Does not kill enemies that are immune to damage while entering the room, such as Lil' Haunts.
* If used before the ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧ fight begins, it will deal no damage to Ultra Greed, as he is invulnerable for the first few seconds upon first entering his room. However, it will still break obstacles as usual.
* When used in Greed mode, it will only activate once for the main room (as opposed to once per wave, in a similar fashion to a standard run). Therefore, its damage potential is maximized if used after all the monster waves have spawned for the current floor.
* Does not open the door to ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ in ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ or ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧, nor does it open ⟨24⟩the flesh door at the end of ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II.
* ⟨24⟩ If used in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II, the entrance to the Mirrored World will be destroyed, making it inaccessible.
** If used in the Mirrored World, it will destroy the exit, which, on top of making it impossible to leave, will then cause Isaac to take damage and die.
* ⟨24⟩ Only works on a single floor of the Ascent.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with eight Giga Bombs, or six Bombs and two Golden Bombs.

items.quote: I can't believe it's not butter bean!
items.description: Isaac farts, sending out a circular rock wave that destroys obstacles and hurts enemies.
items.effects:
* Upon use, Isaac farts, knocking back enemies and their shots. It also sends out a circular rock wave around him that deal 10 damage per tick to nearby enemies and break obstacles.
* ⟨24⟩ Shots deflected by Wait What? farts deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
items.notes:
* This item is identical to ⟦i:294¦Butter Bean⟧ in appearance.
* ⟨7⟩ ⟦i:294¦Butter Bean⟧ has a 10% chance to turn into this item upon pickup.
* ⟨24⟩ Each run has a 5% chance of replacing Butter Bean with Wait What? in item pools. Both items generally do not exist during the same run.
* One way for both items to exist in the same run is via ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧ or ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧. Since both items are identical in appearance, you can differentiate them by looking at the items that are next to them, ⟦i:294¦Butter Bean⟧ will be between ⟦i:293¦Head of Krampus⟧ and ⟦i:295¦Magic Fingers⟧ while ⟦i:484¦Wait What?⟧ will be between ⟦i:483¦Mama Mega!⟧ and ⟦i:485¦Crooked Penny⟧.
* This item is useful for opening Secret Rooms, Super Secret Rooms, Bedrooms and the path to ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧. In Bedrooms, it can also open up the passage under the carpet.
** To break open a secret room, the wall must be hit with one of the rock waves, not the gas cloud, so Isaac needs to stand a few steps away from the wall.
* The earthquake can open Bomb Chests.
* The earthquake can destroy Shopkeepers.
* ⟨7⟩ The earthquake can be used to blow up the Donation Machine or activate/blow up a Shop Restock Machine.

items.description: Has a 50% chance to double all items, chests, trinkets, and pickups in the room. If the effect fails, spawns a Penny and the other items and pickups disappear.
items.effects:
* Upon use, has a 50% chance to double all items, pickups, trinkets, and Chest in the current room.
** If the effect fails, the items, pickups, and chests disappear, and a Penny is spawned.
items.notes:
* If used in a Shop or Devil Room, the duplicated items and pickups can be taken for free.
* If the effect fails in a shop that contains a Shop Restock Machine, then the Restock Machine can be used to refresh the Shop, bringing back new items and pickups.
* ⟨7⟩ If used in the Boss Rush room, it can duplicate the items, and all of them can be taken without affecting the originals. Successfully duplicating the items will trigger Boss Rush, and failing to duplicate them will not.
* ⟨7⟩ If used on ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ and ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ after defeating ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, it can duplicate them, and they can both be taken without affecting the originals.
* The 50% chance is predetermined after each use of Crooked Penny. By force quitting or using ⟦i:422¦Glowing Hourglass⟧ after each failure, this can be exploited to generate large numbers of copies of useful items — if the penny is going to fail, then use it in a different room, recharge it, and try again.
** ⟨24⟩ The outcome of Crooked Penny is determined on a per-room basis, meaning that it will succeed in certain rooms and fail in others respecting the 50/50 chance. Using Crooked Penny will still advance an RNG step, however, and re-roll the outcome of the other rooms.
* If used in Boss Rush and the items disappear, the boss rush cannot be started.
* If Crooked Penny is used right after taking an item from a choice pedestal (such as those created by ⟦i:414¦More Options⟧), it is possible to double the other item(s) as they disappear. The copies of items will not disappear and will act normally.
* Unlike ⟦i:347¦Diplopia⟧, Crooked Penny can be used to duplicate trinkets.

items.description: Hurts Isaac without depleting health, activating any items that trigger upon taking damage.
items.effects: * Hurts Isaac without taking away health, giving him invincibility frames equal to a full heart damage and activating any items that trigger upon getting hit.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ The item will cost 10 cents if found in a Shop.
* As using the Dull Razor will grant extra invincibility frames like normal damage, this item can be used to enter Curse Room for free, or, with proper timing, allow Isaac to avoid taking damage from an enemy or obstacle.
* ⟨7⟩ The invincibility frames allow Isaac to use Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars for free.
* ⟨24⟩ Dull Razor ignores shields granted by ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧, and similar items.

items.description: Removes a Heart Container, increases Damage and Range, and grants a ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧. ⟨16⟩ If Isaac has a ⟦i:207¦Ball of Bandages⟧, it will instead give additional copies of that.
items.effects:
* On use:
** Removes one Red Heart Container.
** Increases damage by a flat +0.2.
** Grants one ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧.
*** ⟨24⟩ The Cube of Meat is not added as a real item in Isaac's inventory.
** ⟨16⟩ If Isaac has ⟦i:207¦Ball of Bandages⟧, Potato Peeler will give additional copies of that instead.
** Grants an active ⟦i:214¦Anemic⟧ effect for the current room.
** ⟨24⟩ Counts as self-damage for the purposes of damage-triggered items.
items.notes:
* It is possible for Isaac to kill himself by removing his final heart container.
* It is possible to generate multiple Meat Boys.
* Cubes of Meat given by this item do not remove any Cubes of Meat from ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ item pools.
* ⟨24⟩ The Cube of Meat gained through this item will persist in the escape sequence of ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ II.
* This item cannot normally be used on Soul Hearts, Black Hearts, Bone Hearts, or Eternal Hearts.
** Thus, this item does not work with ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧. Using it will not hurt them, nor produce any Cubes of Meat.
* ⟨15⟩ If Isaac has ⟦i:207¦Ball of Bandages⟧, Cubes of Meat will be added regardless.
** Harbingers will preferentially drop Cubes of Meat if Isaac has both types of orbitals.
* ⟨24⟩ In Repentance Co-Op the Cube of Meat gained through this item will persist when a player dies allowing them to have a powerful damage output while in ghost form.

items.description: Grants a random item effect for the current room.
items.effects: * Grants a random item's effect for the current room.
items.notes:
* This item can trigger self-damage effects, making it not recommended for ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧.
* Using this item multiple times in the same room will replace the previous item with a new one.
* Metronome cannot grant the effects of itself, ⟦i:422¦Glowing Hourglass⟧ or ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ Also unable to grant ⟦i:326¦Breath of Life⟧, ⟦i:482¦Clicker⟧, or ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧.
** ⟨16⟩ Also unable to grant ⟦i:640¦Urn of Souls⟧.
* Metronome can grant items that haven't been unlocked yet.

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Has the effect of a random die item that changes each use.
⟨24⟩ Replicates the effect of a selected die item (except Spindown Dice), and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Upon use, grants a random die item that transforms into a different random die item.
** Each die item has a 2 room charge.
** D infinity is able to use all the available effects, regardless of whether the individual die mimicked by this item has been unlocked prior or not.
* ⟨24⟩ Upon use, acts as any die item except for ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧, and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.
** The charge time when picked up is 4, but changes to that of the last used die. Cycling does not change the charge time.
** The table below shows charges and effects.
items.notes:
* The icon of the D infinity will change to resemble the corresponding die while being held. Putting it back on a pedestal will change its icon back to normal.
* ⟨24⟩ When in possession of more than one active item with the ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧, all dice must be cycled through before the other active item can be used.
** When playing as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ and holding D infinity as well as another active item via ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧, if ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧ is replaced by another passive item in its slot while the other active item is held, ⟦i:489¦D infinity⟧ will be dropped on the ground, reset to its original state. This could allow the player to use any dice item with only a 2-pip charge.
* ⟨24⟩ This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with eight ⟦p:dice-shard¦Dice Shard⟧.

items.description: Spawns two random items from the current room's Item Pool and then disappears. Starts with no charges.
items.effects: * Upon use, spawns two random item pedestals using the item pool of the current room. Eden's Soul is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory.
items.notes:
* Starts with no charges when first picked up.
* ⟨7⟩ Unlike ⟦i:441¦Mega Blast⟧, this item can be charged with a single Lil' Battery.

items.description: Spawns a familiar that drops a random pill every ⟨7⟩ 3 / ⟨24⟩ 7 rooms. Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room are poisoned.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that drops random pills.
** Acid Baby drops a pill every 3 cleared rooms. The first drop happens after 2 rooms.
* Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room will be poisoned for 2 ticks. ⟨24⟩ Enemies also take 10 additional damage.
items.notes: * ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Acid Baby having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

items.description: +1 luck. Spawns a fairy familiar that points out Secret Rooms, Crawl Space entrances, and tinted rocks.
items.effects:
* +1 luck.
* Spawns a familiar that sporadically moves around the room.
* Upon entering a room with a Secret Room/Super Secret Room entrance, tinted rock, or a rock with a Crawl Space underneath, it will fly towards it.
** If there are multiple secrets, then it will fly from one to the other.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* The familiar will sometimes hover over a pit or a Poop, indicating that an unreachable crawl space has been generated there.
** ⟨7⟩Although it might seem intuitive to dig the spot open with ⟦i:84¦We Need To Go Deeper!⟧ or ⟦p:ehwaz¦Ehwaz⟧, their chance of spawning a crawl space is independent and not guaranteed to work.
* An extra crawl space that is added by ⟦t:74¦Stud Finder⟧ won't be identified by the familiar.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Increases damage based on how many empty Red Heart containers Isaac has.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a flat damage up based on how many empty Red Heart containers he has.
** ⟨7⟩ The damage up given is 0.2 for each empty Red Heart container Isaac has.
*** ⟨24⟩ The damage up given is ((2 × MissingHearts) ^ 1.6) × 0.1, where MissingHearts is the number of full red hearts of health missing. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
** Damage ups are only applied for every fully empty heart container.
items.notes:
* This item has no effect on characters that can't have any Red Heart containers, unless Bone Hearts are collected. If a Bone Heart is gone, so does the Adrenaline damage. This means that Adrenaline is only truly useless on ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧.
* This item affects both ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧; empty Coin Hearts increase damage.
* As ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, empty Bone Hearts increase damage, but if the Bone Hearts are broken, the damage buff is lost.
* ⟨24⟩ The maximum damage bonus from Adrenaline is 14.05 normally, 16.15 with Bone Hearts, and 30.9 for Magdalene with ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears fire sparks of electricity in random directions upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Tears fire 1-2 sparks of electricity in random directions upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.
* ⟨24⟩ Tears fire 1 short-ranged spark of electricity in a random direction upon hitting an obstacle or enemy. When an arc strikes an enemy, it will strike another nearby enemy, chaining up to four times.
* Sparks deal half of the tear's damage.
** Sparks behave like spectral and piercing lasers and will arc to hit enemies that are close enough, even striking multiple ones in a row.
** An enemy can take damage multiple times from sparks of a single chain. If an enemy take damage from a tear, it does not take any damage from the chain which the tear causes.
** Tears that hit the floor due to running out of range do not generate arcs.
** ⟨24⟩ If the floor is wet, such as ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧, ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧, ⟦s:flooded-caves¦Flooded Caves⟧, some rooms in ⟦s:scarred-womb¦Scarred Womb⟧ and ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧, and after using ⟦i:291¦Flush!⟧, the arcing distance is increased.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.
⟨24⟩Gives a chance to shoot blue fires alongside tears that become smaller as they travel.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩Shooting tears sometimes spawns a fire similar to ⟦i:289¦Red Candle⟧, damaging enemies and destroying shots it comes into contact with.
* ⟨24⟩Shooting tears sometimes spawns a blue fire similar to ⟦i:164¦The Candle⟧, damaging enemies and destroying shots it comes into contact with. It lasts on the ground for a limited time and can pass through obstacles.
** The fire deals 6× Isaac's damage at base, gradually fading to 3× damage with the size of the flame.
* Creating farts through items/pills such as Re-Lax, ⟦i:36¦The Poop⟧, ⟦i:294¦Butter Bean⟧, and etc. causes fire to shoot out alongside the fart.
** ⟨4⟩The only exception to this is the farts generated by ⟦t:24¦Butt Penny⟧.
items.notes:
* ⟨4⟩ The chance of spawning fires is not affected by luck.
* ⟨24⟩ The chance to shoot fires depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 12 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},50\%)
** At base luck (0), the chance is 8.33%, maxing out at 50% at 10 luck.
* The fire can destroy Shopkeepers.
* ⟨7⟩Enemies with fire variants will change to their flaming variants when they get hit with the flame.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a luck-based chance to fire needles that instantly kill basic enemies and deal triple damage to bosses. If a needle kills an enemy, it bursts into more tears/needles.
items.effects:
* Adds a chance to fire needles which deal triple Isaac's tear damage.
** Needles will instantly kill regular enemies and cause them to burst into 10 more tears in all directions.
** The chance to fire a needle depends on luck.
** ⟨7⟩ The formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 30 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \times 2 \right \rfloor}
*** At base luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 100% at 14.5 luck.
** ⟨24⟩ The formula used to determine the chance is: min(\frac1 { 30 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \times 2 \right \rfloor},25\%)
*** At base luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 25% at 13 luck.
** The tears released upon an instant-kill also have a chance to be needles, though these ones do not have the instant-kill ability. They do retain the 3× damage, however.
items.notes:
* The needle tears can kill enemies that are normally invincible, such as ⟦e:peep¦Peep⟧'s eyes, Death's Heads, and Stoneys.
* The needle tears can kill Stone Grimaces and Spikeballs, allowing Isaac to permanently remove any obstacle in a room.
** ⟨24⟩ The needle tears can kill Bomb Grimaces, dropping 10 unlit Throwable Bombs. This can make it detrimental to shoot at them, since they are usually provided as a tool rather than an obstacle.
* The tears in the burst are larger than normal but do not have a damage bonus.
* Unless piercing is obtained, Knights will still block the needles if shot from the front.

items.description: Isaac becomes camouflaged at the beginning of each room. Until he shoots, all non-boss enemies will be confused. ⟨24⟩ Isaac gains +0.5 Speed while camouflaged, and gains Tears and Damage upon breaking it.
items.effects:
* Upon entering a new room, Isaac will become camouflaged and all enemies become confused. The effect will last until Isaac presses a fire button.
** Bosses will not be confused when Isaac is camouflaged.
** ⟨24⟩ While camouflaged, Isaac gains +0.5 Speed. When the camouflage is dropped, enemies in a short radius around Isaac take 15 damage, and he gains a temporary +10.5 Damage and +7.5 Tears up which both rapidly scale down to 0. The tears up ignores the soft tears cap.
*** If Isaac is firing tears while walking into a room, the camouflage and stat boost will not apply.
**** This also applies when pressing a fire button to skip boss transition cutscenes.
items.notes:
* List of enemies that are completely unaffected by this item:
* List of enemies partially affected by this item, all of which visually appear confused but react to Isaac's presence in some way nonetheless:
* Red Fire Places & Purple Fire Places are not affected by this item.
* While bosses are not confused, monsters spawned during boss fights are confused, as long as the effect lasts.
* The item's effect can potentially cause FPS drops.
* Champion enemies become tinted the same color as regular enemies, making it difficult to distinguish them.
* A co-op baby firing will also end the camouflage effect.
* ⟨24⟩ Shopkeepers can be destroyed by the area effect when firing tears for the first time in a room.
* ⟨7⟩ This item does almost nothing in Greed mode, despite being able to be obtained from the Greed mode Treasure Room.
** ⟨24⟩Due to its ability to destroy Shopkeepers, Camo Undies can net you some extra Pennies or Nickels from shops and The Shop floor, should a Shopkeeper wave appear there.

items.description: Whenever a Devil Room or Angel Room would spawn after defeating a boss, both rooms spawn. Only one can be entered.
items.effects:
* Whenever a Devil Room/Angel Room spawns after defeating a boss, the other will also spawn.
** Upon entering one, the other one will disappear.
** Both rooms will spawn even if a devil deal was made before.
** In rooms without enough accessible walls, only one of the two will spawn.
items.notes:
* Even with ⟦i:215¦Goat Head⟧ or ⟦i:499¦Eucharist⟧, both rooms will not stay open, and entering either of the rooms will make the other disappear.
* Teleportation via a ⟦p:joker¦Joker⟧ card, a Red Chest, or a Sacrifice Room before defeating the boss and choosing a door will follow the normal rules of Devil/Angel Room generation, instead of a 50/50 chance.
** This means that if Duality was taken as a Devil deal, or any other deal with the Devil was made in the run, teleportation will always lead to the Devil Room.
** The room that was chosen this way will be the only one that opens once the boss is defeated.
** Teleporting after choosing a door will always take you to the same room.
** Gaining Duality during Greed/Greedier Mode will only generate one room as per normal, rendering it normally useless. However, both rooms will generate in the penultimate floor, The Shop.

items.description: Grants a Red Heart container for every 25 Coins Isaac has.
items.effects:
* Grants an extra Red Heart container for every 25 Coins Isaac has, up to a maximum of 4 hearts at 99 coins.
** Dropping below the number of coins required for a Red Heart container removes the Red Heart container.
items.notes:
* The extra Red Heart container can exceed the maximum Coin Heart container limit of ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧, allowing him to obtain more than ⟨7⟩2 / ⟨24⟩3 Coin Heart containers.
* Depending on the character used, this item only affects Red Heart containers, Soul Hearts (⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧) or Coin Heart containers (⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧). It does not affect ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧.
* ⟨7⟩ The Red Heart container gain is not retroactive - picking it up at 99 coins will not grant 4 extra Red Heart containers.
** However, picking it up at 99 coins and then dropping below 99 coins will lose a Red Heart container, decreasing the viability of picking this item up the more coins you have.
*** The player will die if they lose their last form of health as a result of Greed's Gullet.
*** If Keeper drops to under 2 Coin Heart containers as a result of Greed's Gullet, or by any other means (Devil deal, etc.), he is unable to use an HP Up to increase his health back to 2 and has to regain the lost coins to do so.
** ⟨7⟩ If Greed's Gullet is rerolled away after gaining health, the extra health will be preserved even if the player loses the coins afterward.
*** However, if this happens with Keeper, his health will drop back to 2 Coin Heart containers upon picking up an item, unless another Greed's Gullet is picked up.
** ⟨24⟩ If Greed's Gullet is lost or re-rolled by any means (including the ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ chase sequence), the health will be lost. This may cause Isaac to die. After returning from the ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ chase sequence, the heart containers will be re-added, but they will be empty.
* ⟨24⟩ The Red Heart containers granted by Greed's Gullet are now retroactive - picking the item up at 99 coins will immediately grant 4 Red Heart containers. Consuming coins will still cause Isaac to lose Red Heart containers.
* ⟨24⟩ This also applies in reverse; consuming Red Heart containers granted by Greed's Gullet through methods such as Devil Room items or ⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧ will cause Isaac to lose an appropriate amount of coins.
* ⟨24⟩ For ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ specifically, Greed's Gullet in combination with ⟦i:416¦Deep Pockets⟧ allows him to bypass the 12 heart container health limit, capping at 15 Coin Hearts at 999 coins.
** Works the same for ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ but caps at 14 Coin Hearts instead.
** By using Health Up pills and Health Up items while having ⟦i:416¦Deep Pockets⟧ the cap for ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ can be raised to 54 Coin Hearts. However, additional heart containers beyond 24 will not appear on the health bar.
*** Works the same for ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ but caps at 53 Coin Hearts instead.
* Be careful when buying items from the Shop, as it can remove Red Heart containers.
* Enemies that drain Isaac's coins (such as ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧s, Hangers, ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧, or ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧) can remove Red Heart containers.
* This item allows ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ to utilize Health Up pills and Health up items, as the Coin Hearts gained this way are kept even if the coins are lost once the coins lost are regained, and can bypass the 99-coin limit.

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Adds a chance to fire a piercing tear that instantly kills any enemy that it touches.
⟨24⟩ Adds a chance to fire a tear that summons ⟦e:big-horn¦Big Horn⟧'s hand to crush the first enemy it hits, instantly killing monsters or greatly damaging bosses.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ Adds a chance to fire piercing tears which will instantly kill any non-boss enemy.
* ⟨24⟩ Adds a chance to fire a tear that summons ⟦e:big-horn¦Big Horn⟧'s hand. It will grab and crush any non-boss enemy, killing them instantly, and attacks bosses 3 times for 12 damage each hit (even ⟦e:big-horn¦Big Horn⟧ himself).
** If the tear kills an enemy, it will be feared for a moment before being crushed.
* Running into enemies deals 3.5 damage to them.
** Damage is dealt up to twice per second per enemy.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:little-horn¦Little Horn⟧ or ⟦e:big-horn¦Big Horn⟧.
* The chance to fire special tears depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: min(\frac1 { 20 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}, 20\%)
** At base luck (0), the chance is 5%, maxing out at 20% at 15 luck.
* The special tears will kill some normally invulnerable monsters, such as Death's Heads, Stonies, and ⟦e:peep¦Peep⟧'s floating eyeballs.
* ⟨7⟩The special tears can also destroy Blue Fire Places and Purple Fire Places.
* The special tears can destroy the various spiked blocks (Wall Hugger, Slide, and Poky) as well as the variants of Stone Grimace. All of these won't respawn if Isaac leaves and re-enters the room.
* ⟨7⟩The contact damage effect overrides the superior contact damage from ⟦i:300¦Aries⟧, ⟦i:93¦The Gamekid⟧, ⟦i:77¦My Little Unicorn⟧ / ⟦p:vii-the-chariot¦VII - The Chariot⟧, and ⟦i:83¦The Nail⟧. Only ⟦i:202¦Midas' Touch⟧ still works and deals an additional 3.5 damage.
** ⟨24⟩ The contact damage adds to other contact damage sources.

* The flies are completely invulnerable and ignored by enemies.

items.description: Isaac's tears deal double damage and inflict bleeding on enemies if they're facing away from Isaac.
items.effects:
* When Isaac's attacks land on the "back" of enemies, they deal double damage and inflict bleeding.
** ⟨7⟩ Bleeding enemies take damage equal to 10% of their maximum health every 5 seconds. Bosses cannot be inflicted with bleeding, but will still take the extra damage.
** ⟨24⟩ Enemies bleed for 5 seconds, bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind red creep that can damage other enemies.
** The extra damage is dealt even if the enemy is already bleeding.
items.notes:
* The damage is dealt as 2 separate hits, as opposed to one double damage hit.
* What is considered to be the "back" of an enemy is based solely on their velocity when the attacks land: their back is opposite to their movement direction.
** High knockback makes it easier to get follow-up backstabs as the enemies are pushed away from the tears.
** Pushing enemies while shooting makes them easy to backstab, though is mostly viable only on ones that don't deal contact damage or while having a shield.
** Completely stationary enemies generally have their back on their upper and right sides, but knockback considerations apply.

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart or Half Soul Heart if an enemy is hit.
⟨24⟩ Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart if an enemy is hit.
items.effects:
* Damages all enemies in the room.
** The damage dealt is equal to Isaac's current tear damage plus 10% of the enemy's max health.
* Has a 15% chance to drop Half Red Hearts when it damages an enemy.
** ⟨7⟩ May also drop Half Soul Hearts. Half red hearts will always drop when Isaac has at least one red heart container; otherwise, half soul hearts will drop.

items.notes:
* When used on ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧, this item should be used when it isn't transformed to deal the most damage, as Delirium doesn't have his armor up when in his true form.
* For enemies that can disappear or go underground, it only affects them if they are visible.
* The Sharp Straw works exceptionally well with ⟦c:samson¦Samson⟧, giving the chance to collect large amounts of health per floor, allowing more damage to be taken resulting in more damage being dealt per use.

** ⟨7⟩ Bleeding enemies take damage equal to 10% of their maximum health every 5 seconds. Bosses cannot bleed and won't take any damage from the razor.
** ⟨24⟩ Bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind red creep that can damage other enemies.
** ⟨7⟩ The razor does not block enemy shots.
** ⟨24⟩ The razor blocks enemy shots.
items.notes: * ⟨7⟩It may not always be a good idea to take Mom's Razor if Isaac has one or more Pretty Flies as orbitals, as Mom's Razor can override Pretty Flies without giving protection from enemy shots.

⟨24⟩ Spawns an orbital familiar that deals contact damage, blocks shots, and fires tears at enemies in its line of sight.
items.effects:

items.description: Spawns ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ as a random friendly boss that fights for Isaac. ⟨15⟩ The boss lasts the for the current room. ⟨16⟩ The boss persists between rooms. The charge time is based on the power of the boss summoned.
items.effects:

items.notes:

items.description: While held, guarantees one item in every Shop will be on sale for half price. On use, makes a random item in the current room free.
items.effects:
* Upon use, turns a random item in the current room that costs money or hearts into a pedestal item that can be taken for free.
* While held, guarantees a random item or pickup from the Shop to be half price.
items.notes:
* Coupon has a 1% chance to drop from destroying normal Shopkeepers.
* Using Coupon in a Devil Room and taking that free item does not affect or remove the chances for Angel Rooms.
* Using Coupon in Greed mode does not restock the taken item or consumable.
* Using Coupon in a Shop while holding ⟦i:376¦Restock⟧ will not respawn a new item after taking the free one.
* ⟨24⟩ Using Coupon as ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ allows multiple Devil deals to be taken.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Any enemy shots that come near Isaac for the next three seconds are held in place then fired back.
items.effects:
* Upon use, for the next three seconds, any enemy shots that come near Isaac are held in place.
** ⟨7⟩ After a shot has been held for two seconds, it is fired back as a tear.
*** Reflected tears always do 3.5 damage.
** ⟨24⟩ When the effect is about to end, all shots are fired back.
*** Reflected normal tears do 6 damage if they would normally do a half heart damage to Isaac.
*** Reflected normal tears do 7 damage if they would normally do a full heart damage to Isaac.
*** Reflected ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ shots do 50 damage, and do not harm Isaac.
*** Reflected rocks thrown by Polty do 35 damage.
* ⟨24⟩ The emanating blue pulse pushes enemies away for the duration of the item's usage.
items.notes:
* The tears can be rammed into enemies while they're held by Telekinesis. ⟨7⟩ They won't disappear until the effect ends but do no further damage.
* ⟨7⟩ As long as the item is used immediately upon recharging, Isaac is effectively immune to enemy bullets.
* Catching shots from enemies that fire high into the air, like the Tube Worm, is very difficult and not beneficial; in the case of the Tube Worm, shots that are caught will just fall to the ground rather than be fired at enemies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: If the box is empty, picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them. If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room. ⟨24⟩ Can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once.
items.effects:
* If the box is empty, it picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them.
** ⟨24⟩ Moving Box can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once, randomly picked (i.e. items are not prioritized).
* If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ Moving Box can sometimes spawn within the special bedroom created by ⟦i:681¦Lil Portal⟧.
* ⟨7⟩ There is no limit to the number of items and pickups that can be held in the box.
* The best way to utilize Moving Box is often to absorb a large number of weaker items, then place them all into one room, and use a reroll effect to reroll them all at the same time. This is especially effective in Secret Rooms.
* Any stored items and pickups unpacked from Moving Box will remain identical to what was originally packed; pills, cards, and runes will stay the same, Sticky Nickels will remain stuck to the floor, active items keep their charge in the box, and Chests will have the same contents as they would if they had been opened immediately.
* Stealing from Shops and Devil Rooms is not possible; only items on pedestals will be packed up.
* All existing Moving Boxes share their opened/closed state. Therefore, it is not possible to carry a Moving Box that is holding items within another Moving Box as the items must be unpacked first.
* If used in a room with a choice of multiple item pedestals, only one of the choice objects will be packed up and ⟨7⟩ the rest will remain and behave normally / ⟨24⟩ the rest will disappear.
** ⟨7⟩ Both items presented by ⟦i:249¦There's Options⟧ and ⟦i:414¦More Options⟧ can be taken.
** ⟨7⟩ Both ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ and ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ can be taken.
** ⟨7⟩ If used in the Boss Rush room, one of the objects is packed up but the rush is not started. The remaining item choices start the rush as normal.
*** ⟨24⟩ Using Moving Box to pack items in Boss Rush starts the challenge.
* ⟨7⟩ If used in a Challenge Room or Boss Challenge Room the objects within can be packed up without starting the challenge.
** ⟨24⟩ Using Moving Box in these rooms starts the challenge.
* ⟨24⟩ Disappearing pickups that are spawned by ⟦c:tainted-magdalene¦Tainted Magdalene⟧ / ⟦p:soul-of-magdalene¦Soul of Magdalene⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ can't be packed into Moving Box.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Connects Isaac's tears with electricity that can damage enemies.
items.effects:
* Connects tears with electricity that damages enemies.
** ⟨7⟩ The electricity's damage is equal to Isaac's Damage.
** ⟨24⟩ The electricity deals 30% of Isaac's Damage, 15 times per second, for a total of 4.5 times his damage per second.
** A tear can generate one connection. The tear does not generate another connection even after the connection is lost. However, other tears can still make connections with it.
** Each of Isaac's tears can connect to other allied tears, including those of shooting familiars.
*** The number of connections is limited by the number of Isaac's tears.
items.notes: * When playing as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, the tears of the brother who picked up the item will also connect to those fired by his brother. For example, if Jacob picked up the item, his tears will connect to each other as well as to those of Esau, but Esau himself will not fire any electric tears.

items.description: Taking damage grants a body part orbital that blocks shots and deals contact damage, up to a maximum of three. The body parts are destroyed after blocking enough damage.
items.effects:
* Upon taking damage, Isaac gains a body part as an orbital, which blocks enemy shots and deals 7 damage per tick (35 damage per second) to enemies it comes in contact with.
** A maximum of three body parts can be active at once.
** The body parts will be destroyed after dealing 30 ticks of damage and/or blocking 3 shots.
** The body parts persist between floors.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:fistula¦Fistula⟧.
* Body parts orbit on the same layer as Blue Flies and Locusts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a random Harbinger familiar that changes every 10 seconds. Harbingers have different behaviors and spawn themed Locusts.
items.effects:
* Spawns a random Harbinger familiar that changes every 10 seconds. All harbingers deal contact damage to enemies and periodically spawn locusts if Isaac currently doesn't have any, though each harbinger behaves slightly differently:
** ⟦e:famine¦Famine⟧ wanders around the room, leaves a trail of slowing black creep, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns ⟦t:115¦yellow locusts⟧ every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and slows enemies.
** ⟦e:pestilence¦Pestilence⟧ wanders around the room, leaves a trail of green creep that deals 1 damage per tick or 30 damage per second, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns ⟦t:114¦green locusts⟧ every 3 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage and poisons enemies, which deals double Isaac's damage over time.
** ⟦e:war¦War⟧ chases enemies, moves faster than the other Harbingers, deals 1.5 contact damage per tick or 45 damage per second, and spawns ⟦t:113¦red locusts⟧ every 5 seconds which detonates upon impact with enemies, dealing double tear damage for the impact of the locust and 60 damage for the explosion. The explosion synergizes with multiple bomb related items.
** ⟦e:death¦Death⟧ chases enemies, deals 1.5 contact damage per tick or 45 damage per second, and spawns ⟦t:116¦black locusts⟧ every 3 seconds that deal quadruple Isaac's damage, applied as two hits of double damage.
** ⟦e:conquest¦Conquest⟧ wanders around the room, deals 0.5 contact damage per tick or 15 damage per second, and spawns two ⟦t:117¦white locusts⟧ at a time every 2 seconds that deal double Isaac's damage.
*** ⟨7⟩ Conquest ignores the locust spawn timer.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ Explosive locusts have a larger aggro range than all other locusts. They will target an enemy from further away.
* ⟨7⟩If Conquest is on top of an enemy when Isaac has no white locusts, it will spawn locusts at an incredibly high rate and deal a lot of damage.
* If an enemy is large enough to stand on multiple segments of Pestilence's creep trail, the damage from each pool of creep will stack.
* The locusts that War spawns can damage Isaac if they explode near him.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Summons a controllable ghost that can perform various tasks depending on what it targets.
items.effects:
* Summons a ghost near Isaac that will follow him around, and summons a controllable blue crosshair. After a few seconds, the crosshair disappears, and the ghost will act depending on what the crosshair was targeting:
** Items / Pickups / Trinkets / Chests / Red Chests / Spiked Chests / Mega Chests: Brings it to Isaac.
*** Can steal from Shops, Devil Rooms, and Black Markets, making the item/pickup free. Stealing an item has a 33% chance to fail. If that happens, a buzzer sound will play and the ghost will disappear without doing anything.
*** ⟨7⟩ Stealing an item from a Shop will restock it with another item, as if Isaac had ⟦i:376¦Restock⟧. This does not happen in other room types.
** Locked Chests / Eternal Chests / Bomb Chests: Opens the chest for free.
** Pressure Plate/Reward Plate: Presses the button. This includes the wave pause button in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
** Enemies: Attacks the enemy until it dies or can no longer be targeted due to a form change or similar cause. The ghost does 3 damage per tick, for 9 damage per second.
** Doors: Opens the door, even if it is locked. Functions the same as ⟦i:175¦Dad's Key⟧ when being used in this way. This includes the door to ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧, exiting ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧'s room, and exiting Boss Rush.
*** ⟨24⟩ This does not work on ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧. However, it does work on doors leading to alternate path levels.
*** ⟨24⟩ This does not work on the flesh door leading to ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ that appears after defeating ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ in ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ or ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧.
*** ⟨24⟩ This does not work on the hidden closet in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧ to unlock the tainted characters.
** Secret Room entrances: Explodes, opening the entrance.
** Some destructible obstacles, Shopkeepers, Slot Machines, Beggars, and ⟨7⟩ angel statues: Explodes and destroys them.
*** Can't target regular rocks, bomb rocks, spiked rocks, fool's gold rocks, blocks, key blocks, normal and red fire places, any poop, or ⟨24⟩ angel statues.
** If the room has nothing to interact with, the ghost will disappear without doing anything.
items.notes:
* If the crosshair is not targeting anything when the crosshair disappears, the ghost will interact with the object closest to the crosshair.
* Picking up a stolen Devil deal will not prevent Angel Rooms from appearing. ⟨24⟩ It will also not despawn the other Devil items for characters like ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧.
* The ghost cannot pick up Sticky Nickels and will disappear upon touching them.
* The ghost can open chests in Challenge Rooms without triggering the room.
* Unlike chests, stealing an item pedestal from a Challenge Room will trigger the waves to spawn upon picking up the stolen item.
* In rooms with multiple pedestal items where only one can be taken, if the ghost is carrying a pedestal while Isaac picks up a different pedestal item, the ghost will disappear. This prevents taking both items for free.
* ⟨7⟩ If used in an Angel Room with no item pedestals, Mr. ME! will target the angel statue, blowing it up.
* If used with MouseControl=1 enabled, while pressing mouse left button, the blue crosshair will keep going away from the character, not following the mouse.
** Having ⟦i:394¦Marked⟧ make the blue crosshair follow the mouse instead.
* If the ghost is currently out and moving, putting down Mr. ME! by any means will destroy the ghost and consume the charge.

items.description: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.
items.effects: * Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.
items.notes: * It will also quadruple shooting familiar tears.

items.description: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other. The eyeballs are not limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.
items.effects:
* Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other.
* Isaac's tears are no longer limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.
* ⟨24⟩ Eyeball tears will start to fall to the ground after bouncing off of each other 8 times.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants a pickup or stat upgrade if all enemies in a room are killed in the order they are marked.
items.effects:
* Upon entering a room, a skull appears over an enemy's head.
** The marked enemy will have a bigger shadow.
** Killing the marked enemy will cause the skull to move to a different enemy.
** If all enemies in the room are cleared in the order they are marked, Isaac gains one of the following rewards at random:
*** A Soul Heart, a pill, a Key, a Bomb, or a Nickel.
*** +0.2 speed, +0.5 range, ⟨7⟩ +0.5 tears, ⟨24⟩ +0.5 fire rate, +0.2 shot speed, +1 flat damage, or +1 luck.
** If a non-marked enemy is killed, the skull will disappear and no bonuses will be granted for that room.
items.notes:
* Losing this item will not remove stat rewards.
* As long as the room is not cleared, Isaac can re-attempt a Death's List by leaving and re-entering.
* The marked enemies are chosen in the same order in a given room, starting from the top-left corner with enemies that are vulnerable at their spawn time (from top to bottom, then from left to right). If new enemies are spawned via Portals or on death, they are added to the end of the marked queue.
* The marked Army Fly will always be the last one in the line of Army Flies.
* Bishops can shield the marked enemy unless frozen or petrified beforehand.
* Killing all piles of a Cursed Globins counts as one kill.
* A room with no enemies that instead requires Pressure Plates to be pressed will also give a reward when cleared.
* If a reward stat is chosen that is already at maximum, the sound effect and Isaac's thumbs up animation will play, but there is no other effect.
* Bosses may also be marked.
* If a Portal is marked and despawns, no other enemy will be marked and the bonus is lost.
* Enemies that are not spawned when the room is entered (such as ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧s from bombed Angel Statues and enemies in Challenge Rooms, ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, and Boss Rush) will not be marked.
* In the ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ boss fight, each of Mom's body parts (eyes, foot, and hands) is considered as a different enemy, and Isaac has to kill the foot to get the bonus.
* If the doors open automatically due to spending a long enough time in the room, any existing mark will disappear.
* Familiars, especially ones that passively or actively damage enemies of their own accord, may make killing enemies in order difficult, if not impossible.
* Ace cards will kill the enemies in the correct order when possible.
* If a Mr. Maw is marked, killing either part of its body will not forfeit Death's List, as the remaining enemy of said Mr. Maw will still be marked.
* This item has little to no effect in Greed Mode.
* Waiting for the Room Anti-softlock to trigger will always grant a reward from Death's List.
* Friendly enemies cannot be marked, and their deaths do not cause the mark to disappear.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into many smaller tears in all directions. Increases tear delay.
items.effects:
* Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into smaller tears in all directions.
** The number of burst tears is random between 6-11 and they have an equal chance of occurring.
** The scattered tears deal random damage that is 50-83.33% of the main tear. On average, they deal 66% damage.
* ⟨7⟩ Tear Delay × 2 + 10
* ⟨24⟩ Tear Delay × 2 + 11
** The tear delay adjustment is applied after additive fire rate modifiers (e.g. ⟦t:39¦Cancer⟧) and multipliers less than 1 (e.g. ⟦i:169¦Polyphemus⟧), and before fire rate multipliers greater than 1 (e.g. ⟦i:330¦Soy Milk⟧).
** I.e. calculate tear delay from tears, then fire rate from tear delay, then apply additive modifiers and multipliers less than 1, then recalculate tear delay from fire rate, then multiply by 2 and add 11, then recalculate fire rate from tear delay, then apply fire rate multipliers greater than 1.
* ⟨7⟩ 1.31~× damage multiplier.
* ⟨24⟩ +1 damage and 1.5× damage multiplier.
* ⟨24⟩ Range down: 0.8× range multiplier.
* The main tear has a roughly 1.71× size multiplier.
items.notes:
* Higher shot speed lowers the arc of the main shot, whereas lower speed heightens it, resulting in a very minor change in effective range.
** The split tears are affected normally by shot speed.
* ⟨7⟩ The tear falling speed stat is entirely ignored for both the main shot and the split tears.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac's tears decelerate as they travel. Upon stopping or hitting an obstacle, they burst into 8 tears in all directions. Tears can be fired into other tears to feed them, increasing their damage.
items.effects:
* Isaac's tears decelerate as they travel. Upon stopping or hitting an obstacle, they burst into tears that fly in all directions. Hitting an enemy will not cause them to burst.
** ⟨7⟩ They burst into 8 tears.
** ⟨24⟩ They burst into 5-8 tears, depending on tear size.
* Tears can be fired into other tears to feed them, increasing their damage and the damage of the burst tears.
** If one tear is fed 5 other tears, it will immediately burst.
** The tears will have their damage added together, with the first consumed tear giving additional damage.
** Tears in the burst will deal half the damage the main tear would have.
** This also applies to Familiar tears.
items.notes:
* Certain items that cause tears to split and feed each other, when combined, can cause the resulting tear to become so large that the game will crash.
* Tears can also burst from shot size. With sufficiently high damage or several tear-size increasing items, the tears will burst almost immediately after firing.
* The distance burst tears fly depends on tear height and not range.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears are replaced with piercing white blasts of light that deal less damage but can damage the same enemy multiple times.
items.effects:
* Tears are replaced with piercing white blasts of light.
** Blasts deal 33% of the regular tear damage, but can hit each enemy they are in contact with up to 15 times per second.
** Blasts decrease in size until disappearing.
*** Despite the blasts decreasing in size after passing through obstacles, this purely visual as the blast will only damage enemies adjacent to the obstacle.
** ⟨7⟩ Blasts do not knock back enemies.
items.notes:
* Since the blasts can strike one enemy multiple times while they remain in contact, low shot speed can be very beneficial whereas high shot speed may lower effective damage.
** Walking backward while firing can allow tears to move slower, making it useful for increasing damage output.
* Items that grant a high Tears rate, such as ⟦i:330¦Soy Milk⟧, can cause the light beams to significantly obstruct visibility, which can further be exacerbated by items such as ⟦i:418¦Fruit Cake⟧ causing rapid color and size change.
* With only Trisagion, Isaac with base stats will deal about 18 damage per second on an unmoving, gaper-sized enemy, which is almost double Isaac's base DPS of 9.5. 1.32 shot speed will reduce DPS of Trisagion to about 14.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Allows Isaac to hold two active items.
items.effects:
* Allows Isaac to hold two active items.
** Swap between active items by pressing the CTRL, R2, RT, or ZR.
items.notes:
* The button to swap between active items is the same button used to swap between cards and pills.
* Items in the secondary slot will recharge at the same rate as the primary item.
* Items that grant temporary effects for the room, such as ⟦i:83¦The Nail⟧, may deactivate if switched with an item in the secondary slot.
* The ⟦p:card¦? Card⟧ does not activate both active items.
* While holding an active item that grants passive bonuses in the secondary slot, swapping the main slot item with a pedestal item may remove the bonuses. If this happens, Isaac can swap the bonus-granting item to the pedestal and pick it up again to regain them.
* The swap key must be pressed twice if playing as ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧.
* This item cannot be unlocked if the player encounters more than ⟨7⟩ one/⟨24⟩ two in Chapters 1-3, except by chance of finding ⟦t:110¦Silver Dollar⟧, ⟦t:161¦Wicked Crown⟧, ⟦t:155¦Holy Crown⟧, ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧, or a 5-pip Dice Room.
** If one Curse of the Labyrinth is encountered, getting to ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ or ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II and entering the Shop there will unlock the Schoolbag.
** ⟨24⟩ If Curse of the Labyrinth was encountered twice, entering the shops in both ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II and ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ will unlock the Schoolbag.
* ⟨24⟩ If ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ drops Schoolbag, the 2nd active item in the player's inventory is destroyed. However, a duplicate active item spawns beside Schoolbag. Tainted Isaac's reroll ability applies to this new item, and the player can choose between the original active item or a new item. Picking up the original active item again will count as another item towards any transformation.
* ⟨24⟩ In "True" Co-op, when a player dies with this item, they will drop one of their active items if they have two. It is unknown if this is a bug or intended interaction.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants one Soul Heart. Upon entering a boss room, grants a shield that blocks one hit, then disappears.
items.effects:
* Heals one Red Heart.
* Grants one Soul Heart.
* Upon entering a Boss Room, grants a shield that blocks one hit. If the shield is not used by the time the player leaves the room, the shield will disappear.
items.notes:
* The shield will be granted regardless of whether the Boss Room is already cleared.
* This item's shield effect has the same synergies and interactions as ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ with the only difference being that when paired with Holy Mantle or ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧'s innate shield it can still reapply later into the run. For a list of synergies and interactions, visit that page.
* Multiple Blankets will only give 1 shield.
* In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, this item grants a shield only for the two boss fights on the final level. The shield does not activate for the regular boss waves on previous floors.
* To quickly unlock this item, keep restarting Greed mode to enter its Curse Room which occasionally contains a bed.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Sacrifices up to two familiars and spawns an item pedestal for each familiar sacrificed. Converts all friendly spiders and flies into coins.
items.effects:
* Upon use, sacrifices up to two familiars and spawns an item pedestal for each familiar sacrificed.
** The order in which the familiars were obtained does not matter; it picks 2 at random to sacrifice.
* Any Blue Flies, Blue Spiders, Locusts, ⟦i:713¦Clots⟧, Dips, or ⟦i:658¦Minisaacs⟧ will be converted to 1 Penny each.
* Wisps will be turned into Half Red Hearts each, and ⟦i:712¦Item Wisps⟧ will be turned into Half Soul Hearts.
* The list of possible item rewards include:
* If Isaac already has all of the above items, copies of ⟦i:51¦Pentagram⟧ will replace any further items spawned.
* On use, causes a brief effect for a few seconds.
* If Isaac has no familiars of any kind, including any temporary familiars, the item will do nothing and will not be consumed.
items.notes:
* If playing as ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧, the ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ familiar cannot be sacrificed.
** Other starting familiars, such as those granted by ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧ or a challenge, can be sacrificed as normal.
* Charmed and friendly enemies cannot be sacrificed.
* Any Pretty Flies are counted as a single sacrifice.
* Familiars spawned from Trinkets like ⟦t:54¦Isaac's Head⟧ can be sacrificed, destroying the trinket in the process.
* ⟨24⟩ Upon use may remove Transformations.
