items.description: Drops a random pill, and spawns a familiar that charges up and fires creep. Using pills changes the creep type.
items.effects:
* Spawns a random pill.
* Spawns a small Spewer familiar that charges up and fires different types of creep.
* The familiar and his creep change randomly when Isaac uses a pill.
* Possible creep includes:
** A line of damaging green creep that deals 0.4 damage per tick (12 damage per second).
** A long line of slowing black creep.
** A line of short-lasting, damaging red creep, with a larger puddle of creep at the end that lasts longer. The creep will deal 1.2 damage per tick (36 damage per second).
** A short-ranged cone of damaging yellow creep that grows larger and deals more damage the further it travels. It deals 2 damage per tick at the lowest range, and increases to 15.2 damage per tick at the furthest (~6-47 damage per second, based on range).
** A large ring of long-lasting slowing white creep.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:blastocyst¦Blastocyst⟧.
* Lil Spewer always starts with green creep.
* The familiar does not do contact damage.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Spewer having ⟨15⟩ 5th / ⟨16⟩ 7th priority.
* The Ipecac shot created by ⟦t:157¦Torn Card⟧ works for unlocking the Lil Spewer achievement.
* The explosive shots from the wisps summoned by Bob's Rotten Head and the ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ count for the Lil Spewer achievement
* Dying to an Ipecac shot with ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ does not unlock Lil Spewer.
** ⟨24⟩ The same applies to ⟦i:556¦Sulfur⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns 3 random trinkets. Taking damage has a 5% chance to swallow Isaac's currently held trinket, gaining its effect permanently.
items.effects:
* Spawns 3 random trinkets.
* Taking damage has a 10% chance to swallow Isaac's currently held trinket, gaining its effect permanently, similar to ⟦i:479¦Smelter⟧.
items.notes:
* If activated while carrying two trinkets, both will be swallowed.
* Trinkets swallowed via Marbles will not be removed or rerolled by items such as the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧.
* ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧ is still lost after Isaac takes damage from regular sources.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦t:69¦Faded Polaroid⟧ cannot be used to open ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧ if swallowed.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns an egg familiar, which hatches a random friendly monster when Isaac is hurt once per room. The power of the monster improves for each consecutive room cleared without taking damage.
items.effects:
* Spawns an egg familiar, which cracks and turns into a random friendly monster when Isaac is hurt.
** The egg regenerates upon entering a different room.
** The usefulness of the enemy depends on how many consecutive rooms have been cleared without getting hurt.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Mystery Egg having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* Mystery Egg will activate when taking non-hostile damage (such as from a Blood Donation Machine or Curse Room door).
* For ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode and Greedier Mode⟧, the usefulness of the enemy is based on waves cleared rather than rooms.
* The list of available monsters is as follows:

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Tears bounce off the floor, creating splashes. Splashes deal 25% of Isaac's tear damage to all enemies in a small area.
items.effects: * Tears bounce off the floor as they travel. Whenever a tear bounces, it creates a small splash that deals 25% of Isaac's tear damage to enemies.
items.notes:
* The bounces increase effective range without affecting the stat, usually by around one third.
* Indirectly acquiring ⟦i:221¦Rubber Cement⟧ through starting an ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ run or the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ and ⟦i:283¦D100⟧ counts towards unlocking the item.
* ⟨24⟩ Dropping ⟦i:221¦Rubber Cement⟧ as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ and picking it back up counts towards unlocking the item.
* ⟨24⟩ Should be avoided when going for ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight, as tears will fall straight to the ground during the final fight.
* ⟨24⟩ Should be avoided when going for ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧, as encountering ⟦e:rotgut¦Rotgut⟧'s 2nd & 3rd phases becomes near impossible to hit: tears DO NOT bounce on the floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants one Bone Heart and spawns three Red Hearts.
items.effects:
* Grants one Bone Heart.
* Spawns three Red Hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a bone familiar that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.
items.effects:
* Spawns a bone familiar that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.
** ⟨7⟩ The reflected projectiles deal 5 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 10 for a full heart.
** ⟨24⟩ The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
** Enemy damage modification from item effects or by stage does not affect the reflected damage.
** Reflected projectiles do not gain Tear effects from Isaac.
* The familiar does not deal contact damage, but kills the same types of flies on contact as Pretty Fly orbitals do.
items.notes:
* Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. Shady) can harm Isaac and be reflected.
* Homing projectiles (e.g. from Psychic Horf) do not retain their homing effect after being reflected.
* Slipped Rib can reflect:
** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle), which explode as normal.
** Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), and their lines of fire do not harm Isaac.
** Fire projectiles (e.g. from ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧).
** Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti, dealing a flat 35 damage.
* Slipped Rib does not reflect:
** Lasers or beams.
** Lines of fire from fireballs.
** Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a white poop familiar, which turns into a White Poop when Isaac is hurt. White poop has an aura that increases tear fire rate and can block enemy shots. ⟨24⟩ The aura also increases damage by 20% and gives homing.
items.effects:
* Spawns a white poop familiar which turns into a White Poop when Isaac is hurt.
** White Poop has an aura that multiplies both fire rate and tear delay by x2.5 and has a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to ⟦i:457¦Cone Head⟧, except the chance is higher.
** ⟨24⟩ White Poop has similar durability to Golden Poop. The aura additionally increases damage by 20% and gives Isaac's tears a homing effect.
** Hallowed Ground will not activate if the player negates the source of damage through items such as ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧.
* The familiar will respawn after Isaac leaves the room.
* ⟨24⟩ This item belongs to the set. Collecting three items from this set will transform Isaac into a walking pile of poop.
items.notes:
* Aligning a white poop to drop next to a Devil Beggar, a Blood Donation Machine or a Confessional is a great way to save on health, as the aura will allow for frequent free plays.
* Damage from Sacrifice Room spikes can be blocked by Hallowed Ground, but no payout is rewarded.
* White Poop is impervious to enemy shots and charging attacks.
* White Poop is not immune to explosive damage or stomping attacks.
* Chubber attacks cannot destroy White Poop, but can still harm Isaac.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Hallowed Ground having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* ⟨24⟩ This item does not produce White Poop in ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧'s boss arena.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a bone familiar that hovers back and forth in front of Isaac, dealing damage equal to Isaac's damage.
items.effects:
* Spawns a bone familiar that can be aimed with the fire buttons in all directions and does contact damage.
** The familiar will continuously hover back and forth in the direction that it is pointing in.
* The damage is equal to Isaac's tear damage and is dealt 6 times per second.
** The damage increases when Isaac is moving on the direction the familiar is pointing in based on Isaac's current speed, up to twice of its base damage.
* The familiar will damage Poops and Fire Places.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description:
⟨7⟩ Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.
⟨24⟩ Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, Bone Fly, Revenant, Big Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.
items.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ When used, spawns one of the following for each enemy already killed in the current room (capped at 8):
** 80% chance for an orbital bone familiar.
** 20% chance for a friendly bone monster.
*** 66% chance for a Bony.
*** 33% chance for a Black Bony.
* ⟨24⟩ When used, spawns one of the following for each enemy already killed in the current room (capped at 8):
** 80% chance for an orbital bone familiar.
** 20% chance for a friendly bone monster.
*** The bone monster starts as a Bony.
*** The Bony has a 25% chance to become a Black Bony.
*** The Bony or Black Bony has a 25% chance to become a Big Bony if a killed enemy has enough HP to meet the formula:
baseHP + floor * stageHP * min(floor, 10) * 0.8 > 18 + floor * 3 * min(floor, 10) * 0.8
*** The Bony, Black Bony, or Big Bony has a 25% chance to become a Bone Fly.
*** The Bony, Black Bony, Big Bony, or Bone Fly has a 1% chance to become a Revenant.
*** There is an additional 8.33% chance for the bone monster to become a Revenant on ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ / ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧ / ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧.
* ⟨8⟩ Spawning an enemy other than a Bony/Black Bony is only possible after dying at least once to said enemy on the save file.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-forsaken¦The Forsaken⟧.
* Orbital bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the time it was spawned and repel enemies that touch them.
** ⟨7⟩ They block 3 shots or deal 2 ticks of contact damage before being destroyed.
** ⟨24⟩ They block 1 shot or deal 2 ticks of contact damage before being destroyed.
* ⟨7⟩ Bonies deal 5 contact damage and 5 damage with thrown bones.
* ⟨24⟩ Bonies deal 8.7 contact damage and 6 damage with thrown bones.
* Black Bonies will explode on death, dealing 40 damage to enemies it hits. The explosion will not hurt Isaac. ⟨7⟩ It will knock him back.
* Internally, the book tracks up to 32 positions each enemy was killed at in the current room, and uses those locations as spawn points for bone orbitals and Bonies.
** Using the book will always spawn at least 1, gives the rest a 66% chance for each location to spawn one, and can spawn up to 8 per use.
*** Having more locations than 8 will effectively increase the odds to spawn each.
*** If one of these locations doesn't spawn a bone orbital or Bony, it can still spawn one if the book is used in the same room without leaving. However, once a location spawns something, it cannot do so again.
* Using the book in a room that had no enemies or was re-entered does nothing and expends the charge.
* Orbital bones occupy the same area around Isaac as Blue Flies, meaning Isaac can have an incredibly dense ring of bone orbitals around him that nullifies most attacks.
* Non-hostile NPCs such as friendly enemies and Shopkeepers can also provide bone orbitals and Bonies when killed or destroyed.
* ⟨7⟩ Destroying Black Poop will damage the friendly monsters acquired from this item.
* ⟨24⟩ Frozen enemies (enemies killed by ⟦i:596¦Uranus⟧, ⟦i:652¦Cube Baby⟧, etc.) will not summon bone familiars unless their frozen bodies are shattered.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Creates a ring of light around Isaac that petrifies enemies in contact.
items.effects:
* Creates a ring of light around Isaac that petrifies enemies on contact.
** Normal enemies stay permanently petrified as long as they are within the ring, whereas bosses get a standard petrification effect that stays even outside the ring but isn't permanent.
items.notes:
* Dad's Ring has no effect on the Mask of a Mask + Heart.
* ⟨24⟩ Will not affect invincible boss enemies such as ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧ or ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants one Bone Heart, +0.7 tears, spawns a ⟦t:21¦Mysterious Paper⟧.
items.effects:
* Grants one Bone Heart.
* +0.7 tears.
* Spawns ⟦t:21¦Mysterious Paper⟧ if it has been unlocked and not previously encountered during the run.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that flies through the room while firing, dealing a flat 7 contact damage to enemies and retrieving pickups.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that fires across the room in the direction of the first tear fired and returns to Isaac when it hits a wall, similar to ⟦i:88¦Little Chubby⟧. Deals a flat 7 damage to enemies that come in contact with it.
** When thrown, the familiar will pierce through some fly enemies, instantly killing them, but will instantly bounce back upon hitting other enemies.
** The familiar can pass through obstacles.
** The familiar can retrieve pickups like ⟦i:338¦The Boomerang⟧.
** Blocks enemy tears when stationary and when thrown.
** After returning to Isaac, it has a short recharge time before it can be fired again.
items.notes:
* Just like ⟦i:338¦The Boomerang⟧, Jaw Bone can grab pickups through obstacles and will not grab Troll Bombs.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Jaw Bone having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* The following types of flies are instantly killed when they come in contact with the familiar:
** Army Fly
** Attack Fly
** Dart Fly
** Fly
** Hush Fly
** Moter
** Pooter
** Ring Fly
** Super Pooter
** Swarm

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Replaces all Red Heart Containers with 6 empty Bone Hearts. ⟨7⟩ Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a tears up. ⟨24⟩ Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a fire rate up.
items.effects:
* Grants 6 empty Bone Hearts.
* Removes all current Red Heart Containers. Does not remove existing Bone Hearts, but does empty them.
* Upon losing a Bone Heart, including ones acquired from other sources, Isaac fires a ring of 8 bones that split into more bones.
** Each Bone Heart lost adds a permanent +0.5 tears up.
** Each bone does twice Isaac's damage plus a flat 22 damage; split bones do half this amount.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-frail¦The Frail⟧.
* If Brittle Bones is removed from Isaac's inventory, its tear upgrades will not be removed but losing further Bone Hearts will no longer have an effect.
* Picking this item up as a character unable to gain Bone Hearts will grant the stats equivalent to one Bone Heart breaking.
** ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ ⟨24⟩ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ will also gain 24 Blue Flies.
* ⟨24⟩ The tears up bonuses gained through this item will persist in the escape sequence of ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ II.
* ⟨24⟩ Losing Bone Hearts not from taking damage (e. g. through a Devil Deal or if a Bone Heart is replaced with a Broken Heart) will not give the tears up effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: While held, causes Mom to continuously attempt to stomp on Isaac. Activating makes her stop for the current room or wave. One of two parts necessary to create ⟦i:552¦Mom's Shovel⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor. Unlocks ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ when used on a mound of dirt that appears in ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧.
items.effects:
* Upon activation, creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor or to a Crawl Space, identical to ⟦i:84¦We Need To Go Deeper!⟧.
* Using this on a dirt patch that appears in Grave Rooms in ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ will unlock ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧.
** Once the Forgotten is unlocked, digging into dirt patches will instead spawn a random type of Chest.
* ⟨24⟩
items.notes:
* It is possible to unlock ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ even if ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ has not yet been unlocked by teleporting straight to the dark room via a Sacrifice Room.
* Does nothing when used on ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧, ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧, ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ (except in a Grave Room), ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧, ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, or ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
* Once Mom's Shovel is complete, the stomping caused by ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧ stops.
* Unlike the Broken Shovel, Mom's Shovel will not disappear if it is left on a pedestal, and Isaac leaves and re-enters the room it was left in.
* Like ⟦i:84¦We Need To Go Deeper!⟧, this item can be used to destroy rocks if used while Isaac is flying over a rock.
* ⟨24⟩ This item can be obtained by using ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ on ⟦i:553¦Mucormycosis⟧ without obtaining the Broken Shovels.
* ⟨24⟩ The full Mom's Shovel can be found within the area of ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧. Even without unlocking the item, its effect can potentially be activated by ⟦i:488¦Metronome⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire spore tears that stick to enemies and blow up after a few seconds, dealing damage and poisoning nearby enemies and releasing more spores.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a 25% chance to shoot a spore that, in addition to dealing damage, will stick to enemies.
** The chance is not affected by Luck.
* Spores will explode 2.5 seconds after sticking to an enemy, dealing 5 damage to and poisoning nearby enemies and firing four more spores in a cross pattern.
** Spores produced from Isaac's spores have homing.
** The spore effects will not damage Isaac.
items.notes:
* Items that deal continuous damage such as ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧, and ⟦i:152¦Technology 2⟧ will apply spores to enemies as well, despite the absence of tears.
* Spores can stick to Frozen enemies, and will act normally.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Enemies near Isaac are afflicted with fear. ⟨16⟩ Grants +0.5 tears and +0.2 shot speed.
items.effects:
* Applies fear to enemies in a small radius around Isaac.
* ⟨16⟩ +0.5 fire rate.
* ⟨16⟩ +0.2 shot speed.
items.notes: * 2Spooky can be used to manipulate ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧. Once Greed Gapers spawn and Ultra Greed is in his resistance stance, the gapers will be feared when getting close, leaving the boss unable to move or damage Isaac.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spends 5 pennies to grant +1.2 damage for the current room. Grants 5 pennies when picked up for the first time.
items.effects:
* Upon use, spends 5 pennies and grants +1.2 damage for the current room.
** The effect can be stacked.
** If Isaac has fewer than 5 coins, nothing happens.
* Grants 5 pennies upon being picked up for the first time.
items.notes:
* Using the item will give Isaac's tears a golden tint that becomes more noticeable with each use, up to a maximum of three times. This effect is purely cosmetic.
* When unlocking the item, coins do not actually have to be spent, just removed. Actions such as donating to a Donation Machine or items like ⟦i:295¦Magic Fingers⟧ will also count as long as the coin amount goes from 99 to 0.
** Similarly, losing coins by getting damaged by ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧ or similar enemies counts as spending coins when it comes to unlocking Golden Razor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ for the current room.
items.effects:
* Upon activation, Isaac is turned into a demon and gains the effects of ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ for the current room.
** If Sulfur has already been used in the current room, it instead gives Isaac a 1.2x damage multiplier, +1 damage, and increases the size of the laser for the current room.
*** Further uses of Sulfur will increase Isaac's damage by 1.
items.notes:
* Sulfur functions identically to ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧. For a full list of interactions, see that page.
* Sulfur is extremely powerful in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, since it can be used multiple times in the same arena.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.
items.effects: * Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.
items.notes:
* Ironically, this item is unaffected by Luck.
* On its own, this item is considerably worse at generating Cards, Runes, and Soul Hearts than ⟦i:158¦Crystal Ball⟧; Fortune Cookie produces 1 per 7.4 charges on average, while Crystal Ball produces 1 per 6 charges guaranteed. However, with ⟦i:116¦9 Volt⟧, Fortune Cookie produces 1 per 3.7 charges on average, nearly twice as often as Crystal Ball.
** If you include the chance of trinkets generating, then Fortune Cookie will produce 1 per 6.6 charges, or 1 per 3.3 charges with 9 Volt.
* ⟦p:dice-shard¦Dice Shard⟧, ⟦p:emergency-contact¦Emergency Contact⟧, and ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧ can be generated by this item.
* Using this item in a room with enemies, spikes, or other hazards can often make it difficult to see what is happening, as nearly half of the player's screen may be covered by a fortune. This can be circumvented by pausing the game and waiting for the fortune to disappear.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Causes Isaac to occasionally fire extra tears in random directions while shooting.
items.effects:
* When Isaac shoots, he has a chance to fire 1-3 additional tears in random directions.
** The chance to fire extra tears is unaffected by luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Repeatedly zaps enemies that are close to Isaac.
items.effects:
* Repeatedly zaps enemies that are in close proximity to Isaac with electricity beams for light damage.
** Enemies can be zapped up to five times per second, with each zap dealing 0.75× Isaac's damage.
** Each zap can hit up to 4 enemies, if they are sufficiently close to each other.
** If the floor is wet, such as in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧, ⟦s:flooded-caves¦Flooded Caves⟧, some rooms in ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧, ⟦s:scarred-womb¦Scarred Womb⟧, and ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧, as well as under the effect of ⟦i:291¦Flush!⟧, the initial distance is unchanged, but enemy-to-enemy arcs reach further.
** Trigger range appears to be approximately two tiles wide — it's possible to zap an enemy standing directly on the other side of a rock.
items.notes: * This item has a brief targeting delay, such that enemies can close in and touch Isaac before they start getting zapped.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Releases a ring of tears and increases fire rate for the current room when Isaac takes damage. ⟨16⟩ Isaac's tears also leave pools of red creep for the rest of the room.
items.effects:
* Taking damage causes Isaac to release a ring of 10 tears and gain tears up for the current room. ⟨16⟩ For the rest of the room, Isaac's tears, including the initial ring of tears, leave pools of red creep where they land.
** The first hit taken increases Isaac's tears fired per second by 1.2, then by 0.4 for every subsequent hit in the same room. This ignores the tears cap and can stack indefinitely.
** Each tear in the ring deals 10 damage and doesn't use Isaac's tear effects.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: DMG down + tears up + you feel nutty
items.description: Quadruples fire rate, with ×0.3 damage multiplier. Each tear is given a random effect that alters its movement.
items.effects:
* Quadruples fire rate.
* ×0.3 damage multiplier.
* -0.16 tear size.
* Each tear gains the effects of either ⟦t:12¦Flat Worm⟧, ⟦t:9¦Pulse Worm⟧, ⟦t:10¦Wiggle Worm⟧, ⟦t:26¦Hook Worm⟧, ⟦t:11¦Ring Worm⟧, ⟦t:27¦Whip Worm⟧, ⟦t:66¦Lazy Worm⟧, ⟦t:65¦Tape Worm⟧, ⟦t:96¦Ouroboros Worm⟧, ⟦t:144¦Brain Worm⟧, ⟦i:221¦Rubber Cement⟧, ⟦i:5¦My Reflection⟧ or ⟦i:233¦Tiny Planet⟧ at random.
** Some tears may have multiple effects at once.
** These inherit the movement, shot speed, range, and spectral effects, but not changes to tears or damage.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Prevents Isaac's attributes from being lowered.
items.effects:
* Prevents Isaac's attributes from falling below their highest values reached.
** Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use Isaac's current stats, items and effects will impact Isaac the same way they would as if he did not have Rock Bottom.
items.notes:
* Health downs do not count as stat downgrades for Rock Bottom.
* Temporary buffs work normally, though they may make reaching new best values harder after the buff has worn off.
** For example, using ⟦i:34¦The Book of Belial⟧ to gain +2 damage will stay in effect indefinitely, but while it's not currently activated, Isaac must earn more than +2 damage from other items to see a difference. The Book of Belial can then be used once again to stack on top of that new floor, so the damage "lost" to make up for the original temporary bonus isn't really wasted.
** Stacking as many temporary buffs at once as possible may be helpful to reach particularly high values.
** Temporary positive multipliers are not retained, only the values reached through them are.
* Stat penalties are accounted for, causing increased difficulty of reaching new best values.
** Optimally, any available increases to a particular stat should be taken before taking the item that lowers it.
** Permanent negative multipliers, such as ⟦i:330¦Soy Milk⟧, work as expected: after the internal damage value is dropped to 0.2×, it would require over 5× increase in damage from other items and effects afterwards to start increasing the best value again.
* If Rock Bottom is removed, Isaac's stats will no longer be locked and return to match his current items/effects.

items.description: Spawns a familiar that chases enemies. After killing enough enemies, it becomes more powerful but will also try to hurt Isaac. Dealing enough damage to it returns it to normal.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that chases nearby enemies and deals 2 contact damage to them per tick (~8.57 per second).
* After killing 15 enemies, Blood Puppy becomes angry, and changes in the following ways:
** Deals 7.5 damage per tick instead of 2 (15 per second, or 90 per second while charging).
** Charges at enemies that are aligned with it in the cardinal directions.
*** If Blood Puppy charges into a live Bomb, it will get caught on its mouth, preventing it from moving until it explodes.
** Drops a Half Red Heart for every 10 enemies it kills.
** Will also try to attack Isaac, dealing a half heart of contact damage to him.
** Can be damaged by Isaac, returning it to normal after it takes enough damage. Blood Puppy has 20 health and 90 armor (effective health is ~140-180).
* After getting 25 more kills (40 total), the angry version evolves, gaining the following modifications:
** Becomes much larger and deals 15 damage per tick instead of 7.5 (30 per second, or 180 per second while charging).
** Destroys obstacles it runs into while charging.
** Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac instead of half a heart.
** Drops a Red Heart after every 10 kills instead of a half red heart.
** Has 50 health instead of 20 (effective health is ~400-500).
* Each boss killed by Blood Puppy counts as killing 4 enemies.
items.notes:
* Blood Puppy appears in the Bestiary as a type of monster if Isaac turns it back to normal after it becomes angry. This is required to complete the Bestiary.
* Blood Puppy is not targeted by other familiars while it is angry.
** Blue Flies and other familiars that deal contact damage will still damage Blood Puppy if they happen to collide.
** ⟦i:527¦Mr. ME!⟧ will target Blood Puppy if the crosshair targets nothing and there are no enemies in the room, and has a chance to do so if there are enemies in the room.
* Since Bombs ignore armor, a single bomb will tame the Blood Puppy.
* Stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy are an enemy for all intents and purposes, similar to ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧. This means it can be affected by, for example, the slow effect of ⟦i:337¦Broken Watch⟧.
* Friendly Blood Puppies will spawn beside Isaac when he enters a new room, while hostile ones will spawn in the middle or opposite ends of the room.
* Once a hostile Blood Puppy spawns, it might start targeting Isaac, ignoring any enemies it may have spawned on top of. This can be dangerous, as you may unexpectedly get cornered from multiple sides right as you enter a room.
* Starting the ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ or ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧ fight while Blood Puppy is angry can be dangerous, as it will let Blood Puppy attack Isaac while he is unable to move during the boss's spawning animation.
* Level 2 Willo will orbit angry Blood Puppy.

items.description: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the contents of the upcoming floor's Treasure Room, as well as the floor's boss. Grants a Half Soul Heart when entering a new floor.
items.effects:
* During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the item that will be found in the Treasure Room and what Boss will be at the end of the floor.
** items will be revealed, as well as the hidden second item on the alternate floors (⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧, etc.)
* Grants a Half Soul Heart upon entering a new floor (this includes each floor of the Ascent).
items.notes:
* On floors, both items and bosses are shown.
* If the floor Isaac is going to has no Treasure Rooms, Dream Catcher will simply show the floor's boss. If there are no Treasure Rooms or bosses on the floor (i.e. in ⟦s:greed-mode¦The Shop⟧, ⟦s:greed-mode¦Ultra Greed⟧, and ⟦s:home¦Home⟧), the dream will instantly be skipped.
* Dream Catcher cannot show glitched items generated by ⟦i:721¦TMTRAINER⟧. Instead, it will just show ⟦i:1¦The Sad Onion⟧.
* Dream Catcher will show a poop in the Treasure Room if there are no item pedestals in the room.
* On ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ II, the boss will appear as a blank space; on the special ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II floor that leads to ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, it will appear as ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧.
* On ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, the Dream Catcher will show all the bosses that can be found in the various boss rooms, starting with ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧.
* ⟨16⟩ When holding Dream Catcher, the dream sequence is unskippable, except when entering ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧.

items.description: Gives Isaac a familiar that grants +0.4 Fire Rate for each consecutive room he's cleared without taking damage. The bonus stacks up to five times.
items.effects: * Gives Isaac a candle familiar that grants a Fire Rate bonus of +0.4 for each room cleared in a row without taking damage, which stacks up to 5 times (Max. +2 Fire Rate), represented by how brightly the flame burns. Starts at 1 stack, and resets to zero if damage is taken.
items.notes:
* The Fire Rate bonus can exceed the normal Fire Rate cap.
** Any self-damage, such as from Curse Rooms, Sacrifice Rooms, the Bad Trip pill, spiked chests, and self-damaging items such as ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧, won't reset the bonus.
* Clearing waves in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ will give the candle charges as if you cleared rooms.
* Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Paschal Candle having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Double tapping a fire key creates a shield that pushes away enemies and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers.
items.effects:
* Double tapping a fire key creates a Divine Shield that slowly moves in the chosen direction.
* The Divine Shield has a variety of effects.
** Enemies are pushed back in the opposite direction, completely reversing their trajectory with some added momentum.
*** Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.
** Enemy tears are reflected, dealing damage back to enemies depending on the source of the tear.
*** The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
*** Reflected projectiles do not gain Tear effects from Isaac.
**** Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle) explode as normal, dealing as much damage as they would have.
**** Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. Shady) can harm Isaac and be reflected.
**** Homing projectiles (e.g. from Psychic Horf) do not retain their homing effect after being reflected.
*** Can reflect:
**** Fire projectiles (e.g. from ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧).
**** Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti, dealing a flat 35 damage.
*** Does not reflect:
**** Lines of fire (e.g. from Dragon Fly), but can reflect fireballs (e.g. from Crackle) and their lines of fire do not harm Isaac.
**** Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.
** Enemy ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers are reflected, dealing 7 damage per tick (105 damage per second) to enemies hit by the reflection. It can even deflect the colossal brimstone laser fired by ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧.
*** White beams, such as those used by ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧ in its second phase, are reflected into ⟦i:643¦Revelation⟧ beams.
* The shield lasts 1 second and has a cooldown of 3 seconds.
items.notes:
* If any charged item is obtained along with Divine Intervention e.g. ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ or Revelation, a different fire key may be pressed to put out the shield without forfeiting the charge of said item.
* The Blindfolded status from certain challenges disables the ability to fire, which also disables the ability to double tap to fire Divine Shields.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his Red Hearts. Increases damage and speed for the floor based on the amount drained.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor if Isaac has more than a Half Red Heart. This drains as much red health as possible without killing him, leaving a half red heart if Isaac only had red health, or none at all if Isaac has soul/black/bone hearts.
* For the rest of the floor, Isaac gains extra damage and speed for each heart lost. The amount of damage gained this way is quadratic, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
** The exact formula is about +(0.15 * HeartsLost ^ 2) damage and +(0.1 * HeartsLost) speed, where HeartsLost is the total hearts of damage taken from Blood Oath (half a heart counts as 0.5).
items.notes:
* Although the animation is only a single stab when the effect is triggered, it's treated as taking damage one time per half heart lost, leading to synergies with items that activate upon taking damage.
* The damage from Blood Oath can be avoided with invincibility, but will not provide any damage and speed increase. That's a useful strategy for the .
* Eternal Hearts give the health up before Blood Oath stabs Isaac, so the new heart is also drained.
* Rotten Hearts are only counted as half a red heart each.
* If Isaac has only Rotten Hearts, blood oath will leave Isaac at aHalf Red Heart, the final rotten heart taken will still give stats equivalent to a Half Red Heart
**This effect causes ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧ to trigger unconditionally when Blood Oath is activated
* ⟦p:xi-strength¦XI - Strength⟧ can be activated at the start of a floor before Blood Oath triggers to have one more heart counted in the bonus.
* If Isaac has half a red heart or less, the effect will not trigger, even if Isaac has soul/black hearts.
* Blood Oath also drains the health of ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, leaving their health at one coin heart.
* The damage caused by Blood Oath does not lower the chance for a Devil Room or Angel Room to appear.
* While playing as ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, red health will not be drained if ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧ is being controlled when Blood Oath triggers.
* If Blood Oath is removed (such as with ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧), any existing damage and speed bonuses will remain until the next floor.
** The damage and speed bonuses are removed after defeating ⟦e:the-lamb¦The Lamb⟧ and refusing a Victory Lap, or upon coming back from obtaining ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧.
* Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Blood Oath having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* The maximum achievable amounts of stats are +20 damage and +1.15 speed if starting the floor with 12 filled normal red hearts (of which only 11.5 are drained), or +21.8 and +1.2 if there is at least one Bone Heart (which allows all hearts to be drained).

items.description: Grants multicolored tears. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect.

** Red: 2x damage, ⟦i:257¦Fire Mind⟧, or Petrify

*** Does not gain 3x damage, effectively making it a damage down.
** Light Blue: Slow, and Freeze on kill
** Green: Poison
** Yellow: Fear
** Orange: Bait
items.notes: * The color of the tears from Playdough Cookie are not based on luck, but their individual effects are. (e.g. Red ⟦i:257¦Fire Mind⟧ tears will always explode at 13 Luck.)

* This item replaces Isaac's regular white aura with a dimmer purple one which lowers visibility in .

items.description: A familiar burrows in Isaac's head, firing 4 slowing tears. Upon taking damage, there's a chance it will burst out of Isaac's head, spawning blue spiders and chasing enemies for the current room.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a spider familiar that burrows in Isaac's head, firing four slowing tears in addition to Isaac's normal tears.
** The slowing tears deal 1.5 damage each, and fired every 1.5 seconds.
** These tears are unaffected by Isaac's damage and tears stats; they have fixed damage and fire rate.
* Upon taking damage, there is a chance that Isaac's head will pop, spawning friendly spiders, and release the Intruder familiar, who will leap at enemies to deal contact damage, and fires four slowing tears towards nearby enemies instead of Isaac.
** The spider familiar deals up to 4.5 contact damage depending on how fast it's moving and fires slowing tears twice as fast compared to when it's in Isaac's head.
** The chance for activation goes up to 100% at 4 luck.
** The familiar lasts for the current room, and Isaac's head is reattached upon entering a new room.
items.notes:

* If The Intruder is released after ⟦i:107¦The Pinking Shears⟧ are used, control is given back to an invisible head with only a shadow visible. This is due to both the head (the spider) and the body being mobilized to attack.

items.description: Destroying poop spawns Dip Familiars that follow Isaac and damage enemies. Destroying different types of poop spawns different Dips with special effects.
items.effects:
* Converts all enemy Dips and Drips into Dip Familiars.
* Rocks have a chance to be replaced with poop when generated.
** The formula to calculate the chance is: \mathit{Chance} = \mathit{Luck} \times 0.5 + 6.25, capped at 10% at 7.5 Luck.
* Destroying Poops spawn 1-4 Dip Familiars, which loosely follow Isaac around, block enemy shots, and deal contact damage to enemies.
** Dips deal contact damage to enemies equal to the damage Isaac had at the time it spawned, and can deal up to 2 ticks of contact damage and/or block 2 shots before dying.
* Destroying different types of poop will spawn special Dips:
** Corny Poops create Corny Dips that spawn 1 Blue Fly on death.
*** Brownie Dips spawned by ⟦e:brownie¦Brownie⟧ and ⟦e:dangle¦Dangle⟧ have the same behavior.
** Red Poops create Red Dips that deal twice as much damage and autonomously charge at enemies, but automatically die after 15 seconds.
** Golden Poops create Gold Dips that have a chance to inflict the ⟦i:202¦Midas' Touch⟧ effect on enemies they hit. They can also take 5 hits before being destroyed, at which point they will drop 2-3 random coins.
** Rainbow Poops create Rainbow Dips that charm enemies they hit and have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart on death.
** Black Poops create Black Dips that leave a trail of slowing creep.
** White Poops create White Dips that recreate the effect of ⟦i:543¦Hallowed Ground⟧ and can take 3 hits before being destroyed.
* Poops unique to ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧ and ⟦i:725¦IBS⟧ also spawn Dips with special effects:
** Stone Poops create Rock Dips that deal an additional 3.5 damage per hit and can take 6 hits before dying instead of 2.
** Stinky Poops create Stinky Dips that release toxic gas as they move and a larger cloud of toxic gas when they die.
*** The toxic gas does 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (~1.2x Isaac's damage per second) and poisons enemies; clouds left behind while alive last 1.5 seconds and the cloud created on death lasts 8 seconds.
** Fire Poops create Flaming Dips that burn enemies they hit and leave behind a fire when they die.
*** The burn deals 3.5 damage up to 6 times, and the fire deals 8 damage at full durability, 6 after taking 1 hit, and 4 otherwise, for a maximum of 22 damage.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:brownie¦Brownie⟧.
* The familiars are destroyed by Bombs, making them very easy to destroy when trying to blow up walls or rocks.
* Familiars remain if this item is lost (re-rolled, etc.).
* Enemies that charge towards Isaac, such as ⟦e:gurdy-jr¦Gurdy Jr.⟧, can deflect off of friendly Dips in unpredictable directions.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: A king's fortune... but at what cost?
items.description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.
items.effects:
* Upon use, summons a sword that hangs directly above Isaac. As long as the sword hangs above Isaac, all item pedestals are doubled, spawning an additional free item next to them.
** Items spawned via other means, like Machines, Beggars, and certain items and cards, are also doubled.
** The extra item will be pulled from the current room's item pool, even if the original item is from a different pool (ex. Beggars or items from ⟦i:585¦Alabaster Box⟧).
* After Isaac takes damage (with exceptions, see below) once with the item activated, at any time with only a brief warning, the sword may fall, instantly killing Isaac regardless of his health. The sword has a 1/10000 chance every 4 game ticks (every 0.133 seconds) to fall, so on average, 50% of all Damocles runs will not drop the sword until after at least 15 minutes and 24 seconds have passed.
** Self-damage (such as from a Blood Donation Machine, Devil Beggar, Curse Room, Sacrifice Room, Spiked Chest, Bad Trip pill, or self-damage Active Items) does not count as damage taken for Damocles, and will not give it the chance to fall.
items.notes:
* The chance for the sword to fall does not increase beyond the first hit taken.
* Items from Chests will not be doubled, which greatly limits Damocles' benefit in Chapter 6.
** The exception to this is Mega Chests, which will spawn one extra item alongside the 2 original items for a total of 3 items.
* In scenarios that have multiple items to choose from (such as rare double Treasure Room layouts and Boss Rush), an additional set of items for Isaac to choose from spawns. Only one item from each set can be taken.
* In alternate path treasure rooms, one item from the second set is known.
* Having multiple Damocles active at once does not spawn additional items.
* The only way Isaac can survive the falling sword is if he's invincible at the time it falls or, by technicality, with a respawn item. After the sword falls, extra items will no longer spawn.
** Losing a life before the sword falls does not remove the sword or its threat.
* Items with associated costs, like those in Devil Rooms or Shops, will not create additional items. This severely limits this item's benefit when used as ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, since most items that are normally created as pedestals are instead Shop items.
* This can cause items that are in inaccessible spots in certain room layouts to be moved to a more convenient location due to not having space for two pedestals in that spot. It can also cause items to move to less convenient spots.
* ⟨16⟩ Damocles' quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.
