items.description: Creates a large pool of yellow creep beneath Isaac.
items.effects:
* Spawns a pool of Lemonade similar to the Lemon Party pill effect underneath Isaac.
** The creep deals 8 damage per tick (24 per second) and lasts ~19 seconds.
items.notes: * ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:peep¦Peep⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Instead of tears, Isaac swings a sword. Charging does a spin attack and fires a projectile, and a projectile is sometimes fired with normal swings if Isaac has no empty Red Heart Containers.
items.effects:
* Replaces Isaac's tears with a sword he can swing in front of him.
** The swing does 3x Isaac's damage +3.5 and deals knockback to both enemies and Isaac if it hits.
** The sword can be swung as rapidly as the fire button can be tapped.
** The sword swing can collect pickups and open chests.
* If Isaac's total health is equal to or greater than his number of Red Heart Containers (same rule as regular Challenge Rooms), the sword fires a projectile when swung.
** The projectile deals damage equal to Isaac's damage +2, and has a cooldown equal to 2x Isaac's normal tear rate.
* Holding an attack button charges a spin attack, ready when the sword flashes, which damages all enemies around Isaac. It also deflects enemy projectiles, which can damage enemies who get hit, and launches a projectile with higher shot speed regardless of Isaac's current health.
** The circular swing deals 8x Isaac's damage +10, and the projectile created from it deals 4x Isaac's damage +4. It can also collect pickups and open chests.
** The charge time is based on Isaac's tears stat, at ~4x Isaac's normal tear rate.
** While charging, the sword will damage the first enemy that contacts it. This will cancel the spin attack.
** Swinging the sword normally while performing the circular swing cancels it.
items.notes:
* Unlike most charge attacks, the direction of the attack can't be changed by pressing and holding a different attack button then releasing the old one. Instead, it will stay pointing the same direction until all attack buttons are released, either doing nothing or using the spin attack, or the sword touches and damages an enemy, dealing sword slash damage.
* Spirit Sword can be used to open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests without taking damage.
* Range upgrades move the hitbox of the sword forwards, including the spin attack. Enough range upgrades can leave a large blind spot directly in front of the sword.
* Only the projectile and spin attack are affected by tear rate, not the normal sword swing, meaning that items that increase damage but decrease tear rate, such as ⟦i:169¦Polyphemus⟧ and ⟦i:310¦Eve's Mascara⟧, are much more effective when only using the swing. Additionally, items that do the inverse, such as ⟦i:330¦Soy Milk⟧ and ⟦i:561¦Almond Milk⟧; are not as effective when only using the swing.
* Spirit Sword will deflect ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧'s Fistula attack and will send it right back at her, entering a short sequence that allows to deal bonus damage, if executed correctly; see this ⟦e:mother¦page⟧ for more details.
* Spirit Sword is overridden by the Blindfolded effect, as seen while playing as ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ or in challenges like .
* Having 30 or more tear rate performs the swing attack automatically.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Creates a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall, indicated by the outline of a door. These rooms have a 10% chance to be a special room.
items.effects:
* Upon use, creates a Red Room next to a wall where there would be no conditions that could prevent a room from spawning there (i.e., the same conditions for a Secret Room to spawn). This is indicated by red door outlines on walls.
* These rooms are most commonly normal rooms, but have a 10% chance to be a special room instead, even including Red Devil Rooms or Angel Rooms.
** Red special rooms of any kind can appear on every floor.
* These rooms use a special Red Room icon on the map.
items.notes:
* The types of special rooms that a Red Room can be are the following:
* All rooms made by Red Key will be 1x1 rooms that can have doors available on all sides.
* All doors within a Red Room will be unlocked or opened, regardless of the room type they lead to. This can open Secret Rooms, and normally inaccessible Challenge Rooms if they are adjacent to a Red Room. Red Room doors will also stay permanently open in the case of Challenge Rooms.
* In ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, Isaac can create a "Red Room" on the left side of the map right under Mom's room. This room will actually be a closet containing a non-tainted character's Tainted form.
** If the respective Tainted character has already been found or a Tainted character is played, the room will contain ⟦i:688¦Inner Child⟧ instead. If Inner Child has not been unlocked, the room will contain a Shopkeeper.
** ⟨16⟩ In Online Co-Op, each player will unlock the Tainted version of the character they are playing as, regardless of whether they are alive or not, and if they are alive, they will also see the correct character, else seeing the host's character. However, if the host is playing as a Tainted character, the room will not contain any Tainted characters even if other players have not found their respective Tainted character, and the character will not be unlocked for anyone.
* If a door created by Red Key takes Isaac outside of the 13x13 area of the floor, he will be taken to the I AM ERROR room.
** The starting room of a floor is always in the center of the 13x13 area.
** This does not occur in ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ II, ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧, ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧, ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, or the special version of ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II containing ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧. No door outlines will appear at any boundary walls.
*** Additionally, this doesn't work during .
** The I AM ERROR room door can only be created while already inside a Red Room. Normal rooms will not show the red outline if they are at the map's boundary.
* Special Red Rooms can be versions that aren't normally encountered without a specific item or character.
** These include:
*** ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧'s Shops, which can additionally contain items from the Boss and Treasure Room pools, and offer trinkets for sale.
*** ⟦i:599¦Voodoo Head⟧'s Curse Rooms.
*** ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧'s ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ Arcades.
*** ⟦i:414¦More Options⟧' double item Treasure Rooms.
*** ⟦t:112¦Pay to Win⟧'s Shop Restock Machine Treasure Rooms.
*** ⟦i:414¦More Options⟧' and ⟦t:112¦Pay to Win⟧'s combined double item Treasure Rooms with a Shop Restock Machine.
** These do not include:
*** ⟦t:174¦Number Magnet⟧'s Devil Rooms.
*** ⟦i:586¦The Stairway⟧'s Angel Rooms.
*** ⟦t:146¦Devil's Crown⟧'s Devil Treasure Rooms.
* Red Key can't overwrite Secret Rooms or Super Secret Rooms. This can be used to discern their locations by finding walls that don't have red door outlines that would otherwise be valid Red Room spots.
* Red Key can't create a room adjacent to the Boss Room on most floors, with some exceptions:
** Red Key can create a room adjacent to ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧'s room in the top right where the room that leads to ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ usually generates. The door to this looks like a crack. This Red Room can only be created when Isaac is in another Red Room adjacent to it, i.e. from branching off one of the Treasure Room.
*** Isaac can enter Hush's room from this crack, but going the other direction will lead him to the Entrance Portal room.
*** Isaac also can't create Red Rooms adjacent to the Shop on this floor either.
** Red Key can create rooms adjacent to most Boss Rooms in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, including ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧'s room. This can be used to find a Boss Room door leading to what would be an empty space (though this may find ⟦e:mr-fred¦Mr. Fred⟧ instead).
** Red Key can create rooms adjacent to the Boss Room in the Mirrored World of ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II.
** Red Key can create rooms adjacent to the first Boss Room if takes effect on the floor.
* When Isaac enters any Red Room adjacent to the Ultra Secret Room, it immediately appears on the map along with the Secret Room jingle, and its door will automatically open.
* If Isaac encounters a Red special room, all of its doors will be its special theme doors.
** All doors in a Red Curse Room still feature spikes, which will damage Isaac if he decides to enter/exit.
** A Red Vault's doors or a Red Dice Room's doors each require two keys to open. The door where Isaac uses Red Key will be automatically unlocked, but the other doors remain locked until Isaac goes through them from inside or unlocks them from outside.
* Multiple Red special rooms of the same type can spawn on one floor.
* All Red Sacrifice Rooms will have their own independent use counters and rewards.
* If Isaac has a teleport to a specific room (⟦p:xvii-the-stars¦XVII - The Stars⟧, ⟦p:ix-the-hermit¦IX - The Hermit⟧, ⟦i:419¦Teleport 2.0⟧, etc.) and has created a special room such that there are multiple of a certain type on one floor, the teleport will choose randomly between each room.
** However, if Isaac has found a Red Planetarium, XVII - The Stars will always teleport Isaac to it over any Treasure Rooms.
* It is possible to obtain ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ outside of the intended method by spawning the Treasure Room that contains it in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧.
** Red Rooms in Downpour/Dross can contain White Fire Places as well.
* Isaac is able to create Red Rooms in the Mirrored World of ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II. They will be reflections of the original floor's Red Rooms, and special rooms created in this way will still be empty.
* Red Rooms can't be created around the Mine Cart Room of ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ / ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ II.
** Red Rooms on these floors can contain the yellow buttons used to build the mine cart track; however, these ones do nothing.
* Red Rooms in Chapter 3 can contain Marked Skulls even before the Ascent is unlocked.
* When in ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ or ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧, their spawn room containing their respective chests can be created by Red Key. These will function the same way regular chests of their respective type would on Dark Room/Chest outside the starting room.
** New ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ doors can't be found in these rooms.
* Red Treasure Rooms will be present in the Ascent, and will not replace regular Treasure Rooms.
* If a red Sacrifice Room appears in the ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ and Isaac teleports via the 12th or higher sacrifice, Isaac will be sent back to the starting room without restarting the floor.
* If a red Sacrifice Room appears in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, then it is possible to defeat ⟦e:the-lamb¦The Lamb⟧ after taking the path through ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧. This makes it possible, without the use of ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧, to get up to 8 Completion Marks in the same run if playing quickly.
* Red Key can be obtained by using ⟦i:297¦Pandora's Box⟧ at ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
* ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧, ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧, and ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧ can spawn in red Mini-Boss Rooms.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with eight ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧s.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a fly orbital familiar that seeks out incoming enemy shots and destroys them.
items.effects:
* Spawns a fly orbital familiar that chases and blocks enemy shots.
** After a certain amount of shots are blocked, it enters a short cooldown period where it still blocks shots, but does not actively chase them.
* Psy Fly also deals 1 contact damage to enemies per tick (15 per second).
* Instantly kills some Fly enemies upon contact.
** Flies affected include: Army Fly, Attack Fly, Fly, Ring Fly, Swarm, and Willo.
items.notes:
* While Psy Fly is an effective means of projectile protection, it is not immunity, and recklessly wading into a barrage of shots can easily result in taking damage.
* Psy Fly will block most types of projectiles, not just red bullets. This includes the fires from ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ phase 2, the bone projectiles Bonies throw, ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ shots from Gurgles and similar enemies, or even the rocks that the Kineti throws at you.
** ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ shots still explode if blocked by Psy Fly.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: Tears up. A mind changing experience!
items.description: Increases tears, decreases speed, and distorts the screen. All effects become more pronounced with repeated use, and wear off by clearing rooms.
items.effects:
* Upon use, grants +0.75 fire rate, -0.03 speed, and distorts the screen and background music. The effects can be stacked in the same room, and the distortion becomes more pronounced with repeated use. After repeated uses, the colors begin to turn very bright and intense.
** Each use increases the recharge time, which starts at 0.5 seconds with the 1st use, and ends with 15 seconds on the 9th use. After the 10th use, it no longer recharges automatically though it can be recharged and used even more through Lil' Batteries.
** Leaving the room doubles the speed penalty and multiplies the fire rate bonus by x0.4, for the uses in that room.
** Clearing a room removes one use's worth of penalties and bonuses, giving +0.06 speed and -0.3 fire rate.
** Isaac's costume will change the stronger the Item's effects get.
items.notes: * This item can very rarely drop from destroying mushrooms in the Secret Room.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +5 Bombs. If Isaac is currently firing, placing a bomb will instead shoot a fast-moving, explosive rocket in the direction he's facing.
items.effects:
* Adds 5 Bombs.
* If any firing input is given when placing a bomb, a fast-moving, explosive rocket will be shot in the direction corresponding to the input.
** The rockets accept analog firing input. This means they can be shot diagonally or in any other angle with a mouse or joystick.
** Isaac will place a regular bomb if no firing input is received.
items.notes:
* Rockets use Isaac's bomb synergies like his bombs normally would.
* Rockets are unaffected by Isaac's shot speed.
* Rockets can be boosted by ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers and ⟦i:726¦Hemoptysis⟧ sneezes.
* Bosses such as ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧ or ⟦e:carrion-queen¦Carrion Queen⟧ can swallow the rockets just like regular bombs.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Passively causes active items to spawn themed orbital wisp familiars on use, which fire tears and block shots. Can be activated to spawn a basic wisp if Isaac has no other active item.
items.effects:
* Upon use, spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac and fires small spectral tears alongside him. The wisps can block shots and deal contact damage to enemies, but take damage when doing so and will be destroyed when enough damage is taken.
** When a wisp is destroyed, the sound of fire being extinguished plays.
*** A normal wisp is white and blue, has 2 health and spectral tears which deal 3 damage, and is summoned in the middle ring.
*** A wisp's health can be represented by its size, shrinking as its health decreases.
*** Most wisps deal contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage. Doing damage this way usually destroys the wisp unless Isaac is invulnerable.
** Multiple wisps can exist at once. Some combinations have an upper limit of 26 wisps: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.
* If another active item is picked up, Book of Virtues will become a passive item that causes active items to spawn wisps when used, often with special effects.
* While held, changes the first Devil Room encountered to be an Angel Room, and increases the chance of an Angel Room appearing by 25%.
** Allows for Angel Rooms to appear even if a Deal with the Devil was taken before.
items.notes:
* It is the only passive item in the Library pool.
** If Isaac walks into a library for the first time with ⟦t:88¦NO!⟧, The Book of Virtues is very likely to appear.
** Because of this, when acquired from a library, the book cannot be rerolled by use of the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:283¦D100⟧, a Dice Room, or getting hit as ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧.
* Whenever Isaac is invulnerable, the wisps are as well, but can still deal contact damage.
* Summoning a wisp while at the maximum will replace the most damaged wisp.
* While having 100% chance of Angel Room discovery, Isaac will not get teleported to a Devil Room by using some items which allow it. Instead, he will be teleported to the Angel Room, keeping his 100% chance of discovering an Angel Room. This can be used to get to the Angel Room on the first floor, where Devil/Angel Rooms do not naturally spawn, and still keep the 100% chance for the next floor.
* This item's passive effects also apply to active items in the consumable slot. (e.g. ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧'s ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧, ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧'s ⟦i:722¦Anima Sola⟧, dice from ⟦t:154¦Dice Bag⟧, etc.)
* While the item can function as both passive and active item, it is treated as a passive item by ⟦t:88¦NO!⟧, ⟦i:477¦Void⟧, and ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧.
* This item is displayed in the Extra HUD as a passive item.
** It will take up one of ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧'s limited item slots.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Upon use, spawns three Soul Hearts and two Angel Room items and is consumed. Starts with no charges, and can only be charged by picking up 6 Soul Hearts.
items.effects:
* This item starts with no charges. Rather than gaining charges by clearing rooms or picking up batteries, Alabaster Box has to be charged through Soul or Black Hearts. Instead of being added to Isaac's health bar, they charge the box at a rate of one charge per half heart.
* Both Soul or Black Hearts that are picked up, or directly added to Isaac's health will count towards Alabaster Box's charges.
* Upon use, Alabaster Box is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory, spawning three Soul Hearts and two items from the Angel Room item pool.
** There's a small chance for each of the spawned Soul Hearts to be replaced with an Eternal Heart.
** If a Devil Deal was taken previously, it spawns only two Soul Hearts and one Angel Room item instead.
items.notes:
* If Isaac takes a Devil Deal that requires Soul Hearts while holding a charged Alabaster Box, hearts are taken from the box before it takes from Isaac's health.
* ⟨15⟩ If Isaac has a full HP bar, and he has either Soul or Black Hearts in his health pool, picking up Bone Hearts will take away 2 charges from Alabaster Box each, instead of replacing any Soul/Black Hearts as they normally would. Bone Hearts will only replace health if the Alabaster Box has no charges.
** If Isaac picks up a Bone Heart at max HP while the Alabaster Box only has 1 charge, then it will take away both that 1 charge and half of a whole Soul/Black Heart (half hearts are unaffected).
* If ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ picks up a Black Heart the box will not gain any charges.
* If the box requires two or more charges and Isaac picks up a Black Heart, the box gains charge as for a Soul Heart and the last Soul Heart (or half Soul Heart, if there is one) in Isaac's health becomes black.
* If the box requires only one more charge and Isaac picks up a full Soul Heart or a Black Heart, then the box becomes fully charged and a half heart of the same type is added to Isaac's health.
* If sleeping in a bed would restore Soul Hearts, they are used to charge the Alabaster Box instead. Any excess are added as Soul Hearts as normal.
** This applies to ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, who is always in the state to recover Soul Hearts, even if usually without effect.
* Soul hearts from Blended Heart can also be used to charge the box. They are, as usual, used for red health first.
* Bulbs are able to drain charges from Alabaster Box.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: May you get what you came for
items.description: Generates a ladder at the start of every floor that leads to a unique Angel Room shop.
items.effects:
* At the start of every floor, generates a ladder which leads to a special Angel Room Shop, regardless of whether a devil deal has been taken. These angel shops always contain the following:
** Three items/pickups for sale. These items/pickups can be on sale, just like with normal Shops.
*** An item from the Angel Room Item Pool for 15 or 30 pennies.
*** An Eternal Heart for 5 pennies.
*** A Soul Heart for 5 pennies.
*** A Key for 5 pennies.
*** A ⟦p:holy-card¦Holy Card⟧ for 5 pennies.
** An ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧ statue. The Angel can be fought for a Key Piece like normal.
** A normal Beggar or Rotten Beggar next to the entrance.
** A Confessional, if it has been unlocked.
* The ladder to the angel room disappears if Isaac leaves the starting room, regardless of whether Isaac has climbed it or not.
items.notes:
* Layouts can be found here.
* The following items cost 30 coins to purchase:
* The ladder disappears after save-quitting.
* Weight decrementation in the generated shops is the same as in regular Angel Rooms, so if an item is seen in the special shop, it won't be encountered regularly again for the rest of the run.
* During the Ascent, ladders will generate in the "starting rooms" (where light beams are located) on every floor.
** The same does not apply during , in which the item simply has no effect.
* The ladder will appear in the Mirrored World in the starting room, and will lead to the same shop.
* Rerolled items in the room will be taken from the Angel Room pool.
* Since a beggar always spawns immediately to the right of the entrance way, caution should be taken to avoid accidental donation.
* If a run is started with The Stairway, i.e. playing as ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ or having collected ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧, the ladder will not appear on the first floor.
* In Greed mode, the ladder does not go away when pressing the button to start the waves. This means money can be gathered from the waves before entering the Stairway shop.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Reveals the location of the Boss Room. Upon defeating a boss, activates ⟦p:xix-the-sun¦XIX - The Sun⟧, fully recharges Isaac's active item, grants bonus damage and luck for the rest of the floor, and removes curses.
items.effects:
* Shows the location of the Boss Room on the minimap.
* After killing the boss in the Boss room shown on the map, has the following effects:
** Activates the effect of ⟦p:xix-the-sun¦XIX - The Sun⟧.
** Gives Isaac +3 damage and +1 luck for the rest of the floor.
** Fully recharges Isaac's active item.
** Removes any Curses from the current floor except the Curse of the Labyrinth.
items.notes:
* The buffs from Sol will be active upon entering all the floors in the Ascent, but it will not activate the effect of ⟦p:xix-the-sun¦XIX - The Sun⟧.
** In ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, the buffs from Sol will activate after entering the TV room. The healing and the item recharge will happen after defeating ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧.
* Only damage and luck buff will be granted upon entering the boss room in the special version of ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ II.
* On floors with multiple bosses (⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, XL floors, ), one random boss room is shown.
** In ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, only the randomly selected Boss room will grant Sol's effect.
* Does not activate with bosses killed during Boss Rush.
* Despite being on a different floor, Sol's effect persists for ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ and thus contributes to the ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ fight.
* Upon defeating a multi-segment boss where all pieces die at the end (Chub, C.H.A.D, Carrion Queen, etc.), the effect activates once per segment, leading to an effective +3 luck and +9 damage until leaving the room, after which, the extra bonuses will be removed. It's probably a bug.
* Sol will not activate upon clearing the Mirrored World's Boss Room.
* If Sol is obtained in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, through ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ or as a starting item for ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧, the effects will activate when entering the main room for the first time. In addition, it will activate each time a boss wave is completed.
** Sol will not activate during the final stage in the mini-boss fight before ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧.
* If Isaac manages to die at the same time he kills a boss, Sol will not save him. Instead, Isaac will die with full health.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: The moon's blessing shines upon you
items.description: Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor. Secret Rooms contain a beam of light that increases Fire Rate for the current floor and gives a Half Soul Heart.
items.effects:
* Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor.
* Reveals one random Secret Room on the map on pickup and at the start of each floor.
* Each newly discovered Secret Room has a shining beam of light that will raise tears for the current floor and gives Isaac a Half Soul Heart when walked under.
** The first light gives Isaac +1 tears fired per second, and all subsequent ones give +0.5 tears fired per second.
** This gives a potential +2.5 tears per second for a given floor, on top of 2 soul hearts.
** The tears up breaks the default 5 tears per second cap.
* Once the effect is triggered for the floor, a silver-bluish shine will appear around Isaac. This light will be strengthened for every beam of light "gathered".
** While this effect is mostly cosmetic, it also partially counteracts both the and the "dark rooms" in the ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧/⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧.
items.notes:
* The beams of light appear in both Secret Room types but not in Ultra Secret Rooms.
** The beams of light also appear in Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms that appear as a result of ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧.
* The beams of light appear even in unopened Secret Rooms on the same floor the item was acquired on.
* The effect can also be obtained in the Mirrored World.
* The tears up bonuses still apply while in the special area of ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧/⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ II.
* No new Secret Rooms are added in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ or Chapter 1 (if it's a starting item for ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧), but the beam of light is still added to current Secret Rooms.
* No new Secret Rooms are added in ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, The Ascent, or ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
* If kept after using ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ with ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧, upon taking damage, the additional tear rate is lost. More beams of light will have to be found or used for the tears to be regained (assuming not all of them were used).
* If playing Co-op or as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, characters that did not pick up Luna will still gain full benefit from stepping within the beam of light. However, this will only benefit one character.
* ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧: The opposite form of Tainted Lazarus can stand in the beam of light and receive its benefits but the fire rate bonuses are independent of each other and does not carry over between forms.
* Multiple copies of Luna will not cause additional Secret Rooms or Super Secret Rooms to be generated.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.4 speed. Doors stay open after entering a room, even in rooms with enemies.
items.effects:
* +0.4 speed.
* Opens most doors after entering a room, even in rooms with enemies, allowing Isaac to leave at any time.
items.notes:
* While ⟦t:124¦Door Stop⟧ has a similar effect, Mercurius has the added benefit of opening the doors that Isaac did not enter through.
* Does not open the Boss Rush door.
* Does not open any Special Rooms, including those that require pickups to unlock. Doors won't be opened even if they were open already (such as Treasure Rooms and Shops on the first floor, Sacrifice Rooms, etc.) or have been entered before.
** Mini-Boss Rooms, despite looking identical to normal rooms, are considered Special and will not be opened. This makes it possible to distinguish between regular rooms and mini-boss rooms without map-revealing effects (such as ⟦i:21¦The Compass⟧).
* Does not open doors to Red Rooms if those doors are created while there are enemies inside the current room.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds one red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart. Enemies near Isaac become charmed.
items.effects:
* Grants one Red Heart Container.
* Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
* Charms enemies close to Isaac. The effect wears off quickly after enemies move away from Isaac.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +1 Damage. Replaces tears with rocks that deal variable damage, have increased knockback, and can destroy obstacles.
items.effects:
* +1 damage.
* Isaac's tears become rocks that have extra knockback and have a chance to destroy obstacles (including walls to Secret Rooms, entrances to ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧/⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ and Bedrooms, and normal closed doors).
** Rocks can be pushed onto holes to cover them as if they were bombed normally.
* Rock tears randomly deal increased/decreased damage, ranging between ×0.5 and ×2 Isaac's damage per tear.
items.notes:
* Despite the chance to deal lower damage per shot, the increase to the damage stat results in a higher average DPS.
* Terra bypasses Blasters' 75% damage reduction.
* Terra can destroy the armor of ⟦e:tuff-twins¦Tuff Twins⟧ and ⟦e:the-shell¦The Shell⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Dash by double-tapping the movement key, becoming invulnerable and damaging enemies. There's a short cooldown before Isaac can dash again. ⟨16⟩ Knocks away nearby enemies and briefly grants i-frames after dashing.
items.effects:
* Double tapping a direction makes Isaac quickly dash in that direction.
** Isaac is immune to damage from all sources during the dash, with the exception of Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, and similar self-damage active items.
*** ⟨16⟩ At the end of the dash, Isaac gains i-frames that protect him against Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars damage. They will also not activate if touched during those i-frames.
** The dash deals damage equal to 4× Isaac's damage + 8.
** The direction of the dash can be angled by holding another button.
** The dash has an approximate 3 second cooldown.
** ⟨16⟩ If Isaac collides with a wall or obstacle, he releases 8 columns of fire that deal 10 damage and can burn enemies.
items.notes:
* The dash can be used to enter Curse Rooms and open Spiked Chests/Mimic Chests without taking damage.
* The dash can destroy Shopkeepers.
* With a controller, tapping the joystick is rather inconsistent, and the dash can often activate by accident. Using the directional pad instead is recommended.
* When Mars's dash is charged, Isaac will occasionally flash brightly, and visible steam will emit from his nose.
* Extra care needs to be taken with this item, as tapping for precise movements too quickly will cause a dash.
* ⟨16⟩ Mars' quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +2 red Heart containers, -0.3 speed. Isaac builds speed while standing still, and releases poison gas clouds when he moves afterwards.
items.effects:
* ⟨15⟩ Grants two empty Red Heart containers and restores half a red heart.
* ⟨16⟩ Grants two full Red Heart containers.
* -0.3 Speed.
* Standing still causes Isaac to build up speed at a rate of +0.25 per second, up to a +0.5 speed bonus.
* Isaac charges up while standing still. Moving releases a fart cloud behind Isaac, damaging and inflicting Poison on enemies that pass through it and draining the speed buff at a rate of -0.25 speed per second. The fart clouds are left behind for the duration of the speed buff.
** The fart clouds deal 0.5× Isaac's damage per tick (1.5× Isaac's damage per second), and last ~2.5 seconds.
* Isaac is immune to Poison from enemies, such as Gasbag or Mushrooms.
items.notes: * The fart clouds are mechanically independent of the speed increase. Even while at max speed, the fart cloud must be charged by standing still.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Upon entering a room, a circle of 7 tears orbits Isaac, which last for 13 seconds before falling to the ground. Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in orbit, turning them friendly.
items.effects:
* A circle surrounds Isaac. When entering a room, the circle is filled with 7 orbiting tears that copy Isaac's tear properties.
** The tears will deal 1.5× Isaac's damage +5 flat damage.
** After 13 seconds, the tears will automatically fall to the ground.
** Orbiting tears are spectral, although they don't visually appear to be.
** The room does not have to be a new room to renew the 7 orbiting tears.
* Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in the orbit, making them able to damage enemies.
** Captured tears deal damage based on their size rather than how much they would've hurt Isaac: basic enemy shots deal 3.5 damage, and most champion shots deal 4.9 damage, but there is further variance.
** Enemy tears caught disappear after a short time or upon leaving the current room.
items.notes:
* Any new effect on tears provided by an item or a trinket won't affect ring tears until getting to a new room.
** This is the same for lost effects (e.g. by dropping a trinket).
* When using a teleporter in ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧, the tears won't teleport and instead travel back towards the ring.
* Saturnus tears deal no damage to "grid entities", such as TNT and Poop.
* When Isaac spawns in the center of a room, or away from the door he should have entered through (for example, against ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ or ⟦e:gurdy¦Gurdy⟧ or on the first room of each floor), Saturnus' tears will spawn by the door and move towards Isaac.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac shoots ice tears, which slow enemies and freeze monsters they kill. Frozen enemies slide away and explode into ice shards when touched.
items.effects:
* Isaac's tears become icicles that freeze enemies upon death, turning them into ice statues.
** Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be frozen.
* Frozen enemies can be kicked, sliding and leaving damaging creep across the room and shattering when they hit a wall, obstacle or an enemy, releasing 10 icicle tears in a circle.
** These icicles can either slow enemies for 4 seconds or turn them into ice statues as well if they deal the lethal hit.
* Killing an enemy by freezing them will prevent any on-death effects from occurring (i.e. splitting into other enemies, firing any post-death tears, exploding, etc.), even after shattering.
* ⟨16⟩ Isaac's tears have a chance to petrify enemies.
items.notes:
* Isaac's own tears cannot apply a slowing effect on enemies. This property is only available for the icicle burst after shattering a frozen enemy.
* The on-shatter icicles deal damage equal to 8 + (floor - 1) which is not affected by Isaac's stats.
** These tears do not inherit any of Isaac's tear effects.
* The blue creep left behind ice statues while they're sliding across the room rapidly deals 2 flat damage for 11 ticks per second, resulting in 22 damage per second.
* Ice statues have 10 health points and can be shattered if shot by 10 tears or projectiles.
** Isaac's damage is irrelevant here and each tear shot will deal only 1 point of damage to them.
** Enemies ignore the ice statues when targeting Isaac and they can also destroy them if shot enough times.
** Explosions will shatter the statues immediately.
* Enemies hit by a sliding ice statue receive 35 flat damage which is not affected by Isaac's stats or the current floor.
* Enemies killed by hit of a sliding ice statue or the blue creep will not be frozen.
* Frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, meaning they don't need to be shattered in order for the room to be cleared. If not shattered, they don't disappear until leaving the room.
* Killing enemies by freezing them does not however count as a "kill" for the purposes of activating the on kill effects of certain items and trinkets. Because of this, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will count towards the on kill effects, rendering them quite difficult to use. ⟨8⟩ These items and trinkets are: ⟦t:118¦Bat Wing⟧, ⟦i:704¦Berserk!⟧, ⟦i:62¦Charm of the Vampire⟧, ⟦i:466¦Contagion⟧, ⟦t:60¦Eve's Bird Foot⟧, ⟦i:520¦Jumper Cables⟧, ⟦i:411¦Lusty Blood⟧, ⟦i:621¦Red Stew⟧, ⟦t:58¦Samson's Lock⟧, ⟦t:189¦Sigil of Baphomet⟧, ⟦i:350¦Toxic Shock⟧ and ⟦i:657¦Vasculitis⟧.
** ⟨16⟩ Aforementioned items and trinkets now properly trigger upon enemy being frozen.
** ⟦i:684¦Hungry Soul⟧, ⟦i:234¦Infestation 2⟧, ⟦i:661¦Quints⟧, ⟦i:640¦Urn of Souls⟧, ⟦i:653¦Vade Retro⟧ still activate their effects, immediately upon enemy being frozen.
** ⟦i:408¦Athame⟧ and ⟦i:434¦Jar of Flies⟧ will only activate upon enemy's ice statue being shattered.
** Enemies, that were gold-petrified (e.g. by ⟦i:202¦Midas' Touch⟧), don't drop coins upon becoming ice statues.
* Champion enemies that drop consumables won't drop anything until their ice statue is shattered.
** As ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, enemies will drop a coin immediately when frozen.
** As ⟦c:tainted-magdalene¦Tainted Magdalene⟧, enemies killed by hug, will drop a Half Red Heart immediately when frozen.
* Using this item in daily-runs is ill-advised as freezing enemies removes a large chunk of exploration bonus.
* If a non-boss enemy dies within 10 ticks (0.33 seconds) after being hit by a freezing tear, it will be frozen regardless of what killed it.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac's mouth fills with tears over time while not firing, up to a cap. Holding the fire button will release all stored tears in rapid succession.
items.effects:
* While Isaac is not firing tears, a charge bar will start to fill up. Holding down the fire button will release the stored tears rapidly. The fire rate is greater and the bar drains faster when more full.
* The charge time and maximum tears per charge scale with Isaac's tears stat, with higher tears charging faster and having more of them.
items.notes:
* While at 0 charge, Isaac fires at his normal tear delay, meaning there is no downside.
* This item has no effect for ⟦c:tainted-lilith¦Tainted Lilith⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.7 tears. Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.
items.effects:
* +0.7 tears
* Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.
items.notes:
* With enough speed and the correct angle or being pushed by an explosion, it is possible to cross pits and pass through obstacles, allowing Isaac to reach places he usually isn't able to reach.
* Pluto can stack with other size reduction effects.
* May allow Isaac to squeeze through the walls and floors in Crawl Spaces and 2nd/3rd phase of ⟦e:rotgut¦Rotgut⟧. Passing through the outermost wall in an unintended direction leads to the I AM ERROR room.
* The decrease in size makes dodging certain tear effects easier, most notably ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧'s continuum tears, and ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧'s feather attacks from their respective second phases.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns an additional Curse Room on each floor. Curse Rooms have improved layouts.
items.effects:
* Spawns an additional Curse Room on each floor, if possible.
** Doesn't work on the Ascent.
* Curse rooms have improved layouts and rewards while Voodoo Head is held.
* A coin is guaranteed to spawn in Curse Rooms.
items.notes:
* Has no effect in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
* The singular coin generated by the item in curse rooms cannot be a special coin (nickel, dime, lucky, etc).
* Does not retroactively upgrade the current floor's curse room when picked up, if one exists. Its layout won't be improved and there is no guaranteed coin.
* This item is beneficial for ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ due to the chance of obtaining ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧ or ⟦i:212¦Guppy's Collar⟧ in curse rooms. However, use caution as the run can easily end from being hit while fighting any enemies inside. A teleport card, such as ⟦p:0-the-fool¦0 - The Fool⟧, would be advised to prevent such situations.
* This item is also very beneficial for ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧, as they can enter and leave curse rooms for free.
* The coin that spawns, while minimal for most characters, is considerably useful for ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, letting them partially heal from the curse room door's donation and letting Tainted Keeper leave even if there are no enemies to get coins from.
* This item causes the level generation to increase the minimum number of dead ends on each floor by 1, increasing the likelihood of curse rooms spawning.
** The level generation does not guarantee an additional curse room can be placed; there is limited space for special rooms, and other types may take priority over it.
*** If a curse room doesn't spawn, it's possible Voodoo Head still increased the dead end count, giving you an extra special room.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Increases the fire rate in Isaac's left eye, causing his eyes to fire at different rates.
items.effects:
* Increases the fire rate of tears fired from Isaac's left eye by 40%.
** The difference in fire rates causes Isaac's tears to be fired at a staggered rate.
** The first shot in a while is always a double shot.
items.notes:
* The listed fire rate on found hud is x1.2 fire rate excluding any items that add to fire rate directly.
* Every type of attack that does not use both of Isaac's eyes benefits from the fire rate up, but will not have staggered attack rate. These include, for example:
** All charged attacks such as ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ and ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧.
** All tear replacers such as ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧ and ⟦i:68¦Technology⟧.
** All one-eyed characters and item effects, such as ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧ and ⟦i:708¦Stapler⟧.
** Attacking via familiars, such as ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lilith¦Tainted Lilith⟧.
* Multi-shot attacks such as ⟦i:245¦20/20⟧ and ⟦i:153¦Mutant Spider⟧ do have staggered firing.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +0.7 tears, grants an Eternal Heart. Allows Angel Rooms to appear even if a Devil Deal has been taken before. Reduces the Devil/Angel room chance penalty for taking Red heart damage.
items.effects:
* +0.7 tears up.
* Grants an Eternal Heart.
* Allows Angel Rooms to spawn even after Isaac has taken a Deal with the Devil.
* Mitigates the penalties to the chance for a deal to appear from taking red heart damage.
** Damage during the stage replaces the 99% no-damage bonus with 40% instead of removing it.
** Damage against the boss replaces the 35% no-damage bonus with 15% instead of removing it.
** In practice, this results in a -24% chance instead of -64% for taking damage during the stage, and -44% instead of -99% for taking damage against the boss.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a trapdoor to every Shop that leads to a second shop with a unique stock and marked-up prices.
items.effects:
* Spawns a trapdoor in each Shop that leads to an additional underground shop that can sell 2-5 of the following:
** A Trinket for 15 cents.
** An Item for 15-30 cents. Items will be from the Secret Room, Shop, Devil/Angel Room, or Boss Room items; there can be multiple items from different item pools, but items will stay to their chosen item pool if rerolled.
*** Devil/Angel room items can cost up to 50 cents, and Secret Room items can cost up to 99 cents.
** A Card/Rune/Soul Stone for 6-8 cents.
** A Black Heart/Bone Heart for 8 cents.
** An Eternal Heart for 15 cents.
** A Rotten Heart for 5 cents.
items.notes:
* The trapdoor spawns even if the shop was replaced by ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧ or ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧, in which case it won't open until Greed has been defeated.
* Similar to Crawl Spaces, there is only one secret shop per floor. The trapdoors in extra shops created by ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧ will lead to the same secret shop.
* If the Member Card was removed from the player's inventory (for example, by playing ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ and replacing it with a different item), the trapdoor will still remain open once it has been spawned, even after leaving and reentering the shop.
* The trapdoor will appear in the Mirrored World version of the shop. Despite the shop itself being empty, the trapdoor will lead to the same secret shop where the items are still for sale. Buying from the secret shop in the Mirrored World will thus remove the bought item from both worlds.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Recharges Isaac's currently held active item and drops 2-4 batteries.
items.effects:
* Fully charges the current activated item.
* Spawns 2-4 random battery pickups.
items.notes: * Battery Pack's quality is considered 1 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Lets Isaac pick up and throw rocks, TNT, Poops, ⟦i:576¦friendly Dips⟧, Bombs, and other obstacles.
items.effects:
* Upon use, picks up the obstacle in front of Isaac. The obstacle can be thrown at enemies, dealing 40 damage and breaking on impact, dropping any contents they may contain.
** Obstacles can be carried between rooms.
** Using it on a Host / Mobile Host will lift the shell off and transform it into a Red Host / Flesh Mobile Host. Isaac can throw the shell after picking it up.
*** The affected hosts will still fire 3 shots instead of 5.
** Isaac can throw bombs using this, either his bombs or Troll Bombs.
*** Golden Troll Bombs grant Isaac unlimited bombs for the floor as they can be carried through rooms this way.
** ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ can be picked up by any other player using it.
items.notes:
* The item will cost 10 cents if found in a Shop.
* Throwing a Throwable Bomb or Poops and bombs created by ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧ and ⟦i:725¦IBS⟧ counts as using the bracelet, using up a charge.
* The item's charge will only be depleted once an object is thrown.
** Activating the item again will drop the picked up obstacle where Isaac is standing without consuming a charge. This doesn't damage Isaac directly, but any break effects the obstacle has can still occur.
*** This makes it easy to quickly clear paths through large amounts of rocks.
*** While the dropped obstacle is falling toward the ground, it can be picked up again by activating Mom's Bracelet.
**** Obstacles thrown by enemies, such as Polties, can be caught in the same way.
* Spiked rocks cannot be picked up, even if their spikes are retracted.
* Similarly, Metal Blocks, Key Blocks and Pillars also cannot be picked up.
* Thrown Poops deal less damage when they are more degraded.
* Throwing a Giant Poop at an enemy deals 320 damage instead of 40.
* Activating the item while running into a Red Poop will allow Isaac to chuck it and effectively remove it from the room.
* Poops created by ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧ and ⟦i:725¦IBS⟧ can be picked up and thrown again freely. You can carry them between rooms and using Mom's Bracelet while holding one will drop them on top of Isaac without destroying them.
** Unlike other obstacles, dropping them under a pit will spawn them to the nearest open space available.
** Picking up a Corn Poop, will cause the blue flies to follow Isaac, but Corn Poop will not spawn more flies unless the ones around Isaac get used.
** Rapidly dropping and picking up a Stinky Poop in one spot will create a potent fart cloud, which when detonated deals a lot of damage.
* While carrying a rock, Isaac cannot drop down a trapdoor to the next floor. This can be used as a way to get pickups close to an open trapdoor without accidentally dropping to the next floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Summons ⟦i:155¦The Peeper⟧ for the current room, which leaves a trail of red creep.
items.effects:
* Summons ⟦i:155¦The Peeper⟧ for the current room, which also leaves a trail of red creep.
** The Peeper deals 12 contact damage per tick (36 per second) and the creep it trails deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second).
** The Peeper can block enemy shots.
** All tears shot from the right eye will deal 35% more damage, same as with ⟦i:155¦The Peeper⟧ affecting the left eye.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which suck enemies, pickups, and shots towards them and damage enemies in the area.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which damage nearby enemies and pull in enemies, pickups, and tears/shots from all sources for 2 seconds.
** Rifts deal half of the tear's damage twice each tick (3x its damage per second), and enemy shots pulled into the rift will damage other enemies.
** The size of the rift increases with Isaac's damage.
items.notes:
* The chance to fire a rift tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 20 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},20\%)
** At base Luck (0), the chance is 5%, maxing out at 20% at 15 Luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions at random intervals while in a room with enemies, shooting faster the closer it is to an enemy, similarly to Boils.
** Each tear fired by Boiled Baby does either 3.5 or 5.3 damage, with no in-between.
items.notes: * Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Boiled Baby having the lowest priority at 6th and thus staying the farthest away from Isaac when compared to other familiars with higher priorities.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires icicles have a chance to petrify enemies and freeze monsters they kill.
items.effects:
* Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires icicles once every 0.75 seconds that each do 3.5 damage and have a chance to petrify enemies they hit and freeze enemies they kill.
** Frozen enemies will block enemy shots, and will slide away when walked into by Isaac.
*** After colliding with an obstacle or getting sufficiently shot by Isaac, frozen enemies will explode into a ring of 10 ice tears that can slow and freeze.
items.notes:
* Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Freezer Baby having 5th priority.
* If a non-boss enemy dies within 10 ticks (0.33 seconds) after being hit by a freezing tear, it will be frozen regardless of what killed it.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Re-rolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.
items.effects:
* Upon use, replaces every pedestal item in the current room with other random items corresponding to the current room's item pool.
** Each pedestal item rerolled has a 25% chance to disappear.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ starts with this item, even if it hasn't been unlocked yet.
* Killing Florian last in an ⟦e:ultra-pride¦Ultra Pride⟧ fight has a chance to drop the Eternal D6 if unlocked.
* In rooms with multiple item pedestals, each pedestal has a separate chance of disappearing when rerolled.
* Despite being described as a 25% chance, whether a pedestal disappears is determined by its InitSeed.
** The result can be predicted by applying a 32-bit xorshift to the InitSeed with shifts 5, 27, and 8. If the resulting unsigned value is less than 230 (1,073,741,824), the pedestal disappears; otherwise, it is rerolled.
** InitSeeds 8, 41, 74, 107, 140, and 173 are observed edge cases that also cause the pedestal to disappear. Including these edge cases, the actual probability is slightly higher than 25%: approximately 25.0000014%.
* Luck has no effect on the item.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a familiar leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to ⟦i:117¦Dead Bird⟧.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a fat bird familiar that sits on Isaac's head until he takes damage.
* Upon taking damage, it will jump off of Isaac's head and land on the nearest enemy, dealing damage and creating a rock line in a random direction. For the rest of the room, it acts like ⟦i:117¦Dead Bird⟧, flying around, albeit slower, and dealing contact damage to enemies.
** Bird Cage does 45 damage to enemies it lands on and 10 damage per rock wave that hits enemies, then does 3 contact damage per tick while chasing enemies (~6.43 damage per second). The rock waves can destroy obstacles.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-cage¦The Cage⟧.
* If damage is taken in a room with no enemies, the familiar will directly go to the flying phase without performing the jump attack.
* Contact damage can be dealt to nearby enemies even when the familiar jumps off of Isaac's head.
* Bird Cage's jump can be carried over to another room mid-jump to create a rock line there instead. The direction of the line is preserved from how it would be in the original room.
* While the familiar is sitting on Isaac's head, it can be affected by certain character appearances. For example, it will appear fully black if obtained by ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The shout gets stronger the more charges the item has. Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, in addition to charging normally.
items.effects:
* Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The item can be used when not fully charged, and deals more damage and has increased range the more charges it has when used.
** The initial shout deals 20 damage + 28 per charge and destroys enemy shots, obstacles, Shopkeepers, Beggars, and machines, and opens bombable doors in range.
** A number of extra pulses are released equal to half the charges used (rounded up) that deal 2.5 damage + 3.5 per charge.
* Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, as well as through normal means.
items.notes:
* Larynx only has 1 charge when initially picked up.
* Larynx will gain charges if Isaac is hit during the ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ escape sequence.
* Obstacles destroyed by the shout don't bridge gaps.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Creates a ghostly familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, but respawns at the start of the next floor. Each time it survives until the next floor, it rewards Isaac with Soul Hearts, Eternal Hearts, or an Item.
items.effects:
* Creates a ghostly familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, respawning at the start of the next floor.
* If Lost Soul survives until the start of the next floor, it rewards Isaac with one of the following:
** 3 Soul Hearts.
** 2 Eternal Hearts.
** A Treasure Room item or an Angel Room item.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:blighted-ovum¦Blighted Ovum⟧.
* Lost Soul hides behind Isaac, opposite to the direction he is firing tears.
** Also, if Isaac is moving to the opposite side he's shooting, then his hitbox will completely absorb Lost Soul's hitbox, making it significantly harder for enemies to hit it.
* Floors completed during the Ascent count.
* Waiting until after the floor is cleared before picking up Lost Soul nearly guarantees a reward payout on the next floor.
* The ghost can take explosive damage from Isaac, e.g. via placing a Bomb.
* Lost Soul's position behind Isaac can overlap with other Familiars.
* Leaving the ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ chase sequence respawns Lost Soul.
* Swapping the item as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ and picking it up again respawns Lost Soul.
* Spiked Rocks will kill Lost Soul.
* ⟨15⟩ If Lost Soul is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧, even if Isaac hasn't been hit.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants a Red Heart container and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging red creep. Isaac can place Bombs at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.
items.effects:
* Grants one full Red Heart container.
* Restores 4 Red Hearts.
* Causes Isaac's Bombs to leave a pool of red creep on the ground when they explode.
** The creep deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second) and lasts 15 seconds.
** Leaves one large creep in the middle, and four small creeps on random direction and distance.
*** Multiple creeps do not inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously.
* If Isaac has no bombs, allows him to place a bomb at the cost of taking half a heart of damage. This prioritizes Red Hearts over Soul Hearts.
items.notes:
* Placing a bomb using health counts as self-damage, and as such, does not affect the chances for a Devil deal, does not trigger ⟦i:577¦Damocles⟧, nor does it reroll ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧.
** ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ will die if a bomb is placed this way.
*** This includes the version of ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ you turn into after touching the white fireplace in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II.
* ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ will take 1 Coin Heart of damage in exchange for 1 bomb.
* ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ can use 1 blood charge in exchange for 1 bomb.
* You can remain at zero bombs and leave excess drops of bombs and hearts to maximize resource use for the floor.
* Placing a bomb using health can let Isaac enter/exit a Curse Room without taking soul/black heart damage.
** But be careful and remember to move quickly upon exiting the Curse room, otherwise you'll take damage from the previous bomb.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a Dumpy familiar that pushes away nearby enemies and projectiles just before Isaac is about to be hit, then falls asleep. He can be awoken by walking to him.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a Dumpy familiar, which follows behind him. When Isaac is about to take damage (as with ⟦t:149¦Panic Button⟧), Lil Dumpy farts, knocking back nearby enemies and shots while also propelling itself in a random direction. Enemies that collide with obstacles or walls take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage. Pushed shots that hit an enemy deal 6 damage normally and 7 damage if they would deal a full heart of damage to Isaac.
** Lil Dumpy has a larger, hidden secondary radius that may randomly trigger its fart effect if an enemy projectile enters it.
* After farting, Lil Dumpy goes on cooldown and "falls asleep" until Isaac walks up to it to wake it up. Lil Dumpy resets upon entering a new room.
* Lil Dumpy deals contact damage, which depends on its speed. If it hits an enemy right after farting, it will deal 8.33 damage.
items.notes:
* Does not prevent damage from environmental hazards, including Spiked Chests.
* Lil Dumpy's position behind Isaac can overlap with other Familiars or other copies of itself.
* Dormant Lil Dumpy can come into contact with and be pushed around by enemies, but doesn't deal contact damage.
* Lil Dumpy can get stuck over rocks and pits, becoming unreachable for the rest of the room.

items.description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a chance to shoot fires alongside his regular tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them, similar to those shot by ⟦i:289¦Red Candle⟧.
** Fires can block up to four shots and/or deal four ticks of damage before being destroyed, and last up to 10 seconds.
** Fires deal 4× Isaac's damage at full durability, 3× Isaac's damage after taking damage once, and 2× Isaac's damage otherwise, for a max possible damage output of 11× Isaac's damage per fire.
** Any fart-related effect that occurs will also generate a flame, like using ⟦i:36¦The Poop⟧ or when generating a bomb with ⟦i:378¦No. 2⟧.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:singe¦Singe⟧.
* The chance to shoot fires depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 12 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},50\%)
** At base luck (0), the chance is 8.33%, maxing out at 50% at 10 luck.
* Flames will destroy Shopkeepers.
* The size of the flames depends on Isaac's tears size.
* Converts enemies into their fire-like variations, such as a Clotty into a Grilled Clotty.
** A Clotty won't be converted if it's in a wet room, such as those found in the Flooded Caves or the one created by an item such as ⟦i:291¦Flush!⟧

items.description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, causing them to attract nearby pickups and enemies, as well as tears/shots from all sources.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, giving them properties similar to tears fired by Isaac when he has ⟦i:315¦Strange Attractor⟧:
** Enemies and pickups that are near magnetized enemies are pulled towards them. This includes live Bombs.
** All tears/enemy shots (from Isaac, his familiars, and all enemies, including the magnetized one) will be strongly pulled towards magnetized enemies.
*** Enemy shots that get pulled in will now also damage enemies other than the ones that fired them.
items.notes: * The chance to fire magnetizing tears depends on the luck stat. The activation rate is equal to 1/(6 - Luck). At 0 luck, the chance is 16.67%, maxing out at 100% at 5 luck.

items.description: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait are attacked by other enemies.
items.effects:
* Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait will move slower and be attacked by other enemies until it is killed or the effect wears off.
* Tears that apply the effect are red.
items.notes:
* The chance to fire marking tears depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 6 - \left \lceil \mathit{Luck} \right \rceil}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 16.67%, maxing out at 100% at 4.01 luck.
* Causes pathing issues with segmented bosses, as they attempt to attack their own segments.
* Most enemies will ignore Isaac in order to attack a baited enemy, making Rotten Tomato an item with both offensive and defensive applications.
* With a high enough luck stat and piercing effects, the uptime of the bait effect can be enough to render some bosses harmless, such as ⟦e:ultra-pestilence¦Ultra Pestilence⟧ or ⟦e:the-duke-of-flies¦The Duke of Flies⟧ who spawn a multitude of flies that it will then focus on.
* This item is very effective during Boss Rush. Boss enemies affected by this item will deal massive amounts of damage to each other and Isaac will be less likely to get hurt by their attacks.
* Due to the nature of ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧'s hitbox, the bait effect will cause Mother to often shoot herself in her second phase causing a lot of her attacks to be nullified.
* Enemies and entities normally non-affected by status effects like the Stone Grimace or Red Fire Place will target the baited enemies.

items.description: Refills all heart containers. Grants an enormous damage boost that wears off over time.
items.effects:
* On pickup, fully heals Isaac and gives him a temporary +21.6 damage up.
** The damage upgrade scales down to 0 over the course of three minutes. Due to how the damage formula works, the damage upgrade scales down faster over time, starting at -~0.015 per half second and increasing to -~.1 per half second as the bonus approaches 0.
** While Red Stew is active, Isaac gains an effect similar to ⟦i:411¦Lusty Blood⟧, gaining a small damage bonus every time he kills an enemy. This damage bonus persists between rooms and floors, allowing Isaac to sustain the temporary damage up for longer than he otherwise would if he manages to kill many enemies. This effect disappears once Red Stew's damage bonus completely runs out.
items.notes:
* Due to the high amount of damage you temporarily gain, this item is extremely effective in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, as all fights are done within the same room and you are easily able to make the most out of it.
* The damage bonuses on kills can exceed the damage increase given from picking up Red Stew.
* The default length of Red Stew is 5390 game frames, which is just short of 3 minutes. (This will be the length if no enemies are killed during the effect.)

items.description: Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups and takes him to a unique Clean Bedroom with some pickups and Chests and a passage to the next floor. For every item Isaac lost, he gets to take an item from a set of three.
items.effects:
* On use, Isaac is teleported to a unique Clean Bedroom that acts like an I AM ERROR room. It has a Bed, two random Chests, two Grab Bags, and a random Trinket. The only way out is through the beam of light, which teleports Isaac to the next floor (with some exceptions, seen below).
* Isaac loses all items and is reset to a state exactly like if he started a new run, though keeping quest items to not block progression. All stats, consumables, trinkets, and all items except for starting items and quest items, are removed. Isaac gains back all of his starting trinkets and consumables.
* For every item removed using Genesis, there will be a set of three items from the removed item's pool to choose from, each set appearing one after the other at the bottom of the room.
items.notes:
* If used on one of the final floors of the game, such as ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧, ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧, ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, or ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ II, the beam of light will be replaced with a Crawl Space that leads Isaac back to the starting room of the floor he used it on. In addition, on ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ or ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ the aforementioned chests will include items. These items will not disappear along the "choice" pedestals.
** ⟨15⟩ If used in the final floor of Greedier mode, the beam of light will instead be replaced with a normal trap door that leads Isaac to a brand new Ultra Greed floor, forcing him to repeat the boss fight.
*** ⟨16⟩ The trapdoor now leads to the starting room of the floor, without resetting it.
* If used in ⟦s:womb¦Womb⟧ II, ⟦s:utero¦Utero⟧ II, or ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, the beam will always teleport Isaac to ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧.
* Crawl Spaces can be generated and entered inside the Genesis room, but upon leaving them, Isaac will be returned to the floor Genesis was used on instead of returning to the room.
** Similarly, ⟦p:joker¦Joker⟧ can teleport Isaac to a Devil Room or Angel Room, and leaving will return Isaac to the room Genesis was used in, instead of the Genesis room.
** Other cards, such as ⟦p:0-the-fool¦0 - The Fool⟧, can be used to directly teleport to one of the rooms in the current floor, successfully escaping as well. Cards can be obtained by opening a Chest, whose contents could be a Locked Chest, whose contents could be a Card.
* Item Pools will not be reset, however any lost items can be obtained again if they spawn.
* Transformations are also removed.
* Does not work during ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧'s fight, instead merely teleporting Isaac to a random location in the room. No items will be removed.
* Take caution; choosing an active item while holding another one will not drop the previous item to the ground, but replace it.
* Genesis will remove all currently active curses, meaning will not affect the item pedestals present inside the room (except during the Ultra Hard challenge).
* Trinkets absorbed using a Gulp! pill or an item such as ⟦i:479¦Smelter⟧ will simply be removed with no extra pedestals granted for them.
* If used as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, both characters' items are removed to offer choices, but Jacob and Esau cannot take two items at once from the choices. Both characters' items are considered in the amount of choices offered.
* ⟦c:tainted-cain¦Tainted Cain⟧ will be able to pick up the items that appear normally, one of the few times he is able to do so (along with quest items and items in the ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧ area).
* If used as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, both forms' items are removed and offer the equivalent number of choices, while his initial ⟦i:711¦Flip⟧ is granted infinite charges and can be used freely in the special room.
* ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧ will lose all existing wisps and reset the soul charge count to its default of 4 on use, but will gain 3 default wisps upon appearing in the Genesis room.
* ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ will lose all of her ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧ wisps and reset the blood charge count to its default of 6 on use. She does not gain extra wisps back.
* If used as ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧, a new set of items and stats will be generated. The first random passive item Eden starts with is rerolled immediately with no choice of three.
* If Isaac uses Genesis while in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II / ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ II / ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ II or their variants, the beam of light will send him back to the regular floors. However, after using Genesis on ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ I / ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ I / ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ I / ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ I, it sends Isaac to the respective second part of the stage.
* Since Genesis resets Isaac's health, it is one way to remove Broken Hearts.
* Using Genesis removes the schwag bonus and ⟨15⟩ damage penalty on Daily Challenges and outside.
* ⟨16⟩ Genesis' quality is treated as 3 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

items.description: Adds 5 Keys on pickup. Allows Isaac to throw his keys to deal damage to enemies, destroy obstacles, and open doors.
items.effects:
* Gives five Keys.
* On use, Isaac holds a key above his head. Pressing a fire button removes one key and throws it as a piercing projectile. The key damages enemies, as well as opens locked doors and Locked Chests it hits.
** The key will also break the first rock it hits, as well as Key Blocks.
** The thrown key does damage equal to 5× Isaac's damage + 30.
** Enemies killed by Sharp Key have a chance to spawn the contents of a chest; the contents they can drop includes the rewards of any possible chest contents, including items.
items.notes:
* Sharp Key gives Isaac five keys for the price of three when bought at a Shop, making its purchase a good value if the player is low on keys.
* Thrown keys follow almost the same unlocking rules as ⟦i:175¦Dad's Key⟧. They can open:
** Secret Rooms
** The doors to access ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧, ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧
** ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s door
** ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧
** The flesh door to ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ in Mausoleum / Gehenna
*** Unlike others, this cannot be unlocked with Dad's key.
* The only rooms Dad's Key can open that Sharp Key cannot are Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms.
* The entrance to Boss Rush and the gate leading to ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ can both be opened from the inside by throwing a key on where the entrance was.
* It cannot be used as a substitute for ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧ or to open the doors to Boss Rush or ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ past their timer.
* Doors will be opened in one thrown key, even if they require multiple keys or bombs to open.
* Thrown keys can also destroy ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧ statues, but not Blue Fire Places.
* Thrown keys cannot pierce or destroy Stoneys.
* Destroying a rock will create a bridge at the opposite side the thrown key hit the rock from.
* Despite being a substitute to bombs, thrown keys will not destroy Shopkeepers.
* Thrown keys will open all the locked chests they move through, allowing multiple chests to be opened with a single key.
** Only locked chests (such as Locked Chests, Eternal Chests, or Old Chests) can be opened by Sharp Key; all other chests are unaffected.
*** In the case of Eternal Chests, thrown keys will only count toward opening the chest one time.
*** Despite Mega Chests requiring keys to unlock, Sharp Key has no effect on it.
** Opening locked chests with thrown keys in Challenge rooms will not cause the challenge room to start spawning enemies.
* Thrown keys will retain Isaac's tear/status effects, but are unaffected by items that replace Isaac's tears (such as ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧, ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧, or ⟦i:114¦Mom's Knife⟧).
* Whether or not an enemy gives chest contents when killed by Sharp Key is seeded per enemy. As such, rooms can be re-entered (using Sharp Key itself or with ⟦t:124¦Door Stop⟧ / ⟦i:590¦Mercurius⟧ etc.) before they're fully cleared to repeatedly get rewards from the same enemy.
* The type of chest that enemies will give the contents of is determined by standard chest generation rules. This makes the contents of standard chests more common, and prevents enemies from giving the contents of Old Chests or Mom's Chest.
* The pickups that enemies killed by Sharp Key can drop are affected by items/trinkets that modify chest spawns/rewards.
** This includes the ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ and ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧'s effect of causing chests to contain Treasure Room items.
* Sharp Key can open the chests in Challenge Rooms without triggering them. However, picking up an item dropped from a chest will trigger them.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Drops 5 random cards.
items.effects: * Drops 5 random cards.
items.notes:
* Of the 5 cards spawned, they will have the following chances to be a type of card.
** 1 out of 5 cards: 93.3% playing card, 6.67% special card
** 4 out of 5 cards: 76.7% Tarot card, 19.3% playing card, 4% special card
* ⟦p:emergency-contact¦Emergency Contact⟧, ⟦p:dice-shard¦Dice Shard⟧ and ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧ cannot be spawned by this item, as they are not considered cards.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, increasing damage and range while lowering tears, granting invulnerability, and allowing Isaac to crush enemies and obstacles he walks on. The effect persists between rooms.
items.effects:
* Upon use, gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, persisting between rooms and floors. While gigantic, Isaac gains the following effects:
** A 4x damage multiplier, +2 range, and -1.9 tears.
** Cannot take damage for the duration of the effect.
** Can destroy Objects, Obstacles, and Pitfalls when walking over them. This includes Metal Blocks and Key Blocks without using keys.
** Can break through normal doors, Secret Rooms, and any doors that require Bombs such as Clean Bedrooms, by walking into them.
*** Cannot break through Challenge Rooms, Boss Rooms, Mini-Boss Rooms, Curse Rooms, Sacrifice Rooms, or any doors that require Keys such as Shops. Bedrooms also cannot be broken back into if they are closed but no longer boarded up.
** Deals extremely heavy contact damage to enemies (80 per tick, or 2,400 per second).
items.notes:
* Using Mega Mush again while its effects are still active will add an additional 30 seconds to the current active time.
* Isaac's physical size, i.e. collision circle or "hitbox" is roughly doubled in radius when Mega Mush is active. This is the only item that can make Isaac tangibly larger than his starting size, as normal size ups can't increase the collision area beyond the default.
* Mega Mush will not negate the damage taken from the ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ door and the Golden Battery. It is also possible to die this way.
* Non-tear based attacks such as ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ or ⟦i:114¦Mom's Knife⟧ are overridden by normal tears while Mega Mush is active.
** The only exceptions are the melee attacks by ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, ⟦c:tainted-samson¦Tainted Samson⟧ and ⟦i:704¦Berserk!⟧, which have increased hitboxes.
* Isaac is unable to use the invulnerability effect to donate to Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars, since they will be destroyed on contact. Bomb Bums will also be destroyed by walking over them.
* Mega Mush can be obtained by using ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ on ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧.
* If Isaac dies while giant, he will revive in his giant form if he has any revival items.
* Using Mega Mush as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ will retain effect and time remaining upon flipping back to the form that used it.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Combined with ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧.
items.effects:
* Spawns a knife handle familiar that follows Isaac.
* Generates a room in ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ / ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ II for ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ to spawn in.
* Combines with ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.
* Launching it at the red door at the end of ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.
items.notes:
* Isaac will remain as The Lost until after he has cleared a room of enemies; it does not matter whether this room is in the mirror world. His normal form will be restored upon entering any room outside the mirror world. This effect can extend to the next floor.
* If you don't have ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ unlocked on ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, you don't get Holy Mantle while in ghost form.
* The red door can alternatively be opened using ⟦i:675¦Cracked Orb⟧, ⟦i:623¦Sharp Key⟧, or ⟦p:soul-of-cain¦Soul of Cain⟧.
* The knife piece can be rerolled, in the event that ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ is not the desired completion mark.
* Knife Piece 1 takes 6th priority on the line of following familiars while the knife familiar created from both knife pieces takes 5th priority.
