* It's possible to see the Knife Piece 1 multiple times by using ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧ or ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧, allowing you to use the ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧ or ⟦i:477¦Void⟧ on one of the duplicates while still collecting the other.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Combined with ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧.
items.effects:
* Combines with ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.
* Launching it at the red door at the end of ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.
items.notes:
* Obtaining Knife Piece 2 without ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ will spawn a knife blade familiar that follows Isaac but has no other effect.
* The door to the abandoned area can be opened with two explosions or items like ⟦i:175¦Dad's Key⟧; however, Isaac will not be able to reach the door unless he has flight or all three buttons have been pressed anyway. If the door is already open, the minecart cannot be ridden but the path can be walked along.
* While in the abandoned area, all of Isaac's items and consumables are removed. Extra Life items will not activate despite still visually appearing beside the health bar. However, any items with reroll protection will still function as normal. (This includes ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ itself.)
* If a character has inherent flight, they will retain it in the abandoned area, making it significantly easier.
* This room, as well as the buttons to reach it, will only be generated if Knife Piece 1 was already collected.
* The buttons can be bypassed with flight and 2 bombs to destroy the door. Upon exiting the room, the rail pathway will be built in order to prevent softlocks from using temporary flight methods such as ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧.
* The red door can alternatively be opened using ⟦i:675¦Cracked Orb⟧, ⟦i:623¦Sharp Key⟧, or ⟦p:soul-of-cain¦Soul of Cain⟧.
* If Isaac takes Knife Piece 2 and is somehow able to immediately leave the room before ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ fully activates (usually by using ⟦i:483¦Mama Mega!⟧ earlier in the floor), the rest of the sub-area will not have reset, and the doors leading to the exit will all be locked. This forces the player to re-enter the Knife Piece 2 room, which triggers another activation of ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧, causing two instances of Mother's Shadow to pursue the player during the escape sequence.
* It is possible to find a Crawl Space as normal in this area, which will be the same crawlspace as any other generated on the normal floor. Entering the crawlspace will allow Isaac to use his normal items and consumables, but Mother's Shadow will also be present. Using any teleport card or item will teleport Isaac to a random room on the abandoned area map. Any items obtained while in this crawlspace will remain upon leaving the area, but will not be able to be used while in the abandoned area.
** It is possible to softlock the run by entering a crawlspace with the key needed to escape the room. Upon leaving the crawlspace, the key will be gone.
** The Black Market or I AM ERROR room can potentially be entered from the crawlspace. Going through the trapdoor there will end the pursuit and lead to Depths II (or alternatives). Isaac will keep all his items, including those bought in the market.
* The knife familiar created from both knife pieces takes 5th priority on the line of following familiars.
* Knife Piece 2 takes 6th priority on the line of following familiars while the knife familiar created from both knife pieces takes 5th priority.
* It's possible (though useless) to acquire another Knife Piece 2 using ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧ or ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧.
* ⟦c:tainted-eve¦Tainted Eve⟧ retains her ability to create clots, but loses access to ⟦i:713¦Sumptorium⟧. Caution should be used if entering with low health as clots cannot be reabsorbed until exiting.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, which contains one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.
items.effects:
* Upon use, transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, which has one copy of almost every item the player has unlocked on that save file on pedestals. After taking an item from a pedestal, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.
** There are also several pickups and Chest in the area. Picking them up/opening them will not cause Isaac to leave the area.
*** If a chest in the area contains an item, picking it up will not cause Isaac to leave the area.
*** Items spawned through the use of pre-obtained items brought into the area, such as ⟦i:490¦Eden's Soul⟧ or ⟦i:515¦Mystery Gift⟧, will also not cause Isaac to leave the area.
items.notes:
* Items that have not been unlocked will not show up in this unique location.
* If Death Certificate is used on a floor while is active, the area will not be affected by the curse, meaning all items will be revealed. ⟦i:402¦Chaos⟧ doesn't affect the area either.
* Items that are typically only granted under special circumstances like ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧ and ⟦i:552¦Mom's Shovel⟧ are present.
* The layout of the area is randomly generated, and items will show up in order of lowest ID number to highest (starting at items in the original Flash version and working up to the Repentance items).
** A new Death Certificate area is randomly generated on the next floor.
** If more items are added to the game through modding, the area will expand to include them, ordered after the Repentance items.
* The only items that do not show up in the Death Certificate area are ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧, hidden items (⟦i:714¦Recall⟧, ⟦i:715¦Hold⟧, passive ⟦i:577¦Damocles⟧, passive ⟦i:34¦The Book of Belial⟧), Death Certificate itself, and G FUEL!.
** During a Challenge, Daily Challenge, or playing ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ their respective banned items will not appear.
* Using Death Certificate while in the area that generates from using it consumes the item without doing anything.
* Using this item multiple times in the same floor will always teleport to the same areas, without respawning the items that were taken or destroyed.
** If an item is taken, it will only destroy the other ones in the current room or any other room Isaac travels to after taking an item, meaning other items present in the remaining rooms will still be available.
** The player can be softlocked by using Death Certificate while having already taken/destroyed all items that were in the area.
* Using this item during the fight against ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ resets the fight after Isaac leaves the special area.
* Using this item while in the ⟦i:622¦Genesis⟧ room will teleport Isaac back into the ⟦i:622¦Genesis⟧ room after taking an item.
** Doing this will turn the current 3 choice pedestals into permanent ones and spawn the next set right on top of them.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with eight Bone Hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.
items.effects:
* Spawns a robotic Pooter familiar that orbits around Isaac and fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles, which destroy them on contact.
** The shielded tears home in on projectiles, but not enemies.
** The familiar deals 1 contact damage per tick or 3 damage per second, and instantly kills weak fly enemies on contact.
** The shielded tears deal 3 damage if they hit an enemy.
items.notes:
* ⟨15⟩ Only 5 Bot Flies can circle Isaac at a time.
* While most orbital familiars orbit Isaac counter-clockwise, Bot Fly orbits clockwise. It shares this orbit ring, speed, and pattern with ⟦i:57¦Distant Admiration⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.
items.effects:
* Upon use, splits enemies in the current room into two smaller versions with ~40% health each.
** Normal enemies can be split twice, while champions and bosses can be split three times. If an enemy cannot be split, they instead take 25 damage.
** If the enemy splits as part of their mechanic, such as Squirt, ⟦e:teratoma¦Teratoma⟧, or ⟦e:the-fallen¦The Fallen⟧, they will instead take the damage required to split them.
** If the enemy has segments, such as ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧ or Buttlickers, they will have their segments cut down to half, rounding down. There are several exceptions listed in the notes section.
** If the enemy has a cable between them, such as Mr. Maw, it will immediately be cut. Mr. Maws specifically will be left with just their head.
items.notes:
* Invincible enemies, such as Stone Grimaces and lowered Hosts, will not be split.
* Multi-segmented enemies will only take damage on one segment.
* ⟦e:pin¦Pin⟧, ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧, ⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧, ⟦e:isaac¦Isaac⟧, ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧, ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦e:the-lamb¦The Lamb⟧, ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧, ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧, ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧, ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧, ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧, ⟦e:ultra-famine¦Ultra Famine⟧, ⟦e:ultra-pestilence¦Ultra Pestilence⟧, ⟦e:ultra-war¦Ultra War⟧, ⟦e:ultra-death¦Ultra Death⟧, and ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ cannot be split.
* Unlike other enemies, ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ has no limit on how many times it can be split with Meat Cleaver.
** If used enough times, Delirium will die.
* ⟦e:gemini¦Gemini⟧ will immediately separate in two, resulting in Suture being enraged even if no damage has been dealt otherwise.
* Using it on ⟦e:loki¦Loki⟧ will turn him into ⟦e:lokii¦Lokii⟧.
* Using it on Grubs will instantly kill them.
* Using it on ⟦e:carrion-queen¦Carrion Queen⟧, ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧, or ⟦e:c-h-a-d¦C.H.A.D.⟧ will split them into two one-segmented pieces, instantly killing both halves.
* ⟨15⟩ Using it on ⟦e:gabriel¦Gabriel⟧ or ⟦e:uriel¦Uriel⟧ will cause them to drop ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ (killing them both without picking up a key piece can result in getting the same key piece twice).
** ⟨16⟩ Only one key piece will drop.
* Using it on ⟦e:the-horny-boys¦The Horny Boys⟧ will turn them into ⟦e:loki¦Loki⟧ and ⟦e:hornfel¦Hornfel⟧. Hornfel will be in his "fleeing" state, but will never exit the room and will only drop extra rewards if Loki is killed first.
* Using it on ⟦e:the-scourge¦The Scourge⟧ will instantly kill it instead of splitting.
* ⟨15⟩ In daily runs, using this item on enemies, especially angel statues increases a part of exploration bonus by quite a bit.
** ⟨16⟩ Each half enemy give half the points the normal enemy gives.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison. ⟨16⟩ Prevents slowdown from cobwebs, and allows Isaac to stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac +2.0 luck.
* Makes Isaac immune to:
** Confusion and fear status effects.
** Burn effects.
*** ⟨16⟩ And damage from Fire Places, enemy fires (i.e. Candler), and fire projectiles (i.e. ⟦e:great-gideon¦Great Gideon⟧).
** Toxic clouds (i.e. Gasbags).
*** ⟨16⟩ This includes poison effects such as those from destroying Mushrooms.
** The ⟦i:331¦Godhead⟧ aura from ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧'s projectiles.
** ⟨16⟩ Slowdown from cobwebs.
* ⟨16⟩ Isaac can stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants flight, +2 damage, and increases speed to 1.1. Grants enough health to have 6 full hearts, if possible. Grants the ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ effect for the room it was obtained in. Automatically given to Isaac after defeating ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧.
items.effects:
* Grants flight.
* Grants a one-time ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧-like effect. This effect wears off upon leaving the room.
* Prevents Isaac's speed from going under 1.1.
* +2 damage.
* If Isaac has fewer than six full hearts of health, Isaac is given enough hearts to get to six full hearts, first by restoring empty red heart containers, and then by granting soul hearts if that isn't enough.
** Does not affect ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ normally.
** ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧'s coin heart containers are affected by the red heart healing, but they will gain Blue Flies instead of soul hearts.
** ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ will have all his bone hearts replenished, and any soul hearts earned will go to The Soul.
** ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧ will gain soul charges instead of soul hearts.
** ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ will receive the flight and stat bonuses for both forms. Since defeating Dogma will swap between forms, the active character before the cutscene will not receive the healing and shield effect, which will instead be given to the form present after the cutscene.
** ⟦i:585¦Alabaster Box⟧ will take the soul hearts before they're given to Isaac, like normal.
* On Normal mode, grants ⟦i:108¦The Wafer⟧ effect, reducing all damage taken to half a heart.
items.notes:
* As with all items crucial to story progress (⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧, ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧, ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, and ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧), this item:
** Cannot be rerolled once picked up.
** Does not take up an item slot for ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧.
** Still grants flight while acquiring Knife Piece 2, as it isn't removed (possible when carried over in a RERUN, using ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧, using ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧, or using ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ on ⟦i:634¦Purgatory⟧).
* ⟨15⟩ Dogma's Holy Mantle effect does not stack with an actual Holy Mantle, but it does stack with a ⟦p:holy-card¦Holy Card⟧ effect.
** ⟨16⟩ All shield-type items now stack in the following order:
*** ⟦t:121¦Wooden Cross⟧
*** ⟦i:535¦Blanket⟧
*** ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧
*** ⟦p:holy-card¦Holy Card⟧
*** ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: While in a room with enemies, spawns red cracks in the ground. Walking over these cracks summons ghosts that launch themselves at enemies and explode.
items.effects:
* Spawns a red crack in the ground somewhere in the room while Isaac is in a room with enemies. Walking over the crack summons a ghost that homes in on the nearest enemy, exploding when it hits it. After the ghost is summoned, cracks will keep showing up in the room until it is cleared.
** The ghost spends one second spawning in before it attacks.
** The ghost deals double Isaac's damage per tick, up to 4 times.
items.notes:
* Only one crack is active at a time.
** The amount of cracks does not increase with additional copies of the item.
* The explosion does not hurt Isaac.
* If a crack is stepped on and the room is cleared before the ghost spawns, it will fly to a random location and explode there.
* The explosions from the ghosts will destroy enemy tears.
* ⟨15⟩ Cracks don't spawn in Challenge Rooms, Boss Rush and ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
* Friendly enemies can be killed by the ghosts.
* The ghosts aren't considered familiars, therefore they're unaffected by items or trinkets that alter familiars or their behavior, such as ⟦i:247¦BFFS!⟧, ⟦i:472¦King Baby⟧, ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧ or ⟦t:148¦Friendship Necklace⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.
items.effects:
* While held, spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. Activating the item causes Isaac to swap places with Stitches. Isaac is briefly immune to damage after teleporting.
** Stitches deals 1.5 contact damage to enemies per tick (3.0 damage per second).
** If Isaac teleports onto an enemy, they will take 40 + 3x Isaac's damage.
** If Stitches teleports onto an enemy, it deals an additional hit for Isaac's damage.
** Teleporting next to a Fire Place will put it out, including blue fires.
** Teleporting on top of Shopkeepers will destroy them.
** Teleporting on top of an angel statue in an Angel Room will not break it.
items.notes:
* Because of the brief immunity after teleporting, Isaac can move in and out of Curse Rooms and open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests free of charge.
* You may also use the immunity frames in greed mode to press the button disabling the waves without taking damage.
* Teleporting on top of an enemy is somewhat risky, as you might take damage from it if you don't move out of harm's way fast enough.
* If timed correctly, the brief immunity can be used to ignore on-hit explosive damage from enemies such as the Kamikaze Leech.
* The familiar can move through any obstacles that can be bypassed with Flight, allowing Isaac to reach otherwise blocked off locations.
** Crawl Space that have an item enclosed by walls can be accessed by teleporting to it with Stitches.
* The familiar is able to be squeezed in between the gap of two diagonally adjacent Key Blocks, allowing the reaching of blocked off items without the expenditure of a key.
* While playing as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, it will only teleport the character who holds the item (if Jacob was holding Stitches and used it, Jacob will swap places with Stitches whilst Esau will stay put).
* While playing as ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧, it will only teleport the body of the Forgotten. Telefrag damage is done to the new location of the body but immunity frames are given to the soul.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Returns Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his stats and items.
items.effects: * Returns Isaac to the beginning of the run in Chapter 1, with all stat boosts, items, pickups, and trinkets intact, similar to a Victory Lap. Unlike a Victory Lap, however, no effects are applied after a certain number of uses, and the timer is not reset.
items.notes:
* Angel Rooms once again become possible to appear even if the player has made a previous devil deal.
* The chance for a Planetarium to appear can once again be increased above 1% without a ⟦t:152¦Telescope Lens⟧, even if the player has previously entered a Planetarium.
* If the Donation Machine was jammed before usage, it will no longer be jammed.
* True Co-Op players can be spawned at the first room after using the R Key.
* If used in a run while achievements and character unlocks are enabled, they will still be enabled after use. Similarly, if these are disabled because the player is in a Victory Lap or seeded run, they will remain disabled after use.
** Beware that using R Key during a Victory Lap will reset the lap counter to 0, as though every Victory Lap is considered part of the same run. Shops will appear as normal, and no items will be removed upon starting the next lap. However, the character will remain ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ if it had been changed, and the game will remain on Hard difficulty.
* The timer and score do not reset.
** This means that the timer requirements to access Boss Rush, ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, and ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧ do NOT reset.
* Item pools are not reset. This means that another R Key can't spawn (and neither can any other items that were already encountered).
* The 13 pill pool does not reset, unlike with a victory lap.
* Due to the acquisition of ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ being dependent on whether or not the items are currently in Isaac's possession, R Key may be used to revisit previous floors and collect the pieces again after already consuming them in the ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ or ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ to unlock ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s door.
* Since ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ will spawn any time their respective floors are visited, R Key may be used to revisit these floors and obtain multiple copies of the items.
* In scenarios where R Key can be purchased, it uniquely costs 99 coins instead of 15.
** This rule does not apply to the extra shop created by ⟦i:602¦Member Card⟧.
** This rule also does not apply to devil deals spawned by ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧.
** Despite this, using ⟦p:ix-the-hermit-reversed¦IX - The Hermit?⟧ on R Key will still only spawn 15 coins.
* In Greed mode, using the item after jamming the Greed Donation Machine will fix the machine, while also preserving the coin total the machine had before jamming.
* R Key cannot be obtained in the Daily Challenge.
** This includes through use of a ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧.
* If an achievement is obtained in the final room of a floor, e.g defeating Delirium for the first time, the achievements are awarded to the player once they complete the first floor of the new run.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a chance to shoot a fist tear that has extremely high knockback and confuses enemies.
items.effects:
* Adds a chance to shoot red fist-shaped tears that deal extreme knockback and cause confusion for 2 seconds.
** Enemies will take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage when they are knocked into a wall/obstacle or when hit by another knocked back enemy.
items.notes:
* The chance to fire fist tears depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 10 - \left \lceil \mathit{Luck} \right \rceil}
** At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 8.01 luck.
* Bosses are also affected by all of Knockout Drops' effects.
* Fist tears play a unique punch sound effect when they hit enemies.
* Knockout Drops can be dangerous in ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ battle, as the Ultra Harbingers may get knocked so far off the screen they become hard to damage further and their attacks cannot be seen properly.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.
items.effects:
* Upon use, Isaac holds an Eraser above his head, which can be thrown in any cardinal direction. Upon hitting a monster, the enemy will be "erased", preventing any of the same enemy from appearing for the rest of the run.
** Deals 15 damage to bosses. If fatal, erases the boss for the rest of the run.
* Can only be recharged by entering a new floor. Batteries and most other methods of recharging have no effect.
items.notes:
* Erased enemies and bosses appear as a brief pink puff of smoke. Any on-death effects are not checked.
** The Seven Deadly Sins minibosses and ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧s will still drop their respective pickups or items.
** If used on multistage bosses like ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ or ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧, erasing the first phase skips any further phases.
** Erasing the first phase of ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ will not end the fight until his hands are also defeated.
* Has no effect on invincible enemies, such as Stone Grimaces, lowered Hosts, or Eternal Flys.
* Bulbs can steal charges from the Eraser.
* If Eraser's projectile hits an enemy's projectile that has collision with Isaac's tears and isn't considered an enemy (e.g. Fire Worm's fire, Coal Boy's coal, Big Bony's thrown bone) it has no effect and Eraser's projectile will be destroyed .
* Although the thrown Eraser cannot hit friendly enemies these enemies can still be erased if their hostile variants are erased. This also means that when effects such as ⟦i:687¦Friend Finder⟧ attempts to spawn an erased enemy it only creates the brief puff of pink smoke wasting the effect.
* Erased enemies will remain erased if a Victory Lap is started.
** Erased enemies will also remain erased if items such as ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧ or ⟦i:622¦Genesis⟧ are used.
* Entities such as Ultra Greed Coins or ⟦e:little-horn¦Little Horn⟧'s Dark Balls are considered enemies and can be erased.
* It is possible to erase Chubber's launched Charger, rendering it unable to attack.
* Erasing Poltys will render Haunted Chests harmless, but may make some rooms impossible to complete without bombs or flight as they rely on a Polty clearing a path.
* Each floor traveled up during the Ascent will recharge the Eraser.
* If a segmented worm-boss such as ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧ or ⟦e:scolex¦Scolex⟧ is removed via Eraser, ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ will disappear if it attempts to turn into that boss. This will spawn the ending chest and count as having defeated Delirium. Other multipart bosses' erased pieces may be unable to spawn, but do not kill Delirium entirely.
* Erased enemies don't grant exploration bonuses in Daily Challenges.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants Isaac a Rotten Heart.
items.effects:
* Grants a Rotten Heart upon use.
** If Isaac has an empty red heart container or empty bone heart, the rotten heart will fill it.
** If Isaac has only filled red and/or bone hearts, it will replace the contents.
** If Isaac has no red or bone hearts, or they all are already rotten, there is no effect.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:rotgut¦Rotgut⟧.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with six Red Hearts and two Rotten Hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac pulls out or puts away an urn that fires a stream of damaging blue flames. It gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.
items.effects:
* Upon use, Isaac pulls out (or puts away) the urn; holding a fire button when it's pulled out emits a stream of blue flames in whichever direction Isaac is aiming. Each flame deals 22.5-31.5 damage per second, depending on how far it's traveled, plus an additional 4.5 damage per second times floor number. Multiple flames can damage the same enemy simultaneously.
** Isaac is also pushed backwards slightly while using it.
** The flames destroy enemy projectiles, Poop, and other fires, but bounce off rocks.
* Killing enemies grants a soul charge to the Urn, up to a maximum of 20. Killing bosses grants a larger boost. Charges must be used to power Urn of Souls, with each charge being equivalent to 15 flames over the course of half a second.
items.notes:
* Can be fired diagonally, or in any direction if using a gamepad or mouse controls (the latter being enabled in options.ini).
* The Urn can't be used to destroy Shopkeepers, unlike ⟦i:164¦The Candle⟧ and ⟦i:289¦Red Candle⟧.
* Multiple Urns share the same charges.
* ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧ can use her soul charges to fuel the Urn. Likewise, ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ can use her blood charges.
* Holding two urns with ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ won't charge both at the same time, each enemy will drop the same charges as if only one urn was held.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: While in an uncleared room, Isaac forms a trail of bloody tears that drags behind him, bursting and dealing damage upon contact with enemies.
items.effects:
* While in a room with enemies, creates a trail of tears that Isaac drags behind him.
** Each tear deals 3.5 damage, regardless of Isaac's damage.
** Tears are spawned at an irregular rate, roughly between once every 0.1 to 1 seconds.
** The tears are spectral.
* Once the room is cleared, the trail will remain but will stop regenerating.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-shell¦The Shell⟧.
* Another trail of tears may appear if the trail is cut in the middle.
* A maximum of 20 tears can exist at once, shared between all trails.
* The tears cannot push active Bombs and Troll Bombs.
* The tears can extinguish Fire Places and set off TNT.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and grant Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin is not held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.
items.effects:
* Upon use, spawns an item pedestal from the current room's item pool.
* Consumes one of Isaac's heart containers, one Bone Heart, or two Soul Hearts, replaced by a broken heart container.
** The priority order of hearts that will be consumed is: one heart container, one bone heart, and two soul hearts.
* After using Magic Skin, if Isaac is not currently holding it, Magic Skin has a chance to replace any item that spawns in the future.
** The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.
** The chance is 33% after one use, 50% after two uses, and 100% after three uses.
** If Magic Skin is on a pedestal somewhere on the current floor, the replacement chance is reduced to 1% per use. Unpurchased Shop and Devil Deal items do not count.
** Each new Magic Skin is fully recharged.
* If Isaac's entire health bar is filled with broken heart containers by using Magic Skin (which kills him, but an extra life will remove one broken heart container), this item will disappear and future items won't be replaced.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-scourge¦The Scourge⟧.
* For most characters, the limit of broken hearts before Magic Skin disappears is 12.
** If using ⟦c:magdalene¦Magdalene⟧ with ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧, Magic Skin will not disappear until you have 18 or more broken heart containers.
** ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ will be able to use the item once, after which it disappears. The item's chance of replacing later items does not trigger, making it similar to ⟦i:515¦Mystery Gift⟧.
*** An extra item cannot be spawned when used with ⟦i:356¦Car Battery⟧.
*** Temporary The Lost forms from the White Fire Place in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II/⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II, or by using the ⟦p:soul-of-the-lost¦Soul of the Lost⟧, have no effect. A heart container is still replaced by a broken heart container, and Magic Skin does not disappear and will still replace future pedestal items if dropped. If Isaac runs out of health in this way as The Lost, he dies immediately.
** ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ gain a broken coin container which are functionally identical to broken hearts. ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ can use it up to 3 times, and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ can use it up to 2 times before Magic Skin disappears.
*** If they have ⟦i:416¦Deep Pockets⟧ and ⟦i:501¦Greed's Gullet⟧, or ⟦t:156¦Mother's Kiss⟧, they can use it more than 2~3 times.
*** Although they can have 13 or more coin hearts under some conditions, they can only have a maximum of 12 broken coin heart containers. They will die only once all coin hearts are gone, causing Magic Skin to disappear.
** If either ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ or ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧ has 6 broken hearts by using Magic Skin, this item will disappear and they will instantly die. However, swapping characters right after one of them reaches 6 broken hearts can prevent them from dying, but permanently disable the one using it.
* Reaching the broken heart limit by using ⟦p:card¦? Card⟧ or ⟦p:wild-card¦Wild Card⟧ won't cause Magic Skin to disappear.
* ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ is able to find Magic Skin while ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧ is carrying it, and vice versa.
* ⟦i:694¦Heartbreak⟧ or ⟦p:vi-the-lovers-reversed¦VI - The Lovers?⟧ will add broken hearts, lessening maximum use of Magic Skin.
* Broken heart containers can be removed by donating to a Confessional.
* In Treasure Rooms with a blind item, if the known item is Magic Skin, it is almost guaranteed the blind item is not.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants flight. In addition to tears, Isaac can charge up and fire a powerful holy laser. ⟨15⟩ Also grants two Soul Hearts.
items.effects:
* Grants flight.
* ⟨15⟩ Grants 2 Soul Hearts on pickup.
* Continuously firing for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a powerful holy laser when Isaac stops shooting, similar to the attacks used by the ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧ bosses.
** The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (up to a maximum of 15 times) and can be aimed diagonally. It lasts for ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).
*** With the EnableMouseControl enabled or an analog controller, the laser can be aimed in any direction, similarly to ⟦i:465¦Analog Stick⟧.
items.notes:
* Tear delay has no effect on the charge time of the laser; it is fixed at 2.35 seconds.
* This item's effects will still work while Blindfolded, which makes it extremely valuable for ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ and in challenges such as or .
* Many of Revelation's synergies are similar to ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧'s.
* Having any charged tear effects like ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧ or Brimstone will lower their DPS if their charge time is under 2.35 seconds, in order to use Revelation's laser.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Increases Isaac's lowest stat and drops either 3 Coins, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key depending on what Isaac has the least of.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts, depending on what attribute Isaac has the least of:
** +1.0 flat damage
** +0.5 fire rate
** +0.2 speed
** +2.5 range
* Also drops either 3 Coins, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key on the ground.
** Bombs and keys are valued at 3 coins' worth. The pickup dropped will be what Isaac has the least value of, and in case of a tie one is chosen randomly.
* As ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧, one Soul Heart or two Red Hearts can also be dropped if they are low on charges.
** Charges are valued at 2 × Charges - 1 coins' worth. For instance having 7 charges would be valued at 13 coins.
items.notes:
* Pickups spawned can be variants of their type.
* ⟨15⟩ As ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, the game still checks the bomb count instead of the poop count. Since Tainted ??? cannot get bombs normally and bombs are turned into poop pickups or troll bombs, he will receive them every time once he has at least 3 coins and a key.
* The tears up can break the soft tears cap of 5, due to the fact that it is a fire rate modifier.
* Cards and trinkets that grant temporary stat increases will affect the stat given by Consolation Prize (e.g. using ⟦p:i-the-magician¦I - The Magician⟧ or carrying ⟦t:65¦Tape Worm⟧ will likely prevent the item from granting a range up, ⟦p:vii-the-chariot¦VII - The Chariot⟧ or ⟦t:37¦Goat Hoof⟧ - speed, and so on.)
** This can be use to force the raise of a chosen stat, if the player knows that 2 of them are tied.
* The stat up is permanent and won't go away even if the item is removed, similar to ⟦i:240¦Experimental Treatment⟧.
** Because of that, ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ can pick it up and freely drop it without losing anything.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a ⟦e:teratoma¦Teratoma⟧ orbital that blocks shots, deals contact damage, and splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking damage. The smaller versions break into blue spiders.
items.effects:
* Grants a large orbital similar to ⟦e:teratoma¦Teratoma⟧ that slowly orbits Isaac.
** The orbital repels enemies that touch it and deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies, once per second.
* After blocking 3 shots and/or dealing 3 ticks of contact damage, the orbital splits into two smaller ones that orbit opposite of each other. They behave the same as the original, except they are smaller and can only take 2 hits before being destroyed, bursting into 3 blue spiders in the process.
** 5 seconds after both orbitals are destroyed, the original, full-size orbital respawns.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:teratoma¦Teratoma⟧.
* If there is a spiked rock in the room, Isaac can destroy Tinytoma with them to spawn lots of blue spiders, as Tinytoma will respawn after being destroyed.
** This can be done until the maximum of 64 blue spiders/flies is reached.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.
* Upon exploding, Isaac's bombs fire 4 ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers in the cardinal directions.
** Each laser deals 8 damage per tick, and can hit up to 19 times.
** Multiple lasers cannot hit the same enemy simultaneously.
** The lasers cannot damage Isaac.
items.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if ⟦e:hornfel¦Hornfel⟧ is killed in his second phase.
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-fallen¦The Fallen⟧.
* The lasers created by Brimstone Bombs can push other bombs, including Troll Bombs and bombs placed by Isaac.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: Beat the juice out of them!
items.description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Instead, they're charged by dealing damage to enemies.
items.effects:
* Causes Isaac's active item to charge when Isaac deals damage to enemies, rather than when he clears rooms.
** Damage dealt by charmed/friendly enemies, active items, orbitals, and familiars (including blue flies and spiders) works as well.
* Charges are gained at a rate equal to the following formula: (40 + (20 × stage)). For example:
** In ⟦s:basement¦Basement⟧ I / ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ I, it takes 60 damage to gain 1 charge.
** In ⟦s:caves¦Caves⟧ II / ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ II, it takes 120 damage.
** In ⟦s:womb¦Womb⟧ I / ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ I, it takes 180 damage.
** In ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧ / ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧, it takes 240 damage.
** In ⟦s:home¦Home⟧, it takes 300 damage.
** Ascent floors use the values of their regular floors, meaning the amount of damage 4.5 Volt needs to gain charges steadily decreases during the Ascent sequence until reaching Home.
* Multiple charges cannot be gained at once.
* Overkill damage does not count towards a charge.
items.notes:
* Tainted characters with active items in their pill/card slot will not have those items charged by 4.5 Volt if their active item isn't already fully charged.
* ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ can be particularly strong with 4.5 Volt during long fights such as ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ and ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ if she still has the ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧, as the damage she deals will allow her to repeatedly duplicate her familiars, dealing many times her typical damage during a single fight.
* ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧ will benefit from 4.5 Volt's effect for regular item charges while retaining her ability to use Soul Hearts as item charges. This applies to ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ with her Red Heart charges as well.
* ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧ will gain charges from 4.5 Volt when Dark Esau damages enemies.
* While the two versions of ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ normally charge both their active items at the same time, 4.5 Volt will only charge when the state that holds it deals damage, and will prevent it from being charged when the other clears a room. This makes 4.5 Volt much worse while playing ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a miniature ⟦e:baby-plum¦Baby Plum⟧ familiar that propels itself diagonally around the room, firing tears behind itself as it travels.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a familiar that mimics ⟦e:baby-plum¦Baby Plum⟧'s attack of shooting tears and propelling itself diagonally around the room. It deals 2 contact damage per tick to enemies (6 per second). It fires 15 tears per second behind itself while moving which deals 3 damage.
** Fruity Plum will prioritize moving towards nearby enemies.
** If there are no enemies, Fruity Plum loosely orbits Isaac.
items.notes: * Since the achievement to unlock explicitly states you must merely defeat Baby Plum, regardless of the method used, sparing Baby Plum and letting her leave counts towards the unlocking of this item.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Summons ⟦e:baby-plum¦Baby Plum⟧ to fight for Isaac for roughly 10 seconds, dealing high damage.
items.effects:
* On use, summons ⟦e:baby-plum¦Baby Plum⟧ to fight for Isaac in the current room for roughly 10 seconds.
** Baby Plum will always twirl, jump, then spit blood and bounce around the room before waving goodbye and flying away.
** Baby Plum does 12 contact damage per tick (24 per second), 3.5 damage per shot, and 2 damage per tick with creep (20 per second).
items.notes:
* If Isaac goes enough time (about half a minute) without hurting ⟦e:baby-plum¦Baby Plum⟧ during a boss fight, she will fly away and leave behind a Plum Flute on the Boss Room pedestal.
** Damage done with ⟦i:709¦Suplex!⟧ does not count as hurting Baby Plum.
** Damage done indirectly, like losing Black Hearts, does not count as hurting Baby Plum.
** Damage dealt passively by familiars such as ⟦i:113¦Demon Baby⟧, ⟦i:417¦Succubus⟧, and ⟦i:581¦Psy Fly⟧ does count as hurting Baby Plum.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels towards the Boss Room, giving an aura that increases damage and tears and grants homing tears.
items.effects:
* Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels toward the Boss Room, fading through doors as it travels towards it. Once it reaches the boss room, the familiar stands in the center of the boss room for the rest of the floor.
* The familiar emits an aura that, while Isaac stands inside it, gives him a ⟨15⟩ 1.8× / ⟨16⟩ 1.2x damage multiplier, a 2.5× fire rate multiplier, and homing tears. It also gives Isaac a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to ⟦i:457¦Cone Head⟧'s effect except with a higher chance.
items.notes:
* In ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, the familiar will travel to the boss room that contains ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧.
* In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, the star will travel directly to the position where Isaac spawns upon entering a new floor.
** On the last floor, it will move to the upper part of ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧'s room.
* Once the star settles down in the boss room, the damage preventing aura can be used to play Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars for free, provided they are spawned via ⟦p:xiv-temperance¦XIV - Temperance⟧ or ⟦p:xx-judgement¦XX - Judgement⟧ cards, respectively.
* The star may travel through Secret Rooms and Curse Rooms on its path to the boss room.
* The star will travel through Red Rooms if they create an optimal path to the boss room.
** The star can backtrack into rooms it already went into if a more optimal path is created by a Red Room.
* During the Ascent, the star will linger in the boss room of each floor, and will not progress backwards through the stage.
* The star will travel through the hole to the ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ fight and be present in the fight. It will be centered on the top half of the room, and will not move when the arena expands.
* The star will be present against ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧, but does not follow for ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧.
* If the door to ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ is opened, the Star of Bethlehem will enter it instead of the boss room containing ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧ or ⟦e:the-lamb¦The Lamb⟧.
** The Star will move backwards towards ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s door if the door is opened later during the floor (such as by using ⟦i:175¦Dad's Key⟧).
* For ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧, the bonuses from the star are only applied if Tainted Forgotten is within its aura, not ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Soul⟧.
* If either ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧ have picked up the star, the familiar will spawn in the room where the character holding it becomes active, which may not be the starting room. It will only move while the character holding it is active, effectively making it take twice as long to travel to the boss room unless Tainted Lazarus also has ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧.
* During , the star acts as usual; originating in the starting room and gradually moving towards the boss room.
* The star will be copied in the Mirrored World and will simultaneously travel in both worlds.
* Entering and leaving the ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ area will reset the star and make it reappear in the room with the minecart.
* The star exhibits a "rubber banding" effect in its movement. If it is in a room that is closer to the Boss Room than the one Isaac is in, it will move slower; if the opposite is true, it will move faster.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns an ice cube familiar that slides around when walked into. It slows and deals contact damage, freezing monsters it kills.
items.effects:
* Spawns an ice cube familiar. It cannot move on its own, but slides around when Isaac walks into it, uses a melee attack on it, or when Isaac or enemies shoot at it.
* The familiar damages and slows enemies it touches while moving. It can deal up to 17.5 damage when it collides with enemies, depending on how fast it's moving.
* Monsters killed by Cube Baby are frozen.
** Frozen monsters will follow the same physics as Cube Baby, and will shatter on impact creating ice shards that are capable of freezing other monsters
* Cube Baby can block enemy projectiles.
items.notes:
* Killing enemies by freezing them does not however count as a "kill" for the purposes of activating the on kill effects of certain items and trinkets. Because of this, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will count towards the on kill effects, rendering them quite difficult to use. These items and trinkets are: ⟦t:118¦Bat Wing⟧, ⟦i:704¦Berserk!⟧, ⟦i:62¦Charm of the Vampire⟧, ⟦t:60¦Eve's Bird Foot⟧, ⟦i:520¦Jumper Cables⟧, ⟦i:411¦Lusty Blood⟧, ⟦i:621¦Red Stew⟧, ⟦t:58¦Samson's Lock⟧, ⟦t:189¦Sigil of Baphomet⟧, ⟦i:350¦Toxic Shock⟧, and ⟦i:657¦Vasculitis⟧.
* If a non-boss enemy dies within 10 ticks (0.33 seconds) after being hit by Cube Baby, it will be frozen regardless of what killed it.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: While held, enemies leave behind ghosts on death. Stronger enemies leave bigger ghosts. Using the item causes the ghosts to explode and damage nearby enemies, and instantly kills all ghost enemies with less than 50% HP.
items.effects:
* While held, enemies leave behind small, red ghosts on death; using the item causes the ghosts to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and destroying nearby enemy projectiles. The explosions will not destroy obstacles, move pickups, or damage Isaac.
** The damage exploding ghosts deal is equal to 3 + 0.04x the health of the enemy the ghost spawned from + ((floor-1)x0.5), and each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times. Blast radius increases the more powerful the explosion is.
*** Enemies with high health, such as champion enemies, minibosses, and bosses will leave behind a larger ghost that creates three explosions.
** Isaac will also leave a ghost upon death, which deals 200 flat damage if detonated.
* Using the item will instantly kill any enemy that has the 'ghost' tag and is at 50% or less HP, including bosses.
items.notes:
* Ghosts can be moved very slowly by shooting at them.
* Enemies that can be instantly killed include all entities that have the ghost tag in entities2.xml.
** This can even be used to kill ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ should it transform into a ghost boss, such as ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧, while at or below half HP.
** The full list of enemies affected are:
*** Candler
*** Dust
*** Kineti
*** Lil' Haunt
*** Nightwatch (unimplemented)
*** Polty
*** Red Ghost
*** Wizoob
** Plus the following bosses:
*** ⟦e:clutch¦Clutch⟧
*** ⟦e:the-forsaken¦The Forsaken⟧
*** ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧
*** ⟦e:the-heretic¦The Heretic⟧
*** ⟦e:the-rainmaker¦The Rainmaker⟧
* Ghosts that are currently not visible on the screen (e.g. in larger rooms) will not be detonated when using the item.
* Friendly enemies can be killed by the ghosts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Converts good pills into bad pills and identifies all pills. Bad pills now have secondary positive effects. Grants one Black Heart.
items.effects:
* Identifies all pills upon pickup.
* Spawns a pill.
* Grants one Black Heart on pickup.
* Converts all good pills into their bad counterparts.
* Grants +0.6 damage for each stat down pill and +1.2 damage for each stat down horse pill Isaac has taken, including those taken before acquiring False PHD.
* Using a non-stat down bad pill drops a Black Heart.
items.notes:
* Bad Trip and Health Down pills will turn into I Found Pills when Isaac is at one heart.
* Neutral pills will not have a secondary effect.
* Telepills will be converted to ??? even if the latter has not yet been unlocked.
* Gulp! and Vurp! will be converted to Horf! even if the latter has not yet been unlocked.
* Pills are only converted while held by a character with False PHD. For example: If playing as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ and ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob⟧ has this item, pills that got converted into 'bad' pills like a Tears Down pill can be given to ⟦c:jacob¦Esau⟧ to convert them back into whatever the pill was originally.
* Losing the item by either dropping it as ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧ or re-rolling it via ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, etc., causes the damage buffs given to be removed.
* With ⟦i:252¦Little Baggy⟧ and False PHD, the Marked Skull in ⟦s:depths¦Depths⟧ II will drop a ??? pill, making it much harder to open ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧ that run.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with seven pills and one Black Heart.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives +0.5 speed and greatly increases the rotation speed and damage of orbitals for 3 seconds. Passively gives Isaac a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage.
items.effects:
* While the item is held, grants a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage (3.5 per tick, or 35 per second).
* While the item is being used, gives Isaac +0.5 speed and increases the contact damage on Isaac's familiars, even if they do not normally deal any. Additionally, orbital familiars spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac when they deal damage.
** The contact damage improves to (1.5 x contact damage + 6). If a familiar has no contact damage naturally, it still receives the +6.
** Blue flies and blue spiders are also affected, and don't disappear while the item is in use.
* The recharge timer is gradually drained over 3 seconds while the item is being used.
** Isaac can stop using Spin to Win at any time by releasing the use item button, at which point Spin to Win starts recharging.
** Spin to Win can be used while it is not fully charged, gradually draining however much charge there is.
items.notes: * Isaac's effective speed can be higher than 2.0 while the item is active, even if the stat is capped.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Enemies explode into tears upon death, which inherit the effects of Isaac's tears.
items.effects:
* Upon killing an enemy, 1 - 16 blood clot tears are released from them in random directions.
** The amount of tears released from an enemy is based on the enemy's health, and is not affected by Isaac's damage, nor the number of tears hit.
** These tears are red in coloration, regardless of Isaac's tears, but will inherit the coloration of applied to enemy status effects.
* Burst tears will do set damage per floor. The formula for this is: (3.2 + 0.3 x stage).
items.notes:
* If an enemy is killed while affected by a status effect, the burst tears will inflict the corresponding effect.
* Homing, range and shot speed do not affect Vasculitis.
* Released tears can be difficult to distinguish from enemy shots, especially from enemies which split in to burst shots upon death such as Red Boom Fly and light blue champions.
** ⟨16⟩ The projectiles are now a unique shape and color to improve visibility.
* All forms of damage will cause an enemy to release tears.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Causes Isaac to spawn Minisaac familiars when he takes damage, which chase and shoot at nearby enemies.
items.effects:
* Whenever Isaac takes damage, he summons a micro-Isaac familiar, known as Minisaac, that chases nearby enemies and attacks on its own.
** Minisaacs deal 1.35 base damage that scales with +0.15 per floor: damage = 1.35 + 0.15 * (floor - 1)
** Minisaacs shoot 3 tears per second and their tear delay is not affected by Isaac's stats.
** Minisaacs persists between rooms and floors.
** Each Minisaac is spawned with 15 health points that are constantly drained with a rate of 0.4 per second. The draining stops when they reach 0.8 HP.
*** They are healed back to full HP whenever Isaac takes damage, even when the familiars cap is reached.
** Enemies can damage Minisaacs by shooting projectiles at them or dealing contact damage.
*** Isaac's bomb explosions will also damage the familiars.
*** Minisaacs are immune to spikes and lasers.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:polycephalus¦Polycephalus⟧.
* The familiar cap for Giant Cell is 16, after which taking damage will not spawn a new Minisaac.
* Minisaacs will change their skin color based on the character that they were spawned from.
** Certain items that change skin color can also affect the familiars' appearance.
* When playing as ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, the familiars take the style as either The Soul or The Forgotten, depending on who gets hit.
** If the familiar takes the style of The Forgotten, it will also inherit its bone club attack, dealing 8.1 base damage that scales with +0.9 per floor. It will swing its bone club 1.5 times per second. It can also interact with pickups using the bone club.
* Minisaacs for ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ will spawn from The Forgotten's body and inherit its skin color but they will shoot regular tears.
* Familiars spawned for ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-azazel¦Tainted Azazel⟧ will not inherit the ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser and will fire regular tears.
* If Isaac has any form of flight, the Minisaacs will receive wings and will be able to fly as well.
** Minisaacs spawned before flight was acquired will not get upgraded, unless the flight is acquired by killing ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧ and starting ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight in which case they will get upgraded.
** Minisaacs that acquire temporary flight (e.g. from ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧) will remain permanently upgraded until they die, even after the effect of The Bible expires.
* If being hit makes Isaac become the ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧, a Shadow-like Minisaac will spawn instead of a regular one.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +2.5 Range, Increases tear size.
items.effects:
* +2.5 Range.
* +0.22 tear size.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns two portals at the beginning of each floor that each lead to either the Boss Room, Treasure Room, or Secret Room.
items.effects:
* At the beginning of each floor, spawns 2 portals that lead to certain special rooms:
** A red portal leading to the Boss Room.
** A yellow portal leading to the Treasure Room.
** A blue portal leading to the Secret Room.
**⟨16⟩ A green portal leading to the Shop.
* On floors with no treasure rooms or no secret rooms, only 1 portal will spawn.
* The portals will disappear once the starting room is left, whether a portal was taken or not.
items.notes:
* Assuming that each portal has an equal chance of spawning, before chapter 4, each portal has a ⟨15⟩2/3 ⟨16⟩1/2 chance to appear. From chapter 4 onward, there's a 1/2 chance of either color spawning.
** In challenges without treasure rooms or without secret rooms, only 1 portal will spawn on each floor.
* No portals will spawn in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
* During the Ascent, the portal will spawn in the "starting room" that leads to the next floor.
* Entering the starting room in the Mirrored World will cause the portals to spawn there, leading to the mirror's treasure, secret, boss, ⟨16⟩ or shop.
* If the run is exited, the portals will not be there upon continuing.
* In ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ the boss portal will lead to a random boss, not necessarily ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧.
* Entering a portal with active on the current floor has a chance of teleporting Isaac to a random room instead.
* The Treasure Room portal will not lead to a Planetarium if available, unlike ⟦p:xvii-the-stars¦XVII - The Stars⟧.
* ⟨16⟩ Card Reading's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: The first five enemies killed in a room will spawn stationary shooting familiars where they died.
items.effects:
* Upon killing enemies, spawns a stationary familiar in their place for the room, up to a maximum of 5. These familiars do not follow Isaac.
* The following familiars can spawn:
** ⟦i:188¦Abel⟧
** ⟦i:607¦Boiled Baby⟧
** ⟦i:8¦Brother Bobby⟧
** ⟦i:113¦Demon Baby⟧
** ⟦i:608¦Freezer Baby⟧
** ⟦i:163¦Ghost Baby⟧
** ⟦i:112¦Guardian Angel⟧
** ⟦i:167¦Harlequin Baby⟧
** ⟦i:275¦Lil Brimstone⟧
** ⟦i:100¦Little Steven⟧
** ⟦i:431¦Multidimensional Baby⟧
** ⟦i:95¦Robo-Baby⟧
** ⟦i:268¦Rotten Baby⟧
** ⟦i:390¦Seraphim⟧
** ⟦i:67¦Sister Maggy⟧
** ⟦i:174¦Rainbow Baby⟧
** ⟦t:57¦???'s Soul⟧
items.notes:
* Killing the heads thrown by ⟦e:rag-man¦Rag Man⟧ before they turn into a Rag Man's Ragling is not counted as a kill and will not spawn a baby.
* The same familiar can spawn multiple times.
* Despite being stationary, tear-shooting babies will still inherit Isaac's movement, angling their tears accordingly.
* Enemies killed by ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧ count as yours and will spawn a baby.
* During ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight, familiars spawned by Quints stay on screen throughout the chase sequence.
* ⟨15⟩ When playing as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, Quints will not disappear on ⟦i:711¦Flip⟧ but instead give the ability to spawn more Quints if Flip is used again. This is very effective in Greed mode and Boss rush because the automatic flip triggers when completing a wave, giving more Quints for every other wave.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac periodically turns into a spiked statue, briefly becoming invulnerable and dealing contact damage.
items.effects:
* Every 6 seconds, Isaac turns to stone and sprouts spikes for 1 second. While Isaac is in this state, he is immune to damage and deals 40 contact damage.
** Isaac flashes white three times before turning to stone on the fourth flash. The first three flashes are accompanied by a "ticking" sound, the final one with the spike extension sound of a mimic chest.
** Unlike ⟦i:210¦Gnawed Leaf⟧, Isaac can still move and shoot tears.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:tuff-twins¦Tuff Twins⟧.
* Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars will still deal damage while Tooth and Nail is active.
* With proper timing, Curse Rooms can be both entered and exited without taking damage.
* When invincible, Spiked Chests/Mimic Chests can be opened without taking damage.
* When under the effects of the Paralysis pill Isaac cannot change into a statue.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: +1 Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac. Item pedestals also offer a random food item. Picking up a food item temporarily grants +3.6 damage and permanently boosts 2 stats.
items.effects:
* Grants one Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac.
* Item pedestals cycle between the initial item and one of several food items.
* Upon picking up an affected food item, in addition to their normal effects, Isaac gains a temporary +3.6 Damage boost (which fades over 30 seconds), a permanent boost to 2 stats depending on the food item consumed, and a permanent -0.03 speed reduction.
* Affected food items heal 3 Red Hearts instead of 2.
items.notes:
* Food items that Binge Eater affects and can cycle between, and their bonuses, include:
** ⟦i:25¦Breakfast⟧: +0.2 Shot Speed, +2.5 Range.
** ⟦i:24¦Dessert⟧: +1.0 Damage, +0.2 Shot Speed.
** ⟦i:23¦Dinner⟧: +0.5 Tears, +0.2 Shot Speed.
** ⟦i:22¦Lunch⟧: +0.5 Tears, +2.5 Range.
** ⟦i:456¦Midnight Snack⟧: +1.0 Damage, +1.0 Luck.
** ⟦i:26¦Rotten Meat⟧: +1.0 Damage, +2.5 Range.
** ⟦i:346¦A Snack⟧: +0.2 Shot Speed, +1.0 Luck.
** ⟦i:707¦Supper⟧: +0.5 Tears, +1.0 Luck.
* All Food items that Isaac has collected before picking up Binge Eater will provide their respective stats, including the -0.03 speed down for each item, but excluding the temporary damage up and extra healing.
* The temporary Damage boost cannot be stacked, and picking up additional food items resets it to +3.6.
* Has no effect on certain items that are required to progress through the game, such as ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧, or ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧.
* No bonuses are granted from other items alluded to be edible, such as ⟦i:193¦MEAT!⟧.
* Removing collected food items or Binge Eater itself will also remove associated stat bonuses.
* Because this affects items in Devil Rooms and all of them cost 1 Red Heart Container, Devil Deals can be used as free stat upgrades.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags, and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.
items.effects: * Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags, and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.
items.notes:
* Guppy's Eye does not show the contents of tinted rocks, Poops, and other obstacles.
* Guppy's Eye does display enemies that can be contained within chests.
* Chests and Grab Bags can only display up to four pickups at a time. If there are more than four, higher-value pickups like Bombs, Keys, and Soul Hearts will have priority on the display.
* If a Red Chest looks like it doesn't have anything in it, it will teleport Isaac to the floor's Devil Room / Angel Room.
* Due to how Trinkets generate, if a Chest displays a trinket, all future Chests will also display/give that trinket until it spawns in some way, at which point all Chests will display a new trinket.
** This means it is worthwhile opening even chests containing undesirable trinkets so that the trinket cycle advances.
* Mimic Chests will change their contents whenever their spikes pop out. The unchanged drops can still be obtained by:
** Opening them with ⟦t:151¦Flat File⟧ or ⟦i:53¦Magneto⟧.
** Using swing attacks (such as ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, ⟦i:147¦Notched Axe⟧, ⟦i:579¦Spirit Sword⟧, etc.)
* This effect works on all non-ending chests, including Mom's Chest.
* This item is substantially less useful in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, due to the scarcity of chests.
* The contents of Sacks or Chests that haven't spawned yet will still be revealed (for example, in rooms that spawn such Chests or Sacks when Isaac pressed a hidden switch, etc.).

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a controllable ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ to fight enemies alongside Isaac, functioning similarly to ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧. If Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.
items.effects:
* Spawns ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ as an extra character alongside Isaac, who is controlled exactly like ⟦c:jacob¦Esau⟧.
** Keeper will have his base stats, except speed, and use coins as health.
** He will not receive any of his starting items, such as ⟦i:349¦Wooden Nickel⟧ or ⟦t:83¦Store Key⟧.
* When Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.
* Grants 1 Bomb upon pickup.
items.notes:
* For calculating room drops, the room drop rate depends on the total luck of Isaac and the Keeper. Because Keeper starts with -2 luck, having Strawman makes room drops much less likely.
* Keeper's health is displayed at all times above his head.
** If is in effect, his health bar will be hidden the same way as Isaac's.
** Keeper will start with 2 coin hearts or 3 if the ⟦a:191¦Keeper now holds... A Penny!⟧ achievement is unlocked.
* Keeper is able to pick up items independently from Isaac. He has his own inventory.
** This inventory is not displayed on the HUD.
** When Keeper dies, the items he obtained are permanently removed.
*** ⟨15⟩ This includes quest items like ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧, potentially leaving you unable to progress.
** ⟨16⟩ Keeper can't pick up quest items.
* Keeper is not able to pick up any active items, trinkets, or consumables.
* Keeper cannot pick up any type of hearts, except for Gold Hearts.
** Eternal Hearts can also be picked up, but to no effect, effectively wasting them.
* Keeper's speed syncs with Isaac's, as with ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧.
* ⟨15⟩ Devil Room items will cost money instead of health as long as Keeper is alive.
*⟨16⟩ Devil Room Items costing red hearts can be picked up by Keeper. Items costing red heart containers will remove the corresponding amount of coin hearts from Keeper. Going to zero coins hearts will kill Keeper. Items costing any amount of soul hearts or active items costing red hearts other than ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ can not be interacted with by Keeper as if they were a shop item that can not be afforded.
*⟨16⟩ Devil Room Items that can be picked up for free via ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧ in ghost form, ⟦p:soul-of-the-lost¦Soul of the Lost⟧, and White Fire Place, can be picked up by Keeper without other items disappearing. Allowing keeper to take the remaining items before Isaac picks up an item.
* When placing a Bomb, Keeper will place another at no cost.
* Keeper can be used to play Sacrifice Rooms at the cost of coins instead of hearts.
* Boss Challenge Rooms will be closed unless Keeper is also at 1 coin heart.
* Keeper is not able to walk through doors or into Crawl Space, although he is able to enter the beam of light that takes Isaac to the next floor after the ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ / ⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧ fight, the one spawned by ⟦i:622¦Genesis⟧, as well as entering the big chest after defeating bosses in later stages.
* Respawn items work as normal for Keeper, but never involve teleporting to the previous room (see interactions).
* If Keeper plays a Blood Donation Machine, it will pay out with 0-1 coins.
* ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ unlocks cannot be earned using Strawman.
* Similar to ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, it is possible to take both items between item choice pedestals with careful positioning.
* Even though Keeper is considered a second character, the run ends if Isaac dies.
* Technically, Strawman is marked as a familiar item in the game's files, although most familiar-modifying items, such as ⟦i:247¦BFFS!⟧ don't have any effect on Keeper.
* Unlike Jacob and Esau, invincibility frames are not shared between Keeper and Isaac.
* If collected in a challenge where Isaac is blindfolded, Keeper will be blindfolded too.
* Re-emerging from the part of ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ II where ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ is hidden will cause Strawman to be regenerated from scratch. This permanently remove all items the summoned Keeper had collected up until that point.
* If Strawman is picked up during the second lap of a Victory Lap, he will become ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ alongside Isaac on every subsequent lap.
* ⟨15⟩ If Keeper is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧, regardless of whether or not the main character has been hit.
* This item boosts the exploration bonus in daily runs a lot.
* ⟨16⟩ Strawman's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.
*Keeper can not be hit by ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧, only being pushed around by Dark Esau's collision.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Sends Isaac on an Ascent toward ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
items.effects:
* Initiates the Ascent sequence.
* Any trinkets left in Treasure Rooms and Boss Rooms will turn into ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧s.
items.notes:
* Dad's Note cannot be rerolled or destroyed in most ways, such as with ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧, ⟦i:477¦Void⟧, ⟦i:706¦Abyss⟧, or even ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧.
* Dad's Note cannot be duplicated via ⟦i:485¦Crooked Penny⟧, even if other items in the same room would be duplicated. Other duplication items such as ⟦i:347¦Diplopia⟧ work as normal.
* The boss room containing Dad's Note cannot be exited once entered, similar to the ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ boss fight. The only way to exit is through teleportation.
* The only item that can be taken in the boss room of this special version of ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ is Dad's Note. No other items will be spawned.
** ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧ pulls from the Boss Pool when used.
* Treasure Room and Shop will still generate in this special floor as in usual floors, giving Isaac more options.
* If Dad's Note is obtained outside of the special boss room via unintended means (such as using ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ on ⟦i:669¦Sausage⟧), the music will slowly fade out, but the Ascent will not start.
* Red Room doors cannot appear on the borders of the map, preventing access to the I AM ERROR room and ⟦s:womb¦Womb⟧/⟦s:utero¦Utero⟧/⟦s:scarred-womb¦Scarred Womb⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Adds a Red Heart Container, fully heals Isaac, and gives +0.2 Speed, +0.5 Damage, +0.5 Tears, +2.5 Range, +0.2 Shot Speed, and +1.0 Luck. Increases the chance of encountering a Devil Room, Angel Room, and/or Planetarium each by 6.9%.
items.effects:
* Fully heals Isaac.
* Gives Isaac one Red Heart Container.
* +0.2 Speed.
* +0.5 Damage.
* +0.5 Tears.
* +2.5 Range.
* +0.16 Shot Speed.
* +1.0 Luck.
* +6.9% Devil Room / Angel Room chance.
* +6.9% Planetarium chance.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: If a room gives a reward when cleared, there will be two different rewards to chose from. Taking one causes the other to disappear.
items.effects:
* At 0 Luck and with no other modifiers, reduces the chance for a room clear to give no reward from 22% to 16%.
* Whenever a room clear reward spawns, a different alternative reward is spawned next to it. Picking up either reward causes the other to disappear.
items.notes:
* If one of the rewards is a troll bomb, picking up the other reward will not make the troll bomb disappear. Likewise, the other reward will not disappear if the troll bomb blows up.
* If one of the consumables generated by this effect is a heart, converting it with ⟦t:140¦Apple of Sodom⟧ or ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ will not cause the other consumable to disappear.
* If one of the consumables generated is a Haunted Chest and is picked up and thrown by the Polty (thus opening it), picking up the contents of the chest will not make the other consumable disappear, and taking the other consumable will only make the opened chest disappear.
** Killing the Polty after it awakens but before it can properly pick up the chest will result in the other reward disappearing, however.
* If one of the consumables is a Bomb Chest, blowing it up and picking up its contents will not make the other consumable disappear, and taking the other consumable will only make the opened chest disappear.
** However, this doesn't apply if the Bomb Chest has an item in it. Taking the other consumable will cause the Stone Chest item to disappear and vice versa.
* Unlike item-based Options effects like ⟦i:249¦There's Options⟧, it is not possible to take both consumables as ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, with ⟦i:667¦Strawman⟧, or in True Co-op. One consumable will always disappear even if both are collected at the same time.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he heals with Red Heart pickups.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart healed with Red Heart pickups or when gaining an extra filled heart container:
** +0.02 speed.
** +0.05 tears.
** +0.10 flat damage.
** +0.25 range.
** +0.02 shot speed.
** +0.10 luck.
* Spawns a Red Heart when picked up.
items.notes:
* Items/effects that directly heal Isaac (such as ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧, ⟦p:xix-the-sun¦XIX - The Sun⟧, ⟦i:62¦Charm of the Vampire⟧, etc.) do not trigger stat boosts from Candy Heart.
* Healing using Rotten Hearts triggers the stat boosts for Candy Heart.
* Picking up an Eternal Heart while already having one so that a new Red Heart container is formed provides stat boosts.
** The stat boosts are equivalent to picking up a full Red Heart.
** Picking up the first Eternal Heart does not grant stat boosts.
** Adding the second Eternal Heart to Isaac's health directly (e. g. by using ⟦i:146¦Prayer Card⟧) does not give stat boosts.
* This item does not give stats when adding to ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧'s blood charges.
* This item is useless for characters that can't have red hearts (e.g. ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧, ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, etc.).
* Any healing prior to picking up Candy Heart will not provide stat boosts.
* ⟨15⟩ The stat bonuses are "stored" on the Candy Heart. Dropping or losing it in any way won't immediately revert the bonuses gained, only when Isaac's stats are updated again. The respective stat changed is the one that loses the Candy Heart bonuses.
** The bonus stats will be lost if Isaac's stats are updated by dropping out of the game or if the game crashes.
* The stat bonuses are seeded, meaning the same stat ups will apply in the same order in the same seed.
* Strategy Suggestion: Leaving Soul Hearts on the ground during a level allows the player to force Red Heart damage and still offer Devil/Angel Deal protection for the next floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Devil deals now cost Coins, Shop items now cost health, and consumables in shops are free but surrounded by spikes.
items.effects:
* Devil deals and Black Market items can now be paid with Coins.
** Anything that generates Devil Deals (such as ⟦i:292¦Satanic Bible⟧ or the special chests in ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧) will also create items that cost coins.
* Items in Shops now cost health.
* Consumables in shops have no cost, but are surrounded with Spikes and can't be pushed out with an explosion.
items.notes:
* Buying shop items for health does not prevent Angel Rooms from appearing.
* Taking a health consumable surrounded by spikes at a single heart or less will still result in Isaac's death.
* Immunity to spikes or invulnerability of any kind (e.g. via ⟦i:93¦The Gamekid⟧) does not prevent damage when taking consumables in shops.
* Shop consumables cannot be taken during invincibility frames, e.g. from taking another consumable.
** ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ can take the consumables, without losing his ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧.
** When transformed into ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧/⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II with the White Fire Place, shop consumables can be taken for free even without ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧.
* The item is not available to ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ normally. If acquired through ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧, ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧ or such, it has no effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: If Isaac enters a Devil Room but leaves without taking/opening anything in it, he gets +1 Damage and a Soul Heart at the start of the next floor.
items.effects:
* Upon entering a Devil Room, a white inverted cross will appear above Isaac's head. If Isaac goes to the next floor with the icon still above his head, he will gain a Soul Heart and +1.0 damage.
* Taking anything generated by the room (items or consumables) will result in the icon going away, including opening Red Chests / Black Sacks.
items.notes:
* After Isaac has taken a Devil Deal, while a Confessional would give an ⟦pool:Angel Room¦Angel Room item⟧, it has a 100% chance to spawn Redemption instead; while a Sacrifice Room would give a Soul Heart, it has a 50% chance to spawn Redemption instead. This is the only way Redemption can be naturally generated during a run, as the item is not in any item pool.
** Other reliable ways include using ⟦i:628¦Death Certificate⟧, or using ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧ on ⟦i:674¦Spirit Shackles⟧.
** Redemption has a small chance to be a starting item as ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧, ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧, or any character with ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧.
** Using ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ as ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧ has a small chance to spawn Redemption.
** If ⟦i:601¦Act of Contrition⟧ was taken after taking a Devil Deal, Redemption is not guaranteed to spawn.
* If there is an item in a Red Chest, the icon will not disappear, even if the item is taken.
* Opening Red Chests that have been spawned after room generation, e.g. as a room clear reward or enemy drop, or opening them with ⟦i:53¦Magneto⟧, won't remove the icon.
* Taking ⟦i:132¦A Lump of Coal⟧ or ⟦i:293¦Head of Krampus⟧ after a ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧ fight will keep the icon.
* Picking up items made free through usage of items such as ⟦i:521¦Coupon⟧ or a ⟦p:credit-card¦Credit Card⟧ will still remove the icon and provide no benefit.
** However, swapping out a free active item for another that was already held will not remove the icon.
* Taking free pickups/items that spawned after the room was entered (e. g. room clear rewards, drops from Fire Places, rewards from Devil Beggars) will not remove the cross.
* Taking pickups/items spawned by ⟦i:719¦Keeper's Box⟧ inside the Devil Room will remove the cross.
* Taking items from a Black Market or ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧ affected Shop will not remove the cross.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: On taking fatal damage, instead of dying, Isaac's ghost is chained to his dead body, and he can continue to fight with 1/2 of a heart, returning to life after 10 seconds. After it activates, it must be recharged by gaining a Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source.
items.effects:
* If Isaac were to take fatal damage, rather than dying, he instead transforms into a ghostly form, resembling ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧, with half a heart. The ghost has flight, spectral tears, and is chained to Isaac's immobile corpse. Isaac's soul returns to his corpse' position after 10 seconds, if he doesn't die while in ghost form.
** Isaac will have invulnerability frames for 1/3rd of a second after reviving.
