** After activation, Spirit Shackles is disabled until Isaac gains a half or full Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source. HP that is used to charge Spirit Shackles will not be added to Isaac's health.
items.notes:
* When the effect is ready, the chains on Isaac's costume are light blue. When they are drained and cannot protect from death, they are grey.
* The Soul form functions near identically to when playing as the ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧.
* If Isaac has any red heart containers, the ghost form will always spawn with half a red heart. If he has no heart containers, he will always spawn with half a Soul Heart.
** ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ will spawn with an empty Bone Heart.
** ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ will spawn with one coin heart container.
* Recharging Soul Shackles will always consume a full Soul Heart if possible, even though a half Soul Heart can still charge the item.
** Blended Hearts will only recharge the item if the Blended Heart would give Isaac soul health.
** Items that add Soul/Black Hearts directly to Isaac’s health (⟦i:72¦Rosary⟧, ⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧, ⟦i:292¦Satanic Bible⟧ etc.) will recharge Spirit Shackles and give one less Soul Heart.
** Spirit Shackles can be recharged by picking up Soul Hearts while in the ghostly form, but it cannot re-activate until its effect ends.
* If Isaac leaves the room while in ghost form, he will not be chained to anything and can move freely. He will also come back to life at his current location rather than where his body was left.
** Isaac can be trapped if he's in the middle of a pile of rocks when this happens. This can be fixed by quitting, then continuing the run.
* Spirit Shackles is not considered a respawn item as Isaac does not actually "die", and will activate prior to all other respawn effects.
** If Isaac dies while in ghost form and is brought back to life by a respawn item, he will respawn, unshackled, in ghost form for the remainder of the duration.
* Spirit Shackles cannot activate in the Mirrored World, nor can the ghost form given by it be used to enter the Mirrored World.
* Spirit Shackles will trigger if a fatal Devil Deal is taken.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Unlocks doors and reveals a random room on the map when Isaac takes damage.
items.effects:
* Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:
** Unlocks all locked doors in the room (doors that need the room to be cleared are not affected).
** Opens the Secret Room and the Super Secret Room if adjacent to the room you are in.
** Reveals a random unmapped room on the floor.
** Destroys all tinted rocks and rocks with Crawl Spaces in the room.
items.notes:
* The effect is able to reveal the Ultra Secret Room.
* The unlocking effect is able to open:
** The golden door to ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧;
** Doors leading to ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ / ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ / ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧;
*** Since opening the door to ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ requires taking damage, Cracked Orb will immediately open it, effectively halving the cost.
** The entrance to the ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ fight in the ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ and ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧;
** ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧.
* The effect will not open the doors to:
** Challenge Room or Boss Challenge Room from inside or outside
** Regular doors in ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ / ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧.
** Boss Rush / ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ doors even after the fight.
** Greed mode
* Taking damage while inside a Secret Room will open all its entrances, even if they lead to Challenge Rooms and are barricaded after ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧ / ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧ encounter.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: If Isaac has one red heart or fewer at the beginning of a floor, he gains an empty red heart container.
items.effects: * If Isaac has one red heart or less at the beginning of a floor, an empty heart container is added.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-visage¦The Visage⟧.
* This item will have no effect for characters that cannot have red hearts: ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧, ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧, ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧.
* The empty heart containers will replace any other heart containers if the maximum has been reached.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Causes Isaac to turn into a ghost if he gets hit while in an uncleared room, giving him flight and spectral tears and blocking the next hit he takes.
items.effects:
* The first time Isaac takes damage while in an uncleared room, time is stopped for 2 seconds and Isaac becomes a ghost and leaves his body behind, which drops to the floor. While in ghost form, Isaac has flight and spectral tears and the next hit he takes is negated.
** Isaac's tears and speed are greatly increased while time is stopped, although this is not shown on the HUD.
** Isaac's ghost re-enters his body after the room is cleared or if he gets hit again.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:clutch¦Clutch⟧.
* The damage blocked by being in ghost form also affects self-damage and red-heart draining sources, like Devil Beggars, ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧, etc.
* Receiving lethal damage can potentially save Isaac's life if he manages to heal before the ghost reenters the body.
* ⟦i:486¦Dull Razor⟧ may be used to safely activate Astral Projection as The Lost.
* It's also possible to leave the room while the ghost is outside the body, either by bombing it or having items that keep doors open, such as ⟦t:124¦Door Stop⟧ or ⟦i:590¦Mercurius⟧. This grants Isaac an additional chance to heal.
** Teleporting outside of the room will not work.
* ⟨15⟩ Astral Projection cannot be triggered inside of Boss Rush.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Replaces tears with fetuses that chase down enemies and deal contact damage. Each shot requires a brief charge up.
items.effects:
* Isaac gains a short delay charge attack that fires homing, piercing, spectral fetus tears.
** The fetus tears do 75% of Isaac's Damage, 3.75 times per second, until they run out of Range.
** The fetuses will automatically fire when Isaac is at full charge, meaning the charge cannot be held.
** Charge time is calculated based on Tear Delay.
*** \text{Fetuses per Second} = \frac{30}{Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1}
*** Fetuses per second is capped at 15.
items.notes:
* Fetus size scales with damage.
* The fetuses slow down upon contacting enemies, making its homing effect more powerful.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that charges a miniature ⟦i:399¦Maw Of The Void⟧ attack while Isaac shoots.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a familiar that creates a fluctuating black ring after a 1 second charge time that damages enemies that touch it, similarly to ⟦i:399¦Maw Of The Void⟧.
** The black ring lasts for 1 second and deals 3.5 damage per tick, up to 15 times per ring, for a total of 52.5 damage.
items.notes: * Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Abaddon having ⟨8⟩ 4th / ⟨16⟩ 6th priority.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: While firing, Isaac charges up a short-ranged ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧-like diarrhea beam that shoots behind him.
items.effects:
* Continuously shooting for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a short-ranged brown ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser and corn shots behind himself when he stops shooting.
** The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second), ticks up to 19 times and lasts ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).
** Corn shots deal 6 damage, and a random amount are created each blast.
items.notes: * ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:dangle¦Dangle⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that flies forward, consuming pickups in its path and dealing damage to enemies. Each pickup increases its size and damage and spawns a Blue Fly. ⟨15⟩ Every 4 pickups, opens a portal that leads to an unexplored room. ⟨16⟩ After 1 + (stage number) pickups, opens a portal which leads to a special room with contents that persist between floors.
items.effects:
* Summons a portal familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots to deal contact damage to enemies.
** ⟨16⟩ The portal will launch itself forward after double-tapping.
* The portal will consume all pickups and trinkets in its path, converting them into blue flies and causing the familiar to become larger and deal more contact damage.
* ⟨15⟩ When the familiar consumes 4 pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to an unexplored room on the current floor and its damage bonus is reset.
* ⟨16⟩ When the familiar consumes 1 + (stage number) pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to a unique purple Clean Bedroom and will disappear for the rest of the floor, respawning upon entering a new floor.
** The room contains a random Chest in the top left corner, a chance for a random battery in the bottom left corner, and a chance of ⟦p:dice-shard¦Dice Shard⟧, ⟦p:soul-of-eden¦Soul of Eden⟧, ⟦t:122¦Butter!⟧, or ⟦i:523¦Moving Box⟧, in the bottom right corner. In the center of the room is the portal exit, which will bring Isaac back out through the portal he entered.
** This room, and any contents within, will remain constant for the rest of the player's run, accessible by any portal.
* ⟨15⟩ Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 + 2 * (consumables destroyed) and ticks up to 10 times per second.
* ⟨16⟩ Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 * (familiar size) and ticks up to 10 times per second.
** There are 4 distinct sizes, the amount of consumables required to increase size depending on the stage Isaac is in. It is not possible to reach the maximum size in earlier stages before the familiar summons a portal.
items.notes:
* Lil Portal doesn't consume pickups or damage enemies it passes over while trailing behind Isaac; it only does so while being launched.
* Lil Portal doesn't consume poop pickups when playing as ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧.
* ⟨15⟩ The portal cannot lead to the Devil Room, Angel Room, Ultra Secret Room, entrance to the alt-path, Black Market, I AM ERROR Room, or ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ fight.
** In the Mirrored World, the Ultra Secret Room is accessible via the portal.
* ⟨15⟩ The room portals take Isaac to is determined at the time they're created; if Isaac clears the room the portal would take him to, he will still be taken to that room if he uses it.
* ⟨15⟩ If every room has been explored, portals summoned by the familiar will do nothing and Isaac will jump up and down in them. This effect appears to be cosmetic only, but it will provide brief invincibility frames equivalent to two ⟦i:396¦Ventricle Razor⟧ portals stacked on top of one another. Same effect occurs if a portal is summoned in rooms that don't appear on map, as Mom's Heart room in ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧/⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ II.
* ⟨15⟩ Portals can lead to Curse Rooms, forcing Isaac to take damage in order to leave.
* ⟨15⟩ Secret Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms can be entered for free by making a portal after all other rooms on the floor are cleared.
* ⟨16⟩ A trapdoor created in the Lil Portal bedroom with ⟦i:84¦We Need To Go Deeper!⟧ or ⟦p:ehwaz¦Ehwaz⟧ will always lead to the I AM ERROR room.
** A Crawl Space can be made as normal, but leaving the Crawl Space takes Isaac to the room the portal was created in, rather than the Lil Portal bedroom.
** Unlike other changes to the room, all trapdoors will disappear on the next floor.
* If Lil Portal consumes enough pickups to create a portal, but Isaac enters a trapdoor which leads to the next floor before the portal spawns, then Lil portal will instead spawn a portal on the next floor.
* Portals will persist after Isaac uses them or leaves the room, and will always lead to the same room.
** Portals do not respect pathing rules, and can spawn on single-tile walkways and in front of doors, forcing Isaac to use them and preventing him from leaving the room through that door. This can cause a softlock depending on what door it blocks and where the portal leads.
*** As Isaac cannot enter a portal while in another animation, picking up a trinket/consumable, or taking damage will allow him to pass over the portal.
*** Alternatively if the player has items like ⟦i:598¦Pluto⟧ or has consumed enough "One Makes You Small" Pills then it is possible to avoid being softlocked as pushing up against walls of any kind will still allow passage through doors and with enough speed, pitfalls and obstacles as well.
* ⟨8⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Portal having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
** ⟨16⟩ Lil Portal has the fourth-highest priority.
* If Lil Portal consumes a Golden Penny, the penny will still reappear.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a Nerve Ending familiar that burrows out of the ground to grab and deal damage to enemies over time.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac a Nerve Ending familiar that burrows out of the ground to grab enemies for 4 seconds. Grabbed enemies take damage over time, are slowed, and are unable to move.
** Worm Friend deals 4 damage per tick (8 per second), for a total of 32 damage per grab.
** Worm Friend can target and restrain bosses in addition to normal enemies, even including endgame bosses such as ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-stain¦The Stain⟧.
* Enemies can avoid/escape being grabbed if they move fast enough, jump, or teleport.
* Worm friend must wait 5 seconds after losing/killing/releasing its target before it can attack another enemy.
* When playing as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧, entering a room with Worm Friend active and then using ⟦i:711¦Flip⟧ to swap to the other character will keep Worm Friend active for the remainder of the room.
* When grabbing ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, the Beast is still able to dive down and appear on the other side, though no animation will be played for either diving down or up. This can be dangerous as there will be no warning of the Beast switching sides.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Enemies spawn floating bones on death, which block shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
items.effects:
* Enemies spawn 1–2 floating bones on death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
** Bones block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.
** Bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the moment they were created.
items.notes:
* This item can be spawned by ⟦e:bumbino¦Bumbino⟧ if he picks up 12 cents.
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:carrion-queen¦Carrion Queen⟧.
* Bone particles will be created whenever Isaac shoots, though this is purely visual.
* Because the bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage in the moment they were created, if the damage stat was changed, the bones that were already present on the screen will use Isaac's old damage stat.
* The bones can immediately hit splitting enemies' spawns, damaging or destroying them as well.
** When fighting ⟦e:ultra-pestilence¦Ultra Pestilence⟧, if Isaac has a strong, piercing tear modifier such as ⟦i:395¦Tech X⟧, the Ultra Pestilence flies spawned will die in quick succession, summoning many bones that push the boss off the screen and out of reach, making the fight significantly harder and more tedious.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Enemies have a chance to spawn ghosts on death, which chase and deal contact damage to enemies and explode after a short time.
items.effects:
* Grants Isaac a chance to spawn a friendly ghost upon killing an enemy, which rapidly chases down and deals contact damage to enemies.
** The chance to spawn a ghost is 33% and is not affected by luck.
** Ghosts deal contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage, 4 times per second (2x Isaac's damage per second).
* After 7 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 flat damage to nearby enemies up to 3-4 times.
** The explosion cannot damage Isaac or the environment.
items.notes:
* Enemies killed by ghosts are unable to spawn more ghosts, except for those killed by the ghost's final explosion.
* The ghost's explosion is capable of damaging friendly monsters, such as Bonies summoned by ⟦i:545¦Book of the Dead⟧.
* Ghosts cannot be taken outside the room they spawned in.
* The ghosts are not considered to be familiars and as such aren't affected by any items that modify the behavior of familiars.
** This also means that Isaac can have more than 64 ghosts at a time and this won't override other familiars.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns random wisps that shoot various tears, block shots, and deal contact damage. The number of wisps spawned increases every time the jar is used.
items.effects:
* Spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac, fires tears, blocks enemy shots, and deals contact damage to enemies, much like the ones spawned by ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧.
** The jar initially spawns only ⟨15⟩ one / ⟨16⟩ two wisps, but spawns an additional wisp each time the jar is used, up to a maximum of 12 per use. The number of wisps that will be spawned by the jar is indicated by both a counter and the jar visually filling up with wisps.
** The wisps spawned by the jar can be ones created by any Book of Virtues synergy, although basic wisps are much more common than special variants.
* Isaac can have up to 3 rings of wisps; an inner, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 6 wisps, a center, clockwise-spinning ring of 8 wisps, and an outer, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 12 wisps, for a total of 26.
items.notes:
* While most wisps that can be given act similarly to normal wisps, there are some with effects that can potentially harm Isaac.
** ⟦i:65¦Anarchist Cookbook⟧ Wisps look like bombs and spawn Troll Bombs when destroyed.
*** ⟦i:483¦Mama Mega!⟧ wisps look like gold tinted bombs, and will spawn Golden Troll Bombs.
*** Bomb wisps with a gray tint are not dangerous; ⟦i:47¦Doctor's Remote⟧ wisps only invoke their special effect when said item is used.
** Wisps that look like gray cubes will invoke the effect of the ⟦i:437¦D7⟧ when they take damage.
** ⟦i:44¦Teleport!⟧/⟦i:419¦Teleport 2.0⟧ Wisps fade into and out of existence and have a chance to teleport non-boss enemies to a random spot in the current room when their tears hit them.
* Switching the jar with other active items and then picking it up again does not reset the number of wisps that will be spawned on use.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he picks up a Soul Heart.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart gained by picking up Soul Hearts or Black Hearts:
** +0.04 speed.
** +0.1 tears.
** +0.2 flat damage.
** +0.5 range.
** +0.04 shot speed.
** +0.20 luck.
* Spawns a Soul Heart when picked up.
items.notes:
* Black Hearts give the same stat boosts as normal soul hearts.
* If a character can only have soul hearts for health (such as ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧), picking up two Eternal Hearts will count as giving one soul heart's worth of stat boosts.
* Soul Locket only activates when picking up actual Soul Hearts, not if they're directly added to Isaac's health (such as by a Balls of Steel pill or ⟦i:78¦Book of Revelations⟧).
* This item gives stats when adding to ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧'s soul charges.
* ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ can use this item normally, despite not having health.
** Unlike ⟦i:585¦Alabaster Box⟧, Black Hearts still work with these characters
* This item is useless for ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, since they cannot encounter soul hearts.
* Hearts acquired prior to picking up Soul Locket will not provide stat boosts.
* The stat bonuses are seeded, meaning the same stat ups will apply in the same order in the same seed.
* ⟨15⟩ The stat bonuses are "stored" on the Soul Locket. Dropping or losing it in any way won't immediately revert the bonuses gained, only when Isaac's stats are updated again. The respective stat changed is the one that loses the Soul Locket bonuses.
** The bonus stats will be lost if Isaac's stats are updated by dropping out of the game or if the game crashes.
* This item can be crafted from ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧ with eight Soul Hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks.
items.effects:
* On use, spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks, similar to ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧.
* Friendly monsters can take damage from flames, spikes, and other hazards.
items.notes:
* Currently, there are 21 monsters that can be spawned in:
** Clotty
** Clot
** I.Blob
** Grilled Clotty
** Vis
** Double Vis
** Chubber
** Danny
** Coal Boy
** Gurgle
** Hive
** Nest
** Holy Mulligan
** Drowned Hive
** Bony
** Black Bony
** Holy Bony
** Blaster
** Dople
** Evil Twin
** Maw
*** Blasters cannot attack unless Isaac presses the active item button, in which case they fire at the cursor.
*** Gurgles can turn into Splashers, which can be controlled like normal.
*** Double Vis, Holy Mulligans and Drowned Hives seem to be very rare spawns.
*** Vises do not require charging, but they sometimes fire at Co-Op players automatically.
*** Dople and Evil Twin will not fire opposite of Isaac, unlike what they usually do.
* Certain enemies will have a crosshair to show where they are firing, mainly those with stringed attacks. A Black Bony will only keep the crosshair until it fires all three shots, but a Holy Bony will keep its crosshair for as long as fire keys are held.
* Bullets fired from friendly mobs will still visibly blink as if they're an enemy bullet, and will be highlighted if Bullet Visibility is set to High, despite not harming Isaac.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.
** If Isaac doesn't have any Red Heart Containers, he will respawn with a Half Soul Heart instead of a Half Red Heart.
* When Isaac respawns as the inner child, he emits a blood explosion that deals 35 flat damage to all nearby enemies.
items.notes:
* Resurrection items activate in a set order. Inner Child is 5th in this order after ⟦p:soul-of-lazarus¦Soul of Lazarus⟧, ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧, ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧' inherent extra life, and ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧.
* Once this item has been unlocked, if the current character's Tainted version was already unlocked or the current character is a Tainted character, it is guaranteed to spawn in the hidden closet in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
** This item will appear even if Inner Child had been obtained earlier in the run, allowing Isaac to have two copies of the item.
** Despite being hard-coded not to appear anywhere else for him, this specific occurrence of Inner Child will still spawn for ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧.
** If this item is obtained in Home, a viable strategy is to intentionally die towards the end of the fight with ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧. Isaac will be respawned with the size down and Speed up, and these effects will carry over to the Beast fight along with the healing provided by ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧, making Isaac much harder to hit for the fight.
*** If Isaac's health consists of only Red Hearts, a safer strategy may be to use bombs to die in the starting room of Home to trigger the item's effects and then use the bed in that room to recover all Red Hearts back.
* The size down from being revived by Inner Child is the same as if Isaac had collected ⟦i:598¦Pluto⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Item pedestals cycle between 5 random items before being picked up.
items.effects:
* New item pedestals cycle very quickly between 5 random items.
** The 5 items will cycle in the same order every loop.
** Items are rerolled at a rate of once every 0.2 seconds.
items.notes:
* Plot-related items (i.e ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧/⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧, ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧/⟦i:551¦Broken Shovel 2⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧/⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧,⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧,⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ etc.) are unaffected by Glitched Crown.
* One of the items will be the initial one spawned/rerolled, while the other four will be from the item pool of the room the item is in.
* ⟨15⟩ Items spawned from Chest normally have a small delay between when they spawn and when Isaac can pick them up; if Isaac has Glitched Crown, this delay is removed and he can pick up the item the moment it spawns, effectively forcing him to get a random item.
** Chests have to be lightly tapped and immediately walked away from to avoid accidentally picking up the item so Glitched Crown can be used properly.
* ⟦c:isaac¦Isaac⟧'s ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ effect and ⟦c:tainted-isaac¦Tainted Isaac⟧'s inherent ability are overridden by this effect.
* All five options will have their weight decremented on sight like usual.
* A good strategy to get a specific item is to remember the one that comes before it in the cycle. Stand as close to the pedestal as possible and move towards the pedestal when the item that comes before the desired one appears.
** ⟨15⟩ Pausing the game between each roll can make this substantially easier.
*** ⟨16⟩ Pausing the game does not pause the rotation of items. Instead, its cycling speed increases to one per frame, returning to normal once the game is unpaused.
* Due to Glitched Crown's indiscriminate cycling of items, anything that turns item pedestals into blind item pedestals, such as Curse of the Blind, or traveling to a floor that offers blind items such as ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧, renders Glitched Crown's effect useless or even detrimental, as there is a chance of missing out on desirable items permanently among the blind choices.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Causes enemies to bounce off of Isaac, dealing damage to them if they hit an enemy or obstacle. Also gives Isaac the chance to deflect enemy shots.
items.effects:
* Enemies that touch Isaac will bounce off him and propel in the opposite direction. If they hit an obstacle or wall while bouncing, they will take damage.
** If an enemy bounces into another enemy, the second enemy will also take damage.
* When an enemy bounces off of Isaac, there's a 50% chance that Isaac won't receive contact damage.
* Additionally grants a 50% chance for projectiles to bounce off of Isaac without taking damage.
items.notes:
* The damage enemies receive when they get bounced into a wall or an obstacle is equal to 8 + 2 * floor.
** The same damage value applies when an enemy gets bounced into by another enemy.
* Enemies that don't deal contact damage cannot be bounced off.
* Since contact damage is applied rapidly, it is possible to end up taking damage and then immediately bouncing the enemy off.
* Bounced off projectiles deal a flat damage that doesn't scale with the current floor or Isaac's stats. This damage is usually 6, but can slightly vary depending on the enemy that shot the projectile.
** Lasers cannot be bounced off.
* The bouncing effect also works against Fire Places and spiked enemies such as Poky, Slide, and Grudge, granting a chance to avoid unintentional damage.
* Isaac can also bounce off Fly Bombs spawned by Blasters and even deny damage from their explosion.
* Bombs and Troll Bombs cannot be bounced off.
* Belly Jelly can prevent damage from Bad Trip pills.
* Belly Jelly can prevent ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧ from being turned into his Lost form by Dark Esau.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Prevents items of quality 0-1 from appearing, and items of quality 2 from appearing 33% of the time. Quest items are unaffected.
items.effects:
* Prevents low-quality items from appearing, greatly increasing the quality of items received from all item pools.
** Items with a quality of 0-1 are automatically rerolled.
** Items with a quality of 2 have a 33% chance to be automatically rerolled.
** Quest items cannot be rerolled.
items.notes: * Due to being quality 0, ⟦i:9¦Skatole⟧ cannot be obtained from Shell Games after Sacred Orb has been picked up.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.
items.effects:
* Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. They deal 1 full heart of damage per use.
* Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.
items.notes:
* The spikes will appear in the current Devil Room upon picking up Sanguine Bond.
* The spikes will deal damage to enemies that walk or fly over them, including ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧.
** As Krampus often spawns in the center of the room, it will deal a significant amount of damage to him, almost killing him completely.
* The item causes all other spikes in the Devil Room to retract.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns eight orbital flies, which turn into Blue Flies after they block a shot. Each time a room is cleared, spawns another orbital fly.
items.effects:
* Gives eight orbital flies when picked up.
* Each time a fly blocks a projectile, it will turn into a blue fly.
* Each time a room is cleared, spawns an orbital fly.
** The maximum number of orbital flies Isaac can have is 16.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Grants 3 broken hearts and +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has. Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more until Isaac has nothing but broken hearts.
items.effects:
* Grants +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has.
* Immediately grants 3 broken hearts.
** Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more, replacing other types of hearts if necessary, and activates ⟦i:35¦The Necronomicon⟧'s effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.
** Once Isaac has no non-broken hearts left, he dies. Extra lives will apply at this point.
items.notes:
* At the maximum of 11 broken hearts, Isaac gains a total of +2.75 damage.
* The effect does not save Isaac from fatal Devil deals.
**However, while taking an item that costs heart/s and will result in death, if Isaac takes any damage, it will leave him on half a blue heart with taken item and will add 2 broken hearts.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: The first 6 times Isaac takes damage on a given floor, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of +1.02 and +3.00, respectively.
items.effects:
* When Isaac takes damage, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor.
** Speed gained per hit is (0.04x previous hits taken) +0.07.
** Fire Rate gained per hit is (0.1x previous hits taken) + 0.25.
*** Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate.
*** Fire rate bonuses can exceed the normal maximum fire rate limit.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Gives Isaac a halo that summons beams of light on enemies inside it. The halo grows larger the more times Isaac has taken damage this floor.
items.effects:
* Isaac receives an angelic halo around him.
* When an enemy comes in contact with the halo, a beam of light starts to form above them. If they stay in the halo for about a second, a beam of light will strike down on them, dealing 3.5 damage and creating 4 more beams that shoot out in all cardinal directions.
** The initial beam of light does 3.5 damage per tick (up to 15 times) and the others deal 1.75 damage per tick (up to 15 times).
*** If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 152.5 damage.
* Each time Isaac takes damage, the halo will grow in size, up to a maximum of 10 times. This isn't damage scaled, but allows Isaac to trigger the Salvation effect from further away. The halo size will reset after leaving the floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a familiar that becomes a weaker clone of the floor's boss when entering the Boss Room. Defeating it drops an extra item.
items.effects:
* Spawns a flat, rotating fetus familiar that follows Isaac.
* After entering a Boss Room, the familiar will move closer to the center of the room, and become a clone of the boss. Isaac must defeat both bosses.
** The Vanishing Twin and original boss will be set to 75% of their maximum health, and their movements and attack patterns will be around 20% slower.
* Upon death, the clone boss will drop an item pedestal where it died from the boss item pool, even if the fight isn't over yet.
** ⟨16⟩ The item cannot appear on top of the trapdoor's tile.
* The effect doesn't occur against mini-bosses and end-chapter bosses such as ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧, ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧, ⟦e:isaac¦Isaac⟧, ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧, etc.
* The Vanishing Twin familiar will return when Isaac reaches the next floor.
items.notes:
* If Vanishing Twin becomes a clone of a boss with a hardcoded item drop, such as ⟦e:gish¦Gish⟧ or one of the Harbingers, the second item pedestal will be from the boss item pool instead of the boss' regular drop.
* Managing to defeat the boss before the twin has transformed into it will not prevent the twin from doing the transformation, and the boss fight will continue.
* Obtaining Vanishing Twin in the boss fight itself will not take effect immediately. The boss room must be re-entered in order for the twin to transform.
* On floors with multiple bosses (e.g. ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧) or when getting , the twin will only act on the first boss encountered.
* The twin will not transform into bosses that are randomly found in some default room layouts.
* This item has no effect in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ and will not normally spawn in this game mode.
* If it becomes a clone of ⟦e:great-gideon¦Great Gideon⟧, 2 extra waves of enemies are added to the battle, as well as the second Great Gideon also performing attacks.
* If Vanishing Twin turns into ⟦e:clutch¦Clutch⟧, the clone will immediately enter its second phase due to not having any Clickety Clacks to possess.
* When multiple ⟦e:rotgut¦Rotgut⟧s are spawned, only one needs to be entered.
* In true Co-op, the pedestal spawned by Vanishing Twin will have an extra item for each player.
* Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Vanishing Twin having the lowest priority at ⟨15⟩ 6th / ⟨16⟩ 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.
* Vanishing Twin does not appear in item pools (and cannot be found normally) from Chapter 4 onwards.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns two familiars that float on either side of Isaac and fire tears that use his tears, range, shot speed, and tear effects, and scale with damage.
items.effects: * Spawns two familiars who float by Isaac's side and fire tears that use Isaac's tears, range, shot speed, tear effects and that each deal 0.375x his damage.
items.notes:
* Twisted Pair is very similar to the item ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧. It provides the same total damage per second increase in the form of a familiar (familiars in this case).
* When playing as ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-lilith¦Tainted Lilith⟧, the demon familiars will deal 50% of Lilith's damage each.
* Holding the up/down + left/right attack buttons will make one demon go further behind and the other one in front of Isaac.
* Because the demons need time to adjust their position while firing, the left/right directional buttons can be tapped to shoot more precise, straight lines of tears.
* They don't inherit all effects and stats from the player. See Interactions below check for small oversights.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac builds rage every time a room is cleared. After four rooms, fires a large ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser when entering the next room.
items.effects:
* Isaac builds up rage every time he clears a room, which is indicated by the patch of skin that spreads around his face, as well as the four sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.
* After four rooms, Isaac's head will start to flash red; upon entering a room with enemies, he will fire a large ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser for ~3.33 seconds.
** The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second).
items.notes:
* The counter for activation will go up during ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, Challenge Rooms, Boss Challenge Rooms and Boss Rush waves, as well as the waves in the ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ fight.
** If the Brimstone laser is ready, it will fire automatically after clearing a Greed Mode or Beast fight wave.
** ⟨15⟩ It will not fire in challenge rooms or boss rush.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.quote: I can see see the future future future
items.description: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.
items.effects: * When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.
items.notes:
* Previously used cards, pills, and runes are effectively used again, meaning items that modify the effects of cards, pills, or runes will also modify the effects that Echo Chamber activates.
** As a result, previously taken golden pills and blank runes will activate a random effect each time Echo Chamber activates them.
* If Isaac uses cards that convert/destroy pickups (such as ⟦p:ace-of-spades¦Ace of Spades⟧, ⟦p:black-rune¦Black Rune⟧, ⟦p:ix-the-hermit-reversed¦IX - The Hermit?⟧, etc.), any other cards Echo Chamber activates that generate pickups have a high chance to have their pickups converted.
* It is advised to avoid using cards that teleport Isaac, as he will be teleported to a specific room the next three times he uses a consumable. This effectively negates any current-room effects from consumables, such as ⟦p:xv-the-devil¦XV - The Devil⟧ or ⟦p:algiz¦Algiz⟧, during that period, as Isaac is teleported after they activate.
** Similarly, it is also advised to avoid using unidentified pills, as Isaac runs the risk of activating either a stat down or Telepills for the next three consumables he uses.
* When obtained on ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, Echo Chamber will only duplicate the last three cards or pills previously used on the character with Echo Chamber. As a result, the character without Echo Chamber can safely use teleport cards or unidentified pills.
* If this item is somehow removed and reobtained during the run (such as when obtained from ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧ or ⟦t:166¦Modeling Clay⟧), the last three consumable types used during the time Isaac had Echo Chamber will be remembered. ⟦i:622¦Genesis⟧ and Victory Laps will erase all of the remembered consumable types, however.
* A card, rune, or pill must be consumed for the effect of Echo Chamber to trigger. That means using ⟦i:286¦Blank Card⟧, ⟦i:348¦Placebo⟧, or ⟦i:263¦Clear Rune⟧ will not trigger Echo Chamber.
** Consuming ⟦p:xiv-temperance-reversed¦XIV - Temperance?⟧ will trigger its effect normally. The pills consumed as a result of using the card are not added to Echo Chamber, and any pills in the current run's pool can be picked as normal.
* While ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧ will activate the effect of Echo Chamber and trigger the last three consumables used, using a different consumable near a wall that a red room could be created on will not create a red room, even if a Cracked Key has been used before.
* Getting automatically revived by ⟦p:soul-of-lazarus¦Soul of Lazarus⟧ does not add it to the queue, and directly using the soul stone will not allow for automatic revival in the future.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns an Old Chest at the start of each floor.
items.effects:
* Spawns an Old Chest at the start of each floor.
* Old Chests are similar in appearance to Locked Chests and likewise require a Key to unlock, but have the color of a normal Chest and a worn-down appearance. When opened, they contain one of the following:
** 1-3 Soul Hearts (43% chance)
** 3 trinkets (42% chance)
** An Old Chest item (10% chance)
** An Angel Room item (5% chance)
items.notes:
* The chest also spawns in the mirrored floor of ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II and ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II if picked up before entering.
* During the Ascent, the chest spawns in the original starting room of each floor, right above the beam of light to the floor above.
* The chest does not spawn in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧.
* Does nothing on ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧ if the new floor is entered by the character without Isaac's Tomb.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: After taking damage, spawns an orbital wisp that lasts for the entire floor, up to a maximum of six. They fire tears but do not block shots.
items.effects:
* When Isaac takes damage, spawns a red wisp that fires spectral tears and deals contact damage to enemies (but does not block projectiles). These red wisps last for the entire floor, and Isaac can have up to 6 red wisps at a time.
** Wisps deal 3 + 0.1 * (current_floor - 1) damage per tear, and fire tears once per second.
** Wisps deal contact damage equal to 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (15 ticks per second = 7.5x Isaac's damage).
items.notes: * The wisps share the first layer of ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ wisps, and contribute to filling its cap of 8.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has +2 flat damage and flight. Characters have independent items and health. Dying as either character ends the run.
items.effects:
* When used, swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has three Black Hearts, +2 flat damage, and flight. When used as Esau Jr., swaps back to the original character.
* Coins, Bombs, and Keys are shared between the two characters, but everything else (including hearts, items, cards/pills, and trinkets) are not shared and apply only to the character that collects them.
* When used for the first time, Esau Jr. gains a random item for each item the original character had. Each new item comes from the same item pool the respective original item was taken from.
** Trinkets, Cards, Pills, and/or Active items are not given; only passive items are.
** Quest items like ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ are given to both characters, as is the Esau Jr. item.
** Pickups that would normally be generated by the new items will not drop when Esau Jr. is first used.
* If either character dies, they both die, regardless of whether the other character has any remaining health.
* If multiple copies of Esau Jr. are used, starting from the fifth one, instead of activating its regular effect, the item is consumed and spawns a familiar that behaves like ⟦i:188¦Abel⟧ but deals 7.5 damage per shot with higher fire rate.
items.notes:
* Unlike ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus Risen⟧ and ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧, Esau Jr. is not an actual character. He is merely a costume applied to the current character, and as such retains all of the special features of the character such as health mechanics, ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧'s blindfold, and pocket active items.
* Despite starting with only black hearts, Esau Jr. is able to gain heart containers if the original character could.
* ⟨15⟩ Esau Jr. will not keep any passive starting items the original character had, and they won't count towards the number of items Esau Jr. will get.
* ⟨16⟩ Esau Jr. keeps all the default starting passive items the character had.
** ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧'s passive starting item is neither preserved, or grants Esau Jr. an item. The same applies to items granted by ⟦i:381¦Eden's Blessing⟧.
* If a character has an Eternal Heart, then that character must be active when going to a new floor for the eternal heart to turn into a heart container.
* ⟨15⟩ Using Esau Jr. removes the damage penalty on Daily Challenges while retaining the schwag bonus. ⟦i:416¦Deep Pockets⟧ schwag only persists if you don't transition between rooms.
* ⟨16⟩ Esau Jr.'s quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his speed, tears, and damage, but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.
items.effects:
* Upon use, puts Isaac in a berserk state for 5 seconds, during which the following effects apply:
** +0.4 speed.
** +3 flat damage .
** Tears are replaced by a jawbone melee weapon that is similar to ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s bone club.
*** The jaw bone deals 3× Isaac's damage when swung and 1.5× Isaac's damage per tick when thrown (3× Isaac's damage per second).
*** The swung jaw bone reflects enemy shots.
**** Reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
*** The thrown jaw bone charges very quickly compared to the Forgotten's bone club, but as berserk only lasts five seconds, it uses a noticeable amount of the effect's limited duration to charge and throw the jaw bone.
*** The swung jaw bone can collect pickups and open chests.
*** A successful melee hit on an enemy makes Isaac immune to damage for roughly 0.25 seconds. This immunity doesn't protect against self-inflicted damage such as ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ or Blood Donation Machine.
** While Berserking, Isaac's fire rate is halved then increased by 2. This will be a tears upgrade unless Isaac's tears is 4 or above.
*** If playing as The Forgotten, the ×0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.
** Killing an enemy while "Berserking" increases Berserk's current duration by 1 second.
** Killing an enemy grants very brief invincibility, preventing damage from exploding enemies.
** Every enemy killed will also grant +0.4 speed until the effect ends.
** Isaac is unable to die while Berserk is active. He can be reduced to 0 hearts, but will not die until the effect ends.
*** This does not apply to insta-kill effects (such as ⟦i:577¦Damocles⟧ and ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧) - they will kill Isaac even if Berserk is active.
* This item charges when Isaac deals damage to enemies rather than by clearing rooms or picking up batteries. It requires a base total of 120 damage, and increases by 40 for every next floor.
items.notes:
* The jaw bone has all the same synergies that The Forgotten's bone club does.
** ⟦i:114¦Mom's Knife⟧: This version of the attack doesn't deflect projectiles.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Briefly grants +1 speed and makes Isaac invulnerable and intangible. When the effect ends, destroys all projectiles and damages all enemies Isaac passed through.
items.effects:
* When used, Isaac gains +1.0 speed and can walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second or until he shoots. If Isaac walks through an enemy or bullet during this time, it freezes until the effect ends, then takes damage equal to 2× Isaac's damage plus a flat 3.5. If there are multiple enemies/projectiles caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional flat 3.5 damage. At the end of the effect, an area of effect blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or bullets were pierced during the effect.
** The damage of the blast at the end of Dark Arts is equal to the sum of all damage dealt while dashing between enemies.
*** Bullets walked through will still count for the final blast damage calculation, even though they can't be damaged.
items.notes:
* The invincibility can be canceled early by firing tears (and hence receive the damage bonus early with Tainted Judas or Black Judas).
* If an enemy/bullet Isaac walks through dies or otherwise disappears before Dark Arts deactivates, they will not grant a damage bonus.
* Orbitals that deal contact damage such as ⟦i:128¦Forever alone⟧ will still deal damage and potentially kill an enemy, while those that block shots like Pretty Flies will still block and destroy projectiles.
** Dark Arts still works on reflected bullets.
** Explosive projectiles will explode when destroyed by Dark Arts.
* While Dark Arts is active, Isaac:
**Cannot pick up items or donate to Blood Donation Machines or Devil Beggars.
**Cannot open Chests. Standing on Spiked Chests or Mimic Chests when the effect ends will safely open them without taking damage.
**Can pass through Curse Room doors or over spikes.
**Can still press Pressure Plates, including the button in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ without taking damage.
* Dark Arts will trigger certain tear effects on enemies it damages, such as burning from ⟦i:257¦Fire Mind⟧.
* Invincible enemies such as Stonies and Stone Grimaces can still be affected and used to increase the damage.
** Hosts can be damaged and killed even while they are lowered and invincible.
** Similarly, using Dark Arts on ⟦e:scolex¦Scolex⟧'s invulnerable segments will deal damage.
* If Isaac walks through an enemy/bullet, the blast at the end of Dark Arts can destroy Shopkeepers.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Destroys all item pedestals in the room and gives Isaac a unique locust familiar for each item destroyed. Locusts fly forwards in the direction Isaac shoots and damage enemies hit. Destroying certain items spawns special locusts with unique effects.
items.effects:
* On use, destroys all items on item pedestals in the room and gives a unique red locust familiar for each item destroyed.
* These locusts are permanent once created, up to a maximum of 64, after which creating more will replace older locusts.
** This limit is shared with Blue Flies and Spiders.
* The locusts loosely orbit Isaac similarly to regular Blue Flies, charging in the direction Isaac is firing until hitting an enemy, wall, or certain obstacles like key blocks.
* ⟨15⟩ Locusts deal Isaac's damage unless they are a special locust (2-3 times per hit).
* ⟨16⟩ The damage locusts deal is a multiplier of Isaac's damage and dependent on the quality of the item destroyed (2-3 times per hit):
** Quality 0: 0.5x damage.
** Quality 1: 0.75x damage.
** Quality 2: 1x damage.
** Quality 3: 1.5x damage.
** Quality 4: 2x damage.
* The locusts may gain additional effects depending on the item destroyed.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:tainted-apollyon¦Tainted Apollyon⟧ starts with this item in the consumable slot.
* ⟨16⟩ Effects from some special locusts have the following consistent properties:
** Explosions are smaller and deal 20 damage.
** Electricity deals 25% of Isaac's damage per tick. It also does not deal damage to the enemy hit, but arcs to other nearby enemies, similar to ⟦i:559¦120 Volt⟧
** ⟦i:160¦Crack the Sky⟧ beams deal 3x the locust's damage per tick.
** Small poison farts deal 5 damage and poison all enemies caught in it.
** Regular large farts don’t deal damage, but push away other nearby enemies.
** All creep function identically to that from ⟦i:317¦Mysterious Liquid⟧ regardless of color.
** Locusts which destroy enemy projectiles will still trigger their effect and block shots while orbiting around Isaac.
** ⟦i:35¦The Necronomicon⟧ effect deals 40 damage. This can be affected by the damage increase from ⟦t:48¦A Missing Page⟧ or ⟦i:262¦Missing Page 2⟧.
** The ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ vortex and subsequent laser each deal 75% of Isaac's damage per tick.
** The ⟦i:399¦Maw Of The Void⟧ effect deals Isaac's damage per tick.
** Locusts that destroy rocks can also open regular doors as well as Secret Room entrances.
* Using Abyss in the Shop or the Devil Room will not affect any items that have not been purchased.
* In rooms where there are multiple items to choose from, using Abyss will give only one locust for each item choice/set.
* If already at the maximum amount of locusts and presented with multiple non-choice item pedestals, using Abyss will only consume half of the pedestals.
* If Abyss is used while Isaac is holding an item above his head, it can still consume the item and grant a locust.
** This mechanic can be used to destroy bought items, unwanted blind items as well as familiars given by ⟦p:soul-of-lilith¦Soul of Lilith⟧.
* Using Abyss to destroy items in Boss Rush or Challenge Room counts as taking an item and causes waves of bosses or enemies to start spawning.
* Locusts granted by Abyss are not taken away during the sequence to obtain the ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧. ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ cannot be harmed, but they can help destroy Fire Places blocking the path faster.
* Locusts granted by Abyss are nearly irremovable, only ⟦i:622¦Genesis⟧ can completely remove all locusts from a character. ⟦i:536¦Sacrificial Altar⟧ and exceeding the familiar limit can remove some locusts. Reroll effects such as ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦c:tainted-eden¦Tainted Eden⟧ taking damage, ⟦i:258¦Missing No.⟧, etc. cannot remove locusts.
* ⟨16⟩ Locusts that have a chance to explode can extinguish Blue Fire Places.
* In Repentance Co-Op if a player dies, any of the special locusts they have will persist, following and attacking from their ghost.
* Using Abyss will destroy the pedestal and the ghostly item from ⟦i:711¦Flip⟧ is not obtainable.
** Passive items can still be consumed while Isacc is holding them above his head without destroying the ghostly item, active items can only be consumed this way while having an empty hand with ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧.

items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
items.effects:
* Gives one full Red Heart container.
* Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

items.description: +1 Damage. Prevents Isaac from firing tears from his left eye, like ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧.
items.effects:
* +1 Damage
* Prevents Isaac from firing tears from his left eye, similar to ⟦c:cain¦Cain⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Isaac dashes forward and picks up the first enemy hit. After a moment, he jumps and slams them into the ground to deal damage and create a circular rock wave.
items.effects:
* Upon use, Isaac dashes forward a short distance. If Isaac runs into an enemy while dashing, he picks them up and a crosshair spawns under him that can be controlled with tear controls. After one second, Isaac leaps up and slams down on the crosshair with the enemy, dealing damage to them and any enemies he lands on depending on his size. On impact, this move creates circular rock waves that damage nearby enemies and destroy obstacles.
** The damage the slam deals is 50 +/- 10 for each size up/down Isaac has.
** Each spike in the rock wave deals 10 damage, and the range of the rock waves increases/decreases for each size up/down Isaac has.
** Isaac is immune to damage for the duration of the effect, which allows him to use it to get into Curse Rooms, open Spiked Chests, and travel over spikes without taking damage.
*** Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars will still deal damage while Suplex! is active.
items.notes:
* In addition to normal enemies, Isaac is able to suplex:
** Bombs of any kind
** Bosses
** Friendly enemies (this deals no damage to them).
** Shopkeepers
** Poky type enemies
** Movable TNT
** Stationary or mostly stationary enemies such as a Stone Grimace or Slide (they will move back to their original position after the suplex)
** Fires (including Fire Places; if Isaac suplexes a fireplace, it will glitch out and leave an invisible damaging fireplace in its original spot)
** Enemies that are normally invincible, such as the ghost of ⟦e:blighted-ovum¦Blighted Ovum⟧ (which deals no damage to it) and ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧ before it moves to the top of the room.
** ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧'s poops, making it easier to break tinted rocks and open secret rooms. After being suplexed, the broken poop can be repeatedly suplexed as well. The broken poop will block the movement of Isaac and enemies, as it is still technically intact, even though it is visually destroyed. If the broken poop is shot at by Isaac, it will be 'destroyed' and is no longer able to be suplexed.
** ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧ if playing as ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧, although care should be taken to move away after the suplex attack to avoid touching Dark Esau.
** Furniture on the ⟦s:home¦Home⟧ floor.
* If Isaac picks up an enemy and then suffers fear, he cannot move the crosshair.
* Despite the description, Isaac cannot suplex angel statues unless the fight has already been started.
* As this item allows Isaac to leap over gaps and obstacle, the player must be careful not to strand him in an inaccessible place without a means to exit, such as teleportation, flight, or another target to Suplex, as that will effectively softlock the game.
* Using suplex on a bomb in the Crawl Space and positioning the cross hair slightly above Isaac propels Isaac with enough force downward to force through the floor and access the error room. Be cautious about this as there's no way to go back to the floor other than teleporting.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Swipes a bag that collects and holds up to 8 pickups, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.
items.effects:
* Upon use, pressing an attack direction will cause a swipe attack with high knockback and 3 damage.
** The swipe scales in size with Isaac's size.
** The swipe will appear further from Isaac the higher his range is.
** The swipe can be used to open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests without taking damage.
** The swipe can be used to block bullets.
** The swipe can be aimed at any direction.
* Swiping a pickup on the floor will add it to the bag. The bag's contents cannot be dropped. Up to 8 pickups can be stored.
** Double pickups like Double Hearts will add two copies to the bag. Blended Hearts will add one red heart and one soul heart.
** Sticky Nickels can't be picked up unless unstuck.
** Chests and Sacks can't be picked up, but can be opened with a swipe even behind obstacles.
** If Isaac has enough money to buy a pickup from a Shop, using Bag of Crafting on that pickup will purchase it and automatically add it to the bag.
* Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag can be used once more to spawn an item pedestal.
** If a recipe would result in an item that hasn't yet been unlocked, a random item will be crafted instead.
* There are a total of 29 different types of consumables that can be placed in the bag. The ordering does not matter for the outcome.
As ⟦c:tainted-cain¦Tainted Cain⟧:
* If pickups are collected after the max of 8 is reached, the contents shift left and up, deleting the top left slot and adding at the bottom right. Tapping the switch key cycles the bag's contents left and up in a loop, making it possible to choose which pickup to overwrite.
* Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag will show a preview what would be crafted. Holding down the Use Pill/Card button will craft the item and place it directly in Tainted Cain's inventory.
** Crafting an activated item while already holding one will turn the old one into pickups like collecting it would.
** hides the crafting preview.
Item Tags:
The Bag of Crafting respects item tags, and which items are available during the current run. This includes the following:
* As ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ prevents items with the nolostbr item tag from appearing when using the Bag of Crafting.
* As ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, items without the offensive item tag will not appear.
* As ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧, items with the nokeeper item tag will not appear.
* In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode or Greedier Mode⟧, items with the nogreed item tag will not appear.
* In Daily Challenges, items with the nodaily item tag will not appear.
* In Challenge, items with the nochallenge item tag will not appear.
* If ⟦t:88¦NO!⟧ is held, active items will be skipped.
* If ⟦i:691¦Sacred Orb⟧ is held, items with Quality 0 or 1 will be skipped. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with ⟦i:25¦Breakfast⟧ instead.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Item pedestals have a second un-interactable "ghostly" item behind them. Activating will flip the real and ghostly items around. If playing as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, also flips between them and ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧.
items.effects:
* While holding Flip, when Isaac enters a new room containing an item (Treasure Room, Shop, etc.), the item pedestal will have a second "ghostly" item behind it.
** The real item can be interacted with normally, while the ghostly item cannot.
** The ghostly item will vanish if there is no real item on the pedestal and Isaac leaves the room.
* Upon use, flips all real / ghostly items around on pedestals, allowing Isaac to collect the ghostly items. Does not affect pedestals that do not contain a ghostly item.
** As long as Isaac does not exit the room, empty pedestals can be flipped, meaning both the original item and the flipped ghostly item can be collected.
* If playing as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, activating it also flips between them and ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Dead Tainted Lazarus⟧.
** ⟨16⟩ Tainted Lazarus' Flip also only requires 4 charges.
items.notes:
* Flip has no effect on item pedestals that do not generate upon the creation of the room (i.e. Boss items, items from chests / beggars, etc.).
* Buying a real item, such as from a Shop or Devil Room, will also buy the ghostly version for free, although it can still only be obtained using Flip.
** Flipping an unbought item will update the price to the ghostly item's.
* Ghostly items do not count as seen or collected before they have been flipped into existence.
** Once a ghostly item has been chosen for a pedestal by encountering it, it will stay even if collected elsewhere before flipping.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a destructible orbital familiar representing a random passive item, which blocks shots and deals contact damage. While the wisp is alive, Isaac gains that item's effects.
items.effects:
* Upon use, Lemegeton will grant a random passive item as an orbital familiar. The item summoned has a 25% chance to be from the current room's Item Pool, or from a random item pool otherwise. The item must have the 'summonable' item tag in order to be generated.
** These familiars can block up to 4 shots and/or get hit by 2 explosions before being destroyed. When the familiar is destroyed, the item it granted is lost.
*** If Isaac is shielded or invulnerable, his familiars are also immune to damage.
** Familiars also deal contact damage to enemies equal to 2× Isaac's damage per tick (4× Isaac's damage per second). They take contact damage.
** Isaac can have up to 26 familiars: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.
*** Using Lemegeton while Isaac already has 26 causes the oldest one to be replaced.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ starts with this item in the consumable slot.
** When playing as Tainted Bethany, picking up ⟦i:647¦4.5 Volt⟧ will cause Lemegeton to no longer gain charges as long as her normal active item has empty charges.
* Items given by Lemegeton are separate from the normal item pools and Isaac's current collection of items. This has the following effects:
** Isaac can still normally find items that were previously summoned by Lemegeton.
** Isaac can have multiple wisps of the same item.
** Wisps cannot be rerolled by ⟦i:258¦Missing No.⟧ or the ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ / ⟦i:283¦D100⟧.
** Wisps do not count towards transformations.
*** Super Bum is an exception and can be gotten from wisps.
** Summoned items do not count towards the Collection Page.
* Items that would normally add or remove hearts/consumables (such as ⟦i:19¦Boom!⟧, ⟦i:25¦Breakfast⟧, ⟦i:230¦Abaddon⟧, etc.) do not do so if given by Lemegeton.
* Summoning a ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ wisp grants ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ infinite lives until the wisp is destroyed.
* Wisps of mapping items only activate upon entering the next floor.
** ⟨16⟩ Wisps of mapping items' effect are applied immediately.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Removes half a heart and creates a Clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tear effects. As ⟦c:tainted-eve¦Tainted Eve⟧, passively converts health into Clots while firing. Activating returns all Clots to health.
items.effects:
* When used by any character other than ⟦c:tainted-eve¦Tainted Eve⟧, removes half a heart of health upon use and creates a Clot familiar.
** Blood clot familiars mimic Isaac's movement (including flight), firing, and tear effects.
** Blood clot familiars will mimic all tear-altering effects, such as ⟦i:579¦Spirit Sword⟧.
** Holding down the swap button allows Isaac to move independently from the blood clots.
*** The familiars have health and will be destroyed if they take enough damage. They start with a set amount of HP when spawned, and the health of Red Heart and Rotten Heart Clots will slowly decay down to 1 HP over time, while the health of the other clot types decay down to 5 HP.
**** Their health decays at a rate of 1 HP per 2.5 seconds.
**** They are immune to hazards such as spikes, Fire Places, and lasers.
**** Enemies deal 1 point of contact and projectile damage to them when hit.
**** Isaac's Bombs and Troll Bombs deal 2 points of damage.
*** Draining health does not count as taking damage, so creating familiars will not trigger damage-activated effects.
* Each type of heart generates a different type of blood clot:

; For ⟦c:tainted-eve¦Tainted Eve⟧ only:
* Passively, holding down the fire button will create blood clot familiars every two seconds and drain half a heart.
* Upon activation, Sumptorium destroys any remaining blood clots and heals Tainted Eve for the same type of hearts that were used to generate them. The blood clots deal 3x Tainted Eve's damage to enemies they pass through as they return.
** Should Tainted Eve have more blood clots than room in her health bar when doing this, all excess blood clots will drop next to her.
* The charge time is only 1 second rather than 10 seconds.
items.notes:
* The type of heart drained first is decided by the following order: Gold Hearts, Eternal Hearts, Rotten Hearts, Red Hearts, then the rightmost Soul Hearts, Black Hearts, or Bone Hearts.
* Clots from a previous run will carry over during a RERUN.
* Sumptorium can't spawn more than 64 clots at once.
** This limit is shared with blue flies and blue spiders. If there are multiple flies, spiders and clots on the screen at the same time, the limit will be 32 for the clots and 32 for the flies/spiders.
* Sumptorium cannot absorb more than 29 clots at once.
* Activating Sumptorium does not restore Tainted Eve's health immediately, as it is not restored until the recalled blood clots return to Eve.
* If Isaac obtains flight, the clots will hover instead of moving across the floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Retrieves the Forgotten's body from any distance. Only available as the ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ effect for ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧.
items.effects:
* Retrieves the ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧'s body automatically, even from a distance.
** ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Soul⟧ is invincible while Tainted Forgotten is returning to him (except to Devil Beggars and similar forms of self-damage).
** Tainted Forgotten will deal ~4-6 times Isaac's damage to enemies that collide with it while it's returning to the Soul.
items.notes:
* This item is not in any item pool and is set to be hidden from appearing in any normal scenario. The only way to obtain it is by picking up ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ as ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ which will give Tainted Forgotten the item in the consumable slot.
** It can, however, activate when using ⟦i:488¦Metronome⟧. This does nothing with most characters, however it will return ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧'s body to him if it is activated.
* Re-rolling Birthright via ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, ⟦i:283¦D100⟧ or similar items will not remove Recall from the consumable slot.
* The item cannot be used while the Soul is holding the body or the body is traveling after it has been thrown. Trying to use it will not waste its charge.
* Obtaining Recall on any other character has no effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Exclusive to ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧. Allows him to save one poop bomb for later, allowing him to gather more over time.
items.effects:
* Removes ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧'s leftmost poop, storing it inside of Hold and cycling to the next poop.
* Using Hold again while a poop is inside it will remove the poop and use it as expected.
items.notes:
* The item is unavailable for anyone except ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧.
** It can, however, activate when using ⟦i:488¦Metronome⟧. This does nothing with most characters; however, it will count as a use of the item when activated as ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧.

items.description: Gives range, speed, or damage when buying things from a shop. Spawns three coins and a Key on pickup.
items.effects:
* Spawns 3 random coins and a Key on the floor when picked up.
* Every 3 coins spent on items and pickups grants in a cycle: +0.5 damage, then +0.25 range, then +0.03 speed.
items.notes:
* The coins and key spawned on pickup can be any of their variants.
* Keeper's Sack works with anything that costs coins, including Devil deals/Black Markets as ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ / affected by ⟦t:171¦Keeper's Bargain⟧ or ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧, items or pickups created by ⟦i:719¦Keeper's Box⟧, the Angel shop created by ⟦i:586¦The Stairway⟧, and the second shop created by ⟦i:602¦Member Card⟧.
* The stat upgrades are tied to Keeper's Sack; losing Keeper's Sack (for instance, using ⟦i:284¦D4⟧, crossing a 1-pip or 6-pip Dice Room, or using ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧) will result in the loss of all obtained stats.

items.description: Rocks and other Obstacles spawn blue spiders over time while in a room with enemies, and spawn two blue spiders when destroyed.
items.effects:
* If Isaac is in a room with enemies, rocks and rock-like obstacles will occasionally spawn blue spiders.
* Causes all rocks to spawn 0-2 blue spiders when destroyed.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns a random Shop item or pickup which can be bought for its normal price.
items.effects:
* Upon use, spawns a random pickup or item, which must be bought for its normal Shop price.
** Items generated will always be shop items and pickups will only be those that can appear for sale in shops.
*** The only exception to this is Black Sacks, which can replace Grab Bags despite not being able to do so in shops.
** There is an an equal ~11.1% chance to spawn a card, pill, bomb, key, battery, item, soul heart, red heart, or sack.
items.notes:
* The pickup/item will be surrounded by spikes/cost hearts if the box is used in a Devil Room, a Black Market, if Isaac has ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧ or is in a boss room after using ⟦i:292¦Satanic Bible⟧.
** While playing as ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ /⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ pickups that would cost health are free.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

items.description: Spawns certain pickups based on how many charges it has. If fully charged, instead has one of many unique effects.
items.effects:
* Everything Jar can be activated while not fully charged.
* If the item is not fully charged, it spawns a pickup based on how many charges it had:
** 1: A Poop.
** 2: A Penny.
** 3: A Bomb.
** 4: A Key.
** 5: A full Red Heart.
** 6: A pill.
** 7: A card, rune, or soul stone.
** 8: A Soul Heart.
** 9: A Gold Heart.
** 10: A Golden Key.
** 11: A Golden Bomb.
* If the item is fully charged, it instead has one of the following effects:
** Spawns a random amount of various different pickups, including coins, hearts, bombs, keys, cards, pills, and trinkets.
** Spawns a Fly.
** Spawns an assortment of friendly dips, blue spiders, and blue flies.
** Spawns random enemies in front of every door and closes the doors.
*** Enemies also spawn in front of adjacent Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms if there are any.
** Does nothing.
** Spawns an item pedestal that cycles between 9 different items 30 times per second. The item selection is from the current room's item pool.
** Spawns many colored beams of light around the room that deal damage to enemies. These beams of light varyingly scale with Isaac's damage.
** Fills the room with Poop, similarly to ⟦p:a-card-against-humanity¦A Card Against Humanity⟧
** Spawns 6 Troll Bombs around the room, similarly to ⟦i:65¦Anarchist Cookbook⟧.
** Flips all sprites to the side, gives Isaac random tear effects for the rest of the room, and permanently increases and decreases one of Isaac's stats, similarly to ⟦i:481¦Dataminer⟧.
*** ⟨16⟩ This also rerolls any item in the room into a glitched ⟦i:721¦TMTRAINER⟧ item.
** Spawns many Shopkeepers around the room. These have a chance to be special/error shopkeepers.
** Spawns a Giga Bomb pickup that gives Isaac a bomb and converts his next bomb into a giga-bomb that deals 300 blast damage, spawns many rock projectiles that deal 15 damage, and creates 13 holes in a diamond shape around the blast zone that deal 99 damage to enemies that were in their areas. These holes cannot spawn if they would close Isaac's path around the room.
*** This bomb has a chance to be lit when it spawns.

items.description: Causes all future items to be "glitched", granting them completely random effects.
items.effects:
* When picked up, all future items become "Glitched", causing them to become random combinations of 2-3 effects based on other items as well as effects that are not normally controlled by the player, such as enemy spawning and other behind-the-scenes effects.
** Quest items do not become glitched. This includes: ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧, ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧, ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧.
** Additionally, the currently playing music will fade out. The silence will remain until another music track plays.
** Any enemies in the room will also become simultaneously frozen and set on fire.
* "Glitched" items can be passive or active and are completely randomly generated with practically infinite possibilities. There is a 75% chance that the item will be passive.
* Random effects combine effects that exist on other items, and assign them to a random event (e.g. on enemy death, on room clear, on damage taken etc.).
** These effects may also be derived from installed modded items.
* Glitched items sold for money cost a random amount of pennies up to 99 pennies.
items.notes:
* Once ⟦a:593¦Corrupted Data⟧ is unlocked, the TMTRAINER effect may be randomly applied to items found in Secret Rooms and I AM ERROR rooms.
* Items affected by TMTRAINER may take the effect of rerolling all of your items. This includes TMTRAINER itself, meaning any future items you encounter will not be under its effect, nor will the items obtained by rerolling due to the glitched item.
* All glitched items appear as ⟦i:441¦Mega Blast⟧ in Isaac's Last Will or the In-game Pause Menu.
* If an item held by Isaac is rerolled into TMTRAINER (Either by ⟦i:284¦D4⟧ or a 1-pip Dice Room), all items after it will be rerolled into glitched items.
* A majority of the random item effects include farts, including active items.
* Due to the sheer randomness of glitched items, some may cause the game to either crash or lag to the point of unplayability.
** However, some may spawn entities that are normally only accessible using the Debug Console, including the Challenge Trophy that spawns at the end of Challenges and the Big Chest that spawns after most major bosses. Touching either of these on a floor that would not normally spawn them will instantly end the run and send the player back to the title screen (unless a challenge is currently being played, in which case the player will receive unlocks as if they had completed the challenge normally). Touching a Big Chest on any floor that can spawn them will NOT give the player the respective completion marks but will still end the run (unless Isaac has either ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ or ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ and is on either ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧ or ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧, respectively.)
