items.description: Chains down the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, preventing them from moving or attacking.
items.effects:
* Upon use, chains down the nearest enemy, completely preventing them from acting for 5 seconds.
** This effect works on enemies that are invulnerable.
** If used again, it releases the enemy early.
** If multiple enemies are chained down at once, the enemy released early will be the one closest to Isaac even if Dark Esau is chained down too.
* While playing as ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧:
** Anima Sola will always target Dark Esau if he is present.
** While Dark Esau is chained down, using Anima Sola again will release him and cause him to charge directly at Tainted Jacob, damaging and burning enemies in its path. This will not use up additional item charges.
** Dark Esau deals no contact damage to Jacob while chained down.
** If used in a room with no enemies, Anima Sola will immediately summon Dark Esau.
** If ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ is obtained, the recharge time is lowered to 10 seconds and the chain duration is increased to 6.67 seconds.
items.notes:
* Enemies other than Dark Esau can also be released. This will not cause them to do anything special.
* If ⟦e:the-visage¦The Visage⟧'s mask is chained down when it runs out of HP, it will outright die instead of becoming temporarily inactive, leaving only the heart to be fought. It is unknown if this is a bug.
* If ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧ / ⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧ is chained down before it can spawn the Eyes at the beginning of the fight and is damaged enough to advance a phase by the time the chains break, the Eyes will not spawn.
* ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ will stop shapeshifting when chained.
* If an enemy is in the middle of attacking with tears, their tears will still be fired after the effect ends. This happens even if the enemy has zero HP by the end of the ability.
* If used against ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧ during her chase attack, the destructible pillars will stop spawning until the effect ends.

items.description: Reduces the internal ID number of all items in the room by one, turning them into the item with that number.
items.effects:
* Rerolls all pedestal items in a room by decreasing their internal ID number by one until a valid item is rolled. This effect occurs per item and is independent of any other items in the room.
** Unlockable items will be skipped if they are not unlocked.
items.notes:
* A list of items sorted by item ID can be found here (helpful for finding Spindown targets at a glance.)
* Hidden items will always be skipped, including:
** ⟦i:714¦Recall⟧
** ⟦i:715¦Hold⟧
** The passive version of ⟦i:577¦Damocles⟧ created by usage of Damocles (the one with item ID "656").
** The passive version of ⟦i:34¦The Book of Belial⟧ created by ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ effect of ⟦c:judas¦Judas⟧ / ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧ (the one with item ID "59").
* Items created by using Spindown Dice are not considered "normally generated" and can be encountered again in their normal pools if they were not picked up.
* Spindown Dice ignores all effects that prevent certain items from spawning, such as through item quality thresholds (e.g. ⟦i:691¦Sacred Orb⟧), Item Tags or other effects such as from ⟦t:88¦NO!⟧.
** This makes the item especially valuable for ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, as many helpful items cannot naturally spawn for him otherwise.
* If used in a Challenge or Daily Challenge, Spindown Dice will skip over items with the "nochallenge" and "nodaily" tags, respectively.

items.description: After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, launches Red Hearts from Isaac that despawn after 1.5 seconds.
items.effects:
* After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, he drops a Red Heart that despawns after 1.5 seconds.
** The heart dropped depends on the source: half-hearts of damage taken drop Half Red Hearts, and full hearts of damage taken drop full hearts.
** The hearts will get launched out of Isaac with momentum, making them difficult to pick up.
** If Isaac is firing tears as he gets hit, the heart will get launched in that direction.
items.notes:
* Damage sources that scale up from half a heart of damage to a full heart of damage starting on ⟦s:womb¦Womb⟧/⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ will still only cause Hypercoagulation to spawn half a heart. However, being hit by a champion enemy will still spawn a full red heart, even though all enemies do a full heart of damage by that stage.
* Red hearts are not spawned when Isaac loses heart containers (such as through health down pills, buying Devil Room items, using ⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧, etc), with the only exception being ⟦i:487¦Potato Peeler⟧.
* Red hearts will still drop regardless of the type of heart being subtracted from damage, making the item generally useless for characters who cannot utilize red hearts.
** However if Isaac takes damage while inside a super secret room layout with specific heart spawn, he will drop a full heart of that type instead. The full heart will drop even if Isaac takes half a heart damage.
* The following damage sources will activate Hypercoagulation:
** Enemy attacks
** Normal spikes
** Spiked rocks
** Fire Places
** Explosions
** Blood Donation Machines
** Devil Beggars
** Confessionals
** Hell Games
** ⟦i:126¦Razor Blade⟧
** ⟦i:186¦Blood Rights⟧
** ⟦i:486¦Dull Razor⟧ (despite it not taking health)
** ⟦i:487¦Potato Peeler⟧
** Extra damage taken from holding ⟦i:352¦Glass Cannon⟧
* The following damage sources will not activate Hypercoagulation:
** Curse Room doors
** The door to ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧
** Sacrifice Room spikes
** Spiked Chests/Mimic Chests
** Bad Trip pills
** Golden Battery
** ⟦i:40¦Kamikaze!⟧
** ⟦i:326¦Breath of Life⟧
** ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧ shop spikes
** ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧
** ⟦i:205¦Sharp Plug⟧
** ⟦i:448¦Shard of Glass⟧
** ⟦i:614¦Blood Bombs⟧
** ⟦i:569¦Blood Oath⟧

items.description: Causes Isaac to throw poop, create buffing creep, or drop bombs while fighting enemies.
items.effects:
After dealing 40 + 13.33 \times (stageNumber - 1) damage to an enemy, Isaac begins to flash red. Releasing the fire button gives the effect of one of ⟦c:tainted-bluebaby¦Tainted ???⟧'s unique poops.
Holds up one of the following types of poop, which he can throw with the fire buttons. All thrown poops deal 15 damage to enemies they hit when thrown (up to 3 times in the case of stone poop).
items.notes:
* The effect can only trigger once per 3 seconds.
* If IBS triggers while Isaac is charging a shot (with items such as ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧, ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧, ⟦i:69¦Chocolate Milk⟧, etc.), the charged shot will only fire after IBS's effect activates. In the case of thrown poops, the charged shot only fires after Isaac throws the poop IBS gives him.
* Poops spawned by IBS can give pickups.
* If Isaac is currently holding a poop, IBS cannot activate until he throws it.
* Isaac can carry poop he is holding between rooms.
* If Isaac takes damage while holding a poop/bomb, he will drop it where he is standing.
* If Isaac hits an enemy with a thrown poop, it will immediately break.
* ⟨16⟩

items.description: Double-tapping a fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood, dealing damage to enemies in front of him. Affected enemies are cursed and take more damage from ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧-like attacks.
items.effects:
* Double-tapping the fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood, dealing damage to enemies in front of him. The sneeze deals damage equal to 1.5x Isaac's damage, knocking enemies and projectiles back. Knocked back enemies take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) additional damage if they hit a wall or obstacle, and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.
** The sneeze has a cooldown of 1 second.
** The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage to enemies if it would have caused Isaac half a heart of damage, and 7 damage if it would have caused Isaac a full heart damage.
* The sneeze applies a curse to enemies. Enemies under the curse will take more damage from ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧-like laser attacks and violently explode on death, damaging and spreading the curse to nearby enemies. Any enemies spawned by those under the curse will also be cursed.
** The following attacks will deal increased damage (2x damage +3 flat damage):
*** Brimstone attacks from ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧/⟦c:tainted-azazel¦Tainted Azazel⟧
*** ⟦i:408¦Athame⟧
*** ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧
*** ⟦i:646¦Brimstone Bombs⟧
*** ⟦i:293¦Head of Krampus⟧
*** ⟦i:679¦Lil Abaddon⟧
*** ⟦i:275¦Lil Brimstone⟧
*** ⟦i:399¦Maw Of The Void⟧
*** ⟦i:680¦Montezuma's Revenge⟧'s brimstone (not tears)
*** ⟦i:441¦Mega Blast⟧
*** ⟦i:49¦Shoop da Whoop!⟧
*** ⟦i:533¦Trisagion⟧
*** ⟦i:640¦Urn of Souls⟧' brimstone (while holding ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ with ⟦c:judas¦Judas⟧ or ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧)
** The curse lasts for 5 seconds.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:tainted-azazel¦Tainted Azazel⟧ begins with an inherent version of Hemoptysis that allows him to deal full damage to cursed enemies.
** The innate sneeze ability is entirely separate from Hemoptysis, and so the sneeze can be triggered twice in quick succession. However, triggering the sneeze from Hemoptysis will cancel Tainted Azazel's brimstone charge, meaning that this item is largely ineffective as this character.
* The sneeze's range is affected by the shot speed stat, and not by the range stat itself.
* The sneeze can push Bombs, pickups and enemy shots.
* The collision damage can be used to damage Hosts while their skulls are lowered.
* Brimstone lasers shot by enemies who are not charmed, such as ⟦e:monstro-ii¦Monstro II⟧, will also do increased damage to cursed enemies.
* ⟦i:643¦Revelation⟧'s charged attack will not deal increased damage to cursed enemies.

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs become spectral and spawn ghosts that deal contact damage to enemies and explode after 10 seconds.
items.effects:
* Gives Isaac 5 Bombs.
* Isaac's bombs create ghosts when they explode, which rapidly chase and deal contact damage to enemies.
** The ghost deals contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage per tick (2× Isaac's damage per second).
* After 10 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 damage to nearby enemies up to 3 times and destroying nearby projectiles. Isaac does not take damage from the explosion.
** If there are no enemies in the room, the ghost follows Isaac. However, it cannot follow Isaac between rooms.
items.notes: * Friendly enemies can be killed by the ghosts.

items.description: Spawns a demon familiar for the current room attached to Isaac that moves and fires in the direction Isaac shoots, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.
items.effects:
* Spawns a demon familiar attached to Isaac by a cord for the current room, floating in the direction Isaac shoots. It automatically fires tears (whenever Isaac is shooting) in the direction of the closest enemy to it, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.
** The item is initially held over Isaac's head until he fires, which launches the familiar in the direction he shoots, dealing 3x Isaac's damage to all enemies it passes through.
** If Isaac has any tear modifier that requires him to charge his shots (i.e. ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧), Gello will automatically release its shot every time it is fully charged.
** Gello's tears deal 0.75x Isaac's damage.
items.notes:
* ⟦c:tainted-lilith¦Tainted Lilith⟧ attacks in a way nearly identical to this item, except she can recall it and launch it again.
* If used multiple times in the same room, the Gellos will eventually overlap perfectly and appear as one after some movement, but all remain functional. This makes Gello exceptionally powerful in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, Boss Rush, and against ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧.

items.description: Throws Isaac's head, which is still able to fire tears at the spot it lands. Reactivating the item or stepping on the head reattaches it.
items.effects:
* Throws Isaac's head while allowing to shoot from the spot it lands, blocking enemy shots as well as dealing contact damage to nearby enemies. Meanwhile, Isaac's body can no longer shoot tears.
** The head does 24 damage on impact and 4 damage per tick (12 damage per second) on contact when it's on the ground.
** The head can return by picking it up with the body, or by using the item again without requiring charges. Both the throwing and retaking of the head can deal damage to enemies passing through.
items.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:chimera¦Chimera⟧.
* This item acts similarly to ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧'s birthright.

trinkets.description: Upon taking damage, Isaac drops a coin.
trinkets.effects:
* Spawns one coin of any type upon taking damage.
** ⟨24⟩ When held by ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, spawns 0-1 coins.
trinkets.notes:
* This trinket can be found by destroying urns, Special Shopkeepers, and ⟨24⟩ buckets in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧.
* Though similar to the ⟦i:227¦Piggy Bank⟧ item, the Swallowed Penny is not limited to just pennies.
* ⟨6⟩ Unlike ⟦i:227¦Piggy Bank⟧, playing as ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ with this trinket always drops a coin, allowing semi-infinite life.
** A trick for farming money when playing as Keeper is to find a room with some static hazard like spikes and taking damage, causing a coin to appear. A penny will only refill life while a nickel will give four cents, and a dime will give nine cents.
*** This trick can also be used to survive multiple uses of a sacrifice room, healing with the dropped coin between each sacrifice.
** ⟨24⟩ As it can now give 0 coins when playing as the Keeper, this no longer works. The ⟦i:227¦Piggy Bank⟧ and ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ also spawn 0-1 coins when damage is taken; with all three, though money is no longer guaranteed, if a large pool of coins is found it can be used to mitigate streaks of bad luck, allowing Keeper to farm coins almost reliably.

trinkets.description: Most non-specific Heart drops become Black Hearts, but most heart drops are replaced by Keys.

trinkets.notes:
* Objects and items such as tinted rocks, Red Chests, Fortune Telling Machines, ⟦i:96¦Little C.H.A.D.⟧, ⟦t:49¦Bloody Penny⟧, or Blue Fire Places can't drop Black Hearts. Thus, they will still drop Soul Hearts/Red Hearts with Daemon's Tail.
* ⟦i:464¦Glyph of Balance⟧ can still force drops to be Red Hearts if the proper conditions are met.
* ⟨28⟩ All heart drops from ⟦p:ace-of-hearts¦Ace of Hearts⟧ will be Black Hearts.
* No effect on ⟦p:queen-of-hearts¦Queen of Hearts⟧, ⟦p:v-the-hierophant¦V - The Hierophant⟧, ⟦p:v-the-hierophant-reversed¦V - The Hierophant?⟧, and ⟦p:vi-the-lovers¦VI - The Lovers⟧.
* ⟦p:viii-justice¦VIII - Justice⟧ is affected by the heart pickup reduction, however its Red Heart drop will be replaced if it spawns.
* Sources of heart drops that are reduced include cleared rooms, bosses, Slot Machines, Fortune Telling Machines, Beggars, Fire Places, Chests, Red Chests, Poops, tinted rocks, items (⟦i:225¦Gimpy⟧, ⟦i:219¦Old Bandage⟧, ⟦i:204¦Fanny Pack⟧), trinkets (⟦t:49¦Bloody Penny⟧), and familiars (⟦i:96¦Little C.H.A.D.⟧, ⟦i:98¦The Relic⟧, etc).
** Hearts that are present upon entering a room for the first time are unaffected by the reduction (for example, the ones found in Curse Rooms/Devil Rooms/Angel Rooms), but will be converted to Black Hearts.
*** The exceptions to this are particular Super Secret Rooms, which have the effect of forcing all heart drops to be the kind found within them.
** ⟨3⟩The ⟦p:v-the-hierophant¦V - The Hierophant⟧ and ⟦p:vi-the-lovers¦VI - The Lovers⟧ tarot cards have a chance to drop one heart instead of two.
* Things that can drop pickups other than hearts will keep the same chance to drop a consumable, but with an increased chance for drops other than hearts and a decreased chance for heart drops. In particular, this increases the chances of acquiring:
** Tarot cards & trinkets from Fortune Telling Machines
** Bombs and Keys from tinted rocks
** Pills and items from Red Chests
** Coins from Poops and Fire Places
** Any pickup from Slot Machines, cleared rooms, Beggars, Chests, and the Fanny Pack.

This also includes stacking the healing effect when entering a Boss Room. The HP removal stacking effect is equal to 0.85 ^ Number of Tick Instances, with golden trinkets adding on 2 to this.

* In rooms where the ⟦t:53¦Tick⟧ effect is given, Isaac is unable to swap Error with another trinket.
* If the ⟦t:13¦Store Credit⟧ effect is given in a Shop, all items will be free and Error will not be consumed.
* If the ⟦t:20¦Monkey Paw⟧ effect is given, Error will never be consumed and can continue to spawn Black Hearts indefinitely.
* ⟨28⟩ If the ⟦t:105¦Bag Lunch⟧, ⟦t:108¦Walnut⟧, or ⟦t:104¦Wish Bone⟧ effect is given, the trinket will not be consumed and will continue to spawn items upon taking damage.
** ⟨7⟩ Touching a Stoney and Movable TNT counts as taking damage and will spawn a lot of items.
* ⟨24⟩ If the ⟦t:173¦Your Soul⟧ effect is given, all Devil Deals will be free and Error will not be consumed.
* ⟨7⟩ Error cannot give the effects of trinkets Isaac is currently holding (with ⟦i:139¦Mom's Purse⟧ or ⟦i:458¦Belly Button⟧) or ones that were ⟦i:479¦gulped⟧.

trinkets.description: Prevents active items from being generated, if possible.
trinkets.effects: * Prevents activated collectibles from being generated, if possible, from all item pools while this trinket is being held.
trinkets.notes:
* Activated items will start appearing again once the item pool's non-activated items are exhausted or become scarce.
* When the trinket is dropped, the item generation mechanics go back to normal, and active items will be generated normally again.
* In runs where many items have been collected/rerolled, the trinket can function as a sort of warning to the player that an item pool will soon be exhausted if activated items begin to show up.
* ⟨7⟩ Fixed boss drops and machines are not affected by NO!:
** ⟦i:65¦Anarchist Cookbook⟧ from ⟦e:pride¦Pride⟧
** ⟦i:42¦Bob's Rotten Head⟧ from ⟦e:sloth¦Sloth⟧
** ⟦i:158¦Crystal Ball⟧ from a Fortune Telling Machine
** ⟦i:293¦Head of Krampus⟧ from ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧
** ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ from a Blood Donation Machine
** ⟦i:37¦Mr. Boom⟧ from ⟦e:wrath¦Wrath⟧
** ⟦i:130¦A Pony⟧ from ⟦e:headless-horseman¦Headless Horseman⟧
** ⟦i:49¦Shoop da Whoop!⟧ from ⟦e:envy¦Envy⟧
** ⟦i:181¦White Pony⟧ from ⟦e:conquest¦Conquest⟧
** ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧ from ⟦e:super-lust¦Super Lust⟧
* ⟨24⟩ Most fixed active item drops are prevented:
** ⟦e:pride¦Pride⟧ drops a Key
** ⟦e:sloth¦Sloth⟧ drops a card
** ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧ always drops ⟦i:132¦A Lump of Coal⟧
** Blood Donation Machines drop a ⟦i:119¦Blood Bag⟧ if unlocked, still ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ otherwise
** ⟦e:wrath¦Wrath⟧ drops Bombs
** ⟦e:headless-horseman¦Headless Horseman⟧ and ⟦e:conquest¦Conquest⟧ drop either ⟦i:207¦Ball of Bandages⟧ or ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧
** ⟦e:envy¦Envy⟧ drops a Troll Bomb
** ⟦e:super-lust¦Super Lust⟧ drops a pill
** ⟦e:baby-plum¦Baby Plum⟧ will spawn a regular boss room item if spared.
* Some active items that are hard-coded to appear in certain rooms will still spawn, such as Grave Rooms that contain ⟦i:84¦We Need To Go Deeper!⟧ or ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ rooms that contain ⟦i:36¦The Poop⟧.
* ⟦e:bumbino¦Bumbino⟧ will still drop active items from his item pool, if he collects enough coins.

trinkets.description:
⟨7⟩ Decreases Isaac's tear delay by 20%, and improves the effectiveness of his other stat upgrades by 33%.
⟨24⟩ Improves the effectiveness of stat upgrades by 20%.
trinkets.effects:
* ⟨7⟩ -20% tear delay (increased rate of fire)
** Since this directly affects tear delay instead of changing the tears stat, it allows Isaac's rate of fire to go over the normal maximum rate.
** Tear delay decreases are more noticeable and are a greater increase to DPS when the tears stat is high.
* Boosts speed, range, shot speed, damage, and ⟨24⟩ tears if they are above their base values.
** Affects stat bonuses from passive items, trinkets that are absorbed or in a second trinket slot, and permanent bonuses given by items such as ⟦i:477¦Void⟧.
** ⟨7⟩ The extra stat upgrades are 33% of any final stat calculations over its base value (which is equivalent to ⟦c:isaac¦Isaac⟧'s base stats), for example with 4.5 damage, it is 1 damage over the base 3.5, and the 1 damage gets buffed to 1.33, ending up with a total of 4.83 damage.
** ⟨24⟩ The extra stat upgrades are 20% of any final stat calculations over its base value (which is equivalent to ⟦c:isaac¦Isaac⟧'s base stats), for example with 4.5 damage, it is 1 damage over the base 3.5, and the 1 damage gets buffed to 1.2, ending up with a total of 4.7 damage.
*** Fire rate multipliers change what is considered to be the base value, so with ⟦i:330¦Soy Milk⟧, only tears ups above 15.00 will gain a bonus.
**** The only exception is ⟦i:600¦Eye Drops⟧, which gains a bonus to its 1.2x fire rate multiplier if it's above base.
*** Direct fire rate modifiers like ⟦i:228¦Mom's Perfume⟧ do not get a bonus.
trinkets.notes:
* The trinket does nothing for the listed boostable stats if they are at or below the base value; the boost is calculated on the total bonus, not per item.
* Luck is not affected by Cracked Crown.
* Speed will not exceed 2.0.

** The chance to shoot teeth depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 33 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}

* ⟨16⟩ This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:pin¦Pin⟧, ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧, ⟦e:the-hollow¦The Hollow⟧ or ⟦e:scolex¦Scolex⟧.

trinkets.description: When hit, there is a small chance to spawn a permanent tonsil familiar that blocks enemy shots. This can happen twice, after which the trinket is destroyed.
trinkets.effects:
* After taking ⟨15⟩ 12-20 / ⟨16⟩ 6-12 hits a removed tonsil familiar starts following Isaac, blocking enemy shots.
* The effect can happen twice, after which the trinket will be destroyed.
* The familiar does not deal damage to enemies.
trinkets.notes:
* When the familiar is generated, Isaac will gain the familiar permanently as a passive item. This allows Isaac to drop the trinket while keeping the familiar.
** ⟨7⟩ The passive Tonsil item does not exist in any item pool; thus, this is the only way to find it and make it appear in the Collection Page aside from starting with it as ⟦c:eden¦Eden⟧.
*** ⟨7⟩ If Eden starts with the passive tonsil item and picks up the trinket, the trinket will spawn only one familiar before being consumed.
* ⟨24⟩ The passive item form of Tonsil no longer exists; its ID has been taken by ⟦i:474¦Broken Glass Cannon⟧ and no longer appears in the Collection Page, nor can it be obtained by Eden as a starting item.
* Sources of self-inflicted damage, like ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ or Blood Donation Machines, can spawn a familiar.
* Damage that is blocked by ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ or the ⟦p:holy-card¦Holy Card⟧ does not count to the number of hits that are needed for the tonsil familiar to spawn.
* ⟨24⟩ Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Tonsil having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

trinkets.description: Chance to fire a homing booger that sticks to enemies and deals damage over time.

** Each booger deals damage equal to Isaac's tear damage every second.
** ⟨7⟩The booger lasts for 60 seconds or until the enemy dies.
*** ⟨24⟩The booger lasts 10 seconds.
* Boogers have a 50% chance of being homing.
trinkets.notes:
* Not affected by Luck.
* Booger tears cannot pierce through enemies.
* Multiple boogers can stick to one enemy to deal extra damage.
* Nose Goblin's effect is almost identical to ⟦i:459¦Sinus Infection⟧ beyond the added homing effect and having half the chance to trigger. Consequently, all its non-homing synergies apply to Nose Goblin.

*** ⟨16⟩ The chance is now affected by luck, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.
trinkets.notes: * Super Ball's tear effect functions identically to ⟦i:221¦Rubber Cement⟧. For a full list of interactions and synergies, see that page.

trinkets.description: Provides a boost to all stats when Isaac's active item is fully charged.
trinkets.effects:
* Increases all stats while Isaac's active item is fully charged:
** +0.25 speed.
** +0.75 range.
** ⟨7⟩ +0.50 tear falling speed.
** +0.20 tears.
** +0.10 shot speed.
** +0.50 damage.
** +1 luck.
trinkets.notes:
* The trinket creates no effect if Isaac has no active item.
* ⟨7⟩ Active items that are reusable indefinitely without a charge bar, such as ⟦i:282¦How to Jump⟧, will allow Vibrant Bulb's effects to be permanent (until the active item is swapped out).
* Vibrant Bulb is slightly less than half as powerful as ⟦t:101¦Dim Bulb⟧; however, its effects are active more often.
* ⟦i:422¦Glowing Hourglass⟧, when used, will not make the Vibrant Bulb inactive and will still provide the bonus until it has one bar of charge.
* Having additional charge beyond full with ⟦i:63¦The Battery⟧ does not provide an additional bonus. It does give an advantage however, since using the fully charged item once still provides Vibrant Bulb's effect.
* If two active items are held (⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧), the one currently active must be at full charge for the trinket to take effect (the other one doesn't need to be fully charged).
* ⟨24⟩ Vibrant Bulb produces no effect with active items in consumable slots, e.g. ⟦c:tainted-apollyon¦Tainted Apollyon⟧'s ⟦i:706¦Abyss⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧'s ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ If ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧ or ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧ are holding enough soul/red hearts to charge her current active item, the Vibrant Bulb will be active, even if there are no regular charges.
** If the active item is fully charged only with soul/blood charges and no regular charges, Vibrant Bulb and Dim Bulb can be both active at the same time if Isaac holds both of the trinkets.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Provides a boost to all stats when Isaac's active item is completely uncharged.
trinkets.effects:
* Increases all stats while Isaac's active item is completely uncharged:
** +0.50 speed.
** +1.50 range.
** ⟨7⟩ +1.00 tear falling speed
** ⟨7⟩ +0.40 tears.
** ⟨24⟩ +0.50 tears.
** +0.30 shot speed.
** +1.5 damage.
** +2 luck.
trinkets.notes:
* Dim Bulb is more than twice as powerful as ⟦t:100¦Vibrant Bulb⟧; however, its effects are active less frequently.
** However, 1 room charge items can be used at the start of each room to effectively get the Dim Bulb's effects constantly.
* Items that charge automatically will get only a tiny moment of benefit from the Dim Bulb before they gain more charge again.
* ⟨7⟩ Items with no charge bar like ⟦i:282¦How to Jump⟧ will activate Dim Bulb's effects permanently as long as the item is held.
* Dim Bulb has no effect when no active item is held.
* If Isaac has 2 items (via ⟦i:534¦Schoolbag⟧), ⟨15⟩ both of them need to be empty to receive the benefits / ⟨16⟩ only the currently held item needs to be empty to receive the benefits.

trinkets.notes:
* If there are multiple Boss rooms on the same floor (, ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧), the trinket's effect will trigger once for each and every Boss Room.

trinkets.description: Grants a shield that negates the first damage taken once per floor.

trinkets.notes:

** ⟨15⟩ It does not, however, stack with the ⟦p:holy-card¦Holy Card⟧; both are treated as the same shield.
** ⟨16⟩ Shield-type items stack in the following order:
*** ⟦t:121¦Wooden Cross⟧
*** ⟦i:535¦Blanket⟧
*** ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧
*** ⟦p:holy-card¦Holy Card⟧
*** ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧
* The shield of Wooden Cross has a higher priority than Holy Mantle or Blanket and will be lost first when hit.
* Entering ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ area with Wooden Cross gives Isaac ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧s drop Angel Room items instead of key pieces when defeated.
trinkets.effects: * ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧s drop items from the Angel Room item pool instead of key pieces when defeated.
trinkets.notes:
* Items are dropped even if both key pieces are already acquired.
** ⟨24⟩ If one key piece was acquired before picking up Filigree Feather, the next time the angel that normally drops the key piece Isaac currently has is defeated, it will drop the other key piece even with Filigree Feather equipped. (E.g. defeating Uriel while holding Key Piece 1 and Filigree Feather will drop Key Piece 2, but defeating Gabriel with the same items will drop an angel item instead.)
*** ⟨16⟩ Key Piece drops are prioritized.
**** For example, after fighting Angels for the first time they will drop Key Pieces. If both pieces are picked up, next time Angels will drop items upon defeat.
**** If only one Key Piece is picked up, an Angel defeated in the next room will drop another Key Piece, and the next Angel in the same room will drop an item. If a remaining Key Piece is not picked up again, an Angel fought in a third room will drop the missing Key Piece again.
* ⟨7⟩ If both Angels are fought at the same time, only the last one defeated will drop an item.
* Isaac can drop the Filigree Feather, fight the Angel, then grab the trinket again if a Key Piece is desired.
* Only Angels that would otherwise drop a Key Piece will drop an item. This means that those who spawn during the ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ fight, Boss Rush or those rarely found in closets in the ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧ do not drop items, but ones found in some Super Secret Rooms and those summoned from Sacrifice Rooms do.
*Considering that Sacrifice Rooms always spawn 2 Angels, and Isaac can get 1 Angel deal each floor, Filigree Feather can potentially generate a ludicrous 3 Angel items per floor.

trinkets.description: The last door Isaac went through stays open, allowing him to leave the room even if enemies are in it.

* While held, the last door Isaac went through stays open, allowing him to leave the room even if enemies are in it.
** Does not prevent doors from closing while Isaac is within the room, e.g. triggering a Challenge Room or awaking an Angel in an Angel Room.
trinkets.notes:
* Does not work in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ Cannot spawn in Greed Mode.
* This trinket allows Isaac to leave rooms, including boss rooms, if the fight goes poorly.
** This becomes particularly useful in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, as it allows to escape the ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧ fight if encountered.
* Leaving immediately after enemies have spawned gives the player information on the fight, potentially improving decision making.
* If a Devil Room has a ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧ fight in it, Isaac may choose not to fight him and leave.
* If ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧ / ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧ is found in a Shop, one can kill it and leave the room while summoned monsters are still alive to respawn the boss and farm its loot infinitely.
* If ⟦e:sloth¦Sloth⟧ / ⟦e:super-sloth¦Super Sloth⟧ is found, one can kill it and leave the room while summoned monsters are still alive to respawn the boss, allowing one to farm cards indefinitely.
* Does not affect ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧'s and ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧'s boss room as the access door itself disappears.
* ⟨7⟩ If a room contained champion enemies, upon leaving and re-entering the room, all previous champion enemies will have turned to regular enemies.

trinkets.notes:
* The "previous floor" status of trinkets can be reset by picking them up and dropping them again, allowing multiple other trinkets to be carried between floors.
* If pickups were transported to another floor from the Treasure or Boss Room, their copies will remain in those rooms and can be encountered during the Ascent.
** Affected trinkets still transform into ⟦p:cracked-key¦Cracked Key⟧s, potentially allowing you to gain large amounts of Cracked Keys.
* Spawns pickups on the first floor if ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧ was used.
* Does not bring pickups from I AM ERROR rooms.
* May spawn ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧ on the next floor if it was knocked down but not taken.
* Special Rooms take priority, in a certain order, over normal rooms, with Boss Rooms having the highest priority.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Using an activated item rerolls it.
trinkets.effects: * Using an activated item rerolls it into a different one.
trinkets.notes:
* The item given by ‘M will always have no charges, regardless of what the previous active item was and whether or not it was overcharged.
* Rerolling into items counting towards transformations (e.g.⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧, ⟦i:434¦Jar of Flies⟧, ⟦i:42¦Bob's Rotten Head⟧, ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧ etc.) will not be counted towards said transformation, regardless if Isaac puts it back down and picks it back up.
** Having the Guppy transformation and rerolling either ⟦i:145¦Guppy's Head⟧ or⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧ will remove the transformation, even if these items were acquired before using ‘M.
* Items that have costs associated with using them (such as ⟦i:295¦Magic Fingers⟧, ⟦i:487¦Potato Peeler⟧, ⟦i:296¦Converter⟧, etc.) can be rerolled even if Isaac doesn't have the resources necessary to use them.
** The only exception is ⟦i:555¦Golden Razor⟧: Isaac must have the 5 cents necessary to use it in order for it to be rerolled.
* The item's charge must be expended for it to be rerolled; items that can be used without spending their charge immediately (such as ⟦i:42¦Bob's Rotten Head⟧, ⟦i:512¦Black Hole⟧, ⟦i:638¦Eraser⟧, ⟦i:655¦Spin to Win⟧, ⟦i:604¦Mom's Bracelet⟧, etc.) must be properly used to have their charge expended.
* ‘M cannot reroll items into ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧, ⟦i:552¦Mom's Shovel⟧, ⟦i:715¦Hold⟧ or ⟦i:714¦Recall⟧.
* The items generated are fixed per seed. This means the same active item on the same seed while holding 'M will always reroll into the same other active item every time.
* The items rerolled into will not be removed from their item pools unless Isaac puts them down and picks them up again.
* Items can be generated multiple times, even after they have been removed from their pools.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Luck-based tear effects have a higher chance of occurring.
trinkets.effects:
* Luck-based tear effects (i.e. status-inflicting tears or other effects, such as ⟦i:496¦Euthanasia⟧) have a higher chance of occurring.
** The bonus is equivalent to +4 Luck, but the other benefits of Luck do not apply.
trinkets.notes:
* Because the bonus is a flat +4 Luck, this trinket works best on items that require a low luck stat to trigger most often.
** These items include ⟦i:495¦Ghost Pepper⟧, ⟦i:616¦Bird's Eye⟧, ⟦i:374¦Holy Light⟧, ⟦i:637¦Knockout Drops⟧, ⟦i:617¦Lodestone⟧, ⟦i:55¦Mom's Eye⟧, ⟦i:461¦Parasitoid⟧, ⟦i:618¦Rotten Tomato⟧, and ⟦i:150¦Tough Love⟧
* The bonus only affects Isaac's tears, the familiars that copy Isaac's tear effects (such as ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧) do not benefit from the trinket.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Picking up Red Hearts, even while at full health, can convert them into blue spiders. The effect may consume hearts needed for healing.
trinkets.effects:
* Picking up a Red Heart has a 50% chance to consume the heart and spawn Blue Spiders, causing a fart that deals no damage.
** Isaac can pick up hearts even while at full health. In this case, the chance goes to 100%.
* Has no effect on Rotten Hearts, Blended Hearts, or any other type of heart.
trinkets.notes:
* The number of spiders spawned depends on the type of heart that was picked up:
** Half Red Hearts will spawn 1-3 spiders.
** Full Red Hearts will spawn 3-5 spiders.
** Double Hearts will spawn 6-8 spiders.
* The trinket allows characters that cannot use red hearts to gain value from red hearts.
* Items that directly heal Isaac, such as ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧, cannot produce any spiders. The hearts must be picked up off the ground.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Improves the fire rate of Isaac's familiars.
trinkets.effects:
* Doubles the fire rate of Isaac's familiars.
** Familiars with charged shots will have their charge time halved. The recovery time between shots is not affected.
trinkets.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-siren¦The Siren⟧.
* Does not affect wisps.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: At the beginning of each floor, spawn 4-8 wisps that orbit Isaac and fires tears alongside him.
trinkets.effects: * At the beginning of each floor, spawn 4 wisps that orbit Isaac and fire tears alongside him. The wisps are the same as the default wisps that spawn with ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧.
trinkets.notes: * If Isaac already has any wisps before entering a new floor, the trinket will only add enough new wisps to bring the total wisps to 8.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Adds a chance to spawn a Lil' Battery when clearing a room, independent of the room's original drop.
trinkets.effects: * Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Adds a high chance to spawn a Lil' Battery when clearing a room, independent of the room's original drop.
trinkets.notes:
* The exact chance for a battery dropping is \min(20\% + (3\% * \mathit{Luck}) , 33\%).
** This means that the chance starts at 20% at 0 Luck, minimizes at 0% at -6.67 Luck, and maximizes at 33% at 4.34 Luck.
* This trinket can be dropped whenever the active item needs recharging, then picked up again once the item is fully charged. For active items that aren't used every time they're recharged (such as the D6), using the trinket this way can generate many free batteries each floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Tears snap 90 degrees to target enemies that they may have missed.
trinkets.effects: * Tears snap 90 degrees to target enemies that they may have missed.
trinkets.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:pin¦Pin⟧, ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧, ⟦e:the-hollow¦The Hollow⟧ or ⟦e:scolex¦Scolex⟧.
* The effect will not work if Isaac is too close to enemies.
* The effect will only work if the tear has a line of sight to the enemy: if it's interrupted by an obstacle, Brain Worm won't work even if Isaac has enough tear height to otherwise clear it unless he also possesses spectral tears.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.quote: Luck way up. Don't lose it!
trinkets.description: +10 Luck. If Isaac takes damage, the trinket is destroyed and its effect is removed.
trinkets.effects:
* Gives +10 luck.
* This trinket is destroyed if Isaac takes non-self damage while holding it (i.e. getting hit by Monsters, walking on Spikes, getting hit by an explosion, etc.).
trinkets.notes:
* This trinket can only be obtained by clearing 3 consecutive floors without taking damage. It will drop upon the final boss room of said consecutive floors being cleared.
** In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, it will drop after defeating the first boss of the third floor (⟦s:depths¦Depths⟧ / ⟦s:necropolis¦Necropolis⟧ / ⟦s:dank-depths¦Dank Depths⟧).
** While playing co-op, everyone needs to play without taking damage for the trinket to spawn.
* Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, Hell Games, Confessionals, Curse Rooms, Sacrifice Rooms, Spiked Chests, Bad Trip pills, White Fire Places and the door to ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ count as self-damage and won't destroy Perfection.
* Every XL floor cleared counts as a single floor for the purposes of obtaining this trinket.
* Perfection can intentionally be dropped if Isaac must take damage for whatever reason, allowing him to keep it.
* Due to the unique method of obtaining it, Perfection can never naturally spawn as a ⟦a:617¦Golden Trinket⟧.
* 10 Luck is coincidentally the highest amount of luck Isaac can have that would help with room clear rewards paying out.
* If Isaac holds multiple copies of Perfection via ⟦i:139¦Mom's Purse⟧ or ⟦i:458¦Belly Button⟧, upon taking a hit only one of them will get destroyed.
* ⟨15⟩ Damage taken by ⟦t:180¦Found Soul⟧, ⟦i:612¦Lost Soul⟧, ⟦i:667¦Strawman⟧ and ⟦p:soul-of-the-forgotten¦Soul of the Forgotten⟧ will reset cleared floors count, thus Perfection will not drop. However, Perfection itself will not be destroyed if they take damage.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Treasure Rooms are replaced with unique Red Treasure Rooms, offering a Deal with the Devil in place of an item.
trinkets.effects: * Every Treasure Room is replaced with a Devil Treasure Room which contains items from the Devil Room item pool that can be bought for the usual number of Heart Containers normally requested (for the spawned item) in a Devil Room.
trinkets.notes:
* The Devil Treasure Room generated will be the same as the Treasure Room that would have been generated, minus the item and room textures.
** Multiple-choice Treasure Rooms, such as those generated in alternative floors and ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, allow both items to be taken upon being converted to Devil Treasure Rooms. The blind item on alternate floors will still be blind, however.
** Urns, mushrooms, polyps, and buckets will be converted into skulls.
* This trinket also converts Treasure rooms on the current floor when picked up. However, this only affects Treasure Rooms that have not been visited yet.
** The same goes vice-versa: dropping the trinket will convert Devil Treasure Rooms to normal ones unless they've been visited.
* Items bought in the Devil Treasure Rooms will affect Angel Room chance like a normal Deal with the Devil would.
* When entering floors during the Ascent, Treasure Rooms visited during the run will keep their previous state, and will be unaffected by this trinket.
** However, unvisited Treasure Rooms can still be converted by dropping and picking up the trinket.
* Does not affect the Silver Treasure Rooms in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
* Extra treasure rooms generated by ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧ will be affected normally.
* Items spawned in Devil Treasure Rooms (e.g via ⟦i:642¦Magic Skin⟧, ⟦p:vi-the-lovers-reversed¦VI - The Lovers?⟧, ⟦p:xvii-the-stars-reversed¦XVII - The Stars?⟧, etc.) will all be drawn from the Devil Room item pool.
* Devil's Crown does not affect the reversed Treasure Room in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧/⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ II.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Picking up coins has a chance to give an Active Item charge.
trinkets.effects:
* Picking up coins has a chance to add one charge to Isaac's currently held Active Item.
** This chance is equal to 1/6th of the value of the coin, and cannot activate more than once per coin collected.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Causes familiars to orbit Isaac.
trinkets.effects:
* Familiars that normally follow Isaac orbit around him instead.
** Does not affect familiars' ability to block shots: if they don't already, they still won't.
trinkets.notes:
* This trinket affects the same familiars ⟦i:472¦King Baby⟧ affects.
* Familiars unaffected by Friendship Necklace include:

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Activates Isaac's active item just before he takes damage.
trinkets.effects:
* Activates Isaac's active item just before damage would be taken.
** This still uses the item's charges, so if the item is not charged, the trinket will do nothing.
** Single-use items will be consumed.
trinkets.notes:
* Panic Button will attempt to use the item 2-3 times per tick as damage is incoming. This may cause some unlimited use items to trigger multiple times before one damage instance.
* Some items will be activated after respawning if Isaac is killed by the incoming damage, including ⟦i:133¦Guppy's Paw⟧ and ⟦i:441¦Mega Blast⟧.
* Taking damage from explosions, enemy creep, spikes and spike rocks, Spiked Chest and Mimic Chest, some attack from above (for example, the stomp attacks from ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧ and ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧), Whipper and their variants, brimstone lasers (including angel lasers), or electric lasers, will not trigger the effect as those are instantaneous.
* Self-damage sources also won't trigger the trinket. This includes items, machines, and damaging doors.
* Does not activate items in a consumable slot (such as ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧'s ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧ or dice items granted by ⟦t:154¦Dice Bag⟧).
* Will activate when touching ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧ while playing as ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧, despite Dark Esau not technically dealing damage.
** This effect still occurs even whilst he is chained by ⟦i:722¦Anima Sola⟧, when he deals no contact damage.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Doors can be unlocked without using Keys. Opening a door this way brings Isaac to an in-between room that resembles ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, with a few monsters.
trinkets.effects:
* Entering a room that requires a Key does not consume a key, but brings Isaac to a room resembling ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, which acts as an in-between of the two rooms.
** These rooms contain assortments of Blue Gapers, Blue Boils, and/or Blue Conjoined Fatties, and are always long rooms (either normal or slim). They have a chance to give a reward when cleared, like normal rooms.
** Once exited, the room cannot be re-entered.
trinkets.notes:
* Doors that were unlocked with the trinket have a blue hue emitting from them instead of the normal floor-dependent hue.
* The doors leading to the entrance of ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ or ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧ can be unlocked for free by Blue Key, though the blue room generated will be a dead end. Leaving the way Isaac came in will leave the door unlocked, allowing the player to continue normally.
* Rooms that require money to enter (Arcades or rooms affected by ⟦i:380¦Pay To Play⟧) can also be opened for free.
* Doors that require two keys to open, such as Vaults or Dice Rooms, will be opened instantly instead of waiting for the animation of both keys to be used.
* The door leading to ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ will also produce a blue room, despite not requiring a key.
* Isaac can unlock the rooms with Blue Key, but not enter them straight away. By exiting and re-entering the room, he can pass through the door that was unlocked with the Blue Key without having to go through the room in between.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Causes most spikes to retract, making them harmless. This includes the door to Curse Rooms, Spiked Chests, Pokies and their variants.
trinkets.effects:
* Makes all spikes retract, preventing them from dealing damage.
** Most spikes leave behind holes or a visual cue showing where they would normally be.
** The spikes around Curse Room doors are removed, allowing them to be entered and exited without taking damage.
** Retracts damaging spikes from Spiked Rocks and Spiked Chests/Mimic Chests.
** Removes the spikes from Pokies, Slides, and Wall Huggers.
*** Pokies, Slides, and Wall Huggers don't immediately stop moving once they are despiked, and are still able to push Isaac without dealing damage.
*** Has no effect on Grudges, neither retracting their spikes nor despawning them.
** Causes Spikeballs to despawn.
*** Doesn't despawn or retract the spikes on Ball and Chains.
*** Doesn't cause the moveable spike balls in ⟦e:singe¦Singe⟧'s boss room to despawn or despike.
trinkets.notes:
* If Flat File is dropped in a room with spikes, the spikes will not extend again unless the room is left and re-entered.
** Spiked Rocks will not re-extend their spikes.
* Mimic Chests won't change their contents when Isaac is up close to them (visible with ⟦i:665¦Guppy's Eye⟧) if opened under the effect of Flat File.
* Flat File also retracts the spikes in the center of Sacrifice Rooms, making them unusable while the trinket is held. The spikes reappear after dropping the trinket and re-entering the room.
** If Flat File is gulped, Isaac cannot use Sacrifice rooms for the rest of the run.
* Flat File does not prevent ⟦e:the-pile¦The Pile⟧ or ⟦e:mama-gurdy¦Mama Gurdy⟧ from using their spike attacks.
* Also removes spikes from doors in the Cursed! challenge, making it significantly easier.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Increases the chance for Planetariums to spawn even if one has been visited and allows Planetariums to spawn in Chapter 4.
trinkets.effects:
* Raises the default chance for a Planetarium to spawn from 1% to 10%.
** This influences the chance after having already entered a Planetarium, keeping it at 10%.
* Further increases the chance for a Planetarium to spawn by 15% if one has not been entered yet.
** Combined with the raised default chance, this adds up to a perceived +24% chance increase when first picked up.
* Makes it possible for Planetariums to spawn in Chapter 4 and ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Grants the effects of a random Mom item each room.
trinkets.effects: * Has a 25% chance to grant the effects of a random passive Mom item each room.
trinkets.notes:
* The trinket can't give the effect of ⟦i:195¦Mom's Coin Purse⟧ or ⟦i:139¦Mom's Purse⟧.
* The trinket can give the effect of a Mom item Isaac already has.
* Mom's Lock doesn't count towards , no matter the effect.
* The items chosen by the trinket won't grant health or spawn pickups/consumables.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: When Isaac enters a new room, has a chance to give him a Dice item as a consumable for the current room.
trinkets.effects:
* Has a 50% chance to give Isaac a one-time use Dice item in a consumable slot when he enters a new room. The dice disappears when he leaves the room, and cannot be dropped.
** This doesn't replace any consumables Isaac already has.
trinkets.notes:
* If Isaac leaves and re-enters a room, Dice Bag will not try to give another die when Isaac re-enters it.
* The dice given are determined by the amount of rooms cleared, and are not actually tied to specific rooms.
** This is the opposite of how ⟦t:166¦Modeling Clay⟧ works.
* Any die can be given to Isaac, including ones that haven't been unlocked yet.
* Dice Bag cannot give ⟦i:723¦Spindown Dice⟧, ⟦i:489¦D infinity⟧, ⟦t:67¦Cracked Dice⟧, or ⟦p:dice-shard¦Dice Shard⟧.
* Dropping the trinket on the ground does not remove dice until Isaac leaves the room.
** This means that the D1 can always be used on the Dice Bag to spawn another trinket.
* If a D4 or D100 die is used, it won't reroll your active item. This is likely because the code for the dice consumable was directly copied from the items themselves, and because the D4 and D100 doesn't reroll your active item (themselves), neither can the dice consumables.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.quote: Walk the path of the saint
trinkets.description: A Treasure Room and Shop appear in the ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧.
trinkets.effects: * Causes a Treasure Room and Shop to generate in ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧.
trinkets.notes:
* Cannot appear in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
* The spawned Treasure Room will have one of 23 unique layouts for the floor.
* ⟦i:660¦Card Reading⟧ will spawn a second portal if Isaac has the trinket upon entering Cathedral.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Grants one heart container.
trinkets.effects:
* Grants one heart container while held.
** This heart container will be filled the first time the trinket is picked up.
trinkets.notes:
* If the only heart container Isaac has is the one given by Mother's Kiss, the trinket will be destroyed if the heart container is traded/consumed.
** The trinket will get destroyed even if smelted via ⟦i:479¦Smelter⟧, ⟦i:538¦Marbles⟧, or a Gulp! pill.
* If Isaac drops the trinket while he only has one heart container for health, he will have no health and die instantly.
** This also means that using ⟦p:0-the-fool-reversed¦0 - The Fool?⟧ card will do the same, even if he has soul hearts.
* The extra red heart container can exceed the maximum coin heart container limit of ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, allowing them to obtain more than 3 or 2 coin hearts, respectively.
* The heart added is a soul heart for ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧, and a black heart for ⟦c:judas¦Black Judas⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-judas¦Tainted Judas⟧.
** Using The Fool? card as one of these characters while holding this trinket will kill you instantly, as it drops the trinket, removing the last half soul heart that you normally would remain with.
* ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ will always get a Bone Heart regardless of whether the body or the soul picked up the trinket.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Every 15 shots, Isaac shoots an ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ + ⟦i:5¦My Reflection⟧ tear.
trinkets.effects:
* Every 15 shots, Isaac will shoot an ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ + ⟦i:5¦My Reflection⟧ tear with a very high range value.
* The tear will follow Isaac until it hits an enemy or lands, where it will explode.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Upon taking damage, Isaac drops 2 random Pickups from among those he's currently holding. Pickups of higher amounts have more chance to drop.
trinkets.effects:
* Upon taking damage, Isaac drops 2 random Pickups from his inventory (except Hearts, Pills, or Cards).
* Pickups of higher amounts have more chance to drop.
trinkets.notes:
* All pickups are subjected to standard pickup spawn rules, which means that trinket's effect won't necessarily result in a net neutral.
** Coins dropped have a chance of being replaced with a Golden Penny, Lucky Penny, Nickel, Sticky Nickel or Dime.
** Bomb dropped have a chance of being replaced with Double Bomb, Golden Bomb, Troll Bomb or Mega Troll Bomb.
*** When a dropped bomb is replaced with a Troll/Megatroll bomb, the game will still subtract that bomb from the total bomb count.
*** Giga bombs, however, can't be dropped if Isaac has them, but their count will still be retained unless the bomb count reaches 0.
** Keys dropped have a chance of being replaced with Golden Keys or Charged Keys.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Replaces all new chests, except Mega Chests and Old Chests, with Locked Chests. Grants one Key on pickup.
trinkets.effects:
* Replaces all new chests with Golden Chests.
** Old Chests and Mega Chests are not replaced.
* Causes Golden Chests to either grant an item or multiple random pickups. This modifies the contents of Golden Chests to be able to give one or even multiple cards, runes, and trinkets from a single chest alongside normal pickups when it doesn't reward an item.
** This includes one or more Lil' Battery and pill pickups allowing Golden Chests to drop these pickups.
* Gives Isaac one Key when picked up for the first time in a run.
trinkets.notes:
* The contents of Golden Chests can be changed retroactively by picking up/dropping Gilded Key. This can even be observed if Isaac has ⟦i:665¦Guppy's Eye⟧, allowing him to see what the chest would have if he did(n't) have the key and choose which payout he wants.
** This also applies to chests that use Golden Chests' loot systems, such as Bomb Chests and Eternal Chests.
** Mega Chests will also have their contents modified if they didn't contain items.
** The difference in contents between the two chest payouts are independent from each other; regardless of if the original chest had an item, card, trinket, or pickups, the modified chest can have any combination of them.
*** Modified chests are still unable to spawn pickups alongside items.
* Gilded Key does not retroactively change chests that have already spawned into Golden Chests, or change their contents.
* Golden Chests in ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧ will still spawn items.
* The unique Red Chests in the beginning room of the ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ will be replaced with golden chests, allowing Isaac to take 4 treasure room items for free instead of Devil Deal items.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Spawns a Grab Bag upon traveling to the next floor.
trinkets.effects: * Spawns a Grab Bag upon traveling to the next floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.quote: Walk the path of the wicked
trinkets.description: A Treasure Room and Shop appear in ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧.
trinkets.effects: * Causes a Treasure Room and Shop to generate in ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧.
trinkets.notes:
* Cannot appear in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
* The spawned Treasure Room will have one of 22 unique layouts for the floor.
* ⟦i:660¦Card Reading⟧ will spawn a second portal if Isaac has the trinket upon entering Sheol.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: When clearing a room, adds a 33% chance to turn into ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧ until clearing another.
trinkets.effects:
* Gives Isaac a 33% chance to visually turn into ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧ when clearing a room. Isaac keeps his hearts and items, but changes his tears to be a short range ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧, gains a x1.5 damage multiplier, a Speed increase, and the ability to fly.
** The effect lasts until clearing and leaving another room.
** The effect can be taken to the next floor.
** The Speed increase is equal to the difference between the current character's base speed and Azazel's (which is 1.25). For instance, ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ will gain +0.35 Speed since his base speed is 0.9.
trinkets.notes:
* Dropping the trinket after this transformation will not reverse it until a new room is cleared.
* The trinket only changes Isaac's appearance to be as Azazel's but doesn't change the actual character. This means that the trinket cannot be used to unlock achievements for Azazel.
* The effect will not change Isaac's health mechanics. For example, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ will retain his zero health and ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧.
* When entering the area in ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ / ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ to obtain ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ while in the Azazel form, flight and the Brimstone laser will remain despite visually reverting.
** However, because picking up the Knife Piece triggers a room clear, the form will be reverted upon leaving the knife piece room, and the escape sequence will not benefit from the trinket's effect.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Spawns a Dip Familiar upon clearing a room.
trinkets.effects:
* Spawns a random friendly Dip upon clearing a room.
** Spawns a random friendly Dip upon starting a new wave in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧.
* Turns enemy Dips into friendly Dips, similar to ⟦i:576¦Dirty Mind⟧.
* Dips come in Poops variants rather than Dip variants. Golden variants drop coins on being damaged and can turn enemies into gold. Red variants do extra damage. Rainbow variants turn into a heart upon death. White variants are harder to kill. Black and Corny variants have had no extra visible effects.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Placing a Bomb spawns an extra bomb for free.
trinkets.effects:
* Whenever Isaac places a Bomb, an extra bomb is spawned next to the original.
** This does not consume more than one bomb pickup.
trinkets.notes:
* The extra bomb spawns in a random location adjacent to the original.
* The additional bomb is affected by any items that affect bombs.
* Ring Cap will also work with Giga Bombs collected via ⟦t:63¦Safety Scissors⟧.
* Can be used to open the door to Bedrooms and the ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧ / ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ with only one bomb.
* This trinket has no effect on the Explosive Diarrhea pill.
* The bombs explode simultaneously with each other, without risk of any being launched.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Replaces Keys and coins that spawn in Chapter 4 and beyond with more useful pickups.
trinkets.effects:
* On Chapter 4 and beyond, replaces all coin and Key spawns with a random pickup from the table below.
{| class="wikitable"
! Pickup
! Chance

| Bomb
| 26.6%
