source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: 50% chance to grant the effect of a random passive Item each room.
trinkets.effects:
* Has a 50% chance to mimic the effect of a random passive item from the current room’s item pool when entering a room.
** The trinket takes the shape of the mimic item.
trinkets.notes:
* Modeling Clay can only mimic items that have the "summonable" item tag, the same way ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧ selects the wisps it summons.
* The item given by Modeling Clay is seeded and based on the room Isaac is in.
* Effects that activate upon pickup will not be applied.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: After clearing a room, adds a 25% chance to spawn a friendly Bony.
trinkets.effects:
* After clearing a room, adds a 25% chance to spawn a friendly Bony.
** 25% of spawned Bonies are Black Bonies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Grants an empty Bone Heart upon entering a new floor.
trinkets.effects:
* Grants one Bone Heart container upon entering a new floor.
** If Isaac has 12 heart containers, the added bone heart will replace the rightmost Soul Heart (if any).

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: While held, counts as one of three items needed to transform into Guppy.
trinkets.effects:
* While held, acts as one of the three items needed for .
** The effect is lost if Kid's Drawing is dropped.
** This includes instantly losing the transformation if dropping the trinket results in having only 2 out of 3 Guppy items required for the transformation.
trinkets.notes: * If multiple copies of the trinket are obtained, they will each count as a Guppy item.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Whenever Isaac clears a room, has a chance to open a neighboring ⟦i:580¦Red Room⟧.
trinkets.effects:
* Whenever Isaac clears a room, has a chance to open a neighboring Red Room.
** This effect can occur while Isaac is inside a Red Room, but the chance is smaller.
trinkets.notes:
* It's possible to increase the chance of a Red Room unlocking if multiple Crystal Keys are held, e.g. from absorbing using ⟦i:479¦Smelter⟧, holding ⟦i:439¦Mom's Box⟧, having a golden Crystal Key. The chance for a Red Room door to unlock depends on the number of Crystal Keys held and if the room cleared is normal or Red.
* Each cleared wave of a Challenge Room has a chance to generate an adjacent Red Room.
* Rooms that are re-fought using the ⟦i:437¦D7⟧ have a chance to generate additional Red Rooms.
* Doors do not have to open to an actual valid Red Room, and can lead outside the map and into an I AM ERROR Room.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Adds a chance for Devil Deals to cost money instead of health.
trinkets.effects:
* Adds a 50% chance for Devil Deals, Black Markets, and ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧ Shop items to cost money instead of health.
** Items that would normally cost 1 heart container will cost 15 coins, while items that would normally cost 2 heart containers will cost 30 coins.
trinkets.notes:
* The effects of this trinket are inherent to ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧, rendering the trinket useless for them.
* Items affected by Keeper's Bargain may occasionally be discounted (30 coin item down to 15 coins, or 15 coins to 7), just like items are in a regular shop.
* Dropping this trinket while in the room disables its effect.
* Purchasing a Devil Deal with this trinket's effect will still prevent Angel Rooms from appearing.
* If an item that costs health is rerolled (via ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧ or similar methods), the new item can cost coins instead. The reverse is also true.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Picking up coins teleports Isaac to a random room. ⟨16⟩ The type of the coin picked up affects the teleport destination.
trinkets.effects:
* Teleports Isaac to a random room upon picking up a coin.
* ⟨16⟩ The type of the coin picked up affects the teleport destination:
** Penny: 50% chance for an unexplored combat room.
** Double Penny: 50% chance for Dice Room, Vault, Clean Bedroom or Dirty Bedroom.
** Nickel: 50% chance for Treasure Room, Shop, Library, Arcade, Challenge Room or Boss Challenge Room.
** Dime: 25% chance for Angel Room or Devil Room. This ignores Isaac's current devil/angel deal chances and picks at random.
** Lucky Penny: 50% chance for Secret Room or Super Secret Room.
** Golden Penny: 10% chance for I AM ERROR room.
** Sticky Nickel: 100% chance for Boss Room or Curse Room. This is only for the still-stuck version and the coin is still not actually picked up.
trinkets.notes:
* The effect can teleport Isaac to any room aside from an undiscovered Ultra Secret Room.
* ⟨16⟩ The trinket has a small chance to teleport Isaac to Black Market if the I AM ERROR room should have been the target. In this case, there will be no door exiting back to a Crawl Space.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Can be used to pay for a Devil deal without losing hearts, and is then consumed.
trinkets.effects:
* Grants 1 free Devil Deal item in exchange for the trinket.
** After a Devil Deal has been taken, the trinket is removed from Isaac's inventory.
** Also works in Black Markets and all other places where heart containers can be exchanged for an item.
trinkets.notes:
* Your Soul has no effect on Devil Deals that cost money instead of health, such as from ⟦t:171¦Keeper's Bargain⟧, or playing ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ and ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧.
* ⟨8⟩ Using Your Soul as ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ / ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧ grants the possibility of taking two items from the Devil Deal instead of only one.
** ⟨16⟩ The trinket gets consumed but you still can only take a single item from devil deals.
* Using Your Soul still counts as taking a Devil Deal for the purpose of determining Angel Room eligibility.
* Taking multiple deals at the same time with ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧ will make both free. The trinket will still be removed.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Increases the chance of earning a Devil Room by 10%, prevents ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧ from spawning, and generates special Devil Room layouts.
trinkets.effects:
* Increases Devil Room chance by 10%.
* Prevents ⟦e:krampus¦Krampus⟧ from appearing in the Devil Deal.
* If held before visiting the Devil Deal, the room's layout will be replaced with one of 12 special Devil Room layouts (7 in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧). These rooms contain 0-3 Devil Room items (most commonly 2-3), 1-3 Black Hearts, and several enemies from ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Unlocks the passageway to ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ and the ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ fight, regardless of the run duration. Using ⟦i:297¦Pandora's Box⟧ grants it a special effect, consuming the key.
trinkets.effects:
* Unlocks the passageway to ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧, regardless of run duration.
* If ⟦i:297¦Pandora's Box⟧ is used while holding Strange Key, the following effects will occur instead of Pandora's Box regular effects:
** The normal effect of Pandora's Box for that level is ignored, and instead 6 random items from any of the following item pools are spawned: Treasure Room, Shop, Boss Room, Devil Room, Angel Room, Secret Room, Library, Locked Chest, Curse Room, and Planetarium.
** Both Pandora's Box and the trinket are consumed.
trinkets.notes:
* Both effects work even if the key has been turned into a passive item from items such as ⟦i:479¦Smelter⟧ or ⟦i:538¦Marbles⟧.
** Using Pandora's Box with the key in this state will remove the key from Isaac's Inventory.
* If playing with modal characters such as ⟦c:tainted-lazarus¦Tainted Lazarus⟧, the character with the Strange Key must enter the room while holding it to cause the passage to open. Leaving and re-entering the room after switching to the correct character will open the door normally.
* Unlike with ⟦i:483¦Mama Mega!⟧, ⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧ must be beaten for the passageway to ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ to open.
* If the passageway to ⟦s:blue-womb¦???⟧ is somehow not yet unlocked, Strange Key will not open the door.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Spawns a clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tears. It dies for the current room after taking too much damage.
trinkets.effects:
* Spawns a blood clot Familiar on the ground near Isaac. The familiar copies Isaac's movement and attacks, but deals only 35% of Isaac's damage.
** The clot will die after taking damage 3 times.
* If Isaac does not currently have a clot from this trinket, a new one spawns when entering a room.
trinkets.notes:
* Holding the "drop" button lets Isaac move independently from Lil Clot.
* Lil Clot will persist after the trinket is dropped, but it will not respawn unless the trinket is picked up again.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Drops a Chest after clearing a Challenge Room, or an extra Boss item after clearing a Boss Challenge Room.
trinkets.effects: * Drops a Chest after clearing a Challenge Room, or an extra Boss item after clearing a Boss Challenge Room.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Isaac explodes upon taking damage.
trinkets.effects:
* Isaac has a 50% chance to explode when he takes damage, similarly to if he used ⟦i:40¦Kamikaze!⟧.
** The explosion deals 185 damage and uses most of Isaac's bomb synergies.
** The explosion does not cause additional damage to Isaac, as the explosion occurs during Isaac's invincibility frames.
trinkets.notes:
* Causes Devil Beggar and Hell Game to become essentially unplayable, as any damage that could trigger Swallowed M80 will likely cause Isaac to explode, killing them.
* ⟨15⟩ Causes Blood Donation Machines and Confessionals to act as if they were destroyed from the explosion despite surviving and functioning normally, resulting in extra coin and Heart drops.
* The explosion cannot be triggered by Curse Room or Sacrifice Room spikes.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Instead of trailing behind Isaac, familiars are directly controlled by the same inputs as Isaac's.
trinkets.effects:
* Instead of trailing behind Isaac, familiars are directly controlled by the same inputs as Isaac's.
* Holding the drop button will allow Isaac to move while keeping the familiars in place, identical to ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧.
trinkets.notes:
* This trinket affects the same familiars ⟦i:472¦King Baby⟧ effects. For a list of the familiars unaffected by this trinket, visit King Baby's page.
* Throwable familiars do not return to Isaac upon impact; instead, they treat their impact location as their new "launch" location, and can be fired in any direction from there. The only exception is ⟦i:548¦Jaw Bone⟧ which will return to the location it was launched from.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Spawns a familiar that copies Isaac's movements and scales with damage and tears. If it takes damage, it will die and respawn on the next floor.
trinkets.effects:
* Summons a Familiar that follows Isaac's exact movements, akin to ⟦c:jacob¦Jacob and Esau⟧, that flies and shoots spectral tears.
** The ghost uses Isaac's speed, tears, range, shot speed, tear effects, and trinkets, and deals half of Isaac's damage.
** The familiar has collision and can be separated. Holding down the "drop" button keeps the familiar in place.
* The familiar dies after taking any damage, and will respawn on the next floor.
trinkets.notes:
* When Isaac places a Bomb, the familiar will drop one as well at no cost.
* The familiar can press Pressure Plates.
* If Found Soul touches a Devil Beggar, Blood Donation Machine, or Confessionals, it will use the machine or beggar once for free before dying.
* Keeping Found Soul alive is crucial for exploration bonus boost in daily runs.
* Although the familiar dies from any damage initially, it is possible for it to obtain health and survive multiple hits with help of effects such as ⟦t:168¦Hollow Heart⟧.
** If Found Soul obtains an empty heart container, it is possible to heal it by collecting a Red Heart. Isaac's heart containers must be full for this to happen.
* ⟨15⟩ If Found Soul is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧, even if Isaac hasn't been hit.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Once per room, using an active item triggers another random active item effect.
trinkets.effects:
* Upon use of an activated item, activates the effect of another random activated item.
** The random effect is any activated item with a charge time of 1 or 2 rooms (with the exception of ⟦i:488¦Metronome⟧, ⟦i:489¦D infinity⟧, and ⟦i:703¦Esau Jr.⟧.) View the page on activated items for a complete list.
** Timed-recharge and infinite-use items trigger the effect once per room. Re-entering the room will allow Expansion Pack to trigger again.
trinkets.notes:
* Effects from one-time-use, timed-recharge, and infinite-use items will not be produced by Expansion Pack.
* ⟦i:124¦Dead Sea Scrolls⟧ qualifies for Expansion Pack as its charge time is 2 rooms. This may result in activations of items not normally selectable by Expansion Pack.
* If Expansion Pack uses an item that requires Isaac to shoot to activate it (like ⟦i:42¦Bob's Rotten Head⟧ or ⟦i:49¦Shoop da Whoop!⟧), using it will be counted as another item use and activate Expansion Pack an additional time.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Upon entering an Angel Room, spawns 5 wisp orbitals. Giving money to Beggars can spawn wisps.
trinkets.effects:
* Upon entering an Angel Room, spawns 5 normal blue wisp orbitals.
** Also applies to ⟦i:586¦The Stairway⟧'s shop.
* Donating to any kind of Beggar has a chance to create a random wisp orbital.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Adds a chance to duplicate one of Isaac's familiars when entering a new room.
trinkets.effects:
* Adds a 50% chance to duplicate one of Isaac's familiars when entering a new room.
* If Isaac has no familiars, spawns ⟦i:8¦Brother Bobby⟧ or ⟦i:67¦Sister Maggy⟧ instead.
trinkets.notes:
* ⟨16⟩ This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating ⟦e:the-horny-boys¦The Horny Boys⟧.
* The following items/trinkets cannot be duplicated:
** ⟦t:57¦???'s Soul⟧
** ⟨16⟩ ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧
** ⟦i:706¦Abyss⟧ / ⟦t:186¦Apollyon's Best Friend⟧’s unique attack locusts
** ⟦i:117¦Dead Bird⟧
** ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧
** ⟦i:575¦The Intruder⟧
** ⟦t:54¦Isaac's Head⟧
** ⟦i:276¦Isaac's Heart⟧
** ⟦i:658¦Giant Cell⟧
** ⟦i:10¦Halo of Flies⟧ / Pretty Flies
** ⟦i:612¦Lost Soul⟧
** ⟦i:436¦Milk!⟧
** ⟦i:661¦Quints⟧
** ⟦i:655¦Spin to Win⟧
** ⟦i:635¦Stitches⟧
** ⟦i:693¦The Swarm⟧
** ⟦t:33¦Umbilical Cord⟧
** ⟦i:697¦Vanishing Twin⟧
** Any temporary familiars, including those from ⟦i:123¦Monster Manual⟧
* The duplication chance reoccurs when starting a room, even when starting a room by exiting to the main menu and re-entering.
** This allows quitting to the menu to be an effective method to cycle for a specific duplicated familiar.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Shops can sell familiars, which will always be at a discounted price.
trinkets.effects:
* Shops and Black Markets now sell familiars instead of the usual item selection.
** The familiars are chosen from the Baby Shop item pool.
** While holding the Adoption Papers, the familiars are discounted to 10 coins. If the papers are dropped, they cost 15 coins.
trinkets.notes:
* A shop that has already been entered will not have its item selection changed, nor will dropping the papers revert them to normal.
* In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, only the shop pool item is replaced with a familiar and discounted.
** This also applies to all shop pool items when playing as ⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧. Familiars spawned from the Treasure Room pool remain unaffected.
* Familiars that appear in both the Shop pool and Baby Shop pool (⟦i:518¦Buddy in a Box⟧, ⟦i:472¦King Baby⟧, etc) will be discounted by Adoption Papers even if the shop was visited before the trinket was held.
* After Baby Shop item pool is exhausted, items from normal shop pool will be generated again in shops.
** Items generated by this will still discount to 10 coins.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Adds a 1/6 chance to spawn a random locust when killing an enemy.
trinkets.effects:
* Has a 1/6 chance to spawn a random locust when killing an enemy.
** Up to 4 White Locusts can be spawned from a single enemy.
* The trinket is not affected by luck.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Spawns an ⟦i:706¦Abyss⟧ locust familiar which will fly forward while Isaac shoots.
trinkets.effects:
* Spawns an attack locust familiar identical to the default ones spawned by ⟦i:706¦Abyss⟧. It will fly forward while Isaac is shooting and deals contact damage ⟨15⟩ equal to Isaac's damage.
** ⟨16⟩ The locust is treated as a Quality 3 locust and deals 1.5x Isaac's damage.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Gives a 50% chance to add a '?' item to Treasure Rooms. Only one item can be taken. The extra items on the alt path are revealed instead.
trinkets.effects:
* 50% chance of adding an extra blind item in Treasure Rooms.
** When one of the items is taken, the other disappears.
** The extra blind items in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧, ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧, ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧, ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧, ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧, and ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ (and ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ if ⟦t:111¦Bloody Crown⟧ is held) have a 50% chance to be revealed instead.
trinkets.notes:
* The effect includes instances where pedestal items would be replaced with something else, such as the Pica Run challenge. If there is not a blind equivalent, both items will simply be shown.
* Its effect can work on the same floor it was picked up on if the Treasure Room hasn't been entered yet.
* Works in both Treasure Rooms in Greed mode.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Adds a chance to petrify enemies when entering the room. Killing the petrified enemy freezes it.
trinkets.effects:
* Upon entering a room, each enemy has a 20% chance to be petrified for 4 seconds. Enemies that have been petrified by Ice Cube are frozen when killed, ⟨15⟩ including those killed up to 2 seconds after the petrifaction effect ends.
** The chance for enemies to be petrified increases with luck, reaching 100% at 40 Luck.
trinkets.notes:
* Enemies spawned in waves are not petrified.
* Bosses can be petrified, but cannot be frozen.
* Every room has a predetermined set of enemies that are going to be petrified. Re-entering the room will not change this, similarly to Champion enemies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

trinkets.description: Grants an invulnerability shield for 1 second after killing an enemy.
trinkets.effects:
* Shields Isaac for 1 second after killing an enemy.
** If another enemy is killed while Isaac is shielded, another second is added to the shield's duration.
** Up to 5 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated.
trinkets.notes:
* If Isaac is in range of an enemy that explodes on death, the shield will not come up before Isaac takes damage from the explosion. Other on-death effects, like firing shots, are still guarded against.
* ⟨15⟩ In Arcades, Blood Donation Machines or Devil Beggars can be used without losing health by killing the red flies from Shell Games and gaining a shield.
** Additionally, losing in a Hell Game always spawns a red spider, the shield generated from killing it guarantees a payout for each half-heart.
* During the fight against ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧, destroying Ultra Greed Coins will not grant a shield, despite being considered enemies.
* Destroyed Shopkeepers also grant a shield.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

consumables.description: When used, copies the effect of Isaac's currently held activated collectible.
consumables.effects:
* Replicates the effect of Isaac's activated collectible.
** ⟨7⟩ Single-use items, such as ⟦i:297¦Pandora's Box⟧, will not replicate but instead activate and disappear.
** ⟨24⟩ Single-use items do not disappear after using ? Card, allowing for potential multiple uses of the items.
consumables.notes:
* Being a special card, the ? Card has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.
* The ID of this card was 43 before the Afterbirth+ expansion.
* ⟨24⟩ Doesn't work with pocket activated items (such as ⟦c:tainted-bethany¦Tainted Bethany⟧'s ⟦i:712¦Lemegeton⟧ or items given by ⟦t:154¦Dice Bag⟧).

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

consumables.description: Teleports Isaac to the starting room of the current floor.
consumables.effects: * Teleports Isaac to the starting room of the current floor.
consumables.notes:
* If the room teleported out of was hostile, it will be reset.
* Previously cleared rooms do not reset.
* If used in the mirror dimension in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ or ⟦s:dross¦Dross⟧, Isaac will be warped to the starting room of the main floor instead of the mirror world
* ⟨24⟩ A 0 - The Fool is guaranteed to appear on ⟦s:depths¦Depths⟧ / ⟦s:necropolis¦Necropolis⟧ / ⟦s:dank-depths¦Dank Depths⟧ II in a marked skull after unlocking ⟦a:635¦A Strange Door⟧.
* When is active, using this card can teleport Isaac to a random room instead.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

consumables.description: Drops all hearts, trinkets, and pickups Isaac currently possesses on the floor, leaving Isaac at half a heart. Pickups may be dropped as items such as ⟦i:74¦A Quarter⟧ and ⟦i:19¦Boom!⟧.
consumables.effects:
* Drops all hearts, trinkets, and pickups Isaac currently possesses on the ground near him, leaving Isaac at half a heart.
* Pickups will be dropped grouped in their highest possible value:
** Every 25 cents will first be dropped as the ⟦i:74¦A Quarter⟧, then Dimes for every remaining 10 cents, Nickels for every 5 cents, Double Pennies for every 2 cents, then finally a Penny if Isaac has 1 remaining cent.
** If Isaac has exactly 99 bombs, they will be dropped as ⟦i:190¦Pyro⟧. If less than 99, then ⟦i:19¦Boom!⟧ for every 10 bombs, Double Bombs for every 2 bombs, then finally a Bomb if Isaac has 1 remaining.
** If Isaac has exactly 99 keys, they will be dropped as ⟦i:17¦Skeleton Key⟧. If less than 99, then Key Rings for every 2 Keys, then finally a Key if Isaac has 1 remaining.
** Every 2 full red hearts will first be dropped as Double Hearts, then Red Hearts for every remaining red heart, then finally a Half Red Heart if Isaac has one red heart remaining.
** Soul Hearts, Half Soul Hearts, and Black Hearts will be dropped as usual. If half a Black Heart needs to be dropped, it will drop as a Half Soul Heart. If Isaac only has Soul Hearts, then he will be left at half a Soul Heart. However, if Isaac has only Black Hearts or a mix of Black and Soul Hearts, then he will always be left at half a Black Heart.
** Gold Hearts will be dropped as usual.
** Bone Hearts will also be dropped. If Isaac only has Bone Hearts, then he can go down to one empty Bone Heart.
** A single Rotten Heart will not be dropped, and always stay in the container as the last remaining heart. Any additional Rotten Hearts will be dropped as usual.
consumables.notes:
* The pickups Isaac drops are set and are not affected by replacement effects, i.e. ⟦t:22¦Daemon's Tail⟧.
* If the amount of pickups dropped exceeds the room's allowed space, then extra pickups will be stacked near Isaac's position when he used the item. The player can still move out of the way while using the card to avoid picking them up.

consumables.description: Throws the card in the direction Isaac is moving, which opens doors, breaks obstacles, and instantly kills any enemy in its path.
consumables.effects:
* Upon activation, Isaac throws the card in front of himself.
** The card is thrown in the direction Isaac's body is facing, meaning the card will be thrown in the direction Isaac is moving. If he is stationary, it will be thrown in the last direction that Isaac moved.
* The thrown card kills anything in its path (including end-game bosses like ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧ and otherwise indestructible entities like Stone Grimaces and Wall Huggers) and gets stuck in the ground/wall after being thrown.
** The only exceptions to this are ⟦e:delirium¦Delirium⟧, ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧, ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ and ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧.
* The card can open doors as if a Bomb had exploded them, although it cannot open any locked doors or open the big door in the starting room of ⟦s:dark-room¦Dark Room⟧ and ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧.
* The card can extinguish fires, break rocks, and open secret rooms.
consumables.notes:
* Being a special card, the Chaos Card has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.
* Using it on multi-phase bosses like ⟦e:isaac¦Isaac⟧, ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧ and ⟦e:the-lamb¦The Lamb⟧ will instantly end the boss fight.
** Using it on ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧ during his first form will end the fight, despite him having multiple forms and health bars. Using it on ⟦e:the-fallen¦The Fallen⟧ instead of Satan himself will not end the fight.
*** However, using it on ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ will only skip one phase.
** ⟨30⟩ It will only kill one phase of ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ ⟨7⟩ unless Isaac throws it from the bottom side, such that after killing the first phase, the card can still catch up with Hush's true form as he pops out at the top of the room. However, this method can fail depending on the timing and the position of the first phase.
** ⟨28⟩ It will only kill one phase of ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧ in Greedier mode.
** ⟨24⟩ It will only kill one phase of ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ and ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧.
* To aim the card correctly, make sure to move/shoot in the direction that it needs to be thrown.
* Does not kill Beggars or Shopkeepers.
* Can kill normally indestructible enemies like the Masks of Mask + Hearts (though this will not kill the heart), Hosts while they're invulnerable, the little chubs in Chubbers, and Death's Heads. It can also be used to kill things typically not considered alive like Wall Huggers and Stone Grimaces.
* If used on ⟦e:pin¦Pin⟧ or ⟦e:the-frail¦The Frail⟧ segments can be cut off causing both bosses to lose length like ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧.
* Using it on an Angel Statue will reveal an ⟦e:gabriel¦Angel⟧ and kill them instantly.
* ⟦e:great-gideon¦Great Gideon⟧ has a special death animation if killed using it, which also reveals a Crawl Space under him containing several Chests and items.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦e:mother-s-shadow¦Mother's Shadow⟧ cannot be killed with Chaos Card, though it is normally impossible to get one in the abandoned area of ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧/ ⟦s:ashpit¦Ashpit⟧ II.
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ does not throw the card in the direction that ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Soul⟧ is moving if Tainted Forgotten is held.

consumables.description: Creates a room adjacent to a viable wall, like ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧.
consumables.effects:
* Acts as a single-use ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧, allowing Isaac to create new rooms by using the key next to a wall where there would be no conditions that could prevent a (secret) room from appearing there. This is indicated by walls that have red door outlines on them.
** These rooms are most commonly normal rooms, but have a chance to be various special rooms instead, including Devil Rooms, Angel Rooms, Shops, Treasure Rooms, etc. The red rooms can be connected to the floor's Ultra Secret Room.
consumables.notes:
* Despite it not being a card, the Cracked Key is considered a special card, so it has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.
* Cracked Key's main purpose is to allow unlocking Tainted characters in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧ without having to rely on finding the Red Key.
** To create a Cracked Key (once unlocked), drop any trinket in a Boss Room or a Treasure Room on any floor before acquiring ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧, including the floor Dad's Note is in. After starting the Ascent by collecting Dad's Note, the trinket left behind will have become a Cracked Key in the corresponding room.
*** While trinkets are fairly common, there is always a chance one doesn't appear naturally. This chance can be avoided by clearing three consecutive floors without taking damage, which is guaranteed to cause ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧ to spawn.
*** ⟦i:439¦Mom's Box⟧ can be helpful for creating Cracked Keys, providing extra trinkets to leave in Boss rooms or Treasure rooms for later use.
* Cracked Keys can also spawn in the same condition as any Card.
* This item cannot be mimicked by Wild Card, ⟦i:286¦Blank Card⟧ or ⟦i:263¦Clear Rune⟧, and ⟦i:451¦Tarot Cloth⟧ has no effect on it.
* Using the Cracked Key in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧ having unlocked that character's tainted version or as a tainted character will spawn the item ⟦i:688¦Inner Child⟧ in the closet where the Tainted character would normally be found, as long as Inner Child is unlocked, otherwise there will be a shopkeeper.
** ⟨16⟩ In Online Co-Op, each player will unlock the Tainted version of the character they are playing as, regardless of whether they are alive or not, and if they are alive, they will also see the correct character, else seeing the host's character. However, if the host is playing as a Tainted character, the room will not contain any Tainted characters even if other players have not found their respective Tainted character, and the character will not be unlocked for anyone.
* If found before the Ascent, the Cracked Key can serve as a Secret Room finder, as secret room entrances do not have red door outlines.
* Cracked Key cannot appear in greed mode.

characters.notes:
* Magdalene's strength lies in her naturally high health and her starting item, ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧.
** With her high number of Red Heart containers, Magdalene can afford more Devil Room deals.
** She has more health to spend on sacrifices, including Blood Donation Machines, Sacrifice Rooms, and items that grant effects upon taking damage like ⟦i:157¦Bloody Lust⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ In co-op, ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧ will also heal other players for half a Red Heart when used.
** ⟨24⟩ If Magdalene is at full health, combined with a fully charged ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧ and a Full Health pill, she can step on a Sacrifice Room spike seven times, allowing her to potentially get two Angel Room items on the first floor. However, this will leave her with only a single Red Heart. Many Angel items are defensive in nature, which will often mitigate this.
* Magdalene's biggest weakness is her low starting speed. Obtaining items that increase speed should be prioritized, as she may not be able to dodge high-speed or homing attacks.
** ⟨4⟩ Once the Aprils Fool challenge is completed, this disadvantage is removed as she will start every run with a Speed Up pill.

* ???'s starting item, ⟦i:36¦The Poop⟧, can provide powerful utility despite its weak appearance.
** The Poop will knock back nearby enemies (⟨30⟩ also knocks back pickups and enemy shots) upon use. Poops can also block enemies and low-flying tears.
** Poops can bridge gaps when bombed from the opposite side (as if they were rocks).
** Placing Poops on Red Poops when they are temporarily disabled ⟨24⟩ and retractable spikes when they are retracted will destroy them.
** Poops spawned in this way will still yield pickups like normal.
** ⟨24⟩ As ??? has an innate ⟦t:86¦Lil Larva⟧ effect, it can be wise to use The Poop repeatedly in one room without destroying them at first, then clear rooms all the way to a Boss Room or other hard rooms, finally breaking all the Poop at once and taking on the hard room. This way, the Blue Flies will be put into better use, being effective if the player lacks damage.
*** A possibly unintended effect is that this stacks with multiple ???'s in true coop: along with The Poop, the potential flies gained per room increases quadratically with players, with the formula simply being the amount of ???'s in game to the second power.
** The Poop will not work well with items or transformations that grant the ability to destroy obstacles on contact, such as ⟦i:314¦Thunder Thighs⟧, ⟦i:302¦Leo⟧, and as the Poop spawned by the item will be destroyed instantly.
* As ??? cannot have red health, Devil Rooms or Angel Rooms are guaranteed.

* Uniquely, Eve's ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧ and ⟦i:117¦Dead Bird⟧ effects activate upon having one remaining Red Heart, instead of half a Red Heart. Eve's 0.75x damage multiplier will also change to 1.00x while at one Red Heart.
** ⟨16⟩ Dead Bird will remain active between rooms at a total HP of one heart or less, no matter the type of hearts remaining.
* Eve works well while low on health; using health towards sacrifices such as Devil Beggars and Blood Donation Machines are good ways to activate Whore of Babylon.
* Curse Rooms are useful rooms to find early. Without any health upgrades, a single one will lower Eve's health into her Whore of Babylon state. They can also potentially grant Soul Hearts or Black Hearts to protect Eve after transforming.
* ⟨30⟩ Eve's ⟦i:126¦Razor Blade⟧ is greatly helpful once unlocked, making it easy to activate her ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧ effect while also granting the damage-up of the Razor Blade, and without lowering Devil Room deal chance.
* Eve has a 16.25% chance instead of the usual 10% for a Soul Heart to replace a Heart drop.
* When unlocking Eve, gaining Red Heart containers or using ⟦i:45¦Yum Heart⟧ does not count as picking up heart pickups. However, the use of ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ does count.

strengths: ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧ : gros bonus quand la vie est basse
weaknesses: Multiplicateur de dégâts ×0,75 (×1,00 à un seul cœur rouge)
tips: Jouer à un cœur rouge active Whore of Babylon : puissant mais risqué.
La Razor Blade permet de déclencher volontairement l'effet.

characters.notes:
* Due to Samson's starting item, ⟦i:157¦Bloody Lust⟧, he has a playstyle that is similar to ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧. Therefore, health sacrifices such as Devil Beggars, Sacrifice Rooms, and Blood Donation Machines are recommended.
** As a result, anything that lowers health is not recommended, as that will make self-damage less effective. Angel Rooms are more valuable than Devil Rooms, if the player comes across any.
* ⟨7⟩ The first three times Samson is hit, his damage is increased by 0.5. The next three times Samson is hit, his damage is increased by 33%.
* ⟨24⟩ Damage is increased by flat amounts: +0.5 for the first hit and an additional +0.2 for each hit, until +1.5 at the sixth. This means that the maximum total is +6.0.
* Samson's starting trinket, ⟦t:34¦Child's Heart⟧, is one of the more optional unlocks — the trinket itself is not too powerful, not to mention it requiring the completion of the Ultra Hard challenge.
* When Samson dies in co-op, his ghost baby maintains his level of rage from Bloody Lust, giving it a red tint. This is purely visual.
* Dying as Samson and then respawning as another character (with ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧, etc.) will make them inherit Samson's ⟦i:157¦Bloody Lust⟧ item.

strengths: ⟦i:157¦Bloody Lust⟧ : les dégâts augmentent à chaque coup reçu dans une salle
weaknesses: Son bonus dépend des dégâts subis
tips: Encaisser un coup tôt dans une salle de boss augmente les dégâts pour ce combat.
Privilégiez les objets de soin pour profiter de Bloody Lust.

characters.notes:
* Azazel suffers from a very short range, in return for better mobility through flight and high speed, high-power bursts of damage with his Brimstone-like attack, and a room clear upon the loss of a Black Heart.
* Azazel's flight is a very powerful asset, allowing him to accomplish many tasks and save resources:
** Due to his flight, Azazel takes damage only when leaving a Curse Room. He can also use his starting card, ⟦p:0-the-fool¦0 - The Fool⟧, to avoid the cost for one room entirely.
** Flight allows him to reach pickups across obstacles and gaps.
** Flight helps in avoiding enemies in general.
* Azazel's mini-Brimstone's charge is kept across rooms, saving precious charging time.
* ⟨24⟩ If Azazel dies in co-op, his ghost will also fire a short Brimstone.

strengths: ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ à courte portée et multiplicateur de dégâts ×1,5
weaknesses: Démarre sans réceptacle de cœur rouge
tips: Approchez-vous des ennemis : le rayon traverse tout sur sa longueur.
Les objets qui augmentent la portée sont particulièrement précieux.

characters.notes:
* Resurrection items and abilities activate in a set order. Lazarus' inherent extra life is 4th in this order after ⟨24⟩ ⟦p:soul-of-lazarus¦Soul of Lazarus⟧ and ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧.
* ⟨7⟩ It can be a reliable strategy to purposefully die at the beginning to become Lazarus Risen and obtain stronger stats, although it will leave Lazarus with only 1 Red Heart container. For example, attempt to complete the 2nd floor without taking any Red Heart damage, enter the Devil Room, and make Deals until Lazarus dies. If successfully performed, this will utilize Lazarus's 3 Red Heart containers to the most, but it also heavily relies on the player's skill and RNG.
* ⟨24⟩ Dying on every floor to always have the stronger stats and a permanent +0.5 damage is tempting, but it will leave Lazarus with little health for Devil Room deals. It may be preferable to go for Angel Rooms instead to gain health.
* ⟨28⟩ After beating the Backasswards challenge, Lazarus will have ⟦i:214¦Anemic⟧ even before reviving. Anemic gives +5 range which compensates for his low base range, effectively nullifying his need for extra Range Ups like he did before.
** Lazarus Risen will always have Anemic activated and will constantly leave blood trails. A higher speed attribute may help him spread more blood around the room.
* ⟨7⟩ Donating Lazarus' last heart to a Devil Beggar and respawning as Lazarus Risen activates the beggar an extra two times for a total of three.

strengths: Ressuscite une fois en Lazarus Risen
tips: Considérez la première mort comme une marge de sécurité, pas comme une vie gratuite.
Vaincre Mom's Heart ou It Lives! en mode difficile avec Lazarus sans mourir débloque ⟦c:bethany¦Bethany⟧.

characters.notes:
* ⟨3⟩ Holding R to reset doesn't work with Eden, and every time you start a new run, you use up one Eden token.
** After starting a run and transforming into another character (using items like ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧ or ⟦i:482¦Clicker⟧), holding R to reset will work and start a new run as Eden, even if you don't have tokens.
* ⟨28⟩ Holding R to reset will consume an Eden Token and start a new run.
* ⟨7⟩ Eden can start with most items, including ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ or ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ if unlocked.
** ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧, ⟦i:551¦Broken Shovel 2⟧ and ⟦i:552¦Mom's Shovel⟧ cannot be granted.
* ⟨24⟩ A noeden item tag determines which items Eden cannot start with. These include ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧, ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧, ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧, ⟦i:668¦Dad's Note⟧, ⟦i:714¦Recall⟧ and ⟦i:715¦Hold⟧.
** ⟦i:474¦Broken Glass Cannon⟧ cannot be granted.
* ⟨28⟩ Eden Tokens are not awarded for killing Mom's Heart or It Lives in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧.
* It is possible to achieve an ending as Eden while not getting another token if the player defeats Mom and earns a Void Portal, then defeats Delirium. This will count as a victory, but no Eden Token will be earned. This can also be achieved by using Sacrifice Rooms to teleport to the Dark Room.

strengths: Objets, statistiques et vie aléatoires : rejouabilité maximale
Peut démarrer avec un objet très puissant
weaknesses: Peut démarrer avec un objet faible ou gênant
tips: Lisez la fiche des objets de départ avant d'avancer : certaines combinaisons changent la façon de jouer.
Adaptez la route (Sheol/Cathedral, Boss Rush…) à ce que la partie propose.

characters.notes:
* Devil deals, while free, still count as making a deal with the devil and will prevent Angel Rooms from opening. Thus, a ⟦p:credit-card¦Credit Card⟧ is still recommended, or getting ⟦i:402¦Chaos⟧ to acquire angel room items (except ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧).
* Using the ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ or a Blood Donation Machine kills The Lost instantly even with the Holy Mantle.
* Bedrooms are much more common as The Lost due to its lack of health. While it cannot take advantage of the beds to heal, the guaranteed Crawl Spaces in clean Bedrooms can give more opportunities for items.
* ⟨3⟩ If The Lost's Holy Mantle effect is lost while within a Curse Room, closing the game, starting it up, and then continuing the run will restore the Holy Mantle's charge, allowing The Lost to leave the room unharmed.
** ⟨24⟩ The Lost can no longer restore his Holy Mantle by closing the game, starting it up, and then continuing the run.
* ⟨7⟩ Using the D4 at all is not recommended, as it will remove the Holy Mantle, making The Lost die in one hit.
* ⟨6⟩ After reaching ⟦s:womb¦Womb⟧, The Lost becomes slightly easier to play, because the invincibility frames from ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ scale with the damage that would have been taken.
** ⟨24⟩ Holy Mantle breaking only grants one second of invincibility frames, regardless of the damage source.
* ⟨28⟩ Isaac will be replaced by The Lost upon starting a third victory lap; however, Victory Laps do not allow the unlocking of achievements.
** ⟨7⟩ Since the Lost's Holy Mantle isn't intrinsic, the Victory Lap Lost will always die from one hit unless the player has explicitly found the Holy Mantle.
* ⟨24⟩ The Lost starts with ⟦i:609¦Eternal D6⟧, even before it's unlocked.
* ⟨24⟩ The Lost's Holy Mantle effect is intrinsic to the character once unlocked, and it can't be rerolled.
** Picking up another one does not double the effect.
** Being innate, this Holy Mantle effect is not shown in the pause menu.
* ⟨24⟩ Though Devil deals and Black Market items are normally choices, there are four ways to fully or partially bypass this and collect multiple items anyway:
** Making the items free with ⟦p:credit-card¦Credit Card⟧, ⟦i:521¦Coupon⟧, or ⟦i:527¦Mr. ME!⟧.
** Cloning the items with ⟦i:347¦Diplopia⟧ or ⟦i:485¦Crooked Penny⟧ (all of the cloned items can be taken, but the original items will still be presented as a choice).
** Making the items purchasable with pennies via ⟦t:171¦Keeper's Bargain⟧, ⟦i:667¦Strawman⟧, or ⟦i:672¦A Pound of Flesh⟧.
** ⟨8⟩ ⟦t:173¦Your Soul⟧ can be used to take an item.
*** ⟨16⟩ Your Soul will be consumed but will not grant an extra item.
* ⟨24⟩ Since ⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧, which grants +10 Luck, is guaranteed to spawn after three floors are cleared without taking damage, it is commonly available to The Lost.
* ⟨16⟩ In multiplayer, if one person is playing as The Lost and another player is playing as ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧, The Lost cannot pick up any free devil deals.
characters.strategy:
* One of the biggest issues of having no health is that many items become completely useless: items that only give health ups, only become effective upon taking damage, or cost health to use provide no benefit to The Lost.
** ⟨24⟩ This is alleviated by the ⟦i:609¦Eternal D6⟧ that The Lost starts with. Even though the Eternal D6 has a 25% chance to destroy an item instead of rerolling it, this is no loss for The Lost if the destroyed item would have been useless for it anyway.
* Trinkets and Items like ⟦t:144¦Brain Worm⟧ that can home-in and target enemies even at a distance are invaluable early in the game, as you do not need to place yourself directly in the enemy's attack path and ⟨30⟩The Lost's spectral tears pass through most obstacles.
* The Lost's flight and ⟨30⟩spectral tears allows taking advantage of obstacles, trivializing certain rooms.
* Anything that grants an extra life (e.g. ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧, ⟦i:11¦1up!⟧) is highly useful, allowing The Lost to retry rooms that would have otherwise ended the run.
* ⟨24⟩ Due to The Lost's ability to take 1 Devil Item for free, Devil Rooms and Angel Rooms become equally valuable, unless one is going for ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧.

Repentance : effet ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ intrinsèque une fois débloqué
weaknesses: Aucun cœur : le moindre coup sans bouclier est fatal
Prendre un accord du Diable empêche toujours les salles de l'Ange d'apparaître
tips: Le bouclier du Holy Mantle se reforme à chaque salle : avancez prudemment.
Les objets offensifs et de mobilité valent plus que tout le reste.
⟦t:145¦Perfection⟧ apparaît après trois étages terminés sans dégâts : fréquent avec The Lost.

characters.notes:
* Lilith's Incubus cannot be rerolled.
** The Incubus can be found as a separate item, and picking it up will grant Lilith another Incubus familiar.
* ⟨24⟩ The Incubus does 100% of Lilith's damage stat, while doing only 75% with other characters, except ⟦c:tainted-lilith¦Tainted Lilith⟧.
* Lilith's Incubus familiar copies whatever tears she would fire if she weren't blindfolded. Combined with the ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧, the basic strategy for her is to simply multiply her damage. Powerful tear modifiers such as ⟦i:169¦Polyphemus⟧ will become even more deadly if Lilith can create several Incubi.
* When shooting, keep in mind that Incubus lingers behind Lilith with a slight delay.
* Incubus has reduced tear size, which makes some items harder to use (⟦i:329¦The Ludovico Technique⟧, for example).
* Due to her starter item ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧, she strongly benefits from other familiars and familiar enhancers like ⟦i:247¦BFFS!⟧.
* All battery items (such as ⟦i:116¦9 Volt⟧, ⟦i:356¦Car Battery⟧, or ⟦i:647¦4.5 Volt⟧) are very useful for Lilith's ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧. This makes money and Shops more valuable as Lilith.
* Activated Items recharge per-wave in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ and Boss Rush, allowing Lilith to use the ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧ very often. Familiars like ⟦i:98¦The Relic⟧ and ⟦i:96¦Little C.H.A.D.⟧ can spawn an endless amount of health if used correctly.
** Due to this, during Greed mode, it is most effective to stay within the Arena for every wave in order to maximize the amount of familiars copied have upon reaching the boss waves.
** ⟦i:647¦4.5 Volt⟧ replaces the per-wave charging. With only this, compared to no battery items, starting and ending fully charged, it's typically possible to use ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧ once or twice more in a full set of Greed Mode waves.
* While other activatable items may have some form of use, it is not advised to permanently trade out the ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧. Without it, Lilith loses what is essentially her greatest strength, as ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ shooting in her place is only a positive with its usage.
* Lilith's ⟦i:412¦Cambion Conception⟧ benefits from Heart Containers, healing items, and Heart-generating items (⟦i:62¦Charm of the Vampire⟧, ⟦i:203¦Humbleing Bundle⟧, etc.) to allow more hits taken, and self-damage sources and items are useful for activating the item's effect.
** Familiars spawned with ⟦i:412¦Cambion Conception⟧ do not count towards transformations nor the collection page.
* If Lilith dies with an extra life item that changes her to a different character (⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧, ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧, ⟦i:311¦Judas' Shadow⟧), she will lose both her blindfold and the intrinsic Incubus familiar.
** Despite this, Lilith's Incubus still counts as an actual item.
* ⟨8⟩ If Lilith dies in True Co-op mode, she won't have the Incubus or the blindfold over her eyes, but her ghost will still be unable to fire tears.

strengths: ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧ tire à sa place et profite de ses bonus
tips: Les objets de familiers sont meilleurs que d'habitude.
Gardez Box of Friends pour les boss afin de doubler temporairement les familiers.

characters.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ Keeper when initially unlocked is one of the game's weakest characters due to his frailty, lack of healing, and slow fire rate and speed. After unlocking the starting ⟦i:349¦Wooden Nickel⟧, he becomes a high-risk, high-reward character who can dominate the late game if played strategically. By beating ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ with him and unlocking his free third Coin Heart, he can enter Curse Rooms without needing a Health Up, and faces less risk when playing Sacrifice Rooms.
** It is recommended that players who struggle with Keeper play in Normal Mode to obtain his key unlocks before attempting the more challenging Hard Mode.
* Keeper can be quite a tedious character to unlock, because the player needs to deposit 1000 Coins to the Greed Donation Machine, which takes multiple good runs and good enough luck for the donation machine to not jam/explode too early.
* ⟨7⟩ Keeper cannot have more than 2 Coin Hearts.
* ⟨24⟩ Keeper cannot have more than 3 Coin Hearts. This cap applies even before Hush is defeated.
** The only three exceptions to this are ⟦i:501¦Greed's Gullet⟧, which allows him to have up to 6 Coin Hearts, and ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧ and ⟦t:156¦Mother's Kiss⟧, which allow him to have an additional Coin Heart.
*** ⟨24⟩ Greed's Gullet in combination with ⟦i:416¦Deep Pockets⟧ can allow Keeper to reach 12 Coin Hearts at 600 coins.
**** It is possible to reach 15 Coin Hearts at 900 coins. Any Coin Heart containers past the max of 12 will appear as an additional row beneath the standard 2 rows of Coin Hearts, similar to ⟦c:magdalene¦Magdalene⟧'s ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧.
** Theoretically, Keeper could gain limitless Coin Hearts by generating and smelting Mother's Kiss, as each copy would grant a heart container, eventually bypassing the 12 heart container cap.
** If the effect of ⟦t:156¦Mother's Kiss⟧ is doubled via ⟦i:439¦Mom's Box⟧ or a ⟦a:617¦Golden Trinket⟧, Keeper will also receive an extra coin.
* Keeper always takes one full Coin Heart of damage, which means he cannot have half Coin Hearts.
** Effects that regenerate half a Red Heart, such as ⟦i:62¦Charm of the Vampire⟧ or ⟦i:218¦Placenta⟧, regenerate a full Coin Heart for Keeper instead.
** Because Keeper can usually not have less than one full heart, items such as ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧ and ⟦i:409¦Empty Vessel⟧ cannot be activated.
** ⟨4⟩ The effect of ⟦i:482¦Clicker⟧ can allow Keeper to have half Coin Hearts.
** ⟨24⟩ The effect of ⟦i:482¦Clicker⟧ will now fill one Coin Heart if Keeper would otherwise have no health.
* The amount of blue flies created from each heart depends on the type of heart.
** Half Red Hearts are transformed into 1 blue fly.
** Full Red Hearts, Blended Hearts, Half Soul Hearts, Rotten Hearts, are transformed into 2 blue flies.
** Full Soul Hearts are transformed into 3 blue flies.
** Black Hearts, Double Hearts, Bone Hearts, are transformed into 4 blue flies.
** Eternal Hearts are transformed into 5 blue flies.
** ⟨15⟩ Gold Hearts are transformed into 6 blue flies.
* Every time Keeper uses a coin to heal himself, that coin is consumed and isn't added to his current coin amount.
** Double Pennies, Nickels, Dimes and items that give money on pickup (such as ⟦i:74¦A Quarter⟧, ⟦i:18¦A Dollar⟧, ⟦i:227¦Piggy Bank⟧, etc.) will give their amount minus the healed HP.
** Using a Lucky Penny to refill health will not give a coin, but will still give +1 Luck.
** ⟦p:2-of-diamonds¦2 of Diamonds⟧ can refill Keeper's health at the cost of 1 coin.
** ⟦t:52¦Counterfeit Penny⟧ allows the chance for Keeper to gain the full value of a coin while healing.
* Coin Hearts are generally treated as Red Hearts, such as in ⟨7⟩ Devil Room /Angel Room chance, ⟨7⟩ Devil Deals, Challenge Rooms, Boss Challenge Rooms, health-recovering items and consumables, and items such as ⟦i:442¦Dark Prince's Crown⟧.
** ⟨7⟩ Taking a Devil Deal costing 2 Red Hearts will kill Keeper.
** ⟨24⟩ Getting hit will not lower the chance for a Devil Room/Angel room to appear.
* ⟨7⟩ If Keeper doesn't have maximum Coin Heart containers, using ⟦p:xi-strength¦XI - Strength⟧ will give Keeper an additional Coin Heart that does not disappear upon leaving the room.
* ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ only gives Keeper 0-1 coins per use (instead of 1-3).
** ⟦i:135¦IV Bag⟧ + ⟦i:75¦PHD⟧: IV Bag drops 0-2 coins per use.
* ⟨24⟩ Blood Donation Machine aren't guaranteed to pay Keeper out with a coin.
* ⟦i:227¦Piggy Bank⟧ only allows Keeper to drop 0-1 pennies when taking damage (instead of 1-2).
** ⟨24⟩ Having a partner in True Co-Op mode can get around this, as the Co-Op partner will drop pennies normally (as long as they are not Keeper themselves), giving Keeper a reliable source of health (the drawback being that the partner will have normal health mechanics and therefore won't have infinite health this way).
* ⟨24⟩ ⟦t:1¦Swallowed Penny⟧ only allows Keeper to drop 0-1 pennies when taking damage (instead of 1).
* Despite having an innate triple shot, Keeper does not start with ⟦i:2¦The Inner Eye⟧. Because of this, the item can still spawn.
** The Inner Eye grants 6 shots with a reduced fire rate.
* ⟨24⟩ Health Down pills cannot spawn while playing as Keeper.
* ⟨24⟩ When Keeper is being played in Co-op mode:
** If he dies, his ghost baby will maintain his innate triple shot.
** He will not convert hearts into flies unless he picks up a soul heart or is granted them directly by an item.
** Devil Deals will use coins for all players.
** Because he cannot pick up hearts, he will not pick up eternal hearts when dead for a free revive.
characters.strategy:
* Changes to the Tears stat are much less effective on fire rate at or below -0.77 Tears (see Tears for the exact calculations), so Keeper will gain very little fire rate from his first 1.13 added Tears. After crossing this threshold, as he fires 3 tears at a time with no multiplicative fire rate penalty, Keeper can gain far more DPS from Tears than other characters.
** For reference, a Tears Up pill gives 0.35 tears. Assuming no other tears modifiers are taken, Keeper will gain 0.08, 0.1, and 0.12 fire rate from his first three Tears Up pills, and 0.47 from his fourth; over 50% more than his first three combined.
** Items that directly increase fire rate are very desirable for Keeper.
* Due to his Coin Heart limit, Keeper can easily die due to fast shooting enemies. As all hearts turn into flies, Soul/Black Hearts cannot be found to protect the Keeper's health.
** ⟨3⟩ Keeper can take a 2 heart Devil Deal by spawning in a co-op baby, taking the Devil Deal, then quickly getting rid of the co-op baby, which will leave Keeper with one Coin Heart.
** ⟨7⟩ Taking Devil Deals that cost 2 Red Hearts will instantly kill him.
* It is strongly recommended to defeat ⟦e:isaac¦Isaac⟧ as soon as possible so that Keeper has the ⟦i:349¦Wooden Nickel⟧, which will vastly improve his survivability.
* Leaving a few coins on the ground when clearing a floor allows Keeper to heal himself if he takes a hit from an enemy.
* Try to bomb as many urns as possible during Chapter 1; ⟦t:1¦Swallowed Penny⟧ can drop from urns, which is amazing as Keeper (see ⟦c:keeper¦Good Items⟧).
** Urns can also appear in an Angel Room, an Arcade, and the ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧.
* In ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧, as coins spawn during waves, Keeper can easily heal himself during each wave by leaving some coins on the ground, even if this will decrease the amount of coins he will be able to collect and spend in the Shop. ⟨30⟩ ⟦e:ultra-greed¦Ultra Greed⟧ attacks make the player lose coins when damaged, which means that Keeper can heal himself as long as he possesses coins.
* Curse Rooms are very risky to enter as Keeper. Entering it through the door will leave the player at 1 health, meaning that if they don't find any coins there, it will end their run. Even with the ⟦i:349¦Wooden Nickel⟧ unlocked, it's not guaranteed that they will leave the Curse Room alive.
** It is possible to enter the Curse Room and remain at full health. This is achieved with a coin in the room right next to the Curse Room's door, most easily achieved with ⟦i:349¦Wooden Nickel⟧. The player can then walk into the Curse Room doorframe to take damage, quickly pick up the coin and heal, then walk through the door into the Curse Room while their invincibility frames are still active.
* ⟨7⟩ It is possible to take a 2 Red Heart Devil Deal by using ⟦t:56¦Judas' Tongue⟧, a Health Up pill, or ⟦p:xi-strength¦XI - Strength⟧ right after paying for the item. This would leave Keeper at 1 Coin Heart (empty if it was recovered using the pill, but he will not be killed), which is quite risky as he will be one hit away from death. However, if the boss item is a normally-useless Health Up, it can make even a 2 heart Devil Deal effectively free if Keeper possess a Strength Card and take the boss item after leaving the Devil Room.
* ⟨7⟩ It can be useful for the player to hold onto any ⟦p:joker¦Joker⟧ cards they find, as they will probably be given an item that increases health at some point in their run; before taking it, they should use Joker to see if any 1 heart Devil Deals are available.
** ⟨7⟩ Keeper's Coin Hearts count as Red Hearts for the purposes of Devil Room and Angel Room spawn chances, making Joker Cards, ⟦i:215¦Goat Head⟧ and ⟦i:499¦Eucharist⟧ invaluable for getting consistent Devil Rooms and Angel Rooms.
* ⟨7⟩ Pills can be risky to take as Keeper since there are many adverse effects in the pool, which can quickly ruin a run should they happen. Picking up ⟦i:75¦PHD⟧ is recommended before trying any pills.
** ⟨7⟩ The Hematemesis Pill will reduce the Keeper's health, but in exchange, spawn many flies.
* ⟨24⟩ The Hematemesis Pill will drop many coins on the floor, making it very useful for quick health regeration, and Health Down Pills are excluded from the pill pool when playing as Keeper, making using unknown pills slightly less risky.
* Co-op babies can be used to exploit a Blood Donation Machine and a Devil Beggar because babies still spawn with a whole heart while Keeper always has a full coin; thus, the baby's health can be replenished by spawning/respawning.
** This doesn't work in Chapter 4 and beyond unless Keeper has ⟦i:108¦The Wafer⟧.
* In fights against ⟦e:hush¦Hush⟧ and ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧, bring ⟦p:x-wheel-of-fortune¦X - Wheel of Fortune⟧: they will not attack the Keeper until he gets closer to the center of the room, allowing him to spawn a lot of coins from the Slot Machine for healing in the middle of battle.
* The Keeper can utilize the Sacrifice Room much more reliably and efficiently than other characters. To do this, instead of picking up extra dropped coins, leave them all on the floor. When the player finds a sacrifice room, they can repeatedly step on the spikes for a reward, then go pick up a penny left on the floor, and repeat this process until they are satisfied with their rewards. This process is easier in Repentance, as the player can start with 3 Coin Hearts rather than 2.
* Once unlocked, ⟦t:84¦Rib of Greed⟧ is particularly useful for Keeper, since it increases the chances of coins dropping after a room clear in place of hearts. This allows for more opportunities to heal.
After beating Cathedral with Keeper, he will start with ⟦i:349¦Wooden Nickel⟧, giving Keeper a source of potential free coins and health.
* It's usually a good idea to use the Wooden Nickel right after entering a room, so that the coin dropped will also work as emergency healing.
* ⟦i:63¦The Battery⟧, ⟦i:520¦Jumper Cables⟧, ⟦i:116¦9 Volt⟧, ⟦i:372¦Charged Baby⟧, and ⟦i:356¦Car Battery⟧ help to further increase the amount of coins produced. Having ⟦i:156¦Habit⟧ will recharge the Wooden Nickel whenever Keeper is hit, allowing him to potentially sustain himself endlessly, as long as the Wooden Nickel pays out. Having ⟦i:156¦Habit⟧ and ⟦i:356¦Car Battery⟧ increases chances for infinite coins.
* Sacrifice rooms can be used much more with the Wooden Nickel, as the coins gained from it can be spent on them.
* ⟦i:116¦9 Volt⟧ can be used to farm charges infinitely in the room before the boss room or a trap room, as the doors will not automatically open after the normal amount of time. It is easiest if there are any immobile or passive enemies.
After beating ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧ with Keeper, he will start with ⟦t:83¦Store Key⟧, giving Keeper free access to Shops.
The following shop items are particularly useful for Keeper:
* ⟦i:248¦Hive Mind⟧: Enhances the many blue flies Keeper will naturally produce.
* ⟦i:227¦Piggy Bank⟧: Drops 0-1 coins with Keeper instead of 1-2, but still provides increased survivability.
** ⟨24⟩ In Co-Op, a player not using Keeper can take the Piggy Bank instead for its full benefit and thus supply Keeper with coins when necessary.
* ⟦i:439¦Mom's Box⟧: Can drop ⟦t:1¦Swallowed Penny⟧, and makes Swallowed Penny drop 2 coins instead of one, resulting in infinite money.
** ⟨24⟩ While this no longer results in infinite money, having a Swallowed Penny that's twice as effective will drastically increase survivability.
* Any Battery type items (see above)
* ⟦i:205¦Sharp Plug⟧ takes only one HP on use.

characters.notes:
* Apollyon's strength comes from turning bad items into base stats. This can heavily reduce the need for good luck throughout the run, as runs can be completed while collecting only a few items.
* Quest Items can be absorbed for extra stats.
** As such, Apollyon can go to ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧ II, as ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧ can be absorbed if ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ isn't the goal of the run.
** Using Void to absorb ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ and ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ will not permanently remove them from the run. They will continue to spawn after defeating ⟦e:uriel¦Uriel⟧ or ⟦e:gabriel¦Gabriel⟧ no matter how many times Apollyon uses Void on them, as long as he does not pick them up normally. This means that Apollyon can fight an angel in an angel room, then absorb both the Key Piece and an unwanted angel item at the same time.
* ⟦i:63¦The Battery⟧, ⟦i:205¦Sharp Plug⟧, and ⟦i:372¦Charged Baby⟧ allow ⟦i:477¦Void⟧ to be used twice consecutively without going into other rooms. This is helpful if the player wants to use ⟦i:477¦Void⟧ to fight the boss and then absorb the item after defeating it after all rooms have been cleared, or when a Devil Room / Angel Room spawns after defeating the boss and Apollyon does not have ⟦i:215¦Goat Head⟧ or ⟦i:499¦Eucharist⟧.
* Finding a Library can be very powerful as Apollyon can use ⟦i:477¦Void⟧ to gain numerous amounts of active effects from one room.
** However, it is not recommended to absorb a few books for the following reasons:
*** ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧ will instantly kill Apollyon if used while fighting ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧. However, taking it is fine as long as the player doesn't forget they have it or aren't fighting him.
*** ⟦i:282¦How to Jump⟧ causes a sudden movement, which can potentially throw Apollyon into an enemy or trap him behind rocks (the latter can be fixed by leaving the run and continuing).
*** ⟦i:292¦Satanic Bible⟧ replaces the boss item with a Devil Deal, which could be bad if low on health. Devil deals also cannot be absorbed until they've been paid for.
*** ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ is treated as a passive item if absorbed by Void. It's much better to take Book of Virtues and gain the passive wisp effect over a minor stat boost.
** It's also a good idea to touch at least three books if possible before using Void, to get the free transformation.
* Note that using Void to absorb items in Boss Rush or Challenge Rooms counts as taking the items and will cause waves of bosses or enemies to start spawning.
** ⟨24⟩ Absorbing passive items from a room with choice pedestals will count as absorbing only one of them.
* ⟨24⟩ Void can be used during the 'item get' animation to absorb the held item. This allows Apollyon to absorb undesirable devil and shop items, albeit by paying their cost first. It can also be used on items formerly unidentified due to the (Pausing is recommended right after picking up the item to properly check what it is before absorbing it or not).
* Defeating ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧ before the purchase of Afterbirth + will not unlock Apollyon

characters.notes:
* The Forgotten's bone club deals 3× his damage when swung and 1.5× his damage when thrown. The melee attack deals knockback to enemies (⟨24⟩ and occasionally The Forgotten himself) if it hits.
** Thus, just using melee is usually better. However, it is worth to alternate between melee and ranged attacks with some builds (such as with ⟦i:169¦Polyphemus⟧, ⟦i:153¦Mutant Spider⟧ or ⟦i:2¦The Inner Eye⟧) to maximize damage.
** ⟨24⟩ At 30.00 fire rate or above, the melee attack is automatically performed while holding shoot key; releasing shoot key makes him immediately throw his bone club (without the usual delay).
** ⟨24⟩ If The Forgotten's damage stat is lower than 3.5, the bone toss attack deals 1x his damage + 1.75 instead, which can be more helpful when he has low damage.
** A bone toss attack has the exact same property (base damage, triggering of tear effects, etc.) as the melee attack right before it.
** The Forgotten's bone club passes through walls, obstacles, and enemies. The thrown bone club can hit an enemy up to two times (once after throwing and once whilst returning).
* The Forgotten has some unique deal with the Devil mechanics:
** ⟨7⟩ The Forgotten cannot take deals with the Devil as he only has bone hearts, but The Soul can with its soul hearts.
*** ⟨24⟩ The Forgotten can take devil deals at the cost of Bone Hearts, equally to normal Red Hearts.
**** ⟨24⟩ As such, it is possible to softlock the game by taking a deal that would kill The Forgotten and switching to The Soul.
***** ⟨24⟩ It is possible to avoid this softlock with ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧, since the Soul won't be chained to the Forgotten.
** If a deal would deal lethal damage to The Soul, quickly switching to The Forgotten will keep him alive. This can even be done to take 3-heart deals for one soul heart.
*** If The Soul has no Hearts, switching to The Soul is disabled until another Soul or Black Heart is acquired.
** Losing red hearts inside bone heart containers does not count as red heart damage for devil deal chances, but breaking bone heart containers does. (⟨7⟩ This includes breaking them through self-damaging items, Curse Room usage, Sacrifice Rooms, Devil Beggars, Blood Donation Machines, etc.)
* The Forgotten's melee attack can collect pickups and open chests.
** Opening a Mimic Chest this way deals no damage.
** Bomb Chests cannot be opened this way. Locked Chests and Eternal Chests still require a Key or the ⟦t:19¦Paper Clip⟧ to open.
** Items that can be moved but cannot be picked up are pushed. This can launch Bombs ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧-style or knock Troll Bombs away.
* The Forgotten has +20% chance to replace a Soul Heart drop with a Bone Heart.
* The shot speed and tear falling speed stats have no effect on The Forgotten's melee attack or bone toss.
* The range stat increases how far away from The Forgotten the melee attack's arcs appear. It doesn't affect the bone toss.
** ⟨24⟩ Range of the bone toss is very slightly affected by range stat.
* The range of the melee attack scales with character size, but if character size is smaller than initial size, the melee attack range does not become smaller than initial.
* To switch between two pills/cards, press the swap key twice quickly.
* Picking up health upgrades as The Soul will convert them into soul hearts, just like ⟦c:bluebaby¦???⟧. It's generally advisable to pick up health as The Forgotten, since bone hearts are much rarer.
* Bone Hearts cannot be broken if filled with at least a Half Red Heart, even if a full heart of damage is taken. This can be abused to repeatedly pay a half-red heart to step on a spike in a Sacrifice Room, for example.
* ⟨7⟩ Unidentified pills are more safely consumed in Soul form, as a Hematemesis pill can be very detrimental for The Forgotten but has no negative effect when consumed as The Soul.
** ⟨7⟩ Health Down pills are converted to Health Up for both forms, but the empty bone heart gained may be risky for retaining Devil Room chances.
*** ⟨24⟩ Health Down pills aren't converted to Health Up anymore.
* ⟨24⟩ With ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧, the player can leave The Forgotten's body in a room and move to a different room with The Soul. When the player switches control back to The Forgotten, The Soul instantly teleports back to the other room where the body was left in.
** ⟨24⟩ This makes it possible to enter and leave Curse Rooms entirely without taking damage - leave the body outside of the Curse Room, go into the Curse Room as The Soul, then switch control to leave.
** ⟨24⟩ This behavior can possibly complicate things at the ⟦e:rotgut¦Rotgut⟧ fight if the body is brought inside Rotgut - after the player defeats the third phase of the boss as The Soul and is ejected back into the boss room, switching control back to The Forgotten will teleport the player back into the third phase of the fight, with that phase of the boss having respawned.
* ⟨24⟩ In Co-Op mode, if The Forgotten dies, their ghost baby will wield the bone club instead of firing tears.
* For the purpose of entering Challenge rooms such as Boss Challenge Rooms, the health of the Forgotten and The Soul are treated separately, bypassing the usual restrictions on these rooms in Repentance. This means that the player can lower the health of either The Forgotten or The Soul to a single heart to enter, and switch to the other once inside for a larger health pool.
* Broken hearts are added to the current form, and are kept there when switching.

characters.notes:
* Bethany's ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ starting item, combined with her unique soul and black heart usage, means that she is a character who sees significantly more Angel Deals than other characters.
* Since Bethany can't use soul and black hearts as a buffer, Angel and Devil Deals are much harder to get. This will usually mean beating floors without taking damage.
** Ways to allow Bethany to protect her devil deal chances include picking up an eternal, rotten, or bone heart.
** It's recommended to maintain a large amount of wisps from the Book of Virtues to keep up a barrier around Bethany, protecting her from taking damage (and thus losing out on a Deal).
* Devil Deals are riskier to take – reducing the red heart count leaves Bethany more vulnerable than other characters.
* An Angel Room will always spawn as Bethany's first deal room due to her starting item, the Book of Virtues.
** The item also means that Bethany will continue to have a chance to spawn more Angel Rooms even if she takes a Devil Deal later on.
* Even though ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ is Bethany's signature starting item, it is not intrinsic to her and can be removed via Dice Rooms, ⟦t:122¦Butter!⟧, or ⟦t:138¦'M⟧.
** However, this also means that Book of Virtues will not be removed when turned into a different character with items such as ⟦i:332¦Lazarus' Rags⟧ or ⟦i:161¦Ankh⟧.
* Bethany's intrinsic soul charge mechanic is, while almost always seen with ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧, entirely separate from it. In the rare event that the book is lost, she can still spend soul charges to use whatever applicable active item she has.
* As Bethany can only ever have red heart health, ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ will prove to be a more useful option overall for the +1 damage boost, if the final run target is not ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧.

characters.notes:
* Classic controls:
** Jacob's active item and pill/card are both bound to the Item button, while Esau's are bound to the Pill/Card button.
** Hold the Drop button to switch from using active items to using pills/cards.
* ⟨16⟩ "Better" controls:
** Items and pills/cards are bound to their normal buttons.
** Hold the Drop button to switch from using Jacob's item/card/pill to using Esau's item/card/pill.
* If one character passes through a door, both characters move to the next room. Curse Room door damage will only be applied to the character that moves through the door.
* With careful positioning, it is possible to take two items in rooms with multiple items that usually disappear upon collecting one (Ex: ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ & ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧). As a result, if the player can handle the increased difficulty from these optional chapter paths, Treasure Rooms in ⟦s:downpour¦Downpour⟧, ⟦s:mines¦Mines⟧, and ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ (including their alternative variants) have double their normal value.
* Changes to the speed stat are only half as effective, but the stat is shared between the two characters.
* When placing a bomb, both Jacob and Esau place one, but only one bomb will be consumed. This allows each bomb to cover double the area by positioning the characters in different locations. If they are aligned properly, this also allows Jacob & Esau to open barricaded doors with only one bomb.
* ⟨15⟩ When Jacob and Esau sleep in a bed, only the one who touched the bed will be healed.
* Jacob and Esau can carry 2 active items, trinkets and cards/pills naturally (one for each).
* Active items involved in Transformations count only for the character who touched the item first. This is most notable with books for the transformation: each character needs 3 different books. For example, if a Library is encountered, and there are 3 book active items, once Jacob picks up all 3 books, Esau can't get the transformation unless the pedestal is rerolled through ⟦i:105¦The D6⟧ or other similar pedestal rolling items.
* Transforming into a new character with items like ⟦i:482¦Clicker⟧ or ⟦i:311¦Judas' Shadow⟧ will grant both of Jacob and Esau's collected items to the new character. All of Esau's held cards/pills/trinkets are dropped on the ground. Esau's active item disappears.
* Dice rooms with 6 pips will reroll held items of both characters regardless of whoever triggered the room. Dice rooms with 1 pip will only reroll the items of the character that triggered the room.
* ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧/⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ and ⟦i:626¦Knife Piece 1⟧/⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧ will combine regardless of whether they are split up or carried by one character.
** This does not work with ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧/⟦i:551¦Broken Shovel 2⟧. ⟦i:552¦Mom's Shovel⟧ will only form if both pieces are held by the same character.
* Devil deals are variable for Jacob and Esau, as the prices may dynamically change based on either of them, which can make it so the other may not be able to take the deal, but can also allow the deals to be underpaid.
** Examples:
*** Jacob takes a deal that leaves him with no red hearts, the deals may change prices to accommodate for the lack of red hearts, so if the deal requires all soul hearts and Esau only has red heart containers, he will not be able to take the deal.
*** Contrarily, if one has 1 red heart container, he can pay for a 2 red heart deal with only 1 red heart, ⟨15⟩ or if one has 2+ red heart containers and half a soul heart he can pay for a 3 soul heart deal with only half a soul heart. The extra required hearts will not be removed from the other character.
**** ⟨16⟩ If the character doesn't have enough Soul Hearts, red containers will be removed at a rate of 1 container per missing soul heart. For example, if Esau only has 1 soul heart, he will pay 2 red containers in addition to the soul heart. This is likely a bug.
* Despite flying items like ⟦i:20¦Transcendence⟧ only affecting the one who picked it up, it's still very useful if you only focus on the brother that is NOT using it, as the flying one will never get caught on obstacles.
* For the purposes of Room Clear Awards, the room drop rate depends on the total luck the 2 characters have. Meaning at base stats, they effectively start with 0 Luck for this purpose.
* Resurrection items activate in a set order, regardless of who owns which item. If the two characters each own a copy of the same resurrection item, the game prioritizes removing Jacob's item.
* If either Jacob or Esau have familiars and the other has ⟦t:125¦Extension Cord⟧, electricity will also arc between both characters, and between familiars and the character that didn't pick them up.
* When entering the Mirrored World, only either Jacob or Esau need to be ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧ while the other can enter it with full health.
* The items that can be unlocked by getting certain endings as Jacob and Esau are very good for future runs (Ex: ⟦i:619¦Birthright⟧), so unlocking those items could be a priority as soon as Jacob and Esau are unlocked.
* Jacob & Esau inherently get an exploration boost in Daily Challenges since Esau is considered an extra player.
* The damage of a Blue Spider or a Blue Fly will depend on whichever brother made it spawn.
** For example, spawning a Blue Fly as Jacob by using ⟦i:434¦Jar of Flies⟧ while having 2.75 damage will make it deal 5.5 (2.75*2) damage.
** For ⟦i:248¦Hive Mind⟧, the damage boost will only apply to whichever brother has it in his own inventory.

weaknesses: Chacun a sa propre vie : protéger les deux est difficile
tips: Débloqués en battant ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ : la route alternative est nécessaire.
Placez Esau près des ennemis et gardez Jacob à distance.
