bosses.rewards:
7 random Coins (75% Chance)
or
⟦i:64¦Steam Sale⟧ (25% Chance)
bosses.behavior:
Greed wanders randomly around the room and performs one of two attacks:
* Fires a spread of 3 projectiles in the cardinal direction closest to Isaac.
* Spawns 2 Hoppers to his either side.
If hit by Greed, Isaac loses 2-4 coins and drops 1-3 Pennies on the floor.
Greed deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes:
* If any member of the Seven Deadly Sins is defeated on the current floor, then Greed and ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧ cannot spawn on that floor's shop.
** Therefore, exploring every room for a Mini-Boss Room and opening the Secret Room is the best way to minimize the odds of Greed appearing.
* Shops and Secret Rooms Greed is encountered in count as Mini-Boss Rooms, and cannot be bombed out of. They also prevent any other Mini-Boss Rooms from generating that floor.
* Once Greed is encountered in a Shop or Secret Room, ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧ replaces him in subsequent Shops and Secret Rooms. After Super Greed is encountered in the same manner, they cannot spawn in Shops or Secret Rooms for the rest of the run.
* Defeating Greed in a Secret Room causes all entrances to adjacent room entrances to be opened. ⟨15⟩ The exceptions are entrances to adjacent Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms- which will be barred and blocked off forever, unable to be opened by a bomb.
* If Isaac teleports out of the room after defeating Greed but without killing all the Hoppers he spawns, Isaac can re-fight Greed for extra coins or copies of Steam Sale.
* ⟨7⟩ Greed can drop ⟦i:64¦Steam Sale⟧ even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.
* ⟨30⟩ Greed spawned by blowing up a special shopkeeper can never spawn as Super Greed, even if another Greed was encountered before.
* ⟨24⟩ The exact spawn chances for Greed/Super Greed are as follows:
** Base chance 33.3%
** Having more than 20 coins entering the floor: +1.66%
** Destroyed the Donation Machine on the previous floor: +3.33%
** Destroyed a Shopkeeper in the previous floor: +0.66%
** Donated money to the Donation Machine in the previous floor: -1.66% per coin, up to a maximum of -8.33% for 5 coins
** These put the minimum and maximum chances at 25% and 39% respectively.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Gurdy is completely stationary and will always appear in the upper middle of the room. She has three attacks:
* Ducks down into her body and emerges from the middle facing Isaac, firing 5 projectiles in a spread.
** She can do this below her and to her sides and will not perform this attack if Isaac is behind her.
* Spawns a Pooter near herself.
* Spawns two Attack Flies behind her.
** Spawned Attack Flies are weaker than normal, with only about 3 health and can be killed if Isaac walks into them, though they will still deal contact damage before dying.
* Summons two Boils in front of her.
bosses.notes:
* Upon entering a room with Gurdy in it, the player will usually be teleported to the bottom center of the room regardless of which side the player entered from.
** This teleporting effect occurs when Gurdy spawns in a Boss Challenge Room as well.
* Gurdy will sometimes be accompanied by Attack Flies to the left and right of her and two Boils in the bottom corners of the room. She might also be accompanied by three Boils behind her.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
* Spawns a Pooter.
* Jumps and shoots a radial of 8 tears in all directions on landing.
* Charges towards Isaac at high speeds, sliding while bouncing off obstacles and walls, She gradually loses speed before coming to a full stop.
** Any Pooters caught in her charge will be killed.
** The course of her charge can be affected by Tear knockback
** If Gurdy Jr. charges into an active bomb, she is slowed down tremendously.
* When she has less than 50% health, she uses her charge attack continuously.
bosses.notes:
* Slowing Gurdy Jr. will, for the most part, render her charge attack useless.
* ⟨7⟩ Piercing tears lack knockback and cannot be used to divert or stop Gurdy Jr.'s charge attack.
* If Gurdy Jr. is feared/stunned during her charge attack after the effect wears off, she will immediately charge at Isaac.
* Gurdy Jr's charge attack has no telegraphing, making it very dangerous to stay close due to the lack of a warning.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Gurglings spawn as a pair and wander around the room. Each individual Gurgling has one attack in total which is performed independently of the other:
* Rushes towards the player when aligned in any cardinal direction, leaving behind damaging Red Creep until they have run into a wall.
** After rushing into a wall, they pause for a brief moment, and then spawn 0-2 Attack Flies.
** Their dash can be interrupted if they run into an Attack Fly.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Headless Horseman consists of two entities: The head and the body. Each performs attacks independently of the other.
The head has the following attacks:
* Shoots 3 projectiles in a spread at Isaac.
* Charges either left or right off-screen and reappears on the opposite end of the screen. He can charge either one, two or three times.
** He performs this attack more often if Isaac is to his left or right.
** This attack deals a full heart of damage.
The body has the following attack:
* Periodically shoots red ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧-like shots at Isaac, leaving a large puddle of damaging Red Creep on impact.
** This behavior is similar to ⟦e:pestilence¦Pestilence⟧'s second phase.
Both the head and the body deal a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes:
* In several normal rooms, Headless Horseman's head appears on his own without his body.
** Two or three of Headless Horseman's heads can be found in the same normal rooms.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Hornfel appears with his own specially designed boss room: each wall has multiple boss doors with minecart tracks connecting each pair of doors. After a short delay, he appears out of a random door riding a minecart and performs one of the following attacks:
* Occasionally, when Hornfel enters the room through a door, he is accompanied by 2 Fly Bombs.
* Throws 1-2 Bombs at Isaac. Each bomb has a small chance of having the ⟦i:256¦Hot Bombs⟧ or ⟦i:220¦Sad Bombs⟧ effect.
* Throws 3 ⟦i:646¦Brimstone Bombs⟧ that resemble mines. Each bomb has a delay and detonates after a few moments.
* Accelerates to a very high speed along one set of tracks, traveling in one direction, while frequently throwing out bombs. After multiple cycles, he slows down, gets sick, and vomits a fireball that releases fire trails in the cardinal directions upon landing.
* Sends out 1-2 decoy dummies with 4 HP on other tracks that burst into 6 Troll Bombs if killed or walked into.
* Other minecarts occasionally appear on other tracks independent of Hornfel, carrying a Fire Place, TNT, or a variety of other enemies:
:: Bony
:: Faceless
:: Danny
:: Gurgle
:: Quakey
Hornfel and his decoys deal a whole heart of contact damage.
Once Hornfel has taken enough damage, he falls out of his minecart and attempts to escape from the room via one of the doors surrounding the arena. He makes no attempt to attack Isaac, but he can still deal contact damage. In this phase, his contact damage is reduced to half a heart.
* Other minecarts carrying other monsters and objects can still appear as usual during this phase.
* If Hornfel escapes successfully, the fight ends as normal.
* If Hornfel is defeated, he unlocks ⟦i:646¦Brimstone Bombs⟧ if not already unlocked, and has a 1/7 chance of dropping either ⟦i:19¦Boom!⟧, ⟦i:646¦Brimstone Bombs⟧, ⟦i:256¦Hot Bombs⟧, ⟦i:137¦Remote Detonator⟧, or ⟦i:220¦Sad Bombs⟧ if it hasn't been seen or collected, otherwise he drops 3 Bombs.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.rewards:
Final Boss Chest (Ending 17, first kill only)
Gateway to ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧ / ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧
⟨28⟩ Entrance to ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧
bosses.behavior:
Hush begins with a fight identical to the first phase of the ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧ fight, having the same attacks and behavior but with a different appearance, half of ???'s health, and longer projectile travel distance due to being fought in a 2×2 room.
See ⟦e:bluebaby¦???⟧ for more details.
After Hush's first form is defeated, it reveals its large true form at the top of the room, taking the form of its splash screen portrait.
* During this phase, Hush occasionally sinks into the ground, becoming non-attacking and invulnerable, and only returning once most of the projectiles onscreen have dissipated. It performs this move every time it loses around 20% HP and also in conjunction with some of its later attacks.
Hush remains stationary in the top center of the room and performs the following attacks:
* Fires barrages of yellow, blue, and green glowing projectiles in certain patterns, combining 1-3 different patterns of projectiles. These patterns include:
** Rings of projectiles that alternate between rotating clockwise and counterclockwise as they move outwards.
** U-shaped salvos aimed at Isaac.
** Lines of projectiles aimed at Isaac that either gain (yellow), lose (blue), or maintain (green) momentum as they travel (these lines have spaces between them every 4-5 shots).
** 2-4 repeating volleys of 4 projectiles, with equal spacing between each volley (the angle these volleys are shot out at rotates as the attack continues).
The same pattern can be used multiple times in each barrage, and projectile patterns become less dense if multiple patterns are used in the same barrage.
Hush sinks into the ground and relocates to the center of the room before resuming its attacks. It also gains the following attack patterns, in addition to attacks from the previous phase:
* Hush's projectile barrage can include two new patterns:
** A very dense ring of projectiles, with a gap aimed somewhere towards Isaac's general direction.
** 3-5 spirals of projectiles, with even spacing between each spiral (projectiles from these spirals initially lose momentum, but after a few seconds they resume their normal speed while rotating counterclockwise as they move out).
* Spawns a cluster of Hush Flies that either orbit Hush, launch towards Isaac's position and fly off-screen, or actively chase Isaac. These flies have invincibility for a short time after being spawned, and alternate between forming the shapes of a circle, triangle, square, pentagon, or a 5 or 6-pointed star.
Hush keeps its attacks from previous phase and gains two more attacks and an extra shot pattern:
* Hush’s projectile barrage can now also include a very wide spread of projectiles that closes in on where Isaac was standing when fired.
* Hush spawns a horde of Blue Gapers, before sinking into the ground to relocate. While relocating, Hush can summon Blue Boils.
* Hush fires three rows of wavy ⟦i:369¦Continuum⟧ projectiles in one of the cardinal directions, which warp over to the other side of the screen and increase in speed the longer they travel. Hush performs this attack 2-5 times before using a different one. These projectiles move in a set pattern and leave safe zones that last the entire barrage.
Hush keeps its attacks from previous phases, gains an extra attack, and modifies its shot patterns:
* Hush sinks into the ground while firing its projectile barrages, moving in a random direction or chasing Isaac as it fires, and spawning Blue Boils as it moves. Only shot patterns from phase 2-1 can be used; the patterns added in phase 2-2 and 2-3 are lost.
* Hush creates three large red projectiles that move outward and split into 3 more projectiles multiple times. The split shots move quickly when they spawn but slow down before splitting again. Hush can start other attacks before the projectiles from this attack fully dissipate.
* ⟨8⟩ From this point onward, the cooldown between each of Hush's attacks is drastically reduced due to a bug.
Hush keeps most of its attacks from previous phases, but loses its ability to spawn Hush Flies. However, it gains one more attack in this phase:
* Hush fires two laser beams upward from its eyes, which creates beams on the ground that move toward Isaac and leave trails of slippery Blue Creep. The speed at which the beams move is based on Isaac's speed stat, and are always possible to outmaneuver. While firing these lasers, Hush also releases five wavy, slow-moving lines of projectiles in all directions.
* ⟨23⟩ When at <1% health, there is a greatly reduced delay between Hush's attacks.
* ⟨24⟩ If too much time passes without damaging Hush, it will regenerate some health. This removes the effectiveness of some very slow fight strategies (such as ⟦i:210¦Gnawed Leaf⟧ combined with less effective familiars) that would have been successful (if slow) in previous versions.
bosses.notes:
* Using ⟦p:chaos-card¦Chaos Card⟧ only kills one of its phases.
** ⟨7⟩ If it is thrown upwards during its first phase, it can kill both phases if timed correctly.
* Using the ⟦p:emergency-contact¦Emergency Contact⟧ on Hush's second form appears to lower its damage resistance by 50% for approximately 5 seconds.
* Upon defeating Hush, Isaac gains 2 charges for his active item.
* ⟦p:a-card-against-humanity¦A Card Against Humanity⟧ works in the Hush room. This can be done after the fight is completed to farm huge amounts of health and coins. Having ⟦i:424¦Sack Head⟧ or ⟦t:2¦Petrified Poop⟧ makes this strategy even more effective.
* ⟨4⟩ If Hush is killed for the first time and ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ is unlocked, Isaac can exit the room and come back in, and the entrance to The Void will appear without having to fight Hush again on a new run.
* Successfully using ⟦i:638¦Eraser⟧ on Hush's first form prevents his second from spawning.
bosses.strategy:
* Effects that cause long-lasting mass slowdown such as ⟦i:232¦Stop Watch⟧ or the I'm Drowsy pill are very valuable, aiding the player's ability to dodge the complex tear patterns and deal with the massive spawns of enemies, which can happen in quick succession.
** The ⟦i:337¦Broken Watch⟧ item can also cause a mass slow, but using it may not be a good idea since it also has a chance to speed up the entire room, making the fight extremely difficult.
** ⟦i:425¦Night Light⟧ or ⟦i:387¦Censer⟧ can apply tear slowdown on a smaller scale than the watch items, but their hard-to-control areas of effect may cause more confusion than benefit.
** ⟨24⟩ The I'm Drowsy pill should not be used against Hush. The laser beams summoned in the final phase move at a speed based on Isaac's own base speed, but the slowdown from I'm Drowsy is not accounted for. Using it during the Hush fight will make it impossible to outrun the lasers.
* Any items that can block or deflect projectiles will be highly useful, due to the bullet-hell design of the fight. Orbital familiars, ⟦i:423¦Circle of Protection⟧, ⟦i:335¦The Soul⟧, ⟦i:243¦Trinity Shield⟧, ⟦i:265¦Dry Baby⟧, ⟦i:404¦Farting Baby⟧, ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧, and ⟦i:242¦Infamy⟧ may greatly help mitigate damage.
** Dry Baby's ⟦i:35¦The Necronomicon⟧ effect will trigger very often due to the amount of projectiles, allowing to easily wipe out the large waves of enemies Hush can spawn.
** ⟦i:581¦Psy Fly⟧ is especially helpful, as it both deflects a large number of projectiles, and only has a small cooldown after deflecting multiple.
** ⟦i:595¦Saturnus⟧ may help with the large amount of bullets, but the tears in the ring at the start of the room may have fallen by the time Hush's shots reach you.
** ⟦i:606¦Ocular Rift⟧ can trivialize most of Hush's attacks as projectiles are pulled towards the rifts and away from Isaac. However, rifts can also disrupt the projectile patterns, making dodging significantly more difficult.
* ⟦i:213¦Lost Contact⟧ may be beneficial or detrimental depending on the player's tears stat; in combination with a high tears stat, many Lost Contact tears may still reach Hush even after blocking Hush's shots, but if the player has a low tears stat, they may find all their Lost Contact tears fired being destroyed during Hush's bullet hell attacks before they can reach their target.
** When the player has piercing tears, however, Lost Contact can cause dodging most attacks to become trivial regardless of the player's tears stat, as the player's tears will destroy any enemy projectiles they come into contact with while remaining themselves intact.
* ⟨7⟩ ⟦i:393¦Serpent's Kiss⟧, ⟦i:399¦Maw Of The Void⟧, ⟦i:408¦Athame⟧, or ⟦i:13¦The Virus⟧ (in combination with defensive items like ⟦p:algiz¦Algiz⟧ or ⟦i:58¦Book of Shadows⟧) will make Hush's summoned enemies occasionally drop black hearts, allowing the player to farm large quantities of health during the enemy-spawning attacks.
** ⟨24⟩ Serpent's Kiss only generates black hearts from contact damage. Maw Of The Void, Athame, and The Virus no longer generate black hearts at all.
* ⟦i:514¦Broken Modem⟧ is not recommended, as it will stop Hush's tears and close some escape routes, making it harder to dodge in some cases.
** ⟨24⟩ Tears affected by ⟦i:514¦Broken Modem⟧ will be deleted rather than frozen in place, making the fight much easier.
* ⟨28⟩ The combination of ⟦i:317¦Mysterious Liquid⟧ and ⟦i:533¦Trisagion⟧ can kill Hush extremely quickly by spawning massive amounts of creep under his large body.
* ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧'s ability to swap characters into The Soul is very helpful in the Hush fight. Since nearly all of Hush's attacks are projectile-based, The Soul can hide behind the skeletal body and deal damage while staying totally safe.
* ⟨24⟩ Magnetizing Hush using ⟦i:617¦Lodestone⟧ causes many of the slower bullets to not be able to go further than Hush's own hitbox, rendering the barrage ineffective.
* ⟦i:316¦Cursed Eye⟧ can greatly benefit ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧/⟦c:tainted-keeper¦Tainted Keeper⟧ if given the right items. They can fight Hush, and if they get damaged while charging, they teleport out of the fight and can go back to the shop area and bomb the Donation Machine to replenish health.
** ⟦t:43¦Cursed Skull⟧ also works for this.
*** ⟨24⟩The Donation Machine can only be bombed once, after which it is destroyed for the rest of the run.
* Hush' Blue Gapers spawning attack is useful for healing when playing as ⟦c:tainted-magdalene¦Tainted Magdalene⟧.

bosses.behavior:
Isaac lies on the ground in the middle of the room and does not begin attacking until he takes damage.
During all three of Isaac's phases, he continuously shoots multiple projectiles in the player's direction at fixed intervals when not performing other attacks. After taking enough damage, he begins to shoot double projectiles and triple projectiles.
Isaac remains stationary on the ground and performs the following attacks:
* Shoots 10 lines of projectiles in every direction.
* Shoots 8 groups of projectiles that curve back towards him.
* Shoots 8 groups of long-range spinning projectiles along with 10 slightly curved lines of shorter-range projectiles in every direction.
Isaac stands up but remains stationary and performs the following attack:
* Isaac alternates between two projectile patterns:
** Shoots 4 projectiles in a cross pattern, which splits into four short-ranged projectiles after a short time, similar to ⟦i:224¦Cricket's Body⟧.
** Shoots 8 projectiles in all directions.
Independently of his projectile attack:
* Summons Angelic Babies in a pair.
* Summons 2 ⟦i:160¦Crack the Sky⟧ beams at random locations.
Isaac grows a pair of angelic wings and is no longer stationary, moving towards where the player is predicted to go with short dashes. During which he also performs the following attacks:
* Teleports off-screen and summons ⟦i:160¦Crack the Sky⟧ beams to cover the screen, starting from one of the top corners to the opposite bottom corner. After teleporting back on-screen, he shoots the 10 lines of projectiles from the first phase. He always performs this attack at the start of this phase and repeats this process every time he takes 200 damage.
** ⟨24⟩ Shadows indicate ahead of time where the beams strike.
* Can perform all projectile patterns from the first phase.
bosses.notes:
* Every time Isaac is defeated, the current savefile's image changes until ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ is unlocked.
* Isaac does not begin attacking until he has been damaged. This can be exploited to make the fight much easier by dealing large amounts of damage in the first hit. Methods of doing this include saving up a large amount of tears with ⟦i:222¦Anti-Gravity⟧, waiting for ⟦i:440¦Kidney Stone⟧ to activate before shooting Isaac, or placing multiple bombs and detonating them all at once with ⟦i:137¦Remote Detonator⟧. ⟦i:352¦Glass Cannon⟧ can also provide a high-damage initial shot, but doing this is extremely risky due to Glass Cannon's additional effect of reducing health to one half-heart.
** ⟨24⟩Glass Cannon no longer reduces health on use, so it can be used against Isaac much more effectively.

bosses.behavior:
Krampus moves randomly around the room in cardinal directions and can perform the following attacks:
* Stops and fires ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers in all 4 cardinal ⟨28⟩ or diagonal directions.
** ⟨30⟩ The lasers can sometimes rotate 90 degrees in either direction after being shot.
*** ⟨28⟩ Krampus signals rotating ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers by growling and quickly dashing towards Isaac before performing this attack.
* Fires 3 projectiles in a spread followed by 4 projectiles in a spread in succession towards Isaac.
Krampus deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes:
* Encountering Krampus replaces both the statue of ⟦e:satan¦Satan⟧ as well as any deals in regular Devil Rooms.
* Krampus can drop ⟦i:132¦A Lump of Coal⟧ even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. However, he can only drop ⟦i:293¦Head of Krampus⟧ once, and any other kills will only drop copies of ⟦i:132¦A Lump of Coal⟧.
* ⟨30⟩ Krampus can spawn in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greed Mode⟧ without needing to be unlocked.
** Defeating Krampus when encountered here still unlocks ⟦i:293¦Head of Krampus⟧ even if Krampus himself has not yet been unlocked.
* ⟦i:402¦Chaos⟧ will not change the items dropped from Krampus.
* ⟨24⟩ Krampus can never appear in the first Devil Room entered on a run.

bosses.behavior:
The number of individual Larry Jr. bodies that can spawn each fight can vary from 1-4. The most common encounter with Larry Jr. is with 2 bodies.
* Randomly moves around the room in the cardinal directions, turning when colliding with walls or obstacles.
** Larry Jr. can change direction if one of his segments is destroyed.
* Randomly spawns Poop while moving.
** Colliding with a Poop destroys the Poop and causes Larry Jr. to turn.
* Larry Jr. segments can be split into smaller copies of the boss as long as the new Larry Jr. segments are longer than 2 pieces.
There is a chance that a Grub can spawn alongside a shorter Larry Jr. (basically replacing a second Larry Jr.) due to its patterns being very similar to the boss.
bosses.notes:
* ⟨7⟩Poop spawned by Larry Jr. will never drop pickups, even when in possession of ⟦t:2¦Petrified Poop⟧.
** ⟨24⟩Poops spawned by Larry Jr. have an incredibly low chance to spawn pickups. This chance is not affected by Petrified Poop.
** Leaving the room and returning will make the poop generate pickups normally.
* ⟨7⟩ The ⟦i:386¦D12⟧ doesn't reroll Larry Jr.'s poop.
* Destroying Larry Jr.'s poop with ⟦t:90¦Brown Cap⟧ will cause it to explode.
* Piercing tears make fighting Larry Jr. much easier, as each tear can damage multiple segments.

bosses.behavior:
Lil Blub diagonally floats around the room and performs the following attacks:
* Spits up 2-3 Small Leeches that swarm around him, blocking shots.
* Spits out a single larger Small Leech that chases Isaac instead.
* Fires 6 streams of projectiles outwards in a radial burst. These projectiles deal a full heart of damage.
* Jumps once towards Isaac, creating a burst of disorganized arcing projectiles upon landing.
** Lil Blub can only use this attack when below a certain threshold of HP.
The previous two attacks also cause any Small Leeches that are swarming around Lil Blub to start chasing Isaac. Lil Blub cannot use any of these attacks if there are 6 or more Small Leeches in the room.
* Jumps towards Isaac 3-5 times, firing projectiles in the cardinal and diagonal directions upon landing. The cardinal shots are faster and travel further than the diagonal ones.
** Any leeches Lil Blub lands on are instantly killed.
** Lil Blub can only use this attack when below 25% HP, and greatly prefers using it if he can.
Upon death, he spawns 2-4 Small Leeches and bursts into a fountain of projectiles that rain down for a few seconds in a wide area.

bosses.behavior:
Little Horn constantly tries to evade Isaac by moving away from him while performing the following attacks:
* Creates and jumps into a Pitfall and pops up elsewhere.
* Creates 3 to 5 Teleport Pitfalls that move outwards.
* Creates a regular Pitfall under himself that lasts for several seconds.
* Throws a Troll Bomb or a Mega Troll Bomb into a created Pitfall underneath himself. The bomb then pops up near Isaac's position.
* Jumps into a Pitfall and appears elsewhere while leaving a Troll Bomb in his place; repeats this process 3-5 times.
* Spawns a Dark Ball.
⟨24⟩ Little Horn takes reduced damage (25 instead of 100) from his own bombs. Bombs from other sources still do full damage.
bosses.notes:
* The ⟦i:210¦Gnawed Leaf⟧ can make the battle easier, as Little Horn will damage himself with his bombs over time. Isaac can still fall into the pits and be transported around the screen, and will appear to suffer damage, but no actual loss of HP will occur if he is in statue form when he falls in.
* The Dark Balls that Little Horn spawns can appear in Closets in the ⟦s:caves¦Caves⟧ and the ⟦s:flooded-caves¦Flooded Caves⟧. They also appear in a room with Little Horn in the ⟦s:chest¦Chest⟧.
* If Isaac has the ⟦t:63¦Safety Scissors⟧, he can acquire maximum bombs from the fight at fairly little risk since the bombs Little Horn spawns will turn into bomb pickups and all his hole attacks are easy to dodge.
* Little Horn's Dark Ball is considered a monster. Killing it will activate items such as ⟦i:62¦Charm of the Vampire⟧, ⟦i:234¦Infestation 2⟧, and ⟦i:434¦Jar of Flies⟧.
* Occasionally, a Pitfall that Little Horn summons will not vanish after defeating the boss. The Pitfall is still active and can damage Isaac, even if it does not actively chase the player.

bosses.behavior:
Loki teleports to random locations in the room away from Isaac and has the following attacks:
* Shoots 4 projectiles in the four cardinal directions, followed by the four diagonal directions, and then the cardinal directions once again.
* Spawns a Boom Fly on top of himself. A maximum of 4 Boom Flies can be alive at once.
* Shoots 8 projectiles in all directions.
Loki deals a whole heart of contact damage.
A Poky can accompany Loki during the fight, dealing contact damage and blocking Isaac's tears.
⟨24⟩ Loki can also be accompanied by 4 Stone Grimaces in the corners of the room.
bosses.notes: * Using the ⟦i:631¦Meat Cleaver⟧ on Loki has a unique interaction, splitting him into ⟦e:lokii¦Lokii⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The fight against Lokii resembles fighting two individual ⟦e:loki¦Loki⟧s. Each half of Lokii teleports to random locations in the room and has the same attacks which they perform independently of each other:
* Shoots 4 projectiles in the four cardinal directions, followed by the four diagonal directions, and then the cardinal directions once again.
* Spawns a Red Boom Fly on top of himself. Only 1 Red Boom Fly can be alive at once.
* Shoots 8 projectiles in all directions.
Lokii deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes: * Using the ⟦i:631¦Meat Cleaver⟧ on Loki has a unique interaction, splitting him into Lokii.

Lust deals a whole heart of contact damage.

bosses.behavior:
Mama Gurdy resides inside the wall at the top of the room. She has four attacks:
* Creates temporary spikes in the boss room in random locations.
** These spikes can spawn under Isaac but have a small delay before they can deal damage.
* Spews a volley of large orange projectiles towards the bottom of the room, leaving slowing Orange Creep.
* Shoots 3, 4, or 7 waves of 5 spread projectiles at Isaac's location.
* Shoots a burst of disorganized projectiles at Isaac.
* Occasionally retreats upwards off-screen before executing her spike attack. Performs her orange projectile attack immediately upon re-entering the screen.
Mama Gurdy deals a whole heart of contact damage.

bosses.behavior:
In the first phase, the two constituent parts act exactly like a regular-sized Mask + Heart; the Heart of Infamy tries to move away from Isaac while the Mask of Infamy charges at him if he crosses her path in any cardinal direction.
* During this phase, the mask cannot be hurt or otherwise affected by virtually any item. When the heart takes damage of any kind, the mask attempts to chase Isaac with increased speed, interrupting her current movement.
* The heart shoots 8 bullets in all directions if Isaac gets too close to it.
* Once the heart is dead, Mask of Infamy begins the second phase. A crack appears in the back of the Mask and can be shot at to deal damage to her. Its behavior remains mostly identical but with increased speed.
** When damaged, she may interrupt her current movement and redirect at Isaac aggressively, but less often than when the heart was being attacked in the first phase.
bosses.notes: * Even though they appear to float, both the mask and the heart can be damaged by Creep and spikes.

bosses.behavior:
* Leaps off-screen and tries to land on Isaac's position, leaving a large puddle of Red Creep upon landing.
* Slides briefly towards Isaac and performs a short-range jump, also leaving Red Creep when he lands.
* Inhales, drawing in Isaac and any monsters towards him, before then vomiting upwards, unleashing a barrage of projectiles into the air. The projectiles will rain down for a short duration, following Isaac's movements.
* Farts, which can damage Isaac if he's too close, and will either:
** Summon 1-3 Dips.
** Unleash a cluster of either small or big projectiles behind him, similar to ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧.
bosses.notes: * ⟦i:213¦Lost Contact⟧ will still block all incoming projectiles from his barrage, even if they happen to go high enough to be offscreen.

bosses.behavior:
Mega Maw is stationary and will perform the following attacks:
* Fires red projectiles at Isaac in disorganized bursts, similar to ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧.
* Releases 2 rings of 5 flames which expand outwards and rotate in opposite directions.
* Releases one large ring of 9 flames that expands outwards.
* Releases one large ring of 9 flames that can rotate in either direction while expanding outwards.
* Gradually spits out a Hopper directly below it.

bosses.behavior:
Passing through the Golden Gate and stepping onto the pentagram initiates the Mega Satan fight.
Mega Satan is accompanied by two hands, which serve as a barrier to protect him and an avenue for him to attack. His hands spread apart if Isaac gets close to him, and move together if Isaac moves away from him. Each hand has 600 HP, and destroying a hand deals 100 damage to Mega Satan. Each hand respawns 30 seconds after it’s destroyed.
Mega Satan has the following attacks:
* Closes his eyes and then fires one of several projectile patterns, including:
** 3-5 lines of blood projectiles. The angle these shots are fired at alternates between rotating clockwise and counterclockwise. The less lines of projectiles there are, the faster they travel and rotate.
** Spreads of brown projectiles that split into 4 smaller projectiles after traveling far enough, similarly to ⟦i:224¦Cricket's Body⟧.
** 2 spirals of blood projectiles that very rapidly rotate clockwise, creating semi-circular waves of projectiles.
** Rings of blood projectiles, fired in rapid bursts of 3.
** 2 spirals of blood projectiles that rotate clockwise at different speeds.
** 3 lines of blood projectiles that alternate between slowly curving right and left with every shot fired. The angle these lines of projectiles are fired out at alternates between slightly rotating clockwise and counterclockwise.
* Closes his eyes and then fires a ⟦i:441¦Mega Blast⟧ laser straight down. His hands always fully spread apart while charging the laser, regardless of Isaac's position.
** The growl that telegraphs this attack is louder than usual, distinguishing it from his other attacks.
* Slams his head into the platforms 1-3 times, creating chaotic bursts of projectiles in all directions.
* Holds up one hand, then slams it at Isaac, creating a circular rock wave on impact. This attack can’t be used if both hands are currently destroyed.
* Slams both hands 3 times, alternating back and forth, creating rock waves that move towards the bottom of the screen. This attack can’t be used if either hand is currently destroyed.
** Destroying a hand during this attack prevents it from creating more rock waves.
* Mega Satan also spawns sets of mini-bosses to attack Isaac alongside him. These sets can be:
** ⟦e:gluttony¦Gluttony⟧ and ⟦e:envy¦Envy⟧
** ⟦e:sloth¦Sloth⟧ and ⟦e:pride¦Pride⟧
** ⟦e:wrath¦Wrath⟧ and ⟦e:greed¦Greed⟧
** ⟦e:lust¦Lust⟧
** ⟦e:the-hollow¦The Hollow⟧
*** These mini-bosses can be damaged by Mega Satan’s attacks. His laser deals 36 damage per tick, while all others deal 10 damage per hit.
* After taking enough damage, Mega Satan and his hands withdraw into the darkness behind him and become invulnerable. During this time, he spawns a wave of bosses or mini-bosses, which must be killed in order to make Mega Satan vulnerable again. The first waves of bosses begins after Mega Satan takes 750 damage, the second after 1,500 damage, and the third after 2,250 damage. He will withdraw but not spawn these waves if there are any remaining previously spawned bosses left. Only when the room is cleared does he spawn the following:
** Wave 1.1: ⟦e:famine¦Famine⟧ and ⟦e:pestilence¦Pestilence⟧
** Wave 1.2: ⟦e:war¦War⟧ and ⟦e:death¦Death⟧
*** There is a chance for all Horsemen to appear as their champion forms.
** Wave 2.1: ⟦e:super-envy¦Super Envy⟧
** Wave 2.2: ⟦e:super-lust¦Super Lust⟧ and ⟦e:super-wrath¦Super Wrath⟧
** Wave 2.3: ⟦e:super-sloth¦Super Sloth⟧, ⟦e:super-gluttony¦Super Gluttony⟧, ⟦e:super-pride¦Super Pride⟧, and ⟦e:super-greed¦Super Greed⟧
** Wave 3.1: ⟦e:gabriel¦Fallen Uriel⟧
** Wave 3.2: ⟦e:gabriel¦Fallen Gabriel⟧
After taking 3,000 damage, Mega Satan sinks into the darkness and rises in his final phase as a skull. He no longer has his hands, nor does he spawn bosses; instead, he fires complex projectile patterns. Possible patterns include the ones from the first phase (with increased shot speed), plus:
* 2 spirals of projectiles that slowly rotate counterclockwise. The shots zig-zag as they travel outward.
* 2 lines of projectiles that alternate between curving left and right. These lines combine to create curving lines with a safe space that moves from the left of the arena to the right.
* Rings of projectiles, with every other wave fluctuating in speed as it travels.
* Many lines of projectiles that slowly curve to the left (if black) and right (if red); these lines create safe spaces to maneuver in that slowly shift to the right.
* Several lines of projectiles that slowly wiggle as they travel, similarly to ⟦t:10¦Wiggle Worm⟧. The angle these shots are fired at either rotates clockwise or alternates between rotating clockwise and counterclockwise.
* Many lines of projectiles that wiggle as they travel and slowly curve to the left (if black) and right (if red); these lines create unmoving safe spaces between them.
* Many lines of projectiles that spin as they travel, similarly to ⟦t:11¦Ring Worm⟧. The angle these shots are fired at constantly randomizes.
** These projectiles don’t travel far enough to reach the corners of the arena if Mega Satan isn’t close to that corner.
* Dense rings of projectiles that wiggle as they travel.
* Several lines of projectiles that make large zig-zags as they travel.
* Six lines of projectiles, half of which slowly curve to the left (if black) and right (if red). These lines create safe spaces that slowly move towards Mega Satan.
* Rings of projectiles that rotate clockwise (if red) and counterclockwise (if black) simultaneously.
* Several lines of projectiles that continuously converge onto each other.
** The projectiles used in these patterns can be colored black, red, brown, or silver, depending on which one is used. For some attacks, they instead appear as red or yellow fire.
As Mega Satan takes damage during this phase, his skull begins to crack before eventually shattering. After this final phase is defeated, the game ends and Ending 16 plays.
* ⟨28⟩ If ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ is unlocked, there is a 50% chance that the game does not immediately end, and Mega Satan instead drops an ending chest along with a portal. Entering the chest ends the game and plays the cutscene, while entering the portal takes Isaac to ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧.
bosses.notes:
* ⟨30⟩ Afterbirth added Completion Marks for defeating Mega Satan. There are no direct achievements needed for beating Mega Satan in Rebirth aside from unlocking Ending 16.
* Mega Satan does not have a health bar, making it difficult to determine how close he is to death. The other bosses that have no health bar are ⟦e:mother¦Mother⟧ and ⟦e:the-beast¦The Beast⟧.
* Mega Satan is behind an invisible wall Isaac can't move past, making it impossible to inflict contact damage effects like ⟦i:202¦Midas' Touch⟧ and ⟦i:13¦The Virus⟧ to him, unless Isaac has an item allowing him to dash into Mega Satan's head (⟦i:130¦A Pony⟧, ⟦i:593¦Mars⟧).
* Using ⟦p:chaos-card¦Chaos Card⟧ on the first phase causes Mega Satan to go into his second phase instead of instantly killing him.
** This is because the first and second phase of the fight are actually two different enemies, and are shown as such in the bestiary.
* Mega Satan's hands count toward the mob cap total in the room, and prevent Greed, Sloth, and Fallen Gabriel from spawning enemies while they are undestroyed.
* With homing tears and ⟦i:329¦The Ludovico Technique⟧, the tear will be strongly attracted by the head even when it can't be targeted, making killing other enemies very hard.
* Unlocking the Golden Gate with the golden key and then restarting the floor with ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧ or an I AM ERROR room will not cause the golden key to respawn and the Golden Gate will be closed again.
** ⟨16⟩ The Golden Gate will stay open after using ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧.
* ⟨24⟩ Defeating Mega Satan will not revive dead co-op players if the portal to The Void appears.

bosses.behavior:
Min-Min floats slowly towards Isaac and performs the following attacks:
* Spits a Willo at Isaac which fires a projectile at him before returning to orbit around Min-Min. Min-Min can have a maximum of 4 orbiting her. Willos do not deal contact damage.
** This can be done multiple times in quick succession until the limit of 4 Willos has been reached.
** Willos orbiting Min-Min occasionally fire a projectile towards Isaac.
* Once Min-Min has 4 orbiting Willos, she periodically causes them to fire 3 projectiles outwards. If any Willos are killed during this attack the remaining ones perform this attack uninterrupted.
In this phase, Min-Min burns away the husk surrounding her, and can now have a maximum of 7 Willos orbiting her. She will continue to float slowly towards Isaac and has new attacks:
* Min-Min spawns up to 4 Willos around herself and then causes all orbiting Willos to fire 3 projectiles outwards.
** Willos orbiting Min-Min still occasionally fire a projectile towards Isaac.
* Spits a Willo at Isaac which fires a projectile at him before returning to orbit around Min-Min.
* Causes the current orbiting Willos to fire 3 projectiles outwards.
* Sends her orbiting ring of Willos to chase Isaac. After a few seconds, they return.
* Disappears and creates several groups of lights on the ground. One group at a time, Willos appear from the lights, fire at Isaac, and disappear.
Upon Min-Min's defeat, all spawned Willos die alongside her.

bosses.behavior:
Mom appears in a unique boss room that has a boss door in the center of all sides of the room. Mom can use these doorways to perform various attacks:
* Stomps on Isaac's position, damaging nearby enemies and destroying obstacles. This attack is telegraphed by a growing shadow and her grunting.
** She always begins the fight by stomping in the center of the room.
** ⟨7⟩ Stomping is considered as explosion damage.
*** ⟨24⟩ Stomping is now considered as contact damage in Repentance.
** The foot itself does no contact damage.
*** ⟨24⟩ Changed to deal contact damage in Repentance.
* If Isaac is near a door, Mom reaches out from it with her hand, dealing contact damage.
* Sticks out a piece of flesh from a door and spawns a Monster with a maximum of 3 alive at once:
:: Gusher
:: Frowning Gaper
:: Globin
:: Attack Fly
:: Pooter
:: Mulligan
:: Maggot
:: Charger
:: Horf
:: Maw
:: Red Maw
:: Clotty
* Sticks an eye out of a door, which does not attack but can deal contact damage.
* All enemies spawned by Mom die alongside her, except for Globins, which collapse into piles of goo.
Mom deals one heart of contact damage.
Upon defeating Mom, all boss doors in the arena will disappear, trapping Isaac in the room unless he has a collectible or pickup effect that can teleport him out.
bosses.notes:
* Defeating Mom for the first time changes the current savefile's image and will allow unlocks to be obtained with mods enabled.
* The 'Stats' section of the menu keeps a tally of "Mom kills". However, this refers to how many times you've defeated Mom completely, as in, how many times you've killed ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧, not just Mom.
* Using ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧ or ⟦p:xv-the-devil-reversed¦XV - The Devil?⟧ during the Mom boss fight kills her instantly and unlocks ⟦i:101¦The Halo⟧.
* Using ⟦p:ii-the-high-priestess¦II - The High Priestess⟧ during the fight with Mom results in Isaac being targeted instead of the enemy with the highest health. However, the stomp can still damage Mom.
* ⟨7⟩ Mom's stomp attack counts as a bomb; this means Isaac can be immune to it with ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ or ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧.
** ⟨7⟩ With ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧, Isaac can be healed when stomped.
** ⟨7⟩ Red Champion Mom is greatly negated with ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ or ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧.
** ⟨24⟩ Mom's stomp attack now deals contact damage, causing immunity to explosions to no longer avoid damage from the stomp.
* ⟦i:327¦The Polaroid⟧ will always spawn on the left pedestal and ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ is always on the right.

bosses.behavior:
At the beginning of the fight, Mom's Heart is always accompanied by 2 Eyes. After a while, Mom's Heart retreats upwards, becoming invulnerable and launching four diagonal lines of red projectiles in a spread that slowly rotates clockwise. When each original Eye is killed, another one spawns in its place near the top of the arena.
* At any point during this sequence, if Mom's Heart's HP is brought below the threshold for her second phase, she will spawn Lumps instead of Eyes.
After the second set of Eyes have been killed, Mom's Heart alternates between two attacks:
* Lowers itself and shoots red projectiles in different patterns:
** 10 projectiles in all directions that expand outwards either continuously or in a pulsating manner.
** 2 streams of projectiles that spiral outwards.
** 2 rings of ten projectiles that pulsate outwards at different intervals.
** 8 slightly curved lines of projectiles that rotate and expand outwards slowly.
* After performing one of these projectile patterns for long enough, Mom's Heart retreats upwards again, shooting the same four slow-moving lines of projectiles, and spawns a number enemies of a singular type:
** 3 Flesh Mobile Hosts
** 3 Globins
** 2 Eyes
*** The type of monsters spawned in each wave is determined always follows the above order.
*** In the same manner as the original Eyes, a copy of each individual monster spawns again following the defeat of the original one.
* After all enemies have been defeated, Mom's Heart lowers itself and repeats the entire process.
After reaching 60% HP, Mom's Heart beats slightly faster and continues the same behavior, but includes new projectile patterns and replaces the types of monsters it spawns.
* Its projectile patterns now include:
** A single line of projectiles that follows Isaac.
** 5 lines of projectiles that mimic Isaac's movements (these lines have no space between projectiles).
** 3 pulsating curved lines of projectiles that rotate and expand outwards. This pattern can occasionally change direction of rotation.
* Its spawned monsters are now:
** 3 Lumps
** 2 Swingers
** 3 Globins
After reaching 30% HP, Mom's Heart beats much faster and no longer retreats upwards and instead performs projectile attacks and spawns enemies simultaneously. However, after finishing each projectile pattern, if there are any monsters alive, it will not perform another pattern until they are killed. In addition, a second wave of monsters no longer spawns after the first is killed.
* It gains one new projectile pattern:
** 4 curved lines of projectiles that continuously rotate and expand outwards.
* It loses the projectile patterns from the first phase except for the following 2:
** 2 streams of projectiles that spiral outwards.
** 8 slightly curved lines of projectiles that rotate and expand outwards slowly.
* Its spawned monsters are now:
** 4 Walking Boils
** 4 Tumors
** 4 Hearts
After reaching 20% HP, Mom's Heart stops its previous attacks and shoots four diagonal ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers that rotate either clockwise or counter-clockwise for a duration before stopping for a moment and then repeating the attack.
* The direction the lasers rotate depends on which is closest to Isaac when they are fired. The closer laser will rotate after Isaac and the rest will follow.
* The duration the beams rotate can be: 1 rotation, 1 and a half rotations, or 2 whole rotations.
* Upon defeat, Mom's Heart fires out a ring of 14 projectiles.
All of Mom's Heart's projectiles deal a whole heart of damage. The heart itself does not deal contact damage.
As most of Mom's Heart's projectile attacks are synced with the rhythm of the heart's beating, as the fight progresses, the speed of each projectile attack increases.
All of Mom's Heart's projectile attacks can hurt and kill spawned monsters.
bosses.notes:
* Every time Mom's Heart is defeated changes the current savefile's image until It Lives! is unlocked.
* Until It Lives! is unlocked, Mom's Heart cannot be continued past unless a Devil Room or an Angel Room appears, which allows access to ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧ or the ⟦s:cathedral¦Cathedral⟧, respectively.
* Just like Mom, using ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧ or ⟦p:xv-the-devil-reversed¦XV - The Devil?⟧ against Mom's Heart will kill it instantly.
* If ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧ or a 5 pip Dice Room is used on ⟦s:womb¦Womb⟧ II / ⟦s:utero¦Utero⟧ II / ⟦s:scarred-womb¦Scarred Womb⟧ II after defeating ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧, and Mom's Heart is again defeated on the regenerated floor, it will count as having defeated Mom's Heart 2 separate times, therefore unlocking 2 consequent endings.
* ⟨24⟩ Erasing ⟦s:mausoleum¦Mausoleum⟧ / ⟦s:gehenna¦Gehenna⟧ Mom's Heart with the ⟦i:638¦Eraser⟧ will not open the passage to ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧.

bosses.behavior:
Upon entering the boss room in ⟦s:corpse¦Corpse⟧ II, the room is empty except for a hole in its center. Walking into it drops Isaac down into the arena where Mother is fought.
Mother begins the fight attached to the top of the room and is stationary, similar to ⟦e:mega-satan¦Mega Satan⟧. Her face and hands can all be attacked to deal damage to her, and she uses them separately in her attacks:
* One of Mother's hands grabs a knife and throws it directly downwards. The knife emits projectiles horizontally while travelling and a burst of many projectile lines in a radius upon impacting the back wall. This attack has two variations in terms of the projectiles' paths.
* One of Mother's arms releases trails of projectiles that move across the arena in a wave pattern, eventually homing in on Isaac.
* One of Mother's hands slams the ground, releasing streams of projectiles in a radius and spawning Small Maggots.
** Small Maggots that land on top of Mother's hitbox do not spawn.
* Occasionally, Mother spits out a unique ⟦e:fistula¦Fistula⟧ at Isaac that bounces off walls. Mother swipes the Fistula towards Isaac whenever it travels close to one of her hands and releases 6 lines of 2 projectiles when it collides with the bottom wall. Mother repeats this several times, causing the Fistula to gradually gain speed, before slamming a hand down on the mass, crushing it and sending 3 medium Fistulas outwards. Each medium Fistula flies until it collides with a wall, sending out 2-3 small Fistulas and being destroyed in the process. These small Fistulas travel a short distance before bursting and spawning a Small Maggot.
** This Fistula can be reflected back towards Mother through the use of a variety of melee-based attacks, each reflect causing the Fistula to glow brighter. Successfully reflecting the Fistula 6 times will cause it to be destroyed upon contact with Mother, dealing damage to and briefly stunning her. It will also burst into 8 medium Fistulas in a radius that disappear quickly, six of which deal damage to Mother; each of these can also deal damage to Isaac. Abilities that can cause this interaction include:
*** ⟦i:579¦Spirit Sword⟧'s spin attack.
*** ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧/⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧/⟦p:soul-of-the-forgotten¦Soul of the Forgotten⟧'s bone swing.
*** ⟦c:tainted-samson¦Tainted Samson⟧/⟦p:soul-of-samson¦Soul of Samson⟧/⟦i:704¦Berserk!⟧'s donkey jawbone swing.
*** ⟦i:710¦Bag of Crafting⟧'s swipe.
*** ⟦c:tainted-magdalene¦Tainted Magdalene⟧'s hug attack, though it cannot be triggered by the Fistula.
* Occasionally, Mother retreats upwards, becoming invulnerable, and summons a horde of 34 Dead Isaacs at the bottom of the arena that walk up towards Mother. If any are left alive to reach Mother, she swipes with a hand, killing any that are caught in the swipe, releasing a tiny burst of red projectiles, and launching their corpses towards Isaac. After a while, she ends this attack by slamming down both hands, which causes a small rock wave to appear beneath any remaining Dead Isaacs, killing them, and launching their corpses up into the air.
After losing 2222 HP, Mother retracts her head and arms into her body before releasing a green ⟦i:441¦Mega Blast⟧ laser down the middle of the arena, destroying the lower wall and expanding the area of the room to be 1x2. She then separates from the top wall, launching her head into the center of the room. From this point on, she slides slowly towards Isaac when she isn't performing one of her attacks:
* Spins around in place, shooting out strings of wavy projectiles in all directions.
* Inhales and draws Isaac to her as projectiles appear behind Isaac as he moves. After that, she shoots a massive ball of projectiles towards Isaac that splits into many smaller clusters when hitting a wall, which each then send out lines of projectiles when they collide with a wall or Mother.
* Leaps upwards off-screen before charging vertically across the half of the room which Isaac is located within, then across the other half in the opposite direction. The half she charges across first is telegraphed by a splat at the top or bottom of the room. After this, she slams down in the middle of the room, sending rock waves and small strings of projectiles in all directions.
* Faint white lines appear at set intervals along a random arena wall before a line of projectiles quickly shoots out of the wall along each line; these projectiles hover for a moment before dropping. One line of projectiles is always lined up with Isaac's position. This attack is repeated five times and follows a pattern: vertical lines, then horizontal, vertical, horizontal, horizontal (or vice versa).
bosses.notes:
* ⟨15⟩ Using ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧ will kill Mother in time if you have an extra life. Even though Isaac dies well before the animation is complete, the game over screen will pop up almost immediately after the animation ends. If Isaac has an extra life item that revives him outside the room, he will be able to enter the Final Boss Chest without fighting Mother again.
** ⟨15⟩ Killing Mother in this way will not reward the completion mark for the current character if they don't have an extra life.
** ⟨15⟩ Killing Mother in this way will not work for ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ (if used as The Soul), and ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ if the revival transports them to the previous room since their death animations are shorter than those of normal characters.
* ⟨16⟩ Using ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧ in Mother's room will now kill Isaac in 11.5 seconds, which is enough time to let Mother's death animation finish and reward the completion mark for the current character before Isaac's Last Will pops up.
* ⟦i:618¦Rotten Tomato⟧ or any items that inflict Charm can cause Mother's wavy projectiles during the first phase and second phase to target herself.
* The ball of splitting projectiles in Mother's second phase can also collide with Mother. The player can therefore move to the opposite side of Mother after she fires to more easily dodge the attack.
* Unlike most other bosses, Mother has no visible health bar in either of her phases, so it is impossible to tell how much damage you are dealing to her without ⟦i:403¦Spider Mod⟧.
* ⟦i:709¦Suplex!⟧ works on Mother, but in Mother's first phase, Isaac can pick up only one of her parts at a time, either her head or one of her arms, and give it a suplex.
* ⟦p:ii-the-high-priestess¦II - The High Priestess⟧ will damage Mother even though it can be considered another form of ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧.
* Using ⟦i:512¦Black Hole⟧ will not stop Mother's wavy projectiles from proceeding once the black hole has diminished.
bosses.strategy:
* ⟦p:chaos-card¦Chaos Card⟧ works on Mother, but only kills one of her phases. If you are holding a Chaos Card, it is recommended to use it in Phase 2, since Mother's attacks are much more dangerous.
* ⟦i:371¦Curse of the Tower⟧ can be very useful, since Troll Bombs will attempt to spawn near Mother, and bombs in Repentance will deal 100 damage and ignore the armor. Around 43 bombs would be able to kill her, which corresponds to about 6~7 times of damage. This will be affordable if you have more than 10 hearts in total.
** Similarly, using ⟦i:65¦Anarchist Cookbook⟧, ⟦p:xvi-the-tower¦XVI - The Tower⟧, or your own Bombs will also help.
* Her charging attack in Phase 2 can be greatly stalled by placing a bomb in front of her path, while also dealing damage to her in the process.
* In phase 2, if the player has ⟦i:210¦Gnawed Leaf⟧, they can bring Mother to a complete standstill while she's charging if they enter statue form in front of her.
** Pair this with at least one offensive familiar and the fight becomes a joke for all characters.
* Using ⟦p:ace-of-hearts¦Ace of Hearts⟧ during the Dead Isaac attack will spawn 10 hearts on average, which should keep any red heart characters alive for quite some time. Using it during the hand slam attack that spawns Small Maggots will usually spawn 3-5.
* Using ⟦i:638¦Eraser⟧ on Mother's first phase allows phase 2 to be skipped as long she has 15 health or less.
* With proper timing, ⟦p:soul-of-judas¦Soul of Judas⟧ can one-shot Mother's second phase even with base damage. The best attack for this is the spinning attack, but it is also possible to do this right after Mother spits out the ball of projectiles. Be aware that the boss can dodge the damage by performing the charge attack.

bosses.behavior:
Upon entering this area, all passive items, active items, and trinkets will be rendered inactive, and Isaac's Bombs, coins, and Keys will be set to zero, leaving him similar to his state during the start of the game. He only has his current hearts. He must walk through several empty rooms before reaching the end room containing ⟦i:627¦Knife Piece 2⟧. Picking it up causes the room to shake and summons Mother's Shadow. Mother's Shadow is completely invulnerable and Isaac must escape her by returning to the special area entrance and leaving. On the way back, the path back will be obstructed by various obstacles, such as rocks, Fire Places, spikes, and Poops.
Mother's Shadow, after appearing, begins slowly floating after Isaac. When close enough to him, she stops and then quickly dashes at Isaac, dealing a whole heart of contact damage. Isaac can 'push' Mother's shadow before her charge by walking into her and will not take contact damage. Mother's Shadow can go off-screen with her dash attack or when a door is crossed into a different room. She then resumes following Isaac.
* Mother's Shadow's position at all times is determined by her position relative to the general layout of the floor, meaning she persists in the same location even when Isaac moves through rooms. However, she cannot be left behind and is carried along as the screen moves.
* After encountering Mother's Shadow, the previously empty path back to the main floor map becomes filled with a variety of obstacles, such as poops that must be destroyed, timed spikes, rocks that must be broken by Throwable Bombs from Bomb Grimaces, buttons, and sometimes keys and certain cards that spawn in each room.
As soon as Isaac passes the door leading out of the sub-area, Mother's Shadow screams Isaac's name in defeat and disappears as the sub-area's entrance is blocked by falling rocks. It is no longer possible to access this area again past this point.
bosses.notes:
* Upon acquiring the Knife Piece 2, all Fire Places are extinguished and then re-ignited as red fires as Mother's Shadow appears.
** Fire places can drop their pickups during this scene.
* After Mother's Shadow spawns and the Knife Piece room reopens, Isaac gains 1 charge for his active item.
* New pickups obtained in the area will persist after Isaac leaves.
* Unlike non-story items, which disappear during the sequence, Isaac's health stays the same, and friendly enemies still follow him here.
** Blue Flies, Blue Spiders, Locusts, ⟦i:279¦Big Fan⟧ spawned from a Pretty Fly Horse Pill, ⟦i:73¦Cube of Meat⟧ spawned from a ⟦i:487¦Potato Peeler⟧, and Wisps spawned from ⟦i:584¦Book of Virtues⟧ and ⟦i:702¦Vengeful Spirit⟧ persist into this sequence, but have no effect on Mother's Shadow. Blood clots spawned by ⟦i:713¦Sumptorium⟧ will also persist and are immune to Mother's Shadow.
* Extra lives granted by items such as ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧ or ⟦i:212¦Guppy's Collar⟧ do not work, as they are removed from Isaac.
** ⟦c:lazarus¦Lazarus⟧, however, still retains his extra life.
* Items that grant flight are taken away, forcing most characters to traverse the obstacles normally.
** ⟦p:xix-the-sun-reversed¦XIX - The Sun?⟧ allows any character to fly, despite not having the visual effects of the card's ⟦i:159¦Spirit of the Night⟧ visible.
** ⟦p:xv-the-devil-reversed¦XV - The Devil?⟧ also allows any character to fly. However, the effect is likely to wear off before the end of the chase sequence.
** ⟦i:703¦Esau Jr.⟧ works similarly. If Isaac enters the zone with Esau Jr., he is still able to fly without his appearance.
* The active piece of ⟦i:550¦Broken Shovel 1⟧ will still spawn Mom's feet in this area.
* ⟦c:eve¦Eve⟧ will benefit from her ⟦i:122¦Whore of Babylon⟧ if criteria are met but her sprite will remain un-cursed.
bosses.strategy:
* The key to avoiding damage during the chase sequence is to be patient. Trying to rush to the exit door will often result in unavoidable hits.
* Mother's Shadow will not attack Isaac directly between dashes, only float in his general direction. She will scream right before attacking, and will lock her direction; stay in place until she starts to dash and then swiftly move out of the way to dodge.
* Going back into the previous room doesn't cancel her attacks, but provides more space for avoiding them, as well as invincibility frames.
* Do not stand on one tile-wide paths for too long, because they limit Isaac's ability to move out of the way of her dashes.
* Since Isaac keeps any health he enters the area with, it is wise to stock up on hearts beforehand to minimize chances of death.
** ⟦c:tainted-eve¦Tainted Eve⟧'s ⟦i:713¦Sumptorium⟧ should be used before entering to maximize health.
* ⟦c:azazel¦Azazel⟧, ⟦c:the-lost¦The Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-lost¦Tainted Lost⟧, ⟦c:tainted-jacob¦Tainted Jacob⟧ in his Lost form, and ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ can escape with minimal risk, as they can use their inherent flight to fly directly to the exit door.

bosses.behavior:
Mr. Fred stays stationary in the middle of a 1x2 or 2x1 room and performs the following attacks:
* Breaks the chain of 1 of the 4 Homunculi that accompany him at the beginning of the fight.
** Unlike other Homounculi, the ones spawned with Mr. Fred can not break free on their own and can only be unleashed by this attack.
* Shoots 4 large long-range blood projectiles in the cardinal directions. These tears leave Red Creep and will burst at the end of their range into a larger pool of Creep.
* Burrows underground briefly and pops back up in his original position, firing eight projectiles in all directions.

Mr. Fred deals a whole heart of contact damage.

bosses.behavior:
Pin burrows into the ground before performing the following attacks:
* Jumps out of the ground towards Isaac and burrowing back into the ground at the end of the jump.
** ⟨7⟩ Occasionally fires 4 projectiles diagonally from the last section of its body when exiting the ground and/or when burrowing back into the ground.
** ⟨24⟩ Fires 4 projectiles diagonally depending on the length of its jump: does not fire projectiles on short jumps, fires projectiles shortly upon exiting the jump on regular/medium jumps, and fires projectiles both shortly upon exiting and after a few moments airborne on long jumps.
* Partially emerges out of the ground to fire a red ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ shot at Isaac before returning underground.
** After performing this attack, Pin will always jump out of the same spot it entered.
bosses.notes:
* Each segment of Pin can be individually damaged, so a single piercing tear could hit Pin multiple times.
** Moreover, if Pin is petrified (due to ⟦i:110¦Mom's Contacts⟧ or ⟦i:372¦Charged Baby⟧, etc.), his individual segments can even be destroyed (though that would not necessarily deal higher damage), which will shorten the boss in its length.
** ⟨24⟩Piercing shots no longer damage segmented enemies multiple times per attack.
* Despite looking like it's flying above the ground, Pin is not immune to ground-based effects such as creep when doing its jumping attack. On the contrary, every segment is guaranteed to pass over the damaging area, making it more susceptible to damage.
** Due to this, Pin also cannot jump across gaps, and will bounce backwards when attempting to cross one.
* The segment that shoots bullets during mid-jump will continue to do so if it's suspended in mid-air with something like ⟦i:722¦Anima Sola⟧.

* Fires a spread of 3 projectiles at Isaac.
* Shoots out 8 projectiles in all directions.
* Summons a Round Worm.
He will stay vulnerable for a few moments after performing an attack before quickly burrowing underground again.

bosses.behavior:
Rag Man chases Isaac if there are no Rag Man's Raglings alive and can stop to perform the following attacks:
* Throws his head towards Isaac. The head rolls for a bit, after which it turns into a Rag Man's Ragling. His head then reappears on his body. While his head is rolling, his body walks around aimlessly, occasionally shooting a homing projectile in a random direction, behaving similar to a Gusher.
** The head has 25 HP and can be shot to damage both Rag Man and the Ragling spawned from it.
** Rag Man's Raglings leave remains on the ground after death. If the head is destroyed before transforming, it still creates a Ragling's remains.
** Rag Man can only spawn up to 4 Raglings.
** If there are any Rag Man's Raglings alive, Rag Man switches from chasing Isaac to following one of his Raglings.
* Revives all nearby Raglings from their remains and heals himself for 10 HP during the process, regardless of the number of Raglings resurrected.
** By doing this, he can overheal above his original HP amount of 200.
* Fires 1, 3, or 5 homing projectiles at Isaac in quick succession.
Once Rag Man is killed, his Raglings' remains disappear, and the Raglings that are still alive won't leave remains upon death.
* ⟨24⟩ Raglings that are still alive will instantly die once Rag Man is killed even if they were not originally spawned by Rag Man himself.
** However, they will not die if they're in their spawning/head stage when Rag Man was killed.
bosses.notes:
* Rag Man will often be accompanied by his own Raglings at the start of the battle, but they aren't able to leave remains upon death.
* He can also start surrounded by 8 spiders.
* The health bar of Rag Man will flash orange for a short time to indicate that he is healing.
* Killing Rag Man's spawned Raglings with ⟦i:411¦Lusty Blood⟧ doesn't boost Isaac's damage.
* Rag Man's head can be caught using the ⟦i:382¦Friendly Ball⟧.

bosses.behavior:
Rag Mega spawns with 3 Purple Balls which are immune to damage and block shots. They circle around him as he floats around the room while he performs the following attacks:
* Each time Rag Mega loses around 25% HP, he breaks off a Purple Ball which starts to chase Isaac.
* Periodically wraps his body in bandages and becomes immune to damage.
* Spawns a Rag Man's Ragling. They will leave remains on the ground after death.
* Fires 3 beams from the sky that travel outwards. If the beam hits the remains of a dead Ragling, it is revived.
bosses.notes: * ⟦i:503¦Little Horn⟧ shots can kill the Purple Balls.

bosses.behavior:
Upon spawning, Reap Creep jumps up to the top of the Boss Room similarly to ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧. It starts off taking Wall Creep's form and can perform the following attacks:
* Spawns a Wall Creep on either the left, right or bottom wall.
* Spews out a continuous stream of projectiles vertically while attempting to follow Isaac's movements.
** When reaching near the end of either wall, it leaves a gap between the stream and the wall.
After losing 33% health, Reap Creep takes Blind Creep's form and has new attacks:
* Spews a huge number of disorganized projectiles, similar to ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧, but larger.
* Spews out a wide spread of spaced projectiles.
* Spawns 3-4 Spiders or a Trite downwards.
After losing 66% health, Reap Creep takes Rage Creep's form and has new attacks:
* Slams itself against either the left or right wall, causing rock projectiles and 3-4 Spiders to fall from the ceiling.
** If it's fought in the Mines, 3-4 Rock Spiders fall instead.
* Charges for a moderate period of time before shooting a wide ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser while attempting to follow Isaac's movements.
** When reaching near the end of either wall, it leaves a gap between the laser and the wall.
* Charges for a long period of time before shooting 4 regular Brimstone lasers diagonally outwards while attempting to follow Isaac's movements. The beams slowly come together leaving a small gap within the center.
** The two Brimstone attacks have distinct charge sounds, allowing the player to distinguish them.
bosses.notes:
* Reap Creep's arena always has a hollow upper layer, preventing Isaac from getting too close with it. This makes the situation tricky if Isaac somehow has to deal damage with melee or grounded attacks.
** Due to this, as of V1.06.J791, Reap Creep cannot appear in the Scat Man challenge.

bosses.behavior:
The first phase occurs against Rotgut's "face" in its regular boss room. Rotgut is stationary in the center of the room and performs the following attacks:
* Spews a constant wave of projectiles that alternates above and below it in a fanning pattern.
* Spews out waves of fluctuating spaced-out projectiles in a disorganized pattern.
* Fires rings of 8 expanding projectiles that alternate between rotating clockwise and counter-clockwise.
* Fires three waves of projectiles in a row:
** A radial of tightly knit slow-moving tears.
** A radial of spaced out fast-moving tears.
** A burst of randomly positioned tears that hover for a moment before dropping.
* Coughs up a horizontal burst of red projectiles to the left and right side of itself.
* Vomits out projectiles, bones, as well as Globin goo, Gazing Globin goo, and Small Maggots that rain down in a large area.
Once Rotgut's first form has been defeated, it sucks Isaac, any monsters, and floating projectiles into its mouth and sends Isaac into a Crawl Space-like interior. The second phase consists of a large maggot that sits in the bottom right of the room and performs attacks depending on Isaac's position.
If Isaac is on the platform, the maggot uses its rear end:
* Launches a cluster of projectiles onto the platform and covers it in green poisonous gas.
* Launches an ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ shot that bursts into arcing tears.
* Shoots out 6 slow travelling tears that travel in a wave pattern across the entire room.
If Isaac is below the platform and on the ground, the maggot uses its head:
* Spits out a stream of arcing blood projectiles along with a few Attack Flies and Small Maggots.
* Shoots out a ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser.
Defeating the Maggot allows passage into the next chamber, which contains Rotgut's "heart". The heart switches randomly between two modes of projectile patterns that occur for the entire duration of the fight:
* Mode 1: shoots out half-rings of 6-7 green projectiles below it with each pulse of the heart.
* Mode 2: drops 3 yellow projectiles in random locations with each beat of the heart. Each projectile splits into 2 arcing projectiles after hitting the ground.
The heart can perform additional attacks that occur independently of its two set modes:
* Retreats upwards and spawns ⟦i:270¦Leech⟧ on the end of the room furthest from Isaac. These Leeches move quickly across the screen and despawn upon reaching the edge of the screen. The final Leech spawned has a chance of being an Adult Leech.
* Drops 2 large blood projectiles below it one after another. Each bursts into smaller projectiles that bounce all over the room.
After defeating this phase, Isaac is automatically ejected out of Rotgut's insides and back into the boss room.
bosses.notes:
* Dying with a respawn item (such as ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧) in the second or final phase places Isaac in the previous phase, meaning Isaac has to fight that phase again. This does not apply to effects that revive the player in the same room such as ⟦i:688¦Inner Child⟧.
* The transitions between phases count as room changes (which means the ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ shield will re-activate after each phase, for instance).
* The chambers for second and third phases are not considered boss rooms for the purposes of items such as ⟦i:535¦Blanket⟧.
* ⟦i:697¦Vanishing Twin⟧ will spawn a copy of Rotgut's first phase. When either of them is defeated, the fight can be advanced to second phase without killing the remaining boss. Second and third phases are not affected except for the fact that Vanishing Twin familiar will remain with Isaac despite having transformed into a copy of Rotgut. After Isaac defeats the third phase of the boss, the familiar will spawn another Rotgut, which will instantly die and drop an item.

bosses.behavior:
The battle against Satan has three distinct phases.
The first phase starts with a slight delay after Isaac enters the room:
* Satan shouts, and roughly two seconds after Satan's voice dies out, ⟦e:the-fallen¦The Fallen⟧ spawns at the center, with two Kamikaze Leeches to either side.
Once The Fallen is dead, the Devil Room statue at the top of the screen transforms into Satan's first form. He stays near the top of the room moving horizontally and performs the following attacks:
* Spits out 2 consecutive spreads of 5 and 4 projectiles towards Isaac. He chains this attack at least twice.
* If Isaac is to either side of him, he can:
** Shoot half-rings of 8 projectiles from both his hands towards the left and right sides of the room.
* If Isaac is below him, he can:
** Shoot two ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers from his hands, that curve towards each other while leaving a gap in the middle.
** Charge up and fires a ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ beam from his mouth directly downwards.
If Satan is pushed too far away from the top center of the room, he will rapidly spring back to that position.
After depleting his entire second phase health bar and reaching half of his total HP, he flies off-screen and has one attack:
* Stomps the ground with both of his feet at Isaac's previous positions, similar to ⟦e:mom¦Mom⟧'s stomp attack, but with less delay. The stomps come down one after another, and after two stomps, they persist for a moment before both are retracted.
* Up to two Kamikaze Leeches continuously spawn during this phase.
** They can be killed by Satan's stomp, but will also deal considerable damage to him.
** There appears to be a maximum amount of Kamikaze Leeches that can be spawned, as they stop appearing if the fight draws out for too long and the Kamikaze Leeches are not killed.
Satan's projectiles and contact damage deal a whole heart of damage.
Once Satan is defeated, remaining Kamikaze Leeches die alongside him.
bosses.notes:
* Every time Satan is defeated, the current savefile's image changes until ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ is unlocked.
* Defeating Satan for the 1st time will unlock Champion versions of Bosses.
* Using the ⟦i:33¦The Bible⟧ or ⟦p:xv-the-devil-reversed¦XV - The Devil?⟧ on Satan will instantly kill Isaac.
* On the third wave, ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ and/or ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧ will be extremely useful, as Kamikaze Leeches and stomping (which is considered as an explosion) will not hurt Isaac.
** ⟨24⟩ Stomps are no longer considered explosions and cannot have their damage negated.
* ⟨7⟩ Unlike in the original Binding of Isaac, Satan's feet don't cause damage on contact for the short time they rest on the ground after a stomp, providing a window of opportunity to deal significant damage with orbitals such as ⟦i:172¦Sacrificial Dagger⟧, or activate other contact effects like ⟦i:202¦Midas' Touch⟧.

Scolex is only vulnerable in his blinking tail segment. He burrows into the ground before performing the following attacks:

* Partially emerges head-first and shoots out a cluster of projectiles towards Isaac, similar to ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧, but with a wider spread.
** After performing this attack, Scolex will always jump out of the same spot he entered.
* Partially emerges tail-first and fires cluster of 3 red ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ shots towards Isaac.
** After performing this attack, Scolex will always jump out of the same spot he entered.
Scolex deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes: * Sometimes, several Lumps, Guts, Para-Bites, or Round Worms can accompany Scolex at the start of the battle.

bosses.behavior:
Singe always spawns with 4 damaging Singe's Balls that can be pushed around; these play an important role in his attacks. Any spiked rock caught up in an explosion launches rapidly across the room, bouncing when colliding into obstacles, walls, and each other.
* Farts, leaving a cloud of explosive gas.
** Spiked rocks caught in this attack will be propelled slowly.
* Runs erratically towards Isaac or a spiked rock and creates an explosion at the end of the run.
** If close to Isaac at the end of the run, Singe can also perform a short jump in Isaac's direction to gain extra distance, creating an explosion on landing.
* Charges up before releasing a large explosion, launching Singe into the air and creating a small cross-shaped pit in his wake; after a few moments he lands on top of Isaac's position. This attack spawns an additional spiked rock that lands down alongside him. This attack only occurs twice during the fight and only after Singe has reached a certain amount of HP.
** Spiked rocks are able to be launched into the pit that Singe creates. This temporarily removes it until Singe generates another explosion, which spawns it again from the ceiling.
** Multiple spiked rocks can be removed at a time, but Singe only spawns one back at a time per each explosion.
* After performing his second large explosion, Singe gains a new attack where he lights a match and places it in front of his butt, farting to produce a large stream of fire that follows Isaac's movement.
* Singe's explosion upon death can also damage Isaac.
bosses.notes: * ⟨16⟩ Singe's Balls can be destroyed by ⟦p:hagalaz¦Hagalaz⟧, greatly simplifying this fight.

bosses.behavior:
Sisters Vis perform the following attacks in conjunction:
* Similar to ⟦e:the-cage¦The Cage⟧, Sisters Vis curl up into balls and roll around the room, bouncing off the walls and each other. One of them leaves a trail of green creep and begins rolling towards Isaac while the other leaves behind a trail of brown creep and begins rolling away from Isaac. After a while, one sister stops rolling before the other and:
** Fires a ⟦i:441¦Mega Blast⟧ laser in the cardinal direction closest to Isaac's position.
*** This Mega Blast laser occasionally sweeps back and forth in a wide arc.
** Fire 2-4 lines of 3-5 projectiles in the cardinal direction closest to Isaac's position.
The attacking Sister Vis finishes a few seconds before the other Sister Vis stops rolling.
* The sisters leap into the air and land on each side of Isaac's position either vertically or horizontally. They then fire Mega Blast lasers towards each other. The two beams collide and stop in the middle of the sisters.
* Together they spawn either two Vis or two Begottens.
** These spawns can be killed if caught in their rolling or their Mega Blast attacks.
* If only one sister is targeted and ends up taking a lot more damage compared to the other in a short period of time, then the sister not being targeted becomes enraged for the rest of the fight, attacking and moving at a faster pace.
When one of the two is killed, the other becomes enraged.
* She no longer performs the jump attack but always performs a Mega Blast or projectile attack after rolling.
* If the Sister Vis that leaves Green Creep dies first, the other will leave Green Creep instead of Brown Creep.
bosses.notes:
* ⟨7⟩ A possible encounter in ⟦s:greed-mode¦Greedier Mode⟧ may spawn up to 6 Sisters Vis.
* They can be found in ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧, even when not unlocked.

bosses.behavior:

* Fires a spread of 4 projectiles in the cardinal direction closest to Isaac.
