Super Greed deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes:
* Defeating Super Greed in a Secret Room causes all entrances to adjacent room entrances to be opened. ⟨15⟩ The exceptions are entrances to adjacent Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms- which will be barred and blocked off forever, unable to be opened by a bomb.
* If Isaac teleports out of the room after defeating Super Greed but without killing all of the Keepers he spawns, Isaac can re-fight Super Greed for extra coins.
* Shops and Secret Rooms that Super Greed appears in count as Mini-Boss Rooms, and cannot be bombed out of. They also prevent any other mini-boss rooms from generating on that floor. Once Super Greed is encountered in a Shop or Secret Room, he and Greed cannot be encountered that way for the rest of the run.
* ⟨7⟩ Super Greed can drop ⟦i:64¦Steam Sale⟧ / ⟦i:74¦A Quarter⟧ even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.
* ⟨24⟩ The exact spawn chances for Greed/Super Greed are as follows:
** Base chance 33.3%
** Having more than 20 coins entering the floor: +1.66%
** Destroyed a machine on the previous floor: +3.33%
** Destroyed a Shopkeeper in the previous floor: +0.66%
** Donating money in the previous floor: -1.66% per coin, up to a maximum of -8.33% for 5 coins
** These put the minimum and maximum chances at 25% and 39% respectively.

* ⟨7⟩ Super Pride can drop ⟦i:81¦Dead Cat⟧ even if Isaac has already encountered / picked it up.
* Super Pride is not immune to damage from his own Mega Troll Bombs while under the effect of ⟦i:722¦Anima Sola⟧.

bosses.behavior:

* When enough health is depleted, the one large Teratoma breaks into three medium Teratomas.

* Each of the three medium Teratomas breaks into two small Teratomas.

bosses.behavior:
* Quickly fires ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser towards Isaac if he is seen in any cardinal direction. The beam bends slightly, following Isaac's movement.
* Flies off-screen into the air and plummets down on Isaac's position a few seconds later, creating a circular rock wave on impact which expands to 4 rings.
* Summons 3 Spiders.
* Dims the room, causing the effect for a period of time.
bosses.notes:
* The Brimstone attack's homing effect is stronger as it gets farther away from The Adversary. It is much easier to avoid by staying close and being ready to pivot around him via quarter-circle dodges when he telegraphs the attack.
* ⟨7⟩ If there is a room containing two Adversaries, their Brimstone shots may be unavoidable if fired from both sides of the room simultaneously.
** ⟨24⟩ Two Adversaries can't fire simultaneously.
* ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧ and ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ make Isaac immune to The Adversary's rock wave attack since it is considered to be the same as explosions by the game.
* If The Adversary dims the room, pause the game and the dim will eventually go away while still in the pause screen.

bosses.behavior:
After defeating ⟦e:dogma¦Dogma⟧, Isaac is given ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧, granting him flight and allowing him to traverse The Beast's 2D Crawl Space-like arena. ⟦i:633¦Dogma⟧ also grants a one-time ⟦i:313¦Holy Mantle⟧ shield, the effect of ⟦i:108¦The Wafer⟧ (if playing in Normal Mode), prevents Isaac's speed from going under 1.1, and +2 damage, and heals him up to 6 hearts with Red Heart Containers and Soul Hearts.
At the start of the fight, The Beast sits inactive in the background. Flying around The Beast are four Ultra Harbingers, which attack Isaac one at a time in the order of ⟦e:ultra-famine¦Ultra Famine⟧, ⟦e:ultra-pestilence¦Ultra Pestilence⟧, ⟦e:ultra-war¦Ultra War⟧, and ⟦e:ultra-death¦Ultra Death⟧. Once they have all been defeated, The Beast lets out a roar, submerges into the lava, then reemerges on the right side of the screen, beginning her fight.
During her first phase, The Beast uses the following sequence of attacks, repeating indefinitely:
* Charges towards Isaac, forcing the screen to scroll while harmful, destructible stalagmites and stalactites move towards Isaac.
** The screen scrolls along with The Beast, meaning that she will not get closer to Isaac even if he doesn't move; this attack only brings the stalagmites and stalactites on-screen.
* At the end of the charge, The Beast begins to inhale large rings of fire which have one small gap that Isaac can fit through.
** Any remaining stalagmites or stalactites on-screen are destroyed at the start of this attack.
* After inhaling 8 rings of fire, The Beast stops and fires a colossal ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧-like beam that covers the bottom and middle portions of the screen.
* After this attack, she performs a quick charge across the screen before repeating the initial charge in the opposite direction. Similar to the ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧-like beam directly before, she covers a large portion of the bottom and middle parts of the screen.
Even if The Beast's HP drops below the threshold for her second phase, this will always still be the first attack she performs every single time.
The Beast enters her second phase below 6660 HP and loses her inhaling attack, but gains 2 new ones. Additionally, during the charging attack, there are more rocky obstacles and some stalactites are cracked and fall when Isaac passes underneath. (As before, the screen scrolls while The Beast charges, with Isaac's position on the screen being maintained.)
At the end of a charge, The Beast performs one of two attacks:
* Opens her mouth and fires 3 radial waves of slow-moving fire, then fires 6 radial strings of fast-moving projectiles which travel through the gaps left between each fire.
* Roars and spawns 4 Beast Souls which chase Isaac and charge at him, trying to predict his movements, before dissipating.
** Any remaining stalagmites or stalactites on-screen are destroyed at the start of this attack.
After using either of these attacks, The Beast submerges into the lava and causes glowing orange lines to appear beneath Isaac and in other random areas. The glow of these lines increases in intensity over time before launching out a large fiery projectile that flies up and falls back into the lava. The Beast gradually increases the rate at which projectiles are launched before eventually reemerging from the lava on the opposite end of the screen and launching a small burst of large fiery projectiles arcing in all directions.
* Any remaining stalagmites or stalactites on-screen are destroyed at the start of this attack.
In The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+, previous attacks from phase 1 and 2 are mixed together and not tied to HP. Phase 3 is still triggering at 33% HP.
The Beast enters her third phase at 33% HP and is indicated by a burst of blood. The Beast is forced to submerge into the lava and reappear on the other side of the screen, then begins charging towards Isaac indefinitely while more stalagmites and stalactites spawn behind him. (As before, the screen scrolls while The Beast charges, with Isaac's position on the screen being maintained.) Cracked stalactites do not appear during this phase.
Once The Beast's HP reaches 2000, her horns crack and her body ruptures in boils. She degrades through two more stages: losing 2 horns and an eye upon reaching 1000 HP, and losing another eye, another horn, all of her teeth, and generally having a melted look upon reaching 500 HP. Upon defeat, a large light ray comes from above and strikes her down, followed immediately by Ending 22.
bosses.notes:
* Phase 2's narrow activation period (from 50% to 33% health) means it will often be skipped, typically if enough damage is done during the long-duration fire rings attack.
* ⟦i:387¦Censer⟧ / ⟦i:425¦Night Light⟧ is not recommended for this boss battle, as it can cause flames to pile up unavoidably during the Beast's fire ring inhalation attack.
* ⟦p:chaos-card¦Chaos Card⟧ doesn't work on The Beast.
** If the fight is entered with a ⟦p:chaos-card¦Chaos Card⟧ it will be converted to a Full Health pill
* ⟦p:era-walk¦Era Walk⟧, "I'm Drowsy..." pill, etc. works for the duration of the fight, and makes for an easy battle.
* ⟦i:516¦Sprinkler⟧ will float in the air for the duration of the flight and remains in place during the chase sequence, providing constant extra damage.
* ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧ works and will kill The Beast before dying, triggering Ending 22. It must be used after all four Ultra Harbingers are defeated, or else it will only kill the current Ultra Harbinger.
** However, if the "I'm Drowsy..." pill was used in the boss room, using ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧ would kill Isaac right before the Beast's death animation's end.
* All teleportation items/cards cannot be used to escape the fight; instead, Isaac will be teleported to a random spot on the screen. Similarly, any respawn items will respawn Isaac immediately, without restarting the fight. Essentially, there is no way to leave the fight after it has begun, outside of ⟦i:636¦R Key⟧ and ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧.
** ⟨15⟩ ⟦i:681¦Lil Portal⟧ is capable of creating a portal in the fight if it consumes enough pickups. Going into the portal will return Isaac to an unexplored room in ⟦s:home¦Home⟧ and softlock the run as it is not possible to return to the boss fight.
* ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ and ⟦i:531¦Haemolacria⟧ travel in an arc, similar to Ultra Pestilence's shots, and are extremely hard to aim. If Isaac has high range when firing left or right, the projectiles will go up and off-screen.
* Most non-flying familiars, such as Super Meat Boy, ⟦i:270¦Leech⟧, or Blue Spiders, are almost completely useless against the Ultra Harbingers, as the familiars will stay stuck in the lava on the bottom of the arena. However, they can damage Ultra War if his movement pattern takes him close enough to the bottom of the screen, and The Beast as she is half-submerged in lava.
* Any item that gives an effect for the room, such as ⟦i:357¦Box of Friends⟧ or ⟦i:34¦The Book of Belial⟧, will work for the entire fight, starting with Ultra Famine.
* ⟦i:337¦Broken Watch⟧ can affect this fight. However, it only activates for 1 unvisited room out of 4. Finishing the fight with Dogma and beginning the fight against the Ultra Harbingers counts as a new visited room. Hence, to have the effect against The Beast, the last visited room in Home must be the 3rd after the effect was triggered for the last time.
* ⟦i:210¦Gnawed Leaf⟧ works as normal in this fight — as long as Isaac stays still and has some way of dealing damage without moving or firing, such as an enemy-chasing familiar. He will eventually kill The Beast with enough patience.
* ⟦i:540¦Flat Stone⟧ makes tears travel straight down, as there is no ground they can skip on.
* Like ⟦i:540¦Flat Stone⟧, bombs fired with ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧ will be fired in a downward arch since there's no ground for them to slide on, making it a difficult item to use in the fight without bomb immunity items such as ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ or ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧.
* Defeating each Ultra Harbinger will grant Isaac's active item 2 charges, similar to Boss Rush.
* ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Soul⟧ is capable of dragging ⟦c:the-forgotten¦The Forgotten⟧ with him as he moves. This means he can move anywhere on the screen, but at a much slower rate. ⟦c:tainted-forgotten¦Tainted Forgotten⟧ flies during this battle and stays where he ends up when thrown (in mid-air), meaning that if you throw him at the Beast you can constantly attack its during the chase scenes.
* The hitboxes of stalactites, stalagmites, and the lava persist during The Beast's death animation.
* Despite not being able to fly or go over gaps in its final form, ⟦i:385¦Bumbo⟧ will be able to "fly" around the arena and deal damage without sinking in the lava. Bombs placed by Bumbo still behave normally and fall.
* Bombs are affected by gravity and are hard to hit the Ultra Harbingers with, but can easily be used against The Beast, especially during chase sequences. As such, it is a great strategy to continuously use all of your bombs during this sequence, as there is no longer any other need for them. This also makes ⟦i:371¦Curse of the Tower⟧ and ⟦i:65¦Anarchist Cookbook⟧ safe to use as long as Isaac does not move too close to the bottom of the screen.
* Because there are no walls or floors for tears to collide with in this fight, the damage boost from ⟦i:373¦Dead Eye⟧ will not fade away.
* Items that place Poops, such as ⟦i:36¦The Poop⟧ or ⟦i:543¦Hallowed Ground⟧, cannot place poops during the fight.
** However, poops will spawn if enemies are turned into poops (e. g. by ⟦i:236¦E. Coli⟧).
* The lava projectiles from both the lava and when The Beast rises afterward can be slowed and knocked down with certain slowing items such as ⟦i:387¦Censer⟧ and high knockback tears.

bosses.behavior:
* Unlike ⟦e:peep¦Peep⟧, The Bloat's eyes are dislocated at the start of the fight.
** The Bloat's eyeballs float diagonally, bouncing off of walls, and do not take damage. They block Isaac's tears and inflict contact damage.
* Performs a small jump in place and fires eight projectiles in all directions.
** Unlike Peep's, The Bloat's projectiles are always shot in the same orientation.
* Creates large puddles of Red Creep.
* Jumps into the air and travels a moderate distance in Isaac's direction, leaving a small puddle of Red Creep and sending out a ring of eight projectiles upon landing.
* Fires 2 ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers from his eye sockets, aiming below him or to both sides of him, depending on Isaac's location. This attack is not telegraphed and fires near-instantly, although it can be deliberately triggered by standing beside or above The Bloat's head.
** He can not perform this attack upwards.
The Bloat deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes: * The Bloat's eyes can be destroyed with ⟦p:chaos-card¦Chaos Card⟧, ⟦i:496¦Euthanasia⟧, ⟦i:398¦God's Flesh⟧, or ⟦i:503¦Little Horn⟧.

bosses.behavior:
* Leaps off-screen and tries to land in Isaac's path, predicting his movement. Leaves a small puddle of damaging Grey Creep and sends out 4-5 lines of rock waves upon landing.
* Quickly shoots 6 streams of 3-7 projectiles in a spiral pattern, similar to ⟦e:mom-s-heart¦Mom's Heart⟧/⟦e:it-lives¦It Lives!⟧.
* Curls up in a ball and rolls towards Isaac, bouncing off walls and obstacles around the room.
* Spawns a grey-coloured Vis that shoots a brown-coloured ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser.
** The different colours are purely cosmetic, and it behaves exactly like a normal Vis.
** Any Vis caught in The Cage's rolling attack will be killed.
bosses.notes:
* ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧ and ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ make Isaac immune to The Cage's rock waves, since it is considered to be the same as explosions by the game.
* When The Cage jumps, there is a delay to his falling animation, causing Isaac to be hurt before The Cage falls back down.
* If Isaac is flying on Pits, The Cage can hit Isaac if it jumps towards him, and it will then be pushed back to the ground.

bosses.behavior:
The Duke of Flies constantly floats around the room in diagonal directions. Knockback from tears and other sources can cause him to change travel direction. He has three attacks that he can perform while he floats:
* Spawns 3 Attack Flies that will orbit around him, blocking shots.
* Spawns a larger Attack Fly that will chase Isaac.
* Sends any orbital Flies outward to chase Isaac.
** He can only perform this attack if he has 5-6 orbiting Flies.
*** If he has 4 orbiting Flies, he cannot perform this attack nor can he spawn more as it would exceed his limit resulting in him only spawning the larger Attack Flies.
* The Duke of Flies will never spawn Flies if 12 already exist.
* Upon death, all orbiting Flies will be free to chase Isaac.
** ⟨24⟩ Spawns 6 random Flies or Attack Flies upon death.
* Unlike regular Attack Flies, the ones spawned by The Duke of Flies can be killed if Isaac walks into them, though they will still deal contact damage before dying.
** ⟨24⟩ This does not include the Attack Flies spawned on death.
bosses.notes: * If Isaac has the transformation, the Attack Flies that The Duke of Flies spawns will instantly turn into blue flies which damage him.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Fallen moves randomly around the room in cardinal directions and can perform the following attacks:
* Fires 3 projectiles in a spread followed by 4 projectiles in a spread in succession towards Isaac.
* Increases its speed and chases Isaac. After taking a certain amount of damage, it halts and fires a ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser in each cardinal direction.
* At 50% health, The Fallen splits into two smaller versions of itself. The two clones have identical behaviour.
** It is possible to avoid the split if the Fallen takes a single hit doing more than 50% damage that causes poisoning or burning as the final one.
The Fallen deals a whole heart of contact damage in both phases.
bosses.notes:
* Unlike other bosses, the item pool of the Fallen room is the Devil Room item pool.
** ⟨1⟩Leaving and re-entering the room will change the item pool to the normal Boss Room item pool.
* The Fallen can appear on the first floor during a Victory Lap if a Devil Room was entered during the previous lap. Even more rarely, it is possible to encounter him on a normal run if the first level was rerolled with ⟦i:127¦Forget Me Now⟧ or a 5-pip Dice Room after visiting the Devil Room by teleporting with a ⟦p:joker¦Joker⟧ card, a Red Chest, or similar methods.

bosses.behavior:
* Spawns a Bony.
** While at least one Bony is still alive, the Forsaken becomes incorporeal and floats erratically around the room staying away from Isaac and very occasionally drifts towards Isaac attempting to pass through him.
** Every tear shot towards the Forsaken during this phase passes through it.
** When at around 30% HP, it spawns 2 Bonies instead.
* When all Bonies are killed, The Forsaken moves close to the center of the room before reappearing and firing 3 ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers in triangular directions with one laser always shooting in the opposite direction of Isaac. These lasers then rotate just over 180 degrees in either direction.
** Afterwards it stays vulnerable for a few moments before spawning another Bony and repeating the process.
* Unlike its counterparts, ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧ and ⟦e:the-heretic¦The Heretic⟧, The Forsaken does not deal contact damage while incorporeal. Rather, if Isaac walks through The Forsaken, it spawns another Bony, briefly becoming vulnerable while doing so.
** If this is repeated without killing any Bonies until there are 4 alive on-screen, the next time Isaac walks through The Forsaken, it performs a modified version of its ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ attack with greatly increased speed and duration, killing off all Bonies.
bosses.notes: * The Forsaken can be instantly killed with ⟦i:653¦Vade Retro⟧ if it is at 50% health or below.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Frail in its first phase has 100 HP like ⟦e:pin¦Pin⟧ and behaves identically, with the only difference that The Frail is less accurate in its jumps and generally overshoots or undershoots Isaac.
Upon its HP being depleted, The Frail's appearance becomes skeletal. It now has 200 HP and performs the following attacks:
* Jumps out of the ground towards Isaac, firing 4 diagonal projectiles from the last section of its body that each split into 4 more projectiles in either cardinal or diagonal directions.
** ⟨24⟩ Whether it fires projectiles depends on the length of its jump: does not fire projectiles on short jumps, fires projectiles shortly upon exiting the jump on regular/medium jumps, and fires projectiles both shortly upon exiting and after a few moments airborne on long jumps.
* Partially emerges head-first and:
** Fires a ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser at Isaac, rotating to follow his movements.
** Fires a quick, non-moving ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser at Isaac 2 times before stopping.
** After performing any of these attacks, The Frail will always jump out of the same spot it entered.
* Partially emerges tail-first and fires a burst of white projectiles in all directions which leave small puddles of slowing White Creep where they land.
** After performing this attack, The Frail will always jump or appear head-first out of the same spot it entered.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Like ⟦e:mega-maw¦Mega Maw⟧, The Gate is stationary and will perform the following attacks:
* Spawns a Leaper into the air. It can land anywhere in the room while releasing its projectile attack immediately.
** There is a maximum of 4 Leapers alive at once.
** The Gate cannot perform other attacks if there are no Leapers alive. As such, it will also always perform this attack first.
* Shoots a ring of 9 projectiles that can rotate in either direction while expanding outwards.
* Shoots two rings of 6 projectiles which expand outwards and rotate in opposite directions.
* Shoots a ring of 11 straight projectiles in all directions.
** The Gate's projectiles can damage its Leapers.
* If there are 2-3 Leapers alive, it charges up and fires a ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser that curves to connect to all Leapers that are not off-screen.
** This kills any Leapers hit.
** If faced alongside other enemies or bosses, such as in Boss Rush, the laser connects to them, damaging them as well.
bosses.notes: * Using the ⟦i:638¦Eraser⟧ to remove Leapers causes The Gate to be stuck attempting to spawn them infinitely, as it cannot perform other attacks without any Leapers alive.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Phase 1:
The battle begins with three Lil' Haunts circling The Haunt, who floats around the room and is invulnerable. The Haunt and its Lil' Haunts can still do contact damage to Isaac while incorporeal.
* One Lil' Haunt becomes corporeal and chases Isaac. Once the first one is dead, the other two take up the chase.
* Once all three Lil' Haunts are dead, Phase 2 begins.
Phase 2:
The Haunt, now vulnerable, quickly flies to the upper wall of the room and begins to move left and right along the wall while periodically performing the following attacks:
* Fires a straight ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser downwards.
* Fires five blood shots in a spread downwards.
* If Isaac is close to the upper wall, The Haunt will quickly dash toward his position.
During The Haunt's transition to this phase, it can deal contact damage during the dash to the upper wall.
The Haunt attacks based on its location and distance. If it cannot make it to a certain position, it gets stuck attempting to reach it and will not attack until it can resume moving.
During both phases, The Haunt deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes:
* Although The Haunt can fly over rocks and most other obstacles, its movement in the second phase can be completely stopped by dropping a bomb in its path.
** ⟨6⟩ In Afterbirth and Afterbirth †, the Haunt is no longer stopped by bombs and can move over them.
* Lil' Haunts are immune to the effects of ⟦i:236¦E. Coli⟧, ⟦i:291¦Flush!⟧, ⟦i:285¦D10⟧ and ⟨24⟩ Ace cards.
* Inflicting fear or confusion on The Haunt during Phase 2 can be dangerous, as it will sometimes start sliding back and forth rapidly.
* The Haunt can be damaged in phase 1 using ⟦i:705¦Dark Arts⟧ and ⟦i:338¦The Boomerang⟧.
* The Haunt can be instantly killed with ⟦i:653¦Vade Retro⟧ if it is at 50% health or below.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
* During the beginning of the fight, 5 Exorcists, which are shielded and invulnerable, summon The Heretic from a large pentagram, after which they turn into Fanatics.
** The Heretic is incorporeal until all Fanatics and the Pacers or Gushers they turn into are dead, similar to ⟦e:the-haunt¦The Haunt⟧'s first phase.
** While incorporeal, The Heretic can still do contact damage.
* Lobs 7 projectiles that, after landing, burst into 6 fires that spread out in a radial pattern. The landing position of each projectile is marked on the ground.
** The Heretic then follows up by launching itself towards Isaac, creating a radial burst of 8 lines of fire where it lands. It spends a short time readjusting its dislocated jaw before continuing to attack.
* The arena of the Heretic always spawns a number of unlit Fire Places. The Heretic can light up 5-6 of them before firing a purple ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser that connects all of the lit fires. The order the Heretic lights each fire indicates what order the laser travels.
** These can be extinguished with an explosion, preventing Brimstone lasers from reaching the deactivated Fire Place.
* Dashes off-screen and turns invisible before charging in again, predicting Isaac's movements and attempting to bite down on where Isaac is moving, doing a full heart of damage if the attack connects. It chains this attack a total of 4 times, each time from alternating sides of the room.
** The Heretic occasionally does not finish the fourth charge, instead fading away and quickly charging in one final time from the other side of the screen.
* Upon death, the Heretic's fiery eye drops down and sends out lines of fire in the cardinal directions.
bosses.notes:
* When not fought as a main boss, such as in a Boss Challenge room or a degraded boss, it will not be preceded by Fanatics and have no first phase.
** The Heretic also cannot perform its ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ attack outside of its regular boss room as there will be no unlit Fire Places.
* The Heretic can be instantly killed with ⟦i:653¦Vade Retro⟧ if it is at 50% health or below.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The number of individual The Hollow bodies that can spawn each fight can vary from 1-4. The most common encounter with The Hollow is with 2 bodies.
* Flies around the room diagonally, bouncing off of walls.
** The Hollow appears to travel faster when moving at vertical angles compared to horizontal.
** The Hollow can change direction if it collides with Isaac.
* Occasionally spawns poop while moving.
* The Hollow's segments can be split into smaller copies of the boss as long as the new Hollow segments are longer than 2 pieces.
There is a chance that a Grub can spawn alongside a shorter Hollow (basically replacing a second Hollow).
bosses.notes:
* ⟨7⟩Poop spawned by The Hollow will never drop pickups, even when in possession of ⟦t:2¦Petrified Poop⟧.
** ⟨24⟩Poops spawned by The Hollow have an incredibly low chance to spawn pickups. This chance is not affected by Petrified Poop.
** Leaving the room and returning will make the poop generate pickups normally.
* Piercing tears make fighting The Hollow much easier, as each tear can damage multiple segments.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Floats randomly around the room and cycles between the following attacks in the following order:
* Summons a Boom Fly orbited by 3 pink Eternal Fly Bombs.
* Juggles 3 bombs then throws them toward Isaac. Each bomb has a chance of having the ⟦i:256¦Hot Bombs⟧ or ⟦i:220¦Sad Bombs⟧ effect.
* Chains together numerous consecutive tear patterns while gradually increasing the rate in which they are fired:
** 4 cardinal projectiles.
** 4 diagonal projectiles.
** 4 cardinal projectiles.
** 8 projectiles in all directions.
** 12 projectiles in all directions.
** 8 clusters in all directions, each contains 3 projectiles.
** 10 projectiles in all directions, rotating counterclockwise.
** 10 projectiles in all directions, rotating clockwise.
** 4 diagonal projectiles.
** 4 cardinal spreads, each contains 3 projectiles.
** 4 diagonal spreads, each contains 3 projectiles.
** 8 projectiles in all directions.
** 4 diagonal spreads, each contains 5 projectiles.
** 10 projectiles in all directions.
** 8 projectiles in all directions.
** 12 projectiles in all directions.
** 12 projectiles in all directions.
** 4 cardinal projectiles.
** 4 diagonal projectiles.
** This attack ends with Hornfel getting sick and vomiting out 3 fireballs that each extend in cardinal directions upon landing.
* Teleports 3 times and throws out a short delay ⟦i:646¦Brimstone Bombs⟧ Bomb each time.
OR
* Throws a ⟦i:220¦Sad Bombs⟧ Bomb at their feet to create a smokescreen before rapidly teleporting to another location. This attack is repeated 5 times.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Moves around the room like ⟦e:the-duke-of-flies¦The Duke of Flies⟧, but much faster and can perform the following attacks:
* Spawns 2 Attack Flies that orbit loosely around him, blocking shots, as well as a Spider.
** These flies, like the ones spawned by the Duke of Flies, can be killed if Isaac walks into them.
** The Husk will not use this attack if there is a total of 8 flies and spiders spawned, but can exceed the 8 limit if he spawns more flies and spiders when just under the limit.
* Fires a spray of projectiles, similar to ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧, but with fewer projectiles.
* Fires blood shots in 8 directions and spreads the flies orbiting him outwards, freeing them to chase Isaac.
** Unlike the Duke, the Husk can perform this attack at any time without any required amount of orbiting Attack Flies.
* Upon death, all orbiting flies will be free to chase Isaac.
** ⟨24⟩ Spawns a 6-8 random Flies, Attack Flies, and Pooters upon death.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.rewards:
Final Boss Chest (Ending 15)
Gateway to ⟦s:the-void¦The Void⟧ (⟨15⟩ 20% Chance) / (⟨16⟩ 100% Chance)
bosses.behavior:
The Lamb floats towards Isaac and performs the following attacks:
* Fires 6 rings of 10 projectiles outwards with one projectile always aimed in Isaac's direction. The Lamb continues to move towards Isaac but at a very slow pace while performing this attack.
* Shoots rotating waves of 3 projectiles around himself in all directions that split apart once they make contact with any surface, similar to ⟦i:104¦The Parasite⟧.
* Fires 5 rotating lines of projectiles.
** The Lamb occasionally spawns 0-3 Attack Flies during any of the 3 attacks above.
* Fires 2-4 lines of homing projectiles in a spread that rotate to follow Isaac's movements.
* Unleashes a burst of many small ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧-like projectiles in random directions.
Once The Lamb reaches 50% HP, his body detaches from his head and falls to the ground. This phase has each part of The Lamb attacking independently of each other.
The head of The Lamb continues to chase Isaac and can still perform most of the attacks from Phase 1. He loses the explosive shot attack and no longer spawns Attack Flies but gains 3 additional attacks:
* Charges extremely quickly directly towards Isaac, stopping at the edge of the room.
* Stops in place and fires four ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ beams in the cardinal directions. The beams can rotate 90 degrees either clockwise or counterclockwise.
* Fires a large burst of homing projectiles towards Isaac, similar to the combination of ⟦i:229¦Monstro's Lung⟧ and ⟦i:3¦Spoon Bender⟧.
* Defeating the body first has no effect on the head's behavior.
The body of the Lamb remains stationary at the position the Lamb was at the end of Phase 1. The body has one attack which it performs at random intervals but while the head is attacking:
* Fires a large burst of disorganized projectiles in all directions and spawns up to 5 Attack Flies.
** If the head is defeated first, the body can spawn up to 25 Attack Flies.
* When the body is killed, a effect is applied for a long period of time.
bosses.notes:
* The Lamb can be reached before ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ is unlocked by taking the trapdoor in a Black Market or I AM ERROR room from ⟦s:sheol¦Sheol⟧ if one shows up.
* ⟨30⟩ The Lamb can be reached before ⟦i:328¦The Negative⟧ is unlocked if a Sacrifice Room is used 12 or more times.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Matriarch hops randomly around the room and performs the following attacks:
* Spawns two small ⟦e:fistula¦Fistula⟧s once she takes 140 damage, and 2 more every 100 damage afterward.
** She takes considerable knockback when this occurs.
** ⟨24⟩ Reduced to 1 small Fistula for the first 2 spawns.
* Spawns a Fistuloid that chases Isaac, subsequently spawned Fistuloids orbit her. She can have up to a maximum of 4 spawned at once and does not spawn more until she has taken enough damage to release a small Fistula even if previous Fistuloids have been killed.
** Only 1 Fistuloid can chase Isaac at a time and they can occasionally swap when Isaac moves close to an orbiting Fistuloid. If the Fistuloid that chases Isaac is killed, one of the remaining ones stops orbiting the Matriarch and starts chasing Isaac.
*** The active chasing Fistuloid will not chase Isaac if he is too far away and returns to staying near the Matriarch until Isaac draws near.
*** Orbiting Fistuloids occasionally fire a projectile towards Isaac
** All Fistuloids spawned when there are 2 or more small Fistulas alive will orbit The Matriarch and one only becomes active when there is only one small Fistula left.
** ⟨24⟩ The Matriarch loses 30 HP each time she spawns a Fistuloid. If this would cause her to change phases or spawn small Fistulas, The Matriarch is unable to create Fistuloids.
* Jumps and launches 8 Chubber projectiles in all directions, which rebound back to herself.
* Spews a large long-range blood projectile towards Isaac that leaves Red Creep on the ground, similar to ⟦e:mr-fred¦Mr. Fred⟧.
** The puddle of Creep left at the end of the projectile's path lasts longer than the Creep trail.
** This projectile can kill the chasing Fistuloid.
The Matriarch's Chubber and regular projectiles deal a whole heart of damage.
After taking 340 damage, the Matriarch rapidly spawns waves of glowing red Fistuloids that have 20 HP and quickly lose health, causing them to shoot their maggots almost immediately.
After taking enough damage, the Matriarch repeats the phase transition attack from Phase 1 to 2. During the rest of this phase The Matriarch no longer spawns Fistuloids and only uses the Chubber and projectile attacks.
When at low HP (after taking ~540 damage), The Matriarch's shell splits into a medium-sized Fistula, 2 small Fistulas and a Fistuloid, and she turns into a low HP ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧.
* Previously orbiting Fistuloids, including the one spawned, permanently orbit her Chub form, while previously active Fistuloids continue to chase Isaac.
* The Matriarch as Chub always spawns charging in a random direction, regardless of Isaac's position, before returning to the normal Chub pattern, similar to the Chargers spawned by ⟦e:sloth¦Sloth⟧.
* If the Matriarch eats a Bomb during her charge attack, she spits it back out at Isaac.
** Most bomb modifiers will still be present on the bomb, except for ⟦i:353¦Bomber Boy⟧.
bosses.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ The Matriarch is unique in being twice as common than other Boss Room Bosses in the Scarred Womb boss pool, but only 1/4th as common as other Boss Room bosses in The Womb.
** This makes her the only boss in the game to have a boss weight higher than 1 on any floor.
** This also makes her the only boss to have a special weight which isn't an alternative variant of another boss on the same floor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Pile slowly slides around the room slowly and performs the following attacks:
* Burrows underground, then quickly reemerges elsewhere in the room and fires 5 bone projectiles in a spread towards Isaac. The Pile repeats this attack 3 times in a quick succession. It will generally try to reemerge close to Isaac or directly in his path to cut him off.
* Summons a Bony with a maximum of 2 alive at once.
* Summons spikes in each of its cardinal directions which start at the edges of the room and move towards the Pile.
* Charges in Isaac's direction and continues until it rams into a wall or an obstacle, creating two diagonal lines of rock waves away from the wall and launching a spray of bone projectiles in Isaac's direction. If it runs into an obstacle it also destroys it along with any other obstacles in a small radius.
** The Pile gains dramatically increased knockback resistance while charging.
bosses.notes:
* ⟦t:14¦Callus⟧ and ⟦i:571¦Orphan Socks⟧ prevent Isaac from taking damage from spikes summoned by The Pile.
** ⟦t:151¦Flat File⟧ has no effect on these spikes.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Rainmaker floats slowly towards Isaac and performs the following attacks:
* Creates two horizontal lines of 6 projectiles each on both sides of himself, then fires them towards Isaac at intervals starting from the far ends towards the center.
* Creates a ring of 12 projectiles around himself, then fires them towards Isaac in short staggered intervals starting from 2 opposite ends of the ring.
* Summons a large water projectile overhead, then pops it, unleashing a burst of projectiles in random directions.
* Twirls around, following Isaac's movements while summoning projectiles around himself which hover briefly before being fired towards Isaac.
** At the end of this attack, the Rainmaker releases 8 projectiles in a radial burst.
The Rainmaker deals a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes: * The Rainmaker can be immediately killed with ⟦i:653¦Vade Retro⟧ if he is at 50% health or below.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Scourge floats quickly around the room, attempting to get above Isaac's position. It can perform the following attacks:
* Shoots a large, fast cluster projectile out of its hood that homes in slightly on Isaac. When it hits a wall, it explodes into a spray of projectiles, leaving behind damaging Green Creep and a cluster of Small Maggots.
** If The Scourge is below half health, it instead shoots out three slower, smaller cluster projectiles from out of its hood that create fewer projectiles on impact.
* Launches one of its tendrils towards Isaac and embeds it in a wall. It then drags the tendril along the wall, causing projectiles, creep, and Small Maggots to shoot out from the wall.
* Launches two tendrils and embeds them into the wall, one directly at Isaac and one in the cardinal/ordinal direction opposite of him. It then starts rotating its arms around while shooting two rings of 12 projectiles outwards.
* Launches two tendrils to either side of Isaac, embedding them into the wall and trapping him in a triangle-shaped area. It will then perform one of two attacks:
** Fires walls of tight projectiles with gaps to pass through from its body. It follows up each wave with an additional, faster projectile aimed directly at Isaac.
** Fires horizontally travelling projectiles randomly out from both its left and right tendrils.
** If Isaac gets caught out of this triangle space for any reason, The Scourge will cancel this attack.
*** The three previous attacks end if The Scourge or its tendrils take enough damage. Each tendril has a total HP of 400.
*** The Scourge takes damage equal to 25% of the damage its tendrils take.
*** The tendrils passively take heavy damage if they're dragged along a wall, dealing a total of 50 damage to The Scourge for each tendril dragged.
*** The tendrils kill Small Maggots they are dragged into.
* Moves to the center of the room and begins sucking in 2 tight streams of projectiles towards it in a spiral pattern. This spiral pattern can randomly switch directions during the attack. Additional random projectiles can appear in the gap between the two streams, further limiting the space.
bosses.notes: * The Scourge is instantly killed by ⟦i:631¦Meat Cleaver⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Shell always spawns in a pair consisting of 4 body segments and a head segment each. They are always fought in a double-sized room.
* Flies around the room diagonally, bouncing off of walls while dealing contact damage; behaving identically to ⟦e:the-hollow¦The Hollow⟧.
** Unlike the Hollow, however, if Isaac is close to the vicinity of its head, it veers slightly in Isaac's direction.
* Normally invincible, but bombs and explosives can destroy its bony exterior (after 15 damage per segment), making its segments vulnerable. There are always one or two Bomb Grimaces that dispense Throwable Bombs for Isaac to use against The Shell.
* When the armor on their body is destroyed, the exposed flesh segments lose the ability to fly, and will spawn Fly Bombs if the segment is at the very end, or shoot a volley of three shots at Isaac if the segment is in the middle.
** The Shell moves slower if there are exposed flesh segments attached to its head.
* If a group of conjoined flesh segments have been detached from the head, they chase directly after Isaac at a very slow pace and continue to attack normally.
** If a single flesh segment has been completely detached, it becomes stationary but continues to spawn Fly Bombs.
* The Shell cannot split into smaller copies; when split down the middle, the side containing 3 segments with at least one of end segments having armor turns into a new copy of the boss with one of the armored body segments turning into a head segment.
** Flesh body segments on the shorter side detach and behave normally but armored body segments are automatically destroyed.
* The Shell's head cannot be damaged or destroyed and dies once it loses all its segments.
bosses.notes:
* ⟦i:592¦Terra⟧ can destroy the The Shells' armor, along with any items that create rock waves like ⟦i:351¦Mega Bean⟧ and ⟦i:484¦Wait What?⟧.
** ⟨16⟩ ⟦p:hagalaz¦Hagalaz⟧ will also remove their armor on use.
* ⟦i:463¦Sulfuric Acid⟧ tears cannot destroy their armor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
* If Isaac has any familiars, The Siren sings, charming up to 3 familiars at a time to assist her and turning their effects against Isaac.
** Isaac's familiars when charmed retain most of their behaviors when assisting The Siren but can now deal contact damage and block shots.
** Charmed familiars have 60 HP and return to Isaac when killed.
* If she has less than 3 charmed shooting familiars from Isaac, she summons up to 3 orbiting Siren Minions of her own. These familiars behave identically to ⟦i:8¦Brother Bobby⟧ but with a slower fire rate and can also be killed. She then glides around the room for a few seconds, letting her familiars use their effects against Isaac. If she has any familiars alive after this, she swipes at Isaac, launching all remaining familiars in a cluster in his direction.
** When the cluster collides with a wall it kills all the familiars and releases a burst of radial projectiles and a cluster of disorganized projectiles.
*** The amount of projectiles launched during this attack depends on the number of familiars that collided with the wall.
* Swipes a short distance in Isaac's direction, releasing 5 projectiles.
* Sinks into the floor becoming invulnerable and chases Isaac, leaving a trail of slowing black creep. After reappearing, she swipes at Isaac, shooting a spread of 5 projectiles.
* Screams, emitting a consistent shockwave around her and spawning 9 pulsating rings of projectiles that expand outwards.
** This attack pushes Isaac away like an inverted Gaping Maw.
** The rings of projectiles have openings towards Isaac's general direction.
Upon death, The Siren burns away, leaving behind her skull.
bosses.notes:
* Bombing the skull that the Siren leaves behind spawns and unlocks the ⟦t:141¦Forgotten Lullaby⟧.
** It only spawns the ⟦t:141¦Forgotten Lullaby⟧ the first time it is bombed.
** Bombing the skull in subsequent runs treats it as a regular Skull in regards to its drops.
** Leaving and returning to the room causes the skull to disappear.
* ⟨15⟩ The Siren can charm ⟦c:lilith¦Lilith⟧'s Familiars, including her ⟦i:360¦Incubus⟧, hence making Lilith a difficult character to kill The Siren with. To counter this, either bait The Siren into launching the familiars into the wall and killing them or use bombs/active items to deal damage.
* ⟨15⟩ Charmed familiars with a charged attack (eg: ⟦i:275¦Lil Brimstone⟧) hold their charge until the Siren launches the familiars.
* ⟨15⟩ Lasers from charmed ⟦i:95¦Robo-Baby⟧ and ⟦i:267¦Robo-Baby 2.0⟧ do not hurt Isaac.
* ⟨15⟩ Charmed ⟦i:681¦Lil Portal⟧ can still collect pickups and create a portal.
** ⟨16⟩ Charmed Lil Portal does nothing and has no hitbox.
* Charmed familiars that are thrown (eg: ⟦i:273¦Bob's Brain⟧) do not count towards the count of 3 familiars that orbit the Siren but are included in the cluster thrown at the end of the attack.
* Charmed ⟦i:188¦Abel⟧ mirrors The Siren's movements and shoots at her, though these projectiles are dangerous towards Isaac and do not hurt The Siren.
* Charmed ⟦i:567¦Paschal Candle⟧ will still grant a tears buff while charmed.
* Charmed ⟦i:268¦Rotten Baby⟧ spawns Attack Flies instead of Blue Flies and ⟦i:280¦Sissy Longlegs⟧ spawns Spiders instead of Blue Spiders.
* Charmed ⟦i:645¦Tinytoma⟧ orbits The Siren but still blocks hostile projectiles and turns into friendly Blue Spiders after being destroyed. It will also not return to Isaac when destroyed and will spawn charmed again for The Siren.
* Temporary familiars and ⟦i:472¦King Baby⟧ cannot be charmed.
* Charmed knife familiar cannot be damaged while it returns after a stab.
* Charmed ⟦i:528¦Angelic Prism⟧ will still split tears and deal contact damage to the character, but it wont work for the enemy.
* Charmed ⟦i:155¦The Peeper⟧ / familiar from ⟦i:605¦The Scooper⟧ will still have the effect of increasing eye damage. The creep from ⟦i:605¦The Scooper⟧ will damage enemies.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Stain burrows underground when Isaac is not within range. While burrowed it becomes invincible and follows Isaac's movements. When close to Isaac, it pops out and performs one of the following attacks:
* Sends out 2 patterns of numerous projectiles in all directions. The first barrage consists of fast-moving bullets that slow down. The second barrage consists of slow-moving bullets that speed up.
* Sends out tendrils to its left and right leaving small puddles of damaging Red Creep directly around The Stain and to its either side.
* Spawns 2 Chargers and can have a maximum of 3.
It will stay vulnerable for a brief moment after performing an attack before quickly burrowing underground again.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Visage is bound together by a chain and cannot be damaged; the chain must first be destroyed to progress the fight, and has 150 HP. During this phase, it only has one attack:
* The heart slowly wanders around the room, and the mask attempts to move toward Isaac, constrained by the length of its chain (which reaches up to 4 tiles outward). Occasionally, the mask charges at Isaac when he approaches it from any cardinal direction, predicting his movements. Upon colliding with a wall, the mask launches out a spray of rock projectiles before being pulled back to the heart.
** The mask cannot charge if it’s close to Isaac.
** The chain only extends for this attack, it's normally rigid and constrains the mask and the heart to a specific length.
** If the mask hasn’t charged in a while, it starts pulling the heart with it in its attempt to reach Isaac.
Once the chain is broken, the mask and heart are unbound from each other and their behavior changes:
* The mask freely moves around the room, briefly speeding up and chasing Isaac if it sees him in a cardinal direction.
** The mask has 100 HP, and can be damaged by explosions, piercing shots, or by being shot in its open back. Upon death it deactivates, which stops it from moving, dealing contact damage to Isaac, or from firing certain projectiles when used by the heart. However, it can still block Isaac's tears.
* The heart now actively avoids Isaac, but also uses a chain to perform a variety of attacks in conjunction with the mask:
** Launches a chain to the mask. Once attached, it directly pulls the mask in and fires a horizontal helix of ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers that pushes both backwards into a wall.
*** The lasers and pushback don’t happen if the mask is deactivated.
** Launches a chain to the mask. Once attached, it swings the mask around in a spiral while also bringing the two closer. The mask fires red projectiles outward while being reeled in. If the mask collides with wall before it unites with the heart, it creates rock projectiles on impact and is then pulled directly to the heart.
*** The mask doesn’t fire projectiles while being reeled in if it’s deactivated.
** Launches a chain to the mask. Once attached, it directly pulls the mask in and then jumps onto Isaac's position, creating a burst of rock projectiles as well as 4 rock waves in the diagonal directions upon landing.
** Launches a chain at Isaac. If the chain hits him, it pulls him into the heart, causing him to take contact damage. If the chain misses, it pulls the heart into the wall it hits, creating a burst of rocks and red projectiles. This attack can only be used if the mask is deactivated, and takes higher priority once it becomes available.
*** Unlike all other attacks, the chain directly hitting Isaac doesn’t deal damage, only him being pulled into the heart does.
*** If the chain hits a bomb while being launched, the bomb instantly explodes and the attack is cancelled.
When the heart drops to half HP, its visual outer shell breaks, exposing the heart. The Heart's movement becomes quicker and more erratic along with an attack change:
* Launches a large, slow-moving energy ball known as Visage Plasma in a diagonal direction that bounces off of walls. If this projectile touches the mask, it fires a ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ laser out its back, rapidly propelling it in the direction it was facing and creating rock projectiles and a radial burst of 8 projectiles upon collision with a wall.
** If the mask is deactivated, Visage Plasma will automatically travel towards it, reviving it as well as causing its normal effect.
** Visage Plasma have 50 HP, and can be destroyed by Isaac.
** The heart always begins the phase with this attack.
* Briefly stops moving and fires out a ring of 16 red projectiles.
* If there are 3 Visage Plasma floating around the room, the heart sucks them in, drawing in Isaac in the process. Each Visage Plasma absorbed heals the heart a small portion of HP. After absorbing all 3, it fires out 4 tight rings of fire along with 4 short-range diagonal ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers.
** The mask deactivates during this attack, regardless of its HP. Unless the heart is on a far side of the room and Isaac is far away enough, Isaac must hide behind the mask to dodge this attack, as the rings of fire are too dense to weave through.
Once the heart has been killed, the mask permanently deactivates.
bosses.notes: * The Visage's deactivated mask can be still targeted by effects such as ⟦i:722¦Anima Sola⟧.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Wretched's behavior is similar to ⟦e:widow¦Widow⟧'s: making large leaps towards Isaac, and can perform the following attacks after landing:
* Leaves a puddle of White Creep that is slightly larger than Widow's, and shoots 8 white projectiles outwards.
* Spits out 2 Spiders, a Big Spider, or a Trite.
** The Wretched can kill her own summons if she jumps on top of them.
* ⟨24⟩ Spawns 3 Spiders upon death.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Triachnid's head hangs down stationary and can perform the following attacks:
* Raises his head, making it invulnerable, and stomps the ground in random locations around the room 3 times in quick succession, leaving small puddles of slowing White Creep. ⟨24⟩ One of these legs will always stomp on top of Isaac's position.
** The appendages that he stomps with can be attacked to damage him.
* Lifts his head off-screen and stomps the ground 3 times at regular intervals on top of Isaac's position, leaving a small puddle of White Creep with each stomp. At the end of the stomps, he slams his head down quickly in the center, shooting 8 white projectiles in all directions and creating a large puddle of White Creep. He can only slam his head down along a horizontal plane across the center of the room and slams it down close to Isaac's position.
** Occasionally performs a fourth stomp before slamming his head down and very occasionally performs a fifth.
** Occasionally, when he slams his head down, he leaves a larger puddle of White Creep, but only shoots 4 white projectiles in the cardinal directions.
** The appendages that he stomps with can be attacked to damage him.
* Spits out a Trite in Isaac's direction.
** Trites can be killed by Triachnid's stomps and head slam.
Triachnid's foot stomp and head slam deal a whole heart of contact damage.
bosses.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ Unlike all other other alternative versions of bosses, such as ⟦e:dangle¦Dangle⟧, ⟦e:c-h-a-d¦C.H.A.D.⟧, and ⟦e:gish¦Gish⟧, Triachnid has the same weight as his alternative boss form.
** Although they share the same weight, Triachnid is actually more common than ⟦e:daddy-long-legs¦Daddy Long Legs⟧, since he also appears in the Scarred Womb.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Tuff Twins always spawn in a pair consisting of 5 body segments and a head segment each. They are always fought in a double-sized room.
* The Tuff Twins roam around the room randomly, like ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧
* The Tuff Twins are initially covered in rock armor that gives them immunity to all non-explosive damage, but bombs and explosives can destroy their armor, making their segments vulnerable to all damage.
** There are always at least two Bomb Grimaces that dispense Throwable Bombs for Isaac to use against the Tuff Twins to break their armor.
** All segments have damage resistance to explosives both before and after having their armor removed, taking only 25-14% damage based on how far away the explosion is from them.
*** This also applies to Isaac's tears if they have an explosive effect, such as if he has ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧, ⟦i:52¦Dr. Fetus⟧, etc.
** The armor absorbs up to 15 damage before breaking, and is independent of the segments' 35 HP value.
* Head segments occasionally spit Inks while protected by its rock armor.
** Vulnerable head segments spit Suckers instead.
** Head segments will not try to spawn Inks or Suckers if there are at least 4 total in the room. However, head segments can occasionally spawn multiple in succession, bypassing this limit.
* Vulnerable body segments spew bloody shots, similar to Boils.
* Tuff Twin segments can be split into smaller copies of the boss as long as the new Tuff Twin segments are longer than 2 pieces.
* The Tuff Twins become faster the more rock armor they lose.
bosses.notes:
* ⟦i:592¦Terra⟧, along with any items that create rock waves like ⟦i:351¦Mega Bean⟧ and ⟦i:484¦Wait What?⟧ can destroy the Tuff Twins' armor.
** ⟨16⟩ ⟦p:hagalaz¦Hagalaz⟧ will also remove their armor on use.
* ⟦i:463¦Sulfuric Acid⟧ tears cannot destroy their armor.
* Destroying all the Bomb Grimaces with effects like ⟦i:503¦Little Horn⟧ and ⟦i:496¦Euthanasia⟧ and then somehow wasting all of the bombs they drop when destroyed can soft-lock Isaac in this fight.
* ⟦i:475¦Plan C⟧ cannot kill the Tuff Twins if they still have their armor.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Turdlet consists of 5 separate segments that travel together similar to ⟦e:larry-jr¦Larry Jr.⟧, and acts the following way.
* Moves around the room loosely chasing Isaac, making wide turns and bouncing on walls.
* After 7 seconds of normal movement, huddles its body together, then launches tail-first towards Isaac while straightening out. Its head end spins around its tail while bouncing against walls at high speeds before eventually decelerating to a full stop.
* Turdlet leaves a trail of slippery Brown Creep wherever it moves.
* After dropping to 30 health or less, Turdlet splits into two parts with two segments, each continuing the same behavior.
** The health each split Turdlet has is equal to the health the original Turdlet had when it split, plus 15.
** While both parts are alive they coordinate the launch attack by huddling together.
bosses.notes:
* Using the ⟦i:631¦Meat Cleaver⟧ on Turdlet instantly skips its first phase.
* Since the health Turdlet's split segments have scales depending on how much health the original Turdlet have when it split, if a strong attack (like a Bomb or ⟦p:ii-the-high-priestess¦II - The High Priestess⟧) causes Turdlet to split, its split segments will have significantly less health.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
The Turdlings spawn as a pair and wander around the room. Each individual Turdling has one attack in total which is performed independently of the other:
* Rushes towards Isaac when aligned in any cardinal direction, leaving behind slippery Brown Creep until it has run into a wall.
** After rushing into a wall, it spawns 4 Brownie Corns that launch out in the cardinal directions.
** Occasionally, after rushing into a wall it will fart, knocking back Isaac and nearby Brownie Corns.
** Its dash can be interrupted if it runs into a Brownie Corn.
bosses.notes:
* ⟨24⟩ The Turdlings are much less common than their counterparts, spawning only 1/4th as often.
* ⟨16⟩ ⟦i:291¦Flush!⟧ kills Turdlings instantly and causes them to leave behind 6 Dips each.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Unlike the other Ultra Harbingers, Ultra Death has only one phase and has three attacks which he cycles through indefinitely:
* Summons a rectangle of 11 Ultra Death Scythes which close in towards Ultra Death's position and continue in the same direction until disappearing off screen. Ultra Death uses this attack 3 times in a succession.
* Flies off screen, then reappears travelling slowly while summoning waves of Ultra Death Heads which move up and down across the screen in the same direction. At the end of the attack, the skulls freeze in place and Ultra Death summons three harmless scythes which spin outwards, destroying the skulls.
* Immediately after the previous attack, the screen darkens and Ultra Death disappears into the darkness. Ultra Death appears next to Isaac and swings his Scythe before disappearing again, darkening the screen with each attack. This attack is repeated 4 times, afterwards, the screen returns to normal and Ultra Death reappears.
** His position during this attack can be indicated by a faint glowing red eye.

source.source: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki (wiki.gg) — CC BY-SA 4.0

bosses.behavior:
Ultra Famine has two attacks which it alternates between:
* Matches Isaac's vertical position and charges off screen. Appears from a random side of a screen and fires a spread of five lines of five projectiles towards Isaac that lose speed before disappearing again. This attack is repeated five times.
* Moves across the screen from one side of the screen to the other, oscillating between the top and bottom of the screen. Ultra Famine spawns a swarm of Ultra Famine Flies behind himself as he moves. Each fly charges towards Isaac when he is close and continue to move in the same direction until disappearing off screen.
After dropping to 1/3rd of his max health, Ultra Famine loses his horse and body becoming only a head. In this phase, Ultra Famine only has one attack which he performs continuously from the center of the screen:
* Continuously fires projectiles in a counter-clockwise pattern, while simultaneously firing 6 bursts of projectiles outwards with alternating orientations.

bosses.rewards:
Final Boss Chest (Ending 18)
Greed Donation Machine
bosses.behavior:
Ultra Greed is fought in a unique vertical double-size room with golden Boss Room doors on all 4 walls in regular positions.
When Isaac enters the boss room, Ultra Greed starts out hanging on a noose before he abruptly cuts it off and lands on the ground. Ultra Greed cannot be damaged until he drops to the ground. Ultra Greed then performs a variety of attacks in addition to wandering around the room:
* Stomps on the ground 4 times, spawning a ⟦c:keeper¦Keeper⟧ with each stomp. Only 4 Keepers can be alive at once.
* Charges at Isaac when he is in line of sight.
* Shoots either 3-5 coin projectiles in a spread from his mouth, or a cluster of coin projectiles, similar to ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧.
** Ultra Greed does not perform this attack if Isaac is far enough away.
* Spins around the room, firing coin projectiles in random directions.
* If Isaac is too close to Ultra Greed, he performs a spin, kicking Isaac away in the process.
* Stops moving and rotates his eyes in a slot machine manner. If both eyes land on the same symbol, he then spawns multiple Ultra Greed Coins of the same symbol.
** If the two symbols on Ultra Greed's eyes don't match, he spawns Ultra Greed Coin (Spinner).
* If there are too many monsters/coins alive at once, Ultra Greed assumes a defensive stance. While blocking, Ultra Greed takes much less damage from Isaac's attacks, and maintains this state until most of the monsters/coins have been killed.
All of Ultra Greed's attacks deal a full heart of damage and cause Isaac to drop coins on hit. If he walks over any coins on the ground, he collects them, healing him for 4.375 HP each. Doing so also makes him slightly more aggressive. Heart coins also make the boss angrier.
When Ultra Greed has low health, he turns red, which increases his attack speed and movement speed. This effect also occurs if Ultra Greed is healed by enough Heart Ultra Greed Coins, although only providing a temporary effect.
* The scaling speed increases if ⟦a:246¦Everything is Terrible 2!!!⟧ has been unlocked by using the Greed Donation Machine.
When Ultra Greed's health bar is depleted, he turns into a golden statue and drops the end chest and the Greed Donation Machine. If in Greedier Mode, he instead begins his second phase.
bosses.notes:
* After Key Coins appear, using ⟦p:a-card-against-humanity¦A Card Against Humanity⟧ causes spawned Gapers to be stuck and, as long as they're alive, Ultra Greed will not attack.
* Having ⟦i:236¦E. Coli⟧ (and perhaps other contact-based collectibles) is a fast way of disabling the Bomb, Key, or Heart Coins because they don't do contact damage. However, unmarked coins do.
* ⟨4⟩ Except for direct contact and the ⟦i:118¦Brimstone⟧ lasers, all of Ultra Greedier's attacks only do explosive damage. Therefore having ⟦i:223¦Pyromaniac⟧ or ⟦i:375¦Host Hat⟧ makes this phase of the fight much easier to survive.
** ⟨24⟩ The rock waves after Ultra Greedier's jump attack are no longer considered explosive damage.
* ⟨28⟩ The entire room will be turned to gold when he dies. This is due to a special shader that turns on in the room when he dies, so using effects like ⟦p:a-card-against-humanity¦A Card Against Humanity⟧ or ⟦p:xvi-the-tower-reversed¦XVI - The Tower?⟧ will make the grid entities spawned look golden.
* Any poop spawned in the Ultra Greedier fight, destroyed or not, will respawn as Golden Poop when Ultra Greedier dies and turns the room into gold.
** ⟨24⟩ This effect is only visual, they act like regular Poop when destroyed despite the gold color.
* If you manage to spawn a Sticky Nickel (possibly through a ⟦i:166¦D20⟧) Ultra Greed may station himself over it and no longer move around the arena.
* ⟦i:638¦Eraser⟧ can allow the Ultra Greedier phase to be skipped if you use it on Ultra Greed when he has 15 or less HP.

bosses.behavior:
Ultra Pestilence spawns with a swarm of Ultra Pestilence Flies that hover around himself for the entire duration of the fight. He has two attacks which he alternates between:
* Launches a large ⟦i:149¦Ipecac⟧ projectile at Isaac's position. Upon landing in the lava below, it creates a pillar of poisonous cloud, creates a burst of projectiles that shoot upwards from the lava, and creates 3 additional projectiles that shoot upwards from the lava on both sides of the pillar. This attack is repeated 3 times.
* Fires a large maggot from his eye which flies across the screen, wrapping around three times. Before it completes a fourth wrap, it reverses direction, wrapping around three more times before re-entering Ultra Pestilence's eye. Where the Maggot comes from depends on how many screen wraps it has done:
** After the first screen wrap, the maggot aims at the top third of the arena.
** After the second, third, and fourth screen wrap (the maggot reverses directions after the third), it aims at Isaac.
** After the fifth screen wrap, it aims at the top third of the arena again.
** After the sixth and final screen wrap, it aims at Ultra Pestilence, re-entering his eye when he hits them.
After dropping to 40% health, Ultra Pestilence loses his head, begins to periodically spawn Ultra Pestilence Flies around himself, and uses two attacks:
* At the start of this phase, Ultra Pestilence's steed spawns an Ultra Pestilence Fly Ball which follows Isaac. Attacking this ball of flies spawns additional flies. Ultra Pestilence performs this attack one more time after dropping to 20% health.
* Fires a spray of projectiles from his empty neck, which rain down on the area in front of it.
bosses.notes:
* ⟦i:503¦Little Horn⟧ or ⟦i:496¦Euthanasia⟧ can kill the maggot projectile.
* ⟦i:382¦Friendly Ball⟧ can be used on the maggot projectile.

bosses.behavior:
Ultra Pride differs from its normal counterparts by having attacks more similar to ⟦e:super-sloth¦Super Sloth⟧ and a Baby than ⟦e:pride¦Pride⟧. They perform attacks independently of each other.
Edmund wanders randomly around the room and performs one of two attacks:
* Shoots out 3 arcing homing projectiles.
* Throws out a horizontal line of Green Creep if Isaac is to his left or right.
** The line is cone-shaped and will always be wider to the right end, no matter which direction it was sent from.
Ultra Pride Edmund deals a whole heart of contact damage.
Florian slowly floats towards Isaac and can randomly teleport around the room.
* If Isaac is close, he periodically shoots out a homing projectile that deals one full heart of damage.
* Florian has ⟨7⟩ 25 HP / ⟨24⟩ 30 HP.
bosses.notes:
* If Edmund is defeated last, Ultra Pride drops ⟦t:61¦The Left Hand⟧, regardless of whether or not it has already appeared during that run. If this is the first time it is defeated, the Left Hand achievement is also unlocked.
* If Florian is defeated last, there is a 25% chance to spawn ⟨7⟩ a A Treasure Room item / ⟨24⟩ the ⟦i:609¦Eternal D6⟧ if it has been unlocked.
* ⟨7⟩ Florian is treated as an ordinary Baby by the game, so it still has a chance to spawn as an Angelic Baby. This will override its unique appearance.
* ⟨30⟩ In one room, two Edmunds can spawn instead of one of each.

bosses.behavior:
Ultra War charges in from the side of the screen and has two attacks which he alternates between:
* Throws a large, Giga Bomb that deals contact-damage and explodes mid-air in a cross pattern that spreads across the entire screen, similar to ⟦i:353¦Bomber Boy⟧ Bombs. The Bomb also releases a burst of 12 lines of 4 projectiles outward when it explodes. This attack is repeated 3 times.
* Charges off-screen, then wraps around the bottom of the screen 3 times, creating 4 to 6 pillars of harmless light in alternating positions across the screen, from which large lava projectiles launch upwards with staggered timing.
Ultra War dismounts from his hobby-horse and has two new attacks which it alternates between:
* Chases Isaac, then lunges diagonally downwards in Isaac's direction. After, Ultra War releases 4 streams of fire in the cardinal directions as well as a small burst of slower moving fires in all directions. This attack is repeated 2 times.
* Lunges diagonally downwards while holding a large bomb which explodes in a cross pattern that spreads across the entire screen. Ultra War then bounces across the sides of the screen 3 times while moving upwards before plummeting into the lava below. When Ultra War emerges, he creates 4 to 6 large lava projectiles that launch upwards with staggered timing.
* Upon death, Ultra War explodes, which can damage Isaac at close range.
bosses.notes:
* If Isaac has the ⟦t:63¦Safety Scissors⟧, the Giga Bombs Ultra War throws will be defused and fail to explode, after which they can be picked up or left to fall into the lava.
* Ultra War's Giga Bombs can be killed by ⟦i:496¦Euthanasia⟧ shots.
* The lava projectiles can be slowed and knocked down with certain slowing items such as ⟦i:387¦Censer⟧ and high knockback tears.

bosses.notes:
* The angels will always alternate in order of appearance. Thus, if Uriel has just been defeated, the next angel spawn is guaranteed to be Gabriel and vice versa.
* If the player defeats an angel, and they already have both Key Pieces, no Key Piece drops. However, if this occurs, it counts as a normal room clear, and the player may be rewarded with a pickup or chest.
* Angels only drop a Key Piece the first time they are defeated, even if Isaac does not pick up the Key Piece, subsequent kills in the same run provide no pedestal item rewards.
** ⟨28⟩ Angels will drop a Key Piece even if they were defeated before. Additionally, if Isaac has one of the Key Pieces, angels will always drop the other piece, even if he already skipped that piece or that particular angel normally wouldn't drop it (for instance, Uriel will drop Key Piece 2 if Isaac already has Key Piece 1 from fighting him earlier).
* Rerolling ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ or ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧ will yield an item from a pool, depending on which room the Key Pieces are in.
** Rerolling the Key Pieces in an Angel Room will yield an item from the Angel Room item pool.
* The angel's beams of light are rendered at a height, though their hitbox is on the ground (and their shadow is invisible). For diagonal beams, this causes Isaac to take damage even if he is below them, and allows him to partially walk into the beams if he is above them.
* ⟨28⟩ Angels will drop items from the Angel Room item pool instead of the Key Pieces if Isaac is holding ⟦t:123¦Filigree Feather⟧.
* ⟨28⟩ Sometimes, two angel statues can appear in the same room. Destroying both at the same time will spawn both Uriel and Gabriel, but only one Key Piece will drop. If each angel is spawned and defeated separately, both will drop Key Pieces.
** ⟨24⟩ Both angels will drop key pieces if fought at the same time.
* Uriel and Gabriel are immune to the Fear effect.
* When spawned inside a Sacrifice Room, the room is not locked, allowing Isaac to simply walk out of the fight.
** When returning to the Sacrifice Room, the angel will be gone.
** ⟨3⟩ As a result, it is possible to miss obtaining ⟦i:238¦Key Piece 1⟧ while getting ⟦i:239¦Key Piece 2⟧.

bosses.behavior:
* Charges either left or right off-screen and continuing on from the opposite end of the screen. Continues until he has crossed the screen three times.
** He performs this attack more often if Isaac is to his left or right.
* Shoots eight projectiles in all directions.
* Ascends off-screen and summons 5 Troll Bombs.
** Returns from the side of the screen.
Once his health is below half, War's horse blows up, dropping War, who performs a crying animation.
* War charges quickly at Isaac gradually building speed and making more tighter turns.
** Every time War loses around 1/3rd of his remaining HP in this phase, he pauses briefly to sob before restarting this process.
War deals a whole heart of contact damage in both phases and during his charge.

bosses.behavior:
Widow makes large leaps towards Isaac, at approximately double the distance of ⟦e:monstro¦Monstro⟧, and can perform the following attacks after landing:
* Leaves a puddle of White Creep and spawns a Sack.
** There is a maximum of 3 Sacks alive at once.
* Spits out a Spider.
* Widow can kill her own Spiders and Sacks if she jumps on top of them.

bosses.behavior:
* Lunges from a pit towards Isaac, releasing 4 projectiles in the cardinal directions in the air. Wormwood then chases Isaac in a zig-zag pattern, before eventually returning to a pit.
** If Wormwood lunges out of a pit and lands on top of another large pit, he returns back into that pit.
** Eats any Bombs dropped in his path same as ⟦e:chub¦Chub⟧ while chasing Isaac, stunning him for a moment before dealing considerable damage.
* Partially emerges from a pit and fires a spray of disorganized projectiles at Isaac before re-submerging.
* At 33% health, Wormwood pierces the ground with his tail at Isaac's location with a short delay 3-6 times. Pits are created where Wormwood pierces the ground. Afterwards, Wormwood charges out from inside the left or right wall horizontal to Isaac's location while spawning 3 Small Leeches. He then chases Isaac for a short duration before returning to a pit.
** Wormwood can never create a pit in a spot that would trap Isaac.
** Wormwood takes increasingly reduced damage after reaching 33% HP until he performs this attack and takes only 20% damage while performing this attack.

bosses.behavior:
* Wrath wanders around the room randomly, occasionally standing still.
* Throws a Bomb towards Isaac if he is in line of sight and then attempts to run away from the bomb.
** Wrath takes only 20 damage (as opposed to the usual ⟨7⟩ 60 / ⟨24⟩ 100) from his own bombs.
Wrath deals a full heart of damage (both bombs and contact).
bosses.notes:
* ⟨6⟩ Occasionally, 2 regular Wraths appear in a Mini-Boss Room and the boss message will display "Isaac vs ⟦e:super-wrath¦Super Wrath⟧".
* Isaac's bombs and ⟦i:168¦Epic Fetus⟧ missiles deal 200 damage to Wrath regardless of modifiers or damage stat.
* ⟨7⟩ Wrath can drop ⟦i:37¦Mr. Boom⟧ even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.

challenges.description:
The starting room spawns with no rooms connected to it. Rooms spawn in clusters around the map and must be found via the ⟦i:580¦Red Key⟧. While the Red Key can be used an infinite number of times, it has 20 uses before ⟦e:dark-esau¦Dark Esau⟧ spawns. Each subsequent 5 uses will spawn another Dark Esau if ⟦e:dark-esau¦Tainted Jacob⟧ has yet to turn into his lost form. The Red Key cannot be used to open doors to I AM ERROR rooms.
Each floor generates as a Curse of the Labyrinth floor, with one shop, and two item and boss rooms, except the fourth floor, which has only one boss room. All rooms may be from any floor of the current chapter.

Some obstacle sprites are randomized even within a level and sometimes the music may be missing altogether. Occasionally, even the floor texture might glitch out, replacing it with a plain color.
